title: Trash Pit
description: A frantic twin stick shooter where you and your enemies are only ever one hit from death. Mow down relentless waves of robots, collect upgrades and claw your way to the highest score you can.

title: Lil Splody: Look Out Below!
description: Zodac and his minions are wreaking havoc! It's up to you to dodge and blow up falling enemies in an attempt to rescue your fellow bomblings!

title: Dungeon: Faster & Deadlier
description: In this singleplayer card game, full of strategic options yet simple mechanics, your brain gets what it craves. Heroes fight under your command in a vast, dark world. They crush their enemies with your prudent judgement, spells, cult items and brute force. Or vice versa.

title: Islands of the Caliph
description: Islands of the Caliph is an old-school RPG with grid based movement set in a fictional island civilization. Thematically it draws on Middle Eastern folklore and religion, offering a lore-rich setting for your character's journey.

title: Rocco's Inferno
description: Rocco's Inferno is a top down, narrative role playing game inspired by The Sopranos and the crime films of Martin Scorsese. You play through a day in the life of Rocco Dante, a captain in the Reggiani crime Family. Who will still be living by tomorrow, is up to you.

title: Meet me at Noon
description: Meet me at NooN is a cozy puzzle game with brain-scratching time-loop mechanics. Control two spirits that create time loops each day, learn their different behaviors, how they can interact with each other and how these interactions are interfering with their time loops.

title: Spelldash
description: Spellburst is a fast paced magical FPS game where you control fire, air, ice and lightning elements to use various spells, fight against exotic monsters and explore different planets with parkour and platforming elements

title: Dumb Little Robots
description: Dumb Little Robots is a 2d puzzle game where you control robots that each have a single function. Help them work together to solve tricky levels. Meet new robots as you go and learn how they change the possibilities!

title: Ballads of Hongye
description: "Ballads of Hongye" is a unique city-building game. Unlike the conventional city-building games, lands in Ballads of Hongye are expanded by finishing the challenges in a limited time. Once you own the lands, you can take your time to build your dream oriental city with over 150 different buildings.

title: Exodemic
description: Destroy aliens, dash between planets, and buy powerful upgrades. Exodemic is a compact roguelike that combines frenetic shoot 'em up gameplay with a procedurally generated overworld filled with vendors, trading hubs, and combat encounters. Race against the clock to save the human race.

title: ElbmarKs
description: A tribute to the magnificent side-scrolling Arcade shoot’-em-up games with a modern look, physics-based movement, and some challenging twists that will test your speed, reflexes, accuracy, patience, and memory at the same time.

title: Aledorn
description: Spiritual successor to many old school hard-core RPG/Dungeon masterpieces, that combines tactical combat system, exploration in the first person view and intriguing travelling system between main map locations.

title: Just Power: The Papal States
description: Are you ready to found a dynasty which controls the Holy See over the centuries? Climb the hierarchies, hire your relatives, blackmail and bribe to get everything you want in this turn-based political simulator.

title: Magical Harvest
description: In this 3D-fantasy farming game you are the one who wants to save the world of Hyldena from the loss of all magic. While exploring Hyldena, you will be able to evolve plants and animals into magical variations and even learn how to use magic yourself with alchemy.

description: Fight of Steel: Infinity Warrior is a new fighting game with ultimate freedom. Players will have the opportunity to customize their own fighter from the appearance to fighting moves.

title: Stone Mirth on Earth
description: Stone Mirth on Earth is a comedy fantasy point and click adventure in which you will take on the role of Stone Mirth, the volcanic stone from Mars who has to save the earth from an evil stone in order to return to his home planet and prove himself a hero.

title: Raccoon Crafts Factory
description: Raccoon Crafts Factory is a game about creating automated factories to produce things of increasing complexity, within an endless 2D world - Use your imagination to design factories, combine simple elements into complex structures.

title: Hero Chest
description: The perfect combination of Roguelike, Hack Slash and Card Game! In Hero Chest you are an angry chest that got tired of being looted and decided to finish them all! With powers and special cards create the dungeon and strategize to reach your goal. An adventure full of combat and gold!

title: Contrablade World
description: Speed through a vast open world and experience incredible battles while you advance your Contrablade in a quest to challenge and beat the mythical gods. A brand new adventure RPG in the unique action physics fighting franchise Contrablade.

title: Space Ballers
description: Space Ballers it's a game between ships that aims to score the most number of goals in challenging arenas with many obstacles along the way.

title: Dreamlined
description: Dreamlined is a physics-based automation/destruction game about building machines and crushing dreams.

title: Astrolander
description: Astrolander is a revolutionary action-packed reimagining of platformers. Embark on a thrilling adventure featuring innovative 2.5D fused with 3D environments and gameplay, unique mechanics, and breathtaking worlds. Take control of a curious robot on a roll named Feedback and an adventurous rocket powered sidekick named Haptic on a quest to save the Most Valuable Programs (MVPs)!

title: Vedette
description: You are the head of an experimental anti-crime task force in the city of Osteria. Use search history, recent emails, and criminal backgrounds to determine whether an individual is likely to commit a crime. The choices you make will have a significant impact on the entire city’s future.

title: Mira and the Legend of the Djinns
description: An epic 2D pixel art style Metroidvania, inspired by Moroccan culture and spiritual traditions. Wield powerful ancient weapons and forge your way through unrelenting deserts, crumbling necropoli, floating islands and dangerous mountains as you try to uncover the secret of the last Djinn.

title: Rail Walkers
description: Rail Walker, noun, a semi autonomous rail-mounted turret attack weapon. Defend against the swarms of intelligent insects threatening your mining infrastructure. Construct rail tracks, strategically move, repair, recharge, reload and upgrade your rail walkers in the battle against these enemy waves.

description: Multi Idle is an idle game that features Exploring, Adventuring, Hero's, Dungeons, Raids and many more in its own kind of idling way. Get stuck in an endless loop of trying new things every time you play!

title: Magirune 2
description: While mining in the search of water, an artifact is found. Learn the secret of this world in this casual dungeon crawler.

description: Explore a diverse island, from dense jungles to snowy peaks. Harvest resources, craft gear to keep monsters at bay. Sneak into pirate camps to free captured creatures, who will become powerful allies. Create a home, tend to your farm and make the island your own. Ikonei is fully in your hands!

title: SGS Spain at War
description: The complete Spanish Civil War from July 1936 to April 1939, with all units, weapons and events included on a weekly base. The most complete strategy game made on this conflict. Fight for your ideals, and take control of Spain!

title: Wildlife Planet: The Incremental
description: Wildlife Planet is a Simulation & Idle game with the theme of wildlife and nature. You will unlock more and more species as you level up and learn the species knowledge. This is a game with refreshing scenes, immersive background music, and different kinds of wild animals and plants.

title: Green Wounds
description: Craft, manage resources, fight enemies, and explore the unknown in this medieval RPG.

title: Welcome to the Backrooms
description: There must be an exit somewhere. Keep your wits about you as you traverse a seemingly endless labyrinth of dingy yellow walls and moldy carpet. Find candy bars and almond water to keep your strength, and stay out of the shadows to keep your sanity.

title: The Complex: Found Footage
description:
Experience the liminal world of the backrooms through a VHS camera, immersing into a mysterious story and wandering the dream-like structures... Might there be something following you?

The Complex: Found Footage is a walking simulator with the world being viewed through a VHS camera. Uncover a mystery that lies in the world of "The Complex", though it may leave more questions rather than answers...

title: Bitlands
description: Platform across strange, magical terrain while meeting even stranger friends and enemies! Discover the history behind the Bitlands, and unlock new allies and powers to traverse the dangerous worlds of the Bitlands, and restore peace to a broken kingdom.

description: Froggo Swing 'n Grapple is a retro platformer game about a little frog on an adventure. Swing 'n grapple through the stages with Froggo's powerful and sticky tongue!

description: Super Hamster Havoc is a twin-stick arena shooter about a war between hamsters and rats.

description: Super Kiwi 64 is a 3D-Platformer and Collect-a-Thon, in a low poly late 90s console look.

description: Welcome back to Smooth Operators 2! Smooth Operators is an advanced simulation where you take control of a customer service company and lead it to financial success! Hire employees and customize your buildings with different types of offices, facilities and accessories!

description: Top Town is an upcoming life simulation game. Create a character and define your own goals and identity by choosing a profession and hobbies. Buy your dream house, visit stores and explore in a persistent and reactive world.

ARPG elements, fantasy environments, legendary loot, a skill system along with many secrets to be discovered!

description: Knight Crawlers is a dungeon crawling ARPG with physics based ragdoll combat. Each crawl is made unique through dozens of skill cards to choose from. description: Race at hypersonic speeds through retro-inspired courses in Synthwave RacersⓇ, an indie-arcade racing game with melodic 80's-inspired synthwave tracks, and tight percision-based action racing gameplay.

title: Fantasy Fishing Town
description: Welcome to Fantasy Fishing Town! Cute pixel graphic x side scroll fishing. It's a unique pleasure! Legendary fish! You're mine!

title: One Life

description: Now is your time to become the ultimate Meiro Master. Earn your way in to the history books and fulfill your childhood dreams of becoming the unrivalled Meiro Master.

Enjoy the chaos and whimsy of simulated characters and environments in this action arena brawler that will keep you hooked with surprising combat twists and gameplay variety. Board the spaceship, we're off to the next scrimmage!

description: Help find these adorable gnome creatures. Is it behind the tree? Is it in the bushes? Look, what shuffles over there? ]Features hand modeled stylized low poly lush 3D environments with as much interaction as possible, supported by atmospheric music. And comics! Its all about the feel.

description: The very first Blitzkrieg campaign of WW2 is covered by this game on a daily basis. And you can also explore alternative situations of different war starts, with the ‘What-if’ scenarios. Man your tanks!

title: Crusader: Dungeon Series
description: Crusader: Dungeon Series Dungeon of Dagginor is the first in the series and is a simple dungeon crawler.

description: Hall Infinite is a challenging infinite runner with multiple varied environments and several playable characters! You will require precise timing and deliberate movements in order to achieve a high score.

description: Car Mechanic Manager is a tycoon management game that lets you manage your own car mechanic business! Build, expand and modernize your car workshop to maintain a good reputation and attract more customers. Manage your business efficiently and destroy the competition!

description: Adorable Witch 3 is a level puzzle game. Players need to control various mechanics in the level to help the witches and elves of the Magic Academy get flowers to pass the trainee witch test.

description: Rabbit’s Tale, a hand-drawn metroidvania roguelike. Play as a Rabbit in search of his kidnapped family, but along the way something mysterious happens: you get lost in a purple Void, a procedural world where dying is permanent. A Venom-like creature tags along. You bound by survival.

title: Revenge on the Streets 3
description: In this new and last continuation, the wife of the former crime boss assumes her role as boss and puts an end to the life of the game's protagonist's brother, helps Karina and her family get the last fight in "Revenge On The Streets"

description: A 2D Online RPG where you can become the most wanted pirate, the strongest bounty hunter or even the highest-ranking Marine! Customize your character to be uniquely yours, level up and find treasures. Start your adventure in the world of Pirate Souls now!

description: A Game Boy styled fishing horror adventure

description: Two silent wanderers,6 full chapters,A game of exploration and adventure

description: An immersive choose-your-own-adventure survival horror with optional adult content featuring hand drawn backgrounds, sprites, and over 150 pieces of full screen art- and 50 endings.

description: New Horizon is a survival with RPG game. Explore a vast world in search of resources, build, upgrade your equipment and fight monsters to survive.

In it, you will follow friends, Sarissa, Dandara, Elaine and Patricia, as they go on an adventurous journey, where love and friendship, and a fated destiny will change their lives forever.

description: It is a retro 3D block breakout that you can easily play. All operations are possible with only the mouse, and the ball behaves by physics.

title: Happiness Double Room
description: The summer has come to an end. You've been kidnapped by a sister you've known for a long time. Leave all your troubles, stresses and worries behind. Live a happy life with your sister in the next few weeks!

description: Lilium is an action role-playing game taking place in a very small, but dense open world. It has a short, interesting main story, several side quests, dungeons and exciting secrets waiting to be discovered. Find your fun by interacting with your surroundings, develop your character, loot everything.

title: Naughty Waifu
description: Move all parts to form the complete image.

title: Comixxx Memories
description: Comixxx Memories is a casual game with relaxing atmosphere featuring high quality, hot & sexy girls done in comic book style. Enjoy the classic card match gameplay.

description: Airborne is a combination of 2D Platformers, Rage Games, Parkour, while also being packed with Action. You need to get to the end of the level by dodging Spikes, Bullets, Turrets, Lasers and more!

title: Disc Golf: Game On
description: The fun of disc golf, coming to PC and console. Featuring six different throw types, ten unique courses and tons of new plastic!

title: The Backrooms: Lost Tape
description: You work in the cinema as an usher and accidentally fell into the Backrooms, now being trapped, needing to unravel the mysteries of the yellow rooms in order to get out of this place, but be careful, there are entities that will be in your way.

title: Twilight Monk
description: Explore the shattered world of Speria as the last remnant of ancient Kung Fu warriors in Twilight Monk! Destroy demons, or enslave them as you hunt down and obliterate the portals from whence they came. In Twilight Monk, you will explore Metroidvania dungeons connected by an open world.

description:
Solos is a puzzle bullet hell with "paper style" graphics.
Practically you'll have to create your own bullet hell, by avoiding bouncing bullets you'll shoot trying to hit all screen elements.

title: Happi Basudei
description: Oldschool platformer which you found on an untitled random cartridge, where you win by doing nothing. Well... except evading.

title: Anno 1800: Seeds of Change
description:
The 1st DLC of the Anno 1800 Season 4 Pass.

Be part of the new world’s agricultural boom with the modular haciendas and face the challenges of a new scenario.

title: Anno 1800: Empire of the Skies
description:
Using the latest construction materials from the New World, you can build a variety of new specialized airships.

Optimize your logistical network by transferring goods and workers between your islands in the New World, and keep your people connected with the new mail system.

Your tactical planning will also take on a whole new dimension as you and your competitors vie for aerial mastery.

title: Anno 1800: New World Rising
description:
The 3rd DLC of the Anno 1800 Season 4 Pass.
Experience the cultural boom in the New World, celebrate with a new population tier and discover new islands to expand!

Anno 1800 DLC 12 includes the following content:

Discover a brand-new, high class society residence tier for the New World – the Artistas.
Take advantage of newly spotted islands on the New World map and use the additional space to expand your empire further.
Embrace the culture of your New Worlds residents by building the Stadium, the grand new monument.
Be able to experience Anno without tax income and beat the ever-changing market to reclaim lost artifacts in the fourth Scenario of Anno 1800.

Granado Espada M

description: Gather together troops and weapons to fight through increasingly difficult armies in this rogue-like deck-building game. Establish synergies between your cards and treasures to create the strongest army!

description:
On Halloween, everyone wants candy, and everyone dresses up to look scary—but can you tell the difference when something truly terrifying actually happens?

Step into the role of Michael, who returns to sort out the aftermath after his parents passed away. On a bizarre Halloween night, you’ll tidy up the house and encounter all kinds of strange people—can you tell apart what’s truly terrifying?

The game takes 10-20 minutes to complete, depending on how much you explore the scenes.

description: Quester is a role-playing game for PC, released by Thousand Games on 2023. Kazushi Hagiwara was deeply involved in the production and based on his suggestions, it was produced by Thousand Games. It's an indie game and includes hack and slash.

title: Sumy Shelltris: Iceblocks 1
description: Tetris? Not! Mutant Tetris!

description: Stranger Danger or Horror, Quest and Magic is a Survival Horror game where you, as the protagonist, must escape from a mad clown who appears in random stages of his anger. The killer clown is a psychopath. He is a unique type of enemy. He likes to play with the protagonist before dealing with her.

description: A slow-paced, story-driven, first-person game that offers an abstract and surrealistic exploration of a troubled mind in its journey towards acceptance.

description: Zombies and Keys is a short action-adventure game with simple, satisfying combat and pure exploration, carefully designed to minimize cognitive load. Perfect for someone who values gameplay over everything else.

description: A medieval turn-based RPG

description: A mixture of incremental/idle and roleplaying game set in fantasy world filled with monsters and things to explore, where battling is constant, almost everything can be upgraded, and with wide array of various prestige mechanics to always keep things interesting and moving forward!

description: Shoot bloody demons and giant penises with your extremely Naughty naked shotgun in this fast paced doom-like FPS!

description: The injured kitten was brought home... One day she takes on a human form! "I got a millenary cat” is a placement game in which you can observe the life of a cat girl.

description: Ship Graveyard Simulator: Submarines brings a new and exciting addition to the game we know and love. Have you already disassembled all the ships on the sandy beach? Then now it’s time to put your skills to test with submarines!

title: Lord of the Click 3
description: The Orcs are getting closer and very soon they will get so close that it will be impossible to get out of the elf kingdom. For the good of the people, the king himself is ready to stop the army of monsters. It will be difficult to determine how this battle will end if you don't help him!

title: Our Fate Forsaken
description: Zeph passed away and became an angel. He first meets Archangel Gabriel, who is very possessive of him. And on Earth, he meets Asa, with who he feels a connection. Gabriel used to be his guardian angel, and Asa is still his soulmate. It's no wonder the two are fond of him. Maybe too fond of him..

title: Faircroft's Antiques: The Mountaineer's Legacy
description: It's summer in the French highlands for Mia Faircroft! Discover a picturesque mountainside town in this Hidden Object game. Explore breathtaking locations, restore priceless treasures, and help out the various residents of Mont Cache!

title: Gate Builders
description: Gate Builders is a sci-fi turn-based 4X strategy game. Build space stations, manage work force, exploit, trade and transform resources. Face space pirates and enemy factions. Build, Expand, Thrive!

title: SGS Pacific D-Day
description: One game, five great battles where the US Marines gained even more glory, at the price of terrible losses. Relive bloody assaults on Saipan, Tinian, Tarawa, Iwo Jima and Peleliu in this recreation of epic land battles of the Pacific War. Both sides are playable, each with their own challenge

title: DragonScales 7: A Heart of Dark Flames
description: The ultimate DragonScales experience. Tile-matching puzzles, battles and a journey of revenge and redemption.

title: Eastern Europe Truck Simulator
description: Eastern Europe Truck Simulator offers everything a trucker’s heart desires!

title: Maze Workout: Western Lost Solo Car Racer
description: It's a retro western styled, maze racing game with 50 levels and 30 western style musics, find the checkpoints and laps to the next level.

title: NSFW Studio
description: NSFW Studio is a casual arcade idle clicker game where your job is not only about editing porn videos, but also fucking your freelancers at your work desk. Your side chicks might not like what you do, so keep an eye out and don’t get caught!

title: Ghost Girl Lasling
description: This is a story of Lasling, a talented genius teenage girl with amazing working abilities, who becomes a ghost after an accident. The only person in the world she is visible to is Mofft, the male main protagonist. Their meeting is as if a fateful encounter and love story begins.

title: Paige Turner
description: In this adventure, you'll travel through a magical library and platform your way through a library lost to time in order to reconnect a father and daughter after tragedy tore them apart. Utilize unique abilities to overcome the library's troublesome obstacles and unlock the pieces of the story!

title: Funerary Services Marquez Paz
description: Enter the rough streets of Marquez Paz, Argentina. Explore the neighborhood and meet its peculiar inhabitants, work for "the fune" and get some cash, cave the head in of a couple of idiots and get some more cash. Get used to it, because the things you're going to see... Oh... Good heavens!...

title: Jasper Vice: Legends Untold
description: Soar, dive, and explore the floating islands as a young Gryphon in this flying fantasy adventure. Delve into the lore and discover what it means to be a Voyager.

title: Minotaur Princess
description: Rescue the Princess? You are the princess! Defeat the minotaur? You ARE the minotaur! Embark on the journey of a princess who gets body swapped with a minotaur. A puzzle fighter RPG where your wits and cunning will be put to the test in a combination of turn based and real-time gameplay.

title: Lifecraft
description: Survive and evolve as an organism with this simulation game in which you will literally start as a single cell and manage and organize all its functions to a fully fledged system! Assemble, breathe, eat, fight threats, produce energy, grow, anything is possible!

title: The Forked Road
description: The Forked Road is a story about traveling through a dead world in search of a place to call home. Which path will you choose, and can you not lose yourself?

title: Steel Deal
description: Play as an unnamed guy and solve the mystery of an old mansion while being haunted by a welder. Discover an epic journey through many exciting and hard levels!

title: Enjoy
description: A very different kind of destruction game where you can build, knock, break, crush and destroy anything you want

title: Dark Hood
description: 2D Platformer. Combination of cyberpunk and magic.

title: Land Above Sea Below
description: Land Above Sea Below is an atmospheric building strategy and puzzle game where you have to build your island from tiles in order to raise its height as much as possible, to avoid it getting flooded by the constantly rising sea level.

title: Eftu
description: In a world threatened by a mysterious interdimensional entity, pick your guild, pick your ship, and pick your battles! Compete with other guilds for resources in a variety of game modes, including Team Versus, Battle Royale, and Racing!

title: GG-Party
description: Dive into the wild open-world party game for up to 8 players! Explore the island, crush quests for big cash, grab properties and shops, and pull sneaky pranks on your friends. The first to become a millionaire wins the game!

title: Mini Island: Cosmos
description: Mini Island: Cosmos is a one small hold & Gun, boss Rush mini-game of Casual difficulty!

title: Gloomgrave
description: Gloomgrave is a roguelike dungeon crawler with a retro pixel aesthetic. Upgrade your Gloomcrawler with unique perks and experiment with different builds as you try to survive each depth in search of the ultimate ancient relic.

title: Raise Your Tribe
description: RAISE YOU TRIBE and fight against Robots or other Survivors. Explore, Craft, Build and Survive in a deadly post-nuclear war island where artificial intelligence has defeated humanity. Start from scratch and end up as the leader of Island!

title: Looping Bravery
description: Looping Bravery is a sci-fi deckbuilding roguelike card battler. Try to find a way to save the planet from an impending alien invasion by traveling back in time to stop an event knows as "The Marking" from happening. Fight in the past to save the future.

title: Mana Launcher
description: Embark on an epic MMO multiverse adventure in a totally free RPG game, and become a legend which will be remembered across generations, universes, be memorable in whole worlds. Feel the mana power growing on you!

title: SpellTome
description: SpellTome is a story driven fantasy adventure 2D platformer. Hurl balls of magic, dash across levels, and jump over obstacles while trying to get the fabled SpellTome.

title: Duks
description: Duks is a simple survivor type of minesweeper game

title: Heads Will Roll: Downfall
description: Heads Will Roll: Downfall is a combination of a tactical role-playing game and visual novel, in which you will assume the role of a medieval soldier.

title: Nightfall Comes
description: Nightfall Comes is a 3D top-view action game with rogue-lite, story of the four protagonists who gathered to the castle of certain land, led by their last lingering feelings in the extinct world.

title: Dashing Orange
description: A 2D precision platformer about a little Orange that can dash and jump around this abstract world to avoid all the traps in the way to reach you goal.

title: Dissonance
description: Dissonance is a top-down 3rd person adventure game. Players will encounter supernatural anomalies and creatures. Find and use specialized gadgets to aid you in your journey. Explore the abandoned research facility and reveal the secret of the organization that sent you here.

title: The Hand of Glory: The Blowtorch Files
description: A young girl, Erica Thimber, vanishes into thin air overnight. Is it a classic teen runaway? That's not what Lazarus Bundy, renowned serial killer hunter in charge of the case, believes.

title: Baller Blast
description: A new twist on the classic brick-breaker!

title: Cat Nips
description: Cat Nips is a game about a cat eating people to escape an office. This cat will need to sneak past guards, cameras and other dangers in order to escape.

title: Hinter
description: Hinter is a horror game based on a brutal piece of disturbing crime case in Bavaria Germany

title: Stardust Exile
description: Stardust Exile is an RTS set in the Milky Way galaxy, containing currently known stars and exoplanets with their real characteristics. The remaining star systems are procedurally generated. It has both online mode and single-player skirmish mode. The online server is persistent and single-shard.

title: Hostlight
description: Hostlight is a first-person puzzle game with mechanics that revolve around the use of light and shadow, and the creation of objects that help to solve the puzzles throughout the game.

title: Emiko's Pledge 2
description: Emiko's Pledge 2 is a 2D Platform Action game based on the story of a Half-Demon girl called Emiko, whose mission is to protect all the residents of the Ettaze state from the enemies who infiltrated into the territory.

title: The Golden Rose: Book One
description: Explore an alternative medieval Europe in this low-fantasy epic adventure! How far are you willing to go to take back your stolen treasure?

title: Jack & Detective
description: Find Jack out among us.Players are divided into "Jack the Ripper" and "Detective" and try to guess who is Jack.You cannot talk to other players in this game, so you must deduce who is Jack by relying solely on the actions of each player. Each game takes 10 minutes.

title: Chapel 3-D: The Ascent
description: Chapel 3-D: The Ascent is a break-neck, violent boomer shooter inspired by classics of the genre. Experience the story behind the events of Cathedral 3-D and make your enemies regret ever crossing your path. Become a beast and let loose.

title: Tennis Manager 2022
description: Become a tennis manager. Manage your tennis academy and train the next tennis super stars. Even more realistic, with new players and updated potentials. Take the reins in 2022.

title: Home Survival
description: Home Survival is an open-world game that is a unique combination of first and third person shooter, survival, crafting, and role-playing games. Experience your own path. Whether it's building the home of your dreams, tending to your crops and watching the sun go down.

title: Prince of Suburbia
description: Prince of Suburbia is a kinetic adult visual novel with only one thing on its mind. This simple sandbox game is packed with lewd scenes and sprinkled with a fun story that aims to never leave you wanting more.

title: Madville+
description: Madville+ is an arena shooter with rogue-lite elements, where you fight incoming waves of aliens and customize your guns as you progress. It is designed to have short play sessions (30-40 min) and replayability.

title: Nightmare Party
description: Nightmare Party is a 5 player co-op multiplayer horror FPS. You are trapped demon hunters and your goal is to survive and escape while a demon and its minions try to kill you.

title: Kargo
description: Collect containers with your spaceship to activate color-coded gates, navigate through challenging levels as fast as possible and deliver your cargo in this 2D cave-flyer with a focus on puzzle elements.

title: Bloody Forest
description: Bloody Forest is an online co-op survival horror game for 1-5 players. You got lost in the forest and you are looking for potential inhabitants or something to repair your car. But what you don't know is that a monster lives here.

title: Spirit Hunters: Infinite Horde
description: You are the Spirit Hunters in this action rogue-lite. Slay huge waves of monsters and harvest their souls for ever increasing power. Unlock many playable characters, abilities, maps and more through a deep progression system.

title: Cartomancy Anthology
description: The Cartomancy Anthology is a virtual tarot deck of 22 games from 22 teams that replicate the actions and experiences of tarot readings by shuffling and drawing cards. Pull a single game, or a spread of three, for a digital reading. Launch and complete each game to collect all the cards and complete your virtual tarot deck!

title: Empty War
description: "You're the best warrior in your planet. Now your race want to conquert everything, and you're the only one to stop them."

title: Koa and the Five Pirates of Mara
description: Join Koa and her best friend Napopo on an action-packed adventure through the islands of Mara! Outwit traps, manoeuvre dangerous environments, and explore a series of dazzlingly different landscapes on their quest to recover stolen pirate loot.

title: Jewel Match Origins 2: Bavarian Palace - Collector's Edition
description: Travel back in time to the Romantic Era and build a magnificent castle in this royal match-3 adventure! Explore 180 huge levels and collect resources to construct a majestic palace for the Bavarian King. Enjoy 3 different modes: timed, relaxed, and moves limited!

title: Back 4 Blood: Tunnels of Terror
description: Tunnels of Terror features the all-new PvE areas “Ridden Hives”, along with 2 new playable Cleaners, new Legendary Weapons, 12 weapon skins, new cards, 8 premium skins, and the fearsome Warped Ridden to discover below the depths of Evansburgh.

title: Eldertrail
description: Eldertrail is a turn-based strategy with rpg elements and adventure cards based exploration. You will take control of unique heroes, explore the world, build up your town, fight tactical battles, craft legendary weapons, level up and evolve your units and heroes to take out your opponents.

title: Expeditions: Rome - Death or Glory
description: Don the armour of a Gladiator and enter the arena to win fame and fortune in ‘Death or Glory!’ Play with the new Gladiator character class as you tackle 3 new arenas either during the campaign or in the brand-new Gladiator mode.

title: Magic Tower: Destroy the Wormhole
description: Magic Tower: Destroy the Wormhole is a fixed value strategy game. Similar to the gameplay of the classic magic tower, on this basis, new gameplay, rich skills and prop types are added. Players can choose different routes to train the role.

title: Fernbus Simulator: Top Class DD
description: This DLC includes the Top Class DD. A luxury double-decker bus for Fernbus Coach Simulator

title: DzombZ
description: Survive or die ! Experience survival horror full of puzzles while escaping between the streets of Algeria after zombies invasion . Suffer to protect your life in situations never attempt them before with first person perspective and powerful actions that make it more realistic then ever

title: Engine Evolution 2022
description: PvP racing action is back - with more and better content, and with formulas! Enjoy multiplayer racing action more intense than ever before!

title: Tameshi
description: Tameshi is a retro-themed vertical scrolling shoot 'em up for 1 or 2 players (local co-op). Battle through 7 stages of relentless waves of enemies all bent on your destruction. Destroy them first before taking on the end of stage boss.

title: Jigsaw Puzzles Infinite
description: Build jigsaw puzzles - solo and with friends! Assemble one of the many included puzzles, or add your own images. Customize size and shape of the pieces for any puzzle. Sit back, relax and build puzzles to your heart's content.

title: Wingspan + European Expansion
description: Immerse yourself in a relaxing, serene world of unusual birds from two continents and expand your wildlife preserves.

title: Virtual Circuit Board
description: Virtual Circuit Board is the minimalist drawing-based logic simulator where you will design, program, decorate, and simulate anything from simple monochrome circuits to complex and colorful computers. Explore your creativity in this sandbox experience.

title: Zombie Death Quota
description: Help Special Forces operative Della retrieve the Bio-waste containers that are causing the zombie outbreak. Grenade, shotgun, snipe and flame your way through the zombie horde and then evacuate in the helicopter.

title: Escape Room Academy
description: It takes the joy of Escape Rooms in a casual and joyful experience. Resolving riddles, getting clues and cracked puzzles have never been so fun and cheerful. Each room has its own quest, and to solve it you are provided with two decks of cards(Clues and Locks) and a room view to inspect.

title: Motorcycle Travel Simulator
description: This is a casual motorcycle driving game, but also a purely realistic travel game. You can ride a motorcycle to travel in the vast open world and enjoy the magnificent scenery!

title: Deadly Rain
description: Deadly Rain is a survival horror FPS game that puts you in a terrifying fight for survival against hordes of scary mutants in a rainy, abandoned village. Find and manage resources to stay alive in the worst and most unexpected situations.

title: Neon Ronin
description: Neon Ronin is a rogue-lite tactical RPG set in a stylish cyberpunk world. Combine unique attacks and abilities with powerful augments to conquer ever-changing encounters. Customize your party's stats and talents as they level up to craft a strategy and squad strong enough to survive the neon city.

title: Hard Drive
description: Explore the cyberpunk world of Hard Drive as you work as a driver and hacker in order to pay down your debts and uncover the secrets of the city.

title: Panic Porcupine
description: Dr. Proventriculus is snatching up the Chickabirbs! Help Panic blast through over 50 stages of topsy-turvy, spike-laced, slime-drenched, buzzsaw-filled deathtraps to rescue them! And remember, there are no rings...

title: TactiCats
description: Knock down your enemies and collect all the cats and achievements in this pixel art party game for true cat lovers. Use different power-ups and survive the dangerous traps to show your friends who's the fluffiest of them all!

title: Gales of Nayeli
description: Face an impending darkness threatening the world of Iuven alongside Nayeli and an interesting cast of warriors. Control varied battlefields in Grid-Based Strategy RPG format while interweaving character relationships to the main conflict.

title: Peep Invasion
description: Forge your team from a variety of different creatures, each with their own strengths and abilities, and stop the never-ending invasion of Peeps!

title: In Sink
description: Work together to solve the various puzzles and escape rooms and break free in this stylized multiplayer co-op adventure. Victory requires more than just you and your partner thinking alike - you'll have to be In Sink.

title: Tremblay Island
description: The French-venture has returned... now on Steam!

title: Kapellmeister
description: Run. Hide. Follow the orders. Keep quiet. Solve puzzles. Don't forget to check the cameras; someone is stalking you. And if you are lucky, maybe you'll get out of this loop of never-ending and repeating events.

title: Maroon Berets: 2030
description: Maroon Berets: 2030 is FPS, TPS, Action-RPG; which simulates the units of special forces in the war.

title: Voodoo Detective
description: Do you like adventure, comedy, and dime store detective novels? Then boy have we got the game for you! Join Voodoo Detective in a story-rich, hand-drawn noir where you’ll pit your wits and hoodoo know-how against a sinister evil that’s taken root on beautiful Zo Wanga Isle.

title: Ethereal Rift
description: Ethereal Rift is a procedurally generated ARPG based around crafting builds, gathering items and hack and slash combat. Play with up to 4 players in this dark fantasy adventure, slaying huge creatures and dark spirits to bring peace to the middle worlds.

title: Overdose WW2
description: Overdose WW2 is an FPS game set in the Second World War. It is a game that aims to offer an experience like 90s FPS games. Overdose comes with content that aims to offer you a long gameplay and nostalgia. The game is an FPS game set in the second world war.

title: The Breadmaker
description: Welcome to the kitchen of the future! Learning to cook has never been simpler! Enjoy five days of easy to understand recipes guided by our brand new automated instructor. As she helps you with each day's lessons you'll discover that cooking isn't really as scary as you thought.

title: Backrooms: Levels of Fear
description: If you're not careful and no-clip out of reality in wrong areas, you'll end up in the Backrooms, where it's nothing but the stink of moist carpet, the madness of mono-yellow, and endless background noise of fluorescent lights at maximum hum-buzz...

title: Murder on Space Station 52
description: Trapped on a space station with a ruthless killer, Edward Locke must solve this mystery, or it will be his last. In this strange place, filled with even stranger people, Edward will discover more about himself than he ever could have imagined.

description: A fast paced parkour game where you have to get to the pizza at the end of each level using your speed, quick reflexes and abilities. Wall run, jump, climb, use your grappling hook to get the fastest time! Set in a gorgeous neon world. For fans of titles such as Mirror's Edge, Hot Lava and Karlson.

title: Hot Tentacles Shooter
description: Hot Tentacles Shooter is a formidable 80's style shooter with a pixel art modern and irresistible.

title: The Fantasy World of Mahjong Princess
description: This is a 2D Japanese Mahjong game with adult simulation features. You are a big Mahjong fan who got reincarnated in another world. As the world‘s top Mahjong tutor, you need to build your own team and train your students while developing special relationships with them.

title: The Legend of Gandar
description: The Legend of Gandar is an action-adventure video game. The player slips into the legend of Gandar, in the role of the farm boy. He woke up one day and received a strange letter, and so begins the story of a boy.

title: Astro Traveler
description: A retro style space sim where you mine, trade, bounty hunt, pillage, and explore. In this game you choose you own path as you navigate the galaxy while balancing faction alligence and legality of your actions.

title: Innocence Island
description: Legend has it that the three rays of light in the sky are emitted by a prism that grants happiness to the one who obtains it. You never believed in that, but it is your last resort...

title: World War ToonZ
description: Navigate across the city while surviving wave after wave of spectacular zombie attacks in this dramatic, high-action zombie apocalypse. As you progress deeper into the apocalypse, join your fellow troops in multiplayer to discover who will reign supreme as the final survivor.

title: La Pucelle: Ragnarok
description: For the first time in the West you can experience La Pucelle: Ragnarok, now loaded with lots of extra content including new scenarios, new recruits, and DLC characters! It even has new voices, new music, and quick travel, dood!

title: Runr End
description: Runr End is a challenging FPP-Platformer set in a dreamish world with secrets to discover. Be careful, don't be another fallen soul.

description: In the Spring Festival of 2005, the blizzard in Xuefeng mountain trapped the drama troupe performing in the village. At the same time, there was a homicide during the performance. Unlike the nervous members of the drama troupe, the villagers were afraid of a more terrible existence than the homicide

title: Runes Magica
description: Runes Magica is 2D rogue-like magic action game. Use a variety of magic and artifacts to defeat your enemies and end your revenge.

title: Adaca
description: Adaca is a Sci-fi First-person shooter set on the mysterious titular planet. Use your gravity-manipulating robotic arm to hurl heavy objects at your foes or even rip their weapons directly from their hands! Explore and manipulate the environment to stay alive and navigate this eerie, hostile world!

title: Hatsumira: From the Future Undying
description: From the development team behind the Grisaia series, Hatsumira -From the Future Undying- is a fantasy visual novel that transports you into a whole new world filled with swords and sorcery!

title: Kamiwaza: Way of the Thief
description: Join honorable thief Ebizo on the streets of Mikado, and put your thieving skills to the test! Will you walk the path of honor for the sake of family? The choice is yours to make.

title: Wish World
description: Leap into the world of Wish, a unique plane of existence filled with adventure and action! Around the world of Wish, the world is unfinished and must be restored, Jump into the past and future using dimensional doors! Do you have what it takes to save the world!

title: Lost In Space: The First Adventure
description: "Danger! Danger!" Play as Will Robinson, Dr. Smith and Robot in this 3D, point & click adventure game based on the TV show: Lost in Space. Explore treacherous environments, outwit classic Villains and solve countless puzzles and mysteries to rescue your fellow crew members of the Jupiter 2.

title: Flower Knight Hu Die
description: A hybrid visual novel-RPG where you take on the role of Hú Dié, one of the city's (unwilling) resident magical girls as she looks for the truth behind her best friend's disappearance. A sapphic magical girl romance set in the solarpunk city of Yánghuāchéng!

description: Horror Night is an Online Multiplayer Coop Third/First person asymmetric horror adventure game. You have to escape the monster, in a procedurally generated scenario by solving puzzles and finding items, alongside your teammates. Characters can be customized through cosmetics and skins!

title: Platformory
description: Platformory is a 2D platformer with minimalistic graphics, in which you not only have to prove your platforming but also your memory skills.

title: Gunner
description: Help the gunner destroy the enemy castle. By placing the right platforms in the right place, you can direct the cannonball to the desired position. Just set the cannon and fire!

title: Garage: Vamp
description: A visual novel by the esteemed smut artist hasselnut - garage:VAMP's premise is simple, you've got a hunky vampire living in your garage who is trying to fuck your wife. Will true love prevail, or will deep repressed desires become too much to bear?

title: TVG Journey
description: Voxel-like medieval escort game.

title: 2080 Apocalypse
description: 2080 Apocalypse is a combination of action-adventure, mystery, 3d platforming puzzle game. In this semi-open world, You have must fight with dead robots and bring a master cube. beautiful adventure with dead robots.

title: Shuuchakueki
description: There are three stories about departure and separation, each focusing on a different heroine of Air.

title: Phantom Thief Mew's Secret Prima
description: In an unexpected turn of events, Miu becomes a phantom thief. As a phantom thief, you have to carry out various mission along with her childhood friend, Chinatsu. To complete your mission,you have to sneak into the targetted location and dodge the obstacles in the way to proceed.

title: Ultimate Muscle Roller Championship
description: Take part in an incredible racing championship, among the most pumped up guys from all over the world.

title: Slot Shots Pinball Collection
description: Slot Shots Pinball Collection Early Access Coming Soon! Early access will include the Slot Shots casino themed table and the Bass Hunter fishing themed table! Purchasing early access will also include two future tables as they are developed and released-and included in the early access price!

title: Racing the Gods: Beyond Horizons
description: The most epic race of all times is about to start. You have been selected as one of the drivers representing earth. It’s race of live and death as only the fastest will survive. Do you have what it takes?

title: Call of Senpai: Waifu Warfare 2
description: Take control of Maria, a girl with Ukrainian roots. Explore the open world, complete "GTA-like" quests, your friends and handlers to earn points and qualify for the main "Call of Senpai" tournament. and your friends and handlers to score points and qualify for the main Call of Senpai tournament.

title: Mojito the Cat
description: Mojito the Cat will push your space vision to the limit, use the logic to find the shortest path to the exit. Rotate the pieces to reach all coins, get the fish scrape and go to the gate to jump to the next level

title: Star Math: Interstellar Rogue 2
description: Star Math is a sci-fi turn-based strategy game where you use your maths to defeat the enemy! Humanity is fighting a robotic threat from space of its own making! You will fight through a huge 100 area procedural saga map to defeat 9 boss ships, before you can fight the mainframe in the final battle!

title: O.A.C: World Begins
description: Are you a leader? Once you convince your nation you are their leader, it will be time to show the world your own political, people management and military strategy skills. O.A.C aims to be a breath of fresh air in the grand strategy genre that will inspire its own kind of videogames!

title: 3D Puzzle: Alchemist House
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

title: 3 Days: Ghosts of War
description: In the heart of the Afghan wilderness, amidst the chaos of war, you awaken to the stark reality of your mission: three days to navigate the perilous landscape, uncover hidden truths, and confront the ghosts of the past. 3 Days: Ghosts of War beckons you into a realm where time is your greatest adversary, and every decision carries weight.

title: Predator: Hunting Grounds - Wolf Predator
description: Become the master Xenomorph hunter and play as the most lethal foe your enemies will face in combat. This DLC pack includes the Wolf Predator premium class.

title: ShapeBreaker
description: ShapeBreaker is a survival clicker: click shapes to break them, preventing sanity lost, survive increasingly difficult waves. Earn coins, buy upgrades, and push further on your next run.

title: Space Voyager
description: Space voyager is a solo action/puzzle game with simple and effective gameplay. Swipe your way through space, but keep an eye of the fuel gauge !

title: Heads Will Roll: Reforged
description: Hardcore survival RPG with non-linear story that lets you play as a young medieval soldier who over the course of battles and adventures becomes the most formidable and respected knight of his era. Or, if he’s not lucky enough, perishes in the chaos of the Hundred Years' War.

title: Mr. Prepper: Animal Farm
description: Take care of the animals, repair the farm’s facilities, learn fishing, explore the new areas, adopt a dog, get to the bottom of the Agency’s special interest in the farm and discover the mystery lurking from above! Use what you learn on the farm in your shelter and breed your own animals!

title: Mad World: Age of Darkness
description: Mad World stays true to the classic MMORPGs but with unique art and grotesqueness. Fight along side your friends to take down formidable enemies, or fight against your friends to test your skills in a world full of fear, despair, and madness. This is Mad World.

title: Slayer
description:
SlayeR is an episode WAD made by Richard Wiles. It also includes four deathmatch maps.

The first level is rather unique compared to the others. It is a large, expansive map while the other nine levels are short to medium and quite focused.

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Legends of Mystery 3
description: Solve incredible puzzles with 1001 Jigsaw. Legends of Mystery 3. 500 photos to prove the existence of magic!

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4: Episode Metal
description: Sonic the Hedgehog 4: Episode Metal is a free downloadable "Lock-On" part of the episodic game Sonic the Hedgehog 4, released along side of Episode II. It enables any player who owns both Episode I and Episode II on the same console to play Episode Metal, thereby acting very similar to the Lock-On Technology pioneered by Sonic and Knuckles. Episode Metal explains the backstory to Metal Sonic's return in Episode II and also serves to connect Sonic 4 to Sonic the Hedgehog CD, befitting the latter game's recent re-release on digital download services.

title: The Quarry: Deluxe Edition
description:
As the sun sets on the last day of summer camp, the teenage counselors of Hackett’s Quarry throw a party to celebrate. No kids. No adults. No rules. Things quickly take a turn for the worse.

Enjoy some extra teen horror flair with The Quarry - Deluxe Edition!

This Edition includes:

- The Quarry Full Game
- Deluxe Bonus Content Pack: ‘80s-themed character outfits, instant access to the Death Rewind system, Gorefest Movie Mode option, and Horror History Visual Filter Pack

title: Sway
description: A short experimental bullet hell. Traverse a dubious reality. Talk to manifestations of your own insecurities. Avoid bullets like you avoid your real-life problems.

title: The Haunted: Hells Reach - The Fog
description: THE FOG - Welcome to DLC 2!The second brand new full level of THHR. The testers were excited about the brand new level and you will be too - so get the achievement "SALVAGED FOG" on all difficulty levels.

title: Here Comes the Wiji Waji
description: Here Comes The Wiji Waji is a multiplayer survival game, where several creatures went to a Playground, and one of them is the Wiji Waji, who is blood thirsty.

title: Side Bullet
description:
Side Bullet is a free-to-play, side scroll online shooting game.
Choose your cartel and use special skills and weapons to battle monsters and other players to be the last one standing!

title: Anno 1800: Gold Edition Year 4
description: Improve your experience in Anno 1800 with the Gold Edition Year 4, including the Season 4 Pass and the Deluxe Pack.

title: Anno 1800: Complete Edition Year 4
description:
Unlock the entire Anno 1800 experience with the Complete Edition Year 4, which includes the following digital content:

Season 1 Pass with three DLCs: Sunken Treasures, Botanica, and The Passage.
Season 2 Pass with three DLCs: Seat of Power, Bright Harvest, and Land of Lions.
Season 3 Pass with three DLCs: Docklands, Tourist Season, and The High Life.
Season 4 Pass, which includes the next three DLCs: Seeds of Change, Empire of the Skies, and New World Rising.
The Deluxe Pack, containing the Anarchist AI character, the soundtrack, a digital art book, and more!

title: Deck of Ashes: Tome of Dimensions
description: Tome of Dimensions adds new playable character with unique storyline, 100+ new cards to experiment with, and, of course, a variety of new deadly enemies.

title: Aqua Energizer
description:
Help Nemo collect the red flashing balls into the energizer. Jump into it and get the code for the next level.
Beware of enemies, but be wise; you may want to keep them alive. Nemo can't live without oxygen. So hurry up!

title: BMX Streets
description: Ready to hit the streets? BMX Streets brings the essence of street riding to your fingertips. Experience the next generation of BMX gaming with realistic physics, meaningful customization and a massive open world. Practice, experiment and explore to find your own unique style and master the streets.

title: Maximus 2
description: Maximus 2 is a fantasy beat-em-up (brawler) that focuses on crunchy and satisfying combat. We captured the spirit of some of the best classic beat-em-ups, melding them into one memorable experience. Fight solo or with up to 4 players cooperative multiplayer!

title: Adios Amigos: Galactic Explorers
description: Team up with your friends & family and explore the peculiar universe of ADIOS Amigos. A game with serious astrophysics in a comic setting for 1-4 players. Explore solar systems and discover planets, space stations, aliens, and artifacts. Improvise fuel efficient trajectories to keep your rusty ship running (and you might see your home planet once again). Toy with accurate and delightful space physics. Break into a space station with an asteroid. Tow a sofa into a black hole. Normal stuff.

title: MythForce
description: Inspired by beloved 80s cartoons, MythForce unites swords & sorcery with gripping 1st-person combat in a roguelite adventure fit for Saturday mornings. Brave the dungeon alone or join forces with friends to take on an ever-changing Castle of Evil!

title: Doomdark's Revenge
description: Those of you who took up their challenge and rode with them to battle against the cruel Witchking will need no reminding of that epic struggle. But now a new epic tale unfolds, the story of Doomdark’s Revenge.

title: Death Drive
description: Death Drive is a road trip visual novel inspired by classic American Gothic fiction.

title: Hot Lap League
description:
Take complete control of your vehicle, perfect your driving, and prove your place in the Hot Lap League. Drift and race your car around 150+ mind blowing tracks, each requiring unique techniques and strategies. Improving your time by racing your best is the only way to the top.
It’s you, the track and the clock - no driving assist, no nonsense.

title: Make a Good Mega Man Level: Episode Zero
description: MaGMML: Episode Zero, an interquel set between the events of MaGMML1 and MaGMML2, is a massive collaboration fangame brought to you by the team behind the MaGMML series! Play as the legendary (?) Reploid (?) Zero as he journeys through over 60 different levels from 40 different creators in a unique blend of Mega Man Classic, X, Zero, and ZX! Blast through levels with the aimable Z-Buster, the trusty Z-Saber, the long-range Z-Burst, and the wildcard Blank Drive, all backed by an expanded version of the elemental chip system from the Zero series.

title: Convenience Stories
description:
Are you ready to redefine convenience?
Step into the shoes of a convenience store manager in this charming business sim. Arrange and customize the store using a wide variety of products - candy, drinks, even hot meals. The choice is yours!
It takes care and attention to take your business to the next level. Listen to your customers, help them find what they're looking for, and they might just become regular shoppers!
When the time comes to expand, cooperation is the name of the game. Negotiate with suppliers and other companies to discover new products and unlock your store's true potential!

title: M.Duck
description:
M.Duck is a roguelite gallery shooter about a duck that knows magic.
Help Magic Duck fight his way up the mysterious tower that has been shining light on his pond each night and interrupting his sleep. Battle fearsome foes, discover new relics, uncover the secrets of the tower, and turn off that light once and for all!

title: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 13
description: Help run Pinecreek Hills and New England’s Minuteman Valley Help the famous Park Rangers run Pinecreek Hills. Have fun organizing events on Bluewaters lake, Cherokee river and Apache trail.

title: Vaultbreakers
description: Vaultbreakers is a top-down high-stakes adventure Action RPG. Fight challenging bosses in heroic brawler combat. Explore a dynamic world that reacts to your actions. Reclaim lost relics and escape! Play solo or with friends in savage PvE & PvPvE modes.

title: Hearts of Demons: Revenant
description: Hearts of Demon is a compilation of wads allowing you to play as various demons: Baron of Hell, or Revenant. Hearts of Demon features new weapons and player models, as well as many demonic abilities to use.

title: Areigna Tactics
description:
Areigna Tactics is a top-down hex based strategy game taking place in the world of Areigna, a fantasy world of Humans, Goblins, Dwarfs, and much more. Play in this multiplayer real time strategy game online in ranked matches with people all around the world.

Unlike many strategy games which are based on resources held and build times, Areigna’s gameplay and balance focuses instead on cooldowns. These cooldowns vary across different units, and their attack and movement. You will need to balance these cooldowns and constraints in your building of new units, as well in the actions you command your units making their way to the enemy nexus.

title: Fueled Up
description: Fueled Up is a chaotic couch co-op spaceship recovery game for up to four players. You and your crewmates must fuel, fix and rescue damaged spaceships before the evil space octopus gets its tentacles on them!

title: AOFrost
description:
AOFrost is a server based on "Argentum Online"
With more than 13 uninterrupted years in its development.
Enter a world full of adventures and become the best!

title: Dastardly
description: A frenetic local multiplayer arena combat game for 1-4 players. Jump, dash, and shoot your way to victory, making use of an array of powerups like shields, cloaks, and jetpacks.

title: Animal Crusaders
description: Crusade to distant lands and fight your friends in this chaotic 4 player skill based brawler or play survival alone. Defeat players and AI in order to unlock unique projectiles, weapons, magic, and cosmetics. Use spacing and custom loadouts to defeat your foes in battle.

title: PongBreak
description: Clean up the scattered programmable matter in a fun and challenging tennis like format. Multiple control schemes allow for casual or precise gameplay.

title: Honey Homer
description: Hit Homer to reach quota!

title: One Hell of a Week
description: A 18+ Yuri romance Visual Novel taking place in a tropical paradise. Oh, and there's Satan.

title: Melty Blood: Type Lumina - Mario Playable Character
description: This will add “Additional Character - Mario” to Melty Blood: Type Lumina.

title: Melty Blood: Type Lumina - Powered Ciel Playable Character
description: This will add “Additional Character - Powered Ciel” to Melty Blood: Type Lumina.

title: American Truck Simulator 2022
description: American Truck Driving Simulator 2022 with Cargo Truck Game Get ready for new, offline, and free truck driving simulator in cargo truck game creator of gaming engine.

title: Chester's Revenge
description: Take control of Chester the pig as you avenge your herd and set out to retrieve the Sacred Carrot. Armed only with his trusty hand cannon, Chester must battle his way through Rad Ralph’s lieutenants in an over-the-top style revenge romp to reclaim the Carrot and stop Rad Ralph from world domination.

title: Reversilly
description: Reversilly is a new type of real time chaos action game! that combines the familiar game of "Reversi" with real-time action elements.

title: Detective Barbie 2: The Vacation Mystery
description: Detective Barbie 2 is primarily an adventure game where Barbie explores the inn and surrounding areas, such as the greenhouse and the lighthouse. Further, the inn was constructed by an eccentric inventor who built all kinds of secret passages and other surprises into the location. Find and use items, leverage your high-tech gadgets, interview the people who work at the inn, and solve the mystery.

title: Demon Turf: Neon Splash
description: Demon Turf is back and better than ever! Join Beebz in this neon lit adventure where speedy platforming reigns supreme!

title: Nomad Survival
description: Battle against hordes of enemies, conquer Boss encounters, and explore various character and skill combinations in this time-based auto-attacking Roguelite in your quest to become stronger and defeat the most menacing of creatures that lay in wait at the end of each run.

title: Mearth
description: Seeking revenge and re-establishing the kingdom, Asteria struggles to escape from the land of dark beings. She wants to defeat Dragos and reunite with her father and her former kingdom.Join this game full of high graphics.İt's a story mode single player RPG game.

title: Emorrior
description: Emorrior is rogue-like dungeon crawler about the struggles in your own life. Where you must assemble your own army of positive emotions to conquer all the bad thoughts that try to ruin your day. Fight, Collect and Survive, seize that happy ending you know you deserve.

title: 3D Puzzle: Farm House
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

title: Ai-(Onic)
description: Fight your friends as a small robot tank and get an outlet for your emotions by destroying your friend's buildings.

title: Gloomhaven: Jaws of the Lion
description: The Jaws of the Lion DLC is the digital adaptation of the eponymous board game and expansion to Gloomhaven the critically acclaimed grim Tactictal RPG. Recruit 4 exclusive mercenaries and explore a new side of the world of Gloomhaven through an arching story filled with new enemies and bosses.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Dynasties of India
description: This expansion brings three new civilizations of India plus three full new campaigns to Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition for the first time.

title: Bitch Hell
description:
Alex is a girl plagued by constant nightmares of flesh, rust and grime.
Fight your way through the night as you spiral into... Bitch Hell.

title: Aerinde
description: Ærinde is a first person point and click adventure game, created by Cloak and Dagger Games for AdventureJam 2016.

title: Borneo: A Jungle Nightmare
description: Borneo: A Jungle Nightmare is an interactive horror graphic adventure, with the direction and script of Ruggero Deodato. Take control of different characters in a desperate expedition to the virgin jungles of Borneo.

title: SpaceSlog
description:
SpaceSlog is a challenging sci-fi spaceship simulator that focuses on shipbuilding, crew interaction, and exploration. Inspired by games such as Rimworld, Starship Theory, Dwarf Fortress and X-COM, as well as iconic media such as Firefly, Battlestar Galactica, Stargate Universe and The Expanse.

Your colony ship has been destroyed. Fortunately, a few survivors managed to escape on a small ship. Now alone, hungry, and lost in space, you must explore the cosmos and guide them to safety.

title: I H8 Ur Face
description: Want to slap the sh*t out of someone but don't want to do time for it? Load an image of the poor bastard on to the dummy and release your rage!

title: The Oracle Land
description: "The Oracle Land" is a 3D fantasy MMOARPG, set in the magnificent story, enjoy a journey of mission in the western fantasy world.

title: Planet Omnia
description: Welcome to Planet Omnia! A multiplayer sandbox game with a focus on exploration, secrets and having fun with your friends!

title: The Vaults
description: The Vaults is a turn-based RPG card game where you will engage with creatures and beings of other worlds, Explore powerful scrolls and weapons, find treasures, learn abilities, and upgrade your keepers to save the mysterious world of Alexandria!

title: Matchmension: House of Mist
description: Matchmension: House of Mist congratulates you as the chosen winner of the royal lottery! Your prize: Mist Mansion! But the mansion has been left in terrible shape and the estate is in dire need of repairs. Direct your own robot butler and harness the power of mysterious stars to fuel your creative endeavor. Renovate and restore Mist Mansion to its former glory in Matchmension: House of Mist!

title: Magi: Mind Game
description: Magi: Mind Game takes the essential elements of a fighting game and turns it into an easy to learn difficult to master turn based strategy game. Focus on manipulating and predicting to outsmart your opponent. No need to memorize combos and difficult controls.

title: Seashells
description: A short first-person horror exploration game that takes around 20-30 minutes to finish.

title: ARCA Sim Racing X
description: ARCA Sim Racing X (ASRX) is sim racing game that was created after updates to the XPatch were abandoned. ARCA Sim Racing X (ASRX) combines the original ARCA08 stock car with the TSF Trucks and other mods from Community members and make a stand alone game to accessible and include multiple class to race in Oval track.

title: Suddenly Meow 2
description: In the second part of the fantastical Match3 game, Tim the cat is hungry for more adventure! Lord Devious broke free from the seal of the fairies and now his ominous shadow is threatening the peace of the forest. Help Tim use his meowtastic skills to save the fairies!

title: Idle Business Tycoon: Build Simulator
description: Expand and grow! The possibilities are plenty in Idle Business Tycoon - Build Simulator Build. Earn money to unlock new establishments and expand your business all over town. The more you build, the more money you make!

title: Loony
description: Loony is a multiplayer strategy, role-playing and thriller where one player takes on the role of the killer and kills those who try to escape from the map, and other players try to escape the map by finding the killer or completing missions.

title: ARCA Sim Racing 08'
description: ARCA Sim Racing is a stock-car racing simulator that focus on 2008 ARCA RE/MAX season that happen on OVAL and road courses.

title: Isle of Arrows
description: Build an impenetrable fortress, tile by tile. Place buildings, build roads, and expand your isle to defend against waves of invaders in this roguelike fusion of tower defense and board game.

title: Bacteriophage
description: Bacteriophage Roguelike Platformer takes place inside the body of someone with many bacterial infections. You play as a cyborg named Terri (“like bacteria”), with a gun that shoots bacteriophage DNA-infused bullets. Your job is to make your way through this human body and destroy any and all bacteria and infections that stand in your way.

title: Trails of Illusion
description: This is a JRPG free-to-play fan game with reference to the Falcom Trails series, and the battle mode is turn-based combat.

title: Smoking Snakes
description: In Smoking Snakes you are part of the Brazilian Expeditionary Force (B.E.F) fighting Axis in Italian territory during World War II.

title: Time is Solid Here
description:
A long, yellow hallway. A floating head who talks of monster trucks and places in-between. A painting, three a plenty, each with someone in need of moving on.

Such is the horror puzzle game, Time is Solid Here, recently selected for the Goethe-Institut's Stillstand/Standstill Project Exhibition.

title: Jaded
description: Jaded ﻿is a large ﻿﻿dark techbase slaughtermap by lunchlunch influenced by Fractured Worlds, Miasma, Magnolia, Abandon, Occula, and Newt. It was a runner-up at the 2023 Cacowards.

title: Still Heroes
description: A digital comic about the story of Emeline. She tries to live her dream of being a superheroine after her friends decided to change their career paths. A gentle and moving story, drawn by hand.

title: Axolotl is Dry
description: Axolotl is Dry is a precision platforming game where you play as a little axolotl taken from his home. You'll need to jump, dash and slide your way through the harsh desert before you sweat yourself dry. Help the axolotl get to his home!

title: Gold Wiper
description: Gold Wiper is an arcade game like Qix and Gals Panic. If you delete the screen and restore the hidden picture, you will be rewarded incomparably with Qix and Gals Panic.

title: N-Age
description: Live as one of the young cyberspace character inside the world of N-Age and discover the secrets and story behind it. Build communities, fight other schools and prove your mettle. Fight the crippling darkness and evil that wants to throw the civilization into disarray once more.

title: Cozy Grove: New Neighbears
description: Word of your legendary scouting deeds has spread throughout the spirit world... and that means more ghosts want your help. The "New Neighbears DLC" adds four new ghost bears, each featuring lengthy personal stories and no long waits between their requests.

title: 4D Chess
description: VR Chess that isn't flat. Move up and down, between levels, and attack from all directions. All the pieces you know with extra moves that add interesting complexity. Several different volumes to choose from ranging from 4x4x4 to 8x8x8. 4d checkers, 3d chess and checkers are included.

title: Bomberman Online Japan
description: An online Bomberman released only in Japan for PC.

title: Pixel Game Maker Series Dandan Z
description: The sixth installment in the fictional "Game Buddy" portable game console series! Play against a total of 10 characters!

title: Confined with Goddesses
description: Confined with Goddesses is a light-hearted story based on hentai culture, in its "funny" aspect.

title: Cook Serve Forever
description: Cook your way through the bustling solarpunk city of Helianthus as Nori Kaga, a food cart chef aspiring to make it big like her role model, the Culinary Queen herself, Chef Rhubarb.

title: JellyCar Worlds
description:
JellyCar Worlds is a return to the classic softbody platforming series JellyCar, set to release 11 years after the last game in the series; JellyCar 3.
JellyCar Worlds is similar to the classic trilogy, with a variety of platforming challenges you must overcome as a car made from "jelly." Worlds introduces its titular feature, worlds, with an overworld level for each world.

title: Ten Tales from the Record of the Adamant Gambit
description: This anthology of ten short slice-of-life games explores life aboard a generation starship, originally made over ten days in December 2021 for the Variety Megajam.

title: Kirigirisou
description:
The main character is a completely normal student with nothing unusual about them. They get lost one night while returning home, left driving in a dense forest. Vision still obscured, they meet the mysterious beautiful girl Kirigiri Kyouko, and give her a ride.
However, after getting into an accident, the two of them take refuge in a nearby Western-style house. That house is in fact where Kirigiri had been headed, but with a huge tree growing inside, it’s a bizarre place.
The heroes are assaulted by a creepy Western-style suit of armor, a skull buried in the garden, and a girl who’s just like Kirigiri Kyouko…
You are the protagonist. Can you solve the mystery of the house and escape from this strange place?

title: Concrete Crown
description:
BEWARE THE MACHINES
THEY VOMIT SHADOWS

title: Edrick's Conquest
description: Edrick's Conquest is an isometric open world Action RPG featuring unique gameplay, charming environments & competitive play. Explore Plesmur, a high fantasy world, on your own or with your allies.

title: Paranoiac: Remake Version
description: Paranoiac is a freeware horror adventure game by Uri made in WOLF RPG Editor.

title: Numlock
description: A mathematics based timed puzzler where you have to match numbers before being grabbed by a creeping hand. Calculate before you get caught in this endless game!

title: Star Tetrinomino
description: Match stars in a row to clear them before time runs out.

title: Definitely Poker
description: A followup to 'Probably Poker'. This game plays like a normal round of video Poker with a twist. Play against the dealer for a highscore but have control over what they can't get via trump cards. Can you stack the deck in your favor?

title: Bananab!!
description: An obstacle course game for two players -- with a twist! Contestants start on opposite ends of a single race track, one moving forward, the other backward in time.

title: Don't Be Afraid: The First Toy
description: Don't Be Afraid - The First Toy, is an introduction to the dramatic story of a boy kidnapped by a psychopath. Exploring the giant house of your torturer you will soon discover things worse than your childish nightmares. Take on the role of Jamie and see what phrase “The First Toy” actually means.

title: Jim's Adventure
description:
Jim's Adventure is a game where you need to follow Jim, the Native American in an exciting and challenging adventure. He is exploring a large world filled with perils, ranging from various creatures to obstacles, all trying to stop him. There are a multitude of levels to complete and Jim has a very limited amount of lives.

Every level has its fair share of challenges, and there are multiple game worlds ranging from haunted forests to deserts, caves and many others.

title: Annie's Millions: A Hidden Object Shopping Spree!
Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Earthblood Champion of Gaia Edition
description:
You are Cahal, a powerful Garou who chose to go into exile after losing control of his destructive rage. On his quest for redemption and blood, Cahal plays a crucial role in the great war between the Garous and Endron, a powerful oil company that serves the Wyrm, whose destruction is ravaging the planet.
He can transform into a wolf and a Crinos, a huge ferocious beast.
Each form has its advantages: the wolf can sneak around undetected, Cahal as a human can interact with other people, and the Werewolf can unleash its rage to tear enemies apart.

The Champion of Gaia edition includes:
- Full game
- 3 outfits for Cahal
- 4 exclusive furs for the Wolf and Werewolf
- A nature spirit to help you in combat
- A unique finishing move

title: Labyrinths of the World: Secrets of Easter Island
description: What starts as a relaxing getaway quickly takes a disastrous turn as your world is attacked by an ancient god and their stone statues! Can you stop the destruction before it's too late?

title: Labyrinths of the World: Secrets of Easter Island - Collector's Edition
description: What starts as a relaxing getaway quickly takes a disastrous turn as your world is attacked by an ancient god and their stone statues! Can you stop the destruction before it's too late?

title: Ayleouna
description: Take Ayleouna on an asteroid hopping adventure in this action platformer with gravity bending elements.

title: Profound Red
description: Profound Red is the twelfth game in the Carol Reed series. In the title Carol is contacted by her friend Stina. The hotel she works at received a suicide note through a text message from a woman called Louise Elliot, but no one knows the connection to the hotel. Carol investigates in Norrköping to find out who she is and whether there is any suicide involved at all. The game uses its trademark first-person view with photographs of real locations and objects in a fixed-screen slideshow style. There are puzzles to solve with items stored in an inventory near the top of the screen. A journal is used to keep track of objectives. Optionally hints can be activated or all hotspots can be revealed. As a long-running series, some locations are revisited in an updated way as life goes on and there is a cast of new and recurring characters. No knowledge of previous games in required to play.

title: The Birdwatcher
description: The Birdwatcher is the thirteenth game in the Carol Reed series. Set in Sweden in the summer, Carol has been down with the flu.
