You play as Alexei, an ordinary man who's been unable to find work. He stays in an unfinished building and has befriended a resident there named Ivan. Alexei is unable to leave due to the rainfall, so he stays inside and dreams.

title: Deathbed Lullabye
description:
Deathbed Lullabye is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 5. It differs from traditional fangames due to how the player only has 7 opportunities to enter the dream world before they are forced to trigger an ending. The dream world changes across 7 nights, with events, NPCs and locations becoming accessible and inaccessible depending on what night it is.

In the year 2004 within a hospital in Mexico City, you play as “Teicuh Maria Yayauhqui Calli,” age 37, a widow and musician. She's also terminally ill and is full of regrets about the questionable life she lived. She only has 7 days to live before she succumbs to her illness. If she either passes on peacefully or ends up in purgatory depends on the player's actions.

title: Tokyo purgatorio
description: Tokyo purgatorio is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. The goal is to explore Ginji Suzumoto's dream and collect Lines (Effects).

title: Nihil
description: Nihil is a fangame of the classic indie hit, Yume Nikki. Following a girl named Yorutsuki escaping from reality through her dreams, you are tasked with collecting several "Effects" found in her dream world.

title: RepresaL
description: RepresaL is a Yume Nikki fangame. You explore Nrutaz's dreams and, one unique feature in this game is an energy bar that the player must prevent from draining while awake.

title: Me llow
description: Me llow is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. Your goal is to explore Nuitsuki's dreams and collect all the effects.

title: Not Dream Syndrome
description: (not) Dream Syndrome is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Shiutsuki and explore her dreams.

title: Wait for Daylight
description: Wait for Daylight is an English Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Nio, a girl who can't seem to fall asleep normally and spends her time daydreaming instead. The goal is to explore and obtain Wishes.

title: Braingirl
description: Braingirl is a Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Mikan, an apartment-dwelling lucid dreamer, and is primarily based around the collection of effects and exploration of the dream world. Scattered across its areas are a form of currency known as CD's, which can be used at vending machines and other types of vendors.

title: Extreme Burger Defense
description: A tower defense game created in under ten hours. You're a scientist who has crafted the most delicious burger in the universe, which also happens to attract every bear in the universe. Including cyborg bears.

title: Night Loops
description: A journey through the psyche. Escape your night shift at the hotel, explore dreamlike worlds, and lose your sense of Self while reliving the time before dawn in this dark, adventure / puzzle game.

title: Petrified
description: Team up with your group of hunters to track down an invisible ghost and stop it from petrifying everyone or fall victim to the ghost's wrath.

title: The World of a Mermaid
description: Welcome in the underwater world of a mermaid, with aquatics creatures & the queen, welcome in The World of a Mermaid!

title: Button Lock 2: Star Carrier
description: Can you solve the puzzle with the limited amount of moves? Explore the world map. Solve the levels with different gimmicks. Get stars by beating levels to explore more of the world map. Solve over 170 levels in this puzzle adventure game.

title: The Splitting: Chapter 3
description:
The Splitting is a mystery adventure game.

In the 3rd chapter Daniel and geM visit Coldwin prison to look for llehctiM, who disappeared at the end of chapter 2 . There they learn more about Mitchell’s escape, and the mysterious ‘Dave’.

title: The Golden Time in High School
description: As a high school student of Shiguang high school, you will spend three years here. What kind of students that you will be? You can choose to study hard and get a good grade.You can choose to be an assistant to teacher to help with their daily affairs. Or just have a romantic date with somebody?

title: This is a Ghost
description: This Is a Ghost is a horror game in which you embody a ghost hunter. This action game will immerse you in the heart of a paranormal investigation, in solo or multiplayer.

title: Iku Iku Succubus
description: Succubi have arrived on Earth, and it's your job to teach them humanity's ways! Your job will be anything but easy as you unravel hidden ambitions, explore human culture, and serve as tour guide for Earth's tasty delicacies. Class is starting in the magical visual novel world of Iku Iku Succubus!

title: Dodo Life
description: Dodo Life is a game about a dodo that desperately tries to find the island where its species lives, avoiding as much as possible not being extinguished on the way by cruel predators in a Jurassic era.

title: Lamoneo
description: Lamoneo challenges your perception and logic. Every door reveals a dreamlike world in which fragments of different cultures and different times mix creating views of dream like beauty. This is non combat 3rd person adventure game.

title: Transport INC: Seamanship
description: Expand your Transport INC gameplay into the oceans of the world. New vehicles, events, custom routes, water themed maps, and more await beyond the water horizon.

title: Vowel Movements
description: In Vowel Movements you race against the clock to group words together into categories. The only catch is that each of the vowels has been replaced by a different vowel. Surely that can’t make things too difficult…

title: Soul Janitor
description: In Soul Janitor, play as the Janitor who returned from vacation to find all his coworkers murdered. A mysterious boss of your boss tasks you with cleaning up their souls. Armed with only a mop and a spray bottle, uncover the dirty secrets behind the murders of your coworkers!

title: Saturn Menace
description: It's 2320 AC your scientific exploration module has been damage by a meteor on the Saturn orbit near an old abandoned spacecraft. Must find new energy sources explore space and search a replacement for the core of your spaceship. Enjoy this singleplayer offline 80's 90's inspired sci fi movie game

title: Running on Magic
description: Woosh! Get ready to flee! Welcome to Running on Magic, a forced-scroll platformer where a quirky wizard is being chased by a tireless Grim Reaper. Hurry through procedurally-generated mindfully drawn environments as you defeat unalike enemies. Don’t let the Grim Reaper get to you!

title: Blue Oak Bridge
description: Blue Oak Bridge features breathtaking 2D hand-painted art in a storybook world of powerful witches, ancient magic and royal secrets. Farm, forage and fish throughout the island of Eloria and use all you discover to brew potions, make produce and help your new friends.

title: Endless Waves Survival
description: Rapture is a casual game with roguelike elements, gain experience, collect items, level up and try to survive thousands of enemies as long as you can.

title: Doki Doki Family: Toku Itaishitsu no Doki-doki Kazoku Seikatsu
description: A sweet life with the "Doki Doki Family”! Leave everything to the heroines and enjoy a life filled with love and affection!

title: Cold Land
description: Help a bear find its lost cub in a beautiful lowpoly snow land. Activate runes along the way to be able to access new regions.

title: Zerocron
description: Zerocron is a straightforward, classical arcade Twin-Stick Shoot-Em-Up with a strong Commodore-Amiga-era feel. Blast asteroids and enemies to burning pixeldust!

title: Magic War
description: Game Features: - Beautiful Pixel Art - Dynamic Music - 30 levels - Hardcore

title: AlexanderBall: A Countryball Tale
description: Ascend to the Macedonian throne as Alexander the Great and relive his conquests! Fighting alongside redoubtable and quirky commanders, recruit numerous types of balls for your army, construct countless cities named Alexandria, and build an empire that stretches to the ends of the known world!

title: Fairy Biography
description: Spirits sealed in the Scrolls have escaped to the human world. As the heir to the Elder Scrolls, it is your mission to protect the world order and hunt down the Spirits that have escaped. Take your courage and step on your journey now!

title: Neighbor Fight
description: Multiplayer first person strategy game with lots of destruction. Destroy the house of your neighbor by throwing furniture and build a business by selling weed!

title: The Pegasus Expedition

Then, organize your army, march forward, and battle the enemy to complete the mission!

Combat is primarily auto-battled. The player’s role centers on managing acquired gear, swapping equipment, and handling crafting and upgrades.

Although the game emphasizes idle and automated progression, strategic skill selection and party composition are key to effective character development.

description: The First Seeker is a challenging top down shooter where you will shoot and slash your way through enemies.

description: Cyrah's Ascent is a third-person combat game with high mobility. Imbued with essence, Cyrah must defeat the Laust and avenge her people.

title: Galaxy Life
description:
The new owner of Galaxy Life, Phoenix Network, has decided not to revive Pocket Adventures. The main reasons for this were the fact that the game was too old (it could not be placed on Google Play anymore), and the fact that they were lacking the source code of the game. They plan a new mobile version, but it will be compatible with Flash, and thus will not be the same PA anymore. That's why this wiki will only get minimal updates, to keep the spirit of PA alive!

Explore the world of Galaxy Life, build a space colony, attack enemies, grab items and rule the universe. Galaxy Life is full of interesting planets and characters. You'd be surprised how big Galaxy Life is! In this free to play MMO strategy game that mixes traditional easy-to-play casual gameplay mechanics with touches of more traditional genres and features like tower defense, RTS, or several competitive PvP features in a persistent on-line Galaxy. You play together with others or your friends and take on evil, so gather your friends to fight evil in this Galaxy Life social game!

description: Arruyo is a 3D first person terror game, where the player is inside a farmhouse with different monsters that will try to kill him/her. To survive and discover the mystery of that place, the player will have to hide from these monsters while investigating the farmhouse.

title: Pestilent Hunters
description: Welcome to europe, home to one of the most cruel and deadly diseases to ever plague humanity, the plague, the black plague. Join the Pestilent Hunters and you'll have to face a variety of disgusting monsters to try to prevent the end of humanity in this frantic roguelike!

title: Futanari Sex: BDSM Room
description: An explicit erotic visual novel about a couple formed by a woman and a futanari. The two thought of using the services of a dominatrix in order to explore their fantasies.

title: Outnumbered
description: Outnumbered is a mass-enemy top-down shooter with rogue-lite elements. You may be greatly outnumbered, but not outpowered. Evolve into the ultimate weapon of destruction!

title: Endless Thief: a Furry Stealth Adventure
description: You're a master thief in this ambient furry stealth game. You sneak past any guard, pick any lock, break into and steal from any secured building. Guards see, hear, speak and chase. Observe and prepare the best plan. Ghost unseen in shadows, distract, stalk, trap or knock out and hide guards.

title: Rolando the Majestic
description: Become Rolando the Majestic and find out how he became the most powerful wizard to ever live! Explore parallel levels using magic and time-travel in a stealth based narrative adventure in order to take vengance against the men who took everything from him as a child.

title: Bocce Time!
description: It's time to head to the park for some VR bocce action! Bocce Time's various courts will have you throwing, bowling and spinning to win in online matches of up to 4 friends or single player against AI. Closest to the pallino wins, folks! It's Bocce Time!

title: Run Build Pew!
description: You’re being Bounty-Hunted! Run, Build your ship piece-by-piece and make it work with the parts you find, Destroy outposts and waves of fleets, and Pick your battles carefully to overcome your hunters in this Fast-Paced Top-Down Action Roguelite Shooter.

title: Carnage in Space: Crucible
description: A fast-paced sci-fi action-platormer/beat-em-up with multiple characters and customization for replayability. Features both adjustable difficulty settings and intense post-game challenges for players of all skill levels.

title: Knights of Fate
description: The Triskelion Knights are an elite force selected and trained to protect the country. They're the King's right hand and they are now called to the biggest mission of their lives, to stop a Shaman from regaining his full powers and starting another war for the souls of the people.

title: Brave Builder Construct A Climb
description: procedural generated 2d puzzle platformer

title: Line Path
description: A mind-bending puzzle game about filling all in one line Relax and enjoy

title: Pitchfork Kingdom
description: Pitchfork Kingdom is a 2D hack-and-slash where each level is full of exciting combat, obstacles, and adventure.

title: Slava Ukraini!
description: A completely free game of heroic defence against enemy aggression. Take part in the defence of Ukraine against Russian aggression. A tribute to the courage and valor of the Ukrainian armed forces.

title: Eyes of Darkness
description: Psychological horror, featuring early 90's graphics and music, vast player's freedom and multiple endings! Leonard White, a professional inspector, is looking for his ex-girlfriend, Kimberly Frances, gone missing in Goodsprings, a small town near Nevada holding the darkest secrets...

title: Shadow's Kiss
description: A modern gothic vampire online RPG featuring turn based combat, intrigue, horror, and mature themes.

title: Echoes of the Stars
description: Echoes of the Stars is a modern action-JRPG standing on the shoulders of the classics. Follow Rin and Eldric in a tale of two souls, bound together by fate in an epic tale of time, space, love, laughter, and the human condition as they challenge those who seek to destroy existence as we know it.

title: Furry Hentai Isekai
description: Short Adult-Only Visual Novel featuring 3 furry girls in another world with different personalities and fetishes.

title: Six Braves
description: Strategy RPG game , full of childhood memories!

title: Reborn Souls
description: As a Maiden of the Ecclesia, Sabrina is in charge of special assignments, in lands where dark magic, urban legends and folkore are all real. While investigating a new incident in one of the appeased villages, she will learn much more than she bargained for...

title: Time Thief
description: Traverse through the magic dungeon and steal the sacred vial containing the embodiment of the tides of time to attain immortality... only then can you find the door to escape.

title: Battlerace
description: Battlerace is a simple first-person shooter that invites you and your friends to play together! The game combines the most popular and best gameplay modes in one production! In Battlerace you decide how to play!

title: Thunder Ray
description: Thunder Ray is Arcade-Boxing, Retro-like gameplay with blood and violence. Defeat all the best fighters in the galaxy to become the GOAT of the universe.

title: Space Worthy
description: Space Worthy is atompunk science simulator. Use science to save the crew of your wrecked ship. This was supposed be holiday for young scientists on scientific educational pkanet. Now you really have to learn something if you want to get back. Find new parts, learn how to use them, build electronics.

title: The United Space of America
description: The United SPACE of America is a high action, arcade style, run-n-gun bullet hell, twin stick shooter that allows you to absorb enemy bullets with your Proton Sabre while you blast through countless enemies and unlock new abilities. There's air dashing, giant Proton Shots and more!

title: Thorn Demon Hunter
description: This is an AVG game similar to Metroidvania. The player will perform a demon hunter exploring and decrypting the castle in the Gothic period and hunting the corrupt soul

title: Vacation Adventures: Cruise Director 6
description: A great hidden object game set aboard a cruise ship

title: Portal Dungeon
description: In “Portal Dungeon”, in this multiplayer Roguelike adventure game with random elements, as an adventurer, you and your friends will bravely find the last portal in this portal world, defeat powerful enemies and save the world.

title: Realm of Cubes
description: Realm Of Cubes is a voxel-based action adventure RPG. It takes place in a handcrafted voxel Fantasy world!

title: Alchemia: Creatio Ex Nihilo
description: Alchemia is a turn-based strategy roguelike with a hint of puzzle. You'll collect alchemical reagents, building your own personalized combat satchel, and combine them into magical recipes, unique to each run, to battle against outlandish foes.

title: Story of Eve 2
description: Guide Eve through a succubus training program in the newest "Story of Eve". Experience a new story with improved mechanics and even more outrageous training scenes and outfits!

title: Escape the Unknown
description: Escape the Unknow is ¾ view dungeon crawler rogue-like game that is broken up into chapters. Players will embark on a journey of discovery as they regain their memory through a world of secrets.

title: The Illusion: Nightmare
description: The Illusion: Nightmare Is A Horror Game Made By Professional Crew In The Art Of Horror. You Will Have The Opportunity To Experience One Of The Most Powerful Types Of Psychological Horror Based On An Environment Designed In Every Detail To Be A Real Hell That Makes You Terrified.

title: Monsters Loot Swag
description: Top-down, twin-stick, power-up collectathon shooter.

title: Cops 2170: The Power of Law
description:
Cops 2170: The Power of Law is a hybrid of RPG and tactical strategy. The central storyline unfolds in the future where the cyberpunk culture and a highly-urban oriented society have populated North America.

The game is a prequel to Paradise Cracked (2002).

title: Godless grove
description: Godless grove - survival horror with elements of a hunting simulator in an open world filled with horrors. Uncover the terrible secrets of the locals and overcome the disgusting creatures of evil that have gathered over this grove.

title: The Alpinist
description: Make your way up the mountain with your ice axe and your grappling hook. Hold tight, watch your steps and make sure not to fall, you never know how far you're gonna land.

title: Cool Animals
description: Cool Animals is a fun and challenging puzzle game. With it, you'll have to use your various skills to be able to overcome the challenges that exist in each level.

title: Taisho x Alice: Heads & Tails!
description: Fandisc of the Taishou x Alice series. Contains after-stories for the original characters and includes new routes for sub-characters Ookami and Ryoushi. Also featuring a school-parody story with routes for all the original characters.

title: Zakuzaku Actors
description: ZakuZaku Actors is a free game created by "Hamusuta". It was first published in 2012, and was released in It was released as an official version in December 2014. Since then, the game has been actively upgraded with additional content.

title: Album
description: Album is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. You play as an old woman named Ethel reminiscing about her past in her dreams. The goal is to explore and find effects.

title: Awaits: 10H
description:
Awaits;10H is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. It is a prequel to the game Hikensha.
It follows the story of a young boy named Yarishi, who is having a hard time with many familiar problems, but that's about to change, as unknown forces lurk around the house and his dreams watching him constantly. Your goal is to collect effects as well as eight seeds that are scattered throughout the dream world.

title: Bunte Märchenträume
description:
Bunte Märchenträume is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam.

Ilyse is a simple girl stuck in her own house. She can't drive, and she can't leave. So what does she do? She reads and sleeps to pass the time. From there, she explores her colorful dreams in order to escape her bland reality. The goal is to explore and find effects.

title: Dream Journey
description: Dream Journey is a Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. It stars MC, a nonbinary character with no real name. It's a traditional fangame, based around exploring MC's dream world and collecting effects. As opposed to a bedroom, Dream Journey takes place on a moving train.

title: Fissure
description: Solve a missing person case while you explore the damaged relationships between characters. The story reveals hidden truths through dialogue choices and exploration. Expose lies, conflicting memories and shifting loyalties where the greatest mystery is the people you thought you knew.

title: Food Diary
description: Food Diary is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. You play as the famous restaurateur Guy Fieri and it plays like a traditional fangame, where you explore the dream world and collect effects.

title: Galactic Merchant
description:
Galactic Merchant is sci-fi business simulator (aka space tycoon game). Starting from small startup with single cargo ship you can grow your company to intergalactic monopoly.

To do so, you could trade, prospect, produce goods, smuggle, rob, give bribes, engage in politics, save lives and use many other options.
During the game you will learn many economical concepts and built-in calculation sheet will help you to use them in practice.

title: Halcyon
description:
A pixel art challenging sidescroller shooter set in a future inhospitable version of Earth.

The year is 2506. A vestige of humankind, you’ve been sent to Earth on the faint hopes that you will find more than the corpse of a once hospitable planet. Instead, you find a landscape blooming with lush, mutated new life.

title: Jamping Fish
description: All you have to do is control the fish with your keyboard to jump over moving stones, plates, cars and more, and avoid starfish or cats to reach the top of the statue.

title: Mementos
description:
A black mist came without warning, sending all who inhaled it into a deep, unwakeable sleep. The citizens of a village are all trapped in a dream world with only one way to escape: go deeper into the dream and collect all of the mementos. Then, the gate to reality will open. One by one, the villagers went down, deeper into the dream. None have returned. Now, it's your turn. This time, you're determined to collect all of the mementos to free everyone.

Mementos is an entry for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. There are 4 mementos to collect, with a few worlds to explore.

title: Mesonoxian
description: Mesonoxian is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. You play as Tyran. Tyran is stuck inside his home due to a rainstorm, leaving him to daydream in his free time. The main goal is to explore and collect effects (known as Influences). A minigame can be played on the console in the room outside the bedroom.

title: Miskatonic Diaries
description: Miskatonic Diaries is a Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. It stars Tomato Chain, who refuses to leave her room and instead explores a dream world collecting items.

title: Moon Cradle
description:
A game made for Dream Diary Jam 2017.

Help Alice explore imaginary space worlds. Collect modifications and gather crew for your space ship, Moon cradle.

title: No Outlet
description: No Outlet is a Yume Nikki fangame that was created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. You play as Mint, a young lady who uses her bedroom cabinet to wander around in other people's dream worlds collecting "spells" and disturbing private spaces.

title: Onohi
description: Onohi is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. You play as Maka as she explores her dream world.

title: Passing By
description: Passing By is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. You play as Wren, who embarks on a train to see where it'll take her.

title: Ruler's Reign
description: Ruler's Reign is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. The game uses image collages for its graphics. You play as a woman named Reina as she tries to stop the rainfall in her dreams.

title: Sleepless
description: A horror game set in an abandoned bunker in Russia, inspired by "The Russian Sleep Experiment." Players must collect important papers from past experiments, but the bunker is difficult to navigate with locked corridors, no electricity, and a constant feeling of being watched.

title: Take the Veil
description:
Take The Veil is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam.
You play as a psychic goat named Ulysses as he arrives at an abandoned campsite. After encountering some strange crosses, he finds an empty caravan to stay in. From here, he enters the Fourth Dimension with the goal of pulling the ethereal crosses. This game contains dialogue and there are a number of NPCs the player can talk to. There are no effects to be gotten.

title: Yume Nyaki
description: Yume Nyaki is a Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. Nyasuki has a dream about being asked by a mysterious person known as Cheru to aid an "Administrator" in some way, and to not harm the tree that Cheru is standing in front of. Then Nyasuki wakes up, and his adventure begins. Nyasuki's main goal is finding effects in the dream world.

title: Revival: Recolonization
description: Set in a post-apoc version of Earth, Revival is a 4x strategy game where the world and its rules can change at key moments, creating a deep and highly replayable experience.

title: Seneca 7: A Cyberpunk Odyssey
description: Build a new life in a cozy cyberpunk adventure RPG! Polluted air having you gasping for breath? Drowning in endless debt? Online dating getting you nowhere? Leave your worries behind and reboot your life on Seneca 7, where dreams come true!

title: All @ Once
description: ALL @ ONCE is a twine based interactive novel. Take the role of Wyatt Reynolds, your average everyday black teen in the small lake-centered town of Primwood a town where the world is quiet and the mornings are hazed. Where Devils walk the street with pockets full of spice. This young man whose life blinked by without a second thought becomes something more when his mind takes on something new. When the thoughts in his head aren't his own and the reality of reading people's minds comes into play.

title: Gränsland
description: The main character of Gränsland is on the threshold of adulthood: she leaves her family nest and moves to an apartment in an ordinary building. But it is not as simple as it seems at first sight, and the atmosphere there is not at all neighborly: the tenants are always hiding something, and the mysterious doors in their apartments, which nobody seems to see, emit a dim light

title: Crashocalypse
description:
Crashocalypse is a video game made in RPG Maker 2000 that was released in May 12th, 2018 and was made by one person named "Default" Reese. The game was created as a fangame dedicated to the Let's Player, Mikennemonic and his community, featuring references and in-jokes dedicated to the community in a turn-based RPG format.

The game was released within the MikeNnemonic forums for download, free of charge.

title: Den Yttersta Gåtan
description: Adolescence is a difficult time: parents don't understand and classmates bully. The main character of Den Yttersta Gåtan sits on the window sill and looks sadly out the window with the rain pouring down. Just as she is about to run away, a mysterious messenger from Asgard itself appears, and outside the window a Bivröst appears on which Heimdall is trumpeting Gjallarhorn and announcing the beginning of Ragnarök.

title: Rogue Soulstone
description: Collect the Rogue Soulstones in this physics-based, fast-paced action roguelike RPG to achieve ultimate power. Learn spells to create powerful synergies, decimate hordes of corrupted souls, face titanic bosses, die, upgrade and try again with a new build.

title: Arsolid Productions
description: Your dreams and wishes have come true in this immense new world of adventures and stories, in a game like never seen before.

title: Ultrarush
description: Ultrarush is a free-to-play, fast-paced arena shooter where you fight for tokens in the middle of arena. It highly relies on movement, reflexes and gamesense.

title: Astro Bandits
description: "Astro Bandits" is a classic 2D top-view arcade scrolling shooter. Earth has been attacked by aliens and you need to destroy enemy starships and to save the planet. Nice visuals and atmospheric music will immerse you in the Aerospace Forces.

title: A Haunted History
description: A Haunted History is a survival horror game that focuses mainly on the story. Discover everything by exploring the ambiance, finding clues and solving puzzles, and also experiencing some lil' bit... weird situations.

title: Automaton Kingdom
description: 2D turn-based puzzle game with a medieval setting and two game phases. Allied and enemy characters will behave automatically after setting them up in the edit phase. you can see the outcome of the different iterations of the level in the game phase.

title: Akapulka: The Rainbow
description: Akapulka is a meditative game about floating across unique ancient ruins and collecting flowers.

title: Godspell Defender
description: This unique arcade game will deliver a quick and simple experience designed around making a few perfectly placed shots. Button mashing will do you no good. There are ten distinct spells in the game that must be combined to maximize damage, creating the ultimate god spell.

title: Virtual country: Yuan fairy summon
description: Team game War chess: MMORPG + Catch pet + TCG + MOBA. Fast paced, slow games, Easy to use, difficult to master. Loss mechanism, life mechanism. Open world, free trade. R & D, production , free trad

title: Shooting girl
description: It's a casual stress-busting shooter game where you beat enemies to get gold for upgrades and unlock weapons and the more levels it is, you have to think about how do you complete the game by refine Weapons . Also there alot fun things like turntable flip cards and other mini-games and CG in here.

title: Bewbewbew
description: Bewbewbew is a lovingly crafted, unique, and colorful action-arcade game!

title: Dungeon Delvers
description: Dungeon delvers is a third person action fighting rogue like. Slay hordes of monsters with ever increasingly powerful gear. Hunt for synergies to unlock godly powers and destroy ever increasingly more difficult enemies.

title: Cryptr
description: A singleplayer hack and slash dungeon crawler game with stat upgrades and numerous levels and enemies to defeat.

title: Rob
description: ROB. We need your help defending Earth from Alien UFO's. Each one having different defenses. Please Rob your are only hope. Play as a Space Control Agent named Rob. Shooting UFO's out of Space to defend Earth.

title: The 7th Sign Project
description: The 7th Sign Project is a classic 2D-platformer action game inspired by Doom, Quake, Abuse, and Painkiller games. Our goal is to entertain the player with massive enemy fights, boss fights, and stirring music.

title: Carrot: Pancakes and Waffles
description: a slice of life game where you live a peaceful day in a whimsical hand-painted coastal town

title: A Piano Tale
description: A Piano Tale immerses the player in the life of musician Alexandra Aaronovitch and her father Boris. Can you help Alexandra find the fragments of the secret concerto for piano and orchestra written by Boris, and play it? Travel to the cultural capitals of Vienna and St. Petersburg.

title: Grizelda: Lynx and the Nine Lives
description: Join Lynx on an adventure to rescue a princess and collect 9 souls. A retro-action RPG filled with puzzles, dungeons, and treasure.

title: Yakyosho
description: A simple Japanese horror game, with horrible creatures, not very complex puzzles, and an unwelcoming atmosphere! Have sweet nightmares...

title: A Weekend in Puzzleburg
description: A Weekend in Puzzleburg is a cozy slice-of-life role-playing game. No need to fight monsters or save the world from impending doom - you've merely booked a relaxing weekend getaway in a town known for its puzzles. Welcome to Puzzleburg!

title: Hand of Doom
description: Sign a contract in blood! Travel throughout the planes of existence slaying or befriending powerful doomlords in this wizard simulator inspired by the FMV games and dungeon crawlers of the early 90's. Learn powerful spells to solve puzzles and combat the dark forces amassing against you.

title: Winter Tramp
description: Winter tramp - A story about a tramp who has to overcome many trials, pain and mysteries on his difficult path. The next 40 kilometers are filled with robbers and wild animals.

title: Penitence
description: Return home and uncover the mystery of your daughter's death, and the demon that plagues you, in this escape room style atmospheric puzzler.

title: Warehuman
description: Game theme: JRPGs that talk about violence and mythology Read the story from the point of view of a character from a 'discriminated race' to think deeply about discrimination. In the combat part, the tense BP battle system offers the thrill of 'hunt or be hunted'.

title: Extinction Eclipse
description: Defend Humanity against an alien invader who is trying to freeze Earth. Explore space, conquer asteroid fields to mine and extract resources. Build a fleet of spaceships and destroy the enemies in this new space action strategy adventure.

title: White lady
description: "White lady" is a 3D stand-alone role-playing game developed by broken DuanQiaoCanXue studio. This game adopts the full real-time combat mode, and the combat experience is free and refreshing. The game depicts the legend of the White Snake, one of China's four major love myths and legends

title: Kitten Burst
description: Kitten Burst is an Adventure/Racing Game about a Flying Cat set in the year 200X. Explore Sites on the Web, Race through Circuits, & Battle Bullet Hell Bosses to Save Cyberspace.

title: Animals Transport Simulator
description: Hurry up to take as many orders as possible. Get behind the wheel, but and be careful with the animals.

title: Guacamojo
description: Finally, it's the turtle's turn to rise! Spin, jump, and smash your way through dozens of tricky old-school platforming levels, all with unique gimmicks and mechanics, to challenge even seasoned platform gamers.

title: Dismantled Director's Cut
description: Experience the game in its best form with the Director's Cut Edition. New graphics, new enemies, more weapons, more blood...

title: WTP Story 1
description: WTP - Story 1 is a dynamic choice lead adventure.

title: Jewel Match Solitaire X: Collector's Edition
description: Explore a fantastical world in this new Solitaire adventure and restore magnificent castles to their former glory! Play more than 1000 (!) levels while unlocking classic solitaire variants! Search every last level for gems that you can use to purchase new upgrades for each scene.

title: Speer DX
description: Throw your speer, use it as a platform, and puzzle-platform your way through 125 stages in this director's cut version of the classic Speer!

title: Versus
description: Versus is an action-packed game combining 2.5D and 3D mechanics. Play as Zed on a mission to the enigmatic island of Isolux, battling fierce enemies and unraveling mysteries that only raise more questions. With unique levels, intense combat, and epic bosses, uncover the secrets lurking in Isolux.

title: The Kobolds Left Behind
description: A tear-filled story game about the bittersweet last day of three abandoned kobolds.

title: Princess of Seas
description: Princess of Seas is a sea sailing with Open-World, Sandbox, Quest, Explore, Sea Battle. Let's go and save this world.

title: Cute Cats 3
description: Kittens come back to challenge you once again! Test your memory and attentiveness. Play a new chapter of the beloved puzzle game and find all differences in pictures with our cute fellas.

title: Stick Go story
description: Stick Go story is a single-player indie game. It attempts to link strategy board games with fighting RPG games. The stickman-like characters can be regarded as 11 Go pieces, and you can fight against enemies by moving these pieces with some strategy.

title: Skylost
description: Skylost is a 3D exploration and crafting game where you climb and glide your way through dangerous floating islands in search of your lost love Amelia.

title: C.A.R.L.
description: C.A.R.L. is a retro puzzle-platformer in which players take on the role of a lost robot in a mysterious factory to uncover the secrets within its walls and thwart the plans of its mastermind proprietor.

title: Two Colours
description: Jump from platform to platform, red to blue, blue to red, timing your jumps precisely, and dodging falls and blocks which kill you over the course of 40 levels, grabbing the 20 collectibles to unlock a secret at the end of the game. Don't lose your focus, don't lose your patience.

title: Kingdoms and Slaves
description: Even with the slavery of the weak green-skinned, the kingdom couldn't resist to the curse of the crystals and began to fall, driving them madness, death, and leading the Kingdom to the catastrophe.

title: The Syber Virus
description: This is a casual rpg game, there are twelve levels from different challenges. You control the main role, with a little bit delicate play skill,to eliminate enemies.You can collect resources inside game to buy items and enhance your role...like a RPG,anyway.

title: Shell Soldier
description: Shell Soldier is a high‑octane first‑person shooter set in a bleak dystopian future. Featuring frenetic firefights against a diverse range of enemy combatants, each employing unique tactics and weaponry, and offering a wide arsenal of lethal tools at your disposal.

title: Midnight Guns
description: A tactical/arena shooter with a focus on movement, dynamic level interaction, and throwing rats at each other. Sometimes involves shooting.

title: The King of Fighters XV: Characters Team South Town
description: Geese Howard, Billy Kane, and Ryuji Yamazaki of "Team South Town" can be used in "The King of fighters XV".

title: 69 Summon Succubus
description: 69 Summon Sucubus - is a game in which you take on the role of a succubus trainer.You have become the owner of a magic book that allows you to summon the succubus Lilith. You need to choose skills for training and complete tasks. After each workout, your succubus will get stronger.

title: Captcha Kills
description: A crossover between Among-us and the Turing Test manifested in a battle royal in which you're to weaponize your own speech with the goal of deceiving others into believing you're dialog is artificially generated and not an imposter of sentient origins. Hide amongst the AI and become the last human.

title: Puppetmaker
description: A 3D first Person Horror Game which takes place in an old dusty house. You are trapped in the house together with an old mysterious Puppetmaker. The key is to be as silent as possible and escape the house by solving puzzles with logic, without being caught by him. Everything you do or move could be heard by the Puppetmaker, so be aware!

title: Ezekial S. Jackson's Amazing Truckology
description:
Amazing Truckology is a children’s computer game created by Ezekial S. Jackson that teaches children about a variety of trucks. There are four places to explore: the farm, fire station, the quarry, and the building site. Fifteen trucks are included in the game. There are also clickable hotspots in some of the scenes. There are some video clips and animations that shows the player the trucks on how it does and how they work. There are colour photographs on every truck included in the game, as well as some technical information.

Four Truck-A-Rama VR scenes are included in the game, as well as 3D animated models of the fifteen trucks included. The player can also simulate driving one of the fifteen trucks in the game as well. The game features background music which has 40 minutes of songs included. Amazing Truckology is suitable for ages 5 and up.

title: Treasure Seekers: Follow the Ghosts - Collector's Edition
Need for Speed II: Special Edition
description: Need for Speed II: Special Edition is a racing game with exotic cars and country‑themed courses, offering tournament and knockout modes. The Special Edition adds extra cars and the Last Resort track, a new "Wild" driving style, mirrored courses, and 3dfx Glide support for enhanced visuals.

title: Screensaver Subterfuge
description: In a parallel universe, the 3D maze screensaver included with Windows 95 assumes a bizarre role in the world of international espionage.

title: LazuLight: By Your Side
description:
Like a star pulled from the skies, a bird torn of its wings, you were bound to the Earth that day. You once ruled the skies, feeling the air rush through your hair as you flew between the clouds, clothes fluttering in the wind as you raced higher and higher. However, that's all in the past now, ever since the accident.

Now, completely opposite to what you once felt, the world is monotonous, gray, and dead. You find no meaning in life, as if frozen in time, now that your freedom was taken away from you.

However, that would all come to change with three fated encounters. The appearance of an old acquaintance from the track team, a reserved class president that seems to be hiding something, and a kindred soul seeking solace in the silence.

Faced with these new people who suddenly appeared in your life, you have to make the choice. Do you wallow in your failure in this monochrome prison, or do you take their hand and repaint this world?

By their side, the hands of the clock start ticking once more.

title: Antonblast
description: Antonblast is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged Dynamite Anton (or his cranked-out coworker Annie) and use your Mighty F’n Hammer to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your Spirits back from Satan!

title: Among the Trolls
description: Among the Trolls is a first-person, survival, action-adventure game where the secret mysteries of Finnish forests are unraveled. Venture deep into the Finnish wilderness to uncover family truths and master the art of survival

title: Starry Sky: After Spring
description: Starry Sky: After Spring takes place in Autumn, when the students of Seigatsu Gakuen are busy with preparations for the upcoming culture festival. They’re holding an exhibition, and some advisors from USA came to help the students. Yahisa Tsukiko, along with her childhood friends Nanami Kanata and Tohzuki Suzuya, was surprised to see their friend Tomoe Yoh there. Yoh came to see her in March, but left for America by the end of Spring. It turns out that Yoh is one of the advisors, and he’s staying in Japan until the culture festival is over.

title: The Ferryman
description:
Keep your lantern to your chest, lad. These waters aren't as calm as they may seem...

As the Ferryman, it's your duty to deliver goods and supplies to the denizens of the sea. It isn't an easy job, but it needs doing. The Keepers depend on you, so you'd better get to it. Just remember - the further you stray from the shore, the rougher yet the seas become.

title: Bokehme
description: Bokehme is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for the Dream Diary Jam 5. The game starts with Bokehme in her bedroom, who refuses to leave. The game tells you to collect dolls scattered around the dream world.

title: Iso
description: Join the robot Nem0-1 to collect photos of the animals inhabiting a post-human planet Earth filled with breathtaking sights and mysterious habitats. Complete your compendium by taking better photos, outsmart dangerous predators and explore the ruins of humanity.

title: Blind Monk's Society
description: A class project in Navigation, Game features Audio only gameplay, to simulate being blind and is set in a Monty Python-ish comical world where a group of blind Monks are initiating you into their society by having you perform several audio navigatory task to help you learn to SEE with your EARS. Game Plays through in about half an hour. Created by Kyle Audick & Erik Carlson UCLA D|MA 2008

title: Abashment
description: Abashment is a Yume Nikki fangame made for Dream Diary Jam 4. You play as Jonathan and explore his dreams.

title: Cats in Hell
description: Cats in Hell is an English fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 4. You play as a cat and explore Hell. The goal of the game is to explore and obtain new skills. Equipping skills doesn't erase the effect of the previous one. This means that all effects can be equipped at the same time.

title: Nana
description:
Nana is an English fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 4. You explore nana's dreams, the goal being to explore and collect effects.
Is nana hiding something? Someone?

title: Outsider
description: Shape humanity's future in a sci-fi narrative game where choices matter. Experience an extraterrestrial contact while deciphering an overarching mystery of far-reaching consequences. Who is the Outsider?

title: V.D.O
description:
V.D.O is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 4.
You explore the dreams of Grey and each dream is split into linear sections that the player must complete to progress.

title: Charon's Staircase
description: In this first-person horror mystery game, you set out to bury the horrible past of a tyrannical government. Retrieve and destroy the documents that unravel the secrets that lie beneath Oack Grove. Will you discover the terrifying truth and find your way out?

title: Gotham Knights: Collector's Edition
description:
The Gotham Knights: Collector's Edition includes:
- Deluxe Edition game and content
- New Guard Statue
- Promethium New Guard Transmogs
- Jim Lee Certificate of Authenticity
- Augmented Reality Talon Key
- Gotham City: City of Bridges map

title: Yume Dreamer
description: Yume Dreamer is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 4. Play as a shy girl called HER who's in a strange world when she enters her dreams. Explore her dreams and experience them for yourself!

title: Lawn Mowing Simulator: Landmark Edition
description: Experience the beauty and detail of mowing the Great British countryside in Lawn Mowing Simulator, the only simulator that allows you to ride an authentic and expansive roster of real-world licensed lawnmowers from prestigious manufacturers; Toro, SCAG, and STIGA as you manage your business.

title: Manda no Yume
description: Manda no Yume is a Yume Nikki inspired game originally made for Dream Diary Jam 2017. Manda enters a different world when she lies in bed. In this world she can discover effects that give her new abilities.

title: Soulstice: Deluxe Edition
description:
Soulstice: Deluxe Edition includes:
Soulstice Full game
Digital Soundtrack
Digital Artbook
Ashen Blade Item Pack

title: Mona
description: Mona is an immersive third person exploration and puzzle game set on an eerie island filled with fantastic creatures. Explore the world and uncover its secrets to figure out what ancient evil decimated the people who used to live there.

title: Px
description:
Px is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for Dream Diary Jam 2.
You play as an unnamed square who finds themself in a hollow world. The protagonist must explore and uncover the truth behind everything. In most areas, there is a notable NPC that you can talk to who'll quiz you or ask you to complete a task. The game has multiple endings based on the choices you make in the game.

title: Violentolitin
description: Violentolitin is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for Dream Diary Jam 2. You explore the dreams of Puck. The goal is to explore and collect effects. Along with effects, the player must also collect orbs hidden around the dream world to see the ending.

title: Tankitos
description: You can choose if you want to play solo missions or just enjoy some fun with your friends in online. Solo missions has same rules as in original "Battle City" game. Player have to protect his base against enemies. Enemies are spawned with different level and power. If player survive all enemies, player wins and can continue to next level, if player lost his all lives, player loosed and must play again. Most of walls are destroyable and those ones contains pickable items like, healths, armor and variety of weapons.

title: Arma Reforger
description: Powered by the new Enfusion engine, Arma Reforger lets you fight for supremacy over 51 km2 of incredible island terrain in an authentic Cold War setting, or create unique scenarios in real-time with the Game Master curation mode. Return to Everon, the war-driven microstate from the hit game that started it all, Arma: Cold War Assault.

title: Night at the Office
description: Experience Night at the Office, a walking simulator, puzzle horror game focused on placing you into the heart of an environment full of terror, suspense and surprise. Night at the Office focuses on delivering a story-rich murder mystery coupled with many horror elements to make the experience far more exciting.

title: Rag Doll Kung Fu: Black Belt Edition
description: Rag Doll Kung Fu: Black Belt Edition includes exclusive skins and a limited edition poster.

title: Miasma Chronicles
description: From the creators of Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden comes a beautifully crafted tactical adventure you won’t forget. Embark on a quest across a post-apocalyptic wasteland torn apart by a savage force known only as the ‘Miasma’.

title: Brilliance shines in Zhejiang
description: 2D role-playing game Players will play the protagonist, the protagonist's first-person perspective to experience the historical changes in Zhejiang in the past hundred years, and experience and learn from the protagonist's tenacious ideals, beliefs and spiritual strength.

title: The Finally
description: JRPG 2D retro pixel adventure puzzle drama love sacrifice tells the story of a young man who must travel to get back to his lover. The gameplay is a walk to find information from the characters around you. to find a way to continue Walk against enemies with battle commands.

title: Wood Cuter
description: The trees outside the village began to grow wildly, blocking the road and occupying the farmland.， Explore the deepest part of the forest, unlock the secrets of the wild growth of trees, and restore the forest to its former calm

title: Ball Hunter
description: The hunter embarks on a journey into the deep forest of Tiger Mountain. Discover the secrets of the deepest part of the forest, unravel the mysteries of animals turning into spheres, and restore the forest to its original appearance.

title: Weird Hat Fight
description: Weird Hat Fight is a party game where you use magical hats to fight your friends to the death.

title: The Bird's Realm 3
description: This is another simple calm open world bird flying simulator! There are no goals or quests, just simply flying around this large island in a sandbox open world to kill time. Find glowing eggs to unlock a bird.

title: Aurelia: Stellar Arising
description: Aurelia: Stellar Arising - 3D Turn-based Fleet vs. Fleet Space Combat Game. Choose between two factions and fight for control of the Aurelia System in over 77 missions per faction. Control fleets of up to 9 ships and give maneuver and tactical commands to each ship.

title: Sore Jaa, Mata ne.
description: A short story. Black and white. Sparse drawings. Sparse music. Three characters. One smile.

title: Sonic CD: Episode Metal
description: A mod that adds Metal Sonic and Amy Rose to Sonic CD as playable characters, with their own movesets and changes to the story scenes, bosses and more.

title: Natsu no Hi no Resonance
description: A delicate tale of coming-of-age, with cell phones, and friends in far-off places, and the first blush of unrequited love ...

title: Dark Tales: Edgar Allan Poe's The Black Cat - Collector's Edition
description:
Go on an adventure with Inspector Dupin! Monsieur Mark Davies has reported his wife, Sara, missing and now it’s up to you to track her down and solve the mystery! Follow a mysterious black cat, who seems to be purposely helping you, and discover helpful clues in Dark Tales: Edgar Allen Poe’s The Black Cat. Use your Hidden Object talents to tackle the case, and discover the evil culprit behind Sara’s disappearance.

Collector's Edition includes:
Bonus gameplay
Stunning soundtrack
Wonderful wallpapers
Integrated Strategy Guide

title: Make a Friend
description:
Meet Nathan, a lonesome middle-schooler who's been given a seven-step ritual guaranteed to make friends. If the man in the cream suit is to be believed, it only takes some clay, some candles, and a small mammal. The only catch: he has to find those things in his own room.

Collect the ritual ingredients throughout the room. You may have to make a substitution here or there.
Perform the steps within the interactive desk interface.
Decide the fate of this house. There are seven steps, but there is only one choice...
...will you make a friend?

title: Mystery Trackers: Raincliff's Phantoms
description: Mystery Trackers: Raincliff's Phantoms is the sixth title in the Mystery Trackers series and in developed by Elephant Games.

title: Mystery Trackers: Blackrow's Secret
description: It's been two hundred years since the plague swept through here... Authorities quarantined the area around Blackrow Mansion, and it hasn't been opened since. But now, an up-and-coming starlet is receiving strange threats that have drawn her straight to the quarantine zone. What is hiding behind the rusted gates of the Forbidden District? Play innovative new mini-games and explore gorgeous hidden-object puzzles as you track down the truth behind Blackrow's secret!

title: Piko-piko: Koisuru Kimochi no Nemuru Basho
description: The story takes place in the near future. As globalization swept the world, almost all of industries in Japan declined. One and only industry that survived is moe industry and Japanese people get together and work hard to develop moe industry.

title: Akuma
description: Akuma is a Spanish Yume Nikki fangame created by AshitaMinami. You play a boy named Akise who cannot leave his bedroom. Along with collecting effects, the main goal of the game is to uncover the story that unfolds by exploring the dream world. Unlike most traditional fangames, Akuma features dialogue and in-game text like journals to help tell its story.

title: E Nikki
description: E Nikki is a Yume Nikki fangame. The game stars a young boy named Hazuki, who has rather light-hearted dreams. What makes this game different from most fangames is that you don't start from the Nexus, rather than that the player starts from a random main world, and is forced to find a leaf to take them to the Nexus. The location is then linked to the leaf permanently, so you can visit it later.

title: Fog
description: You have just escaped a murderous cult that has now summoned a ginormous being to track you down. It and the ones it controls will stop at nothing to hunt you down while you try to find food, money, and anything else you can use to survive in this horror roguelike adventure.

title: Idtipsa
description: Idtipsa is a Spanish Yume Nikki fangame, starring Nex. The goal is to explore the dream world and collect effects.

title: Strange Memo
description: Strange Memo also known as Strange Fancy in older versions, is a Japanese Yume Nikki Fangame. Strange Memo is a traditional fangame. You start as Maigo. They can travel to the Fantasy World by sleeping on the bed, and the main task is to collect effects scattered in it.

title: Yume Doodle
description: Yume Doodle is a Spanish Yume Nikki fangame. The game starts with Twinky, but you can also switch to Twink. Their worlds are different, and they can't go into each other's dreams.

title: Bunny Girl Story
description: The girl works in the Bunny Club. She loves to sing songs and dance. But she is alone. However one day there is an opportunity to change everything.

title: Doki Doki Exit Music: Redux
description: A total rewrite and general overhaul of the 2018 Radiohead-inspired mod, Exit Music. It has been improved on every front, with a story loosely following the events of the original, but rewritten from the ground up to improve the experience, and make for a much more cohesive and enjoyable story. On top of that, the mod retains its Radiohead score (now censor-friendly!), all-new spritework & CGs, alongside a meticulous attention to detail & sound design.

title: Nukitashi
description: Seiran Island. Even here in paradise, there are those who work in the shadows to bring it down... Confront the tyranny of a twisted system in this long-awaited visual novel adventure.

title: Yume Fumi
description: Yume Fumi is a Spanish Yume Nikki fangame. The game stars Lilit and Insomnia. In Yume Fumi the player follows the traditional exploration concept as Yume Nikki. You always start as Lilit, and you can switch to Insomnia and back using a book. Your main goal is to collect all effects for both characters.

title: Yume Shikki
description:
Yume Shikki (sometimes referred to as Yume 4kki) is a fan collaboration project created by users of 4channel/4chan's /v/ board.
The gameplay of Yume Shikki is that of a traditional fangame and involves exploring a variety of different worlds and collecting various effects. No endings or end goal exists in the game. The protagonist of the fangame is Yotsuba Koiwai, the main character of the Yotsuba&! manga.

title: Time Traveler
description:
The young Mizuno Mai is the result of a relationship between a spirit and a human being.

From the beginning of her life, she has been trapped in some mysterious and curious worlds defended by some living beings called "Guardians." Her birth broke god's rules and her grandfather will be chasing her to erase her existence and everything around her as part of a personal revenge. Because of that, and with a bit of help, she will be able to travel to the past, present and future, and grow in a lot of ways to face her fears.

Meanwhile, you will discover more than a simple reason like that. She will fight monsters, demons and a lot of other souls... and a mysterious God is behind all of that. Mai will try to uncover the truth of his strange world.

title: Mystery Masters: Wicked Worlds Collection
description: A collection of 20 mystery games for PC.

title: SpearFrog
description: "SpearFrog" is a hardcore ,action adventure game with beautiful pixel Art.

title: Divine Combat
description: Divine Combat is a turn-based strategy game wherein you lead a team to victory against another team. The fights are in top-down view on a grid, much like similar turn-based unit management games. There is no penalty for losing.

title: Another Side
description: Another Side is a psychological horror game with greater focus on the mystery of the plot and atmosphere than just cheap scares on the screen, brings a simple mechanics with greater purpose in its story, explore every corner, use logic and find paths to be followed.

title: Invasion Vill
description: A traveler ends up in an accident, after which he is forced to find a way to escape the creature that is chasing him. Will you be able to find your way to survival?

title: No Way Up
description: The only way up... Is down.

title: Offenders
description: Make deals with people to identify and distract your enemies in order to eliminate them one by one and clear the areas from them until you reach their leader.

title: Nora: The Wannabe Alchemist
description: Witchcraft school dropout Nora can’t seem to keep her houseplants alive, much less excel at alchemy, but her dream is to become a famous alchemist! In this visual novel-time management hybrid, your greatest enemies are klutziness … and a ticking clock.

title: Crash Forts
description: Crash Forts is an addictive physics and destruction game. You have to destroy various structures with the help of tools.

title: Station Osirius
description: Station Osirius - The State has lost contact with Osirius Station. You are assigned the task to recover to the station and find out what is happening there.

title: Pirate Treasure
description: Logic puzzle game in which you have to find pirate treasures!

title: A Match with a Succubus Witch
description: A Match with a Succubus Witch tells the story of a guy who lives into a fantasy world where he meets a sucubbus witch ready to fulfill their most pleasurable desires. Gameplay is a Match 3 classic with visual novel that allows the player to take off their clothes and make choices to keep in track...

title: Elmo's Preschool
description: An educational computer game in which Elmo hosts a handful of minigames meant to teach children about the basics of numbers, letters, shapes, facial expressions, and music.

title: Project Noah
description: Welcom aboard! You're now the crew of Revision, global leading company of space exploration. Operate Project Noah. Follow the manual. The destiny of space explorer dog Noah is on your hand.

title: Fiefdom
description: Change the world, one battle at a time in FIEFDOM: a multiplayer action melee game set in a playerbase-driven story. Clash swords, cast spells, rain down arrows & more in in battles of up to 100 players both at land & at sea. Dive into a world where your victories define the outcome of entire wars. Who will you be fighting for?

title: The Valiant
description: Embark on a journey of brotherhood and redemption in The Valiant, a squad-based RTS set in 13th Century Europe and the Middle East. Command and level-up your medieval knights as you fight through an epic SP campaign, then take your skills online in both cooperative and competitive MP modes.

title: Impasto
description: Impasto is a first-person horror adventure game inspired by the works and legacy of Francisco Goya, the revered yet tortured Spanish painter. Set within a world irreversibly altered by his fraying sanity, the player must use both stealth and wits to survive.

title: Vinemon: Sauce Edition
description:
Vinemon: Sauce Edition is a Monster Catching Parody Fan Game made in RPG Maker XP Engine which is coined by the developers as "An Interactive Shitpost full of soul."

The game is set in a new Region known as 'Fanoth', which used to be a region that was once believed that no person would or should ever be able to enter.

title: Band of Mercenaries
description: Band of Mercenaries is a couch one-hit kill respawning arena game in which your lives (respawns) are the mercenaries you hired. To win you can either be good on the battlefield or have money sense to make the battle unbalance from the start.

title: Lenny's Time Machine
description: Travel through time in a multimedia world of games, puzzles, and creative adventures.

title: Punk-o-Matic 2
description: The ultimate music game! Create awesome punk-rock-metal music build your career!!

title: Let's Go Baby! Suffocation
description: The journey in Let's Go! Baby! Friends World finally reaches its crescendo with Let's Go Baby! Suffocation, a standalone expansion / definitive edition combo that finally concludes the narrative running behind LGB:FW.

title: Trash Patrol
description:
Trash Patrol is a cooperative multiplayer game for 2-4 players. You and one or more of your friends break into a house. Your goal: Steal every item within the given time!

But be aware of the homeowner! They do not condone raccoons running around their house and trashing it! If they spot you: Run!

title: Conformity
description: Conformity is a first-person horror video game created and developed by Alessandro Capriolo.

title: Outward: Definitive Edition
description: Outward: Definitive Edition combines the base game with The Soroboreans and The Three Brothers DLCs, presenting a complete survival-RPG experience in the world of Aurai. Players navigate through a challenging open world where they must manage basic needs while exploring dungeons, mastering combat, and uncovering the mysteries of the realm. This edition includes additional weapons, expanded areas, mechanical improvements, and enhanced visuals, integrating all content into one cohesive package.

title: Fall Guys: Season 1 - Free for All
description: Welcome to Fall Guys: Season 1 - Free for All! You're invited to dive and dodge your way to victory in the pantheon of clumsy. Rookie or pro? Solo or partied up? Fall Guys delivers ever-evolving, high-concentrated hilarity and fun!

title: Super Gosu Cars
description: Arcade racing action mixed with kart racing combat! Up to 8 players in local multiplayer! Lots of different vehicles, drivers and tracks to try out and more yet to unlock! Go for gold in the Grand Prix! Hone your skills in Time Trial! Run wild in Custom Tournaments! - It's Super Gosu Cars time!

title: Fresh Out the Oven
description: Fresh Out the Oven is a relaxing single-player cooking and business management game. You'll go through 20 varying mini-games as you discover new types of food to cook, and if you take too long you'll burn it! As you move on up you expand your restaurant and can design it however you want.

title: BookStore Simulator
description: Open your dream bookstore and begin sowing the seeds of knowledge among locals. Push the boundaries of possibility and immerse your business in a world of magic.

title: Galaxy Cat
description: Play as Coz the Cosmic Kitten as you travel the solar system reconnecting the universe together.

title: Shady Lewd Kart
description: Shady Lewd Kart takes go karting party games and mashes it with a dating sim to give you fast power sliding game play, sexy power-ups and lewd unlocks. The first ever Ecchi Kart game!

title: Run Hare Run
description: Being a rabbit is not an easy task, especially if thou are an endangered species listed in the red book.

title: Logjam
description: Logjam is a short gay forestry sim about a burly lumberjack chopping wood on a hot summer day.

title: Alley Cat: Remeow Edition
description: A remake of the 1983 game Alley Cat (Atari 8-bit/IBM PC) with more modern graphics and sound and some added features, most notably several new stages and a multiplayer mode.

title: Hyperliminal
description: Welcome to Hyperliminal, a horror/exploration/fever-dream experience. The game itself is narration and exploration-based with some action to keep things interesting. You will explore a strange dreamscape and witness sites ranging from gigantic food to a town overtaken by arachnids. Unravel the mystery of the recurring nightmare while keeping safe a safe distance from the horrors that live within.

title: GreedFall: The Dying World
description:
The story starts three years before the events of the first game and the adventures of De Sardet.

This time you play as a native of Teer Fradee, uprooted by force from your island and taken to the continent of Gacane, where the colonists are from. In this old world ravaged by war and scarred by the Malichor plague and the political scheming of the different factions, you need to regain your freedom and control of your own destiny. Using diplomacy, cunning or combat, as well as help from allies you make, it's up to you to end one man's ambitions of conquest, which could spell the end for the continent and your island.

Experience the unique world of GreedFall again by exploring the old continent! Travel across new landscapes, from Olima – the city of stars of the Bridge Alliance – to the shores of Uxantis, and uncover the secrets of these ancient lands. Meet all the factions that share control over these nations and navigate the treacherous waters of their schemes and conspiracies.

Create your own character and find allies to join your team. Help them with their quests, uncover their secrets and make them your friends, rivals or even lovers. As well as equipping them the way you want, you can also take control of them in combat.

Immerse yourself in an ever deeper RPG experience where every choice has an impact on your adventure and where diplomacy, manipulation, infiltration and combat are all viable paths for you to achieve your aims.

title: WRC Generations
description:
New mechanics have been integrated to represent the demands of the hybrid engines. In order to win, you have to carefully manage your battery by adapting your engine mapping throughout the special stages you take part in.

As community satisfaction is always a priority , you can now share customised livery and stickers with other players. The best creations will be rewarded and highlighted.

title: Uchikano: Living With My Girlfriend
description:
Uchikano - Living With My Girlfriend is a slice of life story involving two childhood friends who start living together, and later develop romantic feelings for each other. Tachibanaki Keisuke is about to begin his life as a fully fledged member of society. He has a job at a small company that he’s satisfied with and he is living on his own, supporting himself. While he is motivated because of his job, everyday he comes home exhausted and one thought crosses his mind, “If only I had a girlfriend…”

One day, his childhood friend Matoi Ayame appears at his door. Her parents moved abroad for work and Ayame decided to stay behind for her college entrance exams. Since her parents are good friends of the Tachibanaki family, they entrusted Keisuke to take care of their daughter. That was how Keisuke and Ayame started living together under one roof and when they started to see each other as more than friends.

title: Totems
description: TOTEMS - A 3D logic puzzle game in which you have to destroy various blocks and magical totems! Your task is to destroy the blocks so that all parts of the totem are on the ground! But be careful, there are other important rules in the game!

title: Fire Heat
description: Fire Heat is a 2D simulation sports game! Immerse yourself in the world of sports and entertainment. You will have a completely unusual approach to sports games, knock down skittles with a butterfly knife throw, throw glass bottles into rings or kick a cake instead of a ball.

title: SpinCross
description: spin it!

title: Kids Tetris
description: Kids Tetris is a variation of the classic Russian puzzle game geared towards children. The main characters of the game are the Minos, the pieces that make up the Tetris board. There are four locations where you can play Tetris: the circus, the fire station, the laboratory, and the haunted house. Each board requires a certain amount of lines to be cleared to win Tetris. Since the game is a variation for children, the blocks start out small and fall down slowly. As the game progresses, the pieces become more complex and they fall down faster. After you win, there are many toys and stage props that you can play with in the activity center. You can also print out coloring pages based on the game and a certificate for each stage you play. The game supports both single player and multiplayer. The game is playable with the on-screen mouse controls or the keyboard.

title: Medal of Honor: Warfighter - Digital Deluxe Edition
description: Includes everything in the standard edition plus the soundtrack and an edge in multiplayer combat. Unlock the ballistic power of the Spetsnaz gunner and the surgical precision of the legendary Navy SEAL sniper.

title: The Sims Medieval: Deluxe Edition
description: Includes both The Sims Medieval and The Sims Medieval Pirates & Noble Adventure Pack. The Sims Medieval takes players back to the Middle Ages, where players can create a hero, go out on quests, and build a kingdom of their very own. Players' adventures decide the future of their realm, shaping it into a thriving utopia or a war-torn area of disaster. The Pirate Pack switches gears, tossing players into a feud between the Pirates of Aarbyville and the Nobles of Tredony.

title: Boot & Shoot
description: Shoot. kick. dodge. kill. improve. die. repeat.

title: Vactics
description: Build your mech to fight against the robotic Vactics. Each time you play the game will assemble a new randomised Solitude City to liberate in tactical combat.

title: Dracula III: The Path of the Dragon - Part 1: The Strange Case of Martha
Detana!! TwinBee
description: The PC-Engine port of Bells & Whistles originally released only in Japan before coming to the West through the Wii Virtual Console service, under its original Japanese title.

title: Mike's Monstrous Adventure
description:
Mike's Monstrous Adventure is a PC game released on September 2002. The game is based on Monsters, Inc. It is a point-and-click adventure game developed by Hulabee Entertaiment.

Players control Mike as he searches the factory and solve puzzles to restore the parts to the Laugh Energy Filter 5000, a laugh machine which is needed for a big press conference. Exploring the factory takes players to a variety of locations including the lobby, platform room, atrium, maintenance room, cafeteria, security booth, conference room, elevator, trash room, pipe room, tentacle room, contamination room, R&D lab, pressure control room, locker room, mailroom and more.

During the adventure, players interact with characters from the film, including Delta, Boo, Fran, Smitty, Needleman, Skip, and Wally. In addition to solving puzzles, kids are required to complete simple tasks like finishing Mike's paperwork, exploring every room in the factory to find joke cards, and maintaining a small inventory. Joke cards are used by Mike to match specific types of jokes, categorized by sports, animals, science, food, music, family, transportation, school, monsters and clown routines, with certain kids to make them laugh.

Upon completion of the first puzzle, a blueprint becomes available that shows the missing machine parts as well as a list of items that have been found. After Mike rescues Boo early in the game, players gain access to the Cereal Slide mini-game where the goal is to become the first player to line up colored cereal pieces horizontally, vertically or diagonally in a row of three (3x3 grid) or four (5x5 or 7x7 grids). Hints and gameplay instructions are included in a printable and colorful electronic manual on the CD.

title: Paso Pico McDonald's de Asobo!
description: This is the PC remake of McDonald's de Asobo!

title: BCI VR Horror Attraction: The Mad Trail
description: Meet BCI VR Horror Attraction: The Mad Trail created by members of BCI LAB room. This game gives you optimized fear by measuring brain waves during play. Also, you can check your shooting skills by scoring right after the expedition. Welcome to the tense BCI VR Horror Attraction: The Mad Trail.

title: Ancient TriPeaks
description: You can be a novice or an expert, you'll still be able to find your way to make history in this take on the old solitaire favorite, tripeaks. Clear away layers of cards as you experience the passing of eons. With eight different games to choose from, this stunning game has something for everyone.

title: Linguist FPS: The Language Learning FPS
description: Learn a new language with this fast paced action shooter! Follow instructions in your target language to unlock weapons and equipment upgrades. Use your new found language skills to save the city from an army of killer robots! Learn Japanese, Russian, French, Spanish, Ukrainian and much more.

title: Tales of Grumville: A Legendary Pie and A Nameless Statue
description:
The small town of Grumville is many things to many people. To some, it is the heart of all of things wonderful and mysterious. To others, it is the land of dreams no longer dreamed about. To little Audrey, it is her new home and "the ugliest, most boring town in the whole freaking world".

Follow her journey as she tries to fight boredom in her small new town, comes across a mysterious statue whose name has been lost in time and stumbles upon perhaps the greatest adventure of her life (so far).

title: TitTok 3
description: TitTok 3 - Minimalistic adventure 2D puzzle platformer with cats, explosions and spinning saws! Continuation of the TitTok 2.

title: Athanasia
description: Athanasia is an action survival horror immersive sim where you explore a mysterious facility and use everything you have to survive with an arsenal of equipment as well as your wits against time traveling predators from prehistory and the future.

title: Tiny Town Mail
description: It's your first day on the job, and you have several packages to deliver, but all of the labels are smudged! Get to know the folks of Tiny Town and try to figure out who ordered what in this small and simple puzzle game.

title: San Zoolin
description: San Zoolin is a beautiful latin island full of mysteries and colorful characters. You get to explore the inner lives of these characters in depth, as well as the beautiful world around them as the new island therapist.

title: Sunset Hills
description: The player takes on the role of Nico, who travels by train to each city to visit his former comrades, encountering a variety of people and events on the journey, and gradually learning about different life through solving assorted puzzles along the way. As they reunite, they recall their past experiences in the war, unravelling the war and Nico’s past, and gradually revealing the true purpose of Nico’s journey.

title: Little Island Adventure
description: A small open-world game, set to deliver the player with an enjoyable journey of exploration through the completion of quests, activities, and solving puzzles.

title: Bits & Bops
description: Bits & Bops is a collection of original rhythm mini-games. Featuring over 20 mini-games filled with catchy music, snappy gameplay and gorgeous, hand-drawn animation, Bits & Bops is sure to brighten your day.

title: Flying Neko Delivery
description: Take on the role of Onigiri, a feline witch who lives in a cottage in the forest and delivers packages flying on a broomstick. Earn money from each delivery to customize your cottage. During deliveries, explore new worlds, forage plants and fungi, and meet quirky villagers along the way.

title: Watashi ha Joyuu ni Naritai no
description: This is a short visual novel about a girl who has lost sight of the reason for her dreams to become an actress.

title: Deer & Boy
description: A Cinematic Platformer who you follow the journey of a boy who, during his flight will meet an unexpected companion. Together they will overcome many obstacles that will change their lives forever.

title: Hooked on You: A Dead by Daylight Dating Sim
