description: Welcome to Murderer’s Island. Your companions: four dead-sexy Killers who, underneath their murderous exteriors, just want a little romance. Flirt your way into their hearts, uncovering dark twists along the way. Will you find true love, forge friendships… or get hacked to death?

title: Picnic Penguin
description: In Picnic Penguin you can push multiple blocks at a time and rearrange them to open the path and complete the levels. Picnic Penguin features several worlds to unlock with a huge variation of puzzles to solve while finding coins to collect all the skins on the gashapon machine.

title: Warframe: Archwing
description: Tenno take flight -- Archwing has arrived! Players Mastery Rank 2 or greater can quest to assemble the Archwing technology allowing for space combat sans spacecraft. Two unique game modes, new enemies, weapons and Mods are all available. Choose from the offensive Elytron Archwing or well-rounded Odonata and bring the fight straight to the enemy, Tenno!

title: Shatter Remastered Deluxe
description:
Shatter returns in stunning 4K resolution running at 120fps, with a modernised UI, and multiple visual improvements. Re-experience the highly acclaimed original soundtrack, remixed and remastered in 5.1 surround sound.
Travel through 10 distinct worlds and battle 9 unique bosses; packed with amazing physics effects, power-ups and special attacks. Take control of the playing field with the innovative “suck and blow” mechanic, altering the game to your benefit and charging up ultimate ability SHARDSTORM.

title: Warframe: Sanctuary
description: Work with Cephalon Simaris to find the source of a mysterious voice. Something is out there, and it is hunting. Work with Simaris to track it down and discover its true nature.

title: Disney's Animated Storybook: The Hunchback of Notre Dame
Mario Cars 2: 64
description: Mario Cars 2: 64 is a game about cars, racing and the notion of whether it be the hand of fate or free will that leads us through this mortal coil. Race with Mario & Friends through three tracks!! Race your cars!

title: Rollovski
description:
A stealth game about a small limbless round detective, who must infiltrate a strange hotel with only circular rooms.

A playable prototype by Simogo.

title: NASB: Nitro
description: This is a WIP mod that changes the behavior of some of the characters and mechanics in the game to give a faster, more explosive experience.

title: Dream Day Wedding: Married in Manhattan
Dennou Taisen: DroneZ
description:
a single-player futuristic shooter. The player is guiding a female avatar through a virtual reality, representing the future world for humans living in suspended animation vats while their bodies are being cared for by insects and their minds are prevented from leaving the virtual world by its dominant AI.
The task is for the character to jump/travel on discs representing memory bits in an organic computer, while avoiding wall mounted cannons, electrical fields and various aliens trying to stop you from escaping the virtual reality into the real world. The graphics are reminiscent of the movie TRON with a bright, neon style.

title: Wing
description: In "Wing", you play as a fledgeling who fell from the nest, learning to fly as you climb back up to the sky.

title: Fallout 3: Broken Steel and Point Lookout
Fallout 3: The Pitt & Fallout 3: Operation Anchorage
Courier Tale
description: You've joined the gig economy as a courier for T.A.L.E. Couriers! Explore, meet and chat with a cast of characters, complete deliveries for the company while doing jobs on the side in this pixel art adventure where this job is not everything you expected it to be...

title: Yoiks!
description: Humorously introducing computer programming and spatial reasoning skills, Yoiks! provides students with an off-beat learning environment where they explore 30 activities of increasing difficulty that typify core concepts of computer programming. Yoiks! engages students in the scientific process of observation, hypotheses formation, and experimentation to apply logical constructs as they solve problems. With Yoiks! in your mathematics and technology curriculum your students will: build logical reasoning and critical thinking skills, develop algebraic thinking skills, intuitively prepare for programming, develop strategies and solution plans, and collaborate to solve problems.

title: Mass Effect 3: N7 Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The N7 Digital Deluxe Edition contains:
- Mass Effect 3
- N7 Arsenal pack and in-game items (N7 Crusader shotgun, N7 Hurricane submachine gun, N7 Valiant Sniper, N7 Eagle handgun, N7 hoodie)
- Downloadable Art book and lithograph
- Mass Effect Digital Comic by Dark Horse Comics
- From Ashes DLC

title: Battlefield: Bad Company 2 - Digital Deluxe Edition
description: This edition includes Battlefield: Bad Company 2 game and Battlefield: Bad Company 2 - Vietnam expansion pack. It also features instant access to four vehicle unlockables and three weapons.

title: Pleasurepunk: Drug Dealer
description: In Pleasurepunk: Drug Dealer you are a hacker trying to find compromised photos of a drug dealer wanted by the FBI. Destroy the blocks and see the most hot pics of her.

title: Kawaii Girl
description: The Kawaii Girl is full of cute girls! Use beautiful girls to clear several dungeons Conquer the dungeon, have a fun.The difficulty of the game is a little high. Please buy carefully!

title: No-Go
description: A dark thriller in first-person perspective. We play as Charles Wood, who has the task of espacing a city taken over by a fanatic gang.

title: Resident Evil 6: Survivors Mode
description: Adds the Survivors game mode to the Extra Content menu of Resident Evil 6! It's a battle between agents, and only the last man standing can be the victor. This mode supports up to 6-players in individual deathmatch, or team battles!

title: Marriage to the Demon Wife!
description: An erotic VR fantasy romance simulation game set in medieval Japan! This is a VR game (also playable on desktop) where you can fall in love with a demon girl whose appearance you can customize to your liking, and even do naughty things with her.

title: Unknown Garden
description: This game is a block puzzle that connects male and Female. This game includes sexual expression by pixel art. When you completed the game you will see a female nude image.

title: Kapitan Pronin: Odin protiv vseh
description: An interactive fiction game Captain Pronin: One Against All originally released for the PC, and later unofficially to PlayStation. The adventure quest has 400 endings and 200 animated scenes, its graphics has the similar style as the cartoon series, and the text contains humor, jokes and allusions to various foreign and domestic pop culture references.

title: Desert Lost
description: This is a third person action game. Players are surrounded by monsters and are free to explore the surrounding area. Players must avoid monster attacks or kill them to survive.

title: Cut
description: "Cut" is a story about the self, the protagonist will explore in a dark and dreamy world, cutting the plant that brings pain to this world - Ner.

title: Hentai Crazy Girls
description: This is the puzzle with a several levels of difficulty and beautiful artbook. All characters appearing in this game are over 18 years of age.

title: Naked Porn Battle
description: Katya is a badass fighter. She organizes championships in the darkest places in the world to attract a diverse audience. Basically, fights always take place between women. Men don't participate in the fights.

title: Intertwined Fate with a Cat Demon
description: The human, Yi, was accidentally infected by a “blood cicada” on the road and ran into Hitomi, a cat demon who was hunting the blood cicada. Faced by Yi, the human who was scared and also infected, the cat demon chose to stay with Yi, in order to protect and to observe her…

title: Paradise Beach Girls
description: A relaxing Visual Novel in which you meet and talk with 5 different girls on a vacation in Miami.

title: Pleasure Airlines
description: Erotic adventure in the hottest flight ever!

title: Anime Gas Station
description: Relaxing puzzle game with cute gas station girls.

title: Milk Bottle and Monster Girl 2
description: "Moke Bottle and Monster Girl 2" is a shooting game that avoids monsters and breaks the target point. There will be 5 monsters in each level. Players can control the Moke bottle to avoid monsters and break the target point to clear the level.

title: Pandemic: The Virus Outbreak
description: Are you good enough to make your country overcome the pandemic? Try it out! You're the president of a new country, In 1/1/2020 a pandemic started and you have to manage the country balancing 8 constantly chaging statistics using isolation measures or budget investments.

title: Glitch Puzzle
description: Glitch Puzzle is a classical puzzle in unusual anime style.

title: Shtdn
description:
The desktop is peaceful as usual.
In order to delete the computer virus called "Agape", the anti-virus program, Virus Buster "Goyou", must cooperate with it while searching through the computer's files.

title: Silver Thread
description: An exorcist that doubts the existence of ghost might sound contradictory but to Alicia Wilkershire, this is the right way to get closer to the truth. Her latest job sounded like another run-of-the-mill case and she greeted her client with her usual pessimism but is it, really?

title: Germinal
description: Help Greg stay healthy during an epidemic as he jumps, hovers and cleans his way through quarantine with his disinfectant jetpack.Witness his developing mysophobia(fear of contamination) express itself in the increasingly difficult game play, and replay the game to master the mechanics or search for more story bits.

title: RSDKv4 Decompilation
description: A decompilation for Sonic 1 & 2 (the remastered versions), making them playable on computers, since the original releases were only for mobile platforms. The mod also comes with a built-in mod loader.

title: Sonic CD 2011 Decompilation
description: A decompilaton of Sonic CD (the 2011 remaster version, using the mobile version as a basis) for computers. This mod adds a built-in mod loader and technical improvements over the officially released version of the remaster for PC.

title: Poena
description: Poena is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. You play as a boy named Kasetsuki who refuses to leave his room for unknown reasons. The main objective of the game is to explore the dream world and collect all the effects (known as :Culpa:).

title: Amillusion
description:
Amillusion is a Yume Nikki fangame by the Team Compote. You play Danaë, who tries to stay awake reading a photo album. Explore her crazy and surrealistic dreams to find the "Keys".

Sometimes, eccentricity can hide darker things...

title: Another Way
description: Another Way is an English Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Drake, a mad scientist who has trapped himself in his lab. He can explore his subconscious via the teleporter in his lab. Another Way is a traditional-styled fangame where the player explores the dream world and collect effects called Experiments in game. Experiments are used with the Shift key, and the player can return to the Lab at any time with the Return button from the main menu. An interesting thing about the Experiments is that each one has it's own face portrait, save for a few.

title: August 31
description: August 31 is a Chinese Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Huá Jū. It plays like most Yume Nikki fangames, except that there are some events that have dialogue with other characters and it has little to no music.

title: Blooms
description:
blooms is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. It stars two characters, Nonoka and Kiribana. The point of the game is to sleep in the bed and collect effects while dreaming. You always start off as Nonoka but can switch characters at any point. In Nonoka's bedroom, there is a music box where the player can access a sound test with unlockable tracks. In Kiribana's bedroom there is a minigame on her bookshelf called Little RPG.

Most of the time, it doesn't really matter which character the player controls, since the dream worlds are the same for both characters and effects are even shared in both of their inventories once collected. However there are a few situations where one character can do one thing where the other refuses or is unable to do the same thing.

Along with collecting effects, there are 3 additional menu types to be found hidden throughout the dream world.

title: Circuitdream.exe
description:
circuitdream.exe is a Yume Nikki fangame made as a crossover with the anime series Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's.
The game features Antinomy and his twin younger brother Bruno. Bruno is in the hospital and it is up to Ant to find out what happened to him by exploring his brother's mind using the mysterious program "circuitdream.exe". By exploring Bruno's mind, Ant learns a lot about his brother that he never knew, as well as things about himself.
So, what could have happened? Is Bruno sick? Was he in an accident? Or was he trying to commit suicide? Antinomy will find out and surely save him!

title: Corallo
description:
Corallo is a Yume Nikki fangame. The main focus is exploring "dreams" and collecting "effects", which can be purely cosmetic or make the character perform certain actions.

Corallo focuses on Maya, a young woman stuck on a wheelchair and locked in a room. She can only stare at the ocean in front of her window and daydream.
By interacting with her mind, the player can learn more about her and her past, and what lead her to be stuck in her current room.

title: Cyclothymic
description: Cyclothymic is an English Yume Nikki fangame. You play as a girl named Koji who refuses to leave her room, exploring a world she enters by reading her notebook. Like most fangames, the main objective is exploration.

title: Distress
description: Lieutenant Huchess came to, an hour or so ago. That was around the time Runoma, blazing orange-hot so near this, its second planet, fell below the distant, jagged crag line. Ensign Covegn died not long after -- Sandra Marie Covegn, both legs crushed under the weight of the pod's torn hatch. Night came quickly, bringing with it cool and howling winds that whistle through desert rocks and carry other, more dangerous sounds.

title: Dream Sequences
description: Dream Sequences is a Yume Nikki fangame. Like other fangames, the game involves exploring the dream world and collecting effects. In this game effects are obtainable items which disappear after equipping them from the menu. In order to activate the effect again, you need to collect it again.

title: Dreams of Dead
description: Dreams of Dead is a Russian Yume Nikki fangame. It's an exploration adventure horror game with a few puzzles. You play as a girl named Aya who wakes up in the hospital for unknown reasons.

title: Dugashoba!
description: DuGaSHoBa! is a Yume Nikki fangame. It is the sequel to Nightmare Castle. It stars a girl named Maho. DuGaSHoBa! is a traditional fangame with the goal being exploration and effect collection.

title: Espacio
description: Espacio is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. You explore the dreams of the protagonist, Via lattea.

title: Friendly
description: Friendly is a Chinese Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Huán Xíng Zǐ and the goal is to explore her dream world.

title: The Sims 4: Moonlight Chic Kit
description: With The Sims 4 Moonlight Chic Kit, Simmers can discover new styles and dress up for a night to remember in the City of Love! Inspired by Parisian designer Paola Locatelli and today’s youth fashions, these new looks are perfect for all the experiences a Sim will encounter during a night out on the town.

title: The Sims 4: Little Campers Kit
description: The Sims 4 Little Campers Kit encourages Sims to explore and enjoy the great outdoors with cozy and cunning camping gear. Sims can play outdoor games from the safety of their DIY blanket fort, with a collection that offers everything a family needs for a night of creative fun!

title: Pocket Crystal League
description:
PCL is a Poke-card game, although completely different to the Official Trading Card Game. The gameplay mechanics were partially inspired by Inscryption, being pretty straightforward and easy to learn.

After choosing a starter deck, your goal is to travel through Kyoumu, challenging each of the Gym Leaders from the eight major cities in the region, building up your team to reach the ultimate goal, the Crystal League. Along the way, you'll be presented with numerous choices to expand your deck, strengthen your cards, give them unique special abilities, and battle other trainers.

The current release includes all of gens 1 and 2 (but with corresponding Fairy types). The game may be expanded with more content and generations in the future, but there are no plans currently for it. It is fully playable in its current state.

title: V Burster
description:
Awesome New Action Shooting game!!

"My name is iiiv (eve). Virus is detected in your smart phone.Let's clean them!!"

Created with future technology "human type anti virus, iiiv" Let's clean with a virus!

title: Marvel Snap
description:
Marvel Snap: The fastest card battler in the multiverse!

Build your Marvel dream team in this fast-paced, action-packed, collectible card game available on Mobile and PC.

title: Loathful
description: Loathful is a Survival Horror in first person with PS1 graphics. Bring yourself in a retro-style adventure where all your nightmares are brought to life. Survive your demons, dive into your darkest fears to overthrow a mysterious virus who seems to have put his hands on this universe.

title: Sonic Mania: Blazey Mix Plus Moveset!
description: Sonic Mania: Blazey Mix Plus Moveset! is a mod for Sonic Mania Plus that replaces Sonic with Blaze the Cat. The mod also adds in a unique play-style for Blaze, which includes a double jump and a fire shield that can be activated for 20 rings.

title: Genso Nikki
description:
Genso Nikki is a fan made tribute to the Japanese indie game: Yume Nikki

Play as a boy trapped in his room. If you dare, turn out the lights and explore his mind. Collect effects to alter his appearance and powers, enabling him to access new areas, who know what you might find!

title: Glemsomhet
description: Glemsomhet is a Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Eldrid, someone who refuses to leave their room and uses a box-like artifact to travel to another world and explores their "dream" world seeking effects.

title: Iter Itineris
description:
Ava Garde was a normal blonde girl until an incident with a mysterious, otherworldly monster. The creature snatched up Beatrice, her friend, and then mutated Ava into a halfling with red hair and green blood. The next day, she could not remember the events, but she did recall her friend being taken. A portal suddenly appeared inside her home. Without any other choice, she went inside and into the Externus, looking for her lost friend.

Iter Itineris is an English Yume Nikki fangame where you play as Ava Garde as you explore the unknown and bizarre realms of the Externus, the goal being to explore the worlds in the Externus and collect all the XenoVisions.

title: Journal Nikki
description:
Ichitsuki is a boy with lemon-shaped hair who can't seem to leave his room for some reason, he just backs away from the door out of his hallway. Poor kid, maybe his dreams will tell us what's wrong, in some strange cryptic way?

This game is a Yume Nikki fangame. There are two types of collectibles in this fangame; effects and memories. Can you tell which type is good or bad?

title: Journey Record
description: At a glance, this game looks like a retro 2D RPG game, but this is actually an action RPG, where you use the Magic Eye Camera and Crystals to swap between seeing the world in 2D or 3D and progress through puzzle-like stages as you fight your way across the land.

title: Kaeri Yume
description: Kaeri Yume is a Japanese Yume Nikki Fangame. The game's protagonist is H2O, a girl traveling alone in a bus. Kaeri Yume is a traditional fangame, the player can explore the various dream worlds and collect effects.

title: Kross
description: Kross is a Yume Nikki fangame. It stars a girl named Zugaikotsuki. She's asleep from the start and the objective is to explore the dream world and collect effects.

title: Kyoku Yume
description: Kyoku Yume is a Yume Nikki fangame and it stars Kyukotsuki. The goal is to explore the dream world.

title: Strange Aeons
description: You are stuck in gnostic cyber-hell. The followers of your cult are summoning you. Chat with an offline neural net AI through the microphone to escape hell and return to the land of the living.

title: Mass Effect 2: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: Includes Mass Effect 2 game, digital soundtrack, The Making of Mass Effect 2 videos, digital art book, Cerberus Network code, digital Mass Effect Redemption #1 comic, Collector Armor and Assault Rifle, and Incisor Rifle.

title: Mass Effect 2: Normandy Crash Site
description: Normandy Crash Site is a DLC pack for Mass Effect 2 that was released with the game's launch. Explore the crash site of the SSV Normandy as Commander Shepard is asked by Alliance Command to explore the site and recover the remains of missing crew members and place a monument on the site. Alliance Command wants Shepard to be the first to walk on the site as Shepard was the vessel's last commanding officer.

title: Mass Effect: Genesis
description: Mass Effect: Genesis is a downloadable "interactive backstory comic". Genesis fills the role of Mass Effect for new players by introducing them to the story of the original game and allowing them to make six of the major plot decisions that players could make. If downloaded, the comic appears between the opening level and character customization. There are two versions of the comic, one each for a male and female Commander Shepard.

title: Mass Effect 2: Cerberus Network
description: An online downloadable content and news service that enables free bonus content for the game. New purchases of Mass Effect 2 are provided with a one-time use access code that unlocks the game's Cerberus Network. However, users who buy the game used have to pay for the Cerberus Network separately if they want access to the bonus content.

title: Mass Effect: Genesis 2
description: Mass Effect: Genesis 2 is an "interactive backstory comic". It is an updated version of Mass Effect: Genesis, which was originally created for Mass Effect 2. Genesis 2 fills the role of Mass Effect and Mass Effect 2 for new players to the series, introducing them to the story of the first two games in the Mass Effect trilogy and allowing them to make some of the major plot decisions that players could make by playing through the previous games. The player is prompted to begin Genesis 2 after character creation, but using it is optional. There are two versions of the comic, one each for a male and female Commander Shepard.

title: Matsurikki
description: Matsurikki is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Maritsuki, a girl in a yukata. The goal is to explore her dreams.

title: Mimi
description: Mimi is a Yume Nikki fangame. This game focuses around Mimi, a young girl who has out-of-body experiences. The game's graphics, uniquely, are drawn purely in black and white. Mimi lacks music, and uses sound effects entirely from the RPG Maker RTP.

title: Monotose
description: Monotose is a short Yume Nikki fangame. The game stars a shut-in named Lex exploring his dream world through sleeping in his bed. Unlike most fangames, the maps aren't looping.

title: P.S.Rose
description: P.S.Rose is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Baratsuki and explore several worlds outside of her bedroom with the objective of collecting effects, all of them relating to flowers or plants.

title: Permafrost
description: Embark on a brutal journey of survival in a perpetual winter. Hunt and gather resources for building and utilize deep survival mechanics to craft your way through a harsh, unforgiving landscape. Forge alliances or dominate the remnants of humanity in this chilling open world saga.

title: Re:Vessel
description: Re:Vessel is an English Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Resa and explore a strange dream world. The goal is to explore and collect effects.

title: Re Rive
description: Re Rive is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. You explore the dreams of 774 and collect effects.

title: Super Vadimka III: Enter ALJ
description: Super Vadimka III: Enter ALJ is a horror-themed, side-scrolling action-platformer developed by VadimBallzGames, released on May 10, 2022, for Windows. The game was created over a span of five months and serves as a sequel to its predecessors, Super Vadimka and Super Vadimka II: Revenge of Dr. Kulik. In this third installment of the Super Vadimka series, players will navigate through daunting cliffs inspired by classic horror elements. The game introduces unique mechanics, such as the ability to throw blue balls and sticks at enemies, along with combatting bosses while striving to endure terrifying scenarios. Players can make use of save functionalities with the F5 and F6 keys, allowing them to track their progress throughout their gaming experience.

title: Repentance
description: Repentance is an English Yume Nikki fangame. You play as a girl named Latanie who refuses to leave her room, so she explores her own dreams instead. Like most fangames, the main objective is to explore the protagonist's dream world and collect effects.

title: Reverse Dream
description: Reverse Dream is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. The main goal of the game is to explore Guratsuki's dream worlds and collect effects (called Images (イメージ) in this game). Interestingly, each effect is based on a certain way of dying, with each effect having 死 (lit. Death) in its name.

title: Rucida's Dream
description: Rucidia's Dream is an English Yume Nikki fangame. You explore the dreams of the protagonist, Rucidia. The goal is to explore and collect all of the effects to access the ending.

title: Sewage
description: This takes place in a Canadian sewer system and end's up at the Parliament Building in Ottawa.

title: Sister's Dream
description:
Sister's Dream, also known by its original name Art de Reve, is an English Yume Nikki fangame where you explore the deep dreams of a girl named Guretsuki.

Guretsuki is a typical 19 year-old hikikomori girl who doesn't want to leave her room. Throughout the dream world are various effects that'll allow you to trigger certain events, or make exploring your dreams a lot easier. Be careful while exploring, however, for the deeper you go, the darker your dreams get...

title: Cerasus
description: Our good man, Reshnha, has been trapped in a world of dreams via an unknown force, and now he must escape by finding all the songs, strewn across a land composed of a pastiche of his own thoughts, memories and actions.

title: Sity
description: Sity is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. The game stars Mutsuki, a boy who cannot leave his room. The goal is to collect 16 effects in the dream world to unlock the various endings. This game has many elements related to modern cities and earthquakes.

title: Soul Song
description: Soul Song is a Chinese Yume Nikki fangame. The game plays much like other fangames, with the player's objective being to explore Mukuro's dream world via sleeping in the bed.

title: Drunk As I Like: Gensokyo Chugging Contest
description:
Compete in a frantic drinking competition against Gensokyo's residents,
try to keep your arms steady so you don't spill anything!

title: The Red Sea
description: The Red Sea is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Nagi, a boy who stays in his room. The goal of the game is to explore and find effects.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Banbuds vs. Reggie the Rat
description: A funny mod of Friday Night Funkin where Banbuds rap-battle against Reggie The Rat on the computer screen, to the tune of “Infant Destroyer”.

title: Umbra
description: Fight against shadows, using shadows. Follow the journey of a child in this third-person RPG filled with unique mechanics, and find out the truth behind the shadow monsters haunting him.

title: Unknown Exist
description: Unknown Exist is a traditional Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. It stars a girl named Kaede, who refuses to leave her room. The objective is exploration and collecting effects in order to achieve an ending.

title: Untitled One
description: Untitled One is a Yume Nikki fangame. You explore Sydney's dreams when you fall asleep.

title: Uotamuosu
description: Uotamuosu is a Yume Nikki fangame. It stars three protagonists: Shiwasu, Bill and Takatsuki. Each one of them has his own locations and stories. You have to go through Shiwasu's scenario first, then Bill's and finally, Takatsuki's.

title: Usagi
description: Usagi is an English Yume Nikki fangame. In this game, the player takes control over a girl named Umiko as she explores her dreams. Once in the dream world, Umiko can visit numerous surreal worlds, find effects that change her appearance (and give her new abilities) and collect Mementos, which are needed in order to complete the game. While exploring the dream world, the player is encouraged to interpret the different events, locations and NPCs he/she encounters to uncover Umikos backstory.

title: Yasumeru
description: Yasumeru is a Yume Nikki fangame. This game stars Yasashi, a boy living in a small house on a hill. The goal is to explore and collect effects. After waking up, you can see the time of day changes every time you sleep. It cycles from morning, to afternoon, to night, to dusk, then back to morning. There is also a small chance of rain when you wake up.

title: YumeSD
description: YumeSD is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. The goal of the game is to explore Tsukiai's dreams and find effects.

title: Yume Iro
description:
Yume Iro is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame, inspired by two games at once - Yume Nikki, and a derived, but unrelated work, Witoru. Just like the original Witoru and its few fangames, this work's design is minimalistic and ​also contains various parodies and references to Japanese pop culture.

In this game, the player takes the role of a girl named Otetsuki who cannot leave her room. As with most traditional Yume Nikki fangames, the player's objective is to collect effects and explore the dream worlds.

title: Yume Nikki: Solitude
description: Yume Nikki: Solitude is an English Yume Nikki fangame produced by Uboachan. You play as Kazenori in what seems like a hospital. When he falls asleep, you are taken to his dream world. All of the effects are available for you to use and there are only a handful of rooms to explore.

title: Yume Shoko
description: Yume Shoko is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Sudou. Along the way to collecting effects, there are also 3 bonus "Omake" effects.

title: Demencia
description: Demencia is a Yume Nikki fangame. You play as a girl named Miko, and enter a dream world through reading books on a pillow.

title: Dickme Dicki
description: Dickme Dicki is a Yume Nikki fangame. It stars a certain man, who has green hair and closed eyes. He appears to be a palette swap of Miserere's protagonist. The game was intended to be a joke, with some blatant criticisms of developers' shortcomings.

title: DreamDayKi
description:
DreamDayKi is an English Yume Nikki fangame. It was made as an April Fool's joke, satirizing fangames that are essential re-skins of Yume Nikki.

DreamDayKi plays exactly like Yume Nikki, but with recolored graphics, different music playing in different locations, several new areas and an additional ending.

title: Dry
description:
Dry is a Yume Nikki fangame. The dream gameplay involves exploration and collecting effects, called "Tracks" in this game. The main part of the game also has some dialogue, but is not the main focus. Dry is drawn in mostly grey shades, making it look somewhat depressing.

Dry is about an alcoholic deer named Dry, who had recently graduated from college and is about to enter university. The game begins with him sitting in a pub and asking the bartender for another drink, but he talks him out of it and tells him to go home.

The problem is Dry is far away from home right now, as his father gave him a CD that should help him to overcome his addiction. His father said that Dry should be far away from home for it to work, so he took a tent and traveled to the place where the game starts.

title: Himi Nikki
description: Himi Nikki is a Yume Nikki fangame starring Waka. Waka is a music student. For some reason she finds herself terrified to go out of her bedroom. Listening to her Music Box makes her fall under the effect of a spell cast over it. There are 3 endings, one of them is the "true end" and the other two are bad ends.

title: MixiM
description: MixiM is a Yume Nikki fangame. The game stars Chie, a girl searching for Effects in order to manipulate her dream world. Through wearing certain effects, areas can change in appearance and show gateways to new locations. Dialogue (including symbols and website names) is used throughout the game to explain the situation of Chie and the dream world.

title: Physicality
description:
Physicality is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Katatsuki, a young boy who shut himself in. Like most fangame protagonists, Katatsuki refuses to leave his room and prefers to explore his dreams instead of reality.

Physicality is a very traditional fangame, so many of its aspects are related to events/locations/themes in the original Yume Nikki. It features bright, childish and colorful themes along with dark, violent and bizarre ones. It has three endings.

title: Reap and Sow
description: After being invited to the biggest house party of the year, things take an unexpected turn when you summon an ancient lust demon. Navigate a bustling house party, attempting to lure unknowing party guests as sacrifices to your new god. Who knows, maybe if you do good they'll keep you?

title: Returning Nightmares
description: Returning Nightmares is an exploration adventure-horror game, inspired by Yume Nikki and it's multiple fan-made homages (but with dialogue & easier to navigate maps). You play as Akira, a young man locked up in his own bedroom, exploring his dreams to remember the events that lead him to where he is now. But some things are better left alone…

title: Shirushi
description: Shirushi is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. You start as Yatsuki, a girl who refuses to leave her room. She can travel to the dream world by sleeping on her bed. Her main task is to collect Stoicheios in certain dream worlds.

title: Silent Infinity
description: Silent Infinity is a English Yume Nikki fangame. The fangame is unique in having a dominant ocean theme. You play as Umitsuki and explore her dream world, the goal of the game being to find effects. Along with saving, the player can change the computer's wallpaper or play a minigame.

title: The Hauntings: Surveillance
description: Monitor haunted locations for anomalies as a technician for a secret government agency. Use various camera modes to collect evidence and identify ghosts. Uncover the truth and prevent public panic in this realistic horror spot-the-difference game.

title: Yume Nikki Ver. 1.00
description:
Yume Nikki ver. 1.00 is an English Yume Nikki mod developed by 369071 2458. This is an expansion mod that adds a number of new areas and events to the game, along with an alternate ending.

The gameplay remains the same as the original. The player enters the dream world by sleeping in the bed. The main objective of the game also remains the same; the player must obtain all of the effects by exploring the dream world to unlock one of two endings.

title: KoiGig: Devil x Angel
description: KoiGig: Devil x Angel is an otome game, developed and published by TwoFive, which was released in Japan in 2007.

title: Angelic Vale
description:
Angelic Vale is a fully-voiced tactical RPG in which the story and battles are divided into chapters and are accessed by traveling to a territory on the World Map. Each character has a set of special skills and magic and their MP is slightly restored after each turn. Players can also buy and assign additional troops to each character which can chain attacks. Unfortunately, items gained during battles can't be sold.

Each character levels up separately after defeating an enemy and, depending on how well the player fought during a battle, they can get rare items and extra gold. The game has 3 difficulty levels and the harder the difficulty level is, the more items the player can acquire after each battle. Some of the levels can be replayed to gain additional items and experience.

The game takes place in the kingdom of Belluna which is still healing from the scars of a civil war that took place a decade ago. The rookie knight Ogil and his childhood friend Fio fall witness to the assassination of the king of Belluna by rebellion soldiers from the neighboring Jerenia Republic. Despite losing the king and being torn between both sides of the conflict, the hero makes his own choices of what to fight for. However, the path the heroes have chosen will be filled with blood, darkness and significant changes to their beloved homeland.

title: Super Mario World: The Second Reality Project - Reloaded
description:
"The Second Reality Project" one of the most complete Super Mario World-Romhacks

Bowser is back again, more powerful than times ago:
He found a power source which let him rebuilt his Airship Fleet. Soon he plans on attacking the Mushroom Kingdom one time more! It's up to Mario to stop him!

title: Friday Night Funkin': vs Impostor
description:
What started as a passion project has now evolved into a complete overhaul of the iconic VS IMPOSTOR mod. Codenamed UPDOG, this brand-new version is a full-on reimagining built from the ground up. Every aspect, from visuals to vocals, has been carefully redesigned to fully reach the potential it once had.

Whether you’re a longtime fan or a total newcomer, VS IMPOSTOR delivers a fresh experience! with new remixes of classic songs, completely overhauled visuals, a brand new menu, and maybe even a few secrets.

title: Owarinaki Natsu, Towa Naru Shirabe
description:
In Kyushu, there lies the small village of Sunomura. In that small village, four childhood friends, Touma Takumi, Ogami Ritsuko, Amamiya Kanon, and Takanashi Mio comprise a small music club at the village school. One day, Takumi happens to see and hear the violin performance of Orihara Ai, a girl who recently moved to the village and transferred into the school. This performance later eventually causes Ritsuko to resolve to recruit Ai into their music club no matter what.

However, one day, one of the childhood friends is separated from the other three, but before doing so passes on her role of "Supervisor" to Takumi. Later, they learn that the school they all attend is going to be closed down in one month due to a government-ordered evacuation of the village. Everyone resolves to make their last month together as memorable and enjoyable as possible before the school closes down...

title: Drainus
description: Drainus is a side-scrolling shooting game in which players take control of the "Drainus", the Kharlal Empire's most cutting-edge fighter with the ability to absorb energy bullets, and take down the enemy ships zipping through space.

title: It's A Me
description: Poor Keke has gotten themselves in a pickle (several times?)! Guide Me through increasingly nasty obstacles while collecting coins in this tricky platformer. Controls are explained in-game; press Enter to start the game.

title: Rocket League: Season 1
description: The Season 1 Series include more than a dozen new items from Rare and Very Rare Decals and Wheels like the Bodacious Octane Decal and Shortquarter Wheels, to Black Market items like the Stipple Gait Decal and the extremely animated Buffy-Sugo Goal Explosion!

title: Youngblood: Search and Destroy
description: Youngblood: Search and Destroy is an isometric action game that was originally scheduled for being published for PC and Sony PlayStation in November 1997. However, the PC version has been postponed to May 1998 while the PlayStation version was pushed back to an undisclosed date.

title: Nauka Prediel
description: A sovietic detective narrative game based on 1970s. You can interact and inspect objects and there are multiple endings.

title: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Evil Otto
description: Boyfriend is stuck in an arcade, causing him to face Evil Otto. Don't let him become another victim of the Evil Otto curse!

title: Pokémon Island
description: This is a Pokémon fan game with the main mechanics, but with a different approach on Pokémon Island. There is a new concept of linearity for the franchise because almost nothing is essential to move forward, but still there are many challenges.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Mario's Madness
description: Friday Night Funkin': Mario's Madness is a Friday Night Funkin' mod based on various creepypastas around the world of Super Mario, each one has their own song, ready to battle with you, Being 7 in total, including cutscenes.

title: Project MSfiX'D
description: Project MSfiX'D improves over the original Project MSX with fixes for objective bugs (Orion using deprecated form of A_RailAttack) and player options like auto-reloading, HUD element opacity, etc. Also built-in cross-IWAD support.

title: Friday Night Funkin': VS. Starlight Glimmer & Trixie
description: Boyfriend and Girlfriend found a portal to Equestria...

title: Paw Patrol: Grand Prix
description: No track is too big, no racer too small! The PAW Patrol are on their fastest mission yet – To win the Pup Cup! Race around iconic locations including Adventure Bay, Jake’s Snowboarding Resort and The Jungle in this 4-player-championship to find out who will be crowned the winner.

title: DreamWorks Dragons: Legends of the Nine Realms
description: Unleash your inner dragon and fly beyond the Hidden World, on a fiery adventure to rescue Thunder’s family and save the dragon kingdoms!

title: Star Trek Prodigy: Supernova
description: After the U.S.S. Protostar picks up strange readings from a dying star, Dal and Gwyn must race against time to save their friends, their ship, and an entire planetary system before a supernova destroys them all! Using their unique skills to overcome ingenious puzzles, endure hostile environments and battle deadly robot armies, Dal and Gwyn must save their captured crewmates Jankom Pog, Rok-Tahk, Zero, and Murf. But they soon encounter a deadly new enemy, one that will stop at nothing to destroy the U.S.S. Protostar and change the very course of history!

title: Cursed Travels: Sunken City
description: A dark puzzle game featuring intriguing mysteries, a unique artstyle, and skeletons. Platform your way through haunted forests, cursed ruins, dark mountains, and more, searching for the mythical Sunken City to solve its ancient puzzles.

title: Pentomino
description: "Pandomino" is also known as "brain racking twelve pieces". It is a hardcore spatial logic puzzle game suitable for young and old. The rules is very simple but challenging. Can you find the secret of the solution? NP->P? Find Your Way!

title: Bowerwhelm
description: Bowerwhelm is an FPS Rogue-like game with minimalist graphics. Kill until you die, upgrade the skills, make powerful builds, and kill more!

title: Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition - Knights of the Mediterranean
description: Knights of the Mediterranean brings a wealth of new content to Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition, including the addition of the Italy and Malta Civilizations, the new Tycoon Game Mode, and 8 Historical Maps.

title: Unbearable
description: A story inspired by old school survival horror. Play alone or together on split screen. Delve into dark environments; hide or run; fight melee or with guns; climb and solve puzzles to discover the story of Unbearable.

title: Arth Island
description: Gather resources, set up a camp, choose your class, level up your skills, don't die of cold or starvation and battle the other failed experiments to survive as long as possible on this procedurally generated island

title: A-Mazing Enigmas
description: After venturing into the Trials of Old, help three characters traverse puzzle rooms using the world and the skills unique to each one of them. Guide them to the end of these trails and get the treasures that are held within.

title: I Commissioned Some Bees
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bees as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 10 art pieces to choose from, and 1000+ bees, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: Ares Virus2
description: The "Ares Virus" series of games is widely acclaimed for its unique combat and individual style of painting. Now that the sequel is back, it will give you an unprecedented experience.

title: The Twilight of Infinity Episode 2 - Attack on the Hydro Processor
description: An explosion in 2041 will lead to an investigation at the Mesa Hydro Processor. Why would anyone blow up a civilian facility, and who could be behind it?

title: Ultimate Fighters
description: 2D Fighting game

title: PlayForm: Human Dynamics
description: PlayForm: Human Dynamics is an Experimental Physics Sandbox focused on Active Ragdoll simulation. Use a variety of tools and obstacles that can push, pull, or smash these simulated humans in many diverse worlds.

title: Meowtopia: Expedition
description: “Meowtopia: Expedition” is a cat-themed and heart-warming Match 3 game. Join and experience the urban fairy tale between Xiaoxiao and “Toffee” the cat, dress yourself up with a cat-themed fashion style, and decorate your own cozy home!

title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Swingers Party
description: Challenging jigsaw puzzles, featuring adult images of 2 couples at a swingers party on a yacht.

title: Eschew
description: Eschew is a bullet hell action adventure where you play as an unknown alien visitor, traveled to Earth in search of a stolen, cosmic power source. Survive the overwhelming onslaught of Earth's military might!

title: Castle Greyrot
description: Castle Greyrot is a challenging boss-rush rogue-lite turn-based RPG that revolves around killing brutal bosses, a lot. Train your party members to overcome the horrors of Castle Greyrot and its unending curse... If you can!

title: Saving Sheep
description: Saving Sheep - a simple 2D arcade shooter. The player is a shepherd, saving the lives of sheep and his own, fighting off a large pack of wolves.

title: The Journey: Episode 2 - Words of Wisdom
description: The second step that you never knew you needed to take to get to wherever you're wanting to go... You won't regret this experience. You have nothing to lose, and everything to gain...

title: Re: Collector
description: I woke up in a mysterious forest. I had no idea who I was or why I was here. Then, I met some friends and went on an adventure...

title: The Riftbreaker: Metal Terror
description: Explore an entirely new area of Galatea 37 in this Story Campaign expansion for The Riftbreaker. Catalog new species. Craft new and unique weapons. Fight hordes of aliens unlike anything you've seen before.

title: Demonoire
description: Demonoire - A heroic 2D shooter, Rescue Senvil from the forces of evil.

title: Escape Simulator: Steampunk
description: This level pack includes four new escape rooms set on a beautiful airship "Valor".

title: The Misanthropic Girl
description: You control two protagonists at the same time in this action RPG, letting you combine their unique skills. Explore and discover in the seamless open world setting of a detailed Japanese town as you watch these two high schoolers learn what “existence” really means in this post-apocalyptic tale.

title: Cyber League Football
description: Futuristic robot football! Upgrade your team, call the plays, and drive your robots to victory on the field.

title: Graviators
description: Graviators is a team arena sports game in space! Compete against friends in pinball-like arenas.Use your spacepods special gravity and shield abilities to control and shoot the ball and score points on the enemy goal.Engage in multiple game modes and arenas with exciting gameplay!

title: Fung Guys
description: Fung Guys is an online multiplayer, team-based, party game, heavily focused on exciting PvP minigames.

title: Rivalry warlord Sengoku
description: A turn-based Sengoku simulation game that can be played by vassal!

title: Simon the Sorcerer Origins
description: Simon The Sorcerer Origins is the official prequel of the legendary Simon's adventure saga. Simon will return for the first time to the absurd world of the Sorcerers unleashing an ancient prophecy and gaining ancient magical powers. Prepare to experience a classic adventure in a modern way!

title: The Last Human is a Biker
description: The Last Human is a Biker is a few hours of pure entertainment. In this 2D shooter you play as John, the last human, and unleash his fury in his quest of vengeance! With unlimited item synergies, make the choices that will allow you to survive against countless swarms of aliens!

title: Pumpkin head
description: This game is a side-scrolling 2D action shooting game created with dot pictures. Control the main character, Pumpkin Head, as he runs through various stages such as the sea and the desert while battling the slime army!

title: Demons Happened
description: Demons Happened is a top down shooter with action/platforming elements. Play as a ghost as dead on the inside as he is on the outside, fighting demons with demons on a journey to fix your tv.

title: My Pet Sitter is a Futanari
description: Can your Pet Sitter teach an old dog new tricks? Are you willing to play nice? Good boy!

title: Mad Bullz
description:
Now you have a chance to take revenge on those filthy people, and ram them with your horns.
It's up to you how you will fight, as you can control bull's movement with keyboard and rotate freely his head (neck) with a mouse.

title: Isolania
description: A plague called "The Sadness" has devastated civilization. A mysterious society rose from the ashes, deciding the only way to protect its citizens is to confine them in cells. There are 3 Edicts governing this new civilization: Stay in your cell. Watch television. Never talk about the outside.

title: King
description: This is a game that combines strategy, tactics and role-playing. You travel to a magical world and become a king. You will manage your own country and conquer the world through diplomacy and war.

title: Mortmentum
description: Fight endless waves of different enemies using your grappling hook in clever ways while trying hopelessly to stay alive just a little longer so you can get a higher score.

title: Who is the Red Queen?
description: Alice, Alice, the Red Queen is missing. The queen has been dismembered and Alice must find all her pieces. A horror-fantasy yuri visual novel filled with death, love, and forgotten memories.

title: Beer Factory
description: Beer Factory is a business simulation and management game. Take the challenge, manage your own beer factory, employees, production lines, import and export of the merchandise.

title: Date Ariane Remastered
description: The original western dating sim updated and bigger than ever before. The first dating sim made with 3D rendered graphics became a viral web classic back in 2007. This new "remastered" version allows players to play as a male or female for the first time.

title: Fault: Stp - Lightkravte
description: Fault: Stp - Lightkravte is the latest entry in the fault series, which has shipped over 500,000 copies worldwide. Lightkravte presents its story through the eyes of Khaji Oberg, an ordinary and unremarkable teenaged boy who finds himself reaching for a dream that slips ever further away from him.

title: Babushka's Glitch Dungeon
description: You are a little old lady who needs to clean up a big magical cellar. Learn colorful mind-bending spells, or just hit stuff with your broom.

title: Elegies: Aya
description: After losing his parents and barely escaping his burning home, Zach wakes up in the hospital where he meets Aya, the ghost of a girl. Who is she, and why can only Zach see her? Together they try to investigate Aya's past, which quickly awakens new dangers.

title: God Edge
description: Travel across Azmra and slay barons using the God Edge; A sword capable of transferring power from the slain to the slayer!

title: Peacemaker: Glorious Princess
description: A classic JRPG. Play the role of a princess, gather partners in a desperate situation, and embark on a legendary journey to save the kingdom and make peace.

title: The Robot Girl Meets the Human!
description: This is an adventure game that takes you on a journey through a world after humans have disappeared. Lead the robot girl "Scarlet" to find the surviving humans.

title: Best of Eleven
description: Puzzle game about finding patterns. Create your own set or randomize the rules to explore almost unlimited amount of gameplays.

title: Panzer Corps 2: Axis Operations - 1943
description: The critical hour where the fate of Germany on the Eastern Front will be decided has arrived! Though the Battle of Stalingrad has ended, the Axis forces in Russia remain in turmoil.

title: Last Meow Standing
description: This lightning fast arena shooter brings you right back to the highscore hunts of the arcade era. Use your arsenal of deadly weapons wisely against the increasingly ferocious monster hordes to survive as long as you can.

title: Zombie Scream
description: Terror descends on a Let's Play creator... Zombie Scream, the 2020 collaboration between the Tsugunohi corrosion-of-daily-life horror series and Japanese video creator Odaken, is finally available on Steam. How about experiencing a taste of the strange new world yourself?

title: Grid Words
description: The next generation of word games has arrived…

title: Something Strange
description: Go about your normal every day life and meet new friends in this short visual novel!

title: Old Gods
description: It looks like you have died. But neither heaven nor hell await you. Assigned a fate from the two creators you will be sent back to life with the task of overthrowing the false gods. Exciting fights, difficult puzzles and a colorful world of different creatures await you.

title: Insect Swarm
description: The swarm is a swarm of thousands of alien zerg, and you, as the only survivor of this wasteland, you need to face them and fight with blood, good luck!

title: Cazzarion: Demon Hunting
description: Demons are troubling here. Kill the brood of evil and send it back to hell. Standard weapons (Assault Rifle, Shotgun) and special weapons (BoomShot, Reaper, ....) are available. As opponents, the demons of hell are fighting against you. Choose your weapon and shoot ("Groarrr.....BOOOOOM")

title: Upirja
description: Upirja is a first-person horror adventure set in the late 19th century in the Balkans. A murky evil distresses the lives of the villagers of a remote region surrounded by snowy mountains. Your mission, as inspector of the King, is to rid these lands from the ghoul that haunts them.

title: Pleim
description: An open world adventure game. You can move around the city, talk to residents, and investigate cases. The game has an interesting plot that will not leave anyone indifferent.

title: Frog lands
description: Solve riddles, go through dangerous traps and overthrow the dark magician!

title: One.
description: One. is a remake of the 1999 visual novel One: Kagayaku Kisetsu he, developed by Nexton's sub-brand novamicus for the company's 30th anniversary.

title: Cute Waifu
description: Move all parts to form the complete image.

title: Heaven Snakes
description: A new generation of a Snake arcade game with unique mechanics, fully in 3D and online! [Beta]

title: Dark Slime
description: Go through a huge number of caves, solve many puzzles, and fight against the strongest enemies!

title: Touhou Crisis
description: Classic arcade nostalgia and modern-indie design collide in this shooting-gallery boss battler! Play as a one-man army in offline solo OR bring a friend in online co-op/versus mode! Supports Mouse AND Lightgun play!

title: Canterz Paranormies
description: Canterz Paranormies is a 2D Top Down survival horror game based on the story of the most renowned paranormal investigation team of the US called "Canterz Paranormies" who got a request from the owner of the Texas Haunted house to investigate it for the paranormal evidence.

title: Rue La Résistance
description: Rue | la résistance is the third project of the RVT studio, which tells about the life of a group of partisans operating in the territory of occupied France. The game is based on the principle of a theatrical production: it is based on the play "Ghost Sonata" by August Strindberg

title: Put Pud Nudli's Adventure
description: Become a hero who saves the island of cats. Explore these varied areas of this island. Fight Chef The Cat’s creatures and after that face the meowing horror. The game is hard, but if you can give it time, you will become better and better.

title: Grimland
description: "Grimland" is a classic 2D side-scrolling platform slasher. The kingdom was attacked by monsters and you have to free the queen and return peace and security to the lands of Grimland.

title: Lights Off!
description: Play through a common childhood fear about turning the lights off and going to bed.

title: Incursion
description: Face relentless swarms of AI-controlled invaders in this sci-fi survival roguelite. As a soldier of R.A.I.D. (Regional Anti-Incursion Defense), wield and upgrade devastating abilities to annihilate your foes. Do you have what it takes?

title: ParaPerspective
description: ParaPerspective is a stylish and minimalist puzzle game where your perspective affects how the world works. Help the little guys get to their destination by rotating the camera and directing them through seemingly impossible geometry.

title: Zeus Quest: The Rebirth of Earth
description: Help Zeus save the planet in one heck of a crazy and hilarious family adventure. A classic point and click adventure game safe for kids. It combines Greek Mythology with Sci-Fi in a funny way!

title: Magiterra
description: Magiterra is a farming simulator game with RTS controls. With a little bit of added fantasy elements, create your crop fields, produce hundreds of resources, fulfill many different missions, help your kingdom prosper and live in wealth!

title: Treats Please!
description: This is a retro-styled puzzle game about keeping a hungry pet happy with tasty treats. Choosing treats the pet will enjoy will reduce their hunger strength level and choosing things they cannot eat will only make them hungrier!

title: Fray Fight
description: Fray Fight is free! Battle the evil hordes on your way to Valhalla. Annihilate thousands of monsters with overpowered attacks and upgrades.

title: Castle Reborn
description: "Castle Reborn" - old school 2D slasher. In this game you slash your enemies, dodge attacks and use the ancient magic against monsters. Try to survive in a mysterious castle, that is getting more and more dangerous.

title: MonGirl Expedition
description: Jack’s simple life ends on his birthday with a surprise. He ends up in an unknown land full of monster girls with a task from the Goddess herself. Will he be able to impress her? Duke it out in dynamic real-time combat, solve puzzles, meet girls, and conquer their hearts!

title: Sword of Jade: Parallel Dreams
description:
An RPG made in OHRRPGCE.

After his fall from grace from the group that calls themselves "Protectors", Dogero questions his role in society. Ready to accept defeat, he is confronted by a long lost friend, who inspires him to keep his dreams alive.

title: Automata Ecosystem: Cellular Automata Simulation
description: Turning cellular automata into an audiovisual experience. Automata Ecosystem is a GPU-powered cellular automata simulation with complex interactions and procedural audio generation.

title: The Overlord Isn't Another Isekai Protagonist, Is He?: Chapter 1
description: Have you ever wondered what awaits you after death? At 25, Kay had no plans to die... let alone to wake up in literal HELL one day. Did he deserve such a fate, or is it all just a ridiculous mistake? Kay can’t remember his past, but he firmly believes that he doesn't belong here.

title: Piggy Jump
description: Here is the Hardest game ever made! Game about Piggy, who is a basketball player with a dream to defeat everyone. Jump, Dodge, Dunk and Fly with Piggy to complete all 45 Levels and mini games. Piggy Jump is a big challenge for thos who like difficult games!

title: Stonedef
description: You have to fight off waves of enemies using magic staves.

title: Ever Seen A Cat? 2
description: A relaxing hidden object game. Find even more cats in several stylish environments! Every play through is different!

title: Ragdoll Funhouse
description: Play a fully physical, humanoid ragdoll and explore a indoor funhouse. Swing from ropes on the ceiling, make your way up climbing walls, or be bounced about by rollers. Test your mastery of our physical controls in the time trials around the map, or just enjoy your time challenging the obstacles.

title: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - Call to Arms
description: Call to Arms adds the Hatchetman chassis, along with 23 new melee-weapon focused 'Mech variants, 5 new melee weapon-focused Hero 'Mechs, 9 new melee weapons, and the new animated Stormsurge skin.

title: Futanari Sex - The New Boss
description: An explicit erotic visual novel following the story of an overbearing new futanari boss doing her best to intimidate the all-female personnel in her first day at work.

title: Sex Chess
description: Hell is about to get invaded and the sinners trapped inside are about to be freed. But the clueless liberators had no idea how cunning the Devil is. This time, the war between Light and Darkness will be waged not on the battlefield, but on a chess board.

title: Bonelords
description: Build up yourself & your defenses in Bonelords! Defend against waves of enemies! Attack using a large variety of weapons & tools! Scale your power, and face the great hordes of Spegroon!

title: Galaxy Citizen
description: Galaxy Citizen is an online Action RPG set in an Alien world.

title: Drums Rock
description: Drums Rock is an arcade drums game for VR, follow the rhythm of rock with your drums and smash the demons. Live a unique campaign: with different levels, challenges, songs and worlds. Drums Rock is an ideal game to feel like a rock hero, while destroying hordes of demons to the rhythm of rock!

title: Dreadful Hours
description: Dreadful Hours is a fast paced time managing survival horror game where multiple creatures are trying to attack you at every point. You must watch the cameras and then decide your next moves while using as little power as possible.

title: Office Run
description: Free and exclusively on PC! Office Run is an endless runner game built around the office theme with 6 playable characters, leveling system, skills, upgrades, power-up items and online highscores. Start as new Intern in the company and move up the ladder until you become the next CEO!

title: Shark Assault Simulator
description: I don't think you'd want to rest on that beach. Shark Assault Simulator is a game that shows us how dangerous it is to sunbathe on an unknown beach.

title: Aces Under the Moonlight
description: Smack your ball in your opponent's goal. Run, jump, and airdash your way to victory in this hand animated, high speed, punk-inspired ball game set against backgrounds of urban decay. Get ready an absolutely electric experience.

title: Space Menace
description: Space Menace is a real-time sci-fi space exploration and space battle game. You play as a space captain, seeking fortune and glory as you see fit. War rages across the galaxy. Factions are fighting for total dominance. Survive and thrive in these chaotic times.

title: Jelly Forest
description: Help the cube jump over the steep rocks and get as far as possible before he loses all his three hearts

title: Potato Arena
description: Potato Party is a Party Game in which you are playing with total of 4 players. Lots of fun and challenging parkour maps are waiting for you to discover and overcome! Grab your keyboard or favourite gamepad, and join the party!

title: Eden Island
description: Eden Island is a realistic-style survival game. As a survivor, you will explore and survive on a beautiful tropical island, craft weapons against beasts, farm and hunt, build your own home.

title: Project Gunship
description: Rain hell on the enemy from 12,000 feet in an AC-130 Gunship. Project Gunship provides an authentic and historical simulation of combat in all gunship variants from Vietnam to present day.

title: Employee of the Month
description: An atmospheric retro inspired survival horror game. Enjoy the late shift at 'The Month' in an abstract and unsettling night of terror, spooks and convenience.

title: Neodori Forever
description: Neodori Forever is a retro inspired, endless arcade 3D racing game inspired by the beloved old classics. A colorful cast of rivals is waiting to race against you on a variety of vibrant environments. Collect power ups and coins on the way to expand your car collection and outrun the competition.

title: What if Your Girl Was a Frog?
description: There was a frog. She was cheerfully croaking on her lake. However, she was not a simple frog, but magic. And so she got a lonely boy. She used her magic and started her adventures.

title: Robo Legend
description: Robo Legend is a twin-stick shooter RPG where you blast your way through hordes of crazy robots, minigames, and puzzles. Choose to save Gear Town, or conquer it, when Voidbot and his forces invade.

title: Ticklish Tessa
description: Ticklish Tessa is a short interactive erotic BDSM game focused on tickling, pleasurable teasing, foot worship, and bondage in a consensual and playful setting.

title: Square Journey
description: Square Journey is a minimalist arcade game that aims to help Square reach the depths of his inner dungeon in search of a greater understanding of himself.

title: Plank Road
description: "Plank road simulation" is a game that allows you to enjoy easy and free simulation of plank road construction. By following the construction method of Chinese traditional frame structure and combining various building elements, To create our own legendary plank road journey.

title: Twofold
description: In a bid to avoid failing out of college, Olive Penn inadvertently finds themselves caught in the middle of a feud between two campus club leaders whose rivalry seemingly threatens to tear their friendship apart.

title: Blood Burger
description:
Marco and his friend Thales are opening a hamburger shop but they don't know anything about cooking. So they decide to go after a secret hamburger formula in an abandoned "ShitDonalds" factory.

But what they don't expect is that the old factory's mascot is still there.

title: Father: The Truth
description:
You just woke up on a dark rainy evening, your parents have gone out for dinner and you're home alone.

But is that the truth? What has happened in this house while you were asleep? What are the secrets that lay hidden within this house?

Find out in this short, retro horror game inspired by video games from 90's combined with semi realistic lighting, a dark moody atmosphere and plenty of tension evoking moments!

title: Scheme!!! Spica, Chinatsu, and Haruka's Enchanting, Marvelous, and Quite Frankly Elaborate Quest to Save Their Cute Girlfriend!
description: You don't have to play the first game to understand this one, but it's definitely highly recommended that you do! Although let's be real, why wouldn't you want to spend more time with these ladies?

title: Tender Feelings Like Water
description:
A yuri Eastern fantasy visual novel created for NaNoRenO 2020.

A water spirit sees a girl in red out on rainy days. The spirit and girl meet and meet again, slowly beginning to fall in love. Yet the rain fails to end. It is flood season, and the people beseech the local god to stop.

title: I Found a New Friend
description:
You've had a long day. All you want to do is climb into bed. But why is your pillow quivering like that?

I Found a New Friend is a short text adventure in the style of the old Infocom games. It is based loosely on the They Might Be Giants song of the same name.

title: In the Hollow of the Valley
description: An interactive narrative work that retells the origin story of salesforce.com as a point-and-click misadventure.

title: Oversomnia
description: Oversomnia is a small Yume Nikki Fangame starring a boy named Irving. He's part of a club that discusses dreams in their free time. They've become aware that they all seem to share the same locations in their dreams.

title: Expiate
description:
Expiate follows the dreams of Corbin, who accesses his subconscious by dozing off to the static sound and visuals of his television screen. It gets predictably surreal from there. You can choose to lead him to the darkest pits of his mind... or just break a bunch of stuff with a metal baseball bat. Either way, something or someone's gonna get beaten up.

Expiate is a mostly traditional Yume Nikki fangame, with some slight alterations to the formula. Effects are a part of the game, but collecting them is not your main focus. Instead, use effects and explore to look for strange objects located around the dreamworld. Gather these items in order to progress.

title: Gnomedrome
description: Yelka Dead, a little lass with big aspirations, goes on an adventure through her dreams.

title: Karlson Run
description: Run through roads, rooftops, and prisons to reach that sweet milk at the end. But beware, dozens of robots, yellow dudes, and red bois want to stop you.

title: Friday Night Funkin' Corruption: Reimagined!
description: Funkin' Corruption: Reimagined is based off of Phantom Fear's corruption, but with an entirely twisted storyline and new songs!

title: Purgatory Dungeoneer
description: A roguelite RPG about plundering a psychic hellmaw for personal closure, and the resources to build a town beyond the grave. Become the mayor of a supernatural medieval village. Recruit over 400 former adventurers to plunder the hellmaw for resources, and unlock the buried memories of your companions. Use these resources to improve the village, and the capabilities of your citizens. And strive to keep a personal touch as the village grows beyond your expectations.

title: Stardust Arena
description: Stardust Arena is a fast paced, chaotic and difficult arcade shooter set in the distant future. An asteroid mining unit finds themself in an intergalactic battle arena, most likely against their will. The only way out is to fight to the death for the entertainment of the local supercluster!

title: Astral Ascension
description: A choice heavy, sci-fi visual novel set in space! With hundreds of decisions leading to branching paths, a uniquely personalized story will unfold.

title: 10 AM Funkin'
description: A christmas gift from Studio Shitballs, based on a scene from Elf starring Will Ferrel

title: Kaitou Apricot
description: Kaitou Apricot is a visual novel by Takuyo.

title: Dakar Desert Rally
description: Dakar Desert Rally is the biggest and most epic off-road rally racing adventure ever developed. Experience the speed and excitement of the largest rally race on the planet, featuring a wide variety of licensed vehicles from the world’s top makers, including motorcycles, cars, trucks, quads and SSVs.

title: Another Generic Space Shooter
description: It's anything but...

title: House of Asterion
description:
"The House is the same size as the world; or rather it is the world"

Asterion (noun)
I. (Mythology) The Minotaur of the Cretan labyrinth.
II. (Anatomy) A point on the exterior of the skull.
III. (Astronomy) A star in the Canes Venatici.

title: Amanda the Adventurer
description: Digging through your attic you found a box set of an old children's TV show, Amanda the Adventurer, starring a brave girl named Amanda and a cowardly sheep named Wooly. You don't recall any specific episodes or characters in the show. Or what happens in the show exactly. Or much about it at all come to think about it, but it still feels strangely familiar. Curiosity takes hold and you decide to watch the tapes and let horror nostalgia take you back to a simpler age.

title: Vertical Kingdom
description: Vertical Kingdom is a roguelite that mixes cities and cards. Due to the fact that there is not much space, you have to build vertically, with the help of platforms and other constructions. You will go on expeditions to obtain resources that will help you improve your camp for your next trips.

title: Destiny 2: The Witch Queen - Season of the Haunted
description: Power, depravity, vengeance. The object of Calus’s desire has taken many shapes over the years. His once-opulent ship, now derelict and corrupted, has returned to our galaxy—its sights set on the Pyramid ship lying dormant on the Moon.

title: For Symphony: With All One's Heart
description: For Symphony: With All One's Heart is a visual novel for PlayStation 2, Dreamcast, and PC.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Vs 7 Grand Dad
The Lizartian
description: The Lizartian is a top-down action-adventure game. We will embody a lizard tamer, a Lizartian, who will have to travel the vast lands of Dekoto to fulfill his revenge. Along the way, he'll face dangers like savage bandits, rugged terrain, and the legendary sandstorm.

title: Chaste Tris
description: Chaste Tris is my first complete video game I have made. It is obviously based on similar other games but easier because there is no gravity. Blocks can be freely moved up, down, left, and right with the arrow keys. They can be rotated with X or Y keys and can also be held for later use with C.

title: Vintage Records from Hell
description: Ever dream of running your own Heavy Metal Record Store? How about having the most amazing Vintage Vinyl collection? If so, dear metalhead, this game was made just for you.

title: Soul Night
description: The main character is a kula who masterfully scatters his enemies - ninjas to the right and left.

title: Quantum Tripper
description: Identification with something absolute and manifest as pure observation. Seeing things differently is a feature of our perceptual systems. Removed from the materialist plane of existence and world substantiation. Regions of the brain will find particular sets of images more challenging.

title: Twilight Bride: Vormslegend
description: An accident, Philip met the "bride" Alice. Although Alice looks no different from ordinary people, she has long been a person in the world. With the deepening of their communication, simple Alice fell in love with this brave and kind boy Philip.... But Philip had an engagement with Sophia....

title: Merge Beasts: Defense Game
description: The evil Beasts are attacking our temple, and we need your help! Merge the Beasts by dragging them on top of each other to build up your defenses. Fight off waves of evil Beasts and take down bosses to unlock new levels.

title: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl: Jenny
description: Buy the Jenny Pack to unlock the state-of-the-art protagonist from My Life as a Teenage Robot. Available Now. Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl game required; sold separately.

title: Keep it Cool, Man
description: Keep it Cool, Man fuses the funky style with typing arcade-shooter gameplay. Add to it a mix of a stereotypical American movie like Independence Day as story and there you have it... man.

title: My Master's A Moron
description: "My Master's A Moron" is a 2D turn-based, tile-based roguelike & roguelite dungeon crawler. Explore your way through your Master's basement (that he happens to rent out to monsters) and discover a multitude of enemies, items, spells, armor, upgrades, and more.

title: Space Penguins
description: Work with penguin chicks who mimick your actions to guide the minecart to the rocket! An action brain teaser where you solve gimmicks and aim to reach the goal within specific limits!

title: Delete Virus;
description: Let's become a computer vaccine 'CCAV' to fight computer viruses and aim for A+! Rhythm action game DELETE VIRUS; for passing the virus practical test.

title: Just A Humble Swordsmith
description: Craft swords from a variety of styles and materials in order to best equip the adventurers who come into your sword smithing shop. Strategize and watch the adventurers fight their way through a dungeon full of monsters in this idle battler!

title: Lock & Key: A Magical Girl Mystery
description: Lock and Key: A Magical Girl Mystery is a romantic thriller starring a married couple of former Magical Girls. Along with and old friend and a new protégé, they'll undertake one last journey to free Chicago from the terrifying grip of a mysterious serial killer.

title: Gas Station Simulator: Shady Deals
description: The uncle is back! And he has a new business on his mind… Build new things on your gas station and make some shady deals!

title: Resistance 204X
description: Fight against other players locally or cross-play online on this fast-paced footsies-based 2D fighting game. Block! Poke! Jump! Grab! Hit & Confirm at the right moment. Make combos and special attacks without bleeding your thumb. Run and reach the end of the stage to win the match. Rollback Netcode.

title: Carter Story
description: Carter's Story is a RogueLike game with random elements combined with action adventures, where you try to randomly pick up equipment and fight enemies, and eventually get the trial of growth.

title: Cosmic Ball Tournament
description: Cosmic Ball Tournament is a single-player, first-person platforming arcade game where your objective is to quickly get through stages whilst accumulating a high score. Use speed and precision to progress and become the Cosmic Ball Champion!

title: The Sword and Peachblossom
description: This is a country strange theme of short visual novel. The game has part of the text of classical Chinese. This game is purely fictional and has nothing to do with real history.

title: Hentai Big Tits
description: Hentai Big Tits - is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Chronicle of Forgotten Times: Pawn of the Gods
description: The kingdom of Ayderia is going through terrible times, people suffer from hunger and disease, and at this time the feudal lords are at each other’s throats in the struggle for influence and power.

title: Home Solo Car Racer
description: It's a small toy car home racing game with 39 indoor levels. You are alone in the game. it's a single player game. But with the option to save multiple user profiles.

title: Space Molmae
description: There's a lot of time waiting for LOL and DOTA, right? That's when MOLMAE Time!

title: Anime Armpits
description: Anime Armpits... It can't get better than this...

title: Philosophical Jigsaw: The Zen Koans
description: Your daily dose of philosophy! Assemble puzzles and watch thought-provoking animations based on Zen Buddhism. To meditate and relax.

title: Chicken Fall
