Follow the compass, seek the depths.
Turn and move with the arrow keys.
Press the buttons to document your voyage.

title: La Madriguera
description: The game takes place in a simple scene in which our character will try by all means to get a piece of cake. Sure, as long as that doesn't mean having to get out of his chair.

title: Pingo Adventure
description: Pingo Adventure is a cute 3D platformer with interesting physics simulation. Follow Pingo to explore the world, solve puzzles, play mini games and even customize your Pingo with the costumes unlocked from the adventures!

title: Genshin Funkin'
description: Travel around the world of Teyvat as Hu-Tao, as you challenge others in a sing off. With 3 full weeks featuring fan songs and covers sung by some of the original Genshin voice actors! This was made as a tribute to the incredible talents of the Genshin voice actors. Includes easy and normal difficulties respectively, along with swapped charts to play the opponent’s side!

title: Paper Bride 3
description: Paper Bride 3 is a Chinese horror mystery puzzle game. This time the story takes place in Moshui Village, which is near Zangling Village, and Fulu City, a small town nearby.

title: Solara: Starlight Horizon
description: Solara: Starlight Horizon is a multiplayer space dogfighting game. Fight, explore, trade, smuggle contraband, mine, craft, and undertake missions to gain favor with various factions throughout the universe. Earn credits, upgrade your ship, purchase new spacecraft, and explore a sci fi sandbox.

title: Clem
description: Clem is a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with a dark twist. Wake up in a world where puzzles intertwine with exploration, weaving a unique narrative rooted in alchemy. A voice awakens you. It gives you purpose. To guide you, you find a notebook with mysterious entries and a house to explore.

title: Super Scattergories
description: The classic category game is back and better than ever! Now you can test yourself or challenge your friends and family with four all new brain-teasing games, plus the original Scattergories. Put on your thinking cap and use your quick wits to go for that perfect score!

title: Drifting Kings
description: Drifting Kings is Stylized Arcade offline/online Drifting/Touge/Gymkhana racing game with a colorful and stylized environments. fun to play ,hard to master.

title: JumpStart Adventures 6th Grade: Mission EarthQuest
description:
JumpStart Adventures 6th Grade: Mission EarthQuest is a JumpStart game released by Knowledge Adventure in 1998. It is designed to cover a full curriculum for sixth grade.
In this game, an organization known as EarthQuest must stop a spacecraft's artificial intelligence, A.R.T., from wreaking havoc on the ecosystems of the world in his quest to redesign Earth.

title: Choke on my Groundhog, You Bastard Robots
description: Choke on my Groundhog, You Bastard Robots is twin-stick shoot 'em up. Each time you die, your previous playthrough returns as a copy to assist you. The number of ghost allies increases with each new life making the player stronger with each death.

title: RLCraft
description:
This started out as a simple little thing I was putting together for my own server and friends, and since then it's turned into something pretty ridiculous. I've gotten some requests about releasing it as a modpack so here it is.

RLCraft, the RL standing for Real Life or Realism and is a take on another mod I made for Unreal called RLCoop that generally has a similar goal, is my interpretation of what I've always wanted in Minecraft when it comes to pure survival, adventuring and RPG, and immersion. I hand selected many mods and individually tweaked each and every one to fit the exact play-style I was looking for, making sure they all worked fluidly with each other, adding my own custom scripts for various changes to vanilla behavior, etc.

Bottom line is, this ain't your dad's Minecraft, and you're going to die...a lot. Just be prepared for that. This tends to happen whenever I make mods for any game for some reason...it usually ends up being unfairly difficult.

title: Air Twister
description: Soar through the sky battling against invaders in this all-new fantasy endless shooter from legendary game creator, Yu Suzuki. Players will assume the role of Princess Arch fighting back against bizarre invaders to save their planet from destruction. They’ll rain down their homing arrows to trace graceful arcs of light across beautiful, artfully crafted stages, before they pierce their foes. With a fun and easy touchscreen swipe-shooting gameplay mechanic, the destiny of the planet is in the player’s hands.

title: CubeLoop
description: CubeLoop is a first-person puzzle game that you can play solo or cooperatively online. Will you be able to figure out what riddle is hidden behind each room? Or will you die and die in an endless loop? Only logic can save you.

title: Galaxy Angel Ex
description: Galaxy Angel Ex is a "supplementary" videogame released by Broccoli. In the "main storyline," Tact and all of the Angels (including Chitose) are hanging out together on the Elsior and having fun.

title: Gust of Wind
description:
Stealth game set in a post-apocalyptic world of rusted technology. Encouraged playstyle is mainly stealth, but melee combat is also possible. The game's UI is as minimalistic and low-key as possible to avoid breaking the immersion.

The story is centered around a delivery mission by sail ship, its purpose being to deliver war technology to a town defending itself against attackers. Player character is the stealth expert of the crew, doing missions involving stealing, spying and sabotage.

title: SCP: Terror Hunt
description: Terror Hunt is a modification for "SCP: Containment Breach". The mod is developed by the same creator of the Five Nights at Freddy's Mod. This mod adds and alters many aspects of the base game. These additions include new SCPs, new rooms, new items, and a brand new storyline for the main character!

title: Cursed Exped
description: Take part in the first journey of the Cursed Exped. Your mission is to cleanse cursed items in a haunted house. Use your tools to locate and investigate items. Create a ritual area to mark your location of interest and bring items with energy there to progress through the game. Be careful though, the unknown is always watching you and waiting around every corner. Stay safe and happy investigating.

title: Ante Mortem
description: Mars has been invaded and lost, your method of escape was to board a demonic starship inbound for earth and save what's left by the time you return.

title: Fortnite: Chapter 3 - Season 3: Vibin'
description: In Chapter 3 Season 3: Vibin’, the Island is one giant party. Bounce around in Reality Falls, ride atop creatures, brave the Screwballer coaster, and revel with a new arsenal. Drop into Season 3 and spread the good vibes!

title: Cyberdekay
description:
Dolphin virus threatens free networks: The dolphin virus spreads through and corrupts active memory, ravaging programs and data alike. The decentralized networks have been hit harder than any other and will soon suffer total memory corruption.

In desperation, the spread of corruption has halted by deactivating core memory, rendering entire systems impassable and hence their resident programs unusable.

Sources in the scene have, at great personal cost, siphoned a military-grade antivirus program that can be our only hope for eradicating the virus - providing its sophisticated layers of encryption can be broken.

We must now make our last stand, reactivate and scour dormant system memory, seek decryption programs, unlock and run the anti-virus to eradicate the dolphin virus.

title: MyFloppy Online!
description: Design your Floppy avatar, customize your room, battle, rob and visit other Floppys online!

title: Espionage
description: Espionage is a 2D narrative puzzle game. The story is set on an alternate history of World War II. You will be a spy deep within enemy lines, facing life-and-death trials and the choice between morality and duty in a series of operations, ultimately growing into a true revolutionary warrior.

title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent
description: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent is a fully-fledged strategy RPG set in the world of Class of Heroes! Create your own party of students in a fantasy realm! Pick them up and guide them to victory against the monster hordes!

title: Labyrinth of Zangetsu
description: Labyrinth of Zangetsu is new 3D dungeon RPG by Acquire. Its gameplay systems are a return to the "roots" of hack-and-slash. It is a title that emphasizes "wa" (the Japanese-style), which is Acquire’s specialty. It depicts a “deep” world view illustrated by ink painting brush strokes. And features a “mixture of wa” sound that channels the music of Japan’s various eras, from "gagaku" (traditional Japanese music and dance) to "noh" (traditional Japanese masked dance-drama). Labyrinth of Zangetsu is developed based on these four keywords.

title: RTX Sweeper
description: Minesweeper, but on steroids.

title: Aluna Rift
description: Dodge danger with built-in bullet-time teleportation. Cosmic chaos, neon lasers, and bosses that delight in your demise. Frantic, fierce, and endlessly replayable. Go solo or team up for co-op mayhem.

title: Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed - Second Coming Edition
description:
Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed is a video game in the open-world action-adventure genre, serving as a remake of the original 2006 game. It is the sequel to the remade Destroy All Humans! and marks the sixth instalment in the franchise.

In this game, players take on the role of Crypto, navigating through diverse global locations such as England, Russia, and the United States. The objective is to complete various missions and overcome human adversaries. The gameplay incorporates a range of weapons and abilities, allowing players to defeat enemies by employing tactics such as mind-controlling humans and utilizing advanced alien technology.

The Second Coming Edition includes the following content:

- Crypto Statue – 70cm/27.6 inch
- Arkwobbler Statue
- Embossed metal plate
- Artbook
- Orchestral score (CD)
- Reprobed: Challenge Accepted DLC (digital)
- Reprobed: Skin Pack (digital)
- Destroy All Humans! – Clone Carnage (digital)

title: Inertial Drift: Twilight Rivals Edition
description: Set in a 90s retro future, ‘Inertial Drift: Twilight Rivals Edition’ is an arcade racer that tears up the racing rule book with innovative twin-stick control and completely reimagined driving mechanics.

title: Calx
description: Calx is an atmospheric 3D action adventure inspired by visionary sci-fi art. Explore planet Syro - vast landscapes filled with crystal structures and ancient technology. Find out what the WARP did to the Quoths civilization. The environment guides you, revealing secrets through exploration.

title: Final Fantasy VIII
description: The Steam version of Final Fantasy VIII comes with several in-game enhancements, including a speed-up option to fast-forward through cutscenes and FMVs and built-in cheats, such as Battle Assist, making battles almost impossible to lose. Like Final Fantasy VII, the re-release version comes with the Magic Booster feature that allows players to boost their characters' magics to 100. Achievements and cloud save data storage are also available. Windowed mode and high-resolution displays (up to 1920x1080 @ 60 Hz) are now supported. However, the game still uses the original MIDI tracks from the 1999 version, rather than the PlayStation version music, unlike the 2012 re-released Final Fantasy VII which has received a musical update. Chocobo World is playable directly from the launcher after booting Final Fantasy VIII.

title: Puzzle World: Cute Monsters
description: Welcome to the game "Puzzle world - cute monsters". Here you will find exciting conundrums in the form of puzzles. You have to combine many different fragments together, while creating a whole picture. Dive into the fascinating world of cute monsters! Don't stop at one - collect them all!

title: Qwilight
description: Qwilight is the most feature‑rich free BMS/BMSON player, offering diverse game modes, broad hardware support, rich online features, and easy accessibility. Community‑driven challenges and profile titles expand through the official Discord.

title: Animals
description: Animals is an engaging clicker game where every click counts. Explore unique habitats like Aerial, Arboreal, Terrestrial, and Aquatic, and collect diverse animals. Earn regular and rare drops influenced by your click activity. Join our community to help shape the game and build a vast metaverse.

title: Witch Epoch
description: Witch Epoch is a game about a Witch fighting in the otherworld with various monsters that are getting stronger every time, collecting colored bonuses the player can cause damage and if the color of the bonus matches the color of the monster's weakness, then he will receive maximum damage!

title: Arcade Flight
description: You're controlling a plane that is going forward in an infinite and randomized space filled with barriers. Use your reflexes to dodge the incoming barriers in high speed. Collect coins along the way to later spend them in the store section.

title: Chance at Life
description: The events unfold in an old house built in 1876. Two friends returning from a party were caught in a storm. They had to stay in an abandoned house to wait out the bad weather. To survive, the friends had to unravel the secrets of the mansion, go after the one who is trying to help.

title: Monsterlands
description: Monsterlands is an exciting rogue-like survival game. Fight against the monsters and try to survive by upgrading your weapons and items.

title: Kotomasho: I Can't Believe This Neet Guy Turned Into a Magical Girl!
description: A Gameboy Color and Anime inspired adventure game with RPG elements. The protagonist is a neet 21 year old guy who suddenly acquires the Power of Dreams and transforms into a Magical Girl.

title: Sanction
description: Sanction is a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world where you are a prisoner sanctioned to come from the safety of your doomsday bunker to gather supplies for the community. Your freedom and your communities lively-hood relies on you. Survive the worn-torn wasteland left from the final war.

title: Jigsaw Puzzle: BDSM Room
description: Train your brain with this memory game, revealing the naughty sex adventures of a girl and futanari couple and their dominatrix, in images hidden behind pairs of cards which you have to match.

title: The Forest Prison
description: In 2160, political dissidents were not sentenced directly to death but were sent for 'cognitive and orientation tests' to a prison from which no one had ever escaped alive. This is the story of James Webb, who was sentenced to life in prison.

title: Futanari Sex: The Gym
description: An explicit erotic visual novel following the story of a sexy futanari personal trainer taking the training of her sweet and oldest friend to another level…

title: Logica Emotica
description: An emoji infused puzzle game for you!

title: Shadow of Asha
description: Asha's shadows are invading and corrupting Narkian. It's up to you to stop her!, level up, explore the village for resources and become stronger.

title: Second Thoughts
description: Second Thoughts is a psychological text-based game where each day you are tasked with executing someone based on the limited information provided until one person remains with their full story revealed.

title: Space Theory
description: "Space Theory" - a space top down shooter game. The player controls a spaceship and fights against space pirates, blows up enemy space stations and acquires upgrades at the end of each mission.

title: Pacifish
description: Pacifish is an incremental fishing management game with several mechanics to interact with and improve. It can be played both idly, or more actively to progress faster.

title: Meat & Greed
description: In the atmospheric puzzle-platformer Meat & Greed, you will experience the horrors of a slaughterhouse from the perspective of different animals. Solve riddles and collaborate with other animals to try and escape this ill-fated factory.

title: Dune Strider
description: Dune Strider is an Adventure-Strategy Game in which you, the player, take command of a merchant controlling a Sand-Barge in a desert and use it to travel and explore the land around you. The road to settlements to sell your goods is filled with dangers and opportunities.

title: The Box Game
description: The Box Game is a 2D top down platformer game written in Java, and your objective is to get to the end of the labyrinth. The game has 11 levels that get progressively larger each level. More gameplay elements will get introduced to you as you go, and in total the game will take roughly 10-20 minutes to fully play through, depending on your skills (or maybe luck?).

title: Breath of Ghosts
description: Breath of Ghosts is a first-person horror game made in realistic 3D graphics that immerses you in an atmosphere of horror and scares you in every way. The main goal is to survive and be saved.

title: Kawaii Hentai Girls 2
description: It's a relaxing anime puzzle with cute kawaii girls. Solve puzzles, and enjoy high-quality artwork.

title: Worker Riot
description: A worker who has been left without a salary is a dangerous opponent. Armed with a hammer, he will not leave them alone. Help him defeat them all. Beat out of them everything they owe you for your work

title: Dead Zone
description: Dead Zone is a multiplayer first and third person survival shooter. Your task is to survive within a closed area filled with many enemies.

title: Kunai Strike
description: A cyberpunk-ninja FPS 3D-platformer. Throw kunai and teleport to them across 5 individual levels. Chain teleports with wall-runs and jumps to reach the goal in the fastest time and avoid falling to certain death along the way.

title: The Backrooms: Mass Extinction
description: If you noclip out of reality in the wrong areas, you'll end up in the Backrooms. The old moist carpet, the mono-yellow rooms and the hum-buzz of the fluorescent lights will be your only comfort in the endless purgatory you have found yourself in. Don't bother crying out for help. Nobody is left.

title: Drunken Fist 2: Zombie Hangover
description: The inebriated antics of Drunken Fist are back with brutal vengeance as you take the role of a hungover rocker in Drunken Fist 2: Zombie Hangover! Waking up in a city full of undead hordes, it’s your job to stumble through the streets pummeling zombie op…

title: Pewt 'em Up!
description: Pewt 'em Up! is a retro inspired arcade space shoot 'em up with lots of upgrades, achievements, extras and more.

title: Speedway Challenge 2022
description: Speedway Challenge 2022 is a 3D speedway game. Feel speedway emotions thanks to realistic riding physics. Play online mode with friends or local in career mode, league mode, challenges, tournament and quick matches. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Morlush
description: The daily life of a Reaper apprentice in Morlush. You have to go to different parts of the magical island, to fulfill the reaper's order, on your way you will encounter various dangers and monsters.

title: Rabbit Burn
description: Fabulous riches, flying fists, and sensual embraces abound in this dazzling arena where rabbit-masked men and scantily clad bunny girls sprint to and from, dodging explosions, brawling with enemies, making love, or just dancing to the music.

title: Final Blockade
description: In this war, you have to play a brave man, go out and defeat zombies and find the cause of the end.

title: DarkSelf: Other Mind
description: DarkSelf: Other Mind is a first-person psichological horror game about the growth of darkness over time. Explore the house, life and mind of John Parse. Complete puzzles inside the mind of John Parse to unlock his memories, and don't let the DarkSelf catch you.

title: Tricky Doors
description: Tricky doors is a captivating game that offers a variety of puzzles. Find a creative way to get out of each room. Tricky doors is a point-and-click game in the "escape the room" genre with plenty of mini-games and complicated quests.

title: Down the Drain
description: Down the Drain is 32 vanilla maps for Doom 2 and is my take on a Hell on Earth replacement with no added assets except midis that I like and bad menu gfx. Difficulty settings, coop, and deathmatch are implemented.

title: Villwars
description: Villars is a real-time strategy game. Control your troops and reach the very center of the enemy lands! Defend your lands, attack and think over the battle strategy depending on the terrain and position.

title: Pedro Land DX
description: An intense, retro run-and-gun platformer western game!

title: Mailman
description: "Mailman" is a 2D old-school top down arcade game ported to PC. It puts you in the role of a postman who has to deliver all the letters to the mailboxes.

title: Dwarven Towers
description: The dwarves are forced now to build towers and every time one of the witches casts a spell one of the dwarves is turned into a frog. heir only hope is to build as many towers as possible and score enough magical points.

title: Pussy 5
description: "Pussy 5" is a hentai puzzle in which you need to move the elements vertically or horizontally to get the finished image.

title: Buck Bradley 2
description: Buck and Ciroki load their bicycle with wheelbarrow-sidecar onto a train headed towards New Milan: it seems that the creator of this futuristic city, the Architect, may have the knowledge to make Ciroki human again! Look for clues that will help you solve riddles and unravel the puzzle!

title: Martial Story
description: "Martial Story" - a 2D platformer runner with classic game mechanics: run on platforms, dodge enemies, throw swords, balance in free fall, test your reaction against hundreds of enemies, train your accuracy in jumping in caves.

title: Jade Order
description: Return from exile and restore the power balance of a secluded land. Play as an ancient warrior that has been tasked to light the sealed beacons of its millenary Order. Avoid the impending doom and complete 50 different puzzles as you aid the Jade Goddess.

title: City Things
description: City Things is a 3D find and click puzzle game in which you have to find some items on the city location within a certain time.

title: Soppel
description: Soppel is a top down bullet-hell game by Faxdoc about descending a pit of trash and garbage. Fight mechs and robots in an attempt to find out what lies at the bottom.

title: Cool Game
description: Traditional roguelike where you build your team to defeat stronger and stronger opponents. Choose your teammates, their position and your opponents wisely, as one mistake can cost you the entire game

title: Isolate Me!
description: An exciting survival game with roguelike elements in which you have to play as a police officer in a city engulfed by a pandemic, look for infected people and isolate them, manage the budget and hire police officers, set up vaccination centers and propaganda stands.

title: Search All: Bitcoin
description: Is a hidden object game in which you need to find all the bitcoins in a large location. Bitcoins will be located in a variety of places, from the most prominent to barely noticeable places

title: Guardener
description: Your garden is under attack! As a garden gnome, you grow and sell various vegetables to create an army. You'll pull out weeds, water plants and fight worms as you go through this year's seasons. Can you survive until winter?

title: Cartridge the Tiger
description: Cartridge the Tiger is a Super Nintendo inspired platformer with an in-game level editor, easy-to-use mod support using C#, and Steam Workshop integration.

title: Meg's Monster
description: Take control of the Underworld’s grumpiest ghoul to help a lost little girl find her way home in this creepy-cute indie adventure. Just be warned: if she cries, the whole world dies.

title: Russian Hunter
description: Russian Hunter is the most realistic hunting simulator you've ever seen!

title: Hentai Pussy 3
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Succubus Dating
description: What do you do when you find out your date is a succubus? Either run away or...

title: Synthwave Fury
description: Speed and fight your way across an endless highway of neon lights and synthetic palm trees in this virtual world of pure retro '80s nostalgia.

title: Cricket Captain 2022
description: Cricket management goes to another level as Cricket Captain 2022 puts you in control. A major re-design of the player aggression system provides greater realism, coaching options and analysis. Limited over matches have been remodelled to give greater balance and reduce collapses.

title: Ashzel & The Power Dagger
description: Ashzel & The Power Dagger, is a Vampire Fantasy action-adventure RPG. Set in the Eerie, mysterious, dark, and sophisticated West Coast - a place where the Vampires of the West Coast are drawn into wonder, awe, and elegant drama.

title: Farm Defense
description: Farm Defense is a standalone game inspired by the Warcraft 3 mod ‘Random Farm’. Enjoy the nostalgic experience with new features and content. You are pitted against waves of increasingly difficult enemies in a Tower Defense environment. Mitigate the random elements to defend the farm. Conquer all 40 waves to live and fight another day.

title: Super Meteor
description: Can "Super Meteor" save the universe from the space debris created by the development of space by the people of Earth?

title: Realms
description: Welcome to Realms, a first-person shooter inspired by the rules and aesthetics of popular tabletop RPGs. Use The Die of Chaos along with your abilities and alternate gun fire to help Fortuna explore different realms and destroy any and all threats along the way.

title: Aces & Adventures
description: Aces and Adventures is a deck builder RPG with poker-powered combat. Journey through a world inspired by Norse and Middle Eastern mythology to save the Life Tree from the evil that gnaws at her roots.

title: Escape from Tarkov: Arena
description:
Escape from Tarkov Arena is a standalone game project - a session-based multiplayer first-person shooter for PC with all the known and beloved hardcore game mechanics of Escape from Tarkov.
Players will take part in gladiatorial battles in various arenas of the city of Tarkov, organized by a mysterious group of Arena Masters led by the Host.

The game will feature various PvP and PvE game modes, ratings, weapon and gear unlocks and unique features for owners of the main Escape from Tarkov game, like the ability to play as your main profile character.

title: Mida's Adventure
description: Mida's Adventure is a puzzle-adventure game where a young lady named Mida searches underground for lost 80's and 90's technological artifacts. Jump into a low poly, low resolution, 2d billboard sprite world filled with dangerous obstacles.

title: Heroes of Time 2: Aizack's Return
description: This sequel is in the MV version. Totally revamped and faithful to the previous game made on VX Ace. Everything you experienced in the 1st and 2nd game is redone with MV graphics. In addition to the battle systems this time is sideview.

title: Hero of War
description: Hero of War is a platform game where every move must be very well thought out, wasting a single shot can put your entire mission at risk.

title: Starwalker: Into the Cylinder
description: Starwalker is an upcoming Survival-MMORPG taking place far into into the future in a space cylinder.

title: Evil's Den
description: Evil's Den: Forsaken Dungeon is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler featuring procedurally generated levels where you will battle through hordes of monsters to close a portal to Hell opened in the village's church.

title: 6-Mon Adventure
description: Embark on an adventure with 6-mon the little robot. Take control of the robot and travel through a disused factory, avoiding falls, protecting yourself from projectiles and traversing dangerous levels to stop the activities of a crazy AI.

title: Psyolence
description: Psyolence is an arcade hardcore top-down slasher with neon graphics.

title: The Roots
description: The Roots is a horror-adventure game that tells a story of a courier who, after several unsuccessful attempts of knocking in, decides to find the recipient and hand the order to him by any means. However, the moment the character gets inside the mansion - imposing but unkempt - the feeling of being trapped intensifies, and it seems to be no way out, or...?

title: Bug Butcher
description: Bug butcher is a roguelite action game with random locations, dynamic gameplay and tons of bugs.

title: Search All: Birds
description: A hidden object game in which you need to find all the birds in a large location. The birds will be located in a variety of places, from the most prominent to barely noticeable places

title: Doudas Danger
description: This unusual platformer will throw you into the thick of a hot skirmish in the depths of a magical forest! The undead, slugs and mimics rebelled and stole all the treasures of the forest - your task is to return them.

title: Chickweed
description: A strange creature has escaped from the lab... and that creature is you! Fight your way to freedom through hordes of enemies, dangerous traps and treacherous ambushes in this hardcore platformer and uncover the mystery of the running bush!

title: 2K20 Cuba
description: 2K20 Cuba is a modification of the 2012 MLB 2K game. Featuring all the teams that participate in the National Series of Cuban baseball and their respective updated rosters and stadiums.

title: Quickerflak_Ruthlessmod
description: Quickerflak_Ruthlessmod is the standalone "pretty hard" expansion of the retro-hardcore minigame Quickerflak.

title: Bionic Tadpole
description: A run-n-gun, non-stop action platformer-shooter! Pick up a weapon. A jetpack. A force shield. All while evading bullet-hell madness! Oh, and be mindful not to let your gun overheat...

title: 100 Hidden Turtles
description: Hidden object game in the undersea world setting. At first black and white hand-drawn graphics in a cartoon style. Then the game becomes colored. Animated fish and algae.

title: Lewd Life with My Doggy Wife
description: After getting kicked out of the hero's adventuring party and almost passing out on the side of the road, karma rewards you with a rescue from a passing doggirl! Put all that stressful "fighting for your life" behind you, kick back and take it easy with a lovey-dovey doggirl today!

title: Paper Plane
description:
Soar Through Serenity. Take flight in a world made of calm and curiosity.

Paper Plane is a peaceful journey through a hand-crafted papercraft world. Glide effortlessly on the breeze, discover hidden wonders, and collect shimmering moments of joy. With no time limits, enemies, or stress, it’s a relaxing experience for players of all ages — whether you’re chasing sunlight through autumn leaves or simply drifting above the rooftops.
Rediscover the quiet joy of exploration, one gentle glide at a time.

Fly free. Wander far. Wonder always.

title: Geballer
description: In this mouse-only Bullet Hell, you create your own problems! Featuring unique and strange bullets, different gameplay modes, extreme secrets and even a level editor, Geballer wants to softly stimulate the reptilian part of your brain until you disappear completely.

title: Burrow of the Fallen Bear: A Gay Furry Visual Novel
description: A gay furry visual novel, full of fantasy and RPG elements. Experience Krile’s journey before he saves the Furry Heroes, Meet 3 unique hot adventurers, Fight with them, Buy items that impact your story, Unlock branches, Explore the Fallen Bear’s burrow. Everything through a classic choice system.

title: What Happened in Addison's Grotto
description:
A young woman from a small fishing village goes missing. Days later agents of an unknown organization find her, take her to a secret location. The young woman saw something she shouldn't have and now something else sees through her.

It needs to be found, isolated, and exorcised.

You're the only one who can do it.

title: Lysogenesis
description: You need to take the ship apart to put yourself together. Play as a seed of intelligence rapidly developing the ability to sense the world around you. Unfortunately the world you're trapped inside is crashed, and power is running low.

title: Knight of the Dead
description: In Knight of the Dead, the apocalypse is upon us. To run from the inevitable horde, one must consider their moves wisely, lest time, and the undead, catch up to them.

title: Shattered Memories
description: Embark on an unforgettable story-driven adventure as Hikari, a young boy caught between two worlds. Uncover the mysteries of Andogas, a land threatened by war and corrupted forces. Along your journey, you'll meet allies, face powerful enemies, and make choices that shape the fate of the world.

title: Loretta
description:
Loretta is a psychological thriller that would make the player an accessory to the heroine’s crimes and would lead her through a self-crafted nightmare. This story is about a woman, dealing with betrayal, her husband’s infidelity, relationship problems and the difficult social situation of the 1940s.

Conceptually and aesthetically, the game is inspired by the American art of the twentieth century, the works of Andrew Wyeth and Edward Hopper, film noir of the 40s to 50s, thrillers by Alfred Hitchcock, the Philip Ridley movie The Reflecting Skin, the books 1922 by Stephen King and Lolita by Vladimir Nabokov.

title: Touhou Kouma Daimeikyuu
description: A Touhou Doujin game based on Adventures of lolo series, developed by BansheeS Software.

title: Kishin Houkou Demonbane
description: Kishin Houkou Demonbane is a remake of Deus Machina Demonbane that makes numerous improvements to the original visual novel, such as full voice acting, lip flaps and blinking for sprites, more animated cutscenes, and a revised script, among other improvements. Unlike the original, this version does not contain any erotic content.

title: Touhou Rock Maiden 3: Houraisan Kaguya no Saigo!?
description: A Touhou Doujin game based on Rockman (Megaman), developed by Capricorn.

title: The Gramsby Summoning
description: Peek out the door and see what's stirring. Made for Two-Minute-Horror Jam.

title: Touhou Rock Maiden FC 2: History's Greatest Sermon!!
description: A Touhou Doujin game based on Rockman (Megaman), developed by CAPRICORN.

title: Observo
description: Observo is a short third-person survival horror game styled after early-2000s game classics, with a focus on atmosphere, puzzle-solving, and light combat.

title: Ring War
description: Become your own bullet hell in Ring War! The online PvP top-down shooter where you can instantly join a lobby with up to 15 other players, scavenge a loadout from a pool of over 250 unique items, and battle to the top of the leaderboard.

title: Rabbitoad
description: A frog-like rabbit is the main character's high-difficulty 2D action In order to fulfill the wish that "I will not be mistaken for a frog" Aim for the place of the goddess.

title: Mortal Vessel
description: A dungeon crawler turn-based RPG where you play a hero that has the ability to possess creatures. Featured more than 10 creatures, each of them have a unique skill and ability, Including upgradable skills, ultimate skills, and combine with other skills.

title: Mayor T-Rex
description: Major T-Rex and his gang are back in town. A new apocalypse is coming because the nature can no longer support humans and their constructions.

title: Don't Get Tagged
description: Escape the Bobber occupied levels by doing puzzles and strategic movement through levels. Experience a variety of levels and challenges through out your play through, overcoming obstacles and those that block your path completely. Just don't get tagged In the processes.

title: Grot Slasher
description: Upgrade your character and try to survive in an endless maze filled with scary creatures. Smash all the items on the level so that the souls that have been hiding there for several hundred years get out of them, and move further along the dungeon.

title: King Pig
description: "King Pig" is an old-school top down arcade game. Your main goal is to save pigs from butchers. Be careful, butchers` saws must not hurt the pigs - dodge the saw with your heavy-duty cloak and kill all butchers!

title: Tower of Spirit
description: Tower of Spirit is a fast turn-based RPG where your choices matter. Gather a group of unique characters, survive a serie of random encounters and battle your way to reach the enigmatic tower!

title: Hiboka
description: Hiboka, a single player survival horror video game based on folklore from Madagascar and set around the middle of the 20th century.

title: Conditus
description: Show your friends who's the strongest ninja, and make them suffer. Or team up with them to eliminate your enemies.

title: Elspell
description: In Elspell you will run into a variety of monsters and challenges you must overcome by casting a wide array of elementally-aligned spells. The core gameplay comes from its unique spellcasting system, where stringing together specific arm and hand movements casts spells.

title: Hallowlands
description: Hallowlands is an open world procedurally generated RPG adventure. Explore a world full of monsters, harvest resources, and craft unique items. An adventure awaits!

title: The Katydids Incident
description: There is a big discussion going on about a mysterious group named The Katydids proposing riddles and challenges on online forums, Are you clever enough to unravel the mystery of this obscure organization?

title: Tales of Fire
description: Tales of Fire is a short story-driven game, embark on an adventure to bring fire to your ant village or else they all die to the cold winter breeze. Platform your way through mushrooms, escape from evil spiders and make friends along the way. Can you save them?

title: We Took That Trip
description: A chill narrative experience through procedural and relaxing landscapes. Appreciate the reunion with your best friends, explore the road and it's fantastic things. Turn the radio on, it's time to enjoy this emotional ride.

title: Kitten Hero
description: Help the kitten rescue his human and other kittens from a spaceship controlled by an alien AI (artificial intelligence).

title: SuperDuck!
description: Explore levels, create paths for the ducklings to reach the exit and save them from being stranded in this puzzle platformer.

title: Banana Drama
description: Banana Drama is an independent early access RTS game offering a single player and multiplayer experience. Your monkey king is held captive by evil dinosaurs - he needs help!

title: Splat Cat
description: Play as an artist painting their way through self-discovery! In this puzzle platformer, you'll wield your brush to paint your own path and defeat your insecurities, doubts, and fears as an artist. Finally, defeat the personification of these insecurities in an epic boss battle and reveal the beautiful artwork you made along the way.

title: Hell Division
description:
Hell Division is a game from the 3rd person, which is a battle of combat drones.

Become a pilot of an armed military drone and plunge into adrenaline-fueled action set in a cyberpunk city divided between two ruthless corporations. The confrontation is inevitable, the question is – will you prevail?

title: Symbiosis
description: Online cooperative or solo survival and action RPG set in a procedural alien world. Explore, survive, battle bosses and gather resources to customize your equipment and defend your bases from creatures drawn by the electromagnetism of your technology.

title: Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed - Dressed to Skill Edition
description:
Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed is a video game in the open-world action-adventure genre, serving as a remake of the original 2006 game. It is the sequel to the remade Destroy All Humans! and marks the sixth instalment in the franchise.

In this game, players take on the role of Crypto, navigating through diverse global locations such as England, Russia, and the United States. The objective is to complete various missions and overcome human adversaries. The gameplay incorporates a range of weapons and abilities, allowing players to defeat enemies by employing tactics such as mind-controlling humans and utilizing advanced alien technology.

The "Dressed to Skill" edition includes the base game as well as the following extra items: Reprobed: Skin Pack, Reprobed: Challenge Accepted DLC (post-launch release), Reprobed: Official Orchestral Score, Reprobed: Digital Art Book.

title: Yuzusoft Collection
description:
Yuzusoft Collection includes:
-Sabbat of the Witch
-Parquet
-Riddle Joker
-Café Stella and the Reaper's Butterflies
-Senren * Banka

title: Ye Olde Cribbage Club: A Later Daters Game
description: Cozy up with your favorite Ye Olde residents with a cracking cribbage contest. What is cribbage? Only the best board and card game combo ever played, enjoyed by many a senior citizen and old soul.

title: Shishi: Timeless Prelude
description: Shishi : Timeless Prelude is a colorful dungeon role-playing game. As Elia, a young mage, you will explore the depths of a sacred sanctuary to complete your training to become an Oracle.

title: Dave the Diver
description: Dave the Diver is an action-adventure and management simulation game developed by Mintrocket. In the game, players control Dave, who spends his days diving into underwater environments to catch fish and gather resources, and his nights managing a sushi restaurant. The gameplay combines real-time underwater exploration and combat with restaurant management mechanics.

title: Dragon Quest X: Nemureru Yuusha to Michibiki no Meiyuu Online
description: The first expansion for Dragon Quest X Online, known as Version 2.

title: Dragon Quest X: Inishie no Ryuu no Denshou Online
description: The second expansion for Dragon Quest X Online, known as Version 3.

title: Ghostware: Arena of the Dead
description: Ghostware is a retro-fps combining the lore-heavy plot and exploration of adventure games with the fast action of '90s shooters. You and other ghosts have been trapped inside an arena FPS created by a wizard's unwillingness to overcome his nostalgia. Escape the past, shoot your way out.

title: AI Under Test
description: The fear of artificial intelligence is nothing new, but will it always be for the bad? Solve puzzles and follow the creator and creator's conversation during the testing phase, until the moment they are interrupted by external matters.

title: Spyer
description: Denny, a government spy, is assigned to investigate a remote area where there is supposed to be a terrorist group. Upon arriving at the scene, Denny comes across several armed individuals, and finds possibly the largest base of the terrorist group.

title: PvNP
description: A classic Sokoban game but with a modern take. 50 levels to test your brain in a semi-open world.

title: Hide and Seek Scramble!
description: Three players. Two teams. One kidnapped bunny! Play as three different characters in this fast-paced, competitive multiplayer game.

title: Talking Kiteboards by Flexifoil
description: Talking Kiteboards is a 12-person multi-player animated kiteboarding racing game. You choose from a range of exciting characters and kites as well as kiteboards which have varying skill sets to compete in races against bots or other players. Collect and win gold coins to spend on customisation.

title: Pixelshire
description: Build the town of Pixelshire and grow your community in a unique RPG sandbox which mixes life sim elements with town building, exploration, and combat. Express yourself by planning the town to your liking, master trades, get to know your neighbours, and explore the continent of Arcadia.

title: Maze Runner
description: You start the game as a cyborg, lost in the world of the Maze. He will need to find and collect all the orbs that will unlock the door to his freedom. He will have fifteen minutes to do so, before he gets lost forever. Complete mazes as third-person shooter. Eliminated over 40 different enemies.

title: Jigoku Unko: Toripuru
description: Our character has a tantrum after eating spicy Adana Kebab. Then he finds himself in hell for some unknown reason. He is no longer human and is even more angry. By breaking all the obstacles in front of him, he tries to advance as far as he can without his anger killing him.

title: Queen's Wish 2: The Tormentor
description: You are in a barbarian land. They are trying to kill you. The Queen demands you tame them. So what now? Escape into an exciting, open-ended story and cunning tactical combat. Epic, indie fantasy adventure. Freely explore a huge world, fight for fame and power, and shape the world as you choose.

title: Leave No One Behind: la Drang VR
description: Leave No One Behind is a tactical RTS war game. Experience the hardest battles fought during the Vietnam War in 1965 between the US Army and the Army of the Northern Vietnam for landing zones X-Ray and Albany and for Plei Me special forces camp with incredible level of immersion provided by VR.

title: Eternal Pinball RPG
description: Level up and equip your hero in this unique Pinball-RPG mashup. Beat everybody on the online leaderboards and unlock the dungeon table to find rare artifacts to complete your collection.

title: Recollection
description: A calm and atmospheric "walking'n'watching simulator" about the beauty of nature. Use your gaze and attention in diverse gameplay experiences: Connect the stars, watch the grass grow, fly with the birds and remember many more of the wonders surrounding us each day.

title: Slime Jumper Adventure
description: Slime Jumper Adventure is a 2D platformer game where you are tasked with guiding the main character through multiple different levels of creative obstacles that increase in difficulty the further you get.

title: Finity
description: Fuse monsters, build strategic decks, catch wild beasts, and battle players worldwide in the ultimate monster MMO!

title: A Bad Game of Football
description: Classic RTS and Football meet in this explosive 1v1 game. Control all your players at once or separately in stadiums full of dangers for your players to avoid. Tackle, foul, and baseball bat your way to victory, just don’t get spotted by the referee…

title: Fountains
description: Master high-skilled combat to uncover the secrets of an ancient, interconnected world.

title: Android Simulator
description: Android Simulator is a futuristic FPS game in which you take the role of an android who is in charge of a spaceship colony. Keep a firm hand on the flight route and manage the right water balance for plants, oxygen level, and spacecraft parameters to securely deliver the colonizers.

title: Road Defense: Outsiders
description: Protect vehicles on the road and survive! Road Defense: Outsiders is a game that combines elements of the 'roguelike' and 'tower defense' genres. Upgrade the towers and your own skills to be able to annihilate all the life around you!

title: Sinner 97
description: Sinner 97 is a first person PSX VHS psychological horror set in 1997, within the confines of a shadowy religious cult. Remain hidden and overcome problems in order to escape the Father's clutches.

title: Skeletons vs Nadia
description: Skeletons vs Nadia is a third person game with beautiful graphics! In this game you have to play as a naked girl Nadya, who needs to get out of the cursed forest. There are a lot of lustful skeletons in this forest who want to kill you!

title: Dream Catcher VR
description: Dream Catcher VR is a relaxing puzzle adventure in the soulful world of Nappia – the land of dreams. Meet characters from varied backgrounds and shape their dreams – search for hidden parts, mend fractured memories, clear your path, and bring colors to the surroundings.

title: Platformity
description: A 2D puzzle platformer that combines puzzle solving elements with speedrunning challenges. Game features multiple obstacles with ever increasing difficulty.

title: Jurassic World Evolution 2: Dominion Biosyn Expansion
description: The biggest DLC yet for Jurassic World Evolution 2 features a new campaign inspired by events from Jurassic World Dominion, including all-new prehistoric species, feathered dinosaurs, a new Chaos Theory scenario, and more.

title: Logicality
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting journey on the island of dreams. Explore the open world and interesting places, while solving various puzzles that use environment.

title: Stream War
description: Stream War is a streaming-based game. Streamers can link their Twitch account to this game with one click. Viewers join this game by commands in twitch comments to spawn characters. Viewers can increase their in-game points and compete for rankings.

title: Plumbers Don't Wear Ties: Definitive Edition
description: He's a plumber, she's a daddy's girl. Only you can get them together, or tear them apart! Plumbers have everything: Greed, sex, spirituality, white-knuckle chases, shameful propositions, a nun, humor, true love, jaded love, jealousy, taut action, comedy, a bad guy, a good guy, a hero, spine-tingling suspense, a hot babe, brazen bravado, a damsel in distress, and a Hollywood ending! Plays like a game... feels like a movie!

title: Project:M
description: Indie Horror puzzle game

title: A Boy and His Blob: Retro Collection
description:
The Blob is back in an exclusive collection with Limited Run Games. The Retro Collection includes the original NES A Boy and His Blob: Trouble on Blobolonia, and The Rescue of Princess Blobette, originally on Game Boy.
Discover Blob's amazing appetite for jellybeans, and the different transformations that occur with each favor. Learn to use these shapes to overcome even the most outrageous obstacles.

title: Rendering Ranger: R2 - Rewind
description: You are the Rendering Ranger, a special forces soldier who defending Earth from a devastating alien invasion through nine levels of action platforming as well as blisteringly fast horizontal shooter stages. Originally developed for Super Famicom by Manfred Trenz, creator of the Turrican series.

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Construction Chaos
description: 2 Brand New Tables with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Construction site themed tables with an emphasis on Drop & Stationary Targets.

title: Shackles of Ellswyn
description: You've fallen into a weird world where men don't belong and are hunted down to become slaves. Will you submit or escape?

title: Honey Select 2: Libido DX
description: The ultimate sex simulator is here! Honey Select 2: Libido Deluxe is a love letter to making love. Engage with high-quality, fully-customizable characters in every imaginable situation. From romantic candlelight sex to the most specific kinks, Honey Select is sure to satisfy you!

title: The Search for Fran 2
description: Welcome to Sans Fran City. You are here to search for Fran, again. While searching, You can also talk with people and go on quests, collect glorbs, drive cars, fly a drone, crash cars, try a "challenge" and much more!

title: Vampire Sweetie
description: Vampire Sweetie is a otome game by Sugar Beans.

title: Crush Them!
description: In the quiet and peaceful grassland, a group of uninvited guests suddenly came! They are ordered by Satan to raid the walls of God! You have been hired by the gods as a new warrior, sworn to live and die with the city wall! Now, follow the will of God and crush them with your fingers!

title: Starry Sky: in Winter
description: The fourth of the four Starry Sky games starring the characters from the drama CDs of the same name.

title: Aim God
description: A shooting simulator that maximize your aiming skills and speed up your reflexes.

title: Hero Realms
description: From the makers of Star Realms Deckbuilding Game, Hero Realms combines the fun of deckbuilding games with the interactivity of trading card game-style combat. The Star Realms Digital Deckbuilding Game has been downloaded over 1M times. Like the hugely popular Star Realms app, the Hero Realms Digital game provides cross-platform play with full gameplay. In Hero Realms Digital, gamers choose their class, battle, gain experience, and level up fantasy-themed characters on iOS, Android, and Steam. Gamers can also adventure through story-driven campaigns and play Pit Fight mode against the AI.

title: Jumanji: The Curse Returns - Winter Resort
description: Play Jumanji in the Winter Resort Map and banish jungle creatures in a snowy wonderland! Add two characters and tokens to your collection and face a whole new riddle!

title: Joyride
description: Joyride is a low-poly style racing game, You will drive your vehicle through roads with different scenery in different seasons, In this game, You can race with yourself, And even operate a drone to watch your driving process, Good luck

title: Albert and Puzzle Mansion
description: Albert's cat has been abducted! Enter the mansion and solve puzzles in order to find and rescue the cat!

title: Starry Sky: After Winter
description: Fandisc for the original Starry Sky: After Winter game.

title: Puzzles with Nature
description: In this game, you will find a huge variety of relaxing puzzles designed to train your brain. Start dragging the puzzle pieces to the right place until you form a whole picture.

title: Blade Bros Impact!
description: An action RPG with several essences from classic 16 and 32 bit era RPGs! Enjoy dynamic battles, scary bosses, get more powerful by gaining levels, getting swords, rods, bows, axes and so forth!

title: The Dead Sea Scrolls Adventure
description: Play as Dr. Jerusalem Jones, an explorer set on finding out the history behind the 7 major Dead Sea Scrolls. Along the way, the player gets to meet a whole cast of characters and traverse across the deserts and caves near the Dead Sea and Bethlehem to learn about the history behind these relics.

title: Crazy Shark
description: You have to control a crazed shark that lives in the depths of the ocean. Declare war on all living things, but be careful, the military is hunting you! Eat vacationers, break yachts, wreck ships, destroying submarines and helicopters!

If you think you are smart then this is a place where you can challenge the power of your mind. In this game you can use boxes and ladders to climb and find solutions to puzzles by focusing and thinking.

title: Panzer Girls
description: This is a fast-paced shooting game with simple operation. Together with the students of the girls' chariot academy, we forged the last line of defense to stop the monsters attacking like a flood.

title: Lovely Moments: Dad and Daughter
description: Jigsaw puzzle with 6 images, about day life of family and fatherhood. Enjoy playing theses scenes in 5 levels of difficulty and play minigames to increase your experience.

title: Dejar Ir: A Pandemic Soulful Tale
description: An intimate and sentimental game where the story is told through different works of art that evoke what we felt during the pandemic, culminating with one of the most beautiful feelings. What will it be? An adventure filled with emotions we experienced during the pandemic.

title: Marvel's Midnight Suns: Legendary Edition
description:
Marvel's Midnight Suns: Legendary Edition is a special edition of the game Marvel's Midnight Suns, developed by Firaxis Games and published by 2K Games. Released alongside the base game in December 2022, this edition includes the full game and the Season Pass.

Additionally, the Legendary Edition includes 23 Premium Skins available at launch.

title: Idle Galaxy
description: Relaxing idle clicker game with various gameplay features. Challenging enough for hardcore players but it also can be fully completed.

title: Revived Forest
description: A 2D platform game. The main goal is to collect all the seeds and save the offspring of the ents. Be careful - there are dangerous orcs and lumberjacks!

title: Dungeon Liberator
description: Dungeon Liberator is a game where eight or two players face off in 1v1 rounds, with the goal to be the last player standing. Players need to compete with opponents for Minions and attack orders. Reaction speed will become as important as tactical ability.

title: L.O.L. Surprise! B.B.s Born to Travel
description: Fans around the world can't wait to unbox their own L.O.L. Surprise! doll - and you're about to make their dreams come true! Choose your character, collect fabulous L.O.L. Surprise! dolls full of glitter, diamonds and more, and team up with up to four friends!

title: Magic Wardrobe
description: Design and color historical clothes while learning about famous women by reading news profiles on famous women through time and diaries and writing your own. Girls will have fun on the traveling adventure to 12 historical periods in time.

title: After He Was Gone
description: "After He Was Gone" is a Tactical RPG. NO level-up system. Character's skills and items will change the battle situation significantly. Collect the treasures and lead therianthropes from getting out from the world of board game. Don’t worry. If YOU don’t lose hope, we can rewind the time any time.

title: Watch Your Back
description: You are some small-time journalists, exploited by your boss. When an abandoned Cold War-era shelter is discovered, your boss sends you there to do the story of a lifetime. Only you two will know what awaits you in there...

title: Atria
description: Fight and survive against Assault droids and Sirens in an attempt to defeat the corrupt conglomerate known as Koretech and save the galaxy.

title: GoVenture Entrepreneur
description: The most realistic small business startup and operations simulation ever!

title: Hell Green Blue
description: terrible creatures that are the guardians of the infernal color, destroy the guardians and save the world from the dominance of the red color!

title: Me Alone Reissue
description: Apocalypse on earth! Many people have turned into monsters that eat the survivors. Stay alive as long as possible! God bless you.

title: Lost Retrograde
description: Lost RETROGRADE is a stealth horror sandbox game about finding your missing grandfather. Avoid a mysterious man hunting you down, but be careful, the he learns & adapts to your every move. Can you outsmart him and find your grandfather?

title: Lord of Darkness: Prologue
description: Lord of Darkness: Prologue is a fantasy game made in pixel-based graphics, just like in the good old days of the early dawn of Japanese rpg. An epic adventure full of dangers and hardships awaits you.

title: Futsuma Shoujo Charlotte
description: Mizuki Konoe, also known as Exorcist Charlotte, lived among others using a disguise. Explore an abandoned factor and fight off the devils! Exorcist heroine RPG!!

title: Futanari Sex: Naughty Massage
description: A visual novel about a couple trying to release tension and increase their sexual pleasure. Not knowing where to start and eager to know all the secrets of erotic massage, they turn to a specialist.

title: Touhou Blooming Soul
description:
This is a fast-paced side-scrolling action game with roguelite elements. Follow Hata no Kokoro as she explores and defeats enemies on the stage of Gensokyo.
The game contains many randomized elements such as items, skills and maps. Players can utilize a variety of different playstyles, making each run uniquely different from the last.

title: Touhou Fairy Knockout: One Fairy to Rule Them All
description: A game where multiple players co-fight or compete against each other! You will role-play as playful fairies with unique personalities, and accomplish your own Gekokujō in Gensokyo where the strong gather! Make your own favorite fairy character the strongest with your own hands!

title: Respawn
description: "Respawn" is an independent adventure game in which you will play the role of a ghost and initiate adventures belonging to the ghost. The game not only has a rich plot, but also has a unique. From the depths of the earth all the way to the sun, killing and protecting, everything is up to you!

title: Legend of Mortal
description: The game world is set in a turbulent state and the mighty Tang-Man declines. The threats from the old enemies keep coming one after another.As a nobody, will you choose either to leave yourself out of it or to fight for Tang-Man's future and turning the tide? The journey of yours,is unpredictable.

title: New Roots
description: In this story-driven pixel game set in a post-global warming world, a young capybara seeks to regrow the extinct native plants of their home with the help of their solarpunk community.

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Legends of Mystery 5
description: An atmosphere of mystery and riddles is already waiting for you in the game "Mystical Legends". 500 amazing pictures of excellent quality will help you feel the world of mysticism.

title: 14 Minesweeper Variants
description: 14 Minesweeper Variants is... well, 14 minesweeper variants. What else would you expect? By the way, guessing is not required in this game.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - Top Gun: Maverick Aircraft Set
description: It's finally happening... A special set in collaboration with the movie Top Gun: Maverick, featuring 6 aircraft (inc. originals), as well as nicknames and emblems. Prepare to pilot new aircraft and take your heroics to new heights!

title: 180 Seconds
description: In the period of 180 seconds you will analyze every object in your house... when the ambulance passes, the thunder, and the ringing of the phone. You live during the time of a pandemic and your mission is to use your real-world knowledge that you have learned about viruses. Would you be infected?

title: 3D Combat Zone
description: In this wireframe graphics FPS game, originally released for the ZX Spectrum in 1983, take on the role of a tank commander in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, struggling to survive against other tanks, deadly flying saucers, and the fearsome super tanks.

title: Accursed
description: Bear your vows in Accursed, a 2D narrative-driven soulslike, hand-drawn in worn fantasy and shades of burning autumn. Bequeathed upon a fading world as a herald of Death, may you find your peace within what remains.

title: Adventures at the North Pole
description: Look for snow-covered tracks, collect evidence at the site of abandoned parking lots, communicate with Eskimo leaders and shamans, and find out what happened to the ship "Silent", its crew and captain.

title: Aierlon
description: Invoke the Gods as you navigate an Ancient Temple in this thrilling First Person Puzzle Platformer

title: Aitta: Finnish folktales
description: Explore and experience the old, lost Finnish folk stories.

title: A Last Will and Testament
description: First-person horror game in an escape room style with nice graphics, inventory, story, voiceover and good price & gameplay. Solve puzzles, collect notes. Fulfill the last will and find a testament.

title: AI Dungeon
description: An AI-powered text-based RPG like you've never played before. Write stories, interact with realistic characters, and experience virtually infinite worlds and genres. Escape to alternate universes where you direct the action and anything is possible!

title: Swallow
description: Swallow is a first-person psychological horror game with a heavy focus on story and exploration. Based on a true story, describe an unsolved case that took place on an isolated island of 20th century England. Players take control of a lighthouse keeper to uncover the truth.

title: Lightworkers
description: A 2D Visual Nove Adventure.

title: Wonderful Waking World
description: A simplistic, dynamic Touhou fangame bullet hell shmup with a pixel art esthetic. Shoot down your enemies and dodge your way through an incessant barrage of projectiles!

title: Boku to Kare no Kiken na Doukyo Seikatsu
Zaxterion: Space Frenzy!
description: Welcome to a high adrenaline arcade space game that offers very addictive and fast paced action! Zaxterion brings 80's old school goodness to modern times for the young and old alike!

title: At the Party
description: Play with friends in person or remotely! A collection of party games to break the ice, have a laugh, and hang out playing. Play on your phones, or on any device with a modern web browser. No need to stream to everyone who is playing!

title: Atomic Escape
description: Uncover a profound secret conspiracy solving puzzles and cracking codes to access the confidential files from a secret space travel project in this first person point and click adventure game set in a beautiful mid century atomic age ranch.

title: Armed Zone
description: Armed Zone is an intensive Third Person Cover Shooter game blended with team tactics and diverse gameplays. Experience the furious combat on ever-changing modern battlefields, you can play both Singleplayer and Multiplayer modes.

title: Arali
description: Fight your way through hordes of enemies, rescue the five forest spirits and bring them back to their tree, and lift the curse plaguing the Enchanted Forest!

title: Animal Sanctuary
description: Create a beautiful nature refuge for all kinds of animals to come and relax in. Give them enough food, water and some toys to play with and see if you can get all the animals to show up!

title: Alien Shooter 2: New Era
description: A desert, an abandoned city, cramped underground corridors of MAGMAs research centers, and for hundreds of kilometers around there is only darkness and thousands of monsters coming from all sides. You have only two options - to achieve your goal or die.

title: Yomawari: Lost in the Dark
description: Another chapter of the atmospheric horror series has emerged from the shadows! Eerie sound design and shadowy environments set the stage for gruesome and terrifying ghosts never seen before in the series.

title: Yakiniku Simulatior
description: Simple and easy game! Just chill out and simulate eating yakiniku!

title: Yonesawara Hospital
description:
Yonesawara Hospital is a single-player exploration horror game from the first-person perspective.
The game focuses on the search for the abandoned hospital "Yonesawara Hospital", and by finding various clues, the truth about what happened at the hospital will be revealed.

title: Car Destroyer
description: Car Destroyer is a pixel racing arena that will make you fight in ruthless wastelands.

title: Byte Lynx
description: Byte Lynx is a sci-fi real-time strategy game with construction-based combat set in the X-736 solar system. Out-maneuver your opponent and make their base your own. Build powerful assault platforms to lay waste to fortified defenses.

title: Bus Driving Sim 22
description: Experience what it feels like to be a real bus driver. Featuring realistic physics, a variety of bus models, three distinct regions to explore (US, Germany, Brazil), authentic traffic and more. Test your skills in career mode, drive freely in freeride or play together with friends in multiplayer.

title: Bunker 22
description: You are a geneticist who woke up in a forest house. Everyone you knew has turned into bloodthirsty zombies, the world is dying out and a secret experiment is to blame. The only way to prevent disaster is to go to an underground laboratory to create a cure and save those who are still alive

title: Call to Arms: Gates of Hell - Talvisota
description: The Talvisota expansion for CtA - GoH offers Finland and the unique northern fighting between 1939 and 1945, including a vast array of weaponry and unique game mechanics. The return of classic skirmishes also expands the Eastern Front with huge, replayable battles with a menacing, revamped AI.

title: Bots Crusher Arena
description: Bot Crusher Arena is an open top-down shooter where the player takes on the role of a cyborg participating in an arena elimination with other cyborgs. The task is to survive in the arena and defeat all enemies. Don't let the enemies hit you.

title: Boxman Adventures
description: Boxman Adventures is a fun platformer game about a friendly box-headed creature. Complete various levels in various different environments, including forests and deserts.

title: Brain Vomits Garden
description: Connect with friends or strangers to explore the vast realm of Brain Vomit. Paint, discover secrets, minigames, sidequests, and drippy apparel in a beautiful, massively multiplayer world.

title: BTank
description: BTank is a game in which you need to destroy balls with different properties using projectiles. By scoring points for destroying the balls, you can get extra lives.

title: Buccaneers Shipshape
description: Beat-‘em-up action on the high seas! Slip into the role of one of four fearless pirates and hack-and-slash your way through waves of enemy hordes, offshore and on a dangerous island in the Caribbean!

title: Bug Dolls: Soviet Project
description: This is a horror game about a small town engulfed in dangerous dolls.

title: Bonfire Peaks: Lost Memories
description: Three chapters of DLC for this critically beloved puzzle game, each with new mechanics and new puzzles.

title: Babysitter Simulator
description: Babysitter Simulator is a casual game which prepares you for mature life! Your mission seems simple at first sight, but it is not so.

title: Bean Story
description: A horror strategy survivor with action and fast Movement Required game. You have a sword which you use to kill enemies and proceed with the story. The goal of the game is to find a way out, survive and find information about your disappearance The game is mostly a wave suvivor game with a story.

title: BioCrisis: Return 2 the Lab
description: The alert has been given, the virus is on the loose, you've escaped the lab, the city will be nuked!

title: Biters & Bullets
description: Kill thousands of zombies, collect loot, and become a lean mean killing machine! Battle and survive hordes of monsters in this high octane casual game with rogue-lite elements. Defeat bosses, hot-wire cars and stack power-ups to infinity. How long will you survive?

title: Bionic Bay
description: An ordinary man in an extraordinary world. Bionic Bay is a new kind of a 2D platformer. It introduces a unique Swap mechanic, allowing players to interact with the physics-based world in new ways. The immersive gameplay is completed by spectacular environments and creative level design.

title: Blast Off Far Away
description: Shoot to move, move to live, live to shoot! Blast Off Far Away (B.O.F.A.) is a space-themed, top-down arena shooter, with a focus on fast-paced arcade-esque gameplay, with the unique twist where movement is limited through the use of the player's gun.

title: Blitz in the Paper Kingdom
description: Blitz in the Paper Kingdom is an indie tower defense game, set in a pop-up sketch book. Players can place automated towers while controlling a character to defeat enemies and defend the king's statues.

title: Blitz Roads
description: Blitz Roads is a futuristic action-packed vehicle combat racing world. Compete in numerous racing tracks with 6 different ways to play. - And test your racing skill with “Challenge Mode”. Start your engines. Ready. Set. Let’s Play!

title: Blocky Dungeon
description: A weird mix of block-placing puzzle and roguelike, where you build a dungeon and explore it at the same time! Defeat enemies, clear lines and collect loot. Explore the different dungeons, complete quests and try to survive as long as you can!

title: Boltcraft
description: Enter an adventure with dynamic combat by choosing a class and specialization, where you can create hundreds of possible combinations of spells to face the enemies of the dungeon. Unlock passive skills for unique perks and gain more power with items you find on your journey.

title: Blazing War
description: The aggressive planets challenged the Earth to a martial arts contest, and each loser would give up a piece of land to the planet for a colony on the other side.Start the game fighting and wipe out all the team members of the other side to be considered the winner!

title: Whore Dealer
description: Whore Dealer is a puzzle game, you only need to swap the bricks to restore the pictures. The game support cheating mode and browsing pictures with one hand so that you can unlock all pictures in just one minute.

title: Withering Rooms
description: Withering Rooms is a 2.5D horror adventure set in a procedurally generated Victorian mansion that changes each night. Sneak through Mostyn House to gather weapons, distractions, magical artifacts, keys, and crafting materials.

title: What Is Love?: Vol. 1
description: What is Love you may ask... Love is a game. Pretty good one actually, full of pretty girls with dark secrets and everything you ever wanted. Love is in the air and you can breathe deeply. And do other stuff. Deeply. But have in mind that your actions matter so Baby, don't hurt me!

title: Wars Across the World: Curupayti 1866
description: This is the complete coverage of the 5 years of the Triple Alliance War opposing Paraguay to the coalition of Argentina, Brazil and Uruguay. e Paraguay strives to capture disputed territories, and then hold them against its powerful neighbours.

title: War Tanks
description: Control the tank and destroy all the enemies. Monitor the condition of the tank's armor and fuel. You can switch between three views: First-person camera, third-person and top view. Minimal interface and understandable for any language.

title: Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature
description: Be a stone Golem and try to save Nature with the help of an adorable Fox! Reconnect ancient sources of energy in environmental puzzles. Discover secrets from a lost civilization and save animals on an emotional quest in a cozy, colorful world.

title: Veggie Menace
description: After a failed spell during a vegetable contest in the Middle Ages, the vegetables come to life and try to invade the civilization. A little witch with her magic powers will need to fight against this invasion.

title: Click Lovers
description: Make full use of your fingers to interact with beautiful girls in various ways~

title: City of Gangsters: Shadow Government
description: Control city politicians and manipulate laws in New York and beyond, in the new expansion pack City of Gangsters: Shadow Government.

title: Chronescher
description: Chronescher is a challenging turn-based puzzle game in Escher-esque spaces. Use impossible geometries, teleportation and environmental snapshots to navigate your mind and uncover your lost memories.

title: Chess vs. Chat
description: Allow your chatters to actively participate and engage with your chess stream simply by typing the moves they would like to see in the chat. :) All without the use of 3th party applications. Includes a highscore, match history, twitch emotes, twitch bot, auto moderating and tons of customization.

description: You have to guess the right move, but you're running out of time. Use the orange pill to get sharp and focus on the right piece. Or use the turquoise pill to chill and slow the time. title: Catastrophe
description: Catastrophe is a minimalist survival experience set in the heart of hell. You wake up in a surreal arena where the monsters of hell are already hunting you down. Without weapons or allies, your only chance is to escape, outwit your enemies, and survive until time runs out.

title: Dorfs: Hammers for Hire
description: A co-op crafting platformer where your friends prove worse than any enemy. Craft weapons and armor from your dwarven workshop, help your patron's army win the battle, and make your way up the Iron Mountain!

title: Drago Noka
description: The surface has become overrun with giant beasts and destructive vermin, leaving an uninhabitable world in their quake. Humans had to get creative and now… they live on the backs of dragons! Gather various materials, create new items, and develop your very own village in Drago Noka!

title: Drunk Games
description: "Drunk Games" is a 2D top down shooter with Battle Royal elements. The player, surrounded by other characters, must collect as many bottles as possible, knocking them out of other drunkards!

description: Dungeonrite is a First Person Dungeon Crawler inspired by the classic RPG's of the 90's. Level up your characters and gear them with the best loot you can buy (or find) as you navigate your way through perilous dungeons filled with enemies and puzzles.

description: She lives alone on a space station. However, nothing prevents this fiery space adventurer from inviting some friends to a raunchy party full of explicit sex and pornography.

title: Dunkeep
description: Combat. Cooking. Crafting. This and so much more in Dunkeep, a casual RPG adventure game mixed with life-sim elements where at night you fight your way through endless dungeons collecting everything you need to run your very own tavern during the day.

title: Dogs Cyberpuzzle
description: A jigsaw puzzle with videos of dogs in a cyberpunk atmosphere. Beat the clock and find out what Kitty's message is.

title: Dis Pontibus 2
description: A single-player game set in a archipelago full of puzzles.

title: Despectum Drakone
description: Despectum Drakone is a turn-based RPG game about rejection and obsession. Equipment can be upgraded with Glyphs and bordures. Humans and agrestes can be recruited as allies during the adventure. The music and artwork are original, created exclusively for Despectum.

description: A narrative driven hacking game that takes you on a journey around murky hacking circles. You will be using the console and graphical tools to hack systems in order to profit and advance the storyline.
