description: Desert Things is a 3D find and click puzzle game in which you have to find some items on the desert location within a certain time.

title: Demon Sword: Incubus
description: Use sword and spell combos to slash and blast through hordes of attacking enemies! Guard break a bosses defenses, find an opening, then obliterate them for good with a well placed super deadly attack! Satisfying 3D side scrolling action with game-play elements inspired by fighting games!

title: Defend the Bits TD
description: An awesome 3D tower defence game created to give you days and days of the most fun TD game in town. Defend from hordes of Blocks with your mighty BIT heroes! armed with bows, axes, cannons and even frying pans.

title: Dead by Daylight: Roots of Dread
description: When the dusk turns full dark, it comes. Dead by Daylight’s Roots of Dread Chapter features a new Killer – The Dredge – and a new Survivor, Haddie Kaur. A new map, the disturbing Garden of Joy, is available for all players.

title: Dancin' Divas
description: A robbery has taken place! Four Diva's from around the world are showcasing their treasures at the local lounge but things have gone south. It's time to fight back!

title: Cyra and the Beacon Path
description: Join Cyra on an intergalactic mission to find her father in this challenging platformer. Journey through seven distinctive and captivating worlds, encounter diverse and quirky new lifeforms, and unravel the mystery of Dr. Kallis’ disappearance.

title: Cut to the Core
description: How much of someone can you cut away before there's nothing left? Find out in this chilling kinetic visual novel - IF YOU DARE!

title: Crusader Kings III: Fate of Iberia
description: The sun-kissed lands of Iberia await your glorious rule with Crusader Kings III: Fate of Iberia flavor pack. Deeply rich in history, culture and people, the peninsula’s medieval destiny is ready to be shaped by your majestic hand, be it clad in conciliatory velvet or as an iron fist.

title: Cryptorig
description: CryptoRIG is a semi-idle server management game focussed on cryptocurrency mining and trading.

title: Cube Decider
description: Cube Decider is a logic puzzle game with RPG elements where you need to make your way through each level collecting power-up and deciding whom and when to attack using your logic and arithmetic skills.

title: Cube Shooter
description: Cube Shooter is a top down arena shooter where players need to dodge and shoot back to pass each level. Shoot your way through levels of 'cube' like enemies who have their own unique abilities to stop you passing each level.

description: Blast through this cultic platformer as a space-faring cultist hellbent on purging the galaxy of heretics! Travel to hazardous planets across the cosmos and eliminate opposing cults with your eldritch blaster.

description: Explore and collect upgrades before the timeloop resets! Collapse Relapse is a 2D platformer where you have to think and plan out your route in order to be able to escape in time, with secrets galore!

title: Cool Kid Cody: Season 1 - Episode 08
description: This DLC gives you access to Season 1 Episode 8: Dead Poet's Propriety! Pizza Boi is a newly ascended Cool Kid. Time to shove it in everyone’s face and get the respect he’s always dreamed of!

title: Cool Kid Cody: Season 1 - Episode 09
description: Episode 9: Freaky Cryday! School Kid Cody is a newly descended Loser. He’d better get his cool back if G-Ma’s gonna let him back in the house!

description: Coral Cove is a relaxing match 3-like underwater game in which you try to build the largest reef without running out of corals to place.

description: First-person action game

title: Entropic Float
description: A free drama-mystery visual novel with a modern fantasy setting. Reach out to the fourteen people trapped inside to find the truth through eighteen endings, influenced by but not exclusively bound to your own system time.

title: Escape Abstraction
description: Escape Abstraction lets you (re)discover 7 abstract paintings in a first person puzzle game. Recompose the painting to escape!

title: Escape the Ether
description: Struggle your way through a gauntlet of 100 intense tests of platforming skills, in this ultimate love letter to the genre. And all this with the use of one hand? Simple to play, impossible to master.

title: Estranged: Arctic Cold
description: Estranged: Arctic Cold follows the story of a fisherman stranded in a mysterious Arctic facility. Experience the rich environments as you venture deeper, and uncover the secrets of the Arctic Cold.

title: Eternal
description: Make History. One man fights for himself. One man fights for all. Be one of the first to experience Eternal, an intoxicating journey into the nature of humanity. Eternal is a ground-breaking fully-animated cinematic masterpiece. 100% Compatible with Steam Deck Gamepad.

title: Eternal Kingdom Battle Peak
description: A "Japanese" MMORPG featuring renowned creators such as Yoshitaka Amano! Travel with your allies through vast fields where weather changes and dungeons where your role is crucial!! PVP is also possible on the field! Establish a legion and join a "Siege" where up to 200 players battle!!

title: Fable of Sand Paws
description: Sand Paw is an adventurous cat who is looking for treasures! Explore the 3D dioramas, rotate the camera to find hidden locations, move blocks and platforms, solve puzzles, find and collect all the lost treasures!

title: Family Battle: Tag Arena
description: A huge fight between the members of the strongest family!? Pave the way to victory with just the two of you! The 2 vs 2 tag-team battle action begins here!

title: Famished Zombies: Decisive Extermination
description: Famished Zombies: Decisive Extermination is a Third-Person Survival Shooter based on Apocalypse days where Zombies are spawned each time when you finish a wave, the more waves you will play , the harder it will be. Play it in multiplayer mode to compete with others players.

title: Farmland Realm
description: The little farm is waiting for you to turn into a Farmland Realm!

title: Find the Cats
description:
Discover adorable cats hidden across charming handcrafted scenes in Find the Cats! Explore colorful environments, sharpen your attention, and find every sneaky little kitty before moving to the next level.

Perfect for casual and cozy game fans, Find the Cats offers a relaxing experience with cute visuals, satisfying discoveries, and plenty of fluffy cats to uncover. Can you find them all?

description: A vertical shoot-em-up by GOTYO.

description: Steiiaria - Endless space lo-fi adventure for all lovers of puzzles and fun! Mahjong, space and planets come together to give you the ultimate gameplay and music enjoyment in this game.

title: Psycho-Jirai In Love
description: A simulation of an outcast romance!

title: The Redress of Mira
description: With a variety of gameplay mechanics, venture through Mira's fantasy world filled with atmosphere and adventure, and pursue her inner peace.

title: Hackerman
description: Joe, an experienced programmer at a reputable technology company, is fired by a director of the company, after having a romantic relationship with the director's wife. Very angry about the situation, Joe starts studying hacking, to get revenge for his firing.

title: PocketCiv
description: A solitaire civilization tabletop game. Plan your moves. Build your empire. Expand your civilization. Try to survive.

title: The Space-Eating Croc
description:
The Space-Eating Croc is a mystery adventure game influenced by classic horror RPG Maker games. Inspect your surroundings to find clues, and solve puzzles to progress.

Explore the mysterious hotel by controlling a mysterious man and a suspicious hotelier. Face the dark truth hidden deep inside the metaphorical spaces within the hotel, and find the monster hidden in between the rifts of space.

title: Midnight Renegade: Recollections
description: A Victorian 2D action platformer where you shoot and slash through grunts until you reach their boss, the Chief Constable.

title: Roast Together
description: A casual game that relies on your drag-and-drop hand speed and simple strategic decisions.

title: Lone Ruin
description: Venture into an old, magical ruin to seek an ancient power in this highly replayable, top-down, roguelike twin-stick shooter. Combine and optimise your spells to defeat twisted monstrosities and dive deeper into the Lone Ruin.

title: Highway Driving
description: Highway Driving is 3D racing game for everyone. Players will be amazed with the overall gaming experience in this game. There are various different tracks and game modes in the game. Players can select many different types of vehicles.

Using artifacts secured during previous hunts, engage in melee combat with the opposing team’s champion. Made by four Drury University students.

description: Thrilling vehicle combat within a musical universe! Face fierce pilots & reach a near unbeatable boss... Train to improve your skills or venture in very diverse challenge areas.

title: Full Void
description:
Set in a dystopian future, Full Void is a 2D cinematic puzzle platformer telling the story of a young teenager alone in a hostile world controlled by a rogue artificial intelligence. Fight your way through puzzles and obstacles to uncover the story that surrounds this broken, crumbling society where only children are still free. But for how long?

A pure hand-drawn pixel-art adventure that will keep you on your toes from the very beginning, with a few jump-scares and a thrilling atmosphere but still suitable for all ages as it does not feature any gore or violence.

Full Void is a spiritual successor to classic cinematic puzzle platformers such as Prince of Persia, Another World (Out of This World) and Flashback, with a modern twist, innovative visual and gameplay mechanics. Along with traditional puzzles, you can use your hacking skills to interact with elements of the game and make your way through this hostile world full of implacable, faceless creatures continuously one step behind you.

description: "Goddess of War Essa II" is a vertical scrolling flight shooting game. The background of the story is World War II. The player controls the protagonist fighter to fight the enemy in the air.

title: Glory's Fools
description: A retro RPG set in the mythic Age of Greece. Find allies, choose your path to glory, fighting monsters, men, or even Gods and become a true hero!

title: Grandma
description: Join the battle to save earth from aliens and robots. Choose to play on the side of humans or aliens in battle.

title: Gorilla Soccer
description: A new type of VR sports competitive game. Your can play football (soccer) as a gorilla! The locomotion is inspired by gorilla tag. You can run, jump, and hit the ball using only your hands. You can not only play with bots, but also play with other players.

title: Golazo! 2
description: Golazo! 2 boldly recalls the glory days of the arcade soccer games, bringing back memories of cult classics we all know. Street mechanics and fields are added to this sequel to bring more depth to this game. Certainly a perfect game for people who are wary of football managers or complicated hard-core simulators. You just grab your controller, sit on the couch and play!

title: Memory Hunters
description: A classic RPG where you will experience unique places, solve puzzles, fight turn-based battles and live an exciting adventure.

title: Memory Puzzle: Futanari Mistress
description: Train your brain with this memory game, revealing the naughty sexual adventures of a young girl and her Futanari Mistress, in images hidden behind pairs of cards which you have to match. Flip two cards, and if the words on them match, they will be removed from the board, revealing a unique image.

description: We have made changes in the differentiation of roles. Only one role has an armor, and the other roles have their unique defense means. And the roles will be very different. Unexpectedly, the energy of one role will not be restored every round. How does he fight?

description: Bob and weave through hordes of corrupt robots and hold them back with your trusty turrets! Mechabot Defender is a casual sci-fi arcade game with rogue-lite elements. Upgrade your turrets separately in unique ways, use unique character abilities, and create powerful synergies.

description: Seriously all you do is beat your meat.

description: Master key is a top down adventure game with a strong focus on item based exploration and secrets. Embark on a journey to discover what that key could be used for and meet colorful characters !

title: China: Mao's Legacy - Homeland or Death
description: Che Guevara's legacy is as living as Mao's. Intervene in the history of the South American states, change their destiny, show them the right path. But at the same time, do not forget your home, where you will now be able to make many more flexible decisions.

title: Outside the Window
description: Outside the Window is a simple pile of pixel houses game, you need to build up your own pixel cityscape piece by piece, after that, quietly admire their results to relax.

description: Operation Defensive is a tower defense game but instead of monsters following a track they follow a player. place down towers to fight those monsters and try to get to the highest wave you can! have fun!

description: Welcome in this tower defense game, welcome in Obelixes Tower Defense. In this game, you have to stop waves of enemies with the help of ancient obelixes which attack hostile creatures.

description: Nude In The Castle is a third person game where you play as a sexy girl who is trying to save her castle from perverts. Armed with a sharp ax, cut and kill the dirty perverts who have captured this castle.

description: A charming puzzle game about moving clouds, combining and walking on them to gather the lost star shards across the skies.

title: Notice Me, Leena-Senpai!
description: Oh no! The Demon Lord is attacking! Help Leena-senpai defend her town against a horde of demon lord goons!

description: Nine Lives or Less is a rogue-like action game about a cat going on an adventure with a special jetpack.

description: Neon Invaders will take you back to your gaming roots with its constant action and relentlessly brutal enemies. Absorb enemy shots of the same colour to trigger a flurry of fire to decimate the alien invaders. Dodge and Match your way to victory through 40 levels and 5 difficulty settings.

description: Project Timi: Sasha's Curse is a 3D rhythmic puzzle-packed action game mashup. Use the rhythm of the music to activate magic traps, fight nightmare creatures, explore the dream worlds and unveil all the secrets that are hidden in Lucity Town.

title: PSI Masquerade
description: PSI Masquerade, an online action fighting death game for both PC and smartphone.

title: Purrrfect Love
description: Sometimes she's naughty and sometimes she's cute... sometimes she's sexy and enthralling to boot. Create your own story of true, throbbing love... A beautiful, visual novel of love... straight from the soul. You're just dying to get those heartstrings plucked, aren't you?

If you score enough points, you get an additional plane. Minimal interface and understandable for any language.

Put your combat skills to the test in this fast paced FPS. Resist and rebel against a rogue AI, will you conquer and reclaim or perish?

Forged to challenge your skills in a fast, fluid movement shooter. While facing a rogue AI and hordes of robots in a single player story. Fight in increasingly complex arenas while continuously expanding your arsenal.

Boho Koumakyou 2 is a free roaming, two dimensional platformer games with an emphasis on an exploratory action-adventure structure. title: Bouhou Youyoumu
description: Bouhou Youyoumu is a dungeon exploring action platformer, sequel to Bouhou Koumakyou ~Scarlet Family~, developed by Marokaka.

description: Flooded is a reversed city-builder, in which you need to optimize your production on an island that shrinks over time. Gather enough resources to flee to safety, while the surrounding world is getting flooded.

description: Play your way into the history books! Updates to your favorite modes deliver all-new ways to control your impact with every decision. Call the shots in Franchise, establish a legacy in Face of the Franchise: The League, and dominate in Madden Ultimate Team.

Equipped with the ability to bend time, they face hostile creatures, solve puzzles and explore the Realm of Time in an adventure rogue-like where time is your weapon.

description: Welcome to a true 80's trash horror experience. This collection has 8 short horror games that you can freely choose which one you want to play.

description: In Starless, navigate a space Ark infested with terrifying monsters in this stealth-action game inspired by classic sci-fi. Can you help the colonists survive, or will they be doomed to roam the endless void of space forever?

title: World of Cube
description: A first-person puzzle game. Explore the world of cube and solve the puzzles.

title: Tower Escape
description: Escape the tower by summoning minions and guiding them to the exit! Tower Escape is a "Reverse Tower Defense" game where you guide a snake through a maze, then your minions follow it as they pick up treasure and keys to the next level.

title: The Trials of Beadie
description: The Trials Of Beadie is a 2D side scrolling platformer that relies on precision playing mechanics such as run, jump, wall jump, dash, fast fall, hover, and wall grab. Play for fun or speed run as fast as you can. You can die as many times as you like, but there are no save points and no continues.

title: Topo Mix Game
description: Only you can help Yuri Dimitrov regain his lost honor in this 8-bit adventure.

title: Paws for Adventure
description: Hunt, Fight and Meow your way to saving the cat colonies. A purrrfect adventure for cat lovers.

title: Just Another Runner
description: Take a quick enigmatic run up memory lane. Don't even think about slowing down, 'cause the present surely won't.

title: Sugarcreek
description: Sugarcreek is a 2D story-based adventure game following Eddie the high-school goat and his closest friends as they try to find his missing stepsister before the week is over!

title: Trespasser 2
description: A first-person action horror game about breaking into your enemy's house and seeking vengeance for the torment you have received in your past.

title: Tales of the Death
description: Join a comic adventure in a hand-drawn book with a life of its own. Rearrange the panels of an animated comic to reveal the stories of the world of The Death.

title: The Abandoned Planet
description: When a wormhole tears open in space, an astronaut is hurled down and crashes on a distant planet. But where is she? Where are all the inhabitants of the planet? And how is she going to get back home? Solve the puzzle and piece together the mystery in this 2D, pixel art, first person, point and click adventure.

title: The Rabbit's Scroll
description: Play as a rabbit ascending up a paper scroll, scrambling to escape a rampaging wall of deadly ink. Can you ensure your beautiful world won't be erased from the history books?

title: Madman Catcher
description: "Madman Catcher" is a classic 2D platform game. The main goal is to get pills of the right color from scattered first-aid kits. Just beware of the mentally ill patients, they are not very happy with your work (that`s why they ran away and do not want to return).

title: Penguins Can Fly
description: An indie penguin simulation game where you upgrade your igloo to make it the coolest igloo ever, create power stations on the outskirts of your island to generate power and money, and eventually launch yourself to the moon to prove that penguins can indeed fly!

title: Pirates Things
description: Pirates Things is a 3D find and click puzzle game in which you have to find some items on the tropic town location within a certain time.

title: Like Dreamer
description: A pop and cute bullet-hell shooting game from Cosmo Dreamer "Outside". Both beginners and experts can enjoy speedy and active playing.

title: Plank Builders
description: “Plank Builders” is a peaceful construction game. Magical marbles have the ability to make stuffed toys come alive. Together with the stuffed toys, the player can plan and construct different buildings made out of small wooden planks.

title: Lightphobe
description: Beware of the darkness... Lightphobe is an asymmetrical team-based PVP game that blends stealth action with fast-paced shooter gameplay. Pick a side and work together as a team to emerge victorious!

title: Placid Plastic Duck Simulator
description: The ultimate high-tech rubber duck simulation, Placid Plastic Duck brings you dangerous levels of relaxation. With chill music, dreamy 3D graphics, and many different happy ducks, your only priority is to float around. Zero Ducks given.

title: Tad the Lost Explorer and the Emerald Tablet
description: Your favourite explorer, Tad Stones is back! Embark with Tad and his friends on a new journey through different cities where you will encounter challenging puzzles in your quest to get the emerald tablet.

title: My Dream is a Lost Memory
description: My dream is a Lost Memory is a short interactive story about having Déjà vu, realizing that this Déjà vu came to you because of a dream, and then wondering if that dream is actually a memory. It's a story about work, limitations and self-respect.

title: Lost Bits
description:
Lost Bits is a 2.5D retro platformer where you join M1L0 on his quest for the Great Legume.

Help M1L0 play through some old PC games on his quest to find the Great Legume!
lost bits is a 2.5D action platformer with charming graphics and a retro aesthetic. Explore a sunken battleship, grapple through a construction site, and fight the computer's operating system in this short game

title: The Sand Knight
description: Kill your foes and power up your mech in this combat-heavy game of destruction and mayhem. Maneuver around the battlefield, avoiding enemy fire while dishing it out in kind.

title: Junior Solutions
description: Junior Solutions us a Sci Fi 3D graphic adventure. Where the player will travel in the multiverse solving conflicts of the different civilizations that inhabit each world and making hard choices along the way resolving mind bending puzzles.

title: Space Maxwell: Arcade
description: Shoot your enemies and try not to let them multiply themselves and turn the game into a chaotic space battle! Space Maxwell is an arcade shooter where your spaceship has the ability to destroy or to multiply your enemies. Climb the leaderboard and try to survive as long as you can!

title: Tavernacle!
description: Grab your hammers and start to craft in this co-op Tavern Defense for one to four players. As a team of Dwarves, you must gather supplies and build towers to protect your beloved brewery. Explore the world and learn to cooperate to achieve victory in this chaotic multiplayer game!

title: Tiny Robo Puzzles
description: Tiny Robo Puzzles Contains 4 Tiny Sokoban Style Puzzle Games that you can enjoy!

title: Spintales
description: The world has succumbed to the curse of gold. You too, start to feel the drag of it... Can you cleanse the world of the curse, once and for all? Pick up your sword and shield, and venture into a unique roguelike adventure!

title: Stack by Stack
description: Stack by stack is a tower defense game where you have to stop evil cunning robots from stealing the core! Craft towers from enemy robot parts, Printing new metal parts for towers on 3D printers, Mining ore, Shooting. Almost all objects in the game can be carried in a stack on your hands

title: Svarog's Dream
description: Awaken as a soul from the Underworld. Discover who you are and explore an ever-changing open world full of mystery. Fight the beasts and gods or ally with them. Die and be reborn in this unforgettable adventure.

title: Tales of Aravorn: An Elven Marriage
description: In the first spin-off of the VN/RPG Loren The Amazon princess, play as Elenor or Saren again and travel to Triberg to make sure that the arranged elven marriage between Lydia and Marian goes smoothly. Be careful: the demons are planning something...

title: Tightrope Theatre
description: Tightrope Theatre is now hiring daredevils! Hop on a shaky unicycle and complete increasingly dangerous tightrope acts! Do you have what it takes to become a superstar?

title: Prince of Persia Franchise
description: A bundle containing all of the mainline Prince of Persia titles released since Ubisoft took over the franchise.

title: GrappleWell
description: GrappleWell is a physics based rage game that will have you climbing up from the bottom of a well using your grapple hook.

title: Hamster on Rails
description:
“Hamster on Rails” is a 3D puzzle Nintendo-like rail builder game, bringing a relaxing experience, featuring popular concepts such as: Mine Wagons and Hamsters.

Travel through different worlds, building crazy railways to solve fun puzzles and thus making it possible to extract mineral resources to save the beloved people of the hamster village.

title: Hardenville
description: A 20-year-old guy studying at the Hardenville University, suddenly has important decisions ahead of him. This adult virtual novel is filled with amazing girls, nudity, drama, romance, moral choices and sex.

title: Heart Lake
description: Heart Lake is a first-person pixel-style game. Different personalities have different and distinct personalities. Players experience different journeys in the process of getting along with different personalities, and finally help the protagonist grow up.

title: Last Time I Saw You
description:
Last Time I Saw You is a coming-of-age narrative adventure about first loves and acceptance. An uplifting story, rich with complex characters, set in a vibrantly imagined vision of late 80s Japan.

Join Ayumi on an exciting tale of self-discovery in which he'll face his first tentative steps into adulthood and confront the terrible curse that has fallen upon his hometown.

title: Last Monarch
description: You are the Demon Lord Kuro on a mission to protect demonkind. Use your abilities to capture and ensnare others. Tumble with different personalities in this 2D rogue-lite shooter!

title: Learn Japanese RPG: Hiragana Forbidden Speech
description: Dialogue changes from English to Japanese as you learn and progress in this comedic RPG backed by professional Japanese voice acting. This is a full introductory Japanese course and adventure all in one. Master hiragana, basic grammar, and over 240 common words used in anime!

title: Plane Attack
description: Control an airplane with a third-person view, and your task is to destroy all enemy equipment on the battlefield. Stock up on armor and fuel to last longer on the battlefield. The plane is equipped with an endless supply of missiles and bombs. Minimal interface and understandable for any language.

title: Pixel Survivors: Roguelike
description: A rogue-lite game where you must face hundreds of monsters with increasingly difficult bosses that strong enough to take you down. Choose your abilities, build your favorite combat style, become stronger and survive as long as you can!

title: Paper Ghost Stories: Third Eye Open
description: Third Eye Open is a third person narrative adventure rendered in a distinctive "paper theatre" aesthetic. Set in early 2000s Malaysia, the player takes the role of Ting, a young girl trying to come to terms with the burgeoning power inside her.

title: Parabellum Galaxia
description: Prepare for war in this VR Space Strategy Simulator. Design your ships, complete your missions, defeat your enemy.

title: Paradox of Hope VR
description: Paradox of Hope is an immersive single-player VR shooter with survival and horror elements. Explore mysterious metro mazes of post-apocalyptic Moscow, use stealth or combat approach to achieve your goal, upgrade your equipment and arsenal, and enjoy the atmospheric moments of stalker’s life.

title: Phantom Tentacle
description: Phantom Tentacle is a story decryption game! The sealed ghost tentacles descended on the town again. Players will play ghost tentacles, attacking lone villagers, capturing nuns, and sneaking to escape from the hunters of knights. Finally rule the whole town!

title: Paper Flight: Super Speed Dash
description: Paper Flight – Super Speed Dash is an interactive game experience that is designed to ease your mind and have fun popping innocent balloons. You jump into the role of a little paper plane that is supposed to rescue the world from little but evil balloon demons by dashing through them.

title: Paper Flight: Speed Rush
description: Paper Flight – Speed Rush is an interactive game experience that is designed to ease your mind and have fun popping innocent balloons. You jump into the role of a little paper plane that is supposed to rescue the world from little but evil balloon demons by dashing through them.

title: Panty Load
description: Casual arcade gameplay with a twist! You want, no you need to get off. Can you avoid life's obstacles for the ultimate reward. Get your load into your panty by any means necessary! Humorous in game achievements! Multiple visual endings not for the faint of heart! Don't take life so seriously!

title: Mystery Solitaire: Cthulhu Mythos
description: Solve the most mystical layouts you've ever seen!

title: My Furry Protogen
description: When your fate is determined by the universe itself, you don’t have many options. You can either oppose it until the very end or accept it for the rest of your life, but neither choice can change your destiny.

title: Mugsy & Mugsy's Revenge
description:
Bundles two business simulation games published in the 1980s by Melbourne House.

As a Chicago mob boss at the start of Prohibition, you must make tough decisions to manage your crime empire. How many hoods to employ? How many clients to squeeze? How much to kick back to the cops? Don't be a schmuck, or you'll find yourself at the wrong end of a Chicago Typewriter.

title: In Your Books
description: In Your Books is an adventure game where you play the granddaughter of a bookseller. After her disappearance you'll have to take the place of your grandmother. Recommend books, learn to know the locals, solve secret mechanisms and discover where she left.

title: Kaichu: The Kaiju Dating Sim
description: Kaichu is a dating sim about kaiju! You play the role of Gigachu, a gigantic romantic looking for love. Meet 6 other eligible kaiju and visit 24 famous landmarks where Gigachu will answer challenging compatibility questions to decide the fate of your relationship.

title: Kamifuda
description: Master the eldritch art of Kamifuda—channeling long dead powers within arcane cards—in this visual novel and deck builder game.

title: Keita's Adventures on the African Savannah
description: It tells the story of a young African boy, Keita, who follows migratory animals from the Serengeti National Park to the Masai Mara game Reserve to seek medicine for his family. On the way, he encounters dangerous wildlife.

title: Kittens in Post-Apocalyptic Fantasy San Francisco: Battle School for Only the Most Awesome Monsters
description: Save a fallen land from despair and doom via recruiting and training adorable but deadly (and awesome) monsters!

title: Kogarashi
description: Kogarashi is a 3D Hack N' Slash game on which you control Abura Akago, a fire demon that fights against the evil spirit Yuki Onna and her army of ice demons.

title: Life is Paradise
description: "Life is Paradise" is an RPG life management simulation game with a high degree of freedom, where you can build your own village, breed livestock, venture into mines, and make friends with all kinds of people! As the protagonist, you can do whatever you want here!

title: Link the Cubes
description: Link The Cubes is a relaxing puzzle game with cute little cubes. Solve the puzzle levels by connecting the cubes and moving them to the goal.

title: Long Drop
description: By the power of POOP! Solve challenging puzzles in this medieval-themed casual puzzler. Unlock new poops and harness their power to overcome the challenges of the Long Drop.

title: Lost Alone: Ep.3 - Granny
description: Responsible for the deaths of his girlfriend and sister, George is an alcoholic with a stormy past. Raised by a serial killer, George's life ends in suicide. But his story starts right from the end...

title: Lustful Pussies
description: In Lustful Pussies, you play in third person as John, who has fallen asleep and is dreaming. In this dream, he is the hero of a real action movie! He has to take the Dildo Gun and shoot back from the crowds of excited women who want to beat and fuck William.

title: Mr. Triangle's Maze
description: Escape a sinister maze and take on the Maze Masters in this retro styled puzzle game!

title: The Questing
description: The Questing is an action-RPG game set in the fantasy world. You can grow by hunting enemies using various weapons and skills that you like. Also, feel free to explore the wide world, discover new towns and cities, and take quests from NPCs around the world to solve them.

title: The Last Starship
description: Introversion Software, the indie legends behind Prison Architect, Darwinia, DEFCON and Uplink, present to you the broken, unfinished and bug filled Alpha of The Last Starship. Pick a ship hull, kit her out with engines, life-support, sensors and rail guns and start your galactic adventure!

title: The Gallery
description: The Gallery is a first-person puzzle game where every painting holds a secret. Explore a mysterious art museum, solve observation-based riddles, and unlock new rooms by deciphering clues hidden within the artwork. Will you uncover the truth behind the gallery?

title: The Chronicle
description: After receiving a package in the mail, Detective Walter Miles is suddenly transported to a World War II Era newspaper building. Can you solve the mystery and escape?

title: Tales From The Under-Realm: After Midnight
description: A gothic visual novel full of intrigue and romance

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Kenya
description: Puzzles of Kenya!

title: Sunwave Hotel
description: Dive into a sexy sci-fi adventure that combines Point and Click with Dialogue Choices. After crash landing during a dangerous job, you and your partner must get back on your feet. Along the way, you'll solve problems and meet new friends to help you before your luck finally runs out.

title: Genopanic
description: Genopanic is a pixel-art, Metroidvania-inspired adventure-platformer. Explore corridors of the space station, teeming with secrets and dangers, and engage in boss fights. Solve puzzles and uncover hidden mysteries in the dark atmosphere of a sci-fi research complex. Discover the truth with each step.

title: Arma 3 Apex Edition
description: Experience the best military sandbox game the PC has to offer with the Arma 3 Apex Edition, which includes the Arma 3 base game, the highly-rated Arma 3 Apex expansion, and a variety of other DLC packs containing a number of additional weapons, vehicles, gear, and scenarios.

title: Beetlebum
description: Insect-themed classic survival horror demo with pre-rendered backgrounds.

title: Wani Wani Picnic
description:
Guide Ally the hungry gator to the picnic. If any baddies get in your way, it's ok, just gobble 'em up! But something tells me Ally might get full before she reaches her goal!

Wani Wani Picnic was created as part of the gamejam, a game by its cover 2015. It is based on the cartridge art created by happymappyart (formerly mandimandi) for Famicase 2015.

title: Pixies 'n Crafts
description:
Pixies 'n Crafts is a 2D platform game with crafting elements.

In it you take on the role of the King, who deploys his energy in the form of adorable creatures to help you escape a terrible monster.

Deep in an unknown universe, there was this monster, which devoured all the matter that was in front of it. He was insatiable, and she never stopped eating. After an era of destruction, unable to take it anymore, something that could perhaps be called “the good essence” of the creature to separate itself from this entity and escaped inside, creating its own world, where its other part would find it. This planet was totally different from the others, there was life, and life cooperated with the development of this planet. Then the creator creature split into several parts, giving way to an intelligent civilization that would further prosper this place. The monster spent years hunting this part and the planet, as it was weakened without its other part.

title: X-Plane 11: Skyline Simulations - KAST: Astoria Regional Airport
description: Fly above Astoria and enjoy the night view with perfect landmarks like the Astoria Column, the Light House and the famous Megler Bridge!

title: Skies of Blue: Remake
description: Skies Of Blue Remake is a First Person Puzzle Platformer in that you go from level to level. Collect all Collectables, complete all levels and build your own in the custom level editor!

title: Our Wonderland
description: A horror-fantasy visual novel about five childhood friends returning to the wish-granting wonderland of their youth. This is the remastered version with updated art and features releasing in 2026.

title: Distraction Machine
description: Welcome to Island City, an isolated metropolis filled with undead feeders and survivors battling over what few safe havens remain. You are The Distractor - a warrior bard wielding the power to soothe the living and control the undead. But will your music save your people or lead them to ruin?

title: The Dead Rooms
description: The Dead Rooms is an immersive horror experience with Roguelike elements. Can you survive? Explore a never ending world of rooms, as you push further into the Dead Rooms, trying to find what supplies you can and avoiding the monsters that call this place home.

title: ColdFortune
description: Coldfortune is a third-person survival adventure game from developer Frostware. Its exploration sequences use fixed-camera perspectives for a moody view of the world ahead, and when the action heats up, expect dangerous gunplay and cinematic hand-to-hand QTE combat.

title: BPM Boy
description: BPM Boy is a physics-based platformer, with influences from games like Marble Madness, Super Monkey Ball, deBlob and Crystal Castles. BPM Boy features multiple routes, hidden secrets, and an original soundtrack driven by RetroNinja's Dynamic Music & Sound Regulator (DMSR). The funky grooves change and react to how you play.

title: Vacation Island
description: Vacation Island is a short reverse-horror game, with a tiny open world to explore and dark secrets to uncover. Made in 14 days for the 2022 Spring 32bits Jam.

title: Deadlink
description: Deadlink is a cyberpunk FPS with roguelite elements. You're the first operative to be recruited to the experimental Deadlink project. Pilot an autonomous combat shell, fighting your way through cramped slums, twisted labs, grimy warehouses, and sleek office buildings on a mission to thwart the schemes of the most powerful corporations in the world. Wield a deadly arsenal, upgrade your skills and tech, devastate destructible environments, and slash corporate profit margins — all at the same time.

title: Mogu-mogu Rumia
description: A doujin game by Top Arts plan based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Maid Made Maze
description: A doujin game by Top Arts plan based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: West Balkans
description:
Discover, deliver and expand your trucking company to the countries of Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Kosovo, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia, and Slovenia.

From large bustling cities to the countryside filled with beautiful nature, you will be able to explore what the Western Balkans have to offer.

You can look forward to many new things that these countries have to offer. Whether in terms of the industry, nature, landmarks, road networks, or a lot of other exciting content!

title: Rhythm Banki
description: A doujin game by Kyuushoku Touban based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Extreme Bankikki
description: A doujin game by Kyuushoku Touban based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Cirno's Strongest Shaved Ice Operation!
description: A doujin game by Kyuushoku Touban based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Ojou-sama no Doki-doki Daisakusen: Norowareta Kurenai no Yakata
description: Ojou-sama no DokiDoki Daisakusen is a fan-made Touhou Project platform action game, developed by BlueMica. It features Remilia Scarlet as the protagonist and Flandre Scarlet as the second protagonist. Saigyouji Yuyuko is also a playable character.

title: Magical Stick Girl Miracle Kurun Survival!
description: Magical stick girl Miracle Kurun Survival! is a doujin shoot-em-up developed by Desunoya Games.

title: Gran Empire: Amane
description: My love in this world, let us defeat the devil! The story of an incompetent warrior's adventure.

title: Roasting Report: A Professor Murder
description: Limited time, clear reasoning! A mystery game to find out the truth about the murder of a university professor.

title: That Summer
description: This world's most beautiful girl, visual noble. His fate is determined by his choice.

title: Don't Toy With Me
description:
For a long time now, Dahlia has lived by herself in the Dollhouse with only the stuffed rabbit Wisker for company. One day the owner of the toys decides to present her with a new companion, a sad clown puppet named Huxley. She's delighted for the company but, as the owner soon realizes, it's not so simple to introduce a new friend to the household.

What happens when you play favorites? Are you really in control of the Dollhouse? Or are the toys about to get out of hand

title: Knights of the Deep
description: Knights of the Deep is an online, action-packed arena fighting game with crustaceans. Choose your favorite brawler from the seas and duke it out against each other using a variety of weapons and special abilities. Each crustacean has a unique playstyle, learn them all and climb the hierarchy!

title: 3D Puzzle: Japan
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful house.

title: Try Me
description: Try Me is a 3D Platform game where moving a ball to a floating square has never been more difficult. This game is completely torque based and all about momentum.

title: Necrosmith
description: A necromancer simulator. Assemble the dead using different body parts while upgrading your tower, combine the abilities of the different fantastic races to fight your way through the hordes of enemies and overrun the ’chosen ones’. To tell the truth, the dead are pretty, uhm, dumb.

title: Putinator
description: The Russian army tried to clone their leader, thus resulting in a never ending mindless horde of Putin zombies... In this retro inspired shooter you take the role of a soldier sent as clean up crew to a town on the outskirts of Chernobyl, with one mission. Kill all Putin zombies.

title: The Way of the Badass
description: Join Scarlet, Princess of Badass, in her crusades against the takeover of aliens, monsters, hybrids, and "Cancel Culture" as she brings toughness back to humanity. Lead desperate allies, from a Nazi to a hobo and other Special Ed students, in liberating humankind from the satire of the Far Left.

title: SailSim
description: This sailing simulator applies actual physics to simulate the behavior of a sailing vessel. This means you can actually capsize or sink a vessel if you are not careful. In some cases the simulator can even reproduce unpredictable results based on your actions, selected parameters and conditions.

title: Paranoya
description: This is a liminal horror game where you are sent to supernatural dimensions, you must defeat the demon and his workers though multiple levels to escape and go back to your normal life.

title: Mischief Dungeon Life
description: “Mischief Dungeon Life" is an isekai fantasy novel game in which Renji is reborn in another world as a demon. He encounters various heroines while playing a big role in the fates of both the Demon Clan and the Human Tribe.

title: Dino Tales
description:
Dino Tales is a colourful adventure game where players explore a world of dinosaurs and interactive stories.

Create your own story from your adventures, discover prehistoric creatures, and unlock new tales as you explore exciting environments filled with puzzles, characters, and surprises.

Perfect for younger players and families, Dino Tales combines exploration, storytelling, and playful discovery in a friendly prehistoric world.

title: Firegirl: Hack 'n Splash Rescue DX
description: Take on the role of a young rescue officer starting her career. Armed with a trusty axe and high-pressure fire hose that also acts as a jetpack, Firegirl responds to emergency calls across the city.

title: Tiny Island
description: Meditative and fluffy God simulator in VR wherein you will help tiny people with chopsticks!

title: Trainz Plus
description: Drive, Explore, Operate and Create the railroad of your dreams - and now collaborate in real time with Multiplayer Surveyor! And with Trainz Plus memberships, you get more content, more features and the latest Trainz has to offer!

title: Trainz Plus: Victorian Railways V class FL Black
description: Drive the Victorian Railways V class steam locomotive, painted in a freelance black livery with 3 levels of weathering.

title: Eins Ring
description: A doujin game by ZWEi based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Polar Bear Riding A Ninja
description: Endless runner with roguelite elements. throw pineapples to defeat enemies while running away from a polar bear riding a ninja. Chose items to throw better, jump higher and defend yourself.

title: Ukraine Defense Force Tactics
description:
Ukraine Defense Force Tactics is a turn-based tactics game in which you lead a small force of Ukrainian units fighting against a seemingly endless deluge of Russian invaders. You will have to outsmart and outmaneuver an overwhelming force of enemies using combined infantry-and-armor tactics and an array of special Stratagems.
Your goal is to destroy as many enemies as possible before needing to retreat your forces. By defeating enemies you gain Glory which then can be used to upgrade your units and unlock new ones.

title: Toaru Pantsu no Railgun
description: An action doujin game based on Toaru Kagaku no Railgun. Developed and published by Werk.

title: Leap of Phase: Samantha
description:
Leap of Phase is a first-person puzzle game. You will need to solve puzzle rooms by utilizing personal teleporter units. Place up to three of these at any time you want.

You thought it would be the chance of a lifetime when tech giant IRT hired you to work in their new testing facility. But now… you’re a guina pig for experimental teleporting technology and suspect that something is wrong with this company. Very wrong...

title: Remedium
description: The fast-paced twin-stick shooter game in the grim post-apocalyptic Renaissance setting. It had been more than a hundred years since the terrible plague devoured the whole Europe and turned almost everyone there in the maddened mutants.

title: Don't Get Distracted
description: Don't Get Distracted is a horror themed rage game. Stay focused, pay attention and you might live to see another day. Good Luck

title: Space Rescue
description: Space Rescue is a special space adventure game.You will navigate a tiny spaceship to slip into the puzzle where the Energy Spinels hidden. They have to glide up and down, avoiding a series of obstrucles, and eventually carry the Spinels back to their mother planet.

title: The Swordbearer
description: Take on the role of a young adventurer who recently inherited a sword. Your journey starts after you apply to the Knights Guild at the capital. Meet loveable characters as you explore this world that awaits you. Face the darkness that surfaces and uncover the evil plot as your story progresses.

title: Thnt
description: You've woken up in an artificial body on a strange and hostile world. Can you uncover its secrets and fight your way out? Take part in a metal fueled FPS single-player campaign that combines frantic action with tactical decision-making.

title: Thrill Penguin
description: crazy parkour game with No cycles, No texts, No complicated weird mechanics, Just have fun and get the thrill now !!

title: River Bones
description:
You float down the river. You remember:

The Hotel, The Town, The Parking Lot, The Lake, The Fire, The Chase.

title: Wands Alliances
description: Wands Alliances is a 3v3, competitive, team-based, multiplayer VR gaming experience where players engage in fast-paced magic duels. Select your class, choose your spells, and take the fight to the streets. Taste sweet victory by completing your team’s objectives or eliminating the opposing team. But duck and dodge too slowly, and the only thing you’ll be eating are fireballs.

title: The Last of Us Part I
description:
Experience the emotional storytelling and unforgettable characters of Joel and Ellie in The Last of Us, winner of over 200 Game of the Year awards and now rebuilt for PlayStation 5.

Enjoy a total overhaul of the original experience, faithfully reproduced but incorporating modernized gameplay, improved controls and expanded accessibility options. Plus, feel immersed with improved effects and enhanced exploration and combat.

It also includes the Left Behind story DLC.

title: Basket Random
description: Basket Random! Basketball is here with its most funny and random way. In Basket Random game, try to score a basket by using only one key with different variations from each other! Changing fields, changing players and changing balls do not surprise you! You can be the best of them all. You can play Basket Random game either against CPU or against a friend in 2 player gaming mode! The one who reaches 5 score first, wins the game. Have Fun!

title: Aliens: Dark Descent
description: Drop into the gripping journey of Aliens: Dark Descent, a squad-based, single-player action game in the iconic Alien franchise. Lead your soldiers in real-time to stop a new and terrifying kind of Xenomorph outbreak on Planet Lethe.

title: Fort Solis
description: Fort Solis is a single player third person thriller set on the far side of Mars. Engineer Jack Leary responds to a routine alarm. Upon arriving at a dormant Fort Solis he becomes unnerved by the lack of any staff at the base. As the night grows longer events begin to unravel and spiral out of control. The mystery of what Fort Solis was created for starts to appear along with its crew. Can Jack escape with what he has discovered and more importantly, his life?

title: Nurtopu: Fetö ile Mücadele
description: For a long time, Fetö has been a problem for İsmail, the art teacher. Ismail seeks revenge, but unlike Wolverine, he does not want to get his hands dirty. Therefore, he reads the Risale-i Nur and prays at home. Nurtopu, İsmail's female rabbit, decides to do something about this and goes on a great adventure. At this point, you, the player, must control Nurtopu to put an end to Fetö and avenge İsmail.

title: Stormgate
description: Stormgate is a free-to-play, next-gen RTS from the team at Frost Giant Studios, including former developers of Warcraft III and StarCraft II. Command mechs to defend the Earth or invade it as one of two other invading alien factions. Explore an ever-evolving campaign storyline, group up for co-op missions, or compete in 1v1. Now in Early Access since August 13th.

title: Highwater
description: Highwater is a story-driven 3D adventure game with isometric turn-based combat set in a flooded post-apocalyptic urban environment. Navigate the world by boat, discover islands, and find new allies to help battle foes in turn-based combat.

title: Goat Simulator 3
description: Pilgor’s baaack! Gather your herd and venture forth into Goat Simulator 3; a totally realistic, sandbox farmyard experience. Invite up to three friends in local or online co-op, create carnage together, or compete in mini-games and then not be friends.

title: Warframe: The Duviri Paradox
description: A Mad King, a mysterious Drifter, and a color-shifting unreality as sublime as it is deadly combine in the latest addition to Warframe’s ever-expanding universe, The Duviri Paradox!

title: Humankind: Cultures of Latin America
description: The Humankind Cultures of Latin America DLC includes:- 6 New Cultures - 6 New Wonders- 9 Independent Peoples- 15 Narrative Events- 30+ New in-game themed music tracks composed by Arnaud Roy

title: Steel Guardian
description: Explore, loot, discover and fight!

title: Unrooted
description: You were sent in a problematic area to soothe the earth, using rudimentary equipment you are tasked with destroying the machines hurting the environment and help the area by putting down fire, get rid of pollution and soothing the trees.

title: Time Flies
description: This whimsical game is part open world and part flight simulator – and you play it as a fly! You are provided with a bucket list that you can complete before you die. But the life of a fly is short – and the list is long! Go ahead and learn an instrument, become rich, read a book, go on tour, find yourself, get drunk, make someone laugh or enter the art world! And if you don’t feel like pursuing your life goals, just hang, clean your wings, listen to music or watch television. Make the best of the time you have! Because we are all going to die.

title: FarmingCat
description: You're a cat in a world of islands. You can explore, craft, cook, build, destroy, collect drops and discover items of old ancestors. Don't worry about monsters, no one will attack you. But you have to care about food, stamina and economy!

title: Diggergun
description:
Diggergun is an oppressive, 2D, platformer about workers, low wages and the environment.

Will you band together with others to push back against your corporate oppressors, side with your employer to get a leg up or just escape at the first opportunity possible?

title: The Curse of Grimsey Island
description: Four separate cases spanning hundreds of years. Are they linked by a curse or something else entirely? The Curse of Grimsey Island is a futuristic detective game where you collect evidence, find motives, and solve one of the greatest mysteries in modern times.

title: Trials of Kokoro
description: In this turn-based RPG, you will customize a group of heroes' equipment, skills, and strengths, before leading them into exciting battles. Strategic, turn-based combat, detailed party management, and an emotional story come together in this grand, epic adventure across the continent of Vitaria.

title: Nightmare Slash
description: "Nightmare Slash" is a 2D slasher with a side view. The player uses mouse to cut his enemies, to dodge and run from flying creatures, wait for the moment to kill dark enemies who gets in his way.

title: Aloft
description: Soar the skies in Aloft, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

title: Desta: The Memories Between
description: Desta: The Memories Between is a character-driven rogue-like, featuring an immersive story, strategic turn-based tactics and… a metaphorical ball-game?

title: Birth
description: Birth is a pleasantly creepy point-and-click puzzle game about living alone in a large city and constructing a creature to keep you company out of spare bones and organs you find lying around. Explore libraries, post offices, museums, cafes, and apartments that don't belong to you, solving observational puzzles hidden in personal belongings and scenery.

title: Gensou Tansaku Nitroid!
description: Gensou Tansaku Nitroid! is a puzzle and exploration based platformer by the doujin circle Desunoya, the makers of other Touhou fangames such as Marisa and Alice and Guruguru Suika. The game stars Nitori Kawashiro as she explores Gensokyo in pursuit of an escaped "nuclear reactor."

title: Little Nemo and the Guardians of Slumberland
description: Explore a dream world as Little Nemo, armed with toys, candy, and stuffed animals in this colorful platforming metroidvania adventure.

title: The Plucky Squire
description: Storybook characters discover a three-dimensional world outside the pages of their book and must jump between 2D & 3D realms to save their friends in this charming action-adventure.

title: Bouhou Koumakyou: Scarlet Family
description: Bouhou Koumakyou ~Scarlet Family~ is a dungeon exploring action platformer developed by Marokaka.

title: Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium
description: Capcom is taking you back to the stadium with another collection of your favorite classic hits! Come see what's changed, and what's completely new, in Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium!

title: Little Aid
description: Little Aid is a otome game by Takuyo for PC and PlayStation 2.

title: Aftonbuilt
description:
Aftonbuilt was a dark new take on the Five Nights at Freddy's franchise.

The player is tasked with surviving four of the most harrowing locations in Fazbear history using only their wits, movement, and a set of handmade tools. Using these, the player will have to fight back, striking back against the monsters that hunt them using traps and the environment to corner and scrap them. All the while exploring these locations for the secrets that lay just beneath the surface.

title: Love Drops: Miracle Doukyo Monogatari
description: Love Drops: Miracle Doukyo Monogatari is an erotic otome game by Sugar Beans.

title: Disney's Animated Storybook: 101 Dalmatians
description: Relive the events of Disney's 101 Dalmatians in an educational animated picture book with minigames.

title: KinoCon! Defend My Sweet Home!
description: A doujin game by Alice Margatroid Project based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Ouji-sama Lv1
description: Ouji-sama Lv1 is an RPG game made by Alice Blue, a subsidiary of Alice Soft. This was their second released project. This game is one of the few Alice Soft non-18+ related games, though the addition disc adds yaoi to the game.

title: Ouji-sama Lv2
description: Ouji-sama Lv2 is a erotic visual novel for PC.

title: Luna Child no Saishuu Bouei Line 2
description: A doujin game by ENAMEL SWORD based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Bomb Meirin
description: This game appears to be based on Bomber King.

title: Spy Rumble
description:
The game is an identity concealment game in which players are divided into two camps, the agent camp and the spy camp, and must take action to achieve their respective victory conditions.
An enemy spy is mixed in with the agents called in by Operation C. The purpose of the spy is to sabotage the agents' activities and take them all out. The spy's objective is to disrupt the agents' activities and eliminate them all.

title: DKO: Divine Knockout
description:
DKO friends in this Third-Person Physics Brawler, set in a stylized world of Gods and Mythology. Smash your foes in 3v3 gamemodes like King of the Hill and Oddball, or win intense 1v1 duels.

DKO's game servers shut down on February 17, 2025 at 12:00 PM EDT.

title: The Galactic Junkers
description: Become the space captain you always wanted to be. There are just a few problems, your ship needs work, there’s a price on your head, and your crew are idiots. Seek your fortune and the truth in The Galactic Junkers, a comedic space combat adventure game.

title: Hoverise Rebellion
description:
Master this fast-paced Vehicular Arena Shooter where movement is your ultimate weapon. In a future devastated by an AI rebellion, humanity’s survival rests on elite pilots capable of unleashing the HoverTanks: advanced war machines that bridge the gap between fighter jets and heavy armor.

Inspired by the legendary mechanical skill of Unreal Tournament and the movement of GunZ: The Duel, Hoverise Rebellion delivers a competitive experience where your ability to navigate the arena is just as lethal as your aim. Forget slow, clunky tanks. This is high-octane aerial combat on the ground.

title: Buta
description: "Buta" is a heart felt story told through text based indie gameplay.

title: Spirittea
description: A slice-of-life RPG set in east Asia, Spirittea is a story about a city author heading out to a mountain town to pick up inspiration for their book. In doing so, they find a magical teapot that allows them to see into the spirit world. Strange occurrences plague the town, and it's up to the player to find and appease the spirits by rebuilding their bathhouse and managing it to a high standard in order to allow them to soak away their troubles. This then frees up the townspeople, who will look to bond with you over food, games, karaoke, fishing and bug catching, giving you plenty of inspiration for your novel!

title: Here to There
description: A singleplayer puzzle FPS. The player attempts to solve each area, making progress towards the end.

title: Putin Orcs Defender
description: Putin leads his orc army to invade Ukraine. Putin's orcs want to plunder vodka and washing machines, and to slaughter everyone. You must take up arms to fight back their invasion.

title: At Your Service
description: At Your Service is a wacky co-op party game you can play with up to four players. Visit chaotic futuristic and fantasy themed homes and get them tidy any way you can! Whether it’s an angry magician or a grumpy dad trying to slow you down, just make sure you make a clean getaway!

title: 30 Days in Red Army
description: 30 Days in Red Army is a simple text RPG with pixelated graphic and randomized events and results.

title: Cat Lovescapes
description: Sneak Black cat through the house and help him reach his forbidden love!

title: Hen, Chicks and Cats
description: Save all the chicks, but choose your moves carefully or they might fall into the wrong paws.

title: Sex Search 2: Ultimate
description: Plunge into the world of relaxation and light erotica! Mindfulness logic game with many modes.

title: Furry Cybersex
description: Furry Cybersex is a unique adult game which combines interesting logic puzzle with exiting animations of furry girls that you earn after successfully passed levels!

title: Virtue's Heaven
description: Virtue’s Heaven is an expressive, 2D action adventure. Explore a world that has been stuck in an endless day for as long as anyone can remember, free your friends from prison and gain enough Zeal to end the Age of Reason.

title: Zuria
description: Build your own tank and battle with other players! Using building tool create unique shape, add weapons, movement and compete with other players in construction skills.

title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite - Pathogen
description: Continue the Aliens: Fireteam Elite story with new environments, maps, cosmetics, and a campaign that puts the crew of the Endeavor into their most perilous mission yet.

title: Freaked Fleapit
description: Hell never looked this good! Save your soul in a wild cocktail of rhythm-based dungeon crawling and date sims, and dance your way through 9 circles of Hell to heart-pumping music. Which lady of the Fleapit will be the one to join you on your trip out of Purgatory?

title: Nitro Kid
description: Synthwave roguelike deckbuilder set in the neon 80's. Pick your agent. Build your deck. Hit card combos and fight through the floors of INFINITY tower. Featuring 30+ Synthwave tracks composed exclusively for the game.

title: VergeWorld
description: Fly, crash, and adapt in this post-apocalyptic high-speed combat racing roguelite. VergeWorld mixes procedurally generated intense action and airship customization with the retro PSX-era 3D visuals and synthwave music.

title: Block N Load 2
description: Get ready to assemble, smash and dominate! Face off in epic 5v5 matches where you can build up and destroy every block on any level while playing as the 22nd century’s greatest heroes. Work together and utilize insane abilities to claim victory!

title: Glitch Busters: Stuck on You
description: It’s a normal day on the net, until a virus outbreak turns everything upside-down. Only your squad of Glitch Busters can take on the net’s kookiest bugs in an online world gone haywire in this 1-4 player co-op 3rd person shooter.

title: Havenhold
description: Havenhold is an Action Sandbox MMO inspired by the ancient Far East. Train as a warrior monk, wield primordial powers, craft, trade, and compete against rivals in riveting battles for access to the sacred peak.

title: Vice Undercover
description: Vice Undercover is a 1980's narco thriller where the only way to stop the deadly cartel is from within. Go undercover. Expose the cartel. Hack the drug war.

title: Reigns: Three Kingdoms
description: Reigns: Three Kingdoms is inspired by the beloved Chinese epic, The Romance of the Three Kingdoms. This game will thrust you into the turbulent final years of the Han dynasty. Swipe your way through negotiations, relationships and strategic alliances!

title: Yum Yum! Dating Show
description:
A send-up of dating shows and anime tropes, about 20 minutes per playthrough. Multiple choices - ooh! But only 1 true ending!

May contain a rude word or two, and a lot of innuendo. But apart from that it's innocent enough

title: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria
description: The only survival crafting game set in the Fourth Age of Middle-earth, the iconic fantasy world created by J.R.R. Tolkien.

title: Shoulders of Giants
description: Shoulders of Giants is an explosively colourful roguelike where players simultaneously control a mysterious mech and the gunslinging amphibian riding on its back. Work alone, with a friend, or as one member of a four-person online co-op team, cutting through waves of enemies on a quest to rescue the galaxy from the forces of Entropy!

title: Rocket League: Season 7
description: Welcome, esteemed Rocketeers! Season 7 features luxurious rewards like the Maestro Car and golden painted pro tier items. Rank up in the Utopia Coliseum (Gilded) Arena, or compete for tournament rewards.

title: Good Heavens!
description: Good Heavens! Is an open-world crafting and building RPG. Embark on a solo adventure or team up with up friends, picking your tool of choice – sword, wand, or carpenter's hammer. Navigate the quirky races and cultures of the promised lands and restore them to their, ahem, intended glory.

title: Exfiltrator: Cyber Stealth Missions
description: Exfiltrator: Cyber Stealth Missions features 30+ levels full of retro stealth action. Evade guards, dodge cameras, and solve puzzles to become the ultimate cyber agent. Your performance will be ranked and rewarded with achievements and unlocks.

title: Will This Bitter Night Bring Change?
description: Follow Hornet and Emily in their attempt to escape the City, in all its neon glory.

title: Weeping Falls Massacre
description: 80's horror inspired FPS, a nightmarish scene taking place at an abandoned orphanage.

title: Deliver Us Mars: Deluxe Edition
description:
Deliver Us Mars is a sci-fi adventure game developed by KeokeN Interactive and released in 2023. It is a sequel to Deliver Us the Moon. It follows the story of astronaut Kathy Johanson as she embarks on a mission to Mars to recover powerful colony ships known as the ARKs, which the Outward group stole. The game combines exploration, puzzle-solving, and platforming elements as players navigate the harsh Martian environment and uncover the mysteries surrounding the disappearance of the ARKs.

The Deliver Us Mars: Deluxe Edition includes the base game and the original soundtrack, featuring tracks composed by Sander van Zanten.

title: Titanic II: Orchestra for Dying at Sea
description: Tragedy is comedy & comedy is tragedy. In this allegorical game, sacrifice your life to save the one you love from drowning in the icy waters of the Atlantic, sink to the bottom of the ocean floor and experience the strange, eccentric, haunting world between life and death, memory and reality.

title: Ouji-sama Lv1.5
description: Ouji-sama Lv 1.5 is a collection of smaller games based solely on Ouji-sama Lv1.

title: E'tude Prologue: Yureugoku Kokoro no Katachi
description: A coastal town called "South Aose" surrounded by the sea and mountains is a place where lots of nature still remains. Two normal high school students go to a school in this town. The story starts in the special winter of the 3rd year of school when these two protagonists meet.

title: Teikoku Sensenki
description: A battle/love sim set in ancient China, about a military commander taking on enemies in 3-on-3 battles, then heading back to find romance.

title: Brigadoon: The Quest of Time
description: Based off the original book and musical written by Alan Jay Lerner comes a brand new indie title inspired by the ever-popular The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask! It follows a similar formula with a time cycle forcing you to do a set of tasks at a certain time in order to make progress. The game takes place in Scotland where a visitor named Tommy Albright from New York was on a hunting trip but gets lost, and finds himself stuck in the land of Brigadoon, which is cursed to appear for one day and disappear for 100 years! Help Tommy learn the secrets of Brigadoon and break the spell so he can escape! Help NPCs in a number of quests! Solve puzzles and unlock secrets! This game will have many surprises along the way, so it's guaranteed to be a blast!

title: Moeru Danmaku STG Moedan
description: Moedan is a practice/training shmup made by D.N.A.Softwares. It features some of the cast of the Touhou series. It also features characters from another series, Moetan, a series of books which teaches Japanese people to say incredibly silly and useless things in English.

title: Rainshade
description: Rainshade is a pseudo-RPG about making friends and parrying your enemies.

title: Touhou Seicross
description: A Touhou Doujin game based on Seicross, developed by Hachimitsu-Kumasan.

title: First Love / Late Spring
description:
"First Love / Late Spring" is a brief meditation on mediocrity, fragility, and the quiet mounting frustration of trying to keep the conversation alive even though we all knew there was never anything there from the start.

Or something like that.

title: Saihate Hospital
description: A mysterious RPG in which children in "Saihate-cho" fight with each other.

title: After the Fall: Frontrunner Season
description: From new maps, weapons and system updates, we have an update from the development team on what's coming up next for After the Fall!

title: Erovoice! Sexy Voices Lead to a Successful Love Life
description:
The story’s protagonist is a young man infatuated with the audio design in adult works he enjoys. Oftentimes, he'll end up focusing on the audio much more than the actual visuals, making him an auralist. One day, while browsing through job applications, he stumbles across a posting for a general affairs office worker, made by Cuckoo Clock. The company focuses on voice acting recording for erotic games, working with a number of voice actresses to provide the necessary samples and dialogue.

Overjoyed by the opportunity to work together with the actresses he adores so much, the protagonist happily applies for the job. Soon, he begins working at the office, performing a number of sometimes unexpectedly intimate tasks. In his line of work, he comes to meet new and long-time voice actresses, as well as spend time with the team’s sound engineer and manager. Just what kind of trouble could he get into while working for the studio?

title: Nijuuei
description:
Nijuuei is a visual novel adventure game set in Japan in the year 1640 centering around Futatsu-kage Sougen, a swordsman who, for reasons unknown to him, holds host to an antagonistic and violent sentient curse he dubs "Nijuuei" that causes him to cast two shadows and wishes to possess him.
The game begins as Sougen travels to the strange and cursed island of Awahomurajima in hopes of finding a way to dispel the curse placed upon him.
Gameplay consists of the player making choices, some of which being timed in battle scenes, and following different story routes to the conclusion.
Nijuuei features the "PIS" (Phrase Interaction System) where some words or phrases are highlighted and may be selected to view an explanation of the highlighted phrase or an expansion upon a related topic.

title: Akiba's Trip: Undead & Undressed - Kati Route
description:
This set contains the all-new Kati's Route.

Experience the “true ending” of AKIBA'S TRIP: Undead & Undressed for the very first time. When a mysterious and malevolent force slumbering inside lovable Finnish maid Kati awakens, will you be able to do whatever it takes to save her?

title: Arkanoid: Eternal Battle
description: The return of the iconic block breaker game from prestigious Japanese video game company Taito!

title: Greedventory
description: Greedventory is a gorgeous pixel-art narrative RPG experience, where the only thing between you and an embarrassingly swift death is your mouse. Strike, parry, and cast powerful spells on your enemies, loot ancient treasures, explore a brutal realm, and become the hero you never wanted to be!

title: I am Future
description: I Am Future is a relaxing survival game about building a cozy rooftop camp amid a flooded post-apocalyptic city. Set up a farm, cook delicious food, dismantle tools for crafting resources, automate chores by recruiting cute robots, and uncover the mystery behind the catastrophe.

title: Little Bear Chef
description: Little Bear Chef is a cozy 3D cooking platformer where you play as a tiny bear chef in a regular sized kitchen. It's all about coming up with creative and funny solutions to cook the recipe at hand.

title: Melodyssey
description:
In Melodyssey you follow the story of a young kid’s journey through beautiful landscapes in search of lost inspiration. There are no enemies here, so you can enjoy the playful environments and block moving puzzles without stressing over heart containers or counter attacks.

Listen to calm soothing music, chat with curious characters and unlock relaxing ASMR scenes in this stress-free exploration adventure.

title: Usagi Shima
description: Usagi Shima is a relaxing, idle bunny collecting game. You’ve been tasked as caretaker of an abandoned island — as you decorate it over time, curious (but adorable!) bunny visitors start to appear! Buy toys, plants, and build structures on an abandoned island to entice curious bun tourists to pay your island a visit. Discover, take photos, and make friends with a variety of bunnies that visit based on how you’ve decorated and arranged the island.

title: Chicken Journey
description: Play as an adorable chicken in this relaxing platformer. Jump, climb and solve puzzles to find the answer to the ultimate question chicken can ask.

title: Freeride
description: Freeride is a game about YOU. Board a train to the Spirit World in our oddball RPG where you make friends, use telekinesis, find secrets, consume ice cream and chart your own path. Each character is uniquely troubled, and in helping them find their way, you might just find yourself, too.

title: Paper Animal Adventure
description: Paper Animal Adventure is a cute roguelike game where you can explore a colorful world, fight scary enemies, and relax with your friends at the campfire! Will you be the one to seal the timelines and find the missing king?

title: Lovebirb
description: Lovebirb is a rhythm-based dating game about finding love one date at a time. Swipe right, chat on Bumbird, and impress your dates by playing all the right words to the rhythm of the music.

title: Oddada
description: A tiny musical world, where houses sing, machines drum, and you create music with them. Ob-la-di, Ob-la-da, Oddada!

title: Bubblegum Galaxy
description: Bubblegum Galaxy is a cute building strategy game about rebuilding the galaxy tile by tile. Discover and design new planets, complete missions, explore your office and befriend your co-workers... all while trying to find out who deleted the galaxy!

title: Soulitaire
description: Soulitaire is a relaxed story game in which you can catch a glimpse of the future of your interlocutors via solitaire. However, you might have to interpret what the cards mean and which future they foretell. Decide what your customers should do to face their problems, and become a part of their life!

title: Toroa: Skycall
description: Soar, swoop and glide across the vast Pacific Ocean as Toroa, the Northern Royal Albatross. Discover the hidden wonders of the sea and sky on your epic journey home with the help of Māori God of the winds, Tāwhirimātea.

title: Olliefrog Toad Skater
description: Olliefrog Toad Skater is the amphibian-based skateboarding game where its easy to be steezy! Create your own little custom cute frog or toad and hit up the local skatepark for a brief skating session, or tackle the more extensive story/career modes and ollie, grind, and kickflip your way to the top.

title: Miska
description: Miska is a narrative-driven adventure game with a strong focus on Australian flora and fauna. Rekindle your connection to family and nature through acts of restoration.

title: Bread & Fred
description: Grab your best bud for help in this new co-op challenge to help two adorable penguins, Bread and Fred, reach the top of the snowy summit. Time your jumps, cling to walls and swing across gaps to see how far you can make it before you tumble all the way back down the mountain.

title: Kity Builder
description: Explore relaxing deserted islands and build cute cities over them as Kity, the builder cat. Customize the buildings and environment at your own pace in a peaceful, stress-free setting.

title: Petit Island
description: Welcome to the beautiful and tropical Petit Island! Relive your grandpaw's youthful adventures by exploring the island and capturing beautiful photos in this heartwarming open-world photo exploration game. Preserve his memories before they fade away!

title: Flore
description: Flore is a dodging game in which you have to bring back life on barren planets. You will have to use your reflexes through the four seasons of the game to bring back trees and animals, but beware of the dark matter!

title: Pine Hearts
description: Pine Hearts is a cosy little narrative-adventure game set in the sleepy scenery of Pine Hearts Caravan Park. Explore the great outdoors as you uncover items, unlock new paths, and discover all the little secrets stuffed throughout the Park.

title: Love, Ghostie
description: Become a wholesome ghost matchmaker and grow relationships between the manor’s residents! Gift items to lift their spirits, set them up on dates, and watch love bloom! Discover cute romances with a unique story between every pair of residents! How will love blossom in your manor?

title: Super Mini Mart
description: Super Mini Mart is a cozy take on the management genre with a charming 3D aesthetic and an endearing cast of characters. Stock, supervise, and manage store activities in a laid-back environment, befriending locals and turning those one-off bargain hunters into life-long loyal customers!

title: PaperKlay
