title: Trainz Plus: Lone Pine Branch
description: A rural and largely single track connection between UP and BNSF owned main lines.

title: Trainz Plus: CP SD40-2 #5865-5879 Dual Flags
description: Drive the CP GMD SD40-2 locomotive, numbers 5865-5879, built in 1984 for CP Rail. Featuring many exact details found on the real locomotives, including CP specific cooling pipe, Locotrol antenna array, open bearung EMD HTC trucks, and more!

title: The Sims 4: Werewolves
description: Howl the night away in The Sims 4 Werewolves Game Pack. Your Sims will transform, join packs, and run wild under the light of the full moon. Explore the world of Moonwood Mill and discover the secrets of the werewolves as you navigate your new lycanthrope life. Sims will unlock new skills, manage new temperaments, and maybe even meet their fated mates.

title: Steelrising: Bastille Edition
description: The Bastille Edition includes the base game, the Marie-Antoinette outfit, the access to the exclusive beta from August 25, the "Discus Chain" weapon and the "Cagliostro's Secrets" DLC when it releases in November.

title: Redout 2: Ultimate Edition
description: The Ultimate Edition of Redout 2 includes the base game, the Redout 2: Season Pass, and a digital download of the Redout 2 Soundtrack. Season Pass includes 2 future DLC packs with new locations, career events, rewards and more, all at a discounted rate.

title: Polyemisokos
description: An abstract puzzle game about connections.

title: Moontrain
description: A Point n Click game set in a strange new world. All Aboard the new, exciting and strange adventure. Keep your hands, quills and tentacles inside for the whole ride.

title: Going Into the Unknown
description: After a girl is infected with an epidemic and the townspeople are infected, you have to face and kill enemies or hide from them, solve puzzles and find documents to complete missions.

title: Lab Crisis
description: Lab Crisis is a turn-based puzzle about a robot who's rescuing scientists from a mutant-infested lab! The more scientists you grab at once, the longer is the chain, so be careful!

title: Magic and Elements
description: Magic and elements is a 2D arena shooter, you are the greatest magician of all time, you pass another test, getting into the arena of the four elements

title: Wanderer
description: A dying planet calls to you, a wandering exocomet, to save its kin before they perish to a mysterious threat. Will you answer?

title: Commonplace
description: A small-scale game about ordinary people in an ordinary place.

title: Rabbit Knight
description: Slay mushrooms in this action packed platformer!

title: Platformer Toolkit
description:
Platformer Toolkit is an interactive video essay, from the creator of Game Maker’s Toolkit.

You’ll get to see, first hand, how platformer characters are designed, as you use the toolkit to change and adjust over 30 variables that drive the hero’s movement.

Change Kit’s max speed, jump height, squash and stretch, coyote time, and more - and then play through a sample level with your chosen stats.

title: Rakuen Yuki
description: Rakuen Yuki is a erotic visual novel for PC.

title: Bob Ross: The Joy of Painting
description: Enjoy making happy little trees with this, the game based on Bob Ross' television paint show, The Joy of Painting.

title: Curseball
description: Welcome To Curseball! Your goal: hit the ball before time runs out. Simple, right?

title: Apocalyptic
description: Apocalyptic is a Zombie Survival Shooter Video Game. It begins in a church where zombies flood everywhere. There are survival quests as you proceed through the campaigns and you must try and survive the apocalyptic horde.

title: LazuNight Funkin'
description: Step into the shoes of Pomu, who, in celebration of LazuLight's upcoming first year anniversary, will be rehearsing for their grand concert with her friends Finana and Elira in the hopes of giving their fans the best performance possible!

title: Lucky Star Troopers
description: Lucky Star Troopers is a 2D fighting fan game based on the anime Lucky Star

title: Arena of the Myths
description:
"Arena of the Myths" is an action shooter fangame project to HololiveEN.

Features
Shooting through out 4 stages, fighting with the other team to gain morale points for victory!
5 characters available to play Kiara, Calli, Gura, Ame and Ina.
Fight Arena Boss to unlock new stages
Catch all the KFP members (Chicken) and save them for further in-game characters shop update!

title: Furry Hitler
description: You play as Hitler, reliving some of your best and worst decisions and seeing where those lead you. Only you decide how this war will end.

title: Cosmic Strike: The Last Sub Sector
description: Giant capital ship combat! Equip your crew, choose your ship and rage battle across the stars in this top down 2D strategic shooter. Unravel the story as you fight hordes of enemies, build up your base, and become the fleet commander this sector needs in its darkest hour.

title: A Midnight Stroll
description: Play as Chelsea as she makes her way down the street to fill a late-night urge. Fight strange creatures that block your path and collect various items that bring you joy!

title: The Most Desperate Angel
description:
An angel meets a woman on earth. There is trouble in heaven.

A visual novel with platformer elements.

title: 77 Oleander Avenue Ghost House Investigation
description:
Waking up disoriented and weary, Tabby wakes up in the parlor of an abandoned house. Her keys, wallet, and phone are missing and she can't remember why she's in such a place... not that it's too far gone from some of the other places she's woken up in over the years.

A horror-mystery visual novel.

title: Acolytes of the Chrystal
description: A young writer goes on a expedition with his mentor/crush and discovers a world he never knew existed.

title: Bullet Report
description: A doujin game by AQUA STYLE based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Double Focus
description: After getting sucked into a magical book, Aya and Momiji must find their way back home. Swap between the two girls in battle, so you can utilize their abilities to gain the advantage. Explore every nook and cranny to unravel the mystery of the Book World!

title: Panzer Campaigns: Scheldt '44
description:
Scheldt '44 explores 21st Army Group’s actions in the autumn of the 1944, focusing on the Battle of the Scheldt, the Maas Salient Campaign, and the Channel Ports. Other actions in Belgium and the Netherlands are also represented, including Operation Market Garden in an all-new campaign scenario.

Scheldt '44 includes 46 Scenarios – covering all sizes and situations, including a solo tutorial scenario plus specialized versions for both head to head play and vs. the computer AI.

title: Megaman X Unleashed 2: Worlds Unite
description: Megaman X Unleashed 2: Worlds United is a continuation of the Megaman X Unleashed fangame, where this time it addresses the legendary crossover of the Archie Comics Worlds Unite comics. The game contains 3 different types of fighting style: the Unleashed, The All Star and the Brawler.

title: Relics of the Past
description: Relics of the Past is a Story based 2D Metroidvania based in a Fantasie world

title: Sightless
description: This game is an exploration based game with RPG-like elements, and stars Sena, a curious boy who yearns to learn more about the world he lives in.

title: Extracurricular Activities
description: Extracurricular Activities is a visual novel following the main character (you!) through his endeavor of trying to romance a member of his tennis team. The choices you make can impact the way your teammates react to you, so make your choices carefully.

title: Cookie Cutter
description: Love turns to rage and chainsaws in Cookie Cutter, a techno-pop-punk 2D hand-drawn Metroidvania set to the backdrop of a bleak and beautiful dying world. Become Cherry, a rage-driven android on a quest to rescue her beloved creator, Doctor Shinji Fallon, from the clutches of a deranged mastermind.

title: Kingdom Under Fire: Avalanche
description:
Kingdom Under Fire Avalanche was a online game that will allow players to battle each other as 2 heroes from the other Kingdom Under Fire Series. It will also have a PvE mode where players have a AI army and they must defeat the other AI army.

It was supposed to be realesed in 2017. The game was shown in beta in 2011 in Korea but due to poor reviews it ended up being cancelled.

title: Air Fli: Misuzu-chin Kiki Ippatsu
description: An action game inspired by "AIR" and "Flicky".

title: Panzer Campaigns: Kiev '43
description: In Kiev '43, as the commander of the Russian 1st Ukrainian Front, you have several armies at your disposal to defeat the vaunted German Wehrmacht. As the German commander you will have at your disposal the powerful panzer forces able to wreck havoc upon their Soviet foes. Included are scenarios that let you recreate all four phases of the campaign from the battle in the Bukrin bridgehead to the final battle near Korosten where the Germans made one last attempt to destroy the Russian forces and roll on to victory. The stage is set! All that is lacking is for you to kick off one of the most whirlwind campaigns on the Eastern Front!

title: Yi Xian: The Cultivation Card Game
description: "Yixian" is an online card deck building game with a background of cultivating immortals. Every game is a deck building experience from scratch. Players will start to practice from the Qi refining period, gradually break through the realm, and obtain stronger cards. By changing cards, the deck will continue to grow and become stronger, with a powerful combination of routines, and finally defeat all opponents to win.

title: Shanshanshanshanshanhai
description: This is a mini-game created by Desunoya at an event called Touhou Game Jam.

title: Alien Science
description:
As an apprentice researcher living on the edge studying extraterrestrial biology, each day brings an exciting new adventure. An unexpected discovery leads to momentous changes in your daily life. How will you survive?

A Sierra-styled text parser game made for Adventure Jam 2020.

title: All in Love and War
description: Gunnery Sergeant Jayden Jones is grudgingly going through the motions of a brutal Marine life he can’t escape from when suddenly he finds himself at risk by the law for blossoming a relationship with his Sergeant Major, Walter Hardy. Under Marine Law, these two are forbidden to be together, so Jayden will have to bear great misfortune and find out what part of himself he’s really missing

title: An Ace Walks Into a Bar
description: Maya is lured away from a cozy night in with her girlfriend by the offer of a "girls' night out" with her older sister Lynn. Unfortunately for Maya, this family reunion doesn't go as well as she hoped...

title: Apartment No. 9
description: Help Leah find happiness or lead her to ruin in this dark slice-of-life story about a teacher whose life is turned upside down when the homeless guy she often stares at out of her window shows up at her door, claiming to have found her purse.

title: Broken: Paranormal Investigation
description:
In the Broken world, you incarnate a team of investigator who leads investigations on paranormal phenomena.

Prepare yourself to survive in a hostile and mysterious environment. Take on the challenges that will allow you to exorcise the enemies you will meet.

In single or multiplayer mode, Broken proposes to solve various missions.

You will have to investigate a paranormal phenomenon and exorcise the spiritual entities. You will have to use the skills of your character and your teammates to succeed in your mission.

title: Apartment No. 9: BxG Version
description: Help Rue find happiness or lead him to ruin in this dark slice-of-life story about a teacher whose life is turned upside down when the homeless girl he often stares at out of his window shows up at his door, claiming to have found his wallet.

title: Polda 7
description: It´s the seventh entry in the point and click adventure series Polda. Gameplay-wise Polda 7 does not differ from previous entries, however for the first time in the series history there is also a secondary controlable character. Just like previous Polda games, this one is also heavy focused on situational humor.

title: Hometopia
description: Unleash your inner architect in Hometopia, the ultimate builder's game with limitless customization and high-fidelity graphics. Build your dream home or design entire neighborhoods, solo or with friends, bringing every creative detail to life exactly as you envision.

title: Ghostwriter Hatate-chan
description: A doujin game by ISY based on the Touhou Project series.

title: PieceWars
description: "Piece Wars" is a chess-based board game. Use the unique skills of each piece to win!

title: The Original Wizard
description: The game is a Dungeon Crawler, where the player must survive the succeeding dungeons and defeat Impeficus on his throne.

title: Night Janitor
description: A first-person horror game where you clean up after rowdy high school kids while also keeping a lookout for clues as to their disappearance. Scrub, vacuum, clean... die?

title: Updog
description: Updog is a game all about getting that dog up. Jump, dive, grapple, and ground pound your way across the cloudscape to grab balloons and fuel for your raft, your one ticket to the heavens.

title: SynthWaves
description: A retrowave tower defense game where the player must manage their arsenal of sentries to fight off waves of synths, stop their invasion, and take the fight to their home.

title: Fanatic Zeal
description: Rogue-lite Quarter View Hack&Slash. Bosses have randomly chosen traits, and you will get different treasure in each play. Online score ranking board (for each difficulties)

title: Toy's Paradise
description: Wake up a toy ready to tear the world apart! Move around the house, trying to tear everything down in a way to gain resources. Use these resources to build more toys, as well as other tools to increase efficiency in pulling this poor family's house apart.

title: Nuclear Fighter
description: Is a fun and fast 2D platformer with a side view. Your goal is to escape from the city and survive.

title: Viltnemda
description: You've been called into the forest to investigate a wounded deer, but the forest is dark and all you have is a flashlight. Oh bother, what a Tuesday you're having.A retro PSX style horror game

title: The Horace Trilogy
description: In the early 1980s, the Horace games were some of the most beloved on the ZX Spectrum. Now, take on the maze navigating of Hungry Horace, the slope slaloming of Horace Goes Skiing, and the challenging platforming of Horace and the Spiders in this compilation.

title: Hidden
description:
You wake up trapped in a mental asylum for the criminally insane which crawling with the most the evil murderers.

The only way to survive is to find the three keys and escape without being found and killed by the other inmates.

In order to navigate around the dark asylum and find the three keys you have a flashlight, however turning on the flashlight at the wrong time will attract the other inmates, so use it wisely if you want to stay alive!

title: Hacker life simulator
description: Take a team of hackers under your strict guidance and become known to the whole world. Expand your hideout and hack various companies around the world. Become the most famous group in the world!

title: Brutal Japan
description: "Brutal Japan" is a survival horror set in modern Japan. Experience a brutal horror that is indistinguishable from reality.

title: Bubble Night
description: Let's run through the quiet night sky through the forest of buildings with the little girl.

title: Armored Battalion
description: Armored battalion is a overlooking shooting game, which is different from the current tank battle mode. It is more inclined to the arcade. There are two battle modes: the battle mode. You can only use tanks that have fought in history. RPG mode. You can choose chassis and artillery freely.

title: Rocket Drift
description: Rocket Drift is a fun, casual, solo rocket racing game for all ages. Rotate your rocket left + right and thrust forward to navigate each level. Be sure to avoid walls and obstacles! Race across the finish line and set your best time!

title: Bakso Simulator
description:
Have you ever dreamed of having your own bakso restaurant?
Dream no further, because now you can do it all with Bakso Simulator!
In this world, you will own your own bakso restaurant with your old friend
Help the townsfolks by doing their quests and uncover all the secrets in town!

title: Project: Name
description: Project: Name is a hardcore Perma-Death first person platformer. Try to beat all three levels!

title: Henshinko!
description: Gamble your reality for money in this male to female transformation-themed, transgender, reality-bending pachinko-style arcade game. Your reality may change at the end of every level, entering worlds of both good and bad fates where your relationship with your fiance can be enhanced... or destroyed.

title: Dog Adventure Harmony
description: A fictitious RPG where you search for your lost dog in a fantasy world. Fight make-believe monsters and dodge creative bullet hell attacks. Meet its imaginary characters... and their creator if you'd like.

title: Fantasy Zoo
description: Fantasy Zoo is a zoo builder where you build zoo for fantasy animals in fantasy world.

title: Bleeding Abyss
description: Run at high speeds surviving the chase of endless groups of enemies. Plan and manage your survival by investing your hard earned rewards into resources. Do you have what it takes to escape?

title: Ein's Sword
description: Simple field battles and training. Defeat enemies that appear in the field and obtain ability points every time you level up. Raise your preferred status and advance the battle to an advantage. Easy to use and comfortable to play.

title: The Western Rooms
description: Will you beat the Rooms? None of them will be easy. Challenge your mind with 3 Escape Room Scenarios! Look for clues, and keep your eyes wide open! Explore an old Western Town Find the Bartender's Recipe Break in the Bank's Vault & Escape the Sheriff's Department

title: Motenase! Nitori-chan
description: A doujin game by ISY based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Call of the Wild: The Angler
description: From the creators of theHunter: Call of the Wild comes a genre-defying fishing experience! Explore a vast and atmospheric open world in search of the perfect fishing spot. Ride the open waters alone or with friends and embark on your journey to become a master angler.

title: Disastory
description: An illustrated choice-driven roleplaying adventure where coffee machines find love and teenage girls steal eyeballs!? Explore a vibrant world with absurd stories and characters.

title: FIFA 23
description: Port of FIFA 23 for PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. This version doesn't have some of the new technologies employed in the next generation version.

title: Crooked Time
description: A visual novel about a man searching for his missing love. The townsfolk say they saw him go down to the valley, they say time moves differently down there.

title: MegaAri
description: MegaAri is a 2d plaftorm, doujin game based on the Touhou Project series.

title: King of Fighters 2002: 3rd Strike of the Orochi
description: A rom hack that rebalances the game while adding new options.

title: Shyftrs
description: Shyftrs is a 2D stylized action adventure metroidvania game that will take you on a journey to uncover the mysteries of your lineage and the world beyond. Your weapon of choice are Cane Sword, Pistol or use your new found prowess. Step up and embrace the adventure.

title: Asym Altered Axis
description: Asym Altered Axis is an Asymmetric Multiplayer Game where one player sets the deadly stage with a variety of traps and hunt down the puny fleeing infiltrators, while the other (up to 5) players team up and stealthily pull off the heist under cover of darkness.

title: 10 Days Under the Sea
description: Set sail on the open seas, and help Little Carrie find her spirit. It`s been removed from her body by the ghost of a mysterious old man. Luckily she`s stumbled upon an ancient compass, but things aren`t quite as they appear. The pieces to the compass are scattered below the waves. Comb underwater scenes for hidden objects in gorgeous locations like the Sea of Japan, the Caribbean, and the Nile. Can you restore the state of things in 10 Days Under the Sea?

title: 10 Talismans
description: The legend says that if you collect 10 talismans, wisdom, power and hapiness will be yours. Enter the mystical challenge of puzzles in the oriental world of 10 Talismans. Set off with swords, amulets, lanterns and much more to collect the mystical talismans. Play against the clock in Classic or take your time in Timeless.

title: Wild Rides: WaterPark Factory
description:
Wild Rides: WaterPark Factory is a game where the player can build a custom water park by constructing a waterslide. There are three levels represented through a different location: Slippery Swamp, Seasick Island or Texas Hills. The game does not focus on managing a park, but rather the design of the slides.

Players can freely move the camera and use different pieces to create a slide. To succeed, it needs to be tested by different people that each have a different personality. Once it is built a test can be performed, showing the character from behind going down the slide. Emojis show how that character experiences the ride and adjustments can be made to improve their satisfaction. A ride can be made too dangerous or fast, causing the character to fly out of the ride.

title: Xango Tango
description: Help this amazing toy robot ‘Xango’ find his upgrade parts in this brain-stretching, 3D animated action puzzle adventure. Match 3 colored crates and watch ’em explode in Classic mode. Solve brain-twisting puzzles in Puzzle mode, or sit back, relax, and play without time pressure in Relax mode. Exotic landscapes, lively tango music and wacky dances make this lively adventure fun for the entire family. Help Xango find all of his parts to witness the surprise ending!

title: 20th Century Trivia Challenge
description: 20th Century Trivia Challenge is a trivia game. It contains over 3,000 trivia questions and over 500 film clips. The game can be played by a single player or up to three teams can be formed to battle through questions topical for all periods of history.

title: 3 Day Eventing: The Ultimate Riding Adventure
3D Bowling USA
description: 3-D Bowling USA provides 12 bowlers, five bowling alleys, multiple camera angles, varying techniques, and different lane conditions. Multiplayer options include head-to-head competition and computer opponents.

title: Worlds of Billy 2
description:
Worlds of Billy 2 is a simple 2D platformer, with strong inspiration from Lode Runner. A young boy, Billy, has a problem with his imagination. In his dreams he is in magic worlds, that he has to travel across and fight against imaginary enemies. For this Billy has to dig holes, wait for enemies, and when creature falls into the hole, Billy can bury it. When Billy defeats all enemies he can go to a teleport. The young hero can't jump, only climb on ladder.

Ten different worlds are waiting for the player, for example a pirate island and a spaceship.

title: 3D Brick Bustin Madness
description:
This Breakout variant features thirty different levels to play through.

The goal in 3D Brick Busters, just like the game this is based on, is simple: Use your paddle to bounce a ball back and forth until you destroy all the multi-colored blocks on the screen. But unlike the original, you can move your paddle up and down as well! The game also features several power ups such as a cannon to destroy blocks and enemies, a ball holder, and a secondary paddle to stop the ball from going off the end of the playfield.

There are also multiple point-giving items, and some items will make it harder for you to play the game for short periods of time, either by moving the camera downward so you can't see the entire playfield, or by turning your ball (or balls) into smiley faces that can't destroy blocks.

title: Sea Bubble Burst
description: Closely resembling Bubble Bobble, Sea Bubble Burst stars Bubbly, an underwater creature with the power to trap creatures in bubbles, then pop them to turn them into fruit. Eliminate all enemies on a level to proceed to the next level. Includes 20 levels.

title: 3D Dragon Castle
description: In 3D Dragon Duel, you (as a dragon) must clear out several castles from other enemy dragons and dinosaurs, while avoiding deadly lava pits and floating spiked balls.

title: 3D Galaxy Fighters
description: In 3D Galaxy Fighters (strongly inspired by the classic Galaga series), your mission is to defend the galaxy from hordes of intergalactic invaders, which appear from the sides of the screen waves. Your ship can only withstand one hit, but you can upgrade your weapons as you destroy enemies. These upgraded weapons have their own benefits and problems, and have limited ammunition.

title: Ankh: The Lost Treasures
description: Ankh: The Lost Treasures is a hidden object adventure game. In ancient Egypt, a temple is plundered and a ship is missing on the Nile. Find the lost treasure with Thara and her friends. Solve hidden object scenes and mini games to gain new hints.

title: Clown For Speed
description: Clown For Speed is your chance to immerse yourself in the real world of ultimate drifting experience. Pick your perfect ride and get ready to burn some tires!

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Revontuli Coast
description: Explore a sprawling archipelago that teems with life. Hunt waterfowl, ducks, and upland birds, in addition to larger game such as Brown Bear and Whitetail Deer. Gaze at the magical Northern Lights, and discover exciting new hunting opportunities in this region of the "land of a thousand lakes".

title: Wars Across the World: Eunus 133
description: Eunus 133 B.C. is the story of the first slave war. The slaves of Sicily revolt and massacre the great landowners, trying to seize the whole island and to contaminate other areas of the Roman republic. The Roman armies must imperatively destroy the whole of the rebels or calm the revolt.

title: Cyber Drift
description: Welcome to the world of Cyber, hold your steering wheel for the next drift track.

title: Anica
description: Anica is a RPG game that made everything by only 1 person who are a cleaner at day and game developer at night, due to labor shortage the developer need to do everything on his own from composing music, game design, programming, bad script writing, not so good story writing, badly drawn art.

title: Blue Star Mobile Team
description: After the Blue Star mobile team has assembled, control the mecha to fight and defeat the dangerous creatures in the universe.

title: Boulder Island
description: The game is a first-person survival battle game, which requires players to defeat the enemy in the game through operation and collection.

title: Chuhou Joutai 3: Three Nights of Scarlet Abscess
description: Pandemonium will break loose if you don't unleash your rage.

title: Classic Memory Game
description: Classic Memory Game is a game of memorization skills, designed for the entire family and suitable for people of all ages. It is inspired by the popular game of pairs where the player requires concentration and memory.

title: Escape If You Can
description: Lost in a silent maze of bookshelves, you have only your wits to escape. Solve the puzzles before the labyrinth consumes you.

title: Everyone Moves With You
description: Take down powerful enemies in this hard 2d fantasy pixel game. If you like a challenge then you came to the right place. You'll travel through multiple different worlds, all sorts of different levels, enemies, weapons and so much more. With new levels being made often.

title: Fire Story
description: FireStory - Top Down game about a firefighter, the player must fight off a flying fire extinguisher and direct the blow in such a way as to put out burning people and other sources of fire.

title: Fufufu
description: Have you ever raced with sheeps, poked noses, or battled against pirate cats? Welcome to FUFUFU, an adorable roguelite adventure for all ages, full of wacky situations. Get ready for some Fu-lish action!

title: Humdle
description: You're in a dark room. you have to escape from here but.. can't see anything!!

title: Island Idle RPG
description: Lead the Balgairs - mercenaries creatures and experts in the art of hard working - manage the workforce, inputs, capital, other resources and help provide all the equipment and weaponry needed to defeat bosses in distant Dungeons

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2000: World Airliners - 747-400 and 777-200 Professional
description: World Airliners 747-400 & 777-200 Professional is an aircraft add-on for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2000 and Microsoft Flight Simulator 2002.

title: WordZap Deluxe
description: An updated version of WordZap for Windows 98 SE. It was distributed as Shareware.

title: WordJong
description: Enter a lush world and combine the tranquility of Mahjong with the challenge of a word puzzle, and what do you get ... WordJong! Grab tiles and remove them from the board Mahjong-style to spell the BIG words for bonus points. Can you clear all the tiles? Longer words mean big token bonuses! Challenge a friend or a clever cast of in-game Masters.

title: Wonder Pets!: Save the Puppy!
description: A puzzle activity game in which players save a puppy and take special care of it. Mini-games include coloring activities, matching, and basic traveling games.

title: I'm Prop
description: I`m Prop is an online hide and seek game. Here Hunters try to find magical dwarfes that live off of energy of their surroundings.

title: Edessa: School of Wizardry
description: Edessa: School of Wizardry is a dark themed action game set in a magical universe. Fight the demons that have plagued the world and cast your spells with the Edessa's unique spellcasting mechanic. Fight the bosses, solve the puzzles and come out on top.

title: 3D Hunting: Grizzly
description: Take on the Grizzly. All new for the hunt of a lifetime!

title: Harvest Mania to Go
description: Harvest Mania to Go gives fledgling farmers a quick lesson in agriculture, or just a veggie good way to pass the time. "Classic" mode involves matching colored vegetables in groups of four or more. Creating longer chains will earn a player bonus points that can be converted into tokens to enter into the Pogo website for a chance to win up to $1,000. As the seasons change, a new vegetable is harvested and a player's rank will increase. The different crop gives the gamer a chance to earn bonus items such as animals, flowers, and rocks for their farm. In "Action" mode, players get the chance to create a farm, fertilize and seed it, and then harvest before the garden grows out of control.

title: VeggieTales: Dance, Dance, Dance
description: A modified version of Dance Praise featuring characters and music from the VeggieTales series.

title: 3D Hunting: Shark
description: Take to the waters on an adventure so real you'll swear to never turn back. Chart your course through stunning underwater 3D environments on your expedition in search of the prized shark. Locations, weapons, equipment and prey so lifelike you'll be lucky to get out alive. But if you're one of the lucky few, you'll reach the shores with a trophy from a successful expedition--and a chance to once again face off against the trophy of the deep.* Navigate through four 3D waterscapes with lifelike scenery, sounds and equipment. * Choose from four weapons in each environment. * True-to-life prey--kill or be killed! * Real-life scuba gear--monitor your air pressure and decompression to survive. * Supplemental equipment--bait, cage and search light.

title: 3D Pool: Billiards & Snooker
description:
With 3D Pool you can enjoy the ultimate billiards and pool experience in the comfort of your own home!

Step up to the virtual table and show what you can do with a cue! In addition to the pool hall classic eight-ball, you can also play nine-ball, ten-ball and even snooker! Whether alone against the computer or in a duel against a real player on the same computer, you'll send balls careening across the table in four selectable, highly-detailed rooms as you work your way up the local high score list.

title: 3D Snowboard Resort Designer
description: 3D Snowboard Resort Designer is a sports-arcade game.

title: Inkbound
description: Go on co-op adventures in Inkbound, an online roguelike from the creators of Monster Train. Craft powerful character builds in procedurally generated runs and battle your way past the inky hordes with a unique active battle system.

title: Bad Birds
description: Bad Birds is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for Dream Diary Jam 2. It's a traditional fangame, the main goal being to collect effects.

title: June Exhibit
description: June Exhibit is an English Yume Nikki fangame. The goal is to explore the various worlds in the Nexus and collect effects (known as Crystals in this game). Some effects can be combined with one another.

title: Yume Otoshi
description: Yume Otoshi is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. You explore dreams of Yumesogi (ゆめそぎ) and collect effects in her dream world.

title: A Bear Family Adventure
description: A Bear Family Adventure: featuring Playtime in the Park is a CD-ROM-based children's edutainment title that had been demoed on the Pippin Atmark console.

title: Aces of World War 1
description: Aces of World War I is an action flight simulator set in World War I. It contains more than 40 missions in a recreated area of 1,000 square kilometers. The objectives of the missions are, for example: air battles, the destruction of balloons or convoys and attacks on ground targets and boats. Weather effects and two different difficulty levels are included.

title: Liquidator: 3D Action Game
description: Liquidator is an unlicensed Russian Action FPS game. This game made on the Build engine and looks like addon or mod for Duke Nukem 3D.

title: MC Eternal
description: A mod pack containing 380 mods.

title: Blasterball 3
description: Blasterball 3 is a fresh new spin on the classic series that's sold millions worldwide! Get set to break your way through mesmerizing patterns of colorful bricks in the most exciting, customizable edition yet. The all-new Level Editor lets you design your own levels. Got a favorite song? Load up your own MP3's and build your own soundtracks as you sit back and let the stress fall away. Secret levels and additional features are just waiting to be discovered ... so don't delay - dive in and play Blasterball 3 today.

title: Underworld: Bloodline
description: Underworld Bloodline is a team-based multiplayer Half-Life mod based on the Sony action movie "Underworld". Rival clans of Vampires and Lycans (werewolves) fight each other while trying to secure a human that hides the power to make them invincible. The gameplay can be described as a mix between Hostage Rescue and Capture the Flag, but the maps are a lot larger and more complex, offering opportunities for a wide range of strategies, such as snipering from inside buildings or taking shortcuts by jumping between rooftops

title: Late Night Gas Station
description: Relax as you work a cold, rainy night shift at a gas station. Order stock & gas, stack the shelves and serve your customers! Keep your store well stocked and clean to keep your customers satisfied. Keep entertained and spend your juicy profits on the gas station PC.

title: Let's Play: The Shining
description: An Atari-esque supernatural horror game based on Stanley Kubrick’s movie The Shining, which was in turn based on Stephen King’s book The Shining.

title: Escape the Emerald Star
description: This is classic hidden object puzzle game, this time set on a ship.

title: The Cryptographer
description: The Cryptographer is an indie game about decoding famous phrases, book quotes and more.

title: OpenGoal: Jak and Daxter - The Precursor Legacy
description: A full-on fan-made PC port of Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy, with added options like resolution, camera, antialiasing, and more.

title: House of Necrosis
description:
House of Necrosis is a Mystery Dungeon-style game inspired by Survival Horror and RPG classics of the 32bit era.

Survive the horrors of the mansion that changes every time you enter.

title: Five Nights At Jerpig's
description: A Five Nights at Freddy's fangame featuring 3 guinea pigs and one hedgehog ( Note: not Sonic the Hedgehog. ). Complete with a custom night and star system.

title: Azteca
description: Azteca is a captivating puzzle game that challenges your strategic thinking and precision as you match and burst vibrant bubbles in a mesmerizing Aztec-themed setting. Immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of ancient civilizations while navigating through intricate levels filled with colorful orbs, each pop bringing you closer to unlocking the secrets of the Aztecs.

title: Sesame Street Create & Draw in Elmo's World
description: A kid-friendly creative game where children join Elmo to draw, color, and build simple scenes using stamps, stickers, and easy tools. Designed for young learners, it encourages imagination, fine motor skills, and basic shape and color recognition through guided activities and playful animations.

title: Sesame Street Art Workshop
description: A Sesame Street-themed activity pack that allows players to insert stickers onto scenes, color in images, dress up characters, or draw freely.

title: Shogun: Total War - Warlord Edition
description: The Warlord Edition contains the complete Shogun: Total War game, plus two expansion packs: Invasion of the Mongol Horde and Campaigns of the Three Unifiers. These expansion sets include new military units, terrain, buildings, and scenarios.

title: Pardon My French Toast
description: Pardon My French Toast is a 3D platformer starring a slice of toast who covers himself in sweet spreads to get fun abilities.

title: Puzzle Hero
description: As a stealth hero, you must free your brother from Zalock and his evil Army of Vegetables, ahem, Darkness! Duel with green beans monsters, pumpkins and up to 50 garden variety species. Collect enough gold and use it to shop for magical amulets, weaponry, and clothing accessories in the Salon. Do you have the cerebral skills to be a Puzzle Hero and outwit this Match 3 war board?

title: Gambaru Amabie-chan
description: This is an action game created by Wanpaku Pixels.

title: Ultimate Pinball Extreme
description: The third game in the Ultimate Pinball series. Featuring new tables in exotic locales including the moon, an African safari, Ancient Egypt, and even multi-level tables to better challenge the players as they maneuver through these tables, some of them rigged with destructible environments.

title: Ultimate Pinball Gold
description: A sequel to Ultimate Pinball but now with 40 tables instead of 20.

title: Present-X
description: This is a shooting game created by Wanpaku Pixels.

title: Turbo Fiesta
description: Third in the hugely popular Turbo series, Turbo Fiesta is what happens when south of the border cuisine takes on an interplanetary trajectory. An astronomical and gastronomical adventure, Turbo Fiesta is truly out of this world! Rebecca and Robert are taking their fast food empire to totally new heights. Serve interplanetary customers in spectacular, far-out locations and watch your fast food empire skyrocket.

title: Turbo Subs
description: A super-charged sequel to the hit time management game Turbo Pizza, Turbo Subs is twice the fun, twice the challenge, with twice as much speed. Hit the kitchen running as Rebecca and Robert continue their pursuit of building the greatest restaurant franchise in town. Except now they find themselves in a much bigger town, New York City! With loads of upgrades, secret sauces, and unique tastes, Turbo Subs is a delicious new adventure for the whole family!

title: Tribes Extreme
description: Tribes Extreme is a cancelled Starsiege: Tribes single + multiplayer expansion that was in development for PC by Dynamix, around 1999. It was meant to offer a proper single player experience, with 12 campaign missions and a new tribe featured in the storyline.

title: Travelrama USA
description: Travelrama USA is a video game by Zenda Studio. The player travels trough the USA collecting postcards along the way.

title: Tropical Swaps 2
description: Stack fruit to make scrumptious smoothies in Smoothie Stall mode, build colorful Tiki souvenirs in Tikitastic mode, or stage a breath-taking fireworks display in Firework Extravaganza! Each game mode builds on the popular match-and-stack puzzle gameplay from the original and adds a whole new level of fun.

title: Totally Spies!: Swamp Monster Blues
description: Totally Spies!: Swamp Monster Blues" is an educational puzzle game based on the "Totally Spies!" animated series. In this adventure, players control the trio of teenage spies—Sam, Clover, and Alex—as they investigate reports of monsters in the Louisiana Bayou to rescue a kidnapped government agent.

title: Adventures With Oslo: Tools and Gadgets
description: Five programs in one! An animated storybook about a llama named Dolly who is constantly requiring rescue by Jimmy who turns into the many shapes of simple machines; An adventure game taking you on a search of Tooltown and the Valley of Machines for clues and a surprise ending; A Coloring Gallery featuring musical markers and a tic-tac-toe game; A very colorful Maze Arcade challenging you to navigate five increasingly complex mazes while scoring your performance; And an Interactive Database which uncovers all six classes of simple machines- the inclined plane, screw, pulley, wheel and axle, lever, and wedge.

title: A.I. Puzzler
description:
Microsoft A.I. Puzzler was a game being developed by Alexey Pajitnov of Tetris fame, and who previously worked on Microsoft Entertainment Pack: The Puzzle Collection.

It's official website has at least two snapshots on the Wayback Machine dating from July 28th 2001 to August 1st 2001, with its first inaccessability date being August 9th 2001, which meant that the game was shelved between the August 1st and 9th timeframe. It also used to be mentioned on Wikipedia's List of video games published by Microsoft page with the earliest dated from June 15th 2011 and the latest prior to removal being being October 12th 2020.

All that remains is just a scan of the manual.

title: Hyenas
description:
Hyenas is a hero-based, multiplayer extraction shooter. Choose a Hyena to play as - each with a unique weapon, ability, and personality - to form a crew of three and steal valuable Merch. The action takes place on vast, themed 'Plunderships' returning to Mars from Earth, loaded with salvaged Merch for your crew to steal.

Competing with four other raiding crews, your goal is to find and crack secured vaults, then steal enough Merch to make your escape. Standing in your way are not only rival players but also the “MURFs” – security forces who will fight to the death to protect the precious cargo.

Once a team has stolen enough Merch, they activate the Plundership’s VIP Extraction, which is revealed on the map. You must find it and make your getaway or stop others from making theirs. The crew that escapes first is the winner, so make sure it’s you!

Fast and frenetic combat is enhanced by the unique weaponry and ability of each Hyena. Additionally, each Plundership features zero gravity areas, some of which can be toggled on and off. Gunfights take on an entirely new dimension, literally, when gravity is no longer a concern. Enemy players can come at you from any direction, so you’ll need to keep your head on a swivel – or make sure to ambush them first.

title: The Holoween collection
description:
The Holoween collection is a set of 3 games featuring HoloMyth's halloween costumes from the Holoween stream!
Play as Amelia Watson, Gawr Gura and Ninomae Ina'nis in their cute outfits!

Pumpkin Party, Ame's game, is a first-person shooter where you fight hordes of pumpkin creatures!
Pick your powerups wisely, as the pumpkin mutations will make your life hard!

Dr. Ninomae's evil laboratory of dangerous experimentations is a puzzle game where you use MATHS to help Ina transform Takodachis into perfect creatures!

Gawrzilla attacks lets you wreak havoc in a city as the most adorable kaiju ever, Gura!
Destroy skyscrapers and dodge nukes to score millions of points!

title: Banjo-Kazooie Online
description: A Banjo-Kazooie mod that adds online compatibility through ModLoader64.

title: Ara Ngc 6397
description:
ARA NGC 6397 is an action-adventure game where you take the role of an undercover agent wh must unravel the plot of conspiracy of an un unpopular governing alliance that hast taken over the Earth.

Gameplay is mixed between rail shooter and classic point 'n click graphic adventure across three different levels.

title: The Faces of Evil Remastered
description: A fan remaster of The Link: The Faces of Evil, an official Zelda game for the Phillips CD-i, changing some features of the original game in order to improve playability.

title: The Wand of Gamelon Remastered
description: A fan remaster of Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon, an official Zelda game for the Phillips CD-i, changing some features of the original game in order to improve playability.

title: Bingo
description: Dive into the captivating realm of Bingo! Venture into the pulsating Bingo Arena where every moment is charged with thrill and expectation.

title: Blood Ties: A Hidden Object Game with a Bite
Dwarven Destiny
description: A visual novel in which you are a human mage, summoned to the Dwarven Kingdom of Stonepeak to discover the origins of a mysterious artifact that's been recently unearthed. There you can romance six pursuable Dwarves.

title: Apathy: Narugami Gakuen Nana Fushigi
description: A first-year student Shuichi Sakagami a member of the school newspaper club is asked to gather information from the seven storytellers assembled by his seniors to feature about the school's seven mysteries.

title: Souen no Iseki
description: An adventure game in which you have the solve mysteries while talking with a friend.

title: Suzu to Mari no Bouken: The Ghost of Friend
Suzu to Mari no Bouken 2: Lost Colors and Golden Bells
Hungry Pigs
description: Become a pig and eat all the cabbage you can!

title: Hell-Hell
description: Hell Hell is a cooperative action stealth game that combines "tag" and "hide-and-seek. Players must work together to collect items in the stage as ordered, summon gates and escape from prison within a time limit, while hiding or running away to avoid detection by the demon that roam the stage.

title: Construction Simulator
description: Construction Simulator is back - bigger and better than ever! Get back to work and help yourself to a huge fleet of vehicles that will blow your mind. In addition to the brands already familiar from other games in the Construction Simulator series, such as Caterpillar, CASE and BELL, you can now take the wheel of new licensed construction machines from partners such as DAF and Doosan and choose from a total of over 70 construction machines!

title: Theater of Death
description: Wander through dark corridors, look into abandoned editing rooms, penetrate dusty archives and uncover the secrets of the movie studio and its employees. Collect puzzle pieces: Study notes, letters, photos, listen to audio recordings to understand what happened on the set of the cursed movie.

title: Lys and Ruka's Magical Bag
description: Something strange is afoot as a mysterious dungeon appears outside the town of Litos. Gather weapons and items to fight the enemies before and get out of sticky situations in this fast-paced action RPG from desunoya!

title: The Adventures of Peter Rabbit & Benjamin Bunny
The Adventures of Pinocchio
description: This is an interactive movie game based on the 1996 live action movie by the same name. After Pinocchio realizes his dream of becoming a real boy, the evil Lorenzini kidnaps him and turns him back into a puppet. You must help Pinocchio's creator, Geppetto, find and rescue him. You'll go through Pinocchio's home town, row a boat through monster-infested waters and visit Terra Magica, the fair where Lorenzini turns boys into donkeys. To succeed, you'll have to dodge deadly traps, solve puzzles and outwit Lorenzini's conniving henchmen. Sometimes, you'll have to turn yourself into a puppet, a fish, a bird or even a donkey to rescue Pinocchio. Along the way you must collect six passwords, each reflecting a lesson in morality that Pinocchio learns.

title: The Adventures of Pinocchio: Activity Center
Tetra Master
description:
Tetra Master was an online collectible card game available through the PlayOnline service on PlayStation 2 and Microsoft Windows. The game was based on the card minigame from Final Fantasy IX. It featured 250 cards from Final Fantasy IX and Final Fantasy X.

The service required an additional monthly fee of ‎¥100 JPY (‎¥105 JPY with tax), €1 EURO, £0.70 GBP, or $1 USD on top of the existing PlayOnline subscription. The online service was discontinued on December 31, 2010, rendering the game unplayable due to its lack of an offline mode.

In the original Japanese version of Final Fantasy IX, the minigame was called "Quad Mist," with the name written in English text on the game board. The English localization introduced the name "Tetra Master," which was subsequently used in both Japanese and English versions.

title: Through Time
description: Through Time is a single-player platform game in which you have to pass levels. The more levels you go, the more difficulty increases. Every month there is a new season with a new theme that is illustrated through the levels. You can unlock new characters and play with them, there are also temporary events in which you can unlock a lot of rewards.

title: Outer Terror
description:
An all-new hyper Minimalist stylized gameplay loop with advanced rogue-lite elements. Each player (1 or 2 players Co-Op) chooses from 10 survivors with various weapons and skills to battle against unending waves of otherworldly creatures.

As the difficulty increases, the player will be able to upgrade and gain new weapons and powers. Each map is massive and through exploration the player will discover other survivor hold outs and treasure.

title: The Mystery of the Mary Celeste
description:
The Mystery of the Mary Celeste is a hidden object game with adventure elements. The objective is to collect all the items shown at the bottom, as a series of black-and-white images on porthole windows, and use them to solve puzzles. Some portions of the scenery bring up a close-up window showing another angle of the scene, usually containing some of the required objects. Clicking on certain objects and characters opens up a number of connected containers around them, and the player has to drag and drop the collected tools from the inventory portholes to these blue circles, to complete the scene and move to the next one.

Mini-games usually appear at the end of each chapter, presenting various challenges and puzzles. A pipeline has to be reassembled with scattered pieces, lengths of rope must be untangled by dragging a series of pulleys, wires have to be connected to complete a circuit, red pins have to be fixed to a nautical map following a list of coordinates and a radio has to be tuned to the correct sound waves. The games can be skipped at any time.

title: Dot Kareshi: We're 8bit Lovers! III - Yami no Hanayome
description:
An RPG world with many "H" temptations!? Now is the time to carve out a new legend together with the characters who were changed when you played the game!

Features Dark Knight (Ankokukishi), Evil Overlord (Maou), Slime and Villager (Murabito).

title: EnantiO
description:
This very short game is an experience more than a real game.

Created for the "Meta Game Jam", this short interactive adventure offers the player to control a guy stuck in an appartement of two rooms lost in space. There is not really a story, as you can imagine, and the universe of the game is deeply absurd : the interest of EnantiO is in the "point & click" aspect and the way to finish the game.

title: Dot Kareshi: We're 8bit Lovers! II - Tenku no Kissu
description:
An RPG world with many "H" temptations!? Now is the time to carve out a new legend together with the characters who were changed when you played the game!

Features Beastmaster (Kemonotsukai), Dancer (Odoriko), Knight and Monk.

title: Quo
description: A first-person dystopian-horror sci fi-liminal adventure inspired by Backrooms. In this mission you are Quo, an autonomous robot explorer. Trace, probe and delve into an unexplored reality full of enigmas and dangers. Now it's your turn.

title: Dot Kareshi: We're 8bit Lovers! I - Densetsu no Otome
description:
An RPG world with many "H" temptations!? Now is the time to carve out a new legend together with the characters who were changed when you played the game!

Features Hero (Yuusha), Mage (Mahoutsukai), Priest (Souryo) and Thief.

title: The Table of N
description:
A blessed meal is an ingredient to a happy life.

Those who feed on humans, the Neversistas, have lived a life
close to an eternity.
They shoulder a melancholic feeling as they circle around the
dull dining table for yet another time.
However, they cannot stop feeding themselves.

The people fear the unknown Neversistas.
They victimise, hurt, and cast doubt on each other.
However, they cannot stop from being suspicious of others.

Even in this town, a widespread rumour about monsters that
terrorise people has initiated a "Neversista hunt" to
exterminate those that slipped into town.
The endless and repetitive mealtimes, suspicion, and love...

Will they be able to obtain a closure?

title: The Multipath Adventures of Superman: Menace of Metallo
The Great Tree
description: The Great Tree is a building game where you choose how to grow each branch of your tree, maintain enough resources to continue growing and reach higher and higher.

title: The Lord of the Rings: Treason of Isengard
description: The Lord of the Rings: The Treason of Isengard was a third-person action-adventure video game for PlayStation 2, Windows, and Xbox. It was the sequel of The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring and like its predecessor was based on the books. It was to be released by Vivendi Universal in late 2003 but was cancelled in September 2003 due to failing the standards Vivendi had set for their games.

title: UNO Undercover
description: Play Uno like you've never played it before! Uno World Tournament Adventure combines the interactive fun of classic Uno with addictive and exciting storylines. You can travel across the globe helping renowned Uno player and secret government spy Felicia Blue solve the case of the illegal Uno gambling operation, or just join a cast of eccentric characters for some high-spirited, traditional Uno fun. Either way you choose, Uno World Tournament Adventure is sure to provide endless hours of carefree Uno fun.

title: Kevin's Path to Wizdom
description: You play as Kevin, the handsomest wizard in school — until your face gets stolen! Learn gesture-based spellcasting as you beat challenging enemies through mind boggling mazes in this turn-based tactics game. Can you catch the thief and save face?

title: Saint Maribel
description: Saint Maribel is a metroidvania-action game with RPG elements. Marical goes to fight the queen of Succubus.

title: Goonya Monster
description: Goonya Monster is a party game where you go on a rampage playing as characters designed by Terada Tera. Split into Busters and Monsters to face off against one another! An absolutely absurd battle awaits you!

title: Blackhawk Striker 2
description: In Blackhawk Striker 2, you're a pilot for the 365 Assault Helicopter Co. Your job is to fly your bird with turbine power, 10 grunts, and a ton of grit. As the last pilot on this mission after a brutal night of heavy attacks, you'll need to fuel up and make a quick stop at the arming pits for some linked 7.62 for the M-60's. Colonel Jackson, a former West Point Officer, has hand-picked you to be his ace gunner along with a top-level flight crew. He clenches your shoulder and passes you a mission log from a well-known pilot, Jim "Ironhawk" Jones. "Good luck," says Colonel Jackson, "make us proud."

title: Blasterball Wild
description: Blasterball Wild is a Breakout clone developed and published by WildTangent.

title: Enionax
description:
Walk through the various eras of platformers with humour thanks to Enionax.

Go from black and white games to unmanageable patchless games! Go through all these eras again with humour.

title: Blast Miner!
description: Mix Constructive Thinking with Destructive Explosions! There's gold in them thar hills! Problem is, the gold lies deep in the cavernous puzzle rooms underneath them thar hills. Can you maneuver the gold out of the obstacle-laced mines? Strategically position a variety of different explosives, charges and other tools throughout each mine–try to come up with the correct mix and timing to blow gold pieces out through the mine shafts. Rack your brain, try numerous different explosive combinations! Each puzzle has multiple different solutions! Challenge yourself, create your own puzzles with the puzzle editor!

title: Tiny Tina's Wonderlands: Molten Mirrors
description:
Break into a heavily fortified prison in Vesper's third Mirror of Mystery! Fight past the turrets, hammers, and furnaces protecting Fyodor the Soul Warden to shatter the chains binding his captive souls.
Deep within his mountain stronghold, Fyodor the Soul Warden lords over his horde of lost souls.
In order to break their chains, you'll need to work past his murderous mechanized defenses, including terror-powered turrets, blazing furnaces, and bone-crushing hammers. But keep your wits about you, lest you become yet another of his captive souls!

title: Toree Genesis
description: A small(!) three level toree thing to celebrate the 31st birthday of that hedgehog.

title: Coco Nutshake
description:
Play for score in a 3-stage arcade fashion, getting a coconut milkshake from our girl Latatta to relieve her breasts of all the excess milk.

If you're doing well you might unlock sick shades that change the worlds colors!

title: In Heat: Lustful Nights
description: Tired of your current job? Are you missing the thrill that made you truly appreciate life? The Diamond Straits has just what you have been looking for! Experience our many resorts, while getting a big paycheck at the same time. Work hard enough and you might just earn a VIP EXPERIENCE of your own!

title: Narin: The Orange Room
description: Narin: The Orange Room is a third-person survival horror game. Play as Narin, a young girl with sixth-sense whose sister mysteriously disappeared. Narin accidentally got involved in the mystical dimension during the twilight time. Find her sister, solve the mystery, and uncover the truth.

title: Pleasure Party
description:
In this "Sandbox" style erotic game, you can choose from 12 diverse locations for your sex party, select from 15 different characters to invite, and place your characters into any of 24 different sexual positions including solo, standard, lesbian and anal.

Be creative as you create sex parties at a nudist resort, a night club, a quiet beach, a public block party and more.

title: Chrono Trigger
description: As the definitive version of Chrono Trigger, not only have the controls been updated, the graphics and sound have also been revamped to make your adventure even more fun and enjoyable to play. To complete your journey, also included is the mysterious ‘Dimensional Vortex’ dungeon and the forgotten ‘Lost Sanctum’ dungeon. Meet the challenges presented to you and long-lost secrets may be revealed...

title: Build It Green: Back to the Beach
description: Help the inhabitants of a tropical island protect their homes and go green in this exciting building game from National Geographic. Build environmentally friendly housing, investigate alternative fuels, and upgrade your facilities with the latest green technology. Earn points and prestige as you protect a precious island paradise from pollution and exploitation.

title: Zaccaria Pinball: Shooting the Rapids Table
description: Unlocks Shooting the Rapids Retro table for Zaccaria Pinball.

title: Beltane: A strange encounter at Duloe - Stone Circle
description: Police and local people are baffled by phone cam footage that seems to show extraordinary phenomena over the 4000 year old stone circle, in Duloe, Cornwall. Experts are examining the footage, filmed by a local farmer, in the hope that sceptical eyes may reveal what the farmer describes as an "encounter". Is it a drone? Faked? Experimental military craft? Or a power generated by the stones themselves? Play to find out.

title: Guru-guru Suika
description: A doujin game by Desunoya based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Amaemi: Longing for you
description:
The protagonist, Nabeshima Tatsuya, was a world-renowned painter.

However, after a certain incident, he disappeared from the public eye.
Now as a social studies teacher, he spends his days away from the art world.

He lives in seclusion with his cat in his social studies preparation room, which is his own residence, away from the public eye.
However, with the arrival of the new school semester, a new wind begins to blow.

Kusunoki Iroha, an attractive girl who adores Tatsuya.

Kurusu Sakuya, the most talented girl in the school, who mysteriously invites Tatsuya to the school;

and Akebi Saki, the daughter of Tatsuya's former teacher.

A life of dullness, like being dead inside while living.
Now it is being colored in gorgeous and vibrant colors by the three girls.

title: HoloCure: Save the Fans!
description: Welcome to HOLOCURE! This is a free, unofficial fangame featuring the vtuber talents of Hololive and its surrounding community, with gameplay heavily inspired by Vampire Survivors and Magic Survival. Collect powerful weapons and items and experiment with all kinds of character builds to create the ultimate character! Will you be able to save the endless waves of fans, and reach the top rankings?

title: Kokorowa Onigiri Delivery
description: A doujin game based on Sakuna: Of Rice and Ruin, developed by Desunoya.

title: Movie Quest
description: Remember the times at the movies? Maybe you've got friends all over the world or want to go on a virtual date? How will you get together to watch a movie? With Movie Quest you can! Settle down and watch a movie, quest, roleplay, challenge each other to get through a horror show!

title: ZpellCatz
description: ZpellCatz is an action RPG with spell casting cats. Players can explore an island with lots of randomly generated dungeons, level up and find loot.

title: Kira-kira Star Night AC
description: Kira Kira Star Night AC is an arcade adaptation of Kira Kira Star Night DX created to promote the release of its console cousin. It plays almost exactly the same: players take on the role of Fami-chan, catching falling stars to try and achieve a high score. The gameplay in this version is slightly tweaked, with Fami-chan now having two different jump heights based on the jump button the player chooses. It had a limited release of one cabinet at the Kaden no Ken-chan store in Akihabara before later being released on CD-ROM for Windows.

title: Kira-kira Star Night: Furusato Nouzei Fujimino-ban
description: The new character graphics and seven songs on the level 2 stage of "Kira Kira Star Night DX" have been redesigned.

title: Paragon Pioneers
description: Paragon Pioneers is a city-building idle game in which you discover, conquer and then build on islands to fulfill the needs of your inhabitants. Even with limited time to play you can enjoy this deep simulation game and follow one of the countless ways to optimize your empire. Build an impressive palace and go down in history as Paragon's most successful leader.

title: A Hero's Rest: An RPG Town Simulator
description: Build shops, craft items with hundreds of customization options, and manage your resources wisely to lead your Heroes to success. Immerse yourself as proprietor of a medieval fantasy town in a world abounding with Heroes and Monsters.

title: Decimated
description: Decimated is a 3rd person multiplayer online survival RPG. Fight against or team up with other players, scavenge loot, transport cargo or VIPs to other locations, collect legal or illegal resources and trade them, hunt legendary creatures, capture territory and build safehouses for their gang.

title: Kouei no Tou
description: An online 3D shooting game where players divided into 2 teams, "Light" and "Shadow" and buttles 4 vs 4 in max. Players ride on a machine which moves automatically and occupy "Tower" which are placed in stages. It is important for players to get power up items and weapons in the stage.

title: Nature Prhysm
description: A unique freeware rhythm game played on three stacked rows of four buttons. Color divides incoming notes by row and mixes together to mark chords.

title: Magic Chaos
description: "MAGIC CHAOS" is an online multiplayer bullet-hell shooting party game for up to 4 players. Customize your own unique combination of diverse characters and strategic skills to win the seriously chaotic battle royale!

title: Chikarou
description: Chikaro is a 2D action game featuring pixel art graphics that incorporate light expressions. The player uses the action of out-of-body experience to explore the field by manipulating enemies and gimmicks.

title: Miniature Land: Four Seasons
description: An escape room game made by hand-building and photographing miniature scenes. Explore a miniature world in live-action and enjoy feeling like you're really there.

title: Akari no Ouji to Kageri no Tou
Hyakka Girl
description:
Every object on the map can be a weapon or tool!
Show the object to the scholar-chan and register it in the encyclopedia!

title: Kamiyogatari
description: Play as a member of the Imperial Summoner Academy's Hero class, team up with powerful summoners and spirits, and explore the world of O-Yashima, mixing Sci-Fi, fantasy and traditional Japan, in this Summoner-Action RPG featuring strategic magical battles and high speed 2D action.

title: Marine Hearts
description: You are now a heart wandering the sea. "Marine Hearts" is a first-person 3D deep-sea omnidirectional bullet-hell shooter. You pursue the mysteries of the sea while losing your body and becoming only your mind.

title: Winter Survival
description: Winter Survival is a story-driven survival game where trauma turns reality into a reflection of your breaking mind. Battle cold, hunger, hallucinations, and adapt to the wilderness as it adapts to you.

title: Chronicles of Tal'Dun: The Remainder
description: Interactive story about two magi trying to survive a failed ritual. Learn from their deaths and untangle the mystery before you. Guide their actions as they come to terms with their past mistakes, and find forgiveness and love for each other.

title: Codename: Apocalypse
description: Codename: Apocalypse is a rogue-like deck-building game that combines role-playing and deck-building elements as one. Play as a normal civilian and try to live as usual, while an unknown doomsday crisis is approaching. Collect various cards to create your own story in the coming apocalypse.

title: Loose Lips Side: Sunnyday
description: This is the second installment in the Loose Lips BL suspense series.

title: Shattered Between
description: A dynamic roguelike shooter, where you can experiment with weapons and special abilities, wander through various rooms-worlds and defeat opponents! Will you pass the tests and reach the final goal?

title: Sheba: A New Dawn
description: Sheba: A New Dawn is an action adventure metroidvania game that takes you through a compelling story of revenge and despair. Fight your way through the next decisive battle, A New Dawn. Explore the world of Sheba and the corruption of Jinn possessions.

title: Between Horizons
description: Between Horizons is a narrative 2.5D sci-fi detective adventure. 33 years into the Zephyr's journey, its mission is suddenly jeopardized. Can you find the culprit before it's too late? Experience an enthralling story set in a semi-open world that branches and ends based on your choices.

title: Moviehouse
description: Welcome to the big show! Moviehouse is the game film-fans have been waiting for. Ready the camera, unleash your creativity and create the flicks you’ve always dreamed of. Grow your operation with your razor-sharp business sense and usher in a new era for filmmakers worldwide…or fail trying. After all, this business is like a box of chocolates—you never know what you’re gonna get.

title: Angon: The Grim Age
description: In Angon: The Grim Age, strategy faces a medieval apocalyptic world about survival and politics. Enter into the journey that leads the world to chaos and misery, exploring unique places on the wasted land of Eradon. Take decisions that can shape the destiny of the people, battle on turn-based old RPG style and immerse yourself in the rich and deep lore with unique npcs that actually cares with your actions.

title: Virtua Unlimited Project
description: Virtua Unlimited Project is a 2D pixel-art style ACT game featuring VTuber characters. With classical platformer gameplay, challenging combat, and retro game feelings, VUP presents you a surreal, virtual world in which you will play as Aizawa Kana to venture and seek the truth beneath.

title: Chaosground: The Siege for Freedom
description: A new type of "siege party FPS" brought to you by high school students who love FPS. Experience the chaotic war for castle control!

title: 7 Days Heroes
description: A 2D pixel action game. Control a squad of four characters to fight against zombies!

title: Byte Cats
description: A highly challenging action game. Control three cats to clear stages with numerous gimmicks awaiting you!

title: Shuumatsu Shoujo
description: An action game with two girls fighting together to survive the end of the world where crazy people roam.

title: Tick Tack Puppet
description: Action game with unusual controls. It's free now. Use the mouse to control the puppet's limbs and beat up invaders from outer space. Time slows down while you are not controlling the puppet. Dodge bullets, punch enemies, and move stylishly!

title: Yumemiru Pyon-pyon Land
description: Yumemiru Pyon-pyon Land is a music/rhythm game.

title: Ekika Queen's Iand
description: This is a horror-comedy youth violence novel game.

title: Cold Bed on Route
description: "Cold Bed on Route" is an equation-like rogue-lite adventure game.

title: Chizome Kijo
description: A savage action game where you become stronger as you slaughter.

title: Astralbringer: Shaded Arkarium
description: STG has reached a new frontier! 2D bullet-hell sci-fi action shooter with mouse control and multiple buttons!

title: Blue's Clues: Meet Blue's Baby Brother
Boggle
description: So you think you’re fast at finding words? Prove it! Challenge yourself or up to 3 friends online in a refreshed, updated Boggle experience. There’s still the same Boggle you like. You can also play with a suite of different variants and house rules to really shake things up! Search fast and act faster… it’s an all-new way to play Boggle!

title: Bottle Buster
description: Very loosely based on the carnival game, Bottle Buster asks you to knock down all the bottles in each level.

title: Bounce Out Blitz
description: Bounce Out Blitz is a straightforward tile-matching game where the player has to make matches of three or more rubber balls of the same type.

title: Give Up the Ghost: A Puzzle Checklist
description: 50 transdimensional puzzles, no filler!

title: Brain Games: Brain Puzzles 2
description: A compilation of Mahjongg, Challenge, Asianata, ABC Island, Rolling Marbles, and Real Jigsaw Puzzle.

title: Brain Training For Dummies
description: Engage your intellect with 10 fun challenging games to keep your mind fit! Increase your reaction time and improve your memory with great brain building games.

title: SoyMilk Runner
description: Game based on SoyMilk streamer and her friends.

title: He Fucked the Girl Out of Me
description: He Fucked The Girl Out Of Me is a semi-autobiographical narrative visual novel about trauma and sex work made for the GameBoy. The author explains how sex work impacted her life and changed her perception of the world. The game takes approximately 40 minutes to play from start to finish.

title: Megaman X Unleashed
description: Megaman X Unleashed is a fangame with the intention of showing that there are still Megaman fans around the world. This project has the mission to create a fighting game based on the series Megaman X in 32-bit style, reviving the nostagia and putting a dream to see mavericks fighting against others in a 2d reindeer in practice with more than 20 selectable characters, including bosses and Secret Characters.

title: Ichigeki Nyuukon! Panda Ball
description:
Use the mouse to smack the panda ball!
Pick up various weapons, roll at amazing speeds!
A 3D mouse-controlled action game.

title: Flappy Tobari
description: This is a mini-game in which you play by dodging objects that seem to fly and hurt you.

title: Nevermore: Documentary Kinetic Novel
description:
Documentary kinetic novel. From the place of a heroin dealer detention. On the backside of a drug’s pop image.

In sleeping areas of Moscow outskirts where supplications, inevitable diagnosis and inappeasable demon of addiction are present.

title: Vivid/Stasis
description:
vivid/stasis is a rhythm-mystery game that follows the fate and feelings of a group of girls as they get wrapped up in a mind-bending adventure involving organizations, mysterious disappearances, and the fourth dimension.

The game ties together an immense and interweaving storyline with varying levels of music-based gameplay... and more...?

title: Elden Ring GB
description: What if Elden Ring released in 1993? Elden Ring GB is a demake of Elden Ring that runs on real retro hardware including all Game Boy consoles, as well as in emulators and on Analogue Pocket. You can also play it right here in your browser, though the other methods are recommended to allow for saving, better colours and higher accuracy. Explore all of the Precipice of Anticipation, Northern Limgrave and Stormveil Castle in this bite-sized demake experience made in GB Studio.

title: Virtomae
description:
A 2000s-style fully customizable virtual pet game!

Take care of your virtual buddy of choice! Have fun together (play an increasing number of minigames, listen to music and watch videos) to make sure they are satisfied! You can also connect with your friends! Return to your pet daily to help it prosper! As presented during the SGDA Summit 2022 Student Games Showcase!

title: Farming Simulator 22: Zetor 25 K
description: Start the motor and enjoy the sound of some European agricultural tradition: With the Zetor Z-25 K, you till your fields with a four-stroke, twin-cylinder diesel engine from another era. Built by the Czech manufacturer Zetor between the early 1950s and late 1960s, the authentic rebuild tractor for Farming Simulator 22 adds a unique and old-school charm to your farm.

title: Farming Simulator 22: Fendt 900 Black Beauty
description: Strong, black, and beautiful: Get the Fendt 900 Vario Black Beauty for Farming Simulator 22, and award your farm with some dark elegance when you roam the roads and fields. With up to 415 units of horsepower for the top configuration, and the striking design of the Fendt Vario series, you’ll be ready for more - whatever your farming operation requires.

title: Farming Simulator 22: Mack Trucks - Black Anthem
description: With the Mack Black Anthem for Farming Simulator 22, you haul in style and all in black: The iconic American truck by Mack Trucks is bursting with strength and style, built for your extended farming operation. Enjoy the authentically digitized design of the Black Anthem, and get your produce on the road!

title: Epiplaphobia
description:
Welcome to our furniture store's dresser section. Stay a while, stay forever!

Run as fast as you can from a haunted dresser without looking back in this retro-style first-person endless runner from the creator of Virtomae. Tap with your fingers and try your best to avoid getting caught by the feral beast. The title features a couple of different difficulty modes and device-based highscores.

title: Twilight
description: Twilight is a small dividing line between light and darkness. Sometimes you have to choose where you should stay and for what purpose.

title: Optimal Conditions for a Sacrifice
description: It’s very straightforward and approximately 5k words short and has slightly different offering outcomes but they all lead to the same one ending; couple of dead-ends are present in case you mess up.

title: Shobon no Rukimin! DX: Shobomi to Yuki no Tiara
Dappou Undead Factory
description: A dark simulation where you work immortals to make flesh, fight off enemies, and build factories! Events and biohazards may occur...?

title: Kyua
description: A metafiction RPG set in a real world.

title: Tokyo Coffee Pandechika
description: "Tokyo Coffee Pandechika" is a cafe game that nostalgically depicts the pandemic in Tokyo.

title: Tales From Toyotoki: Arrival of the Witch
description: A boy moves to a remote island in Okinawa and is informed that his grandfather, who was supposed to take care of him, has evaporated. When he is ready to fend for himself on the remote island, he meets a girl who calls herself a witch. The girl deals with magic from another world and life on a remote island where Ryukyuan culture is deeply rooted. What fate awaits them both? ────

title: Uchi no Tenjouura ga Sawagashisugite Shouganai Slowly Neko-hen
Kofun ha Ikiteiru: Maholova Club no Shitai Sagashi
Finrendly
description: High-speed one-step action using squares.

title: Dyna Marisa 3D
description: DynaMarisa 3D is a 3D third-person Touhou Project shooter fangame released by Twilight Frontier that parodies Sandlot's Earth Defense Force 2017. This game features stereoscopic 3D graphics, activated by through the Options menu, this allow for 3D graphics on computers using video cards that support for stereoscopic 3D graphics.

title: Insanity
description:
Insanity is a freeware horror-style adventure game by Uri made in WOLF RPG Editor.

A group of high-school friends is talked into exploring an abandoned mansion.
Before long, they discover a dead body. They hurry to call the police, but find the front door's stuck.
As they search for another way out, they learn the truth about what happened in this house...

title: Autumn Wish
description: Young witches Celia and Fen enjoy an evening full of magic and happiness together in town, but Celia finds herself wrestling with some complicated feelings and dangerous obstacles. Draw runes to cast spells, explore town, and be a gay mess of a witch in this narrative RPG visual novel!

title: Super Vadimka IV Evil Returns the Horrors of Vadimka's Adventures
