description: Super Vadimka IV Evil Returns the Horrors of Vadimka's Adventures is an action-adventure video game in the platformer genre.

title: Ronin Trail
description: Ronin Trail is an open-world adventure game about a wandering samurai searching for his purpose. You play as a survivor of war who must take on odd jobs and bounties to make a living. The game takes place at the start of the Edo period in Japan, shortly after the country was ravaged with war. As you travel through the countryside, chaos persists as disbanded soldiers form violent gangs that terrorize the villagers. It's up to you to bring peace back to the valley.

title: The Fazbear Facility
description: The Fazbear Facility is a FNaF Fangame directed by PhantronGames that is currently in development or has released depending on when you're reading this, all rights to Five Nights at Freddy's belong to Scott Cawthon

title: Backroom Beyond
description:
Backroom Beyond is a first-person game that mixes puzzles with single-player adventure in a dark, harrowing environment that makes the player question the protagonist's sanity. Based on the internet myth, Backroom Beyond goes further and makes the player wonder if that journey is about something more personal than anything else.

The narrative has two main points. Drawings tell part of the game's story on the walls. The drawings have no defined authorship, which gives them an extra degree of strangeness. The second point is the existence of The Guide, a being that instigates the players to think about their actions in real life.

The game basically has one objective throughout its 40-level journey: place the red box over the red button and open the door to the next level. It seems simple at first, but it's not. Each environment has its own logic. If the players feel frustrated because something went wrong in their strategy, they can press the “wake up again" button, which will return them to the beginning of the level.

title: Agos
description:
Agos is a 2d, side-scrolling, open-world online RPG with PvE and PvP
in which you collect items to help you conquer your foes.

title: Untold Secrets: Lost in Time
description: Untold Secrets: Lost in Time is a five-game hidden object compilation for PC. Explore exotic locations and solve hundreds of puzzles across Time Riddles: The Mansion, Unexpected Journey, The Lost Kingdom Prophecy, Relic Hunt, and My Beautiful Vacation. Track clues, uncover secrets, and complete mini‑games as you travel, interview colorful characters, and piece together each story.

title: Tang Chi
description:
Reunite the Seven Pieces and Something Magical Happens

Tang Chi

Journey into a timeless realm where the power of the mind makes geometry take on form and substance--experience the mystical power of Tang Chi, the ancient Chinese puzzle that comes to life before your eyes. Master the power inherent in the pure simplicity of these seven classical forms. Follow the way of the shapes to ultimate mastery of the mystical puzzle known as Tang Chi.

Tang Chi is a challenge for agile minds of all ages. Play it alone, or play it with your family and friends. Play it at home, or use it at work for an invigorating mental break that's completely caffeine-free.

Tang Chi, the ideal challenge for the mind.

title: Ultimate Pinball
description:
Ultimate Pinball is a series of 20 different pinball tables which run from separate executables from the launcher. They are grouped by the following categories: Space, Historic, Monster, Sports, and Places.

The tables themselves run on the Balls of Steel game engine. Like that game, each of these pinball tables is presented in an overhead view with a "dot pixel" display at the bottom of the screen which relays the player's score, messages and bonuses.

The "goal" of each table varies with the theme but generally the player is expected to shoot & ricochet their pinball into specific places in specific orders. The player's controls are to move the paddle on the left, move the paddle on the right, launch a new ball and "tilt" (shake) the pinball machine.

title: The Serpent of Isis
description: A Hidden Object Adventure game spanning across Europe, in the search of a lost treasure discovered by your grandfather, which was stolen at some point. It features many varied and interesting levels interspersed with fun (skippable) minigames. The games has a optional feature to turn off time limits to make the game easier. It has a cast of interesting characters, full of mystique.

title: The Bibleman Videogame Adventure: A Fight for Faith
description:
Now is your chance to help the greatest heroes of all time! Join Bibleman and the Bible Adventure Team in this highly engaging interactive adventure! Based on the best-selling Bibleman videos and national live-tour, A Fight for Faith, players can choose to be Bibleman, Cypher or Biblegirl.

Featuring 9 levels of action, adventure and challenging puzzles, video and sounds from the Bibleman video, as well as original music by the Rock n' Roll Worship Circus, players must take on the Wacky Protester and his henchmen in order to save the children of Andersonville, using the Biblical scripture and the Full Armor of God.

title: Trivial Pursuit: Bring on the 90's Edition
The Elder Scrolls: Arena - Deluxe Edition
Microsoft Train Simulator: Sandpatch
description: Experience the challenge of hauling heavy CSX freight through the tight and winding Alleghenies. Navigate the vast Cumberland Yard on complex switching duties, and do battle with nail-biting grades, all in Train Sim World 2: Sand Patch Grade.

title: Nordic Ashes: Survivors of Ragnarok
description:
Norse themed Roguelike enemy hell, where you’ll have to survive hordes of creatures that come your way. Unlock new weapons and abilities as you battle. Upgrade your character's stats with Constellation Ability Trees and slay your enemies before they surround you, or it may be too late…

Fight all sorts of beasts, from basic creatures to Elite monsters and Epic bosses with their own AI. Don’t be fooled, even minions can be pretty dangerous!

Unlock new weapons and abilities as you battle. Upgrade your characters’ stats with Constellation Ability Trees and slay your enemies before they surround you, or it may be too late…

After Ragnarok, Yggdrasil, the World Tree, lost almost all of its energy to sustain the Nine Realms. Only a few heroes survived the End of the World. In this Technical Demo you’ll play as Axeldör, a Norse berserker, Thyra a fierce hunter, and Hafgrim, a master of the elements. Wield a legendary sword, or maybe conjure ancient fire to slay all the enemies that have reached your realm to conquer its remains.

Design different builds and make each run different by using the Constellation Ability Trees to upgrade your damage, area, cooldown and many more stats during each run.

title: Skull and Bones: Limited Edition
description: Enter the Golden Age of Piracy as you sail through rich merchant trade routes. Embody an insatiable pirate captain, dive into the battle for the ruling of the Indian Ocean and become the most feared pirate, alone or with your gang of up to 5 players.

title: Yuru-fuwa Ball
description: A doujin game by Desunoya based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Yuru-huwa Souls
description: It is an authentic fantasy that provides a sense of accomplishment in conquering stages.

title: Horse Tales: Emerald Valley Ranch
description: Set off on a captivating horseback adventure and discover the mysteries of Emerald Valley!

title: Smurfs Kart
description: That is the question you will need to answer in this dynamic kart racing game in the world of Smurfs! The whole family can choose one Smurf, its kart and special power, then you’re ready to go on wild races!

title: Bassmaster Fishing 2022: Super Deluxe Edition
description: Experience the thrill of competitive big bass fishing and climb the ranks to become the Bassmaster Classic champion!

title: Caesar's Palace VIP Series: BlackJack
description: Caesars Palace VIP Series Blackjack is a 1998 "gambling simulation" published by Interplay, focused on Blackjack card game variants.

title: Capcom Coin-Op Collection Volume 1
description: Capcom's Coin-op Collection Volume 1 is a compilation of five arcade games: 1942, Commando, Side Arms Hyperdyne, Vulgus, and Ghosts 'n Goblins.

title: Run to Nowhere
description: A minute-long horror game styled like a silent film.

title: The Mirst
description: The Mirst is a horror game, you will be unleashed in front of your house where bizarre events are going to happen to you to find the origin of it all.

title: Donut Crabs
description: Donut Crabs is a physics puzzle game. Control the platforms and guide the donut along the trajectory you set. Help the crab collect all the donuts on the island and solve the huge amount of relaxing and, sometimes, hard puzzles!

title: Ultimaze
description: Ultimaze is a tile-based puzzle game about navigating small labyrinths.

title: The Adventures of Big Faz
description: A 2D Platformer where you must defeat BigWill and return the potatoes to the people

title: Rainbow Aliceland
description: A doujin game by Desunoya based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Hidden Mysteries: Return to Titanic
description: Solve Hidden Mysteries in Hidden Mysteries: Return to Titanic! After using a secret alias to board the Titanic, things go terribly wrong and you find yourself trapped among the wreckage. In order to earn freedom from your watery tomb you must appease your captor by re-writing history and freeing the spirits trapped aboard the 'unsinkable' luxury liner as well as discover why fate has chosen this destiny for you.

title: Bales of Amber
description:
Welcome to the end of the world. In this Kafka-esque dystopia, the government has gathered all remaining animals in order to form the Animal Factorization Initiative. Now you live in an apartment inside a whale.

This surrealist seascape creates an opportunity to be an intimate part of the ecosystem you live in in a way that you never have been before.

title: Niravasi
description:
In ages past, there existed a city unlike any other. From the strength and unity of humanity, Niravasi was born. But when a brutal war ravaged the world itself, Niravasi became lost to the depths of space. Some say its people remain unharmed, while others speak of dark horrors residing in its streets. In the end, these are just stories.

But Niravasi is real.

title: Sushi vs. Remilia Scarlet
description: A doujin game by Kyuushoku Touban based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Touhou Madan Zan: Unbelieved Heroes
description: A doujin game by INSIDE SYSTEM based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Touhou Madan Zan Shun-pu: Unbelieved Heroes
description: A doujin game by INSIDE SYSTEM based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Touhou Madan Zan Cronica: Unbelieved Heroes
description: A doujin game by INSIDE SYSTEM based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Saints & Sinners Bingo
description: Hilarious character dialogue and a catchy original soundtrack set the stage for this exciting bingo game with something for everyone. In Saints and Sinners Bingo, you play in 20 different cities across the country, competing alongside a colorful cast of opponents as you make your way to the International Bingo Championships. The special Good Luck Charms you'll collect along the way add a dash of strategy to a classic game of luck, giving you strategic 'moves' that improve your chances of winning! With 3 game modes and over 100 bingo patterns, Saints and Sinners will have you in bingo heaven.

title: Total Pinball 25: 3D Tables
description: Total Pinball 25 is an Action game, developed by Stellar Stone and published by GameMill Publishing,

title: Tower of the Ancients
description:
A full 360 degrees of puzzle madness - filled with mind-challenging, full colour graphics. Experience the power of the tower with a look-and-feel that will take you away from your mundane life. Challenge your dexterity and your mind with the newest brain bending 3d puzzle game.
Turn the Platform to line up your blocks witch fall from the sky rendered in a beautiful 3d environment. Listen to the surreal music score and become totally immersed in the action. The key to success, mind over matter, speed and persistence.

title: Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary
description: Entirely rebuilt from the ground up, Q.U.B.E. 10th Anniversary is the ultimate celebration of the decade-old original, bringing refined visuals, completely redesigned and revised gameplay sections, and a whole new chapter to the award-winning, brain-twisting first-person puzzler.

title: My Golf Game featuring Ernie Els
My Horse Farm: Welcome to Trotterville
Panzer Campaigns Budapest '45
description: It was dawn on New Year's Day in the last year of the war. The enemies of the Reich were closing in on both the East and West Fronts. The Germans had squandered much of their last panzer reserves against the Americans at the Battle of the Bulge. In the east, the lines were holding pending the next major offensives by the Soviet juggernaut, and while Stalin continually hounded his generals to finish off the pocket of German and Hungarian troops holding Budapest, the Germans still had another offensive in them. They launched Operation Konrad - an offensive that almost succeeded in relieving the surrounded troops. Can you succeed where the Germans failed?

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Bloodhound
description: Meet the Bloodhound, your new best friend and the first ever hunting dog in theHunter: Call of the Wild. Use it to track the scent of blood from injured prey, match its traits to your hunting style, and forge a bond that will last a lifetime. The Bloodhound is the most efficient and loyal sidekick a hunter could ever want.

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Free Species: European Rabbit
description: The European Rabbit is a social and territorial animal known for living in large underground burrow systems called warrens. Recently, an expansive network of warrens was discovered near the crop fields in the Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve in Germany. This DLC is free for owners of theHunter: Call of the Wild

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Saseka Safari Trophy Lodge
description: It’s time to present your prize trophies in the fashion they deserve. The luxurious and exotic design of the Saseka Safari is perfect to show off your single and multi trophy mounts, or to showcase your favourite weapons on gun racks.

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - TruRACS
description:
The long awaited TruRACS (short for True Random Antler Configuration System) has finally arrived to theHunter: Call of the Wild, allowing for an even more immersive hunting experience. Thanks to the system’s randomization of antlers and the introduction of TruScore, a more accurate way of providing a Trophy Rating, players can now encounter animals with antlers of varying sizes and shapes within the same species, with horns and tusks to come in the future.

TruRACS will be a constantly evolving system and new species will be continuously introduced through future free updates.

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Trophy Lodge Spring Creek Manor
description: Every experienced hunter ends up amassing a sizable trophy collection that deserves to be presented in an appropriate fashion. Spring Creek Manor is perfect as a Trophy Lodge, so show off your prized harvests in a true rustic style.

title: Lorelei and the Laser Eyes
description:
A woman, summoned by an eccentric man to participate in a project in an old hotel somewhere in central Europe, becomes embroiled in a game of illusions, increasingly dangerous and surreal.

Now you are invited to fall into the same rabbit hole, in a non-linear mystery with an immense amount of handcrafted puzzles, constantly presenting you with new riddles to solve, each leading you closer to deciphering the enigma of Lorelei and the Laser Eyes.

title: Super Bomberman R 2
description: A sequel to Super Bomberman R, featuring an expanded story mode, and a new "Castle" battle mode which has one group teaming up to build castle defenses while the other attempts to breach the castle and take the treasure.

title: Little Noah: Scion of Paradise
description: Join the genius alchemist Noah and her cat companion Zipper as they explore ancient ruins to uncover the secrets hidden within! Create unique teams and combos from 40+ recruitable allies in this casual but compelling game!

title: Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection
description: Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection features all 10 mainline games in the Mega Man Battle Network series!

title: Pac-Man World Re-Pac
description: With polished graphics, enhanced gameplay, and updated features, Pac-Man World Re-Pac is action/platforming fun for both experienced Pac-fans and new Pac-thusiasts the world over!

title: Blanc
description: Blanc is an artistic cooperative adventure that follows the journey of a wolf cub and a fawn stranded in a vast, snowy wilderness. They must come together in an unlikely partnership to find their families.

title: Doraemon Story of Seasons: Friends of the Great Kingdom
description: Doraemon, Noby and their friends land on an unknown planet and decide to help a new friend fulfill his dreams—by farming! Plow the fields, harvest crops and tend to the animals. You can even use Doraemon’s secret gadgets to farm in a flash! Relax by living with friends, eating delicious meals and fishing. And with local play, you and a pal can build a ranch together!

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Wild Goose Chase Gear
description: With the appearance of Hirschfelden’s first field fowl, the Canada Goose, it was time for Connie and Doc to order some new items for the store.

title: Harvestella
description: Introducing a brand-new fantasy x life simulation RPG from Square Enix! Through the changing seasons, explore an imaginative world, tend your crops, make new friends, face enemies in dynamic combat, and unravel the mystery of the season of death, Quietus.

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Backpacks
description:
When preparing for a hunting trip, you have to anticipate the hours or days ahead. What prey will you hunt? Where will you go? How long will you be out?
Often, you’ll want to travel light to decrease weight and stay agile in rough terrain. But other times, you just want to take as much gear as possible and go for longer stretches. To accommodate those epic hunting trips, the reserve wardens have added three new backpacks to the store.

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Shooting Range
description: Lately our wardens have received requests from you, our hunters, to add a shooting range so that you could get to know your weapons a little better. Well, your wishes have not fallen on deaf ears and Conni, with help from her friends, has built a brand new, top of the line, shooting range in Hirschfelden.

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Facing the Wild 1
description: As Doc likes to say, there are as many opinions on the perfect hunting experience as there are hunters. Making your own decisions and personalizing your hunt is what it’s all about. That’s why, in this character customization DLC, we have added new options to give you more diversity and more choice when it comes to creating your hunter. But it’s not just the characters that get a ‘facelift’ - there are also new fur variations for all animals in both reserves.

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Bearclaw Lite Compound Bow
description:
The Bearclaw Lite Compound Bow is the first free DLC for theHunter: Call of the Wild, and contains a premium bow available for purchase using in-game currency.

The Bearclaw Lite CB-60 is a premium color variation of the Razorback Lite CB-60. It's sleek, quiet, and just as efficient as any rifle in the hands of a skilled archer. Mainly used for small and medium-sized game.

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - New Species 2018
description: When the reserves initially opened, 12 animal species were huntable between Layton Lake District and Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve, and an additional 4 in Medved-Taiga National Park and 7 in Vurhonga Savanna (paid DLC content). The ecosystems of these reserves are ever-changing, sometimes leading to the emergence of new species…

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - New Species 2019
description: Upon the initial opening of the reserves, there were 10 huntable animal species between Layton Lake District and Hirschfelden Hunting Reserve, an additional 4 in Medved-Taiga National Park, 7 in Vurhonga Savanna, and 6 in Parque Fernando. Since then, the reserves have, between them, received 4 new species, including the Gemsbok, Canada Goose and more. The ecosystems change, as new species emerge...

title: Power Strife Deathmatch
description:
Power Strife Deathmatch is a game with all the hallmarks of old-school deathmatch, you've got your B-hopping, your selection of impractical (and fun) guns all with their own unique alt-fire abilities, you've got weird maps with strange secrets to find, and best yet... A log-book where you can learn all about the characters, weapons and items you'll find in the strangest deathmatch game ever created...

Oh, and I forgot to mention the best part... It also features random item pickups ala mario kart... Just in case you needed the gameplay to get even more hectic...

title: Carnivorous
description: A hybrid racing/hunting game.

title: Carrie the Caregiver: Episode 2 - Preschool
description: Carrie the Caregiver 2: Preschool is the second episode of the hit casual game series combining arcade action with thoughtful and elegant puzzle design.

title: Start Survey 2
description: Alone in a research station on a faraway moon, conduct an environmental survey of your surroundings to discover the source of the anomalous signals. Just be sure you catch it all on tape.

title: Derelikt
description: Survive the dark corridors of a space station in Saturns orbit in this narrative retro FPS with faithful PS1 aesthetics. Meet over a dozen unique NPCs, manage your inventory, solve puzzles and fight against the eldritch abominations!

title: Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection Vol. 1
description: The renowned Mega Man Battle Network series is back! Vol. 1 contains Mega Man Battle Network 1-3, including both versions of Mega Man Battle Network 3 for a total of four titles, plus additional features like a gallery of illustrations and music! In addition, online play is supported!

title: Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection Vol. 2
description: The renowned Mega Man Battle Network series, which has expanded into anime and comics, is back. Volume 2 includes six action packed games from both versions of Mega Man Battle Network 4 to both versions of Mega Man Battle Network 6, plus additional features like a gallery and online play!

title: Quantum Bummer Blues
description: Escape from space prison, smash atoms, chase high scores, and paint pretty pictures with the river of your blood.

title: Castlevania Fighter
description: Castlevania Fighter is a M.U.G.E.N based/homebrewed Castlevania fangame.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask Online
description: A mod which allows online multiplayer while playing The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask. This mod needs an application called ModLoader64 to work.

title: Mischief Makers Online
description: A mod which allows online multiplayer while playing Mischief Makers. This mod needs an application called ModLoader64 to work.

title: TTV4
description: TTV4 is the latest volume of the retro hardcore maze wanderer minigame series Trip to Vinelands.

title: Mindfulness Simulator: ASMR Meditation Game
description: Wander freely through the forest as your own Ego or as a Stone. Explore the procedurally-generated environment listening to Alan Watts' teachings about Mindfulness, Meditation, Peace and Happiness. Play with ASMR Grass when you roll over it with varying weather and time of day. Just be mindful.

title: Dee's Nuts
description: Dee is a squirrel, who lives in a tree. Like any squirrel, Dee must collect nuts for the winter. Dee needs your help to collect as many nuts as possible and store them in the tree. Along the way, you will have to dodge threats from above and collect power-ups to aid you.

title: Evertwine
description:
Evertwine is a free to play trading card game that uses blockchain technology which means that you actually own the cards you play with.

Whether you are learned in the ways of blockchain mechanics and card games or are just a novice, there is a place for you here. The rich world of the game will keep you entranced while you find your own path through it.

Collect cards, battle, and trade with other players. And the best part of it – paywalls will not stop you from experiencing the full scope of the game.

title: Spellcast
description: SPELLCAST combines the strategy and deckbuilding of a card battler with the dynamic gameplay of word games.

title: Touhou Daiundoukai: Gensou Kyoutou Yuugi Meddlesome Magician
description: A doujin game by Top Arts Plan based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Touhou Daiundousai
description: A doujin game by Top Arts Plan based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Expert's Las Vegas Casino and Devil's Island Pinball
CatDog: Saving Mean Bob
description: CatDog: Saving Mean Bob was a cancelled action video game based on the popular Nicktoon CatDog for the original PlayStation and PC. Not much is known about it, other than the fact that Robert Lamoreaux worked on the game while he was also working on the PC game CatDog: Quest for the Golden Hydrant and that it would've been developed by KnowWare and published by Hasbro Interactive.

title: Championship Mah Jongg, Oriental Chess & Dominoes
Championship Riding Star
description:
Championship Riding Star (known as "Riding Star 2" in Europe) is the sequel of Riding Star, a riding simulation released by dtp Entertainment AG for Windows 95/98 and ME. Just like the original game did in 1999, the sequel puts the emphasis on a realistic portrayal of riding challenges and features the three riding classes military, dressage and horse jumping.

The player can create a rider avatar and own several horses. These may be equipped with different types of accessories such as saddles, blankets and decorations. While in the stable, the player can look at each of his horses from nearby and take individual care of them: the quadrupeds can be fed, their fur can be groomed and their hooves can be cleaned.

By completing tournaments in the three classes and five difficulty settings, the player can win prizes, unlock further content and improve the statistics of his horses. Each horse gains additional experience points through training and participation in tournaments. The game features a number of indoor and outdoor levels of varying difficulty, including a virtual representation of the world championship stadium in the German town of Aachen, home to the World Equestrian Games 2006.

The controls are somewhat different from most games featuring horses: The reins of the horse are simulated with the mouse and the keyboard is used to control the speed.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Miku Full Week
description: Friday Night Funkin': Miku Full Week is a mod that adds in a full week based around the Vocaloid character Hatsune Miku.

title: I Make Saints
description:
I Make Saints is a short first-person psychological horror walking simulator which can be completed in 30 minutes.

Wander the personal hell of a deranged individual and discover the true nature of their terrible crimes through notes, objects and saintly icons left over different atmospheric and at times surreal environments.

title: Fushigi no Gensoukyou
description: Fushigi no Gensoukyou is a roguelike game by Aqua Style based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Friday Night Funkin' Soft
description:
Friday Night Funkin’ Soft does not stay within canon by any means. It’s a remix of the base story and even though the characters are counterparts/based off of the ones you are familiar with, should not be expected to stick with said canon.

Friday Night Funkin’ Soft takes the basic reskin formula and turns it on it’s head. Its a new way to enjoy a beloved rhythm game with a focus on story telling, character design, and creativity.

title: Sanae no Chou Tokkyuu: TheExpressTrial
description: A doujin game by Aqua Style based on the Touhou Project series.

title: I'm on Cirno Duty
description:
This is a fangame based on the I'm On Observation Duty Series by Notovia/Zaster, created with their permission, made for and themed after Twitch streamer Cirno_TV. Please support the original I'm On Observation Duty series on Steam, iOS and Android.

Like in the original games, you have to check live surveillance footage to detect and report anomalies by type and location, which can be anything from a room's door opening, to the sudden presence of strange intruders.

The difference in this game is that a lot of the anomalies are either generic memes or Cirno_TV community-related jokes/references. Originally a private project, the game became public after a significant amount of interest was shown from audiences.

title: Motto!? Fushigi no Gensoukyou: Under the Moonlight
description: Motto!? Fushigi no Gensoukyou: Under the Moonlight is a Mystery Dungeon game made by Aqua Style. It is a sequel to Fushigi no Gensokyo, featuring Reimu Hakurei as its main character with newly adopted enemies, items, equipment, systems, and many more.

title: Miracle Party: Fushigi no Gensoukyou 2
description: Miracle Party -Mystery Gensokyo 2- is a roguelike game starring Sanae as the main character, created by AQUA STYLE. It is the fourth title of the Fushigi no Gensokyo series and has many new features such as a complete new user-interface, a new party system.

title: Motto!? Fushigi no Gensoukyou Plus: The Dungeon of Dreams and Magic
description: More!? Mystery Gensokyo plus -The Dungeon of Dreams and Magic is a roguelike game created by Aqua Style. It is an expansion disk of the previous work Motto!? Fushigi no Gensokyo Under the Moonlight.

title: Motto!? Fushigi no Gensoukyou Prologue: Chijou kara no Kyoui
description: A doujin game by Aqua Style based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Fushigi no Gensoukyou Origin: Hajimari no Kamikakushi-hen
description: A doujin game by Aqua Style based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Fushigi no Gensoukyou Chronicle
description: Five previous works have been reborn as a single story piece.

title: Fushigi no Gensoukyou: Another Face
description: A doujin game by Aqua Style based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Miracle Chou Party: Sanae to Tenshi no Gensou Labyrinth
description: A doujin game by Aqua Style based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Hop for the Best
description:
Hop For The Best is an indie clay-style platformer game in which you play as Forgy, an adorable little frog chasing hope for a better life.

Sprint, roll, climb, dash, and hop through beautiful clay inspired worlds. With no way to attack and danger at every turn, all you can do is… Hop For The Best!

Hop For The Best Features four gameplay modes. Standard Mode, One-Life Mode, Kid’s Mode, and Challenge Mode.

title: Fushigi no Gensoukyou 3
description: Fushigi no Gensoukyou 3 is a roguelike game by Aqua Style based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Miracle Party Plus: Fushigi no Gensoukyou 2
description: A doujin game by Aqua Style based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Public Defense Corp: The Ambassador of Peace
description: Haruka finally catches a break after Jakou’s attack on Japan relents. At the same time, without any enemies to fight, her life as an FUW pilot has become a bit boring. Luckily, her staff has a great idea: become a tourism ambassador to help the economy recover!

title: Spektakl: Banned Edition
description:
\SPEK.TAKL\ is a a first-person psychological horror game with multiple endings that can be completed in under an hour.

It is a late-night television watching simulator. Sit down on the couch in your new apartment straight out of 1994 and enjoy a cozy evening bingeing cable TV until the sign-off comes around and there's nothing else to watch.

Whatever you do, do not worry about the neighbors; do NOT answer the door; and never EVER watch the VHS tapes that are dropped through your mail slot.

\SPEK.TAKL\ is an intense, intimate and disturbing horror-themed psychosexual exploration on the lengths some of us go to in order to avoid facing the inevitable.

title: Miracle Chou Party Plus: Sanae to Tenshi no Gensou Labyrinth
description: A doujin game by Aqua Style based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Ears of the Killer
description:
In XX City, a new music scene is forming - it's known as "Crime Wave" and all of the songs are about committing homicide. Meanwhile in the Beach District something is stirring, coming out of the sea. Can BB and her sister ZZ outrun the New Wave? Can anything change the shape of things to come?

"Of The Killer" series no. 7, cartoon mystery horror game for You.

title: Mononobe no Futo to Muttsu no Shiren
description: Mononobe no Futo to Muttsu no Shiren is a fan-made Touhou Project-roguelike game created by Aqua Style.

title: Fushigi no Gensoukyou 3 Plus
description: A doujin game by Aqua Style based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Touhou Genso Wanderer: Mononobe no Futo to Nanatsu no Shiren - Fushigi no Gensoukyou TOD Another Story
description: Mononobe no Futo to Nanatsu no Shiren is a fan-made Touhou Project-roguelike game created by Aqua Style.

title: Touhou Genso Wanderer: Momiji Inubashiri
description: Adds the player character Momiji Inubashiri to Touhou Genso Wanderer.

title: Hearts of Iron IV: By Blood Alone
description: Build a new empire, resist foreign aggression or explore the limits of neutrality in Hearts of Iron IV: By Blood Alone. This new expansion for Paradox Interactive’s World War II grand strategy wargame adds new alternate history options and gameplay variety for three nations, as well as other significant changes.

title: Dark Angael
description: Dark Angael is a 2D run-and-gun platform game with a mystical fantasy theme. In this game you play as Carina, the Dark Angael. Thanks to Azrael the world has been plunged in total chaos and the end is near. It is up to you to defeat Azrael and his army of demons. Carina has to fend off the demon's with the various weapons she finds or she can rely on her superpowers.

title: Jected: Rivals
description: Eject into the world of high-octane stunts, bumps and automobiles! Fight off the competition and become the greatest Rival!

title: Bug Dates
description:
Just like bugs, this game is cute, creepy, and a little bit eerie.

Lonely? Don't worry! Your best friend signs you up for a dating show without your permission. The fun part you're gonna date some bugs! Have fun!

title: Clue
description: Clue is a full-motion video adaptation of the popular board game of the same name. It is an amalgamation of two earlier CD-i titles where (up to six) players take turns investigating a mansion where a murder happened, uncovering clues and evidence to reveal the assassin. There are three storylines with four difficulty levels, each with a unique solution making it altogether twelve different mysteries: Deadly Patent (from Clue), The Road to Damascus and Blackmail (both from Clue 2: The Mysteries Continue).

title: Threshold RPG
description:
Threshold is a high fantasy, real-time, multi-player, online role playing game. Once you step across the Threshold you will be absorbed by the rich, detailed, highly developed role playing atmosphere that comprises this fantasy realm. You become the hero, the heroine, or even the villain depending on your character and your imagination.

On Threshold, role playing is required and enforced. This policy creates and preserves Threshold's top notch role playing environment. Although there are places to communicate "out of character" within the game (after all, it is nice to get to know the people you are gaming with), outside of such areas players stay completely in character.

Threshold RPG opened to the public in June of 1996. It is the oldest role playing enforced MUD currently in operation.

Available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, this exciting gaming environment is home to thousands of players from all over the world. These players are indeed what makes Threshold RPG a truly unique and marvellous gaming community.

title: Combat 3D
description: Combat 3D is a multiplayer tank battle game. Players control tanks in various 3D environments, engaging in combat against other players or AI-controlled opponents. The game features different tank models, each with unique characteristics and capabilities. Players navigate their tanks through diverse terrains, using strategy and skill to outmaneuver and defeat enemies. Combat 3D likely includes multiple game modes, such as team deathmatch, capture the flag, or objective-based missions. The game emphasizes tactical gameplay, requiring players to consider factors like armor positioning, ammunition types, and terrain advantages. With its 3D graphics, Combat 3D aims to provide an immersive tank warfare experience, appealing to fans of military vehicle combat games and strategy enthusiasts seeking competitive multiplayer action.

title: Combat Mission 3: Afrika Korps Special Edition
The Land Before Time: Dinosaur Arcade
description: The Land Before Time: Dinosaur Arcade is an educational game for Windows-based PCs intended for children ages 4-7 released by Sound Source Interactive in North America in November 2000. The game features five minigames revolving around Littlefoot, Spike, Petrie, Ducky, and Chomper that involve guiding them around various levels and a pinball-style game. Children's Software Review noted that it was less educational than others in its genre, calling it a "strictly an entertainment title", with little real educational value except for some practice with eye-hand coordination and logic.

title: The Lord of the Rings Online: Mithril Edition
description:
This version includes:

- Exclusive Steed of the Horse-lords' Mount
- Path of the Fellowship Bonus Quests
- 2,000 points to spend in Middle-earth

title: The Realm
description: The player lost in a village in another world is looking for a way out alone.

title: The Game of Life: SpongeBob SquarePants Edition
Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars - Kane Edition
description:
This collector's edition contains:

- Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars
- 5 new multiplayer maps
- Unique unit skins.
- 5 wallpapers.
- Bonus DVD.

Only 100,000 copies of this package were published.

title: Sacritice
description:
Once a year on October 31st a person is chosen to give their face to God.

And today is your turn.

Navigate through a mysterious gallery in an attempt to save yourself, will you make the right decisions? Or will you fall victim to your impulses.

title: Company of Heroes: Anthology
description:
The compilation Company of Heroes: Anthology contains all previously release games in the Company of Heroes series. The games included are:

- Company of Heroes
- Company of Heroes: Opposing Fronts
- Company of Heroes: Tales of Valor

title: Dare to Stay
description: In the town of Redstone, Pennsylvania, an evil returns striking chaos that once targeted families in the 1950s. Detective Alasdair, a successful investigator is reassigned and is forced to relive the haunting cases of his past.

title: Zugzwang
description:
Desire is a labyrinth. As a sex angel, you must help mankind meet each other in the neon darkness. Drink deep their juices, distill their pleasure into divinity. The absence of the witch does not invalidate the spell.

A gay chess-puzzle game inspired by sex magic, the history of censorship in the US, architecture, and the poetry of Emily Dickinson.

title: Concentration
description: Enjoy the classic card game of concentration!

title: Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration
description:
Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration takes players on an interactive journey through 50 years of video games via interviews with designers, developers and industry leaders, documentary footage, product design documents, high-resolution original artwork, and a specially-curated list of more than 90 playable games.

At the heart of Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration are the Interactive Timelines, which combine historical trivia, digital artifacts, all-new video interviews, and playable games into one singular experience. When you encounter a game in the Timeline, you can immediately play it without losing your place.

The massive list of games spans six original Atari console and home computer platforms and generations of arcade titles, the most ever included in a collection by the team at Digital Eclipse. For the first time ever, games from the cult favorite Atari Jaguar and Atari Lynx platforms will be playable on modern consoles. Behind every game are the stories of Atari, what was happening at the company, what went into the creation of the games and the hardware on which they ran, all told by the people who were there. It is a rare opportunity to get a rich behind-the-scenes look at the history of video games.

In addition to presenting these Atari classics exactly as they were, the talented team at Digital Eclipse has also created the Reimagined series—six new games that revisit, mash-up and reimagine Atari Classics. Each of these new games is included in Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration.

title: Final Fantasy VII
description: In addition to graphical resolution improvements to the previous port, this re-release of the PC version of Final Fantasy VII also featured cloud saving, as well as unlockable achievements and a Character Booster feature.

title: Svetlograd
description: Evil imps are invading the cities of Svetlograd. As a counter-measure, a crossbow is deployed to protect the gates, using the imps themselves as ammunition.

title: Sweetopia
description: Marble-popping fans get a taste of "la dolce vida" with Sweetopia from casual games publisher PlayFirst. The frantic action takes place in a candy factory filled with twisting conveyor belts transporting a mix of 14 confection types. The goal is to eliminate groups of three or more by launching specific candies toward matching treats. Twists on the familiar theme include ricocheting candy off barriers and firing the sweets from a choice of launchers within each stage. Two play modes (Arcade and Story) offer slightly different objectives as you attempt to clear 70 luscious levels and save the fructose-filled factory from closing down.

title: Bip + Bop
description: Bip and Bop's worlds are converging - and it looks pretty scary! Help Bip and Bop return their worlds to order by alternating between them and compounding their unique abilities!

title: Triennale Game Collection Vol. 2
description: The Triennale Game Collection Volume 2 is a free virtual exhibition of video games created for the 23rd International Exhibition of Triennale Milano by five of the world’s most renowned independent game designers, showcasing these artists’ experimental approach to interactivity.

title: Text Express
description: All aboard the Text Express. The concept is simple, beat the opposite train to the next station. Use words as the coal to stoke the fire to get you there. Longer words make more fire to help you beat the opposite train. Get stoking now!

title: Error143
description: A bickering and bantering rivals-to-lovers visual novel.

title: Outer Space Survival
description: In Outer Space Survival you play either alone or with others as a stranded astronaut who needs to repair his spaceship in order to escape from this planet. After that, you can explore space, complete missions, or settle on a planet and build a base.

title: Atai no Gensoukyou
description: Atai no Gensokyo is a fan-made Touhou Project-roguelike game created by AQUA STYLE. It is a spin-off game of Fushigi no Gensokyo made for April Fools' Day, featuring Cirno as the protagonist.

title: Motto!? Atai no Gensoukyou
description: Motto!? Atai no Gensokyo is a fan-made Touhou Project-roguelike game created by AQUA STYLE.

title: Motto!? Atai no Gensoukyou alpha
description: A doujin game by Aqua Style based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Atai no Gensoukyou Shunkashuutou
description: A doujin game by Aqua Style based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Magic Chou Party: Marisa to Marisa no Gensou Hanabi
description: A doujin game by Aqua Style based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Hitsuji Shitsuji
description: This is a sheepish butler action game by Top Arts Plan.

title: Showrunner
description: Create and run your own TV show! An isometric management game where you craft scripts, populate your world with characters and cast actors to play them. Hire and manage staff, develop your studio and gain a dedicated following.

title: Wiraburut rai Phalang: Khai Tom
description: A Turn-based RPG adventure game. Players will take on the role of a 'hero' who has been summoned to another world. The only goal of the 'king' who summoned him is to help eliminate the dangers in the dungeon. The hero must overcome various obstacles, explore dangerous areas, gain experience, and find rare items in order to defeat the 'demon king'.

title: A Game That Saves the Muscles Caught in the Ceiling of the Gymnasium
description: This is a new type of shooting game in which the player rescues muscular trapped in the ceiling of a gymnasium by hitting them with a ball.

title: Emberfate: Tempest of Elements
description:
Set in regular modern-day life, you are the leader of a raiding guild in the world's hottest MMORPG, Emberfate, which has just released the new expansion, Tempest of Elements. Balance the intricacies of being a guild leader, ranging from preparing for boss battles or distributing loot, to managing the complex relationships you have with your fellow players. Engage in conversations with your guildmates, listen to their troubles — and maybe pursue one of the three possible love interests to build a romantic relationship of your own!

Take charge of your own fate, and shape the future of those around you. In Emberfate, everyone is dealing with something, and your choices and support could make all the difference.

title: The Accursed Crown of the Giant King
description: Epic, classic-style fantasy role-playing game. Single player, party based, featuring real-tie with pause gameplay. Combines open-ended exploration with an overall quest.Deep, complex role-playing system, with many skills, powers, spells, and items.

title: Pixel
description: Pixel is a minimalist platformer + puzzle game! Control a being that aims to reach somewhere... always jumping, dodging, avoiding and tricking obstacles that seem not to let you proceed. Died? Just try one more time =D

title: Omega Squad
description: Lead a team of marines inside a space station infested with monsters. Level up your squad and upgrade your weapons in order to clean the station of any threat. But don't forget to manage your squad as health and fatigue will play a big role in your squad's performance.

title: Sanae no Gensoukyou

description: This story follows Goku a yakuza member who spent 12 years in prison for a crime he did not commit. After being released, he learns that the Tojo clan had taken his beloved"xioyu" captive for wrongfully been accused of spending the Tojo boss money and now he has to rescue her from the opposing gang.

title: PomoFarm
description: PomoFarm is half focus timer and half idle farming game! As Tomato the Duck, grow your farm as you focus on tasks in the real world!

title: K-Pop & Rock Band Manager
description: A new star is born! Favour Toys B.V. Entertainment wants to release a new 4-member Band. You have to choose the trainees who you think are ready to make their debut to the public and make a new history. How you manage the band will determine their future.

title: Way of the Hunter: Elite Edition
description:
The Elite Edition includes the base game as well as the following extras items:
- Way of the Hunter: Season Pass.
The Way of the Hunter Season Pass includes two new region DLCs. + The Way of the Hunter Hunter's Pack

title: Ghostrunner: Complete Edition
description: Adapt, overcome and kill in the challenging but rewarding Ghostrunner: Complete Edition, the ultimate Ghostrunner experience, which includes the critically acclaimed Ghostrunner, Project _Hel expansion and all cosmetic packs.

title: The Jackbox Party Starter
description: Get the party started with The Jackbox Party Starter! Featuring three updated titles: Quiplash 3, Trivia Murder Party 2 and Tee K.O., this starter pack is sure to entertain!

title: Black Spire
description: "Black Spire" is a side-scrolling action-adventure game. You will control a brave warrior, experience difficult soul-like battles, and explore the secrets hidden in the depths of the Black Spire.

title: Monster Girl
description: As a casual puzzle game (spot the difference), it is perfect for training your observation. In the game, there are numerous hidden spots on the character's accessories and background. You need to spot 4 to 8 differences in each stage to complete the mission.

title: Elemgate
description: Roll through 2.5-D stages while controlling your speed and switching elements to hit gates, activate ramps, enter portals or reverse and restore gravity with the correct element to get more time that converts into score that you will need to pass levels, earn stars and find a way to escape.

title: Stradiwackius: The Counting Concert
description: In VroomBooks' Stradiwackius, Albert, Wendy, Pablo, and the Bookworms will spend hours showing your child the wonder of books, words, facts, and pictures. With the use of their Interactivator, the Bookworms take your child beyond ordinary electronic books, and make Stradiwackius come alive with interesting facts, 3D animation, and fun learning games in four different languages

title: The Great Reading Adventure
description: Anthropomorphic kid bear Lil' Howie and his friends help the player learn reading comprehension, alphabetizing, word families and real phonics through mini-games.

title: The Art of Fly Fishing: Volume One - Rivers of the British Isles
description: The Art of Fly Fishing: Volume One - Rivers of the British Isles is a fly fishing simulation. After deciding between the three available locations (The Test, River Spey and Blackwater), the player has to choose a place to fish (an overhead map helps with the choice because it shows information of fish locations and traps). Then follows casting (clicking the mouse three times in the correct rhythm similar to the three-click system of golf simulations) and waiting for a fish to bite. As soon as this happens, the next step is to initiate a strike (by clicking with the right timing) and land the fish by applying and releasing line tension. The player has a choice between different rod, line and bait. There is also an in-game encyclopedia about fly fishing.

title: Where's Oswald?
description: A short horror experience taking place in a dream or a memory.

title: Minion Raid: Epic Monsters
description:
Experience epic minion adventures as a trainer in the dungeon

You have the power over many little minions - train them to become unbeatable fighting machines and take the scepter in your hands! The monsters of the underworld are looking for a new overlord, but the selection in the dungeon is hard...

To leave the arena victorious, you need well-trained minions with special abilities. They also acquire them through evolution. Your trainer skills also play a role: the better you are as a drill instructor, the more dangerous your troops will be in battle.

Attack is the best defense: Choose a suitable battle strategy!

Depending on the training session and the type of minions, they have different fighting abilities. Some are stronger in attack, some are better in defense. Accordingly, you need a clever battle strategy. Choose the attacking minions for the front lines and the minions with a longer range for the back lines. It's also helpful if you know the strengths and weaknesses of your opponents in the dungeon and choose your battle lineup accordingly.

Before facing the competition in epic battles, you can try out your minion squad in test campaigns.

But if your lineup is suitable, you can also send your minions directly into the arena for the first PvE battle. Let's see how good your training was... There are also tournaments in this idle fighting game - those are fought in PvP mode.

Winning the arena will bring you not only higher prestige, but also gold and a better ranking in the league. If you still don't get enough of battling in the dungeon, then create a guild and work together with other guild members to make fat loot.

Fame, glory and gold make you an overlord

Your mission in this idle fighting game is to seize the power in the dungeon. You'll achieve this by preparing your minions well for battle. As a trainer, you should also advance your own skills. To do this, you'll use the gold you collect through victories in the arena. Idle missions in the tavern also bring you gold. You can use it to upgrade your trainer skills and those of your minions. Afterwards, you fight your way across the dungeon on a map and encounter different enemies. Use your captured resources wisely while training your minions and you'll soon be able to rule over the monsters of the underworld.

title: Stranger of Paradise: Final Fantasy Origin - Trials of the Dragon King
description: “Trials of the Dragon King” includes new jobs, weapons, accessories, and a new category of equipment, as well as new areas, stories, and challenges.

title: Tryp FPV
description: TRYP FPV is a drone FPV Simulator. This game has been created to give the most realistic and complete drone FPV piloting experience to everyone : beginners to pro.

title: To Become a Tengu
description: An office romance otome game with a dash of supernatural.

title: Escape: The Endless Dogwatch
description: A point and click adventure game with a horror twist! You play as 2nd Officer Walton on the SS Carolina. Explore the ship, use items, find the crew, and try to survive! A fun, challenging and satisfying experience!

title: Mythic Meetup
description: An unsuspecting human in search of a little more spice to their life, you have just followed a mysterious email link to ... a server of real life mythical creatures? Well, this wasn't quite the dating pool you had in mind, but some of them have definitely got their eye on you!

title: Touhou Genso Wanderer Reloaded: Tojiko Soga
description: Adds the player character Tojiko Soga to Touhou Genso Wanderer Reloaded.

description: This DLC adds new team members from Touhou: Wily Beast and Weakest Creature.

title: Touhou Genso Wanderer: Lotus Labyrinth R - Lotus Friends
description:
Venture into dungeons with a huge party of your favorite Touhou characters!
This is a dungeon-crawler RPG with an absurdly large party size!
The dungeon-crawler RPG Genso Wanderer is now a game with an Oversized Party System that pushes the envelope of the roguelike genre!
Now you can bring dozens of partners with you on your dungeon crawls, in addition to other quality of life improvements that make the game's systems and controls smoother than ever.

title: Danmaku Amanojaku: Gold Rush
description: Danmaku Amanojaku Gold Rush is a one-stage danmaku mini game and publicly-unreleased installment of the Touhou Project, featuring Seija Kijin as the sole playable character and Reimu Hakurei as the sole stage boss. The game was created for Digital Game Expo 2014's "Doujin Shooting Game Caravan" contest, where it was available to be played.

title: My Little Universe
description: Creating a world isn’t easy, but it’s certainly a whole load of fun, as you’ll find out in this exciting casual worldbuilding adventure game. It takes mining, crafting, logging, digging, smelting, construction and a little gardening to make the perfect planet, and you’ll have to do all that while fighting off primeval monsters intent on bringing an end to your divine plan. Armed with just a pickaxe and the almighty strength of your arms, get down to doing a god’s work and build a world of wonder in this addictive, original action game.

title: Teen Witches Academy
description: You will take the role of the Main Character, a powerful Mage who has been banned by the Magic World Council after they used him to win the hard war against Obscure Magic. He will be brought back to freedom by a mysterious powerful Mage Lord, called Gorath, the Lord of Corruption, who can give his power back. In return MC must accept to take the role of the headmaster in a Teen School of Magic, and bring all the teen witches to Corruption.

You can download this in "Freem!".

description: Breathe in is a game about Meditation. You control your focus, and must navigate your way to the 'breathe in' and 'breathe out' pick ups in order to focus on your breathing. Breathing lessens your tension which builds up over time, if you let your Tension get too high, you will lose the game.

description: Dreamward started as a student pitch project at Carnegie Mellon University, Entertainment Technology Center. We created a puzzle-solving game experience combining novel gameplay with amazing art and music inspired by Tang and Tubo cultures.

description: In the vast space, where to go from time to time, the enemy crazy and difficult to deal with, and how to find a ray of life before energy exhaustion?

You as the player, will guide the inquisitive toad through diverse, dangerous environments filled with not-so-friendly creatures.

Also, you control an orange Squirrel equipped with more-than-military-grade turrets! OMG - can it get any better?

description: Help keep a happy home in this short hand-crafted platformer telling a touching tale about a bird, it's children and their home.

Play as Rina, a thief living in the year 2442 in the corrupt Galactic Empire. Travel to the future to save the past from a tremendous time paradox. Fulfill your destiny of keeping time intact.

Otome visual novel with a focus on connections and friendship.

A quiet coming-of-age story about how photography changed the lives of three people in a rainy small town and the paths in life they took with it.

title: Lkyt.
description:
Every thousand years, the Dark Reign rises and pushes forth to destroy all humanity, but those of the Shoreline Nation have dedicated their lives to defending the world from this recurring threat, using the magic within themselves and their bonds between each other to stave off these vicious foes. It is here that Tasuku trains, expecting the next rise to come generations later, but now as signs of the Dark Reign are uncovered with their nation still unprepared, Tasuku finds himself thrust into a battle that will determine the fate of the world.

Can two people find hope for the future with an outlook so bleak? Is it possible for friendship to turn into intimacy on the eve of humanity's destruction? Can love save the world?

title: How a Healthy Hentai Administers Public Service
description: How a Healthy Hentai Administers Public Service is an erotic comedy developed by CLOCKUP, where we follow the daily life of Jin Sintani, the precinct's newest sex officer charged with serving the community and protecting the peaceful citizens of Vaginville from the threat of sexual frustration.

description: An unforgiving hardcore fantasy FPS dungeon PvPvE adventure. Band together with your friends and use your courage, wits, and cunning to uncover mythical treasures, defeat gruesome monsters, while staying one step ahead of the other devious treasure-hunters.

description: Manage your own Cruise Ship! Maintain your vessel and sell tickets to the wealthiest of passengers. Issue orders to your crew and keep their morale high. Choose the layout of your ship and the kind of amenities you want to offer. Keep the prices right, passengers satisfied, and your wallet full!

title: Paperback Vol. 2
description: Word-building meets deck-building in the unique game Paperback Vol. 2

title: Dream Magic Will
description: In a magical forest, animals began to occupy the territory of other animals for unknown reasons. In order to find out the truth, a team guarding the forest was born!Build a guard force to prevent enemy invasion and explore the truth of the forest!

title: Putrid Shot Ultra
description: A chaotic shoot-em-up roguelite with magic spell casting. Defeat enemies with your gun! Stack tons of passive spells that trigger when you shoot while weaving your unique active spell in between. Blast your enemies with gunfire and magic spells while you dodge through the rubble.

title: Sabotris
description: Sabotris is a strategic, competitive, 3D block stacking game, but with a twist: you can sabotage your opponents, but be careful; you can also end up sabotaging yourself! Choose to play either by yourself to beat your own high score, against your friends or other players, or even against computer AI!

title: Redaxium 2
description: Appease God every 6 days or die! Find a way to break the cycle of ritual sacrifice.

title: The Ballad of Radolf
description: After years of peace an island emerges from the sea with the Demon race, now the Demon race threatens to throw the world into chaos. Can you stop the Demon race and restore peace to the world in this turn based RPG.

title: Just Sign!
description: Just Sign! is a 1-4 players tower defense online/local co-op, where you build the turrets. Get resources, refine and craft them into defenses to counter various enemies and bosses on dynamic maps.

title: Backrooms of Reality
description: A game in which you navigate through backrooms' mazes and solving simple environmental puzzles. Sometimes you may encounter some creatures that live there. The game contains horror elements.

title: FurBalls Racing
description: FurBalls Racing is a platforming racing game that's fun for players of all skill levels! Roll, wall jump, spin drift, and... shoot poop?... as a squishy, fuzzy FurBall while rushing towards the finish line!... and avoiding poop.

title: Project Romboid
description: Project Romboid is a hard, arcade shooter roguelite in which you will have to pick and combine items so that you can survive waves of enemies that will chase you and shoot at you. New items will appear every level. Combine them to create powerful builds that will help you survive.

title: Away From Life
description: You are left alone with yourself in the middle of the Indian Ocean, fighting for survival with the wildlife of the nearest islands and the ocean elements.

title: Omnichess
description: Omnichess is the game that allows you to design and play your very own chess variants! With AI and online play there are a huge variety of options.

description: Washed ashore in a strange unknown land after a shipwreck, Astrid must traverse her way through monsters and men alike in an attempt to return home. Dangers lurk around every corner and she doesn't know who to trust.

title: Vikindor
description: Vikindor - Side-Scroller Platformer, a game with random generation, where the player in each level gets into a randomly generated world of the underworld, with its enemies, unique locations, chests and other traps. Each race will be different from the next!

title: SnailQuest
description: A Puzzle Game Based On 2048 Move Style

description: Grindshift is a stylized hoverboard game with ramps, rails and jumps. There are no gameplay objectives or unlockables, just endless hoverboard riding and score counting.

description: A sci-fi, survival horror and first-person game. The player will encounter numerous of creatures and characters that involves a mystery to be unraveled on all worlds, finding clues and going through portals. The player progresses through exploration and may die if they fail to avoid the monsters.

description: Shards of Nogard is a powerful, evocative fantasy adventure game that will surprise you with fastpaced combat, mind-boggling puzzles, beautiful hand-crafted environments and an immersive story about the eternal battle set in the medieval fantasy world.

description: A first-person horror game about a janitor, whose day turns stranger by the minute. This game features some random events, that make every playthrough slightly different.

description: Navigate your relationships and figure out the truth behind the ghost of a 80s children's TV show host who's been haunting you in this fully voiced R-18 visual novel filled with nostalgia, romance, and horror. Can everyone get their happily ever after?

title: Alla Prima
description: A starving artist desperate for money and validation joins a religious cult, unaware of the god-seeking ritual she's diving head first into. Explore your environment, solve puzzles and uncover your past to make sense of yourself and the reality unfolding in front of you.

title: DEPO: Death Epileptic Pixel Origins
description: DEPO is a first person 3D platformer where you control a rebel pixel inside a computer with an evil Operating System governing everything. You'll find final bosses, cinematic scenes, arcade mini-games, 50 huge levels full of surprises, ¡and big stories to discover!

title: Level Tank
description: Blast your way through swarms of enemies in this action-packed top-down shooter. Upgrade your tank, collect power ups, and survive against a wide variety of enemies while exploring diverse maps in multiple different game modes! How long will you last before getting overrun?

title: Rusty Seas
description: A game about furry girls fighting over junk on the beach.

title: Galxagar
description: "Don't go to Galxagar"; a phrase uttered by many who have traversed its rim. Untold treasures, and terrors, await within its blackened depths. Ready your craft, spacefarer, because you're about to enter the most dangerous sector in all the stars. Get ready.. for Galxagar!

title: Mythic Origins
description: Explore an infinite, procedurally generated labyrinth. Discover a world packed with puzzles, enemies, bosses, and treasure. Join forces with fellow heroes to hunt down the gods, or strike out alone and be the first to discover uncharted territory. Become Mythic.

title: First Time in Rome
description: Travel blogger Kate Robinson and her daughter Nicole are headed to Rome for a big job with a local tourism agency!

title: Space Major Miner
description: Space is dark and full of terror... and raw resources! Mine asteroids, upgrade your equipment and blast cosmic aliens.

title: Music Store Simulator
description: With Music Store Simulator you can lead a musical instruments manufacturing company. Create, sell, earn and reinvest improving and developing your business. Expand your Brand and climb to success in order to become the world's largest manufacturer of musical instruments!

title: Estencel
description: Slash your way through Estencel! Traverse across a corrupted, maze like city fighting horrors. Customize and arm yourself into the ultimate monster killing assassin in this fast paced horror/fantasy Action RPG. Solve the mysteries of this world before they swallow you whole.

It's your first day of work for Death Noodle Delivery Inc. Ride your hoverboard and try to survive in a cyberpunk world on the brink of collapse. Deliver the noodles, hack the hoverboard and build cat bombs. You may find that this world hides a filthy secret.

Upgrade your old hoverboard from a rusty ironing board to a perfected killing machine. Jailbreak AI paywalls and unlock new power-ups that let you manipulate time and launch explosive cats!

Talk to your neighbours and find out their dirty stories. Browse the web for hacks and pleasure. Survive long enough, and you may discover that this world hides a terrible secret.

title: OutWave

Buy and control a cars or motorbikes. Listen to retro music and don't get caught by the cops! The game looks like a gif!

title: A Mage Reborn
description: Walk the path of a legendary mage, combining four different schools of magic to devastating effects.

title: Lost Paws
description: Survive as a stray dog in a large open world. Scavenge, craft, trade, and steal your way into a world where all the pets disappear. Arm yourself and take to the streets to rise from homeless to well-off no matter what it takes. What kind of story will you tell?

In order to make everything return to its original state, Yoru, who awakened as a demon hunter, decided to challenge the initiator.

title: Spellic
description: Spellic is a arcade action wizard shooter. With your keyboard, cast spells like fireballs to defeat your enemies or help your allies in various multiplayer battles.

title: Mist Guard
description: Mist Guard is an Action RPG where you have to escape a dark, mysterious prison. Explore, fight enemies and upgrade your character to escape.

description: Grab a slice of this fast-paced, pixel art, top-down shooter.. Pizza Death! Made by members of the Australian thrash band Pizza Death, the main soundtrack is a NES chiptune cover version of their entire debut album, Slice of Death!!!

title: BoxLoop
description: Dive into the world of Time Loop and Evil Boxes.

title: Party Words
description: Party Words is a word party game with a bunch of different game modes and a ton of words to keep it fresh! Pass and play with a single device or join multiple devices to unlock new possibilities. Who's the fastest guesser? Who has all the ideas? Whose doodles are the best? Find out with Party Words.

description: A free 2d roguelite where enemies form a living ecosystem with rivalries and alliances. This is not your war: scavenge some gold and escape with your life... Or stay longer to uncover secrets and more riches, the choice is yours. Strange things happen to those that follow the footsteps of Greed...

title: Pog 8
description: Cute, minimal physical puzzle.

title: Toggle Cube
description: Toggle Cubes is a game where you have to guide people to the stars by toggling cubes on and off. You have to overcome monsters, fireballs, and spikes by using keys and teleports.

title: Chimeras: Wailing Waters - Collector's Edition
description: Can you save the Heavenfall campers from a malevolent force in time?

title: Space Aces
description: Space Aces is an indie space shooter that plunges you into an online universe full of action, strategy, and fierce competition. Step into the cockpit and evolve from a rookie pilot into the most feared Ace in the galaxy!

title: Pandemic 1993
description: Survival horror set in Japan! Fight off various creatures, search for your missing wife and child, and escape from the town safely!

title: Ball Go Home
description: Roll, jump, and fall through over 100 levels in this fun, difficult 2D physics platformer. Master a unique control scheme as you get your ball home!

title: Junkyard War
description: Junkyard War is a unique take on the tower defense genre. Clear trash from the junkyard and recycle it into valuable resources while holding off waves of your competitor's army trying to make the trash disappear by burning it all down!

title: Tempusia
description: Based on rewinding time mechanics, Tempusia is the puzzle platformer requiring a big cold head :3

title: Animosa
description: Journey alongside the timid knight through this challenging metroidvania full of unique bosses and dynamic enemies. Build trust, unlock abilities, encourage and explore.

description: Court of Crowns is a Visual Novel game inspired by Ace Attorney. You play as a Princess Adela de Rex and lead the Crown Curt that resolves important disputes between the Nobility. But what kind of a person is Princess Adela de Rex? Decide that for yourself, thanks to the game's unique Belief System.

title: Fungiman
description: Just a game about a friendly fungus. There's nothing wrong, is it?

title: Down n' Up
description: Down n' Up is a platformer where you can't move: you can only jump. In an all-in-one map where many challenges await you, climb higher and higher to reach the top. Be careful not to fall from too high!

title: Mechanic Heroes
description: Build your team of mechanics and work together to repair and deliver as many cars as possible before the time runs out! Playable with up to 4 players, locally or online, Mechanic Heroes will make you love mechanic or simply hate your friends.

title: Orbital Approach
description: Orbital Approach is a Physics based, arcade space game where the highest score rules supreme. Navigate around planets, avoid obstacles, travel through wormholes, and more!

title: Entry
description: Hyperultrasupercasual turn-based game where you should create words by adding letters on the field and using it. The middle of the field is a random word with 5 letters. Every turn you can add only one letter and create only one word. Every letter equal one point, so to win just get more points.

title: Flappy Butt
description: Flap around as buttcheeks propelled by your own gasses whilst trying to dodge pipes!

title: Charging Out Dead Zone
description: This is a zombie car parkour game. The pace of the game is very tight. The goal of the game is to score as many points as possible. .

title: Indigo Loop
description: Indigo Loop is a quick-count, time management puzzle game with a splash of strategy and luck. It shares the classic puzzle game spirit of being easy to pick up and challenging to master.

title: Detective Fantasia DX
description: A corpse has been found on the beach! Explore a summery island to gather clues and uncover the truth in this mystery game, Detective Fantasia DX!

title: Overdriven Evolution
description: Destroy Huge Bosses, dodge thousand of bullets and resolve quick puzzles with your powerfull space ship ! New and remade stages with improved graphics and 3D environments. More enemies and more bullets !

title: Shockwave: Land of the Blind
description: A first-person immersive bomb disposal sim with stealth mechanics that lets you taste the anxious life of a sapper. Work with specialistic equipment to disarm a wide range of explosives. Gather intel to choose the right path in the multi-layered levels and stay out of sight from armed militants.

title: Tactical Bandits
description: Tactical Bandits is an extremely challenging top-down action game where the player travels on a journey to the West Coast to reach the Last Settlement, the last known human survivor camp.

title: Dreams with Furry
description: Dreams with Furry - Cleopatra, Mulan and Joan of Arc are now furry girls! Relaxing gameplay and cute atmosphere.

title: Block-ed
description: Craft, challenge, and conquer beautiful 3D puzzles in an arcade showdown, where creativity meets competition.

title: StarMech
description: Transform your mech to fight, upgrade, and survive long enough to jump to safety in this bullet hell roguelite.

title: Witchhazel Woods
description: Your dog has been kidnapped by a lonely ghost! To save her, you must go on a journey through the woods, helping the creatures you meet along the way.

title: Sigh of the Abyss
description: Embrace the monster within to change the fate of a nation in this dark fantasy visual novel.

title: Solar Nations
description: Rule thousands of worlds and conquer thousands more in this unique take on galactic Grand Strategy. Influence your empire's hulking economy in order to accommodate astronomical military might, then wage strategic wars against rivals and anyone else who would dare threaten your splendor.

title: AirShooShoo
description: AirShooShoo is an online multiplayer arena gravity shooter, where you select your armoury for a fast paced combat against each other. Practice speedrunning in solo mode. Use all your weapons and resources to kill, or die just to respawn instantly for revenge.

title: Witness of the Night
description: Survive the night in an old observatory, helping your friend find the sources of mysterious radiation from outer space.

title: The Game of Fourtune
description: The Game of Fourtune has begun. Play as Clyde Raveron & Devon Rhodes as they try to survive a magical death game on the whims of a god obsessed with four. Four rounds of play, four deaths per round, one survivor granted one wish. Do you have a will strong enough that not even death will stop you?

title: Wormmy
description: Venture out to the planet core to save your cute friends from hunger! Jump, eat and explore, in this platformer game with infinite horizontal levels!

title: The Binding of Survivors
description: A game of rogue adventure, mowing, coolness, and walking. A group of characters of different backgrounds and abilities have come together to explore the deepest secrets of this evil unknown planet. Defeat the tidal wave of enemies, different bosses, and achieve various challenges and achievement.

title: Happy's Clocks
description: Run around an enormous mysterious house that once belonged to your dad, while running away from terrifying monsters and solving interesting puzzles. Discover what happened or maybe what was supposed to happen when you left.

title: Neighbors: Suburban Warfare
description: NEIGHBORS: Suburban Warfare is a lighthearted, team-based PvP game about neighborhood warfare! Deploy traps and barricades to defend your own house. Use the tools from your surroundings to acquire crazy item to get the better of your Neighbors!

title: Stellar Watch
description: Spin and strategize for survival in Stellar Watch, a roguelike tower defense. Steer your ship, unlock tech, and enhance drones to outwit enemies.

title: Rat Chef
description: This game is about you playing like a rat. You own a restaurant, and you have to deliver food to your customers and they will come very fast so hurry up!! At the same time as you keep your restaurant up, you should still make a profit on it so you can pay for the food and bills

title: Periphery Online
description: A refugee capsule lands on an uninhabited planet. You have to survive, rebuild civilization and, if possible, regain control over the Earth. One big universe, one endless pvp session for all players.

title: Chamrosh
description: Chamrosh, The Guardian Of Persia, turned himself to stone with magic for being immortal to protect persian lands forever, and only kaveh the blacksmith's blood can turn him alive again,after thousand years,after the latest generation of kaveh, you are the only one who can turn him alive.

title: Abyss Fantasia
description: The city "Cynthia" on the edge of the abyss, the "missing" girl who didn't know where she came from began to step into the abyss. Experience the complex emotional, mysterious biological environment under the Abyss. Finally face the deepest darkness of the abyss.

title: Juicy Futa
description: A lewd Visual-Novel about Futas on an open island

title: SCP: Intrusion
description: SCP: Intrusion is a tactical first person shooter that takes place in the SCP universe. Two factions (Foundation Forces and Chaos Insurgency) fight to the death over the control of an SCP facility.

title: Cyber City Clash
description: Cyber City Clash is a 2.5D fighting in a near future dystopian setting. Battle your way through the various environments of the Cyberpunk city in either single player vs AI, or against a friend in 2 player modes.

title: Aria and the Crystal Kingdom
