description: Wield cards as your weapon in this deck-building fantasy RPG inspired by Slay the Spire and Paper Mario! Battle against enemies in strategic turn-based combat, travel across a hand-drawn world, customize your deck, and grow strong enough to face whatever lies ahead!

title: Retrowave Rider
description: Retrowave Rider is a mash up of Geometry Dash and Guitar Hero. Dive into synthwave worlds filled with retro-inspired visuals and smooth synth sounds, and experience this journey with all of its trials and glories.

title: Alone Again: The Countryside
description: You live in Caçapava, in an isolated neighborhood, in the countryside. In Brazil, carrying guns is forbidden. Mysterious creatures move around your house, you can’t protect yourself… Reach them or they will reach you!

title: Stoney's Adventure
description: A 2D Puzzle Action Platformer set in a fully explorable world and beyond.

title: Urchins and Ink
description: Urchins & Ink is a twin shooter with a twist! Learn how to properly read and pronounce Japanese while fighting off pesky sea urchins. Help Sumi learn the language and unlock new levels to challenge fluency. Swim quick and think but don't lose your ink to prove practice makes perfect!

title: The Shadelight
description: Shadelight is a horror game set in Louisiana. Hide and sneak to avoid mutant family. Find nesesary items to leave their mansion.

title: Deer Journey
description: Deer Journey is a third person walking simulator game. Outcasted by the other deers, an albino fawn is forced to go deep into the forest to find a place to live. Join him on his journey through a world too big for which he may not be yet ready.

title: Candy Girlfriend
description: A fantasy trip to the candy kingdom that belongs to you~ Will you meet the girl you want?

title: The Creepy Syndrome
description: The Creepy Syndrome is an anthology that offers several psychological horror stories, with different pixel art and retro 1 bit, 8 bit, gameboy, etc. styles. Stories of a disturbed mind that intertwine with each other while being analysed by a mysterious psychiatrist.

title: Lands of Crown
description: A rogue-like in a medieval, randomly-generated world. Fight, talk, steal, cast spells, complete quests, level up, acquire loot and conduct trades, all to take the Crown. Where Streets of Rogue meets Kenshi, choose your own play style and play as any class, if you can meet them, you can be them!

title: We See You
description: We See You is a rhythm based down-scrolling runner. You play as a pair of eyes trying to go as deep as possible, avoiding enemies moving in different patterns with a goal to get a good score to top the leaderboard.

title: Waitventure
description: Idle RPG with automatic battles, enemy recruiting and fusions.

title: Miss Neko 3
description: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the psychedelic city — Neko City#96572! All good things you want will happen here! Just dance with the charming neko, solve their match puzzles, and you will get mysterious rewards!

title: Fateless Night
description: Fateless Night - is a 2D action platformer where enemies are randomly generated. It is perfect for players who don't really like rogue-lite conventions, such as losing most of game progression after each death.

title: Reign of Dwarf
description: Survive, farm, and conquer, that's the philosophy of Reign of Dwarf. We provide you the tools, you choose how to use them. Go to war, make alliances, or hide away from the world, the only morals will be the ones you choose.

title: Alabama Bones Adventures
description: Alabama Bones is a classic point and click adventure, streamlined for the modern age. Explore locations across continents and solve simple puzzles to return a variety of museum artifacts to their original owners.

title: Push the Blocks
description: Move the main block to the "X" of the stage. To do this, push some blocks, blow up others, and solve thought-provoking puzzles. Let's relax and burn some neurons?

title: Game Cycle
description: Relive the bygone era of CD-ROM shareware! As a recently-contracted games analyst, you are tasked by the CEO of Best Value Games to make sure the games set to be included in their upcoming release are up to code. How much you get paid depends on how much ground you cover!

title: Godumas
description: Godumas is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Explore the strange island, search for items, run or sneak your way through local inhabitants and find a way to escape… before you are sacrificed.

title: Betrix
description: Rhythm Tetris - fusing Tetris with Music. Tap rhythm with harddrop, and feel melody with stack. Create your own level and share it with other Players.

title: Jumping Jazz Cats
description: Play, race and hang with your feline friends in this online platformer party game! Purrfect your pussycat parkour as you sprint, jump, bounce, swing, skid and slide through a collection of collaborative and competitive mini-games set in a grandiose cartoon mansion. Get jumpin', jazz cats!

title: Solo War Medieval
description: Solo War Medieval is a first-person shooter game like no other. You need to survive against infinite amount of knights alone, but modern weapons would help you a bit. Modern weapons vs. medieval knights - what would be outcome?

title: Hyperland
description: Pick up, fire and dodge the bombs! An action-packed multiplayer casual shooter with basic moves but still easy to play.

title: Sexy Sharks
description: Short Adult-Only Visual Novel featuring 3 shark girls on the beach with different personalities and fetishes.

title: Quest: Escape Dungeon
description: Join the group of adventurers in the quest for treasures! Solve puzzles and fight the dungeon guards to find the cave full of gold and get back home safely.

title: Beltex
description: Beltex is a casual factory game played on a hex map. Extract numbers. Combine them using mathematical operations. Deliver them using belts across a huge map. Unlock new buildings and upgrades.

title: Near the Fear
description: Roguelite racing game set in surreal world of subconscious. Lost in dark corners of your mind, set out on a journey to rekindle forgotten light and find your way home.

title: Crossfar
description: Fight in massive, fast-paced PVP battles with hardcore team tactics in zero gravity! Choose from five drone classes upon respawns and put your spectacular pilot skills on display to defend your gate, destroy or sneak past the enemy defenses, cross the field and breach the enemy gate on the far side.

title: Epic Party Quest
description: A retro-themed party game for up to 4 players, in which each player takes the role of various now-retired fantasy heroes and relive the story of their epic adventures in a series of highly competitive, fast-paced mini-games.

title: Fight Club: All Stars
description: Absolutely accurate and totally precise physics based ragdoll fighting)))

title: Soul Link
description: Soul Link is a challenging puzzle game where you use your intelligence to build bridges with falling pieces of various shapes. Reconnect this broken land with Soul Bridges, and make the world whole again!

title: Collision
description: Daniel has grown up in the Thick Oak Forest for years, living with his mother and father. His father, Oliver, was drafted into war four years before the events of Collision. His father disappears just a few hours before coming home. Solve his murder in a beginner friendly, turn based RPG.

title: Barricade
description: Barricade is a zombie horde shooter with a classic 90's feel. Players use objects to build a barricade that protects their only source of upgrades. Endless waves of zombies will exploit weaknesses in your defenses. Will you juggle building, shooting, and repairing, or be overrun?

title: Solomon Snow: First Contact
description: Sometimes when you come to work, the Solar System is under attack. Glakmirk battle cruiser has landed on Neptune and portals to the other planets are open, and as Solomon Snow - an ordinary security worker, have to deal with an alien army coming out of the gateway in the Futuresalt Corp.

title: Paradise Cleaning: Me and my Doctor's Life in the Hospital
description: Paradise Cleaning: Me and my Doctor's Life in the Hospital is super-casual action game. All you have to do is just cleaning out all dirty icons by dragging over them within the time limit. There are 5+1 dirty icons and each of them can be cleaned by the corresponding Cleaning tools.

title: Scranny
description: Scranny has locked you in her house... best of luck escaping !!

title: Elvera
description: Welcome into the realm of ELVERA, an Indie Third-Person PvP Action Game passionately developed by a single developer.

title: Albert Innovation
description: Albert Innovation is an immersive, narrative linear horror game, where you will attempt to unravel the mysteries of what was once the most brilliant technological innovation company of the olden days. Manipulate machines, run away, and put an end to this nightmare.

title: Cosmopoly
description: Cosmopoly is a multiplayer board game for 1-6 players. Play with friends, buy planets and space stations, participate in auctions and trade, build upgrades and become dominant in space.

title: Incoherence
description: What started as a relaxing day off with your partner suddenly takes a turn when you find yourself waking up alone at the metro station of a creepy, abandoned complex owned by a mysterious megacorporation...

title: Count Pumpcula
description: Embark on an exciting 2D-Metroidvania journey through the Eastern Archipelago of Lanthir Range! Along the way you’ll need to save the Sagelings from a dark curse in the forest of Orn, fight prehistoric creatures that were thought to be extinct, escape the beasts that lie within the Isle of Orad, and slide through the icy catacombs of Krakens Pass. In your down time, relax with charming new companions on the enchanting Island of Travellers Cove.

title: Cowboy Hell
description: Cowboy Hell is a top-down, bullet hell shooter following a recently deceased cowboy and his horse as he adventures through a vibrant open world. Shoot cows, dodge bullets, collect guns, solve puzzles, and befriend characters as you work towards defeating Jeff Bezos himself!

title: University Stories
description: University Stories - an exciting animated game with lots of different girls. Go on dates with girls and win their hearts.

title: Shattered Heaven
description: Shattered Heaven is a single-player deck builder card game with RPG elements and an ambitious branching narrative, set in a dark fantasy world. The game focuses on a card game and roguelike gameplay fueled by a great replay value, thanks to procedural dungeons, a deep crafting system.

title: Return to the Skyway
description: Traverse through a fantastical island and utilize the local fauna to destroy obstacles. In this 2D platform, the player controls a character that has crash landed on a tropical island. Complete puzzles utilizing the creatures' unique abilities in order to fix their ship and return to the Skyway!

title: Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy
description: Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy is a indie game developed by GAMEPULSE. You play as the Touhou famous character Cirno, become a hero, and embark on her journey to liberate the Gensoukyo and save her dear princess.

title: Watashi no Kokoro ha Kirei desu ka: Am I Kind Hearted?
description: The heroines are left to pay for the treatment of a strange disease!? They have taken on shady jobs at night without the protagonist's knowledge…all while not knowing that it was actually a misdiagnosis.

title: Snacky Tower
description: Defeat enemies in a rock-paper-scissors style combat to clear every room. Your steps are limited, so plan carefully and puzzle your way to the top of Snacky Tower! Use gold to increase your chances to win or beat your highscore in endless mode.

title: Katana Rama
description: A mobility based, fast paced action game where you play as a hacker program, with the mission of breaking out of a digital security system. Coming to Steam 2022.

title: Animal Wish
description: If you have long dreamed of taking a break from the hustle and bustle of the city or becoming a real farmer for one day, enjoying the gifts of nature, then welcome to the animal farm!

title: Restart Your Life Adventures of Tylenol
description: Embark on your adventures in the fantastical land of Tenot. The mystical power of tarot will guide you to eradicate evil and darkness after your reincarnation. To be a great warrior, to increase your strength, to explore the unknown, to give you infinite joy. A Rougelike turn-based FTB game.

title: Special Gulag Rescue Operation
description: When the barbarians came and took away your people and put them in gulags, you knew you had to put down your wrench and pick up a gun! Play as an ordinary mechanic from Mariupol in this procedurally generated top-down shooter.

title: Prototypers
description: An arcade-style controller-friendly physics-based RTS game

title: SpaceKraft!
description: Explore the space and go for new adventures with this physics based space game! Discover steampunk themed planets, solve puzzles, gather resources, craft machines & systems and have fun with gravity in an open-world galaxy. Refuel, repair and upgrade your ship to find your way back to mother earth.

title: Heavy Burden
description: Explore the world in an abstract first-person platformer, immerse yourself in the game's philosophical meanings to awaken your desire to think.

title: Big Flying Asteroid
description: A fun little space shooter inspired by the 1979 classic Asteroids.

title: Rasetsu Fumaden
description: In the Edo period, in a world where demons, humans, and gods exist together, Rasetsu Raki, a princess of the demon tribe who possesses great sealing powers, helps people and defeats the enemies by skillfully using various 'sword techniques' and 'barrier techniques'.

title: Deadnaut: Signal Lost
description: Deadnaut: Signal Lost is a sci-fi horror turn-based roguelike where loyalty isn't earned - it's installed. Scavenge derelict ships and abandoned moons filled with hellish creatures, brutal AI and insanity storms. Gather gear and upgrades to fight or evade the hi-tech supersoldiers hunting you down.

title: Light Maze
description: A simple casual game where you light up floor tiles in a level in order to go to the next level.

title: Fetus
description: Fetus is an arcade hardcore platformer set in ancient Rome.

title: Knights of the Kitchen Table
description: Giant food monsters are attacking! As a Knight of the Kitchen Table, it is your sworn duty to defeat them in this action-adventure, hack-and-slash, souls-like game!

title: Ukrainien Agent
description: You play as a Ukrainian intelligence agent. Having penetrated into the lair of the enemy, you have to do a heroic deed, to divert to themselves the maximum attention.

title: Chasing Halo
description: It is a team tactical competitive shooting game,which has forged vehicles, novel playing methods,exquisite pictures and shocking scenes. In the tripartite battle of virtual history, we will break through the siege,use exquisite strategies to sweep away thousands of troops and be the winner.

title: SnowBrawl
description: A multiplayer snowball fighting game! Choose from different hero characters, team up with ur friends and best the opposing team in familiar game modes!

title: Planet S
description: Planet S is a real-time strategy game where your goal is to colonize multiple planets in a solar system to advance your civilization, build a city and supply it to grow your faction.

title: Neet
description: Alone on Halloween? How pathetic. Learn and choose how to live your sorry life, talk to a series of surreal visitors and witness the unspeakable in this highly interactive, soulful and atmospheric life simulator.

title: Castaway of the Ardusta Sea
description: Going on another solo adventure, Aisha sets off by ship. Unfortunately, a sudden storm and the incursion of a giant sea monster hinders her path. Through the turmoil, she is thrown overboard and wakes up on an unknown island. Aisha must find her way home and survive the pirates and monsters that lurk both above ground and in the deep.

title: Bots City
description: Artificial intelligence is out of control. Only a Hero can stop this madness. The Hero's goal is to get to the main computer and disable it, thereby disabling all robots. Our hero has only one weapon, but that won't stop him!

title: Space Monkeys
description: Space Monkeys is a solo-developed, fast-paced action game where you must unleash your inner ape to face 12 unique levels in space. Use skill and strategy to dodge lasers, evade enemies, and collect bananas in zero-gravity on your journey to escape a retro-styled evil space station.

title: Lost Dream: Memories
description: Lost Dream Is back bigger than ever! Explore the world as a cute little fox and go on a mission to find your forgotten piece.

title: Perfect Partner
description: Perfect Partner is a party game with 2 people work closely together to defeat other teams to win. The road to the championship is full of obstacles, your teammates may be your worst enemy! Have fun in this game or meet the soul mate you are most acquainted with here.

title: Workaholic
description: Workaholic is a frantic rouge-lite FPS where you go on a rampage through a hellish office space as your grasp on reality crumbles.

title: Sword & Fairy Inn 2
description:
Sword & Fairy Inn 2 is a life simulation and management game that combines inn management with RPG-style progression. Players oversee daily operations such as cooking, staffing, and expanding facilities while maintaining customer satisfaction and improving the business.
The game incorporates additional systems like farming, exploration, and mini-games, with a focus on resource management, character recruitment, and gradual progression through interconnected activities.

title: Five Nights at Sexy's
description: Welcome to your new summer job at the Sexy Fucking Club, where men come to have a good time! The main attraction, of course, is the new generation of sex dolls. These are animatronic robots programmed to do whatever you want!

title: White Paper
description: What is your subconscious mind trying to tell you when you are mindlessly drawing on a piece of paper? Maybe someone trapped there, in a dark, damp basement and yes, screaming for help and trying to break out?

title: Burning Requiem: Fates
description: "Burning Requiem: Fates" is a new 2-On-2 Indie Fighting Game produced by Project Requiem! Seeking to shake up the fighting game formula to bring some new flair! Featuring characters coming from the new tie in webcomic series of "Burning Requiem"!

title: Spiderbro
description: Help Spiderbro through a strange dystopia and overcome the shadow spider that is constantly hindering you. Collect items and solve puzzles and keep moving, don't let the shadow spider get the better of you.

title: Red Tower
description: The most violent creatures from darkness were arrested inside the Red Tower. An evil force capable of destroying it was discovered, putting all of mankind at risk. Shoot the monsters, upgrade your weapons, rise to more challenging levels, and destroy 'em all 'til not a single one is left!

title: Magic vs Zombies
description: Simple game of shooting magic projectiles to kill zombies and level up to get stronger and kill more zombies.

title: Night Blood: Avenger's Tide
description: "Night Blood: Avenger's Tide" is a side-scrolling action game that takes place in the world's most prosperous city, Atlandi. Players need to control Mark to find his own past, break through the enemy's siege, and finally uncover the huge conspiracy hidden behind the crisis.

title: Turbo Light Rush
description: Automatic Run&Gun containing 12 levels with retro-futuristic aesthetics. Make the best score !

title: Kinkoi: Golden Time
description: Welcome to Noble Private Academy, an institution that cultivates the wealthiest, most well-connected students in all of Japan! At this boarding school, one must be willing to accept all of its refined and dignified teachings or be met with strict opposition!

title: Heal & Hurt
description: Heal & Hurt is a fast-paced old-school arena shooter where you switch sides from angel to skeleton and vice versa every time you die! Both characters have unique abilities that you can use to outclass your opponents. You should also pay attention to damage types as you can either heal or hurt your enemies (and yourself!)

title: Doki Doki House
description: Doki Doki House is a dating sim that takes place in beautiful Australia on the Gold Coast. In this game you play as the heroine, which suddenly becomes the temporary owner of a guest house. Fall in love with these characters and experience the interesting story of your very own guest house!

title: Maelstrom Legacy: The Tesla Mystery
description: Maelström Legacy: The Tesla Mystery is a Point & Click / Puzzle game, where you lead the investigation in an anachronistic Paris where Nikola Tesla, organizer of the Scientific Congress, has disappeared. Investigate and unravel the secrets of a steampunk and Art Nouveau Paris...

title: Captain Gazman: Day of the Rage
description: New third-person beat'em up with shooter elements from the makers of December 24th! Mafia clan Nilgor is looking for a driver. But he finds himself embroiled in a war between the Nilgors and Gareses. Take control of Montana or Kurbon and take part in the biggest crime showdown of those years!

title: Real Rage
description: Are you too calm? Do you want to be angry? If the answer is yes, you have to play this game! You have to use all of your skills to complete the stages, and defeat the boss. There are many traps, enemies, and other surprises on every level. The deathcounter is waiting for you!

title: Qabara the Artist
description: An RPG adventure about the world's most anxious 9-year-old painter.

title: V.A Proxy
description: V.A Proxy is an openworld metrovania with a fast-paced action rpg combat like Nier, it follows the story of three last machines of their kind as they fight the corrupt ridden world and unravel the fate of their makers to decide the future of all remaining life forms.

title: Pigface Massacre
description: Pigface Massacre is a survival horror game can be played up-to 4 players. While trying to stay alive, uncover the serial killer Pigface's bloodcurdling mystery and find out the truth behind events.

title: Aero Tales Online: The World
description: Aero Tales Online is a new free-to-play Anime MMORPG featuring fantastic PvP and PvE features. You will find yourself in a mysterious story of the Key of Skylight. Choose your side, customize your character and enjoy the journey of Aero World!

title: Regular Human Workshop
description: Regular Human Workshop is a 2D physics simulation sandbox. There are no predefined goals or objectives. Simply throw objects into the world and interact with them in various ways.

title: Dick Ranger
description: Experience an amazing adventure with Dick Ranger, who set off in search of his lost father William, a valued explorer and anthropologist. Travel with the hero through different lands and places.

title: Turf Wars: A Snail Escape
description: Escape the garden in this snail-paced rougelike where you got to expand your turf or dry out trying. Danger lurks behind every bush, so just remember this one important rule: Stay. on. yellow!

title: Atama
description: Use physic powers in Atama to see through the eyes of your pursuers to avoid detection as you investigate a cursed rural Japanese village. You can't fight back; you must rely only on your powers and your wits to avoid your enemies. Inspired by Forbidden Siren and Junji Ito.

title: Dango!
description: Dango! is a casual liquid puzzle game. You need to pass a variety of levels, draw a path through which the liquid will flow and fill the vessel.

title: Graveyard Girls
description: Graveyard Girls is a halloween-themed yuri visual novel about complicated grief and overcoming hardships. Collect Elle’s “scribbles” to learn about her struggles, befriend a mysterious girl, and have a conversation about death.

title: Ballex 2: The Hanging Gardens
description: Ballex² is a third-person rolling ball game, the sequel to Ballex. You will control a ball, enjoy the scenery of the four seasons, overcome obstacles and solve various puzzles.

title: Autonauts vs Piratebots
description: Create, automate and defend an impenetrable base. Assemble and command a Bot army to combat an entire Piratebot invasion. Build, program and battle your way through five different zones.

title: HuntForOut
description: HuntForOut is a survival FPS game, where your main goal is to get out from The Labyrinth before it collapses. The task won't be easy; there are a lot of dangers in this mysterious place, and the walls are always moving to harden your way…

title: I Love Finding More Pups
description: Travel through all new locations as you befriend and adopt all new pups!

title: Room 12
description: You wake up in a place where all life forms want to kill you, and you don't remember anything. As you try to find clues about this place and your memory loss, a voice on the other end of a radio will try to help you out.

title: Afterdream
description:
Afterdream is a 2D psychological horror adventure game.

Navigate the obscure location populated by ghosts, and collect items to solve puzzles as you move further through the intriguing story. Look through the lens of your strange camera and photograph highlighted objects to interact with them.

title: Three Skies
description: Three Skies is a story driven strategic RPG with challenging non-linear dungeons, turn-based elemental combat, and highly customizable heroes.

title: Ceaseless
description: Create, Customize, and Command each module on your starship, explore ceaseless space filled with unique environments, and battle endless combinations of enemies in timed, turn-based combat.

title: Droned
description: Droned is a small, passion project that brings friends together for some good old fashion action. In that spirit, get your friends online and hop straight in some top-down combat.

title: Forever Lost
description: Who are you...and what happened at Hawthorne Asylum? Find the answers in Forever Lost, a puzzle-based, psychological horror adventure through a dark, forgotten landscape.

title: A Crown of Thorns
description: A Cyberpunk visual novel in a post Apocalyptic world that is a cross between Sin City and Blade Runner. Based on the IP of the 3 time award nominated feature film script entitled “Blade n Blood” .

title: Train Simulator: Midland Main Line: Nottingham - Lincoln Route
description: Explore the eastern reaches of Midlands territory with Just Trains’ latest addition to their Midland Main Line network, which spans 34 miles from Nottingham to Lincoln!

title: Planetary Exploration Company
description: Fight aliens as your explore planets, collect resources to build tools and items, while you manage your company and try to survive.

title: Repetendium
description: Fight against an army of elemental creatures hell bent on your destruction. Compete with other players on the leaderboards to show who is the master of Repetendium!

title: Elfheim: Chapter 1
description: Elfheim is a magical land beyond your wildest dreams! The king of the Slimes unexpectedly sets on an exciting adventure filled with lewd Elves, underlying mysteries and lighthearted fun!

title: Midnight Memories
description: A game with a mixture of melancholy and action. Where your main objective is to recover your memory and find your friends.

title: De'Vine: Heavenly Acres
description: Welcome to your farm on Heavenly Acres! Farmland that presents many opportunities. Harvest trees & plants. Grow Crops. Romance with other misfits. Collect up to 200 unique monsters and compete with monster battles! Indulge in the underground for buried treasure and dangerous monsters!

title: The Nameless Braves: Heaven
description: The Nameless Braves is a kinetic-style Visual Novel. Set in the fantasy continent of Ankh-Seah during a dour era referred to as "The Dark Age", one young man strives through trials and heartbreak to accomplish his dream of becoming a hero.

title: Otoko Cross: Pretty Boys Klondike Solitaire
description: Meet 5 cute cross-dressing characters as they challenge you to classic solitaire! Win with the cards you're dealt and unlock new outfits for your companions in this this celebration of Japanese "otokonoko" style and sub-culture.

title: The Tale of Treasonous Tom
description: The current King of Dilford in the Land of Pilfered is jolly old King Palaverous. What a putz! Using whatever means necessary, you must rise from amongst a heap of friggin' idiots to claim the throne. There are those who call you...Tom?

title: XP Soccer
description: XP Soccer is a game designed to look and feel like your favourite soccer games from the NES era!

title: Godtail
description: After what seems like a dull day of school and track practice, Violet overhears some conversation about some monster sightings. Afterward, her friend Hannah tells Violet to let loose and pay no attention to it – but maybe she should have.

title: Rage Rabbit
description: Rage Rabbit is a fast paced platform game set on an island haunted by mysterious shadows. Shoot down your enemies, explore an interconnected world, defeat powerful bosses and obtain new power ups.

title: Dr. Chatelet: Faith
description: Amputations, bloodletting, alchemy - all of which seem unthinkable today - were the treatment options that medieval doctors revered. You must face challenges one after another and experience gains and losses in the course of your constant adventures

title: Lost Life: Origins
description: "Lost Life" is an indie horror project where you have a chance to explore a foggy town full of mysteries. A place where worlds collide ready for you to reveal their secrets.

title: Five Nights at Floppa 0
description: You got a job as a security guard at an insurance company, but it turns out that it's not all that easy. After all, your tasks are not only to protect the office, but also to protect yourself!

title: Haunted Places
description: Survive in the radioactive zone and fight off all the monsters in your way. With you you have only a pistol and a little cartridge.

title: Cleaning the System
description: Get to the end of the level as fast as possible by mastering the mechanics of this out of control platformer.

title: The Backroom: Lost and Found
description: The Backroom: Lost and Found tells the story of a room in the backrooms. Can you keep your sanity, bring the lost together, and find your way out?

title: Hordound
description: Hordound is a mysterious and prosperous city full of puzzles and mysteries. But the darkness broke out and enveloped the city, hiding it under water.

title: A Loney
description: Welcome to the fantasy world of A Loney. Get ready for an exciting adventure with the main character! The world is filled with various creatures threatening the world! Grab your sword and deal with them!

title: Hanako in the Abandoned School
description: This is a walking simulator game where the story takes place in an abandoned school.You must escape the curse of Hanako and escape alive.Explore the school and collect the materials left behind to uncover what once happened in this school and find a way to escape.

title: Game Over: A Musical RPG??
description: An adventure RPG with rhythm based combat encounters, zany characters, moral conundrums and platforming elements? Oh sorry I didn't know this was a question. Yes.

title: Kaz's Adventure
description: Traverse Through 5 Beautifully Designed Worlds With Over 30 Fun And Exciting Levels And Tons Of Post Game Content To Enjoy In Kaz's Adventure!

title: My Dystopian Robot Girlfriend
description: Extremely unique lewd simulator game. Try to survive in a dystopian world with a very advanced and customisable sexbot you found in a ditch. Earn money with streaming, gambling, stocks or hard work and try to maintain your sanity. P.S. Sexbots are now illegal!

title: MrFox
description: "MrFox" is is a classic 2D side-scrolling platformer. To collect all lost treasures you will visit three different colorful locations.

title: Zombies Midnight
description: "Zombies Midnight" is a top-view 2D survival game. At night zombies come out of the forests and want to eat you and you need to stay alive, managing your shelter and resources.

title: Kokoro's Gensokyo Journey: The Lost Masks
description: A 2D exploration danmaku action Touhou fangame (AKA a danmaku Metroidvania). Control Hata no Kokoro in a journey to find her masks. Look for power-up items along the way and challenge powerful bosses to reclaim them!

title: The Accursed Crown of the Giant King: Chapter 2 - The Duchy of Despair
description: Continue your adventure with Chapter 2 of The Accursed Crown of the Giant King, "The Duchy of Despair".

title: The Accursed Crown of the Giant King: Chapter 3 - Citadel on the Wilderlands
description: The Accursed Crown of the Giant King, Chapter 3, "Citadel on the Wilderlands", follows the party out of civilization into the unsettled north.

title: The Accursed Crown of the Giant King: Chapter 4 - The Fallen Giant Kingdom
description: The Accursed Crown of the Giant King concludes with the epic Chapter 4, "The Fallen Giant Kingdom".

title: Astroblaster
description: An arcade-style 2D top-down space shooter. Blow up space rocks and space pirates for as long as you can. You'll also need to maximize a delicately-balanced economy of resources. Keep trying to out-do yourself! Five boss ships will break in at various points to make life difficult.

title: It's Dark
description: There has been a containment breach in a secret facility located deep underground. Experiment E.C.H.O has escaped and is running loose. The lab has gone into shutdown mode, and it's dark...

title: Rock Wrecker
description: Mine what you can and get out with the loot.

title: In to the 029
description: In to the 029 is a horror game based on live-action 3D graphics. Collect clues through simple puzzle solving and investigation. Face the truth through endlessly repeated investigations amid the growing tension and fear.

title: Downtown Jam
description: Revolt against Dr. Taste’s evil soda corporation by shredding the streets on your skateboard! Kickflip, grind and wall-ride your way downtown and beat your friends on the leaderboard! Trick and grind your way onto the leaderboards or wipe trying.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Bridges
description: Puzzles of Bridges!

title: Lost in Hell
description: Lost in Hell is a single-player game with endless hordes of monsters, grim characters and gritty scenarios! Blast your way through the evils on this atmospheric side-scrolling, with directional freedom to explore and combat, or to flee your enemies and spare ammo.

title: John Brick
description: John Brick is a game with a very simple and challenging mechanics, just be quick between shooting and protecting yourself

title: Valor & Victory: Shield of Cholm
description: Shield of Cholm is the second DLC for Valor & Victory. Cholm’s emergence onto the stage of historical events of World War II came about as a result of the Russian Winter Offensive of 1941-1942.

title: Elena's Journal: Unfinished Expedition
description: Help Elena discover the City of the Amazons in a Time Management adventure!

title: I Commissioned Some Bees 3
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bees as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 10 art pieces to choose from, and 1000+ bees, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: The Grim Nightmare of Nibras
description: The Grim Nightmare of Nibras is a story with the search for objects in gloomy locations.

title: Anvillage
description: In Anvillage you are a knight that needs to build a village by harvesting woods and stones. You will also be building tons of buildings and crafting equipment and other itens.

title: Furry Fantasy
description: Furry Fantasy is a match3 game with live2D animations. After a ship crush, main character lands himself on an unknown island. Get to know the kingdom, travel places and discover differect characters on your way. Your main goal is to get the Talisman of Wishes, a long lost treasure.

title: Resonance of the Ocean
description: Pick up what the waves wash ashore to make instruments. Use those instruments to answer the echoes heard from beyond the ocean.

title: Where are My Potatoes?
description: Hero nut character need potatoes. Solve puzzles in different level to reach level end and collect missing potatoes

title: Cows&Co
description: Cows&Co is a 2D puzzle game where you take on the role of a farmer named Ronnie.

title: The Game of Life 2: Sweet Haven World
description: The Game of Life 2: Sweet Haven World is ready for any peg dedicated to the art of candy-craft. Go to College and be a Cake Designer, or start your career as a Factoria Technician. Buy the Croissant Cottage or sparkle from the Lollipop Lighthouse. Sprinkle some magic on your life choices today!

title: Destoria: The Withering
description: Destoria: The Withering is a mini top down shooter game with a sole objective to survive as many waves as possible.

title: Alice in Wonderland: Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Relive Alice's adventures in Wonderland with this beautifully illustrated jigsaw puzzle game. Eight puzzles from easy to not-so-easy difficulty level, with cards and trophies! Just use the mouse to drag and drop the jigsaw pieces onto the right place.

title: Zombies Attack
description: Zombies Attack is a retro pixel action game. Pick up your weapons and fight your way through the terrifying zombies! !

title: The Rack
description: The Rack is the world's most innovative social hub to play 8&9-Ball in VR. With realistic ball and table physics, you can put your real life skills to the test! Whether you're an aspiring VR Pool professional, or seek the more casual lifestyle, there is sure to be enough to keep you busy!

title: Left 2 Dating
description: is a 2d puzzle game about dating. You need to help the boy or girl find the other half and complete the date in different scenarios.

title: Control Room Alpha
description: It's your first day on the job as a crane operator, in a dodgy underground science facility. Your supervisor will show you the ropes. Oh and by the way, I hope you didn't lie on your resume regarding the fact that you're not scared of spiders.

title: Sphere Game Legendary
description: The newest game in the sphere game franchise now, with new mechanics and challenges. Grab metal bars to pass the obstacles and reach the portal to the next level. Game developed by Diego Paes.

title: Alara Prime
description: ALARA Prime is a free-to-play, 4v4v4 competitive tactical first-person shooter. Choose your class, utilize a wide array of gadgets, take advantage of your surroundings, and work together to claim victory. The 3-team format of Transmission mode opens the door to new strategic choices. Teams can backstab, stay focused on the objective, or wait for their moment when the enemy least expects an attack. Pull into the lead and you’ll have to watch your back at every turn.

title: Legend of the Moon
description: -Classic dungeon exploring action RPG -For those who get sick and tired of endless and meaningless level up we developed it so they can get nostalgic about the moment you held a controller to see the ending part when young.

title: Galaxy Trader
description: Explore the galaxy in this peaceful space trading RPG

title: Universal Flight Simulator
description: Fasten your seatbelts and be ready for the most realistic and beautiful flight of your life! Universal Flight Simulator will let you pilot from old dusters to modern jets and helicopter.

title: Automaton Lung
description:
Make use of your special abilities to skate, shoot, and fly through over 40 unique locations, all rendered in beautiful stereoscopic 3D. In a strange land with almost no information you must be resourceful and clever.
Question everything you see and trust nothing you hear.
Each footstep taken, every mile flown, and all doorways entered reveal more to discover in Automaton Lung.

title: The Solar Ring
description: The Kingdom of the Sun needs you

title: Agile Firefighter
description: Agile Firefighter is a small game in which you are a firefighter and save people from fire!

title: The Marson Home
description: The Marson Home is a single player, mystery-thriller. Explore the home, find the pieces to the ritual, and rid the place of the tormenting spirit. Keep in mind - your not alone...

title: Redneck Rift
description: Every problem can be solved with a shotgun and every solution can be celebrated with an ice cold beer. Help Cletus quench his thirst after a long hard days work as he platforms his way through the bayou, time and back again in this retro styled, difficult action precision platformer game.

title: Ray'z Arcade Chronology
description: Ray'z Arcade Chronology is a compilation developed by M2 and includes the original Arcade versions of the three games in the Ray series, with the later two titles also having all-new HD remasters.

title: RayCrisis HD
description: Remastered version of the arcade game that was first released within the 'RayStorm x RayCrisis HD Collection.'

title: Koatl el Defensor: Los Túneles Perdidos
description: Koatl the Defender, the Lost Tunnels is an action platform video game set in the Koatl the Defender universe, published by Codex Studio.

title: Zombie Buster
description: Zombie Buster is a game that takes you to the pages of a creepy zombie comic. Didn't you dream about it? If so, keep it up! Fire the cannon, destroy zombies and clear the levels! Your luck will be with you!

title: Naraka: Bladepoint - Ultimate Edition
description: Naraka: Bladepoint is a 60-player PVP mythical action combat experience with martial arts inspired melee combat, gravity defying mobility, vast arsenals of melee & ranged weapons, legendary customizable heroes with epic abilities.

title: Non-Binary
description: "Non-Binary" is a video game that mixes text choices and bullet hell to tell the story of two non-binary people's journey of self-discovery. Make your choices. Dodge words. Go through things that hurt without breaking down. If you can.

title: UniverseV: Star Domination
description:
Conquer the galaxy and defeat the mysterious elder race in this amazing 2D turn-based strategy game. To do this, you will have to build your own fleets with different ships equipped with modules of your choice. Your conquest will be supported by special game cards different for each race. These game cards can dramatically change the situation on the battlefield.
You will be able to play 5 different normal races, and 2 extra races. Each race has its own ships, modules for these ships, and game cards that really can be the game changers. You will have to fight in 6 completely different arenas where each arena has its own special abilities that dramatically can change your strategy during the battle.

title: The Sea of Death
description: The Sea of Death is a mystery puzzle adventure in which the story revolves around the people and experiences that the protagonist, who has lost his memory due to an accident, meets in the process of regaining his memory.

title: Gale of Windoria
description: Soar on the breezes around the world in your flying Beakle, upgradable with parts to spread your accessible areas. Make use of the elementals not only in turn-based battles, but in dungeon gimmicks as well by combining character abilities. Find also the Quartzes to strengthen your party, acquire skills and techniques. Not to forget the entire world drawn with nostalgic pixel artworks!

title: Tropical Resort Story
description:
Build accommodation for your guests and get those tourists coming! Make the environment even nicer and discover great travel packages to give visitors the best vacation possible. Develop the resort to make your guests' dreams come true!
On this ocean island, the sparkling sea is a huge attraction of itself. There's a huge variety of incredible fish waiting to be discovered! Try improving water quality by placing marine plants and rocks in the ocean, and releasing fish you've caught while fishing - you may attract new fishy residents!

title: Beat Slug Hyperway
description: Blast through space in this slug filled infinite runner! Score points, unlock power ups, buy upgrades, and customize your colours on your slug kicking rampage.

title: Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak - Deluxe Edition
description: Experience Monster Hunter Rise and its massive expansion Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak in one convenient set!

title: Wits of Gods
description: Wits of Gods is a multiplayer turn-based strategy card game. The game uses a shared deck and you do NOT need to build a deck. The rules are simple. Play your hand during your turn to operate your deity and up to 3 pets. We recommend that you start with a 2V2 mode (2 players vs 2 players).

title: Machinist
description: A game production platform based on 3D physics engine and building block logic programming. Players who like creating games and assembling machinery can design a rich variety of custom games without having to learn and memorize complex commands and gain profit through the in-app purchase system.

title: Jinshin
description:
Jinshin is a JRPG based on an ancient-themed fantasy tale of when Kami deities lived alongside humans.
Mikazuchi, a man of sword mastery and wisdom, joins the Amaterasu Clan to save his master from Onigami Ichigan, the head of an ominous force. When the war is done, will peace or chaos reign supreme?
Make use of tactician Mikazuchi's orders and gain powerful formation effects to turn the tide of battle in turn-based battles full of ambiance and strategy. Use materials to craft equipment and unlock Kami Arts within weapons to unleash extremely powerful skills. Learn magic arts from Tsukumo Kami hiding all over the world, and focus on developing your village through commands to receive rewards and learn new crafting formulas.

title: Quadrata
description: Quadrata is a minimalist logic puzzle where you control two different characters with the same keys on either side and collect diamonds with a limited number of moves to finish.

title: Mission Zero
description: Mission Zero is a 2v4 competitive stealth game featuring blend-in and distinguished gameplay experience.

title: Ocean Man
description: This is a role-playing turn-based game. In the game, you will play a captain and lead your team to explore the ocean and find the treasure! You need to sail in the ocean, explore different islands, sometimes encounter sea monsters. You will find new partners, expand your team and adventure with them.

title: Hassle Online
description: Hassle Online is an open world multiplayer action role-playing game with no limits, with thousands of players on one map. Join the criminal world of your native land and gather your gang of friends or take the side of the law and arrest the entire underworld!

title: Nowhere House
description: Nowhere House is the third chapter in the Hidden Town escape game series. You will have to interact between three parallel worlds and seek help from the characters trapped in the house. Only with their help you will be able to escape.

title: Farm RPG
description: Farm RPG is a simple, menu-based, mobile-friendly farming RPG / MMO game where you start a farm, plant crops, fish, craft and explore.

title: Hero Tale
description: Follow the boy on a journey to become a Hero! Explore quirky medieval fantasy island, gain experience while doing quests and become stronger. Adapt your strategy by choosing your own path on the massive skill tree. And when it looks like you are getting stuck, remember, practice makes perfect!

title: Echocalypse: Scarlet Covenant
description: Kemono Girl RPG has topped the free download list on App Store and Google Play in multiple countries or regions! Embark on a journey with 10 million players worldwide in a post-apocalyptic exploration, and stand alongside charming Kemono girls! Enjoy a time-saving and relaxing card battle!

title: Devils 'n Dragons Arcade
description: Devils 'n Dragons is a 2D run and fight platformer turned on arcade action in a medieval fantasy world.

title: Duck Paradox
description: Shoot bouncing bullets to kill corrupted versions of your Pet Duck. Slow down time to maneuver in a flashy way as you try to solve puzzles under pressure and chain explosions to rescue the original version of your Pet Duck!

title: Loplight
description: Loplight is a twin-stick shooter taking inspirations from Hermetic lore and old alchemical concepts. Explore the ruins of this world, find out who's responsible, and defeat the monstrous creatures blocking your path.

title: Blade of God X: Orisols
description: "Blade of God 2" is a 3D hard-core action game. In this game, players will be one of the painful, sadness, ordinary, but great heroes; to adventure among the huge and mysterious Nordic kingdoms, to fight with the “sacrificers” who once lost their "destiny", and launch a self-salvation travel.

title: Brain Syndrome VR
description: Brain Syndrome VR is a FPS bullet hell shooter featuring a cell shaded art style and an option for local multiplayer. Even though the game has VR in the title, it can be played without it. The game has more than 12 hand crafted levels ready for you to explore.

title: Futanari Sex: Mile High Fun
description: An explicit erotic visual novel following the story of two gorgeous women taking advantage of their boss’s luxury private jet AND the hot futanari flight attendant in their pursuit of joining the Mile High Club as they return from a business trip.

title: Unilogue
description: Adventure with your unique friends and defeat powerful enemies! Unilogue is a new tower defense game with elements of a build-your-own roguelike. Form the best party you can think of and set out on a rugged adventure!

title: Ceke Ceke
description: Ceke Ceke is an awesome game for learning typing without looking at the keyboard. If you want to type like a 'pro' than this game is for you!

title: Elves Fantasy: Hentai Puzzle
description: A relaxing puzzle game full of beautiful art featuring sexy elves

title: TrackRace
description: Choose your little car and race!

title: Spermination: Cream of the Crop
description: You may have beaten off others and came first a thousand times, but you've never tasted the sweet Cream of the Crop. This sequel is harder, faster and will blow your crusty socks off! Choose from 3 difficult leagues: Hand, Mouth and the coveted Cream Pie! Crack the egg & unlock your bundle of joy!

title: Project: Eternal Flame
description: A sci-fi, apocalyptic adventure game combined with an alternative card-based platformer. Military cadet Rainman and his companions encounter a series of unusual events during their summer vacation, unearthing the truth behind the events of seven years ago. They take action, navigating the chasm between warring nations in pursuit of their own beliefs... Will they succeed? And at what cost?

title: 100-man-nin no Nobunaga no Yabou
description: It is a social game focusing on war simulation for mobile phones and PC. At the beginning of the game every player choose which warlord they want to serve.

title: Make Love Not War
description: 12 charming girls will help you relax and have fun. Girl soldiers, doctors, sailors, pilots and special agents are waiting for you!

title: Rooftop Garden Simulator
description: Who said the city can’t be its own escape? In Rooftop Garden Simulator, you can transform your urban corner into a warm and relaxing agricultural space. Build, explore, and connect with the sprawling, citified landscape in a stylized simulation that’s designed to be fun for gamers of all ages.

title: Maze Mart
description: You play as Isaac looking for a bottle of milk. Through small labyrinths you will have to choose how the story will end.

title: Vein
description:
VEIN is a post-apocalyptic survival multiplayer sandbox game. Gather supplies to survive, explore abandoned buildings, defend your home, and rebuild society, whether alone or with friends.

Game is currently in around the clock development and will include bugs and potential room for improvement

title: Hellfire Tactics
description: Hellfire Tactics is a competitive multiplayer card strategy game. Experience intense 8 player matches while drafting from over 40 different units all with their own unique effects on the game.

title: TotalNerds
description: You play Jona & Louise in a city where everyone seems to have something to hide. People have secrets and a plot has been hatched. Who can you trust? Better to trust no one, not even technology.

title: Max Capacitor
description: A simple puzzle game by Alan Hazelden and Andrew Shouldice.

title: Friday Night Funkin': VS Kacy
description: After BF and GF help Kacy and her foe, they continue their path of finding the right opponent for BF... or just getting out of the space-like environment. Too bad that they get sucked into a black hole, because they got company!

title: Hina-chan Snowtime
description:
This Touhou fan game involves skillfully guiding Hina-chan as she tumbles down a snowy mountain—not to save her, but to build a giant snowball.
Enlist the help of Nitori and Suika to knock down obstacles along the way.

title: Yippy Cube
description: Yippy Cube is a happy party game. You will incarnate cute animals, place and eliminate cubes falling from the sky with your friends in various interesting stages. Whether working together to achieve the goals or PK with other teams, you will have constant joy and fun.

title: Acanthoceras
description: A short game based on a Horror and Parkour mixup. Find Keys, escape monsters, Make your way in the ruins and fight back

title: Fortitude Invasion
description: The alien invasion has already begun! They're already here! Who can help the brave warriors to learn the full power of our civilization!?

title: Blockhead 2D
description: Blockhead 2D is a mostly multiplayer, retro-style platformer. It comes with a cast of characters, game mechanics that resemble the classic 8-bit brawlers and sound design that keeps the action going!

title: Hero Youseijyo
description: Hero Youseijyo is an old style raising mini game. Train up a Hero to defeat the Demon King.

title: Hauling Away
description: Alone and stuck in job that he has no passion for, Ray is about to meet someone that may change his life forever. Will they be able to find salvation together?

title: Floating Material -The Hill Where the Star Born.-
description: Shun is the only male teacher at Kyoukasen Girls’ School, a well-known high class school also known as the “Water School” since it is situated in a forest and there is a lake on the school grounds. It is a place to heal the wounds of those girls who are hurt. He meets girls who shut off themselves from the world, those who don’t have confidence in themselves, those who are still traumatized by their past. He decides to help them move forward with their lives.

title: Red Lucy
description: Red Lucy is an adult visual novel with a focus on more mature women and the secrets that they hold. There is a large emphasis on music and art's relationship with the human experience.

title: Ikusa Megami 2: Ushinawareshi Kioku he no Chinkonka
description: Battle Goddess 2 or BG2 taken place around one year after events of first game. Although, it is the second game release with Battle Goddess title and third release in the series, this taken place as the sixth game in the "Battle Princess" series.

title: Ikusa Megami Verita
description: The wandering God-Slayer Serika, who's still searching for his purpose. The half-demon king of Menfill, Loui, who just won the war, but lost his wife in it. This is the story of two infamous heroes and how their paths in life inevitably cross each other, and the conflict that it brings. While on the backdrop of the setting, various ancient forces rear their head and the temple of Marsterrie starts moving.

title: Ikusa Megami
description: Celica Sylphil, the immortal warrior known as the Godslayer, lives within the stolen body of the goddess Astraea. For this, he is hunted day in and day out; servants of the gods seek to kill him for the threat he poses, while demons seek to take the power of Astraea's body for themselves. Only the matron goddess of the kingdom of Rewinia offers him sanctuary; alongside the White Dragon Knights and their commander, General Revia, he fights to hold back the forces that would do the kingdom harm.

title: Beat Valkyrie Ixseal
description: Oudou Tsuguhiko is a student who believes he is the reincarnation of the Demon King, and is waiting for the time he can fully regain his powers. When that time comes, he is attacked by the valkyrie Ixseal, and further betrayed by his Demonic Chancellor Bezel, who steals six of his powers and leaves him only with lust. Ixseal learns that the Wargrim, Bezel's army, have isolated her from the heavens and her source of power, so she teams up with Tsuguhiko to fight back against them.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - Ruin
description:
You can run, but you can’t hide…

Enter the ruins of Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex in the FREE story DLC for Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach!

Gregory is once again trapped in the now abandoned Pizzaplex, and he needs your help! Play as Cassie, Gregory’s best friend, Faz-fanatic, and would-be savior as she braves the dark, dreary, and dilapidated pizzeria. Armed with only a Faz-Wrench, a Roxy-Talky, and this weird bunny mask, you will have to help Cassie find her friend, free him, and safely escape the ruins.

Can you save your friend, yourself, and the Pizzaplex? Find out in the 100% free DLC, Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach – Ruin.

title: Gwent: Rogue Mage
description: Gwent: Rogue Mage is a single-player card game that is based on the standalone version of Gwent. It features roguelike elements in addition to exploration and interactions derived from The Witcher Tales.

title: Little Nemo and the Nightmare Fiends
description: Little Nemo and the Nightmare Fiends is a 2D non-linear platformer with 4 playable characters that players can freely switch between. The game features artwork inspired by the groundbreaking 1905 Little Nemo in Slumberland comic, hand-drawn keyframed animation, and a cast of surreal creatures and characters.

title: The night spoke our names
description: A tiny game where you roll dice, use them to activate skills, and hope to survive the winter.

title: Race Day Rampage
description: Welcome to Race Day Rampage, a social arcade racing game built for streamers and their audience. In the game, you take on the role of Race Director. You pick the tracks, invite your audience and control the race. Cinematic camera controls let you zoom in on specific racers or areas, or zoom out and watch the race from afar. At the same time, the tracks have various traps that you can control to add to the chaos and influence the race!

title: Colorful Recolor
description: Colorful Recolor is a fast-paced puzzle game with a kaleidoscopic collection of brain teasers. Play through 100 levels with engaging mechanics, striking biomes, 10+ distinct elements, and an abundance of colors. Paint your way through this colorful world!

title: Time Raiders
description: Delve deep and explore the vast eastern undergrounds. Treasures? Monsters? Who knows what awaits you...

title: Jelly's Adventure
description: Move : →←↑↓ Jump : Space bar (You can long Jump or short Jump) Respawn : Space bar Reset the save point : R

title: Half-Earth Socialism
description: Try your hand as a global planner of a future society. Play with a wide range of technologies and policies spanning different fields and ideologies. Will you lead the world to ecological utopia or planetary ruin?

title: Slime Rule
description: A monster suddenly appeared, took over Uzacan castle. It destroyed a series of the world's top heroes, caused a worldwide uproar. The most shocking fact is that it's just a small slime.

title: Aliens vs. Ghosts
description: Use Nukes, Electricity, Freeze Rays, Heat Rays and powerful Minions to defeat all the Ghosts in this wave-based first person shooter! Only Ghosts stand in the way of your invasion of Earth.

title: The Newton Mystery
description: The Newton Mystery is a 2D puzzle platforming adventure where you play as a group of friends who have formed a rag-tag monster crime-solving team. Join them on their journey of self-discovery, wacky interactions, and realizations that everything is not as it seems in the sleepy town of Newton...

title: Interrogation Simulator
description: Inspired by JCS videos and similar Interrogation analysis. Match evidence with statements. Play good cop/bad cop. Make choices. Learn what makes people tick. Unravel the mystery.

title: Finding Felicia
description: "Finding Felicia" is a tale of the bonds of sisterhood, finding oneself, and lesbian love told through the lens of a charming point-and-click adventure. Play as Jessie Reznik, who goes on a grand journey around the Pacific Northwest to find her runaway sister, Felicia.

title: Train Simulator: Long Island Rail Road - New York: Hicksville Route
description: America’s busiest, most historic, and legendary commuter railroad – the Long Island Rail Road – now comes to Train Simulator Classic! A trio of iconic New York City terminals (Penn Station in Manhattan, Atlantic Avenue in Brooklyn, and Long Island City), across “The Island” to Hicksville, New York.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Pro Train - Class 68 ScotRail
description: The Class 68 is a type of mainline mixed traffic diesel-electric locomotive manufactured by Stadler Rail (and previously by Vossloh España) for Direct Rail Services (DRS) in the United Kingdom. This dlc - made by 3DZUG for the Pro Train series, is in the ScotRail livery.

title: Space Fury: The Phantom Menace
description: Tear up your enemies using various power-ups and weapons in this old-school debut project "07natuskare".

title: Pacebreaker: An Experiment in AI-Perfected Exercise
description: VR is not just fun exercise. It's the first generation of exercise equipment capable of meaningful live bio-feedback. Pacebreaker is the VR Health Institute's testing ground for research-based next generation exercise in VR, artificial intelligence, and content that can help save lives.

title: Sweet Tooth to Go
description:
Sweet Tooth To Go is Pogo.com's own variant of Bejeweled, developed by the original creators of the game. The gameplay is identical to Bejeweled, however it has a new theme. Instead of different kinds of jewels, the player now has to match sweets of different kinds.

The game takes place on an 8x8 grid of tiles. The player's task is to match three or more tiles of the same sort. This is done by swaping adjacent tiles. Once a match has been made, the tiles disappear and other tiles drop down to fill their place, possibly creating a chain reaction of more matches.

Sweet Tooth To Go has two game modes, normal mode and time trial mode. The difference is that the normal mode lets the player take as long time as he wishes, while the time trial mode has a bonus bar that continually counts down towards zero. The bonus bar is replenished when the player makes matches.

title: Stuart Little: His Adventures in Numberland
description:
Why is Numberland so fun? It’s because Numberland is a big animated cartoon, but in this cartoon, the child gets to be one of the characters — Stuart! And what’s going on in Numberland?

As the children play the games with the cartoon playmates, they earn “brainpower,” which they see filling up Stuart’s brain. When they have enough brainpower, they can use Numberland’s powerful Imagination Machine! This machine turns “imagined” toys into “real” toys, which the children can then sell in Bee’s toy store. So in a nutshell – – they explore and explore, learn how to play games from cartoon playmates, earn brainpower, make toys, sell them to customers, and learn math the whole time…And they never seem to get tired of it!

title: Bughouse
description: Play as Christopher, a kid left home alone with a terrifying STALKER on the loose! Try and survive in this 80's, PS1 inspired, Home Invasion Survival Horror game - OR DIE TRYING!

title: Hentai Dream
description: The girls fall asleep and wake up in a fairy-tale world full of bright colors and emotions. In that dream, girlfriends discover each other in a new way ...

title: ProBee
description: A fast paced, team based arena game, in which the players control cybernetic athletes to measure their skills at Ultimate Frisbee and Parkour. Strategically place yourself around the arena to catch your team’s passes.

title: Missing Cat
description: Please find Nuri, the cat that disappeared while I was picking up the feed!The protagonist and the cat (Nuri) who lived in a peaceful countrysideWhile you're on your way to get food, you suddenly go to the mountains to find a cat who left the house

title: Tower Defense King
description: Tower Defense King is a classic strategy game where players must build an impenetrable line of defense to protect their kingdom from gathering monster hordes.

title: Heaven Knows You
description: heaven knows you is a short romance visual novel about Inno, an explorer trapped inside a buried castle in the desert. there, she falls victim to a spell that waited hundreds of years to be cast. there are witches there. it was developed as a collaboration between drinkrust and enzu.

title: Gangs of Sherwood
description: Fight the armies of the Sheriff of Nottingham and lead the rebellion, solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Play as one of the Merry Men, combine your attacks, and free the people in this futuristic dystopia inspired by the legend of Robin Hood.

title: I.Rule
description:
I.Rule is a tower-defense fangame based on The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth and Plants vs. Zombies.

It's a roguelite where you fight monsters using babies with different abilities, based on familiars from The Binding of Isaac. Fight bosses, complete various challenges and craft the most effective strategy to win!

title: Dicey Dungeons Reunion
description: This is a major new DLC for the game – six new episodes, one for each contestant. There’s new music, new art, new equipment, and of course new gameplay!

title: Anna-san-tachi no Fushigi no Meikyuu
description: Anna-san-tachi no Fushigi no Meikyuu is a roguelike game produced by Capricorn.

title: Portal: Forever Testing
description:
Portal: Forever Testing Is a Fan-created Modification for Valve Software's Portal 2, containing various custom-built levels for the game.

Initially started in 2019 as a small map pack for Portal 2, Portal: Forever Testing has been separated into a stand-alone mod for the game after many iterations.

title: Stars in the Trash
description: Stars in the Trash brings the magic of animated movie classics into a narrative-driven platformer that combines action, exploration and puzzles. Tired of feeling trapped at home, Moka, a spoiled cat decides to run away and seek adventure. Explore, make friends, fight, and escape from the kennelman.

title: Doki Doki Takeover!: Bad Ending
description:
Experience what goes wrong in an official alternate ending to Friday Night Funkin': Doki Doki Takeover.

3 Hard-only songs await as the club spirals into glitchy madness.

WARNING - This mod features the following:
>Strong horror content
>Flashing lights

We do not recommend you play this mod if either of these things make you uncomfortable.

title: Zorpon
description:
You do not know what Zorpon is.

You must discover Zorpon.

Truly Understanding Zorpon shall surely put you on the road of enlightenment.

title: Crown Wars: The Black Prince
description: The War of Crowns rages on. Knights and brigands run rampant throughout the land, sowing destruction. From your castle base, rise to become the lord who leads the battle against the forces of evil in this turn-based tactics and strategy game.

title: Ravenswatch
description: Fallen heroes of old folk tales and legends: you are on the verge of a crucial battle against the Nightmare invading and corrupting your world. A roguelike action game from the creators of Curse of the Dead Gods, playable solo or in online co-op.

title: Paradize Project
description: Fight, Hack, and Survive! Alone or with friends, explore a mysterious open-world infested by zombies. Collect materials, craft weapons, and fight for your life. Learn to hack zombies to assist in fighting, protecting, or farming. Welcome to Paradize!

title: Voltage High Society
description: Punch, evolve, escape! This cyberpunk FPS Metroidvania pits you against horrific cyber-monstrosities as you master deadly abilities to break free from the derelict prison island of Nemo Ultra.

title: Starting Life In Another World Naked
description: You will venture into a world much like ours before you are "taken" to another world, a fantasy world. You are the hero of this new world, but sadly you start off with nothing. You must survive and build your way to defeating the Demon King; that's why you were summoned in the first place.

title: Skull and Bones: Premium Edition
description:
Skull and Bones Premium Edition includes:
- Base game
- Up to 3 days early access.
- The Ballad of Bloody Bones Collection
- 2 extra missions: The Ashen Corsair & Bloody Bones Legacy.
- Digital Artbook of 84 pages and digital selected game soundtrack.
- Smuggler Pass token (Unlocks a premium battle pass and additional content. Usable when new seasons release.)

title: One True Hero
description: One True Hero is an epic 3D platforming adventure featuring a young hero who can barely save himself! Explore ancient ruins, defeat an army of evil minions and unravel the mystery of the sinking town!

title: Dead Train
description: A zombie survival game that takes place in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. You must manage your food and water carefully because resources are limited. You need to make your way to the end of the railway and back to civilization.

title: E-Elementals
description: In E-Elementals you will play as E-Elemental 1k7. E-Elementals are advanced bots that are tasked with doing a variety of different tests and trials. Initially the tests seem normal, but 1k7 will quickly learn the truth behind them...

title: Mars 2055
description: You wake up, alone, on a planet that appears to be Mars. There is not much else I can tell you.

title: City Limits
description: Relax and build cities on a desolate tranquil island. Plan ahead to cover the island efficiently by combining buildings and cementing your place on a tile. Each turn an entity spreads, attempting to take over barren or unstable tiles.

title: Light Them Up
description: Light Them Up is an ambient PC puzzle game about constellations.

title: Fracture: City of Destruction
description: Welcome to Fracture: City of Destruction. An online multiplayer First Person Shooter offering a fast paced, arcade style shooter experience. Customize your weapons with camos, optics, and weapon kits and jump into battle.

title: Party Pie
description: Party Party is a VR party game, you can draw and share your own characters, chanllenge large number of unique levels with them. We will also add the map editor in the future , you can create your own levels!

title: Forza Horizon 5: 2019 Nissan 370Z Nismo
description: Forza Horizon 5 2019 Nissan 370Z Nismo

title: Nympho's Path
description: Nympho's Path is a hentai puzzle game for adults, where your goal is to defeat every enemy who stands in your way of pleasure. Are you ready to make everything try to satisfy your lust?

title: Prostitute Simulator
description: Experience the life of an attractive and sensual prostitute and seduce your clients in a city full of policemen, gangsters and cheated women in Japan, where prostitution is prohibited and your life is in danger at every corner.

title: Strong Moon
description: Explore Lunaria's planet and become stronger with new allies help, Moon Shards and Strong Moon's mighty muscles.

title: Zaccaria Pinball: Zombie Invasion
description: Zombie Invasion! The mode where brain fluid polishes the steel ball!

title: Our Summer Sports
description: Beat the heat with some thrilling summer games! Pass around the Joy-Con controllers and compete with up to four players! From Surfing to Jet Ski and even the Water Slider, there are ten exciting sports to try!

title: Runewatch: Age of Arcanum
description: Runewatch is a Single-Player Roguelite First-Person Shooter with Role-Playing Game elements for PC. The player controls an elementalist who makes use of their magic abilities while exploring randomly generated dungeons, defeating enemies, and progressively becoming a master elementalist through exploration, killing, death and repetition.

title: Chatbotaged
description:
Chatbotaged is a twitch interactive Chase horror game built in Unreal, where the player assumes the role of an unnamed clone, developed solely for the purpose of testing and demonstrating the effectiveness of Genespliced weapons developed by a company called Pyontech Industries.

The clone's task is to find the correct keycard in a contained space, while avoiding and potentially escaping the Weapons.

To raise the stakes, there's a timer, and Twitch Chat has the ability to "bend the rules," in ways that modify the game's behavior.

Will the player escape? Will the clock run out? Will Chat have mercy? There's only one way to find out!

title: Dungeons of Sundaria
description: Dungeons of Sundaria is an action-packed RPG where Heroes adventure through epic dungeons facing fearsome creatures either solo or with a group of friends. Master your class, loot everything, and destroy the foul creatures of the deep!

title: Eye Can See You
description: “Eye Can See You” is an otome horror game that follows a girl with psychic abilities that allows her to see spirits. As she enters a new school, she finds spirits residing in her school and makes it her goal to help them fulfill their deeds. But there is evil lurking in the shadows with its own agenda.

title: The First Descendant
description: Launched in July 2024, The First Descendant is a next-generation third-person co-op action RPG looter shooter featuring high-quality graphics developed using Unreal Engine 5. In the game, players become a Descendant whose mission is to combat against alien invaders – The Vulgus who crossed dimensions over 100 years ago and brought with them the devastating Colossi and destruction– for the survival of humanity and to protect Albion and the continent of Ingris. Players will encounter spectacular stories as they grow stronger through various missions and raids to finally discover the Descendants' secret. Cooperation is crucial as players team up with one another in strategic multiplayer boss fights where teamwork and tactics are key. New equipment, materials, and items obtained through a myriad of missions and boss fights will contribute to players’ character development.

title: Yamabiko ha Ojou-sama no Osoba ni
description: A doujin game by Nuu based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Mega Man Eternal
description: Mega Man Eternal is a fan game made by Daniel Page. In the year 20XX, the world was at peace for the time being, all thanks to Mega Man putting an end to Dr. Wily's schemes once more. During this time, Dr. Light had developed a new prototype technology to enhance Mega Man's memory and copy abilities called the "Mega Data". He intends to use the data to bring back all his previous creations to destroy Mega Man and take over the world. Using the Mega Data, Dr. Wily even created eight original Robot Masters as a part of his new Mega Data Number (MDN) series. Now it is up to Mega Man to stop him, save Rush, and put to stop to Wily's evil scheme again.

title: FSR: French Street Racing
description: A racing game in which we participate in competitions held in different corners of the title France. We choose from fifteen different sports machines, which can also be tuned to a large extent.

title: Cooking Academy 2: World Cuisine
description: Cooking Academy 2 is the second entry in a cooking simulator series. The goal remains the same, the player has to use the mouse to slice and dice vegetables and meat on the chopping board, liquefy ingredients in the food processor, and perform other common kitchen activities before the timer at the top-right corner reaches zero.

title: Patchy's Magical Maze
description:
A seamless blend of first person dungeon crawling with fast-paced action RPG combat, explore the magical maze as Alice while fighting off foes as her doll, Shanghai.

Project made for Touhou Pride Game Jam 4.

title: ExpressLane
description: ExpressLane is a 32 player multiplayer 1st person shooter. You and your friends team up to destroy enemy teams' respawn points, while defending your own. The map is built from randomly-selected floating islands connected by ExpressLanes that players can fly through. Last team standing wins!

title: BloodPit: Skelton II
description: Find travelers and fight mutants through the violent waves and endless levels of the blood pits.

title: Hexoplanet
description: You take control over a robot civilization that recently achieved self-consciousness and needs to prepare a new planet for their masters, the humans.

title: Combo Card Clashers
description: Combo Card Clashers is an auto battler meets roguelike deckbuilder - Choose cards for your combo grid and play them all each turn! Build a balanced deck, craft powerful card combos, and use tactical decisions to unravel each hero's mystery while saving the world.

title: Smash
description: This game takes you into the mysterious world, where each level is striking in its beauty and harmony. You have to explore it.

title: Gary Grigsby's World at War: A World Divided
description: Gary Grigsby’s World At War: A World Divided brings you to back to the dawn of the greatest and most terrible war the world has ever seen. Take command in this dynamic, turn-based strategy game of World War II that puts you in the role of some of the most legendary leaders of history. In Gary Grigsby’s World At War: A World Divided, you have complete control over the production, research and military strategy for your side.

title: Gun Star
description: Doujin game of the comedy slice-of-life series LuckyStar... with guns! GunStar takes the player in a series of side-scrolling levels blasting everything in sight, but unlike most side-scrolling shooting games GunStar aims for an FPS experience in 2D with WASD movement and mouse aiming, even emulating weapon recoil.

title: RedNeg 3Stars
description: Doujin bullet hell STG by あうとさいど.

title: Pita-Ten Minigame: Gohan to ka dekimasu
New Super Realistic Mario Bros.
description:
New Super Realistic Mario Bros is a kind of creepypasta game but not really?
It starts off normally, like a classic Super Mario Game, but suddenly, it acts weirdly...

title: Sloth Simulator Almost
description: Sloth Simulator is a round based combat mini game with fun gadgets and action heavy movement skills to unlock. Play as and upgrade your slot! Defeat enemies and unlock different islands as you adventure!
