title: Nantettatte Aki Shimai
description: A doujin game by Nuu based on the Touhou Project series.

title: LAZ3RZ
description:
Fast paced dystopian, action packed, mobility focused, competetive first person shooter.

Sail with us through space in the world of LAZ3RZ! You can currently choose one of 8 available characters and meet friends & people around the world
in the social area or battle your enemies in one of the arenas.

title: Popgoes Arcade 2
description:
A new POPGOES Arcade adventure!
Another day working at Fazbear's Fright. Your work has lead you to find old drawings, some vintage training tapes and recently, a real robot from the original location!
This attraction doesn't skimp on details. So there's one last thing... To tie everything together, a new arcade game, celebrating the history of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, was just introduced for the location!
Now that you've left some voice memos for a co-worker, you have to make sure everything about the game is in working order.
That kind of job can't be too hard, right? It's just a simple kids game, right?
You don't regret something you've done recently... right?

title: Dead Oculus
description: Dead Oculus is a lethal fast-paced bullet-hell where you can brutalize your foes by wielding custom weapons with cataclysmic attachments

title: Coin Operated Carnage
description: Coin Operated Carnage is a single-player rogue-like complemented by a unique tactical fight mode. Maneuver up to three lovable heroes at a time through tile-based adventures composed of hundreds of unique unlockable game elements interacting with each other.

title: Can Gym Break This?
description: Competition with yourself will improve your power, memory, and ideas to achieve big things in life. It will make you healthy and with health, you can achieve anything in life. The beautiful environment will give you the pleasure to play the game and try the different modes (Day, Night).

title: Satus
description: Satus - global fantasy strategy, in which you can lead one of the 4 fractions: magicians, dwarfs, dark side, hell virus. Every fraction is unique. Capture all the enemies, arrange the end of the world, build a great empire!

title: Mountain Offroad Simulator
description: Put on your safety helmet because we're starting a new off-road adventure right now!

title: Summer Road
description: Summer Road is a new RPG based on the concept of playing RPGs more casually. It targets people who are tired of AAA RPGs and want to play in a short time, and want to immerse themselves in nostalgia.

title: Revenge of the Orcs: Flag of Conquest
description: A fantasy visual novel about the end of an era when humans and orcs are at war. Driven by a burning desire for revenge, one orc hoists a flag of rebellion. Soon, it will become a flag of conquest!

title: SGS Operation Downfall
description: Project Manhattan failed! Operation Downfall, the Allied plan for the invasion of the Japanese home islands is set in motion. Start with Operation Olympic to capture Kyushu, and move on with Coronet, the landing near Tokyo. Force Japan surrender with the largest amphibious operation in history.

title: Magicians and Monsters
description: Flying battles, controlling Excalibur attacks, taming monsters, land and air battles, experiencing a different magical journey...

title: Pixa Clicker
description: Pixa Clicker is a game in which the objective is to earn an absurd amount of money. To do this you'll need a lot of stores that offer a variety of items or jobs.

title: Cells of Immunity
description: Become a young white blood cell in training and learn how they mature and fight against invading pathogens. Team up with other types of cells, with unique strengths and weaknesses, and overcome disease for good. To serve and protect the human body at all costs.

title: Fight For It
description: Turn-based, rogue-like adventure of randomness. Roll lots of dice to test your luck.

title: Neon Breaker
description: You break bricks. There's music. There's chaos.

title: A Webbing Journey
description: A Webbing Journey is a physics-based sandbox game where you play as a cute little spider. Explore a giant house, create crazy web structures, and complete oversized chores in creative and fun ways.

title: Shogun Showdown
description: Shogun Showdown is a turn-based combat game with rogue-like and deck-building elements. Position yourself and attack at the right time, upgrade your tiles and combo them to get ready to face the Shogun!

title: Banana Hell: Mountain of Madness
description: Jump your way to get the blue diamond as you try to survive a very annoying banana monologue! A REALLY HARD game!

title: Carnival of Gods: Oppression
description: An imprisoned Tyrant God risks to escape thanks to the help of his disciples. In a mission for your Gods and your people travel to his prison, Limbo, a powerful magical place and stop his rising before its too late or your world will be ruined.

title: The Monster Mole
description: An asymmetrical PvP horror survival game where you either try to survive and escape a vicious beast with your teammates, or hunt your prey as the nearly-blind monster that inhabits the surroundings of the fictional town of Dry Lake.

title: Ultimate Soldier
description: "Ultimate Soldier" is a classic 2D side-scrolling platformer. You are a lone fighter who was thrown into the jungle. Defeat the enemies, get out of the dangerous jungle alive!

title: Code Alkonost: Awakening of Evil
description: Code Alkonost is a first-person story-rich, atmospheric survival horror adventure game inspired by Slavic mythology. Travel through a dark fantasy world and encounter the possessive spirits and illusions of the underworld. Experience authentic art style and stories never before seen in horror games.

title: Trash Bomber
description: Inspect randomly generated piles of trash, poured into the incinerator. Find all the objects that aren't allowed to be burned down, and... BLOW THEM UP!

title: The Purge Dilemma
description: Do you have the intuition and cunning to successfully save yourself from the vicious Stalinist purges? Prove your loyalty to Stalin in this social deduction game designed for 5-10 players.

title: Utomah
description: Utomah is a 2D platformer in which the player navigates through a nightmarish world. Grapple, latch, and dash through incredible environments, discovering the darkness of one's inner mind, encountering true horrors along the way. Prepare to push your skills to the limit!

title: Vermis Orbita
description: Vermis Orbita is a fast-paced, wave based, action game where you control a Dragon-God who has the power to utilize orbiting objects as weaponry to fight off swarms of enemies.

title: Fallen Hero: Retribution
description: So you're a villain now? Let's see if you survive the experience.

title: Escape Chase Zombie
description: "Escape & Chase Zombie" is action game where you collect spheres on the map while escaping from zombies. zombies use their very smart brains to chase you. Escape from zombies with your instant judgment & selected items!!

title: Land of the Mage Lords
description: Summon troops and use magic to defeat mage lords and other foes while surviving attacks from their followers. Learn new spells and recruit troops with unique powers. Venture across the land, battling ever stronger enemies until reaching the evil Mage King.

title: Axis of Power
description: Stylized characters fight focusing on gameplay mechanics MORE than common input dexterity requirements! A pick up and play arcade-style 3D fighter that will keep you on your toes at all levels!

title: Red Fury
description: Fast paced arcade action where you become stronger as you are covered in the blood of your enemies and your own wounds.

title: Tatoe Sore ga Ningyou Demo
description: A doujin game by Nuu based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Crazy Traffic Racer
description: Crazy Traffic Racer is a new endless arcade race with the ability to break, blow up and crash cars from traffic. Drive along a busy road, earn money, upgrade your car and buy new ones. Take a fresh look at endless racing!

title: Moonrakers: Luminor
description: A fully-cooperative game mode for the board game Moonrakers. Luminor gives players a totally new way to experience Moonrakers, introducing a co-op game mode for 1-5 players where you'll adventure across a procedurally generated map, build up a ship, and face off against a Utopian Alliance General.

title: Hide Alone
description: You try to play dangerous hide-and-seek with a doll at home alone. Started out of curiosity, this hide-and-seek game has rules that must be followed or your life will be at risk. Never get caught by them, stay calm and survive to the end.

title: Lost Gray
description: Recover all 9 gems scattered throughout the stages, each gem you manage to get a new skill to help you, always remember to come back between stages.

title: Burg
description: Burg is a First-Person Multiplayer Hide and Seek! Both teams are equipped with a set of abilities they can use to evade/capture the other. When a hider is caught they join the seeker until only one player remains victorious!

title: Magnetic Bonds
description: Magnetic Bonds is a fusion of the visual novel and turn-based RPG genres inspired by shonen manga where players explore a vast galaxy, befriending characters and building relationships as they progress through the story and take down enemies and bosses.

title: Pitstop in Purgatory
description: Astrid wakes up in Purgatory and has to make peace with her death. Only problem is... she doesn't remember anything! Point and click your way through adventure based gameplay mixed with visual novel storytelling, and solve the mystery of our heroine's untimely demise.

title: Book Quest
description: Book Quest is an action adventure RPG presented in retro pixel art style featuring cinematic cutscenes and dialogue. Throughout this medieval fantasy, gameplay alternates between top-down and side-scrolling perspectives.

title: Football History Football Simulator
description: The Football History Simulator provides play creation for football coaches. It can be customized to accommodate the user's branding form team uniforms to stadium field markings.

title: Cavalry Girls
description: In this refreshing and exciting shooting game, lead the brave and fearless girl soldiers to fight with the enemy. Refit different types of machine armour, reasonably deploy machine soldiers with different skills, repel all kinds of enemies, and protect the Empire behind you in the gunfire.

title: Moonman
description: Moonman is a power of lunar energy created in a laboratory far from Earth. This is a 2D action game in which you run to the real moon while releasing powerful beams with self-inflicted damage and cleaving off the approaching enemies. Aim for the fastest clear while properly managing your energy!

title: Particle Hearts
description: Particle Hearts is a 3rd-person adventure game where you explore a world made entirely of particles. Use special abilities to manipulate those particles, solve puzzles, avoid detection, and navigate this sinister and beautiful land.

title: WatanOS
description: WatanOS is a c̶̭̄ọ̶͝m̷̝̂ṕ̵͉l̶͚̂e̵̥̽t̵͕̂e̴̝͑l̵͎͛y̸̮̌ ̷̡͝ñ̵ͅo̷̦͒r̶̤̽m̷̧̌a̵̼̽l̶̹̇ operating system for all your mistery-solving needs!

title: Popgoes Finale
description:
After Simon's successful domination of The Popgoes Pizzeria, a mangled Sec-Strings makes one last effort to communicate with WeaselWare. After hours of silence, and with only a few days of power left, a sign of life finally appears...
Fritz Glade is alive.

In POPGOES Finale, a dying Fritz takes a dying Strings through a selection of memories from his mysterious and misfortunate past, adding to and concluding the story of the POPGOES series.

Traverse through beautiful pixel art environments with a brand new chiptune soundtrack. This is not a horror game! There are no jumpscares, no dying... in fact, there is no losing at all. Just walk around and take the story in.

title: Kill It With Fire: Exterminator Edition
description: The ultimate spider hunting experience!

title: Once Upon a Time in Morocco
description: Explore the ancient and mysterious dreamland of “Once Upon A Time In Morocco”, traveling through the golden sands, discovering their secrets and their ruins, and collecting the Lost Tablets of Self Acceptance.

title: Milf Toys 3
description: Hentai is not just 2D girls, this is a whole art. And in this art units understand.

title: Eremidia: Archivist's Curse
description: Archivist's Curse brings you into an otherworldly harbor of knowledge: The Great Library, although unfortunately, you ended up in the dangerous section of the complex called Hall of Pawnsmoor.

title: Eris and the Fading Kingdom
description: Eris and the Fading Kingdom is a 2D Metroidvania where you fight epic bosses, meet strange allies and uncover the secrets of the kingdom, consume enemies and items to gain new ability's and heal any damage you might have taken. All with a 2D hand drawn art style.

title: The Voices Games 2D Collection
description:
A collection of 4 small games by The Voices Games:
- Ascendshaft: A vertical scrolling shootemup
- Violetti Goottii: A 2d Platformer
- Dragons in Space: A sidescrolling Shootemup
- Endless Shaft: A score attack survival game

title: Hidden Farm 2 Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: The Apple Tree
description: The Apple Tree is an interactive story in the genre of a visual novel. Investigate a series of murders together with police Captain Christian Tyler and try not to fall into the trap of criminals!

title: Space Bunny Explorers
description: After crashing on a planet in search of a new adventure, you decide to support an exploration team that gets attacked by robots and wild animals and help them unravel the mysteries of the planet named Kepler-452c.

title: Tainted Gun
description: Travel the universe as a hired gun and explore strange planets in this fast-paced roguelite action platformer. Can you find a cure against the taint before your time runs out?

title: Death Bowl
description: Death Bowl is a 2D precision platformer where you race through a deadly obstacle course to compete for the fastest time. The odds are against you, but with the help of experimental drugs, you just might live to see another day.

title: Third Wild
description: Survive, fight, build your buildings, and go on an adventure in a medieval open world with monsters and strange areas for you to explore.

title: Pindeavor
description: Pindeavor takes overhead action-RPG style mechanics and themes them along pinball-like powers. Bump, bounce, roll, and reflect obstacles as you make your way through 9 dungeons, facing off against enemies, bosses, and lots of balls and bricks.

title: Death's Playground
description: Enjoy scaring your friends or other players so much they might get a heart attack or try to survive from the horrors of the haunted locations in this Asymmetrical Multiplayer Psychological Horror Game! Death's Playground brings the single-player horror games experience into the multiplayer world.

title: Brave Heroes
description: Kill thousands of creatures and try to complete four seasons. Brave Heroes is a casual action rogue-lite game about using both environment and magical powers to survive against thousands of creatures that only aim to kill you.

title: Pawn Shop: Simulator
description: Pawn Shop Simulator is an exciting simulation game where you take on the role of a pawn shop owner. Your mission is to manage your inventory, negotiate prices with customers, and grow your business.

title: Helicopter Gunship DEX
description: Helicopter Gunship DEX aims to replicate the brilliance of 90s helicopter simulators using modern technology. Employ realistic helicopter tactics during missions generated by a sophisticated random mission generator giving you an almost unlimited amount of re-playability.

title: Ghost Trap
description: You've died and landed in purgatory, your options? Unending suffering or finding a way back to your world.

title: Malice
description: Malice: Burn haunted objects, banish demons in a spooky mansion. Multiplayer or single-player options. Are you brave enough to survive?

title: Lost in the Open
description: Lost In The Open is an atmospheric turn-based tactical game set in a procedurally generated low-fantasy world. As the target of an assassination attempt, you must fight tooth and nail to escape through the forests of Wailon while repenting for your past crimes as king.

title: Garden's Bane: DG's Quest
description: This is a difficult precision platformer.

title: Ima wo Ikinobite
description: A doujin game by Nuu based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Last Bus Home
description: A short horror game where you find yourself approaching a bus stop; it is late at night and the next bus to arrive is also the last one for today, and you do not want to miss it.

title: Bokura no Keshigomu Otoshi Shin Gakki
description: Play more! Hit it! Poke it off! The new school year begins with our Eraser Droppers! Battle anytime, anywhere!

title: 69 Andariel Hot
description: 69 Andariel Hot - Puzzle with visual novel elements in fantasy style. Dear elf Andariel is waiting for you in the "House of Flowers". Play a game with her and in case of victory she will fulfill your cherished desires.

title: Spooky Milk Life
description: Come on to the 'Spooky Milk Life', Explore and solve the mystery of Mid Night Falls with full of sexy characters and erotic situations. Procedural dungeon and Turn-based battle are waiting.

title: Spirits Chronicles: Flower of Hope - Collector's Edition
description: Not everyone who wants to save something at any cost thinks about the consequences. That's why the residents of Lorelai are in danger. Help them to stay alive!

title: Sonokuni
description: Sonokuni is a hardcore high-speed action game. In a world of bio-science fiction and Japanese mythology, manipulate time and space to protect your dying country from the forces of a superpower. This experience is truly HIPHOP as you continue to struggle for a solution other than violence.

title: Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend
description: Welcome to Eientei, combine multiple colors of mana to build your ideal deck, duel with gensokyo girls, and chase back the mysterious moon treasure. Also, enjoy the unpredictable Roguelike with fantasy Danmaku!

title: Blobble Wars 2
description: Mouse-based physics strategy game. Take the other team's towers before they can take yours! Features 50 unique levels and four difficulty modes.

title: Space Ranger Appleseed
description: Become a Space Ranger, guarding a Space Orchard. Fly across asteroid belts, drive across dusty moonscapes & liase with the Space station to get your bumper crop of space apples ready!

title: Echo Wisp
description:
A Metroidvania Adventure into the Spectral Depths.
Embark on a captivating metroidvania journey in Echo Wisp! As the guardian Specter and his trusty companion Mip, you must venture into the heart of darkness to seal away the malevolent Dark Wisps, spectral entities threatening the peace of the forest. Explore a vast, interconnected world teeming with danger and mystery.

title: Meta Sudoku
description: Meta Sudoku is a minimalist game, fresh interface and quiet music is very suitable for relaxation, reduce fatigue, give you the most comfortable experience.

title: The Wire Man
description: This game is a difficult 2d platformer game where you use wires to get to the goal point.

title: My Divorce Story
description: Gather evidence for a successful divorce! My Divorce Story, created by an experienced divorce lawyer and based on real-life counseling, now on the Steam!

title: Shogunaria
description: Shogunaria is an action-adventure RPG that takes elements from old school classics like Zelda, YS, Neutopia, Golden Axe Warrior, and Diablo. Select one of the 4 characters and take on a series of dungeons filled with traps and enemies!

title: Minimal Bubble Pop
description: Keep your score high with bubble management skills.

title: Doodle Drive
description: DoodleDrive is a 2d creative driving / puzzle / physics game. Doodle roads and shapes and unleash your driving skills on the path you have crafted to reach the Finish line.

title: Picking Wheat
description: This game is mainly composed of two parts: you are forced to watch some author's nonsense, and some simple puzzle levels. There are 9 preset levels to help players understand the basic rules of the puzzle. Free level editor, players can edit and upload levels, Download them, and give your likes!

title: Havendock
description: Havendock is a cozy colony sim set in the heart of the ocean. Players build a thriving town from the ground up — welcoming new settlers, managing resources, and exploring new lands at their own pace. The game features character creation, resource collection from floating debris, farming, animal raising, automation systems, and deep-sea exploration via submarine.

title: Limited Lifetime Corp
description: Lead your LLC to its inevitable destruction in this day by day management sim. Harvest resources, make a profit, expand your Corp. But be careful; from the local fauna to the Syndicate, no one wants you to succeed.

title: Miyeon-si Simyulleiteo: Misonyeo Geimui Juingongeul Jojonghaneun Geim
Daguri: Gambling Apocalypse
description: Daguri: Gambling Apocalypse is an open world gambling simulator. You must help ‘Daguri’ pay the debts he racked up during an unintended gambling spree. Roam the world, bet on gambling mini-games, and make some money!

title: Flightpath
description: A story-driven, quirky shoot'em up, where your path choices affect the outcome of the story. Select one of three possible characters, each with its own storyline and see how the choices you make change the way the game unfolds.

title: Gravity Flux
description: A 2D local multiplayer shooter featuring robots, where the gravity randomly changes. Up to 8 players.

title: Radial Flow
description: Flow to the beat of your own music in this psychedelic, addicting, and punishingly difficult arcade game. Enjoy endless challenge and replayability with over 30 different levels of various difficulties.

title: Last of Ark
description: A roguelike deckbuilding tactics game that combines elements from 'Monster Train' and 'Into the Breach'.The player needs to establish organization in a destroyed world, defend against enemy attacks, and restore order.

title: Escape Yourself
description: You will take on the role of Danny Bent, a boy who wakes up in a train car. Without memories and without knowing why he is there, he soon realizes that something strange is going on. Can you solve all the puzzles? Of discovering the truth? Will you be able to escape?

title: Cooper's Cleanup
description: Cooper's Cleanup is a top-down collect-a-thon. You play as C.O.O.P.E.R, a robot vacuum who is moving around a home, "cleaning" up the collectibles hidden throughout the level. However, C.O.O.P.E.R is new to his environment, and needs some time to find his way around.

title: Out of Ore
description: A casual heavy equipment experience. Mine ore, Move dirt, Build and repair.

title: An Iou
description: AN IOU is the debut visual novel by Davey Cadaver. The music, backgrounds, & characters work together to create a world that is the stage of a novel for the user to read. The user takes the POV of the protagonist to experience a memorable story with an incredible soundtrack and multiple endings.

title: A Clumsy Flight
description:
A Clumsy Flight is a 2D action-roguelike with a focus on dodging enemy planes and upgrading your equipment.

Shoot down swarms of planes to survive your adventure through the clouds. Make smart upgrade decisions along the way to not get submerged by the hundreds of enemies coming your way.

title: The Mystery of William Moore
description: Put on your detective hat, and get ready for the mystery of a lifetime. Embark on a plot-driven, walking simulator-puzzle video game with an amazing plot and surprise ending.

title: Roots in the Sky: The Hand of Glory 2
description: After five years in hiding, former Miami detective Lazarus “Lars” Bundy is swept up in another globe-trotting supernatural mystery whose origins trace back to a legend about the creation of Earth itself.

title: Cityscape Sprint
description: Use your momentum in this arcade style platformer to conquer each stage and climb the leaderboards. Enjoy 2-4 hours of tight gameplay in bright, cheerful levels - easy to beat but impossible to perfect.

title: Scary Mansion Horror House HD
description: Welcome to your new mansion, on the Scary Mansion: Horror House 3D!

title: Death Leak
description: Death Leak is a 2d twin-stick shooter/platformer with an emphasis on exploration. Use the gamepad to fire throwing knives while avoiding enemy projectiles. Explore the world and figure out what caused the massacre of your village.

title: Through the Night
description: Through the Night is an action game in which you travel Through the forest at night looking for flies and killing them.

title: Still Here
description: Go to school no matter when you are.

title: 13 Wood St Remastered
description: 13 Wood St, a night in October: a long road, a dark forest and the house mentioned in the last will, making you the owner of a mysterious property. Welcome to 13 Wood St, a story rich horror game! Remastered 2022.

title: Five Nights at Candy's 4
description: Five Nights at Candy's 4 is a upcoming fourth installment of the Five Nights at Candy's series developed by Emil Macko. Five Nights at Candy's 4 will be the fourth and last game of the Five Nights at Candy's series. Forgotten Candy is confirmed to be the main antagonist of the game.

title: Peepo Island
description: A difficult obstacle course 3D platformer where the goal is to survive and escape the Island!

title: Cobra Kai 2: Dojos Rising
description: Immersing fans with what they love about the series, Cobra Kai 2 offers players a unique perspective from all 3 competing dojos-featuring an engaging "pick your story" narrative campaign that will shape the entire story, ending, and even who the player controls.​

title: Shadow of Destiny
description:
Shadow of Destiny is an adventure game. There are no action elements in the game, and the protagonist has no health bar. Each chapter has a time limit, during which Eike has to find a way to prevent the murderer from killing him. This is mainly achieved by traveling through time to different hours, days, years, and even centuries. Obtaining a crucial item, having a conversation with a specific character, or performing another action in the past will prevent Eike from getting killed. Time-traveling requires energy units, which can be found by exploring the town. If Eike fails to achieve the goal at hand within the allotted time and prevent his murder, the chapter must be restarted.

During the course of the game the player will have several choices and opportunities to change the future in various ways. Due to the time-traveling feature, many objectives can be accomplished in non-linear ways, branching the storyline and eventually resulting in eight different endings, six of which can be achieved during the first playthrough, and two others unlocked after having reached the other six.

title: Seven Seas
description: Sail across the seas and hunt down pirate ships. Enter a turn-based combat mode and control your fleet across the naval battle area. Utilize a variety of weapons and tactical means to either sink or board enemy ships and defeat them before they make the next move.

title: Mickey Mouse Kindergarten
description: Disney Learning Mickey introduces school-age players to the worlds of time, listening, and dancing. Players will have the company of Mickey Mouse, Donald Duck, and other Disney characters throughout the game. The "edutainment" includes matching exercises, identification games, and creativity art opportunities. The developers have targeted seven primary areas: cognitive, creative, emotional, moral, physical, social, and thinking skills are all given attention.

title: Nickelodeon Kart Racers 3: Slime Speedway
description: Rebuilt and re-imagined from the ground up, Nickelodeon Kart Racers returns - bigger and better than ever! Featuring a fully voice-acted cast of over 40 iconic characters, drift, slide, and boost your way to the finish line on tracks inspired by legendary Nickelodeon shows like SpongeBob SquarePants, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, Avatar: The Last Airbender, and more!

title: Aquarium Land
description:
Dive into an aquatic world where amazing animals await you!
Go fish in the sea, swim, catch species like goldfish, starfish, koi fish and add them to your fish tank to expand your aquarium shop!

Drive a motorboat, ride a jet ski or just jump in the water and dive with a friend in multiplayer mode!

title: Asterix & Obelix XXXL: The Ram From Hibernia
description: Join Asterix & Obelix in a brand-new original story in… Hibernia! Explore this crazy action-adventure in a local coop mode up to 4 players!

title: Asterix & Obelix XXXL: The Ram From Hibernia - Limited Edition
description:
Join Asterix & Obelix in a brand-new original story in… Hibernia! Explore this crazy action-adventure in a local coop mode up to 4 players!

Asterix & Obelix XXXL: The Ram From Hibernia - Limited Edition includes:
- Game: Asterix & Obelix XXXL: The Ram From Hibernia
- Two sticker sheets
- 3 lithographs

title: Construction Simulator: Day One Edition
description: The Day One Edition of Construction Simulator contains additional designs for your personal protection equipment: Customize your helmets with 9 different designs and choose from a selection of ear protection and glasses! Additionally you can choose a sleek new sports car to drive around the two huge world maps and find a bobblehead of your good friend Hape on the dashboards of select vehicles.

title: Mir M
description:
MMORPG and Sequel to MIR4 (2021), In the world of MIR M, strength is not the only factor in measuring one's growth.

You can walk the path of the hero, ruling over the battlefield with overwhelming power. Or, you can walk the path of the master, gathering, mining, and fishing to reach the highest level.

Whichever path of growth you choose is completely up to you. The results of the choice you make will be recognized by all as meaningful.

title: 12 Tails Online
description:
'12 Tails Online' is a Thai instance-based MMORPG by BigBug Studio.

'12 Tails Online' are named for the 12 animal species that make up the playable classes; Bat, Bison, Cat, Chameleon, Mole, Monkey, Panda, Penguin, Rabbit, Sheep, Whale, and Wolf.

title: Lollipop Chainsaw RePop
description: Lollipop Chainsaw RePop is a remaster of the original. RePOP is a definitive version of the game which leaves the story unchanged, with the focus on quality of life improvements and additional gameplay content.

title: Sproink
description: In an action-packed story-based gem matching game involving fast decisions, perilous bridges, collapsing cave systems, and plentiful explosives, you are this civilization's only hope.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants and the Nicktoons Gravjet Racing
description: SpongeBob SquarePants and the Nicktoons Gravjet Racing was a racing game planned for release in 2009 featuring characters from SpongeBob SquarePants, Barnyard, Ren And Stimpy, Fanboy And Chum Chum, My Life As A Teenage Robot, The Mighty B and possibly more. Before its cancellation, the ESRB rated the game and gave it an E rating along with stating that it was intended to be released for the Xbox 360 and PC. The name of the developers and publisher however have not been revealed.

title: SpongeBob Diner Dash 2: Two Times the Trouble
description: Developed and published by PlayFirst in 2007 for PC, this time management game has players help SpongeBob and friends save their favorite restaurants from Sharkey Two-Times, who plans to open a casino in Bikini Bottom. The game features new characters, challenges, power-ups, and restaurants while maintaining the classic Diner Dash gameplay style.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man: Creative Studio
description: Swing into action with the Spider-Man Creative Studio! Star in your own comic book! Import your own photos & you star with Spidey. Make hundreds of SPider-Man creative projects including calendars, greeting cards, bookmarks & more. Discover the Spider-Man character profiles & learn about Spider-Man, his friends & foes. Answer the amazing questions in the Spider-Man Quiz. Play Spider-Man games including Spider-Man Sudoku, Solitaire, Puzzles, matching games & more!

title: Spellagories
description: Unscramble magical words in a fantasy curse‑breaking word game.

title: Sphera: The Inner Journey
description: Join Tess, a lonely young girl, on a perilous journey into a world born from her imagination in Sphera, a new hidden object adventure from Sandlot Games! Teased relentlessly by her older brother for her quirks and oversized glasses, Tess longs to escape her isolated life. Her chance arrives when she discovers a mysterious marble that transports her to a bizarre realm ruled by a kind walrus-like creature named Zuchary. However, when Zuchary's adopted son, Jacob, betrays him, he turns to Tess for help. In return, she will be given the chance to return home. Aid Tess in embracing her true destiny as a warrior princess in Sphera!

title: Spider-Man 2: Activity Center
description: Just like Spider-Man, kids can swing from the rooftops of Manhattan fighting crime and battling the evil Doc Ock in an interactive learning environment. Spider-Man Activity Center features seven challenging activities based on specific movie events that all take place in key locations. The game's activities involve saving Mary Jane, identifying the criminals, creating mixtures in the lab, and more. Actors from the movie Spider-Man 2 lend their voices to the game.

title: Cooking Academy
description: Grab your oven mitts and don your Chef's Hat! Cooking Academy is the game that places you in the kitchen of a prestigious culinary school! From eggrolls to pancakes, from ravioli to creme brulee, it's up to you to prepare over 50 recipes! Learn interesting trivia about food while mastering the skills of chopping, kneading, mashing, flipping, frying, and much more! Unlock new recipes and trophies by passing your cooking courses and exams. Are you ready to be a Master Chef? Well, then it's time to enroll at the Cooking Academy!

title: K3LVN
description: K3LVN is a sci-fi action platformer where the player is a creature who’s been experimented on and is trying to escape the space station lab where they’re being kept. K3LVN is able to change their state of matter to alter their behavior. The three states usable are the Gel state which is the default bipedal state, the Liquid state which makes K3LVN smaller and grants the ability to climb on certain walls, and the Solid State, which turns K3LVN into a ball to roll around and gain momentum. They must use these abilities in combination with each other to traverse the environment as quickly as possible.

title: Crystalize! 2: Quest for the Jewel Crown
Valand
description: Valand is a Viking Age city builder. With your own strength you have to rebuild the whole settlement and bring it to prosperity.

title: The Last Metal Shooter
description: he Last Metal Shooter is a 2d Game art style run and gun action game focused on wave battles with the enemies and fighting using different weapons that can be selected and changed during the fights.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Ice Creams
description: Puzzles of Ice Creams!

title: Streamer's Court
description: Streamer's Court is an interactive game that can be played with your Twitch chat! In this game, you as a streamer are the judge of your chat and decide whether they are guilty or not guilty. Of course, your chat may disagree with you!

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Wacky West
description: 3 Brand New Tables with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Wild Western themed tables with a 50's and 60's style pinball inspiration.

title: Poly Puzzle: Primates
description: Cute, relaxing, polygonal puzzle game with primates.

title: Mystery Solitaire: Grimm's Tales 6
description: The magical medieval world of the Brothers Grimm fairy tales continues to fascinate with its diversity. The Middle Ages in all its splendor.

title: Lewis Carroll's Alice
description: Lewis Carroll's Alice is a short interactive narrative game based on the classic English 1865 children's book, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, by Lewis Carroll.

title: Jacktus Green: The Fluffy, the Spiky and the Spicy
description: Chase Guindilla to retrieve your beloved Cattus! Jump, dash, and hook around in this 2.5D platformer. Discover different levels, fight enemies, ride minecarts and meet the bizarre neighbors of Sofrito Town.

title: Iron Ruler
description: Iron Ruler provides that quick 20-60 minute strategy break you need while your food is cooking, or your code is compiling, or the paint is drying... Iron Ruler's unique ruleset uses the triangular number sequence.

title: Gunship Battle: Crypto Conflict
description: ‘Gunship Battle: Crypto Conflict’ is the newest installment of the Gunship Battle series - a 4X massively multiplayer strategy game. Utilize jets, aircraft carriers, and other units to fight your battles in real time at sea. Gather and upgrade your units with TITANIUM to conquer the battlefield.

title: Galactic Escape
description: In this top-down roguelike shooter game you go through levels of enemies to escape [???]. You do this with the help of weapons and items you find on the way. You can equip up to two weapons. Mix and match the weapons and items you find to make combos that work together.

title: Furry Orgasm
description: Furry Orgasm - is an amazing 2D puzzle with images of furry beauty ladies the final purpose of which to give you some pleasure!

title: Breakyo
description: Classic Brick-Breaking game with a slight fusion which completely alters the fundamental gameplay.

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Interior Design
description: Bright, modern and unconventional interior design. Each picture is a unique choice and vision of amazing people. Enjoy a selection of incredible designs.

title: Dungeon Slime Collection
description: While walking in the forest, our slime fell into a slippery dungeon! Can you help him get out only by sliding to the dungeon’s walls? Dungeon Slime Collection is a bundle of two games, Dungeon Slime: Puzzle’s Adventure and Dungeon Slime 2: Puzzle in the dark forest.

title: Cyber Chess
description: A fantasy adventure for beginners and grand masters. Three totally unique chessboards and themes make this program the ultimate challenge for novice and advanced players.

title: Space Rangers 2: Reboot
description:
It's an official remake of the "Space Rangers 2: Dominators".

This edition contains the original "Space Rangers" (2002) and the improved version of the "Space Rangers 2: Dominators" (2004). Among the new features are new game modes, new spaceship screen, new spaceship types, new equipment with additional characteristics, new text quests and new maps.

This edition also contains a lot of fan art - mini-games, pictures, wallpapers and screensavers. Many "Space Rangers" fans from the official game forum actively contributed to this remake - they created maps, wrote quests and tested the game.

title: E.T.E Chronicle
description:
In the near future, chaebols will replace the political power, and wars will continue in order to compete for interests.
The Igodra Company discovered the remains of aliens and their equipment in the near-Earth universe - code-named [Urd], and then discovered a mysterious particle that humans have never understood, called the Delta particle.
The appearance of delta particles has broken the balance of human forces. Relying on the unique delta technology, Ygodra Corporation has developed a powerful extensible tactical exoskeleton——Aita, whose military strength has reached an absolute advantage over the chaebol.
In order to consolidate its interests, Ygodra Corporation built a huge circular orbital base - Gray City above the equator, and carried strategic weapons on it.
The existence of Gray City threatens the interests of other chaebols, and they unite to form the "Human Alliance" to attack the Ygodra Corporation. In the end, the Human Alliance won the war at a heavy cost, and the Gray City was paralyzed, but the absolute strength of the Ygodra Corporation was not shaken.
During the war, the Human Alliance captured the artificial life body 01 manufactured by Igodra Corporation based on Urd, and then developed its own Delta Technology and Aita, breaking the monopoly of Igodra Corporation on Delta Technology , the Human Alliance and Ygodra Corporation entered a period of confrontation.

title: Deepening Fire
description: Deepening Fire is a soulslike horizontal scroll action single-player game. You'll take a solo adventure in the Rhost Kingdom to challenge the powerful enemies, choose a variety of weapons, put on strong armor, and defeat the most terrifying enemies with precise blocking. Explore hidden levels, collect story pieces, and reveal ancient secrets of the Rhost Kingdom.

title: Breath of Ghosts 2
description: Breath of Ghosts is a first-person horror game made in realistic 3D graphics that immerses you in an atmosphere of horror and scares you in every way. The main goal is to survive and be saved.

title: Mushroom Musical
description: A colorful rhythm platformer game.

title: Pet Shop Hop
description:
Hop to it in order to save your family's pet shop from being gobbled up by MegaPet Superstore!
Sell pets and accessories to challenging customers!
Keep the shop clean, the animals fed, and use tips to upgrade the decor or your resources!

title: Hot Sento Girls and love
description: Hey, wanna warm up with me?

title: Penguin Puzzle
description: Penguin Puzzle is a puzzle game where you slide colored ice cubes around to either create a 2x2 or 3x2 square of the same color, or match the bonus shape shown to the right. With every move, more ice cubes appear, so plan your moves well. Every five levels, a bonus level will fill the screen with ice cubes. Click on a block to remove all connected ice cubes of the same color. After removing those, the remaining ice cubes will fall down to take their place.

title: 4 Minutes and 33 Seconds of Uniqueness
description: A game which can only be won by being the only person in the world playing it.

title: Oscar the Ballonist & The Secrets of the Forest
Disney's Reading Quest with Aladdin
description: Your child will be whisked away to learning adventures that build essential reading skills and challenge the imagination. Genie, Jasmine, Iago, and the gang are here to cheer kids on with encouragement and helpful hints. Watch them improve their skill levels as they journey to free Aladdin.

title: Overball
description: Inspired by Pong, Overball reinvents the classic formula with explosive power-ups, destructible defenses, and a ball that grows more dangerous with every hit. Battle with up to 6 local players in fast-paced, frantic, and utterly chaotic matches.

title: Soldier Elite
description: Metropolis Software's Soldier Elite is like a low-budget, direct-to-video version of Metal Gear Solid. It doesn't have the big names, the peerless production values, or the engaging, intricate plot line. Instead, this Polish-developed third-person stealth action game is saddled with frustrating, half-realized sneaking mechanics, English-as-a-second-language voice acting, and very little inspiration or originality. In short, this is a bad facsimile of a much better game and has a hard time justifying its existence.

title: Bucket Crusher
description:
Power up your machine and get caught up in the craze of destruction! Will you manage to completely destroy the wall until not a single brick is left standing?

Immerse yourself in the most satisfying casual game where you tear down walls brick by brick using a circular saw! Push the bricks into your Bucket Crusher to convert them into cash, but watch out because you can run out of fuel!

title: Otto's Magic Blocks
description: Teach Otto new tricks as you bound through quirky levels. Beware! The magic board is flat, so you dont want to leap lazily off the end! Go bonkers and spring towards those power-ups cuz the bad bugs are out to get you! Uncover secret levels in this Dreamland Arcade hit!

title: AudioQuake
description: A set of modifications to id Software's Quake designed to make the first-person shooter playable for blind and visually-impaired players.

title: Dance Praise: The Original
description: Dance Praise: The Original is a Christian dance video game developed and published by Digital Praise.

title: Dance Praise 2: The ReMix
description: Dance Praise 2: The Remix is the sequel to Dance Praise, with more songs and support for up to 4 players, as well as several single-player mini-games.

title: Dark Tales: Edgar Allan Poe's Murders in the Rue Morgue - Collector's Edition
Furry Pet Dog Yiff Hentai
description: Very Short Adult-Only Visual Novel featuring furry dog girl in different sex scenes.

title: Micro Scooter Challenge
description:
Scooter Challenge is a studio-produced IncaGold arcade game in which the player can try their hand at racing on a scooter. Race routes run through London, New York, Cairo, Rio de Janeiro and Sydney. The creators took care of several variants of the game, including the option of multi-player competition.

The first PC game to bring the popular world of Micro Scooter to life. Race around manyworld - wide locations, from Trafalgar Square, London, to the Olympic Stadium, Berlin.

Use your skills to outrun the opposition and watch out for the ramps and power - ups to help you get ahead of the competition.

* Multiple camera angles and stunning graphics

* 7 great locations in a variety of weather conditions; from bright sunshine to snow

* Race against your friends in multi-player mode over LAN for up to 8 players

title: Disney's Winnie the Pooh & Tigger Too: Animated Storybook
description: Animated StoryBook: Winnie the Pooh and Tigger Too is a PC video game released on April 30, 1999. This Disney's Winnie the Pooh adventure is presented in the form of a colourful storybook. Each page in the story is presented on screen with text and a full-colour interactive picture

title: Disney's You Can Fly! with Tinker Bell
description: You Can Fly with Tinker Bell is a 2002 point-and-click computer game released by Disney Interactive.

title: Disney's Activity Center: Winnie the Pooh
description:
Winnie the Pooh and the Blustery Day: Activity Center is a PC game from 2000.

Winnie the Pooh's Activity Center is a wonderful way to entertain your child on a rainy day; with six different activities at three different difficulty levels, kids of all ages can enjoy time spent inside. Also included is the animated storybook Animated StoryBook: Winnie the Pooh and Tigger Too, which offers more fun games and reading activities.

In the Winnie the Pooh's Activity Center, a friendly narrator greets you on "a blustery day." He presents activities such as Eeyore's house hunt--help Owl to find a new home; Heffalumps and Woozles--match the characters in Pooh's dreams; and Fly a Piglet--prevent Pooh and Piglet from running into trees and stumps. You may also choose to read the interactive book of Winnie the Pooh and the Blustery Day, which introduces different activities as you read the story along with the characters.

title: Private Dick: Lipstick & Lies
description:
Private Investigator Sam Steele is in a rut. His clients have dried up, his useless secretary is (still) waiting to be paid, and his ex-girlfriend has broken the sanctity of his favourite bar.

It's almost a relief when a case walks through the door. Almost. A missing dog, an unrequited debt and a suspicious kidnapping all come to a head in a dingy motel out of town.

Mystery and comedy combine in this mature and complex story.

title: Mystery P.I.: The Curious Case of Counterfeit Cove
My Scene Goes Hollywood
description: Join the action with Barbie, Madison, Chelsea, Nolee, and Delancey as they work on their own movie! Play fun games as you help finish the script and design totally amazing sets. Then style the girls from head to toe for the big production! Now it's time for ultra-fabulous fun at the premiere of the movie you helped create!

title: My Scene
description: Hang out with the My Scene girls for fashion and fun in the big city! Cruise through four areas of the city in search of cool items needed for each occasion. Go shopping and help them buy a to-die-for outfit, find the hottest new makeup, or search for cool sunglasses to prepare for the big event! While shopping, uncover trendy fashion boutiques, a hip music studio, and meet cute boys. Plus, take fun quizzes and "tell all" tests to discover things about you and your friends! Complete fun activities like designing chic clothes to earn extra cash.

title: ZEQ2 Lite
description: An open-source DBZ fangame with a focus on making it easy for users to mod without programming knowledge.

title: Dark Hermetic Order
description: A cancelled first person action adventure game planned as a sequel to Azrael's Tear. Players would take the role of a secret agent with magic powers, who infiltrates a strange cult to eliminate their leaders.

title: Dark Hour
description: A commercial add-on for Quake that adds new custom levels.

title: The Little Spirit of the East
description: The Little Spirit of the East is a mystery adventure game set in a legendary village.

title: Warriors Orochi 3: Ultimate - Definitive Edition
description: With all the content of "Warriors Orochi 3", new characters and episodes that deepen the story, new modes, and DLC that has been released for other platforms, enjoy the world of Orochi to your heart's content!

title: Booty Farm
description: Congrats, you just inherited a farm and your hot neighbors will not let you be! Erotic hijinks ensue on your neverending quest to expand your farm! Discover spicy romances and intertwining stories in this bizarrely relaxing farm simulator.

title: DD No Limit Texas Hold'em Tournament Edition
DD Tournament Poker No limit Texas Hold 'em
Decisive Battles of WWII: Ardennes Offensive
description:
Decisive Battles of WWII: Ardennes Offensive is a computer wargame developed by the Strategic Studies Group. The game depicts the historic World War II battle known as the Battle of the Bulge.

Ardennes Offensive is the first game in the Decisive Battles of World War II series.

title: Play Chess: Deep Fritz - Grandmaster Deluxe
Amiko Legends
description: Amiko Legends is creature-collecting extraction RPG where every expedition is a risk. Charm wild Amiko and fight alongside them across an untamed world shaped by your actions. Push deeper or pull out, but only what you extract is yours to keep.

title: Road & Track Presents: The Need for Speed - Special Edition
description:
Road & Track Presents: The Need for Speed - Special Edition is a 1996 retail re-release of The Need for Speed for PC which includes several improvements over the original 1995 PC release.
It introduced support for Microsoft Windows 95, whilst capable of running on Microsoft DOS, and several improvements to its rendering engine as well as two additional tracks.

The complete soundtrack playing during races was also made available on the Special Edition. This feature was previously only in the PlayStation and Sega Saturn releases.

title: Sidestep Legends
description: Practise your sidestep skills as you dodge spells coming at you from all directions. Level up and choose from a variety of upgrades and new abilities to increase your chances of survival in this moba inspired rogue-lite. Unlock new characters and explore different skill combinations each round.

title: D.M. Dinwiddie, Physician-in-Training
description:
Developed by Health Media Lab with grants from the National Institutes of Health, D.M. DINWIDDIE, PHYSICIAN-IN-TRAINING teaches children to identify and treat 12 common medical conditions: burns, choking, insect bites and stings, bumps and bruises, cuts and bleeding, sunburn, sprains and broken bones, food poisoning, common cold, influenza, tonsillitis, and appendicitis. Kids play as D.M. Dinwiddie, a 12-year old girl or boy (player's choice) who is earning a Medical Arts Achievement Badge. Through a series of interactive adventures, D.M. finds injured characters in her virtual neighborhood, including her little brother who has an insect bite.

By looking at and talking with the injured characters, and then using a special MedLab (an onscreen database that serves as a reference and diagnostic guide) and her first-aid kit, D.M. is able to diagnose and treat the hurt people.

title: Dora the Explorer: Carnival 2 - Boardwalk Adventure
Dora the Explorer: Lost and Found Adventure
Time Tripper
description: Time Tripper is a WAD developed by em essex. The game features a custom protagonist, Doomelph, who must defeat many of DOOM's monsters alongside new ones and traverse spacetime.

title: Move or Die: Couch Party Edition
description:
Move or Die is an absurdly fast-paced, 4-player local party game where the mechanics change every 20 seconds. The very definition of a friendship-ruining game, Move or Die is easy to pick up but hard to put down.

This is an offline only version of Move or Die that was available only with Amazon Prime and was delisted on May 1st 2021.

title: That's Not How it Happened
description: Disaster! When the Turner family’s inn burns down, they must recount the events that took place leading up to its fiery end!

title: Alien Xenoblaster
description: Arcade themed game with loads of content such as dumb ugly aliens, crude humor, comedic undertone and more.

title: Ginger: The Tooth Fairy
description: Help Ginger in her Tooth Fairy quest in this cute, educational and fun platformer for all ages. Cute graphics and catchy music, fun gameplay and hidden secrets will put a smile on your face.

title: Vermillion Descent
description:
After falling for what seems like forever, Dictum combat android VERSION-1.413^^10+2 finds herself in a mysterious otherworld deep below, an endless chasm devoid of life and futures. Without memory of who she was, who she is, or where she's located, all she can remember is that HOME is ABOVE.

Explore a beautiful and melancholy hand-drawn world inspired by the art of Tsutomu Nihei's Blame! and Aposimz. With only your wits and a one-ton coilgun attached to your arm, you must navigate the lower layers of the Follicle, an immense superstructure that seems to extend endlessly both in space and time.

title: Touhou: Heart of the Tiger
description: How does the highly revered Buddhist Monk Shou Toramaru spend her nights? ...By drinking at bars! Explore Shou's past and present as she helps different Touhou characters sort out their relationships in this visual novel (with minigames)!

title: Asu Kano! Asu mo Kanojo to Issho!
description: An erotic visual novel from PinballMap.

title: First Time In Paris: Collector's Edition
description: Join amateur travel blogger Kate Robinson and her daughter Nicole as they go on their first big business trip to save a Parisian hotel!

title: Hell of Sins: Soul
description: Hell of Sins: Soul is a Cthulhu-style horror adventure game (AVG). The story tells that Qin Xuan, the male leading role, fell into hell after his death, and found that hell was not the legendary reincarnation place of souls, but a horrible prison with various kinds of evil ghosts--Hell of Sins.

title: Mr. and Mrs. Potato Head Go on Vacation
description: Mr. and Mrs. Potato Head Go On Vacation PC game by Infogrames, Inc. 2001

title: Silent Seeker
description: Silent Seeker is a "Hide & Seek" multiplayer game. Play in the clutches of the hunter to find the props hidden in the map! Or Play as a prop and hide from the hunter!

title: Dream Day: Honeymoon
description: Help Jenny and Robert celebrate their tropical getaway in this romantic hidden object sequel to Dream Day Wedding. Explore beaches, tiki bars, spas, and more while searching for souvenirs, solving mini‑games, and navigating the dreaded “Honeymoon Crisis.” With dozens of levels and multiple paths to choose from, craft the perfect honeymoon keepsake for the happy couple.

title: Dream Day: Wedding
description:
A romantic seek-and-find adventure featuring beautiful graphics and unique puzzle games. Visit the florist, gown shop, bakery, and other shops to make Jenny's wedding day a dream! But be warned! The challenging Wedding Crisis levels are sure to throw you for a loop! Can you make Jenny's Dream Day Wedding happen?
12 levels.
9 mini-games.
Ever-changing gameplay.

title: Exorcist II
description: Save the world from everlasting darkness in Exorcist 2, the next terrifying chapter in the saga of Garret Ghostfighter.

title: Farming Simulator 22: Platinum Edition
description: With the Platinum Edition of Farming Simulator 22, you start your farming venture in one of four distinctive European and American environments to take on agriculture, forestry and animal husbandry. At your disposal: More than 500 authentic machines and tools by over 100 renowned agricultural manufacturers from all over the world.

title: Rescue Heroes: Meteor Madness
description: Rescue Heroes: Meteor Madness is another in the Fisher-Price Rescue Heroes Series, this one is aimed at children in the 4-7 age range. The story behind the game is that the earth has been struck by a cluster of meteors that have done damage in specific areas. It is the Rescue Heroes task to travel to the trouble spots and rescue people who are trapped. There are four hot spots to be dealt with, each representing a different mini game featuring different heroes. Each game has three levels of difficulty, trainee, specialist and expert, with each level of difficulty having more people and animals in need of rescue. The player can change the difficulty if they find the game too hard or too easy. When all missions have been completed the game unlocks one of a series of printable pictures which the player is invited to colour in.

title: Militarism
description: Militarism, also known as "Generals of War" in Germany", is a science fiction real time strategy game. The Malkari, an alien race, have conquered and destroyed earth. Fight in two campaigns as the humans or the aliens with modern weapon systems like tanks or planes and even orbital cannons. Multiplayer is possible via LAN and internet.

title: Cycle Breaker
description: Deflect bullets and take down invading robot minibosses with just your laser sword, in pursuit of the highest combo!

title: Ukraine War Stories
description: Ukraine War Stories is a set of visual novels about the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine. Set in the early months of the war, it tells the stories of civilians trapped on Russian-occupied territory. All stories are based on real events and eyewitness accounts.

title: Elohim Eternal: Prologue
description: A FREE Prologue to Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code, a turn-based JRPG-inspired indie title inspired by Xenogears and Shin Megami Tensei. Play as Joshwa as he helps an ex-Judge let go of his past. Battle beasts with mechanical parts using elemental and divine magic.

title: Make a Good 24 Hour Mega Man Level
description:
Make a Good 24 Hour Mega Man Level (MaG24HMML, or just 24H) was a private contest held by a small group of people from the MaGMML community. Contestants were given 24 hours to create a level based around the contents of a virtual mystery box, filled with a random selection of 2 enemies and 2 gimmicks from the official Mega Man games. There was no guarantee that any of these assets would make sense or work well together, so it was up to the contestants to make the most of what they had been given.

Despite some rough edges owing to the time constraint, the levels are on par with anything you'd find in any other MaGMML game. However, the game itself is very short and extremely light on bonus features; there's no hub world to explore or extensive postgame content to delve into. 24H is less a traditional MaGMML and more a proof of concept for Make a Good 48 Hour Mega Man Level, so please set your expectations accordingly for maximum enjoyment.

24H has no story or cutscenes of any kind, but the game technically takes place at the same time as Episode Zero, with the premise being that Mega Man is testing the simulation technology used in MaGMML2.

title: Make a Good 48 Hour Mega Man Level
description:
After all the work he's been doing for so many years, Mega Man is finally taking a well-deserved vacation. The Light family has set sail on a luxury cruise ship, the SS Elroy! Unfortunately, it seems an up-and-coming group of ne'er-do-wells has set their sights on the same cruise. Before long, it's up to Mega Man to blast through the cruise's Simulation Fair in an effort to gather enough Energy Elements to save the day!

Make a Good 48 Hour Mega Man Level (MaG48HMML, or just 48H) was held to test and refine the Megamix Engine in preparation for MaGMML3. Participants had 48 hours to create a level using randomly selected enemies and gimmicks from across the entire Classic Mega Man series. Levels were evaluated and ranked by a panel of 4 judges, and an elaborate game was built around the results. Unlike the main MaGMMLs, participants were not allowed to program custom objects for their levels - but that doesn't mean this game isn't just as wacky and innovative as previous ones.

48H is a spiritual successor to Make a Good 24 Hour Mega Man Level that takes place between MaGMML2 and MaGMML3, but no previous MaGMML knowledge is necessary to enjoy the story.

title: KWRPG Buster!!
description: KWRPG Buster!! is the newest entry in the long-running KWRPG series. Run and gun your way through more than 8 colourful and exciting levels! Defeat the bosses to gain new powers and confront your evil doppelgänger!

title: Harpoon
description: Top Down Shooter, a game where the player will have to dive into the endless depths of the sea as a diver and face thousands of predatory marine life, shooting back at them, pumping their weapons and equipment, gaining points and passing more and more, setting new records!

title: Mirror Chains
description: Novel match-3 gameplay + all kinds of beautiful girl characters = this game, you are welcome to challenge~

title: Matamarcianos
description: Simple freeware doujin shooting game where you shoot enemy waves before the time runs out. Get hit once and it's game over.

title: Family Feud II
description:
It's Family Feud 2, the sequel to the smash hit, with new questions, awards, and mega-bonus points for winning streaks and top answers!

Try to guess what 100 people said when they answered our survey. Beat the average score, or go head-to-head with a friend or an entire family!

Hours of fun with over 2,000 questions and 10,000 answers! Fabulous art, music and commentary from the game's host!

Survey says: Let's play Family Feud 2!

title: Mega Man: Dr. Wily's Final Attack
description: "Mega Man: Dr. Wily's Final Attack" is a 8-bit style Mega Man fan-game. 8 new stages, bosses and weapons; a whole slew of new enemies and even a secret hidden stage if you think you can find it.

title: Mega Man Ram
description: A few months after Roboenza was cured, Sheep Man was back to his job working at a circuit board manufacturer. After routine checks, he found a mysterious computer program running on one of the terminals, and on contact with the monitor, a mysterious surge of energy transformed Sheep Man! Now, with his new powers, he wants to take over the world, and has recruited 6 Robot Masters to help! It's up to Mega Man to stop his plans!

title: A Shadow Over Freddy's
description:
A Shadow Over Freddy's is a short point & click exploration horror game created to showcase unique free-roam gameplay while keeping the spirit of Five Nights at Freddy's intact.

Playing as an individual trapped inside an abandoned Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, you must traverse the location while avoiding the creeping darkness that infests every corner of the building. Complete different objectives each night, uncover your lost memories and find a way out of the accursed restaurant.

Relive the horror of the first FNaF game, as you explore every nook and cranny of the dilapidated remains of the original location, but with a new twist on the formula that will scare even the veterans of the series.

With no doors, no cameras, or time on your side, will you survive one last time against the shadows of your past?

title: Mega Man: Day in the Limelight 2
description:
Mega Man: Day in the Limelight 2 is the second game in a fangame trilogy based on the 8-bit series of games, and created by Riverroad.

Story-wise, Mega Man has either disappeared or become unable to beat Dr. Wily, and it's up to past Robot Masters to save the day.

While the basics function much the same way as traditional Mega Man games, each character has different attributes, from movement to attack patterns and even special abilities!

The idea was novel enough to warrant further sequels, improving on the formula. MMDL2 in particular allows you to play as the conquered Robot Masters in subsequent stages, among other secrets.

title: FarmCraft
description: Roll up your sleeves and get to work and start building your farm now!

title: Mega Man Christmas Carol Remix
description:
In this remake of the original Flash game, controls have been improved, boss AI redone and made both fairer and more difficult, and the entire things been rebuilt from scratch with the Christmas Carol 2 engine!

In addition there are achievements and 10 possible endings.

title: Mega Man Christmas Carol 2
description:
The sequel to the first game. The player fights against four brand new bosses: Tiny Tim (alongside Bob Cratchit), Scrooge, Want, and Ignorance. It starts in a teleport room, in an unknown place (most likely in Wily's fortress). After the player has defeated the Robot Masters, the final battle awaits.

One possible ending to see, but with different characters.

title: Oh Joes! (A Proto Man Adventure)
description: Oh Joes! (A Proto Man Adventure) is a short Mega Man fangame that sends Proto Man on a mission to reclaim his stolen Proto Shield from a fortress full of Joes. It's more of a puzzle and strategy game than it is a traditional Mega Man game—you can force your way through everything, but the challenges are specifically designed to get you to think before you act. The game is intended to be a solid challenge for experienced players, yet accessible to players of any skill level.

title: Quint's Revenge
description:
Quint's Revenge stars the titular Mega Man from the far future. The twist here, Dr. Light knew of Dr. Wily's trip through time to reprogram Mega Man. Now free from Wily's control, Mega Man, i.e Quint, sets out for revenge.

The game adheres closely to Mega Man 2 and 3 but moves at a much quicker pace. The whole game is built around Quint's seldom seen abilities, like Sonic Dash, ducking, and ledge grabbing. It's an interest twist of the tried-and-true NES formula. Though still in beta, the game spans fifteen stages (8 Robot Masters, an intro stage, 6 fortress stages).

title: Rockman ZX Prequel
description:
Rockman ZX Prequel – a fan-game set 200 years before the events of Rockman ZX – quickly become a favorite among Chinese-speaking Mega Man communities.

Unique to ZX Prequel, though, is a light/dark world system. In the light world, you'll occasionally run into virus-infected mechaniloids. However, in the dark world, ALL enemies will be infected. Light or dark, enemies infected with the virus are said to be stronger than the norm. A gauge at the top of the screen shows you just how bad the outbreak is in your current position.

title: SuperDanny Powered Up
description:
Take control of the craziest Mega Man fan alive as you take on Dr. Wily and Robot Masters from MegaMan 1 & 2 in this epic Classic series game. Get equipped with power-enhancing items, classic-character costumes, and Cross Fusions--the ability to change into the Robot Master himself and inherit both his weapon and attributes--as you overcome up to 20 levels in various difficulty modes and conquer the 18 Challenges.

SuperDanny Powered Up is a loving fan tribute to Classic Mega Man that delivers content from the original NES games remixed in cool and unique ways, backed by a rock-solid engine widely praised for its precise accuracy with Capcom's.

title: The Real Deal: 10 Classic Card Games
Spellcraft
description: Spellcraft is a new type of strategy game: a Real-Time Battler where you actively command an entire team of heroes and cast spells to outplay your opponents.

title: Porkchop's Adventure
description: Porkchop's Adventure is an indie point-and-click fangame developed by Phisnom and composed by Nathan Hanover. It is a fangame of the Five Nights at Freddy's franchise based on the main concept of POPGOES Arcade 1 and 2. It's a teaser game of Porkchop's Horror Show.

title: FR3DD-Y2 p1223-R1a
description:
FR3DD-Y2 p1223-R1a is a visual novel FNaF x VA11 Hall-A fangame, created for the Fangames at Freddit's gamejam event.

You play as a potential new pizza-tender for Freddy's Pizzeria going through your first day on the job; getting used to the restaurant and its odd staff, cooking various types of pizza to serve to hungry customers, and having inane conversations with whoever sits in front of your station. The game takes the gameplay and style of VA11 Hall-A and mixes it with FNaF characters and pizza-making inside a Freddy's restaurant.

title: Steven's Game
description: This is a small side game to Porkchop's Horror Show and will tell the story of Wonderland Toys, where Steven, Dorothy, Robbie, Terry, and Friend come from.

title: Another FNaF Fangame: Open Source
description: Another FNAF Fangame: Open Source is a moddable, infinitely changeable version of FNAF 2. It can be anything you want it to be, so make it the most enjoyable horror you have ever imagined. It's a FNAF 2 with newer mechanics, new office and different settings!

title: Pogo Bunny
description: Russian action-puzzle game where the player controls a bouncing rabbit through a series of stages, hopping between tiles.

title: Tom Clancy's The Division: Resurgence
description: The Division Resurgence is a free-to-play third-person shooter RPG that features a whole new and independent campaign from Tom Clancy’s The Division and Tom Clancy’s The Division 2, offering a new perspective on key story events. It takes place in a contemporary post-crisis America where a virus outbreak has created chaos and the collapse of the government. As an agent of the "Strategic Homeland Division” your mission is to restore peace, to protect civilians against hostile factions, and to help them build a better future.​

title: Mulk & Swank: Great Adventure in Magic World
description: A rare South Korean platform game based on the national animated series of the same name; clearly aimed at a children's audience.

title: White Heart Baekgu
description: First in a trilogy of South Korean platformers based on the animated film Hayan Maeum Baekgu, itself based on the 1993 news story surrounding the dog which travelled over 260km in six months to reunite with its previous owner. Received official localisation in the CIS and France.

title: White Heart Baekgu's Second Story
description: Second in a trilogy of South Korean platformers based on the animated film Hayan Maeum Baekgu, itself based on the 1993 news story surrounding the dog which travelled over 260km in six months to reunite with its previous owner. The game is more faithful to both source materials than the previous title.

title: White Heart Baekgu 3
description: Third in a trilogy of South Korean platformers based on the animated film Hayan Maeum Baekgu, itself based on the 1993 news story surrounding the dog which travelled over 260km in six months to reunite with its previous owner. This entry has almost nothing to do with the previous titles, and received official localisation in the CIS under the name "Rex 2." Also includes an electronic pet application.

title: Those Nights at Fredbear's
description: Those Nights At Fredbear's was a free roam survival horror video game developed by Nikson. The game was cancelled, but way later on the 17th of July 2018, Nikson revealed a teaser trailer for a "Those Nights At Fredbear's" remake at the end of his anniversary Q&A video on The Joy of Creation: Story Mode.

title: Unreal Shift At Freddy's
description:
Unreal Shift at Freddy's is a game inspired by the popular franchise Five Nights at Freddy's by Scott Cawthon.

It features a fully remade map from FNAF 1 in 3D and gives you the ability to free roam however you wish.

title: The Joy of Creation
description:
The classic Five Nights at Freddy’s fan-game returns, rebuilt from the ground up to offer a modern and immersive horror experience with real-time graphics powered by Unreal Engine 5.

The Joy of Creation puts you in the shoes of The Creator, a game developer forced to confront the manifestations of his own mind throughout five unique levels, each with a unique blend of free-roaming and classic sit-and-survive gameplay mechanics.

This game is officially backed by Scott Cawthon as part of the Fazbear Fanverse Initiative.

title: Those Nights at Rachel's 2
description:
That onslaught and terror which corrupted your very mind is only the beginning, those nightmares which tormented your brain is nothing like what we prepared.

Together we'll make your final moments something worth chanting for, something worth telling. And you- well you'll just be there to watch it all go down, sitting and staring without the ability to pick yourself up.

Tonight will be OUR night, the night in which we reign the same amount of screams and terror as we have in the past to find the one thing in which we really want

title: Last Crash
description: While performing missions in a world on the verge of destruction, we try to survive by managing resources under difficult conditions with special equipment.

title: Adventure Climb VR: Brave the Elements
description: This map pack adds five new levels to climb and explore all with varying difficulty to challenge even the most advanced climber!

title: Evil Bird Simulator
description: Evil Bird Simulator is a weird pixel art game where you control an evil bird that craps on people and cars. Some of the people will try to attack you and you will go to hell if you get a game over. You will have to play your way through hell to get back to the normal game. Do you have what it takes?

title: Kung Fu Er San
description: Kung Fu Er San is an 2D retro pixel fighting game inspired by the old classics.

title: Dreambound
description: Mysterious deaths. Friends, both old and new. Dreams that are reality, and reality that is a dream. Will Noah be able to move forward and solve the mystery⁠—or will he give in to the demons of his past? A story-rich BL mystery visual novel.

title: Hybrid Harmony
description: A romantic comedy visual novel set in a modern fantasy world filled with mythical creatures and races! Shape your story through tons of meaningful choices, text characters and unlock wallpapers using an in-depth phone system, and learn about the world and it's lore with an expansive glossary!

title: The Joy of Creation: Reborn
description: The Joy of Creation: Reborn was a free-roam survival horror video game that was being remade from the ground up for the Fazbear Fanverse, Including new assets, new gameplay, new everything.

title: The Joy of Creation: Halloween Edition
description: The Joy of Creation: Halloween Edition is a free-roam survival horror video game developed by Nikson. The game is created for Halloween, and the player's only enemy is Ignited Springtrap.

title: Reader Rabbit 2nd Grade: Mis-Cheese-ious Dreamship Adventures!
description: When the fabulous Dreamship crash lands into gooey Mt. Cheesemore, Reader Rabbit and Sam must find it before the bungling Pirates get there first. Our heroes need your help using skills in grammar, reading, science, fractions, and telling time. With seven cheese-ilicious activities, you're in for a giant slice of adventure!

title: Those Nights at Rachel's 2: Reloaded
description:
Two years after the events of Those Nights at Rachel's, errors begin to manifest within the fabric of the system, causing sensory and auditory hallucinations for its most dedicated following. On a rush to prevent backlash from the general public, the administrators of the 'TNaR' project push forward to develop a backup operation to their virtual-survival experience, designed with a new stable structure to permanently maintain hegemony whilist appealing to a new wider demographic.

Your job? Make sure everything works according to plan for the release of the new project. Welcome to the New Doug and Rachel's faithful beta tester! We hope you enjoy your stay; because this is the last one you're ever going to get.

title: Those Nights at Fredbear's: Reboot
description: hose Nights at Fredbear's Reboot is a discontinued official remake of the very first cancelled free-roam FNaF fan-game Nikson made. The remake features new story, new graphics, new characters etc. If you are going to use anything on this page for refrence in your fangame. Please credit the page and those who have contributed to it.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's Cleaning Simulator
description: Five Nights at Freddy's Cleaning Simulator is a cancelled free-roam Five Nights at Freddy's fan-game made by Nikson for Fangames at Freddit's game jam.

title: Tom Clancy's The Division 2: Warlords of New York - Season One: Shadow Tide
description:
Despite the SHD agent’s best efforts, a cell of rogue agents has been activated. Intel suggests that this cell is mobilizing and planning an attack in D.C.
Your first target, Neptune becomes available to hunt down today. We believe he sabotaged base infrastructure, killing several members of the JTF. Good luck out there, Agents!

title: Tom Clancy's The Division 2: Warlords of New York - Season Two: Keener’s Legacy
description: The Division tracks down a new rogue agent cell determined to pick up where Keener left off. Take down these all new targets, participate in new Leagues, Global Events, and more. And of course, earn all-new gear, weapons, and a new skill variant.

title: Tom Clancy's The Division 2: Warlords of New York - Season Three: Concealed Agenda
description: An all-new Season starts today in The Division 2! Season 3: Concealed Agenda introduces new targets to hunt, new Leagues, new Global Events, and more.

title: Tom Clancy's The Division 2: Warlords of New York - Season Four: End of Watch
description: Prepare for one of the biggest targets the Division has faced yet. In Season Four of Warlords of New York, Agents will chase down an old friend – do you have what it takes to bring them to justice?

title: Tom Clancy's The Division 2: Warlords of New York - Season Nine: Hidden Alliance
description: Agents take on Captain Lewis of the True Sons and his lieutenants: Castillo, Daniels, Chang and Xander.

title: Hidden Shapes Animals: VR
description: Tired after a hard day at work? Now, with the help of VR, you will delve deep into an environment exclusively prepared for you to have fun and rescue your tranquility, surprising yourself with each solved puzzle!
