description: This medieval fantasy base-building game allows you to lead your warriors to traverse randomly generated battlefields. Reinforce the capital against the orcs' invasion.

title: Inferos Numine: Descent Into Darkness
description: Forge your path through the unknown kingdom. Explore a variety of landscapes and caverns infested with vast monsters and creatures. Battle your way through and explore the kingdom in this 2.5D Style shooter-platform-fighting game.

title: Beaver Clicker
description: Beaver Clicker is an idle game where you collects logs, then using these logs, you can acquire all sorts of sources for these logs, like convincing squirrels, sponsoring school field-trips, or even taming the fungi found in nature itself to help you in your wood collecting journey.

title: Bioframe: Outpost
description: Bioframe Outpost is a 2d sci-fi action adventure game, dedicated to exploration, experimentation, emergent gameplay, and narrative. Its unique approach to non-linear exploration and action gameplay offers a fresh take on Metroidvania gameplay.

title: BicycleSim
description: Buy, Assemble and Ride a bicycle. Choose from a large number of Bicycle variants. Can ride the pre-built bicycles in a wide number of exotic environments and locations !!

title: Bicycle Mechanic Simulator
description: Run your bicycle workshop and repair bicycles by your own hand. Tighten the screws, adjust the chain, and then do some personalized printing. It's not just your sweat that makes you a bicycle repair master, but your attention to detail and skills.

title: Waterfall
description: A shadowy figure seeks peace.

title: What the Fortress!?
description: A Tower Defense game where you carve the path for your enemies and you form the terrain. Unlock 20+ Towers, fight against 30 types of enemies and choose from 5 different ground tiles.

title: Story Walker
description: "Story Walker" is a leisure collection puzzle solving Chinese game. The game tells the story of the new book wizard entering the book world to collect elves.Players need to control the hostess to explore in the scene, and have a small journey with the game characters.

title: Garden Guardian
description: Take control of master gardener Snippy Shrubs and keep your garden safe at all costs! A new take on classic LCD games, rethought through a modern lens! Complete objectives through 18 Trial levels, or hop into the four Endless levels to show that you can garden with the best of them!

title: Life After Death
description: Life After Death is a fictional survival game. Its up to you survive in this game, a challenge.

title: Blastonier
description: A 2D physics-based puzzle game inspired by old flash games and arcade tasking you with shooting a ball into a cube.

title: Fly Fly Tuk Tuk
description: Have you ever thought about what it's like to see a tuk tuk flying?

title: Alaris
description:
A global crisis that only continues to escalate. A dangerous run-in with a shadowy stranger. And a mysterious word that won't stop gnawing at you. How does everything tie together? And what role could you possibly play in all of this?

Enter a world of magic—of Fae and Dragon.

title: The Final Answer
description: A survival horror trivia game. Survive traps and twisted games by answering trivia questions. Incorrect answers lead to death.

title: Stereo Boy
description: A chill, innovative sci-fi adventure where you explore two isometric worlds at the same time. Teleport between worlds to navigate impossible terrain and solve mind-bending puzzles. Along the way, you'll fend off hostile creatures and uncover the story of a lost civilization.

title: Sissa's Path
description: Sissa's Path is a sokoban game where you play as the kitten Sissa! You will have the opportunity to get to know one of the curious hobbies of Sissa's: Playing with her toys! Help Sissa move her toys to the corrrect spot in this fun but challenging game. Can you help Sissa organize her toys?

title: LoFi Hotel
description: This is a cozy game that mixes management with world map exploration. Gather gems to unlock rooms and hotel improvements. Explore levels in a sky world to collect the cutest guests and musicians in the islands. Your songs will change depending of which musicians you collected. No rush! Just chill!

title: Maze Ablaze
description: Maze Ablaze is a fast-paced strategy game where you move the walls of a maze to defend an explosive barrel from an oncoming flame! Move fast and think faster as you work with limited resources to survive as long as possible.

title: Neon Circle
description: Rotate, think, wait, jump and rotate the screen.

title: Miners and Machines
description: Become a gold mine owner! Find gold in the ground, dig for it, and deliver it to the gold washing plant machine! Build your mining plant and manage machines which take a lot of fuel… Buy new lands and upgrades for your equipment! It’s a real gold fever!

title: Bloodwatch
description: Bloodwatch is a short horror game about surviving at all cost on the island when the maniacs are trying to find and kill you. Explore, finding weapons, items, find the leader and kill him.

title: Tribe War
description: It is a strategic card game (SCG) that combines the genre of card games, chess, and chess. Create an original deck and use your card to target your opponent's base Stores, card packs, and new species will be added in the future.

title: War of Bellrook
description: Go forth on a text-based, choose your own adventure where you can choose your role and embark on adventure as various different people who tread different paths.

title: Monkey Milk
description: You're monkey must collect fruit to process into delicious beverages while avoiding not-so-friendly creatures that live alongside the groves of fruit in this level based, top down game.

title: Embodiment
description: In this 2D puzzle platformer, take control of a blob with the ability to take control and embody skeletons. Use their abilities to swim, climb, and fly through the facility.

title: Code Rivals
description: Code Rivals is a free-to-play, autonomous-robot programming and combat game. Learn the basics in the campaign tutorial or challenge your friends in online combat arenas, in different multiplayer modes.

title: Fossil Finder
description: You are a young promising scientist who went to the excavations of ancient lands. Find all the artifacts of antiquity, precious stones and remains of past civilizations!

title: Deneb: Across the Stars
description: “Deneb: Across the Stars” is a mouse only, top-down, hardcore-platformer. Astronaut Vega crosses the stars to find her lost colleague Altair and save the dogs. Move carefully. A single mistake can lead to an endless fall.

title: Sokobalien
description: Do you have what it takes to build the biggest space farm in the galaxy? Help the alien reach this goal in this classic Sokoban puzzle style game! Push cows, sheep, pigs and chicken so that the correct UFO beams can abduct them. (Also, as a side-quest, collect all the hats you can!)

title: Mothercore
description: A tower defense game with weird and wacky towers and enemies. Play in the two modes, Story mode and Arcade mode. And follow a weird story about an organization and last power source humans have.

title: Everything Has Arms
description: High-five a cannon, chase a flowerpot or escape the vicious hunters in Everything has Arms, a fast-paced hide and seek VR game. Room-Scale VR highly recommended.

title: Lymph City Blues
description: Take on the role of a detective immune cell named Dan Dendrick in this neo-noir narrative. Track down and uncover the murderer of the mayor of Lymph City using your sleuthing prowess and bring justice back to Lymph City...for no one is immune to justice.

title: Slaughter Horse 2
description: Use deduction, murder and trust your luck to eliminate the town council and rule over the helpless cartoon horses in a twisted strategy RPG.

title: Fire All Humans
description: Fire all the humans in splatastic fun and solve the puzzles. With hilarious explosions, addictive physics based shooting of your humans to reach the end goals!

title: Rallyallyally
description: Rallyallyally is a multiplayer, last-man-standing racing game. Each round one player makes a new track that the others must follow. Slow players are eliminated until only one remains. It's fun, bold and exciting.

title: Dash Shooters
description: Dash Shooters is a multiplayer, fast paced racing game, where the main movement mechanic is dashing! You can race through a randomly generated map, gather powerups, fight your friends, go through objectives, shoot crystals, and much more! Play with up to six of your friends for endless fun!

title: Voxrush
description: Voxrush is a time survival FPS game with a full destructible voxel environment. Kill monsters, take points, upgrade stats and weapons, use skills and find a better way to survive as long as possible to become the best!

title: Descentium
description: Whilst researching the mysterious new element Descentium, A remote facility in Southeast Asia has gone radio silent. Alina, an elite operative who works for Descent Laboratories has been sent to investigate. Will Alina discover the secrets of the temple or fall into madness?

title: Radiant Cell
description: What do you do when you're locked inside a video game with a crazed AI and some guns? You F*CKING run and kill...That's what you do! in the world of radiant cell, get ready to defend yourself as you wall run, shoot, slow down time, and of course grapple.

title: Bravery
description: BRAVERY is a third-person 3D adventure game in which players guide a fragile matchstick character through vast, detailed environments that appear enormous in scale. Gameplay focuses on exploration, tense chase sequences, and interactive fire mechanics that allow objects to be ignited. Throughout the journey, players discover hidden areas and capture enigmatic orbs that are sealed within restored magical mirrors, shaping progression through the world.

title: Anomalia
description: You must survive this horror and puzzle game, Robots were created to aid in technological advances, but here they are getting more and more terrible, explore the place and delve deeper into the terror.

title: Tracing Decay
description: Tracing Decay is a dark dystopian simulation, that revisits impactful art that revolves around themes of decay, memory loss and recollection. The experience allows the player to explore the environment freely in search for several galleries within the ruins.

title: Para-Lax
description: Para-Lax is a 2D platformer in which you play as a hero named Lax and help a farmer get back his stolen dirt! Wander through a beautiful Pixel-World, avoid the traps and kill as much goblins as you can.

title: Age of Undead
description: Age of Undead is a multi-genre game (turn-based, RTS, FPS) that allows you to face the frightful Zombie Apocalypse with 3 unique factions: the Army, the Infected, and the Survivors. Make strategic choices in the Campaign, then go into battle and fight to survive!

title: Radii
description: Radii is a challenging platformer. Traverse an abandoned compound with limited movement capabilities, managing energy and momentum.

title: Zombie Apocalypse: The Last Defense
description: Create your own strategies, tactics and manage your resources in this survival tower defense game. Buy weapons, vehicles, explosives, soldiers, turrets and battle against huge waves of zombies. Can you survive for 25 days?

title: Mutant Meltdown
description: Mutant Meltdown is a fast-paced turn-based with roguelike elements in which you have a group of survivors in the aftermath of an apocalypse. The ultimate goal is to survive the mutants.

title: Kraino Origins
description: Ghouls, ghost & plenty of hidden wall meat. In Kraino Origns you'll explore 8 levels of unadulterated retro platformer action! With ghoulish enemies, powerful weapons, hidden secrets, and a boss ready to wipe the floor with you!

title: War Dots
description: Fast paced tug-of-war auto-battler. Unleash hordes of soldiers and wreak havoc upon your enemies!

title: Dodge Mania
description: In Dodge Mania you will go through different levels where you will control character and you have to dodge falling objects. New level - new custom objects!!

title: The Bad Kids
description: As an adaptation of the popular suspecse TV series, Cat's Cradle, this game combines investigation, solving puzzles and reasoning with original stories, which can build a more Immersive experience. Game will build new stories based on original setting and focus on the inner world of the character.

title: Droid Warfare
description: An exoplanet named Pumara is a highly resourceful world & is civilized by cybernetic androids. An army of Alien- based Androids launches an international invasion in attempt to take control of the planet. The citizens of Pumara formed an alliance to fight the alien forces & to protect their planet.

title: Truck Simulator in City
description: Truck Simulation game in which we combine Arcade and Simulation gameplay. Pick up your cargo and deliver it to the destination. If you want to pamper yourself, access Stunt Trails or Parking mods.

title: Pencil Case TD
description: Pencil Case TD is a tower defense game with pencil cases and stationery as the theme. Players need to use different stationery to guard their scores to get promoted.

title: Japanese TeTris
description: Japanese TeTris is Tetris like you've never seen before - incredibly addictive in stylistic graphics too!

title: Tactic Legends
description:
Tactic Legends is a revolutionary card game that combines strategy, skill, and a touch of luck. Our game introduces a unique collection of cards and innovative mechanics that will captivate both new and experienced players.

Tactic Legends is an exhilarating online turn-based card game where strategy and skill are your greatest allies. Engage in intense battles against players worldwide, and prove your mettle by unlocking and collecting powerful cards from all collections to complete your ultimate decks.

title: Note of Janus
description: The ordinary mansion where the Marquis of Ethan is living... and a terrible incident happens there. Get to the bottom of the case and uncover the secrets hidden in the mansion!

title: Matcha
description: Matcha is a simple puzzle game, built around the beautiful Korean writing system, Hangul.

title: Snow War
description: Snow-War is a multiplayer Half-Life mod based around snowballs fights.

title: Thunder Helix
description: Pilot deadly helicopter gunships, battle enemy forces and complete dangerous missions within a thrilling desert warzone!

title: Idle Baker Boss
description: Grow your bakery franchise and manage bakeries in this cute idle tycoon game

title: Alien Decimation
description: Destroy waves of UFOs in a arcade style space shooter with an array of powerful weaponry.

title: Motel Simulator
description: An abandoned motel across from the gas station. Renovate and furnish it, rent rooms and expand. Pick your patrons wisely - just handing them their room key and getting their cash is just where the adventure with your guests starts…

title: Object Wars
description: The war is small, in Object Wars fights the other players with weapons like a toothpick launcher, the last one alive wins the game.

title: Tikus Tales
description: Tikus Tales is a colorful 3D platformer featuring Suki and Tuki—two daring mice on a quest to defeat rebellious creatures and free the imprisoned Zodiac guardians. Face off in multi-phase boss battles filled with combat, platforming twists, and charm!

title: Seasons of the Sorcerer
description: Seasons of the Sorcerer is a top-down action game set to Antonio Vivaldi's "Four Seasons.” Use a diverse set of spells to incinerate, bash, transform, and control your foes on a year long journey across early Renaissance Italy.

title: The Ghost and the Golem
description: Confront mystic perils and revelations, pogroms, & your own wild heart, in a Jewish historical fantasy of bandits, betrothals, klezmers, and kabbalists!

title: Celestial Tear: Lost World
description: Explore an eerie planet marooned in a dark dimension known as the void. Command a dysfunctional trio of soldiers in fast-paced tactical combat with otherworldly creatures. Scavenge for supplies and build a camp to survive the harsh environment on this Lost World!

title: Ghost Puncher
description: This is a beat'em up with influences from Guardian Heroes and Little Fighters 2, 3D hand-drawn environments, with anime-style characters and music composed exclusively for the game.

title: The Explorator
description: Explore mysterious counter-zones and brave dangers to discover priceless treasures buried beneath the ruins of Atlantis.

title: Our Hero! Last
description: Start the last Our Hero! adventure which ends the trilogy: a new hero joins the party to help Ourhero, Tay and Fury to fight in the final epic battle!

title: King of Conquerors
description: Your journey from adventurer to king will begin here!

title: SSS222: HyperSpace
description: A fast-paced addicting space shooter with an inspiration taken from many modern games. A project I have been passionately working solo for the past 2 years!

title: Yusetsu
description: Snow melting bar, melt the ice in your heart. This is a warm love game, where you can enjoy a real Japanese bar love experience.

title: Ever Seen A Cat? 3
description: A relaxing hidden object game. Find yet more cats in several new fairy tale themed environments! Every play through is different!

title: Lum: Hide from Nightmares
description: Lum is a stealth and puzzle game where you control a soul and its companion dog. Hide and run from the nightmare creatures of this dreadful place while solving puzzles. Escape from the limbo to find peace in this short adventure!

title: Ashen Knights: One Passage
description: Two heroes, two different genres: souls-like & hack’n’slash. They switch places and trigger a wild emotional storm making sure you never get bored of playing. Assay your strength and stamina as a defender of the Abyss-devoured world. Be merciless yet cautious in Ashen Knights: One Passage.

title: HeistGeist
description: A story-driven RPG set in a cyberpunk version of Central Europe. Play as Alexandra, doublecrossed street-smart thief on the run after a job gone bad. Put together a team of specialists, execute highly elaborate heists, fight in card-based battles and hack into the most secure corporate systems.

title: Mass Harvest
description: Mass Harvest is the first Unreal Engine 5 game. Survive the alien parasite pandemic! They have destroyed our moon and harvested all our resources and guess what? We are the main resource of this planet so get ready before they get to you!

title: Pixel Gangsters
description: Run your gang of mobsters and conquer the city in this indie mafia tycoon game.

title: Rapid Retort
description: Test your speed, aim, and awareness in Rapid Retort as you tackle a series of progressively more complex shooting trials.

title: Pentacore
description: Pentacore is a metroidvania with a focus on platforming and exploration. Run, shoot, climb, and blast your way through a massive world. All in order to find five keys and leave your prison of a planet.

title: Spirit Eyes
description: Spirit Eyes is a horror game in which, as an experienced exorcist, you take a contract to an abandoned house in Wyoming. Player must discover the type of ghost and try to get rid of it. As you try to communicate with the spirit, you will have to make choices that will affect the course of the game.

title: Mana Valley
description: A strange dark force has moved over mana valley turning once friendly creatures into vicious adversaries. As a novice witch, you must hone your skills in magic to find and defeat the evil that is plaguing your home.

title: MouseWars
description: MouseWars is a real time multiplayer cursor war game. The cursors have to fight until only one remains.

title: Cyberhunk
description: Retro FPS wave shooter with stackable powerups and upgradeable weapons.

title: HyperGlide
description: Hypergliders is an intense wingsuit flying game featuring infinite procedural levels and trick combos. You can glide to relax or you can glide for a spot on the leaderboard, it's your choice.

title: Call to Arms: Gates of Hell - Ostfront
description:
Independently developed by Barbedwire studios, published by Digitalmindsoft.
GoH is an RTS/ RTT that portrays WW2.
It offers a choice of instantly switchable top- down, third person and first person (for vehicles). SP, PvE, PvP. Dynamic campaigns are available for singleplayer and in co-op.

title: SHPR
description: SHPR is an arena survival roguelike in which you have to buy items while creating amazing builds and synergies that will help you defeat enemies to be able to pass to the next stages.

title: Interference: Dead Air
description: All hell's breaking loose in a mysterious research facility and the only person who can save the day is the night shift security guard in the booth outside. Remotely control systems, guide scientists to safety or just… goof off? You’re not in danger. Yet.

title: Genimas: Life Reborn
description: you are Drassil, a demigod raised and trained by Freyja far from civilization, your destiny is to defeat the evil entity known as Ragnarok and to achieve it, you will have to evolve genetically traveling through the 9 Nordic worlds.

title: Dragon Mine
description: Go through the numerous mazes and try to get to the cave full of gold waiting at the end, but remember - the journey won't be easy. Think fast and move precisely to get to the exit - any delay may result in the escape portal to be covered with mysterious water, blocking your way out.

title: Starcom: Unknown Space
description: Starcom: Unknown Space is an action RPG of space exploration and adventure. Build your own starship while discovering an epic story in a universe of strange mysteries, alien factions and uncharted worlds.

title: The Fate of Baldr
description: Join the Vikings in an epic tower defense adventure! Defend your ship against mythical bosses while mining resources and upgrading skills. Battle solo or team up with friends in online co-op for a journey of strategy, conquest, and victory.

title: Gangstar New York
description: Welcome to the Big Apple, a huge free-to-play social sandbox ripe for the taking. Race, shoot, steal, and jetpack your way to the top of the underworld in a near-future New York. Claim the Kingpin title, change the game for everyone and reap the rewards. Your city, your rules.

title: Aliens After Ava
description: You are Ava, a survivor out in the wild in the midst of an alien invasion. Fight back as you dodge, jump, roll, and use advanced technology to navigate your escape across terrain and extraterrestrial foes!

title: Master of Earth
description: A voice from beyond awakens the vast potential within you. As you master these unearthed powers, you will raise the secrets hidden in a temple once thought destroyed.

title: Space Trash Scavenger
description: Grab your jetpack and explore procedural asteroid fields, derelict spaceships and abandoned outposts. Build your Space Rig to process scavenged trash. Craft, trade and fight your way to success in this interstellar, open-world sandbox.

title: Zero World
description: Gather resources, craft items, kill others, raid houses, but don't get raided yourself

title: Raccoon Roller
description: A sidescrolling physics platformer that challenges your creative thinking and mechanical skill. Using rockets and grapples find the fastest way through levels to climb ranks on the leaderboard.

title: Cognition Method
description: Cognition Method is a story-driven, first-person puzzle game inspired by Space Odyssey 2001 and Solaris. Discover an innovative mechanics of altering gravity and dive into the surreal setting. Find your way within a mysterious artifact and unveal a non-ordinary story.

title: Smushi Come Home
description: Play as a tiny lil' mushroom who's lost in the forest and can't find its way home. Explore unique areas freely at your own pace, chat with friendly inhabitants, and take on different adventures to get back home!

title: Those Who Rule
description: Join three fresh recruits caught in a web of betrayal as war looms over the land. Lead your band of heroes through tactical turn-based battles, master unique abilities, and forge powerful gear to turn the tide of battle. Will you unravel the conspiracy driving the conflict—or be consumed by it?

title: Twilight Wars
description: A team based top-down shooter game. Pick up weapons and fight enemies with allies. Mission-based storyline leads you into this fantasy world.

title: Cultivation Story: Reincarnation
description: Cultivation Story: Reincarnation is a top-down pixel art style action roguelike based on cultivation and Chinese mythology.

title: Idle Spiral
description: This is a beautiful "Idle", "Incremental" game based on spirals and mathematics. Your goal is to make the spiral grow farther and farther from the origin. The game is very simple, but it is very deep and can be enjoyed for a long time!

title: Out of Hands
description: Out of Hands is a card-based thriller that blends card battles, video collage and psychological horror. With nightmarish roguelike elements and live-action visuals made out of the real hands of the developer, the game provides an intriguing and spine-chilling experience that leads you to combat the mental struggles and retrieve the lost memory.

title: Tendryll
description: Delve into grid-based card play in this roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble your party, carefully select your battles, and construct powerful item builds to cleanse the Tendryll of its befouled enemies.

title: Paws and Leaves: A Last Tale
description: Life flashes before your eyes when you die. Help Me Fox by finding his memories beyond life and experiencing a touching, cute, and scary tale.

title: To the Stars
description: The picture-book-loving Little Princess lives happily in the Castle with her best friends Little Seal and Little Sharks day after day. However, the Little Princess, long “Protected” in the Castle, has always been dreaming of seeing the beautiful starry sky depicted in the picture book.

title: M.S. Salmon
description: The game takes place in an antropomorphic world in the late 1960’s where our protagonist Ben Hearnden, a penguin detective, has to solve a murder case on a luxury ship called M.S. Salmon. While he collects the evidences on the ship, he isn’t only coming closer to the truth of the case, but also lighting up his own dark past. M. S Salmon is an interactive 2d animation film combined with minigames such as railshooter-levels, point & click and gastro sim.

title: Jasper and the City of Lights
description: Let me tell you a story my friend. It is the journey of Jasper and a fallen star into the whispering forest to find his sister Nora. In the deepest of shadows an ancient spirit is lurking but there’s hope shining from the horizon: The City of Lights.

title: Saga of Sins
description: Saga of Sins is an unholy action-adventure where mystery meets rewarding arcade gameplay! Immerse into a world of stained glass that is stained by sin.

title: Project Morph
description: Project Morph is an isometric, souls-like, sci-fi action-RPG wit a unique player shapeshifting mechanic. Collect enemy DNA and use it to transform into various creatures, called 'Morphs'. Become your enemy, literally, and fight fire with fire!

title: Delicious Dungeon
description: Delicious Dungeon is a combination of action-adventure and simulation game. The player is the owner of a local restaurant in a fantasy world. But to run the restaurant they have to explore dungeons full of dangers and enemies to get the ingredients needed to cook delicious meals for their guests.

title: Kona II: Brume
description: Northern Québec, 1970. A bizarre mist —the Brume— is disconnecting a rural mining village from its quiet reality. Step into the shoes of Detective Carl Faubert as he unfolds the mysteries haunting the region while battling for his own survival.

title: Little Islanders
description: Your people need you, and you've been summoned to protect and guide them in their time of need. You must help them settle the island that they now find themselves inhabiting. Help them build their town, protect them, and ensure that they thrive.

title: Ghostly Moans
description: Spirits have been possessing people in the kingdom and a young priestess named Mia has become well-known for her diplomatic way to exorcise these creatures. Follow her in search of the ones responsible for this situation.

title: Crustacean Nations
description: Crustacean Nations is a real-time strategy game about total crab warfare. Build a sprawling sand castle and amass huge armies to dominate the beach and become the one true crustacean nation!

title: Cable Clutter
description: Cable Clutter is a puzzle game where objects can be connected to each other to change their behaviour. Puzzles can be solved by pressing buttons, automation, and some head scratching.

title: Born Anew
description: Born Anew is a 2D Platformer set in an Open world Life Simulator set in a Fantasy Medieval world full of Adventures to be had, the game has many ways to play it and it will NOT have a main Story line. Build your own Fate and Future.

title: Terror Brain: Night Out
description: Terror Brain: Night Out is a Single-Player First-Person Action-Adventure Psychological Horror PC Game where you take on the role of university student Sarah Mitchell while she is trying to understand what happened to her after everything went dark during a night out at the local bar.

title: Students of Psionic Power
description: "Students of Psionic Power" is RPG based typing game. You can create your own party members (Can input name, can choose portrait for all of 5 members in ally party). 20 portraits (10 school boys and 10 school girls) are included for character creation.

title: Chess, but...
description: Play against a low level engine, simulating a 100 rated player, while completing challenges. Multiple difficulty modes make the game suitable for chess beginners and experts.

title: Sovereign Syndicate
description: Victorian steampunk RPG with tarot cards instead of dice. Investigate the disappearance of society’s most vulnerable to uncover a mysterious cult. Play as three characters, each with their own skills and motivations. Customize your characters with narrative choices to unlock new tarot cards.

title: Alchem It
description: Become an alchemist shopkeeper and serve potions to your customers. Master your tools to gather many ingredients and brew potions as fast as you can. Unlock new tools, levels and decorate your dream alchemy shop.

title: Primal Hunger
description: Hunt or be hunted. Eat or be eaten. Evolve or die. Grow stronger and evolve with each victory on your way to becoming the Alpha Predator in this thrilling battle royale.

title: Project Death Strikers
description: Death Striker is a Couch Co-op, run'n'gun shooter. Fight through the hordes of enemies. Take out punishing bosses to find out what caused the mutation. Your choices will decide how this apocalypse ends.

title: Ants Took My Eyeball
description: Ants Took My Eyeball is a 2D action platformer roguelite. Descend in to an ever changing ant hill, fight your way through hordes of insects with a variety of weapons, face formidable bosses and ultimately find your stolen eyeball.

title: Welcome to Chornobayivka VR
description: At that day the Russians start a miss planed attack against the Ukraine, Joe grabs his preferred weapon to stop the Zombie Russian Soldiers that got infected by a sick experiment of Putin. Fight for democracy and freedom in a wave like horror VR shooter experience for free.

title: Herald of Havoc
description: Herald of Havoc is an FPS that merges the fast-paced gameplay of the 90's era shooters, with the crazy capabilities of what can be done today. Destroy hundreds of enemies with a crazy arsenal that includes classics weapons as well as things like Power-fists, ChainShotgun, Ultra Cannon, and more.

title: Sophonce
description: Sophonce is a science fiction psychological horror first-person shooter that relies on philosophical undertones as the primary focus of the plot.

title: Cog Owl
description: Jump higher and higher as you clean the clockworks of reality from the cosmic waste!

title: Logicubes
description: Logicubes is a fascinating puzzle adventure game. Discover an enchanting universe reeling on the edge of darkness. Accompany Wis on a dangerous journey alongside new friends, solve mind-bending puzzles and awaken The Great Architect, save the Cubeverse from the eternal darkness.

title: Horns of Justice
description: Play the brutal ball sport where death is the only referee. Master your weapons, spells and tactics to become the ultimate player in the deadliest tournament in history. Play Campaign for a storyline unique to MOBA’s or dish it out in online multiplayer.

title: Ayatana
description: Welcome to the mysterious world of Ayatana! The first stop will be the discovery of Asian temples. You will play as Ava who is looking for her missing friend. Through many clues, help Ava to find Julia by solving puzzles and find the temple of Ayatana.

title: Run, Doodleguy!
description:
Run and jump around as Doodleguy and draw helpful platforms as the Pencil as you escape from the Big Eraser destroying the world!
...and when you're done with that, try making your own fun, or check out what other players have made!

title: Flyable Heart
description:
―It began with a single envelope.

One day, an admission pamphlet to a famous academy arrived, containing an “all-you-can-eat” cafeteria pass. That alone was enough to lure our hero into visiting the super-prestigious Otori Ryouran College Community, home to students who excel in a variety of fields. Offbeat and unique students like a robot seem natural at Otori Ryouran. Organizing this odd student body is the responsibility of two groups ― the Student Council and the Ryouran Society.

I was so happy to change schools, so why is a fortuneteller saying ominous things the moment I step out the door!

Why did all the fireworks explode on the bridge!!

And why was the only available room in the women’s dorm!!!

“Be wary, boy who carries an exceptional fate. Misfortune awaits you beyond here.”

title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla: Forgotten Saga
description: This free game mode is inspired by the rogue-lite genre and presents players with a new challenge as enemies are relentless and every choice counts.

title: Hot Lap League: Deluxe Edition
description:
Take complete control of your vehicle, perfect your driving, and prove your place in the Hot Lap League. Drift and race your car around 150+ mind blowing tracks, each requiring unique techniques and strategies. Improving your time by racing your best is the only way to the top.

It’s you, the track and the clock - no driving assist, no nonsense.

title: Encounters: Music Stories
description:
Encounters: Music Stories tells us about the desires of its characters to meet and be happy with their loved ones. Do you want to know how these stories end? You will have to be precise and let yourself be carried away by its wonderful music.

Each character plays a part of the musical piece. To advance you will only have to go down the blue tiles at the right time and live the experience of synchronizing with the instruments of precious melodies.

title: Zumba Garden
description: Zumba Garden is a match-3 marble shooter puzzle game. Your goal is to protect your beautiful garden from evil golems. Special projectiles and other bonuses, which you upgrade by spending collected stars, are there to help.

title: Yars: Recharged
description: Yars: Recharged is the latest title from Adamvision Studios and SneakyBox, the team behind the Atari Recharged series, infusing elements of arcade, shoot-em up, and bullet hell into the classic's formula. Yars: Recharged requires players to remain acutely aware of visual and audio cues that hint of impending danger, and to master rhythm of each boss as they navigate increasingly complex enemy defenses, all to epic soundtrack by Megan McDuffee.

title: Realife Simulator
description: Feature Contents Character Creator Once you have created your character, you can go to the clothes shops and barber shops if you want to get a unique look. Social Events In case we meet new people, take your cell phone number, record it in your own guide and send a message or call each other.

title: Expedition Agartha
description: Expedition Agartha is a hardcore multiplayer First Person Looter Survival game. Explorers and Mercenaries from around the world find themselves on a mysterious island in the Lost Continent of Mu. Launch your expedition, encounter ruthless enemies, and discover the secrets of Agartha.

title: A Path to Light
description: An original handcrafted puzzle. Guide your steps and find the way. Sometimes the path can be hard. The goal is to touch the triangle(light).

title: The Pier Arcade
description: Play a great selection of physics-based and digital arcade games, just like those found in real-world arcades and piers, competing for high scores, tickets and jackpots.

title: Colorless World
description: Immerse yourself in this strange Colorless World. Unleash new mechanics and defeat obstacles, monsters, and bosses. As you unravel a hidden story told between the lines that will shape your ultimate destiny.

title: Weed Runner
description: Weed Runner is a drug dealing, crime fueled, story driven, point and click adventure.

title: Cuisineer
description: Explore the world of Cuisineer as you enter dungeons and defeat monsters to get vital ingredients to cook delicious food to serve at your restaurant in this super cute and tasty rogue-lite dungeon crawler!

title: Machine Gun Fury
description: On a bold and potentially dangerous mission to revive the classic Arcade military shooter. Fully loaded with addictive top-down and side-scrolling run-and-gun gameplay, pixel-perfect 2D graphics, explosive SID soundtrack and massive destruction! Fight on foot and in heavily armed vehicles.

title: Heavens' Revolution: A Lion Among the Cypress
description: Revolution consumes a Persian dieselpunk city! Will you let it consume you, too? Make a name for yourself as a powerful astralchemist and resist the usurpers…or join them!

title: Warlords: Under Siege
description: Warlords: Under Siege is a mix of RTS and TD genre, where you build a small city and defend it against continuous waves of enemies. Improve your assortment of weapons with each playthrough, unlocking new possibilities to beat the ever-increasing threat.

title: Road Draftsman
description: Fun combination of parking and puzzle game in which you draw the path of cars to their parking spot.

title: Kenosis: The Liminal Tapes
description: Enjoy this single player horror experiences to explore, solve puzzles, find recordings and documents with lore, escape the monster, and try to find your way out of the creepy places of each tape.

title: Short Stories Paranoia
description: How do you know, if something is real, or just in your mind? Are you really sure that you can distinguish imagination from reality? For the next couple of hours, listen, watch and be part of a story where imagination and reality intersect each other.

title: Public Transport Simulator
description: Buy old station to rebuild the depot. A realistic simulator of a public transport manager. Repair old buses, decide what trams will look like, hire best people. Earn money and give people the best transport in the city!

title: Colored Effects
description: Colored Effects is a puzzle platformer game where you use different abilities to advance through levels. Each color grants a unique ability. Switch between the colors and their effects to collect gems, defeat bosses, and solve fun puzzles.

title: Cube Chaos
description: Cube Chaos is a complex strategy rogue-lite about placing units to create giant armies, factories, combos, or self replicating murder crabs, overwhelming and surviving your opponents. Build and adapt new strategies each run using a ludicrous variety of units, perks and more.

title: Subsequence
description: Subsequence is a linear single player story driven 3D adventure game about overcoming obstacles, solving logical puzzles and exploration of the world.

title: Reka
description: Start your life as an apprentice witch to the legendary Baba Jaga and venture across a mysterious, natural landscape with your companion, chicken-legged cottage. Develop your magical powers, customise your home, craft potions, help or hinder villagers find your way in the world.

title: The White Raven
description: Wage tactical war, Explore spiritual hellscapes, and Spark beautiful romance, or bitter rivalries in this Open World turn-based Tactical RPG: The White Raven.

title: Mono Playground
description: Welcome to Mono Playground! This game is a basic 2D platformer adventure, where you can run up walls, eat cookies, and earn a high score! You play as Mono Kitty, an intrepid adventure in search of something to nourish his cravings of adventure, and stomach! Hope y'all enjoy the experience.

title: Stasis Valley
description: Stasis Valley is an action-platformer which follows Adam, a young man who descends into a world frozen in time. Uncover its secrets, experience a story about grief, and confront the dangers lurking within the valley.

title: Zardy's Cave
description: Beneath the farm something terrible awaits. You fell down a giant hole into a dark world full of terrifying scarecrows and monsters. Now you must make your way through the tunnels deep underground while watching your back. Solve puzzles, find tools, and most importantly… Stay alive!

title: Guardians of Holme
description: Fight off legions of Devil with traps! With a blend of deck building + Roguelite + Tower Defense, and a wealth of cards, relics and enemies, Guardians of Holme will give you a new experience every time you play.

title: Mind Over Magic
description: Design, build and manage your magic school to explore what lies below. Study lost arcana, grow exotic plants, brew potions, and raise undead servants -- only you can prepare your fragile students to harness their Mind Over Magic.

title: Zippy the Circle
description: A Christian-themed, story driven, 3D polygonal rendered action adventure video game in the Zippy the Circle franchise!

title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Futanari Pool Party
description: Challenging jigsaw puzzles, featuring adult images of girls and a futanari, having sex by the pool.

title: The Twilight of Infinity Episode 3: A Deuce of Devils
description: A time travelling journey to 1486 leads to a sinister game of cards where even the Devil may have taken on more than he bargained for.

title: Meteorites 3D
description: Experience the retro inspired game Meteorite 3D built for modern 3D rendering, being a spiritual successor to the space games of old

title: Kapow Pets
description: Play Kapow Pets using physics-based blasts to strategically move your pet through a variety of levels full of dangerous traps and hazards. Collect treats and treasure! Unlock new pets and pet skins to complete the ultimate collection of Kapow Pets!

title: Boxel Golf
description: Boxel Golf is a multiplayer golf game packed with challenging courses, custom hats, and a powerful level builder.

title: Tvö
description: Tvö is an online cooperative puzzle game where two players must use their wits and communication skills to find a way into the heart of the labyrinth. This game can be played using our in-game voice chat or a third-party option.

title: Land of the Vikings
description: From victuals to Vikings, lead your village and expand it into a thriving city. A wise Jarl must manage resources, survive harsh conditions and enemy raids, and guide their fellow Vikings to work together through social conflict. Skál!

title: Eva 4: Sim Date RPG
description: A Neon Genesis Evangelion satirical fan game, where players can date two of the main characters, Asuka and Rei.

title: Dayshift at Freddy's 2: Electric Boogaloo
description: Dayshift at Freddy's II or DSAF 2, is the direct sequel to the infamous DSaF 1! Once again, you must survive a week as a suited worker at Freddy Fazbender's Pepperoneri in the year of 1987 (months after the events of DSaF 1!) Once again, you must wear ridiculous-looking suits, give out cake to screaming toddlers and get through the week without being killed (or worse: fired!) This time though, Freddy's is bigger, has more possessed, mucus-dripping robots, and has even more choices and consequences. Powerful forces are at work and Freddy's has one last chance before they're shut down for good. This is your last chance to make things right. Or kill more kids and hang out with aubergine-man. Whatever sounds the best to you, heh.

title: Crete
description: Fight against the Ancestors and other biopunk creatures. Use their DNA to build your procedural weapons, find a friend and combine your skills to be even more powerful. The further you go, the better rewards you will get for the next run. It is up to you to reveal what is up there in the north.

title: Chess Survivors
description: Chess Survivors is a grid based, quick-turn, roguelike where you outmaneuver and destroy an ever growing horde of chess enemies. Combine abilities and upgrades to create game-breaking builds. Unlock cosmetics, characters, and powerful relics. Think fast, die, learn, repeat.

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Cute Cats 2
description: Adorable and clumsy kittens will cheer you up!

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Home Sweet Home 3
description: Soft cozy atmosphere of a nice home.

title: Franco and Apollo
description: Franco and Apollo is a rogue-lite survival action game with auto-shooting. Fight against hoards of enemies side by side with your robot dog. Combine weapons and characters to get stronger and be able to defeat all the bosses!

title: 13 Steps
description: Find a way out in this horror/time loop Game. Hide, run, and uncover the mysteries of the "EOS Complex" as you are pursued by the automated security bots gone rogue. They only move when you do, so tread carefully, every step could be your last.

title: 30 Days to be the Best
description: You have a dream... but the clock is ticking. Your determination and your own two fists are all you have left. Make them count.

title: 69 Berta Hot
description: 69 Berta Hot - Puzzle with visual novel elements. Your maid Berta was caught stealing and now it's easy for her to make amends with you. Don't miss the opportunity to see all her hidden talents.

title: ACL Pro Cornhole
description: Play against top ACL pros in the most realistic Cornhole game ever created!

title: Acras
description: A High Fantasy top down Strategy RPG. Featuring a colorful and diverse cast of characters, free movement turn based strategy combat, a unique spell and inventory upgrade system, topped of with an engaging and dramatic story. Built from the ground up to support how you like to play your rpg's.

title: Adorable Witch 4: Lust
description: This is a small game of decrypting levels. Players need to control the various mechanisms in the levels to help the heroine get the flowers. The game contains a total of 30 levels for players to play.

title: AdventureQuest Worlds: Infinity
description: AdventureQuest Worlds: Infinity is the anything-goes fantasy MMORPG. The game is growing under your Hero's feet as you play. Featuring weekly updates, 100+ Classes, 10,000+ weapons, absolutely crazy storylines, and the freedom to play and be whatever your heart desires.

title: Adventures of the Old Testament: The Bible Video Game
description: Experience the Bible in a new, interactive way. Read, Watch, and Play through the Scriptures in this action-adventure faith-based game! Interact with others through our Community Hub, Old Jerusalem!

title: A Frog's Job
description: A soul-saving frog reaper with the power to stop time. How many souls can you save? Will the Frog God grant your wish? Find out in this challenging puzzle platformer with a unique clock-stopping mechanic

title: Anodos
description: A kinetic visual novel featuring questionable meats, weird friends, and irresponsibly bizarre adventures.

title: Ancient Wars: Medieval Crusades
description: New Real Time Strategy Game based on medieval times, where you will control powerful factions and empires, with large-scale epic battles, asymmetric civilizations, unit customization system with RPG elements, dynamic AI, 8K support and much more.

title: Ancient Aliens: The Game
description: What if aliens helped create Earth’s ancient civilizations? Play as a reluctant alien-human hybrid in this story-driven city building game! Manage resources, manipulate primitive humans, and help promote scientific discovery as you build the colossal pyramids—to uncover the secrets that lie within!

title: An Architect's Adventure
description: This is a 3D Sokoban game. Adjacent blocks are connected together. You need to construct the structure required for each level through whimsy to pass the level.

title: American Truck Simulator: Western Star 57X
description: The Western Star 57X combines the best of two worlds – taking the X-Series DNA with bold design & rugged durability, combining it with the best of Daimler Truck North America’s on-highway platform, tested over millions of miles. The most advanced and innovative Western Star highway truck. Ever!

title: Alien Colosseum
description: Alien Colosseum is a fighter management simulator where you take the role of the Ludus manager, responsible for recruiting and training fighters to participate in the arena. When the fight begins, you then control the fighter and must win against a variety of enemies.

title: Aleon's Nightmare
description: Aleon is a young girl who is looking for a job. One day she found a job but things didn’t go well as she wishes. You have to find out the odd things happening in the mysterious house and You need to survive in the middle of psychopath puppets. And remember... You are in the middle of nightmare.

title: AsteRoid Rage
description: Destroy everything in this short casual physics game!

title: AsteroIdle
description: An asteroid mining based idle game. Travel in space and discover.

title: Ashen Knights: Foreshadow
description: Two heroes, two different genres: souls-like & hack’n’slash. They switch places and trigger a wild emotional storm making sure you never get bored of playing. Assay your strength and stamina as a defender of the Abyss-devoured world. Be merciless yet cautious in Ashen Knights: Foreshadow.

title: Avocado Puzzle Quest
description: Collect match 3 together with a fun Avocado!

title: Aiyana
description: Aiyana is an open world voxel survival game. Explore the lush world to gather enough resources and take on the creatures of the night. Once you are ready, enter their portals to fight them back and earn your place on the global leaderboards.

title: Al-Ankabut
description: Al Ankabut involves the hunt for the frailest of webs, the spider’s web. Throughout this journey, the player is tried with mathematical challenges and taught wisdom from the holy book.

title: Alchemist Tris's Desire
description: Control the main character, Alchemist Tris. and collect the materials for the items needed to solve the problems of the villagers. This is an RPG in which the player collects the materials for the items needed to solve the problems while exploring the forest.

title: Aground Zero
description: The world has ended. You are deep underground, and all alone other than your AI companion. You will have to mine and build to survive, and search for other survivors to help you. Will you be able to reach the surface? And what will you see when you get there?

title: Agony: Lords of Hell
description:
Build your empire on the bones of the Lords of Hell to become the absolute ruler of the underworld!

The main inspiration for the gameplay in Agony: Lords of Hell is the iconic Populous series. While the main character of the game - Nimrod, will focus on developing the city and managing the army, the demonic Vydijia will become the main unit controlled by the player. With numerous combat skills and special powers, Vydija will lead Nimrod's army to victory, and will be the key strategic element of every battle.

Thanks to her high position among other succubi, Vydija will use her abilities to seduce and then incorporate martyrs, who do not belong to any of the factions, into her own army.

title: Age of Solitaire: Build Civilization
description: Build your civilization with the classic Klondike Solitaire card game. Beautiful graphics and healing music will help you to blow away your stress. Enjoy your time with the Solitaire card game.

title: After the Inferno
description: An adult visual novel set in an original fantasy world. Featuring animated and voice acted scenes, both NSFW and SFW.

title: Bad Impressions
description: Bad Impressions is a game where you draw a character card and a scenario card and you have to improvise how that character would react to the situation. Hundreds of cards gives thousands of unique scenarios.

title: Battle Rift
description: This is Battle Rift, a sci fi, first-person shooter. It's like Super Mario only harder and in 3D and of course with weapons. The main mode is the "Challenge Mode" where you fight your way through 20 hard levels.

title: Beauties Academy: Spellcraft Tournament
description: The centenary Spellcraft Tournament is about to start and Rosalee is getting ready to win it. Face enemies, meet friends, learn powerful skills and win a huge prize!

title: Go to Hell
description: Go to hell is an adventure FPS with a pixel art style, you have to find items to advance in your quest and fight against angels.

title: Anolock
description: The hero of a petty noble who lost his family and servants due to a pandemic will hire three maids with a referral from his friend. Through contact with them, we will recover from the sadness of loss and the suffering of sequelae.

title: Anomalous Zone
description: Containing breakthrough? Supernatural invasion? You will play the role of an investigator involved in the incident, facing the unknown environment and defeating the terrifying enemy.

title: Anti-Nightmare Master Plan
description: Wipe out superior forces of nightmare monsters and protect the dreamer. Create your own unique skill path for a variety of weapons. Evolve through a rogue-lite system and overcome the nightmares.

title: Apotheosis
description: Apotheosis is a single player turn based RPG that takes place in a surreal universe. Discover the powers of the Archetypes that lie within and use them to your advantage. Solve puzzles, explore mazes and unveil the truth about your past.

title: Archetypes: The Rite of Passage
description: Discover the depth of your personality while journeying along the path of initiation as the young Viking Olaf. Every choice will impact your environment, and contribute to a map of your archetypical psychology. Embrace your inner warrior, lover, chieftain, and druid - and change the world!

title: Archmage Ricka
description: In order to retrieve the illegal property embezzled by the evil Lord, Ricka received a mission to capture the Lord. But it was a trap. She fell into a dungeon arranged by the Lord in advance. Although the demons in the dungeon are weak, the existence of various traps makes it difficult to escape!

title: ArcRunner
description: ArcRunner is a beautiful Cyberpunk-styled action rogue-lite set in the far future on board a huge space station where the controlling AI has gone insane, and its up to you to traverse the Arc to find and destroy it.

title: Armored Lab Force Vulvehicles
description: Raze the road less traveled with your Vulvehicle, the ultimate all-purpose armored combat machine! Whether flying through the sky, or burrowing deep underground, these gals stop at nothing to blast through terrain and enemies alike in this comical action STG!

title: Boooooooooobs
description: Boooooooooobs is a match 3 puzzle game with many levels and cute boobs. No matter what size is your preference, you'll find the right one in our collection. Big boobs and small tits, big nipples and perky nipples, whatever you pick out, you will have a nice time playing!

title: USAC: Code Breach
description: USAC: Code Breach is a unique coop experience based on a French cyberpunk universe. As a special police unit, you and your partner are brought to investigate a sudden shutdown of a research facility. Between reflection and action, you must survive a situation that is beyond you.

title: Before Sunset
description: Before Sunset is a 2D hand-drawn mystery and psychological horror game. Ah-Dan lives with his blind mother and also his pet dog in an old village. Since a very young age, Ah-Dan knows the rule of the village to always come home Before Sunset.

title: Bell Kingdom
description: Bell Kingdom is a 3D platformer, jump inside of dreams and explore the weird worlds within.

title: Beloved Rapture
description: Beloved Rapture is an indie jRPG inspired by the classics. Explore beautiful landscapes, fight in turn-based battles, and uncover many secrets. This mid-length adventure balances both an intimate coming of age story, and larger threats looming over the troubled kingdom.

title: Beneath the Deep
description: Beneath The Deep is a Sci-Fi Horror game Inspired by the 80's retro style. It takes place deep beneath the sea in a Facility where human testing is done. Nightmarish Monsters lurk beneath the Deep

title: Best VRcase 9000
description: Small minigame experiments of differing genres rendered in simplified N64+ graphics in Virtual Reality. otherwise classified as "retro VR".

title: Bias
description: Caught in the Terror of Bias." The protagonist, a film actor, has moved with his wife to a new residential area. During the moving process, his wife suddenly disappears. You enter a strange world in this residential area that began with the disappearance of his wife.

title: Bicycle Challage: Wastelands
description: Ride your bike around the city overcoming all obstacles.

title: Brew!
description: Brew! is a game in which you run a potion stand and must make potions as per request.

title: Bounce Castle
description: Control powerful heroes in a magical fantasy world to defeat monsters that threaten the kingdom. This turn-based physics/strategy game will have you bouncing and booping enemies using a mixture of precision and chaos to save the realm from all kinds of hand-drawn baddies.

title: B.L.A.C.K. 1
description: You are drifting in space... Your Oxygen is running out... And suddenly bandits start to take interest in your tiny, experimental space Capsule.

title: Blast Cats
description: Blast Cats is a love letter to classic 3D platformers! Bomb your enemies to smithereens and smash them flat with your mighty hammer! Find precious gems as you run and jump through secret worlds. Fight powerful foes and show them who’s boss! Adventure explodes unto the world, hang in there baby!

title: Blight: Survival
description: Blight: Survival is an upcoming medieval, co-operative, action horror game set in an alternate 14th century powered by Unreal Engine 5.

title: Bloody Efforts
description: Play as a brave Warrior keen in his swordsmanship, a wise Sage spellcasting powerful Magic or an adventurous Bard healing wounded allies. Is that not your take? Then create your own Heroes! Set their Weapons, Skills, Passives and join the battle to prove your own hierarchy through Bloody Efforts.

title: Blood Scheme
description: A blood test company raised more than US$700 million from venture capitalists and private investors, resulting in a $10 billion valuation at its peak. You are the only journalist who found out this is a scam. Publish your article before the company is listed!

title: Capitals
description: A mash-up of the common idle clicker genre and a city builder, Capitals is a fast-paced and competitive strategy game. Each match is set on a resizable game board made up of hexagonal tiles, randomly generated each time you play.

title: Casa De Diamantes
description: Accompany agent Steph, right hand of the revered forbidden flower, on the hunt for their final rival residing in the beautiful and glamorous casino, the Casa De Diamantes.

title: Case 03: True Cannibal Boy
description: A short anti-classic JRPG. Step into the roles of a handsome moneygrubber and a female psychopath as they take on an exorcism job that pits them against the evil spirit they were destined to face... (This game will have support for English.)

title: Burning Skies
description: 'Son, you are the last hope of the resistance to free the mankind from the claws of the General BLODMESTER and his terrible War Machines.'BURNING SKIES is a frantic roguelite vertical shmup, with huge boss fights, tons of threats, weapons and a unique atmosphere.

title: Bunny Hop: Eggstreme
description: Bunny Hop : Eggstreme is a challenging 3D first-person platformer based on the famous movement feature called "bunny hop". Beat your friends, explore the world, find all the secrets this universe offers you and become the very bester bhopper the world has ever known.

title: Bumpstick
description: Bounce and bump in this fresh take on the platformer genre, control your neon stick as it bounces through tricky platforming challenges!

title: Whimsical Heroes
description: Fight tactical turn-based battles in the cartoonish world full of whimsical creatures. Wisely positioning your heroes on a hex grid and combining their unique abilities is the key to victory and obtaining the precious bubbles.

title: Candy Sweet
description: Candy Sweet is a simple colorful match 3 game. Your goal is to move the elements on the field in such a way that three or more identical candies fall into one row

title: Cannibals
description: A family of cannibals is killing people in the local forestry. Together with the police, you are heading there to stop the bloody atrocities...

title: Cat Seeker
description: Hide and seek with cats! Find and catch the kittens. Each kitten has different tricks up their sleeve.

title: Dice Gambit
description: A turn based tactics game where you roll and allocate dice to control your characters in combat. Completely customize your characters build with a huge array of powers that allow for boundless combinations. All set in a Neo-renaissance metropolis, filled with aristocratic families vying for power.

title: Dimakerus
description: Disguise as anyone. Mimic their ways. Ambush your friends. Discover cursed Roman relics in ever-chanading catacombs and wield their might to obliterate those who stand in your way.

title: Disfigure
description: Disfigure is a top-down shooter rogue-lite in which you fight countless grotesque creatures shrouded in darkness. Choose from a variety of upgrades to create unique builds each run and survive.

title: Disc Golf Online
description: Play Disc Golf online with friends in a casual, but physically accurate Disc Golf simulation. Explore beautiful and diverse procedurally generated worlds. Play a new course every time, or replay your favourite course to master it.

title: Direct Contact
description: Direct Contract is about Authentic Warfare, First-person Tactical realism experiences. Most weapons are in the same specs for each classification in today's world, making most modern combat asymmetrical.

title: Zefyr: A Thief's Melody
description: In a colorful archipelago, play as Eïko, a young thief studying at the Guild. Investigate kidnappings, steer clear of roaming pirates or fight them. Sail the ocean on a cute turtle and climb every island. Cure sick animals, and find the truth during this feel-good journey.

title: E-Girl Next Door
description: You've just moved in next door to a beautiful girl who seems to have it all together. Little do you know, she's just getting started in the world of online adult content creation. Help her out on her journey and see what this exciting adventure has to offer.

title: Egg Hop
description: Use eggs to hop your way through the temple to make your way to the treasure.

title: Eden Universe
description: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to be a god? This game will definitely answer that question. In Eden Universe, you play the role of a god tasked with leading his people to victory and glory. Start your own religion and use divine powers to rule the universe of Eden.

title: Dye Hard
description: A heroic sheep dyes its wool to blend in and infiltrate's a cooperation run by goblins. These goblins have taken copyright law too far and must be stopped!

title: Dash FPS
description: Dash FPS is a fun-filled Multiplayer First-Person Shooter with all kinds of new mechanics. Players have the option to utilize Jetpacks, Super speed, and much more. Play against our High Quality AI or battle against others on an online server.

title: Frontline Grunt
description: A First-Person Shooter game in which the main goal is to capture and secure objectives in a level and winning by draining other team's conquest points.

title: Space Station Designer
description: Space Station Designer is a construction and management game that puts you in charge of creating and expanding a network of orbital outposts in Earth and Lunar orbits.

title: Clouded VR
description: Upload your mind to the cloud and immerse yourself in a dystopian virtual holiday at the Cloud Hotel. This VR experience is a satirical commentary on our relationship with the virtual world through personal devices.

title: Devi: A light in the Dark
description: Uncover hidden truths in a remote Indian village where a teenage girl has vanished without a trace. Step into the shoes of Devi, an amateur sleuth with a passion for detective novels, as she defies her parents' wishes to embark on a perilous journey to find her missing friend.

title: Magurele Mystery
description: A military mission in Romania has gone wrong when a mysterious beast attacks. Beat your fear and go on an adventure to find Virgu The Beast.

title: Sinbad
description: Sinbad is a 3D sandbox platfomer inspired by A Thousand and One Arabian Nights and games such as Super Mario and A Hat in Time, taking place in the magical and mysterious world of the magic lamp.

title: Touhou Genso Maroku
description: Touhou Genso Maroku is a traditional turn-based RPG released at Comiket 81. It is much like The Genius of Sappheiros, its predecessor from the same creator.

title: ThanksTaking
description: Play as a bloodthirsty turkey seeking vengeance on everyone in the household! You must try to escape the house before you are caught and cooked. Use a large variety of brutal attacks to take down your enemies and show them who's boss!

title: Galactic Thunderdome
description: Galactic Thunderdome is a 2D sci-fi platform brawler with a focus on physics-based mayhem. Best your friends with a vast array of weapons and gadgets in a world rich with emergent gameplay, explosive antics, and bloody remains.

title: Driftmaster
description: A fixed-angle, top-down, arcade drift racer. Race through different cities and gymkhanas throughout Canada to develop mastery over your drift. Your mightiest opponent...is yourself

title: Jam Gods
description: Become the superstar you've always wanted to be in an immersive extreme basketball experience like nothing else before. Drain deep threes, dunk from anywhere, swat away shots, catch soaring alley-oops. Are you ready to become the chosen one?

title: Tristan Cole's Pro Driver
description: TCPD is a combo based stunt driving game inspired by classic racing & extreme sports titles. Complete objectives while drifting, grinding, and performing insane aerial stunts in your ride to show off your style & prove you're the best driver on the street!

title: Secret of Sardinia
description: Swim through a desolate underwater world to discover the truth of your lost civilization. As the last sardine in Sardinia, you must translate ancient fragments, listen to the voices of the dead, and rebuild a forgotten mythology as you uncover the deepest secrets of the sea.

title: Miniland
description:
The world doesn't generate itself - you do it, shape the world as you wish! Start with nothing, and build dream houses for goblins and yourself while exploring, collecting resources, crafting, building, fighting, farming... and more!

Miniland is a game where you can do anything you want to! Of course you will still need to eat something from time to time, but beside that, there are no restrictions!

You start with a small patch of land, that with time you can expand by yourself with biome tiles which you receive every day.

In no time, you will find yourself in a big and pretty house with a farm beside, crafting new tools and exploring caves.

title: Dofense
description: Dofense is a Tower Defense RTS focused on the variety of strategies and maps. Defend the energy cores from ever increasing enemy waves by destroying their spawn gates. Build tower mazes on Hex grid. Adapt them to dynamic changes in the terrain. Face quirky bosses. Design your own levels and share them with others,

title: Halberd Black
description: A sci-fi turn-based JRPG game with a rich story and a diverse cast of characters!

title: KaBoom!
description: Pew Pew Pew, KaBOOM! is a challenging old school arcade game filled with action! Unlock new costumes and enjoy the awesome Chiptune OST as you reach new highscores!

title: Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground
description: Demolish & Build 3: Excavator Playground is a playable sneak peek at the driving and demolition physics from the upcoming Demolition & Build 3. In the game, you take control of a modern excavator and drive around a small test track or demolish structures.

title: Day of the Dino Survival
description: In this alternate timeline, German Scientist found a way to make a door way into a different reality. By doing so managed to bring dinosaurs into our world. Being Germany's last hope to push the Red Army out of Reich the scientist unleash the dinosaurs upon the world.

title: Project: Knight 2 Dusk of Souls
description: I saw that tall castle in my dream where normally there was an island... I'm now lost and there is no turning back... A lonely knight on top of a deadly castle... This game is a real time combat collectathon in the style of Dark Souls where you have to collect emblems to progress through a castle...

title: Koi-Koi VR: Love Blossoms
description: The story is a multi-ending that depends on your choice.We look forward to welcoming you.

title: Senpai and the Mysterious Dungeon
description: To save the kidnapped senpai and also the beloved one, Fulla decides to challenge the dungeon on the island inhabited by demons. This is a traditional 2D roguelike RPG. Every time you enter the dungeon, the layout will change! Use various skills and equipment to save your senpai!!

title: Lost2
description: This is a casual puzzle point-and-click puzzle game. You can click on the corresponding item to solve the puzzle according to the prompts in the game.The game has a variety of interesting ways to solve puzzles, such as puzzles, leveling, color matching, etc.

title: Hero's Party R
description: "Find 30 people to come to the Demon Castle party!" One day, the king received a letter from the demon king, the old enemy of mankind. Although it was obviously a trap, the king decided to take advantage of this opportunity to suppress the Demon Castle.

title: Exiori
description: Depart on a multi-world adventure to find the legendary relic known as the Exiori to avenge your friend and return home.

title: Rise of Rebellion
description: "Rise of Rebellion" is a 3D action RPG that pursues the tension of confronting strong enemies and sweating in your hands. People worshiped God and the land where God dwelled. Survive the battlefield by mastering the deep tactics of melee weapons and the energy "May" derived from the earth.

title: Gaz
description: Gaz is a boomer shooter heavily inspired by the pioneers of the FPS genre, such as Doom or Duke Nukem. Dive into dirty, post-communist Poland and fight for your survival. If you think you can save the world, you're already dead.

title: Sneaky IT Support
description: Sneaky IT Support is a simulation game where you find naughty secrets in employee computers. Every laptop has a problem you have to fix within a given time limit. If you're fast enough, you'll have time to look around for their naughty secrets. The more secrets you find, the more money you'll make.

title: I Commissioned Some Bees 5
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bees as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 10 art pieces to choose from, and 1000+ bees, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: Woe
description: Dismantle horrific monsters in real-time gallery combat, descending through random dungeons in search of new weapons, tools, and bizarre artifacts to stave off death a little longer. Woe to all who enter...

title: The One Chapter 1
description: Every hundreds of years or more, a male will be born, some say he will be a god amongst men who will save them as he will give them gifts that will make them Stronger, faster, better.....

title: SCP: Daybreak
description: An open-ended, SCP-based, atmospheric, exploration-focused, survival-horror game with puzzle elements and replayability.

title: Pigglet in Mrs. Big Bad Werewolf
description: Pigglet would do anything for a free meal. Even entering a restaurant full of tasty monster girls! Fight, flirt, adventure and puzzle your way into their hearts... and beyond! ;) Nom nom! A NSFW rpg adventure with a tried-and-tested one-handed control scheme!

title: Blood Flowers
description: is an AVG single-player game with storyline and puzzle solving as its core gameplay. Yinchen Zhang, a meteorite hunter, beginning with a meteorite that contains the qualities of revitalisation, the story gradually unravels the mystery of memories from 20 years ago.

title: Robolife2: Nova Duty
description: 2nd series from Robolife-Days with Aino Live with a robot girl from nowhere. Fix her body and find her secret. Visual Novel with Date sim & time management gameplay!

title: Dungeons of the Amber Griffin
description: Play as a group of daredevils who explore the world of dark fantasy in search of fame, amber and gold. Experience the classic mechanics of the iconic ‘90s Dungeon Crawlers with a new twist. Solve the mystery of the ghost that haunted the ruins and discover a bestiary based on Kashubian beliefs.

title: Hero Hours Contract 2: A Factory for Magical Girls

description: Think, talk, and fight through moral dilemmas and hand-crafted Japanese RPG combat. Test your tactical mastery. Become a better person. Gain karma and create history in a land torn by conflict. Do you have what it takes to overcome fate?

title: Obsidian Legion
description: Embark on a dark journey in this 2D Adventure Game. Rise to the challenge as you fight your way in a land of perils and wonders. Explore the world and collect the tools necessary to overcome the many obstacles set before you. Find the path that leads to the Obsidian Legion.

title: Mystic Gate
description: One day, a "gate" created by the gods suddenly appeared in the human world. Adventurers challenge the "ordeal" that awaits them beyond the gate in order to make their wishes come true. A roguelike dungeon exploration shooting game!

title: Tall Poppy 2
description: In this comedy-horror adventure, explore the city of Boots Bay where you must go through hell to discover the reason why Tall Poppy is tormenting you. It's time to put an end to his terror once and for all!

title: Drug Lord Simulator
description: Production, dealing, and most importantly, raking in the big money. Drug Lord Simulator puts you in the front-row seat to a drug deal gone bad. With everything lost, you now have to make your way back to the top, starting with virtually nothing. That is, of course, if you survive the climb.

title: Platfuzzles
description: Platfuzzles is a game with short levels where you need to figure out how to reach your powers and use them to get to the goal. It's a platformer with puzzle elements. Jump, dash, pound, shoot, turn invisible and slow down objects to achieve victory!

title: Twin Cores
description: Defend a Terraforming station against hordes of enemies in this short coop-only rail-shooter! A unique mix of nostalgic arcade elements and modern coop shooter gameplay. Triumph against your foes and compete for the top of the leaderboard!

title: Phantom Matrix
description: Phantom Matrix is a theatrical, physics-based puzzle VR game. Armed with your wits and the dual magnetic pistols, it’s time to save your friends.

title: Sleepytime Village
description: To learn how to be an adult you have to act like a kid. Sleepytime Village is a narrative adventure that tells the story of a neglectful, workaholic father who becomes trapped in a children’s storybook reality, using the classic point & click interface can you guide Rufus home?

title: The Last Defender
description: Set in the merciless blizzards of a far off planet, The Last Defender is a cooperative third-person survival shooter with strategic defence and crafting elements. Nurture your colonists, build your defences and prepare for an enemy that adapts and learns your weaknesses. No wave is ever the same.

title: Whisky Bottler
description: Learn the magic of whisky. Discover the aromas in old barrels. Visit Scottish distilleries, get to know their secrets, and start your own in the future. Create your own exceptional whisky. Find out whether you can be successful on the luxurious liquor market. Become a whisky bottler!

title: Spaceward Cosmic Conflict
description: Spaceward Cosmic Conflict is a space combat simulator of fast-paced, action packed space battles; set in the future of an alternate history.

title: We. The Refugees: Ticket to Europe
description: A socially engaged existential visual novel based on a huge number of choices and consequences. Become a journalist who pretends to be a refugee and tries to cross the Mediterranean Sea illegally to do research for his upcoming book. Inspired by true events.

title: Reddish
description: Reddish is a 3d action platformer with a lot of combat and exploration, each level has different enemies and secrets, also the world map is highly explorable and hides some surprises. Some gameplay aspects are influenced by snes platform classics, bringing then to the new generation.

title: The Rat Plague
description: The Rat Plague is a platform adventure game, which combines modern design concepts with the visual effects of the console in the 1990s.

title: Locked in my Darkness
description: A tense, atmospheric descent into psychological horror—trapped in a place where reality fades and fear takes hold.

title: Cyrano
description: Write love letters and cross swords in a one hour adaptation of the classic play: Cyrano de Bergerac!

title: Once in Yaissor 3
description: Volodya finally returned to his normal routine of life, but for how long? People never change, and even years later there will be a new "Volodya" to usher in a new era. And what kind of new era? That's for you to find out in Once in Yaissor 3.

title: Spellpowder: Uprising
