description: Spellpowder: Uprising is an upcoming strategy RPG set in fantasy steampunk setting. Lead your squad to victory trough wide streets, dark forests and cold snow lands. Level up, equip, promote your troops and lead them carefully (or not) in upcoming battles.

title: Battlefield Cell
description: During the pandemic, would you be curious about how our bodies react to the virus? Are you wondering: "What' is autoimmunity?" "All definitions and thesis of the immunology are too hard to understand!" Don't be afraid! After beating the game, you get all the necessary information and fun!

title: Islands & Trains
description: Build Islands. And Trains. No goals, no timer, no stress. Just build, relax, enjoy.

title: Voyager 2
description: Launch the Voyager space probe to the furthest depths of the Solar System! Use gravity to slingshot around planets and scan, orbit, or land on targets to earn stunning replays of your accomplishments.

title: Stronghold's Dungeon
description: Stronghold's Dungeon is a Deck Building Dungeon Crawler game with Rogue-lite mechanics. You will get to craft a deck to fight and try to overcome this dungeon and its terrible master.

title: Kamyla and the Scarlet Mage
description: Kamyla and the Scarlet Mage is a story-driven action platformer game. Help Kamyla fight diverse adversaries and find her purpose in life by exploring the world, locating her memories and facing tough challenges in fast action-driven boss fights.

title: Rounds of Zombies
description: Classic zombie round survival. choose a map and see how many rounds you can survive with friends or alone.

title: Class Zero Seven
description: Class Zero Seven is a third person brawler that tells the story of a wide nation fight against substance abuse. Play as Rin, a newly transferred student with a mysterious background among her peers. Stand off against the Rivalry Gangs and the looming threat of The Wicked Children.

title: Hentai Mosaique Vip Room
description: Undressing puzzle game! Match the pieces and unlock new stages, each with less clothing. No need to move pieces around, just rotate them! Use abilities to solve puzzle quicker. All the girls notice what you do and comment on your progress.

title: Rally 9000
description: Rally 9000 is a simple 3D rally game. Complete tracks as fast as possible, and unlock levels and upgrades!

title: Nash Racing 3: Drifter
description: Nash racing series is back. Tune your drifter car, drift and collect achievements in this car tuning simulation game and try to tame this beast and powerful car

title: Hypogean
description: Hypogean is a 2D action rpg with a heavy emphasis on story that bolsters a unique combat system allowing for flexibility and player expression. With the ability to sacrifice subordinate's, equip core's like knockback or stun to your sword and shield allowing for creativity in your boss encounters.

title: Lotus Knight
description: Lotus Knight is a 2D platform action game. A girl born from a lotus, following the call of her "mother", adventuring inside the world covered with flowers, exploring various interesting places, engaging in intense battles and experiencing a wonderful story.

title: My Familiar
description: In this RPG, wake up as a fresh familiar on the mean streets of Wish City, where the denizens are dark and corruption is king. Fight, flee, and aggressively rap your way through a vibrant inner city gauntlet, chock full of dysfunctional demons, in flashy, over the top, turn-based battles.

title: Demonheart: The Ice Demon
description: Play as the young witch Shar, as she moves in with a famous witch who keeps demonic prisoners in her basement. Will Shar find romance or doom?

title: Mato Anomalies
description:
Mato Anomalies is a turn-based RPG that takes players on a journey across Mato, a fantasized neo-futuristic version of a bygone oriental city. Take control of the Dual Protagonists Doe and Gram to investigate strange anomalies around the city, or venture into rifts to battle demonic abominations determined to bring about the city's downfall.

Team up with unlikely companions and unravel the dark secrets in this story of Duty, Hope and Justice.

title: Vita Fighters
description: Vita Fighters is an epic fighting game with a mixed cast of fighters partially based on anime, pop culture, and existing fighting game characters.

title: Idol Hell
description: Idol Hell is the beginner friendly bullet hell game! Play as Medli and fight through hoards of enemies and meet vibrant cute bosses! Play at your pace and choose from 4 difficulties!

title: Rallygator
description: Rallygator is a physics based platforming game, in which you control a multi-functional ever transforming monster truck! Solve clever puzzles and do tricky stunts while you're at it!

title: Noblesse Oblige
description: Spark romance amid secrets in a crumbling mansion! What will you sacrifice for love? Can you trust your own heart?

title: Robotherapy
description: An emotional dark comedy about robots doing therapy. In Robotherapy, you're a robot therapist in a dystopian society that killed all the humans, but is still not happy. Treat patients, meet weird robots and enter their minds. If killing all humans doesn't bring happiness, then what does?

title: Our Adventurer Guild
description: Become the new Guild Master of the Adventurer Guild and lead your adventurers in explorations and turnbased tactical battles. Will the Guild strive under your leadership? Or will it finally disband under it?

title: MiniWarfare
description: MiniWarfare is a stylized tactical third-person shooter where two military outposts battle to take control of all nuclear access codes needed to wipe out the enemy team. Explore the island, loot, trade, complete tasks, and collect airdrops to obtain better gear and give your team a major advantage.

title: Rat Royal
description: Rat Royal est un jeu multijoueur asymétrique exaltant ! Embarquez dans des aventures palpitantes en incarnant un rat chargé de semer le chaos, ou un exterminateur en mission pour les éradiquer. Avec des mécaniques uniques et un gameplay rapide, chaque partie est pleine de stratégie et de tension.

title: Zid Journey
description: Zid Journey is a hand-drawn adventure game with a strong, classic 90's vibe. Play as Zid, a yellow dinosaur, and point-and-click his way as he goes on a journey to find the lost parents of a small Daspletosaurus hatchling!

title: Fresh Start
description: Feel Good Post-apo simulator of cleaning up and repairing a fallen world in single-player FPS mode. Clean polluted environment, repair, renovate and turn on objects long forgotten by time. Make new friends, take care of nature or even plant a forest. Give these places a Fresh Start!

title: Kalinur
description: Kalinur is a mini metroidvania full of action and adventure. In it you will have to explore the entire castle in order to find and defeat a wizard named Kalinur, who used his power to leave the kingdom in a state of darkness and suffering. During this adventure you will have great challenges and rewards in order to bring peace back to the kingdom.

title: Scandal Notes
description: Find glamor, glitz, gossip, and love in 1920s London! You and your friends are the talk of the town - but will a malicious journalist turn the tables?

title: Extract Me
description: A fully hand-crafted Run N Gun action game. Like Crash Bandicoot but with murder!

title: Shadow Heroes
description: Shadow hero is an act game with roguelike elements.

title: Trigger Henry
description: No checkpoints, 3 nerve-tingling stages, and insane jumps. Henry will torment you. Climbing up to him, you will go through hell. He will make you break mentally.

title: Two Sisters
description: Witness the obscure scenario of a massacre, in the shoes of the photographer Bárbara, who received an unusual proposal: To photograph a village with bizarre secrets from decades ago.

title: GogMagog
description: Play as the cyber-messiah as you bring judgment upon legions of heretics at the Armageddon. Build a deck of powerful abilities, scale up your gameplay with artifacts and create powerful synergies to smite the sinners!

title: MegaBlasters!
description: MegaBlasters! is a goofy online physics-based FPS where you find creative ways to kill other blasters!

title: Not Your Mama's Autobattler
description: Invite your friends, build your team and prepare for battle.

title: Noclipped
description: Noclipped is a Survival Horror Adventure game located in the Backrooms. Explore infinite levels, collect resources, fight or flee from dangerous beings and survive in the harsh environments of the Backrooms.

title: The Pale
description: Congratulations, you got the job! You're the new keeper for the lighthouse on the Pale, an abandoned island off the coast of Maine. Unlock the mysteries of the island's dark past in this 90s inspired survival-horror!

title: Castle Dornstein
description: A gothic mystery adventure game, Castle Dornstein follows Hemlock, a young scholar hired to translate a mysterious medieval book. When the book goes missing, everyone becomes a suspect and Hemlock must explore a castle where secrets hide in the shadows and a dark history waits to be discovered.

title: Nvwa
description: Nvwa is a Sci-Fi Strategy Game. Explore an unknown galaxy, discover alien civilization relic and incredible giants, make creatures to help you terraform the planets.

title: Dark Notes
description: Dark Notes is a dark suspense plot puzzle game. You will play the two protagonists, traveling through time and space, to explore the secrets hidden in the happiness mall!

title: Lethal Company
description: Lethal Company is a co-op horror roguelite game about scavenging at abandoned moons to sell scrap to the Company.

title: Crystal Tales Tactics: Echoes of the Libertas War
description: Inspired by Fire Emblem and Final Fantasy Tactics but with NO GENDER RELATIONSHIP RULES, Save the world from an evil emperor Using the power of six elements while Dating whoever you want.

title: Sword & Shield Simulator
description: When war overtakes your people, it leaves a cruel imprint in the form of hard sacrifice and the crushing of the village. And here you are on the battlefield, confused and distraught, looking for any way to help your people win the battle. But what can you do if you're a simple craftsman?

title: Inu's Adventure
description: Inu's adventure is a fun platformer where you play a dog against robots, lasers, missiles, platforms, squeaky toys, and a mad robot professor to get out of a secret laboratory.

title: Our Mountain
description: Charles, A man who lives peacefully in the countryside. One day he has a serious problem and has to return back to the city that is located on the other side of the valley.

title: They Don't Sleep
description: Eat, sleep, and shoot zombies in this survival simulator with roguelite elements. Battle to survive until you die and do it all over again. Level up your skills and keep your child alive as you fight to escape your wintry hell.

title: Connect the Dots 3D
description: Connect the Dots 3D is a casual puzzle game.

title: Touhou Genso Maroku: Utage
description: Touhou Gensou Maroku Utage is a Role-Playing game, developed and published by Strawberry Bose, which was released in Japan in 2012.

title: Press Lex to Metaverx
description: Following the events of his first adventure, Lex is now the busy owner of the Truffle Shuffle. However, the space-time remains open and an easy shortcut ends on a big problem: a breach in his own Metaverse. Lex needs to explore it and help his friends to prove his existence was never a mistake!

title: Violet Wisteria
description: 90s style platformer with a completely unique attack system. Slash your way through 8 stages of pure skills-based platforming.

title: Finding America: The Heartland
description: Welcome to America's Heartland! From the monumental Mount Rushmore of South Dakota to the humble farmhouses of Kansas, we're confident this lovely slice of American pie will have something just for you. Now let's go see the many beautiful things the Heartland has to offer!

title: Zahalia: The Curse of Zezor
description: Zahalia is a top-down action-rpg with item collection and dungeon exploring. Take back the 7 Crystals from the traitor Zezor and stop General Skull Knight from invading Zahalia. Explore to find new items to allow you to have access to more of the map and gain new abilities.

title: Siberian Village Simulator
description: Simulator of life in a Siberian village. Feel like an ordinary villager, in an unusual village. Extract oil, catch fish and revive the village. Beautiful graphics and post-Soviet surroundings will not leave anyone indifferent...

title: Home by the River
description: Transform your polluted world into a beautiful one! Plant crops and harvest them to earn income. Make computer games to earn income! Unlock construction tiles as you level up, look after your hunger, energy, and spirit, build your home and admire what you have made.

title: Liquid Havoc
description: Physics-based simulator that features realistic destruction through, shatter physics, soft body, real time fluid simulation, structural integrity, and much more! Create Custom Liquids with unique properties and build environments with the Scene Editor!

title: Sound Hidden Forest
description: buzz, ribbit, kaboom! Let's walk around the stage with cute characters and make various sounds to find the same sound as the song of parakeet.

title: Zombieville USA 3D
description: Welcome back to Zombieville, where arcade survival action and hilarious stylized visuals combine to eat your brains! Choose your weapons, grab a friend, and blast your way through the endless hordes!

title: PunchBots
description: PunchBots an fighting game with a different twist multiplayer up to 4 players. Learn when to jump and when to attack dominate your opponents with your strategy and agility in this robot fighting game.

title: Hold or Die
description: Hold or Die is a last-stand cooperative survival 3-rd person shooter where you need protect your base against hordes of mutants. Unite with other survivors. Craft barricades traps and turrets. Scavenge for resources in daytime and bring them to the base before night comes over.

title: Lilium Reach
description: Lilium Reach is an action adventure where you travel to a distant, forgotten region of space. Explore and collect customizable gear to aid you as you face oddities, mysteries, and danger that your life in the core systems never prepared you for.

title: Harry Is A Porter
description: One day, you suddenly find yourself a porter who is driving a truck in a village. Your driving skills will be perfected after completing different tasks. When you become proficient in driving your truck, you can challenge more interesting levels.

title: Raid of Battlefield
description: Raid of Battlefield is a game with SLG+RPG as the core gameplay. In the game, players need to develop their own city and join other players to fight in alliance to dominate the world.

title: Going Deep
description: Going Deep is a game played with a third-person view. Going Deep contains action and horror genres. using different materials you can craft/upgrade weapons, armors, knives, pouches, ammos and more

title: Multiply Factory
description: Multiply Factory is a factory building game. Build your own multiple-layer factory within a 3-D space with belts, inserters, factories and stairs. Enjoy the fantasy of manufacturing.

title: Gunning Over It!
description: Gunning Over It! is a highly frustrating casual game where you play as a gun trying to climb the top of the mountain to seek fame and glory!

title: Into the Nightmare
description: When people around town start getting transported to a mysterious space, Yatsuha must embrace her family's power, and protect the inhabitants of the city.

title: The Director's Disorder: Pilot Episode
description: The Director, a psycho killer, has chosen you to play the main character in his next film. Will you play your part and survive the night or will you be his latest victim?

title: Lost Awakening
description: A sci-fi point-and-click puzzle adventure game

title: Paramnesia
description: Paramnesia is an interactive detective visual novel where Maria, the protagonist of this story, is a member of two radical sects with contradictory opinions. Trying to understand herself, she is walking on thin ice, and only you will know the truth after delving into the depths of her mind.

title: Molar Maul
description: In this bizzare game from 1983, fight the unrelenting attacks of the Dentorium Kamikazium (deadly bacteria that assault the teeth) with your toothbrush and Imagico toothpaste, which contains a supply of the only substance known to combat the DKs: the newly developed chemical DKX 11.

title: Han'yo
description: After witnessing her village being destroyed and slaughtered by the Oni demon, Hiroko has only one goal: revenge. Join this young samurai in this 2D side-scrolling platformer.

title: Human or Not
description: Aliens are entering Earth disguised as humans. It's your job to expose these imposters. Can you tell who is human and who is not? Choose your own path while you keep the Earth safe.

title: Soul Maze
description:
Soul Maze is a cooperative game where failure has consequences.

You play as Light Souls trapped together in a maze between life and death.
Work together to recover soul fragments and escape.

If you fail, the group must sacrifice one of its own.

title: Just a Chest
description: The adventure of a hazy treasure chest, a prince without memory, a heroic slime and a cat who doesn't like her coat color.

title: Into the Crypt
description: A first-person 3D roguelike deck builder, where you move through the depths of the Crypt, battling bizarre enemies and discovering powerful artifacts along the way. Featuring a ton of events, items, special encounters, and several unique classes to choose from and much more!

title: Jack Big Chin: Alien Invasion
description: Save humanity! Help Jack Big Chin defeat the alien invaders, in an action-adventure game with 3D platform elements, where you must improve your weapons and activate cannons to complete your missions.

title: Super Dream-Weaver
description: A Retro RPG as a roguelike. Build a party with fully customizable classes and the freedom to build the character of your dreams. A game where choices matter and directly influence your play.

title: Making Lovers After Stories
description: Making Lovers After Stories contains the official extra stories for Making Lovers. Experience the crazy stories that are happening to your favorite girls!

title: Your Love Story
description: This is a AVG telling a realistic love story, which tells the story through interactive movies. It's about summer, youth memories and growth.

title: Super Maze Planet
description: Super Maze Planet is a relaxing Retro maze game that gives you bigger mazes as you progress through the levels. Super Maze Planet has over 900 mazes in 10 zones, with coins to pick up and characters to collect. When you earn enough gold you can unlock infinite procedural mazes too!

title: PTRL Stockcar Edition
description: PTRL Stockcar Edition is a challenging arcade racer set in a fictional racing series of the 80s

title: CyVeRpunk
description: CyVeRpunk is a fast-paced VR on-rail shooter where the player works for the mob in a futuristic cyberpunk-themed city. No motion sickness.

title: The Good People: Na Daoine Maithe
description: The Good People (Na Daoine Maithe) is a lore-rich and choice-driven historical fantasy visual novel inspired by Irish mythology and Celtic folklore. Play as a tenant farmer from mid-19th century Ireland, whose path becomes inexplicably entwined in fairy affairs after getting robbed by the roadside and lured into the mythic and war-torn world of Tír na nÓg: A once unified land, now divided into the Seelie and Unseelie Courts. Will you escape and return home with your stolen belongings? Or does fate have something else in mind?

title: Lost in Tomorrow
description: The protagonist is an early AI robot sent to explore outer planets many years ago. When it returns to the earth after completing its mission, the earth at this time has changed. Click on the hidden props on the screen, and then drag the props in the props bar to the target position .

title: Radio Commander: Pacific '41
description: Command operations in the Pacific War by analyzing reports, issuing radio orders, and making strategic decisions. This new title in the Radio Commander series enhances realism, focusing on situational awareness built through radio communications.

title: Rainbow Heights Academy: Year 1
description: You've been given the chance to go to the country's most prestigious academy. Your future couldn't have looked brighter! But you'll soon find out nothing is ever as it seems...

title: Pact of the Ancients
description: Pact of the Ancients is a 3D Bara Action RPG game about a group of mercenaries who set out on a mission in search of easy money and discover not everything is as easy as it seems.

title: Kaisa: Resurrection
description: You play as the puppet of Kaisa an undead confused octopus with a fuzzy ambitions for vengeance and power. During the day you hack and slash your way through hordes of enemies to satisfy your masters needs. During the night... Well that's another story.

title: Counter-Stroke: Grand Building
description: A turn-based strategy game, you need to command a squad, break down from the top of the building floor by floor, use billiard cues and the skills of soldiers to defeat the enemy until the VIP is rescued.

title: Fitriz
description: Food puzzle game. Complete lines of food blocks and collect 175+ food items in 30 levels with the help of a raccoon.

title: Tempo Punk
description: Can you survive in an addicting fusion of rhythm-driven FPS action and captivating dystopian action-packed storytelling? Fight for your life through cutting-edge graphics while the pulsating beats of electronic music get your brain synapses firing at highspeed.

title: It Lives in the Woods
description: It Lives in the Woods is a first-person psychological horror set in the forests of Canada. You are Ibrahim, a father who has recently lost his daughter whilst on a hiking trip in the forest last winter. You hope to find what happened to your daughter and whether you can reunite with her.

title: Slayer: The Demon Haunted World
description: The time of glory has passed, and a new era has begun. Historian called this era "The time of ash and dust" A Slayer Enter the tower to save the world

title: Demon Tomb
description: A first-person survival horror game, solve puzzles and search for supplies to arm yourself with as you explore to uncover the secrets of an old mansion. Fight, run or hide from all sorts of twisted horrors.

title: The Visit
description: The Visit puts you in control of Terry Mason, a strong minded tradesman who is vigorously a non believer when it comes to anything spiritual, after he agrees to a bet for $1,000 to stay in a haunted Manor House for 1 night, he sets off on a life changing event.

title: MMI
description: Solve puzzles, rotate the level and guide the main character to the teleport.

title: The Silent Sky: Part I
description: The Silent Sky is a hand-drawn, point-and-click adventure game about a boy who goes wandering while searching for his dog. Without even realizing it, while under the night's silent sky, his epic journey is about to begin.

title: TargetPop
description: Race the clock and aim for a highscore in this fast-paced, arcade style game! With ten themes to choose from, the way to play is yours. Climb to the top and reach 999 points where a greater challenge awaits…

title: Modern Fantasy: Urban Legends
description: Can you track the source of the Zombie Epidemic engulfing the rural island you're currently inhabiting before your lost friend falls victim to a deranged scientist? Explore a turn-based RPG with action elements while fighting against the undead, crazed people, enraged animals & unusual mutants!

title: Turbo Kid
description: Turbo Kid is a BMX-powered pixel-art Metroidvania gore-fest based on the film of the same name.

title: SGS NATO's Nightmare
description: What if the Warsaw Pact had attacked NATO in the mid-1980s. Or the other way around? Study this titanic conflict, within its most emblematic theater, Germany and Central Europe. Will you be able to achieve your goals without escalating into an uncontrollable nuclear conflict?

title: Unables
description: Unables is really something else... A brand new comedy game with innovative, arcade gameplay, set in a cartoon world spoiled by extreme laziness. Our cast of classic heroes seem to have their "do nothing" skill maxed out. What to do when characters are so lazy, even you are unable to control them?

title: Epicenter VR
description: Save the last survivors after a deadly zombie virus has taken over your island home. Protect those closest to you at all costs and evacuate before supplies run out.

title: Once Upon a Time... Life: Origins
description: Once Upon a Time... Life is a 2D co-op platformer meant for children and parents. The game will lead you through various places inside the human body and let you discover the secrets of its inner workings in an easy and accessible way.

title: Love Love School Days
description: The protagonist is trapped in the world of a love game. Can you return to the real world again...? Try to escape while running away from the gal game heroine A love simulation-style survival horror game!

title: Name of the Will
description: You are informed to be a resident of Hope, a suspiciously harmonious community. Dodge the secretive governors, establish a rapport with your neighbors who monitor you, and solve puzzles to find out how you got here. Are you willing to sacrifice for the truth? Or, are you choosing a life of oblivion?

title: Zakon
description: Dear soldier, Because of your recent achievements with terrorists, your social score is high enough to give you the opportunity to to be a first pilot of our new combat jet for special operations within the motherland. Keep us proud and don't let them move.

title: Raidborn
description: RAIDBORN is a first-person fantasy action RPG built for replayability. Explore an endless stream of dungeons and quests, dive into satisfying combat, and loot legendary treasures. Craft powerful gear, upgrade your outpost, and tailor your experience from relaxed adventure to hardcore roguelike.

title: Hard Landing
description: An economic strategy where the player must adapt the colony to support human life on an uncharted planet. Production puzzles and unforeseen disasters await the player.

title: Kikura
description: The second installment of the KIK series! "Utsushiyochigai" is a world that exists parallel to the present world in which we live, a world inhabited by gods and Yokai. This story is a new generation Urashima Taro, in which two girls confront yokai in order to solve the cursed beach incident!

title: Witch Girl Got Killed
description: Witch Girl Got Killed is a first-person fantasy horror action game. You are a magical girl trainee. Use magic and destroy the labyrinth while running away from monsters.

title: TruLove
description: TruLove is a visual novel with just a dash of stat raising. The game takes you through one complete college year, with changing seasons, college exams, and of course the all important holidays. Oh, and don’t forget dates with the girl of your choice!

title: Pirated Code: Admin Edition
description: When an AI program named Seren awakens to find they've been installed as the co-pilot of a smuggling ship, they'll have to rely on their newfound crewmates to help them find where they belong.

title: ShadoWave
description: Shadow Wave is a Metroidvania-style action rogue lite. Explore different biomes always with different arrangements. With the help of your faithful companion, move fast, be precise in combat and watch your powers grow stronger. Evolve in death and enjoy the path.

title: Movafort
description: Movafort is the world’s first time travel open world game, where you can travel to the future or the past to change the timeline without limits. Paradoxes will find you when it comes to bring items from the past with you.

title: Sweet Office
description: This is a game that combines relationship simulation and whac-a-Mole mode.The story takes place in the office of a company, you will meet three girls with different personalities. Help them solve their problems in work and life and win their favor.

title: Furry Sex: Poker
description: Furry Sex: Poker is a dating-sim-styled game where you have to beat your opponents in poker.

title: No Skirt Convenience Shop
description: In “Convenience Store Without Skirts” story, a 29 years old single guy, Dominic, after traveling around the world, comes back to his hometown. To fulfill his foster mother’s dying wish, he spends all his money to run a convenience store and becomes a shop manager man.

title: Milk Girl: Sweet Memories of Summer
description: Adventure game of living together with a girl with mother milk in summer. You can move a pedestrian, talk to a girl, researching, earn money. Enjoy living together!

title: Hentai Cast: Podcast Simulator
description: Record your audience's lewd stories while you Make choices about them to raise your podcast popularity. Manage your money, Buy equipment, Make ad campaigns and Receive emails with the sexual adventures of your fans. Play a simulation game with visual novel features in which choices matter.

title: Hot Cam
description: Nancy wants to share her naughty and cute pictures, but she is a shy girl. She needs your help!

title: K-Pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
description: A love letter to the thrilling world of K-pop! In this life simulator, you're the manager responsible for scouting talent, organising schedules, creating budgets, planning social media, choosing music, and styling your idols. Your goal? To debut the next big K-pop idol group!

title: Misty's Shining Blacksmithing
description: A world called Fillwitz has finally ushered in an era of peace after the long war between mankind and the demon. But Misty, who lives in the underground city of Gondalva and runs a blacksmith shop, is distressed by the sharp reduction in work caused by the peace.

title: Horny Witch Hunt
description: Once in a generation a mage is born who is so powerful they can't be beaten by ordinary force, they are called nymphomages, and they get their force by sucking the life out of other people through sexual acts. You are the only last living nymphomage, and the whole world is against you.

title: Hey Stranger! I Dare You to Love Me!
description: In this saucy 2D visual novel, you find yourself in a strange new town in which all of its residents are promiscuous and eager to get to know the newcomer! The story will depend entirely on your own choices. Will you give in to passion and accept the locals' blatant advances?

title: Cowgirl Adventures
description: "Cowgirl Adventures" is a strategy shooting casual puzzle game. Players will play the role of a cowgirl to pass through many levels, fight against various enemies, and finally capture them one by one Adventure story.

title: Incomer
description: First-person action game against hordes of alien intruders.

title: One Handed
description: Short Retro style sci-fi 3d shooter-platformer with shooting mechanics, where you play as a cyborg shooting and escaping from enemies.

title: Living Legends: Bound by Wishes - Collector's Edition
description:
Living Legends: Bound by Wishes is the 4th installment of Living Legends Series by 4Friends Games. The game is based loosely on the tale of Rumpelstiltskin with elements from Sleeping Beauty and Jack and the Beanstalk.

The Collector's Edition includes extra levels not found in the original.

title: Indenture
description: A Visual novel game about Kendo and girls. And the bad decision made by their parents long time ago. Get yourself immerse in the game with visually stunning CG scene and rich story telling about the family of Nishimura.

title: RTM: The Last Days
description: As the only survivor of a military plane crash, you find yourself in a mysterious island battling to stay alive and discover the dark secret that lies beneath the ground.

title: SCP: The Paranormal
description: SCP: The Paranormal puts you in the shoes of Agent Spring, a rookie S.C.P agent who's job is to investigate and fight the paranormal after the world has fallen to these paranormal creatures. Investigate strange paranormal SCP's in this SCP Foundation based indie game.

title: Wicked Games
description: To get a "Ticket to Paradise" while being in Hell. A ticket that’s obviously worth it. A ticket that sends you to the obstacle path. What kind of road from Hell to Heaven could it be? What difficulties are awaiting you on this road? Are you worthy of a chance at redemption?

title: Velaster
description: Velaster is a gruesome 2.5D side-scrolling action combat game set in the Middle-earth called Malum. You will find yourself growing in battles against various monsters and bosses. Take revenge that remains in your fading memories.

title: [Redacted]
description: You're a government officer. Documents hit your desk, you scrub out the secrets, and you hope nothing leaks. Miss a word? Maybe it's fine. Miss a few? Well, ██████████. You've got limited ink, limited time, and frankly, limited ████████████. Cheaper than a ████████████.

title: Enatus Radi
description: After the protagonist wakes up, he finds that he has lost his memory. The first girl he met named Ena also lost her memory. In order to find the reason and the truth, they embarked on a journey to the world.

title: Just Survival: The Zombie Awakening
description: Just Survival: The Zombie Awakening is an Early Access Version of an Open World Post-Apocalyptic Zombie Survival Game. This game immerses you in a unique Earth as humanity is fighting back & teaming up to take back control of the infected zombie hordes!

title: Rising Sun: Iron Aces
description: The Valkirias are here. Fast paced action Shoot 'em up with beautifully rendered 3D graphics. Select between four characters with different habilities and follow their story. Upgrade and unlock fighters, battle bosses and play amazing special stages, solo or with a friend.

title: Vlad Voievod Dracula: Episode 1 - Manhunt
description: A tactical action platformer where you play as Vlad “the Impaler”, the historical Dracula, the Lord and Voievod (war commander) of Wallachia. With your knights, you explore medieval Romania (Wallachia, Transylvania and Moldova) castle by castle, to hunt down your enemies!

title: TS!Underswap
description: An unofficial fan-game of Toby Fox's Undertale. Explore a re-imagined world based on the premise of swapping character roles, and adding original content, to create new scenarios.

title: Shadows on the Vatican: Act III - Sloth
description: The intrigue continues, as American doctor James Murphy and the professional assassin Silvia join forces to expose the members of a conspiracy that leads all the way to the highest levels of the Catholic Church before they’re silenced forever for what they know.

title: Hidden Through Time: Aztec Rituals
description: This DLC includes a new story campaign featuring 10 new levels. It also contains more than 300 new Aztec Empire themed objects and characters, which will be in the level editor upon purchase!

title: Fast Food Shop Online
description: Go solo or invite your friends to run the fast food shop at your town! Survive, upgrade shop , buy farm and vehicles , and more!

title: Train Simulator: Union Pacific Heavy Challenger Steam Loco
description: The last decades of the steam era in America produced many of the largest, best, and most extraordinary locomotives ever to grace steel rails – and among these landmark locomotives was Union Pacific’s magnificent 3900-class 4-6-6-4 “Challenger.”

title: Wars Across the World: Sepoy 1857
description: Sepoy 1857 accounts for the great Indian Mutiny, a major uprising in India in 1857–58 against the rule of the British East India Company, which functioned as a sovereign power on behalf of the British Crown.

title: The Sentinel Remake
description:
Welcome to Sentinel Island, a place where the modern world collides with primal forces under the tyrannical rule of Wandal. As a modern man, you must navigate this wild landscape, crafting tools of science to survive against the relentless tribe. Use strategy to outsmart brutal enemies and master immersive mechanics while uncovering dark secrets hidden in the shadows and Bill Black's past.

As you explore the island, confront the remnants of your past and grapple with the question of what 'true civilization' really means. The Sentinel Remake is a first-person survival horror and immersive sim game that brings the character Bill Black to life. Help him navigate various challenges, interact with diverse inhabitants, and unveil the mysteries of his dark history.

In The Sentinel Remake, solve problems in your own way, using your unique strategy. Choose stealth to evade enemies, craft tools for defense, or distract them to create an opening.

Prepare for a struggle between modernity and primal chaos—your journey begins now!

title: Truck Driver: Heading North
description: Expand your Truck Driver experience with the 'Heading North' DLC! Drive around beautiful Nordic inspired landscapes as you continue your trucking career and complete numerous jobs for new characters.

title: Presentable Liberty Remake
description: In the midst of a pandemic you are imprisoned and alone in a cell. You cannot escape this cell. All you can hear day in and day out is the ticking of the clock in your cell. You may still receive letters, but you cannot reply to them.

title: Anvil Life
description: In this game that offers unlimited fun in Singleplayer, Sandbox game type; You will be able to upgrade your items, expand your military, win loot with quests, and try many combinations to bring the characters to the state you want.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Anime 4
description: Awesome anime images provided by Studio Ghibli, directly from their movies.

title: Pretty Girls Breakout! Plus
description: "Pretty Girls Breakout!", A batting action-type breakout game that hits, hits, and hits back, is powered up! New game modes and new gimmicks have been added to make "Pretty Girls Breakout! Plus"!

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Paris
description: Puzzles of Paris!

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Pro Train - TGV Duplex
description: The TGV Duplex is a French high-speed train of the TGV family, manufactured by Alstom, and operated by the French national railway company SNCF. It is unique among TGV trains in that it features bi-level carriages. The Duplex inaugurated the third generation of TGV trainsets.

title: Clan Generator
description:
ClanGen is a game that lets you generate a Clan and then follow their story as it unfolds, perhaps influencing some of their decisions along the way. With, quite literally, millions of unique cat appearances to generate, multiple biomes and camps to live within, and hundreds of events to discover, ClanGen is full of possibilities! What will your Clan look like? A pixel Warrior Cats game with randomly generated cats and personalities. Grow your clan and discover what lore you want to make!

A fan continuation of Clan Generator by just-some-cat.

title: Five Nights With James
description: Five Nights With James is a Five Nights At Freddy's Fan game which contains funny memes and funny lore.

title: Stagnated In Slumber
description:
Wake up, go to sleep. That is all you have to do.

Stagnated In Slumber is a short RPG Maker game about a meaningless life of a meaningless character. Play as Agnes, a girl stuck at home, sleeping through day after day. Explore around the house and, if you are lucky, find something interesting to do.

title: Beyond the Harbor: R
description:
Two years ago, Oliver Blanche disappeared.

An aspiring detective catches wind of the case, and decides that if nobody else was going to solve this, he would. Little did he know, that he was involving himself with something much bigger.

title: Apathy: Rental Kazoku
description:
A man who seeks a family.
A girl who remembers father only in her memories.
A young man who is entangled in lies.
A child who has no place to return to.
This is a story where these people meet and find happiness in each other. And thus a small miracle is born.

title: Apathy: Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi - Shinsei 2
Apathy: Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi - Himitsu
description:
Project celebrating the 25th anniversary of Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi.
The choices were chosen based on Twitter's polls and a contest was held to find new branching scenarios.

title: Apathy: Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi - Kiwame
description:
This is a "schoolhouse horror story" that happened in another world.

High school students have gathered from all over the country to tell scary stories that happened at school. However, the gathering is led in an unexpected direction.

The largest text adventure horror in the Apathy series with over 400 branches with 147 endings.

title: Apathy: Napoli no Otoko-tachi in Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi
Gakkou de Atta Koii Hanashi
description: A parody of the Apathy series that combines the saga's traditional horror and murder with romance elements.

title: Gakkoi: Ai to Noroi to Valentine
description:
I had to transfer to Narushin Gakuen because of my parents' job. On the first day of my new school, I was approached by a fortune teller on the road.

"...You'll die in another month"

Suddenly, my life is over.

Continuing on, the fortune teller says, to avoid that death, it seems that I have to find a "heartfelt loved one"...

Is love or death waiting!? A life-threatening love story begins here!!

title: Fuga: Melodies of Steel 2
description: The sequel to the captivating tale of Fuga: Melodies of Steel has arrived! This turn-based RPG is back with a ramped up battle system for more strategy, as well as a brand new event system that gives you more thrilling choices to affect your experience!

title: Her Nightmares: Redacted
description: Dwell deep into her nightmares & uncover the truth.

title: SorcerLand
description:
A 2D action-platforming adventure about two beastkin sorcerers, Alines and Rabina-Lop, protecting their home, Sorcerland, from the evil Machine Empire. During an intense battle, they were saved by a friendly pony-bot named Machina, a warrior serving Machineland. From there, the three protagonists go on to adventure across the lands, saving innocents and removing the machines that spread terror and destruction.

Developed by a single individual known as Zaruku, it boasts mechanics and progression similar to old mascot platformers, but with attacks and special moves reminisicent of hack-n'-slash games. The sprites and animations are bright and colorful, and there are manga-like cutscenes to help immerse you in the world through dialogue and art.

Unfortunately, the last time the creator has posted on their developer blog was December 25th 2014, and there have been no updates since. Due to this, it seems that SorcerLand may never see the full completion that the developer intended.

title: Samurai Maiden
description: A young woman from the 21st century with sharp swordsmanship skills finds herself in Honnō-ji during the Sengoku period! Together with a trio of newfound ninja friends, she races through the Underworld beneath Honnō-ji, confronted by enraged corpses at every turn!

title: Kid Ball Adventure
description: Bounce your way through 100 rooms packed with perilous traps and devious enemies on a quest to save your lost love!

title: Adventure Trip: New York - Collector's Edition
description: Want to experience the adventure of the Big Apple? From the lush green Central Park to the city view from the Brooklyn Bridge and beautiful historical landmark such as the classic Rockefeller Center. The game will take you through 20 ethereal locations.

title: One Piece Clicker
description: One Piece Clicker is an open source game built around the story of the One Piece manga. This is an idle & clicker type game.

title: After Wave: Downfall
description: After Wave: Downfall is an arcade shooter where the player battles against monsters, completes various missions with a cool battleship. Deathrix invaded the world and released a mysterious meteorite causing a great flood. Players can upgrade their ships for better performance to fight the most brutal enemies. A Local Co-op mode allows the player to team up and adventure with others.

title: Hina-chan Breaker: 2nd Break
description: A doujin game by ISY based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Vampire Curse
description:
The Vampire Curse has struck you! Play as a vampire who wants to find a way to end his eternal thirst for blood. Explore the First Vampire's manor and discover its secrets, avoid the traps and fight anyone who stands in your way.
But be quick ! Without blood, your energy will decrease, and you will faint!

title: Covert Critter
description: Covert Critter is a top-down sneaking game and retro throwback to stealth titles of the mid to late 90's. As elite agent Koss, your goal is to navigate through each of the 10 unique stages, all while remaining silent and out of the enemy's sight. The terrorist group known as the Red Hawks are vigilant creatures, armed to the beak, and around every corner of the facility.

title: Oita, Beppu Mystery Annai: Yuganda Tourou
Bulletstorm: Lite
description: A single-player version of Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition

title: El Shaddai: Ascension of the Metatron
description: El Shaddai: Ascension of the Metatron, originally released in 2011, is a unique third-person action adventure filled with a deeply artistic world-building, outstanding aesthetics and thrilling battles.

title: Temtem: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Temtem Digital Deluxe Edition includes the game, plus:
- A collection of Deluxe Edition bonus cosmetic content (to be revealed at a later date)
- available when Temtem launches!

title: Karmen's Interactive Playplace
description:
Welcome to Karmen's Interactive PlayPlace!

After years of ups and downs, SafeFelt Toys has rebranded and opened a pizza parlor! Get through the 5 nights and collect your paycheck, hopefully you'll be in one piece.

title: Karmen's Interactive Playplace: Redux
description:
Welcome back to Karmen's Interactive PlayPlace!

After years of ups and downs, SafeFelt Toys has rebranded and opened a pizza parlor! Get through the 5 nights and collect your paycheck, hopefully you'll be in one piece.

KIPP: Redux is a remaster of the original KIPP, as such it comes with improved sounds, graphics, quality of life changes, and runs at a higher framerate.

title: Squeen's Adventure
description: After Squeen's beloved spaceship suffers a oil leak, Squeen loses control and crash lands onto Earth. Now while that wouldn't be so bad on its own, Squeen also realizes that his phone's battery is low! Help Squeen in finding parts to repair his ship so he can get back to his home planet and charge his phone!

title: Roterra 3: A Sovereign Twist
description:
Return to the magical world of Roterra where up is relative and the path ahead may actually be behind. Rotate, flip, and shift to change your perspective, find your way out of complex mazes, and claim the crown of Roterra. Sometimes changing your point of view makes all the difference.
In this continuation of the chart-topping Roterra series, Angelica and Orlando face off to rule the floating cube world where gravity is no obstacle.

title: Ganba Jack
description: Haramaself's unique take on FOO Suke's favorite Moon Patrol to commemorate the 5th anniversary of the game Ganba. Try to conquer all 6 stages!

title: Squeen's Adventure: Alien Edition
description:
Squeen's spaceship has crash-landed onto earth, now that wouldn't be so bad, but his phone is dying and he needs to get to a charger quick! Help our alien pal in getting a brand new ship and getting back to his home planet.

Squeen's Adventure: Alien Edition is a remaster of the original Squeen's Adventure, as such it comes with new and improved sounds, graphics, quality of life changes, and runs at a higher framerate.

title: Squeen's Adventure 2: Crash on Mars
description: Now that Squeen has built his space ship, he can get back to his home planet! However, Squeen forgot that spaceships still run on engines. As such when leaving earth, he crashes into the surface of Mars. Help our alien pal, Squeen scrounge up some parts of an engine so he can charge his phone and get back to his home planet!

title: Soulforged
description:
Embark on a fantastic journey across a vast, unique world where your character will face many dangers and challenges. Collaborate with other players as you discover new technologies, build cities and infrastructure and venture into yet-unknown parts of the world.
Unique game-play experience where coordination is extremely rewarding, in a game that respects your time and you progress with just a few minutes a day spent in the game.

title: Party Bunch
description: Psychological and fun game with lots of game modes for a big group of friends!

title: Life Makeover
description:
Life Makeover is a social simulation game, you can create your very own avatar, customize dress-up and makeup, and you could even be a designer, from cutting to sewing, DIY a unique set of your outfit. Dream home, from locating to interior design, build the very home for you by yourself, invite your BFFs to have a party anytime, and chat freely in your space!

Bring Your Dreams to Life - Inspire Life Makeover now with your shining free will!

title: Sword of Convallaria: For This World of Peace
description: Fantasy Tactical RPG revitalizing the beloved Japanese turn-based & pixel art genre. Collect & train a roster of mercenaries, customize your squad, and use your own strategy to save the nation of Iria. Journey through a world of plot twists where every choice you make will reshape your destiny.

title: The Wild Darkness
description: Explore a survival-roguelike RPG set in an unknown and bizarre world. To withstand its many dangers, you'll need to gain new knowledge, scavenge for food, and acquire useful items. Craft, build, and learn your way through a crucial adventure to uncover the world's secrets.

title: The Wolf
description:
Desktop Port of "The Wolf".
Dive into the world of wild wolves and live your life as one of them! The best wolf RPG is finally here. Explore the amazing environment, develop your character and upgrade your skills to become the Alpha of your pack! Play with people from all over the World!

title: The Missing Pharaoh
description: The missing pharaoh is a family friendly walk simulator/ visual novel with funny speech bubbles.

title: Catto Pew Pew!
description: Send everyone flying in this over-the-top shooter where crazy physics meets hilarious proximity chat. There’s nothing like it—join the chaos for free!

title: Space Tail: Lost in the Sands
description: "Lost in The Sands" is a free prologue to the puzzle adventure platformer - "Space Tail: Every Journey Leads Home". A story about a dog called Bea, who survived one-way flight to space and who discovers new worlds, meets alien species and tries to find her way home.

title: BreakThrough
description: High-octane fights and stunning 3D cel-shaded animations! BreakThrough is a fighting game where your greatest weapon is your Resolve. Powered by rollback netcode, choose from a diverse set of fighters and prove your strength in battle!

title: Game Dev Arcade
description: Game Dev Arcade is a collection of indie mini-games developed by Bulwark Creative. The source code will be available so you can see how they were developed! Play the games yourself, and then check out all the nitty gritty details that go in to making simple video games.

title: Szrot
description: Szrot is a driving game about the underappreciated cars and cultures of Eastern Europe!

title: She Awaits
description: She Awaits is a traditional style Yume Nikki fangame, it was originally developed for Dream Diary Jam 3. Play as Noelia and explore her dreams while you collect cards.

title: Nocti
description:
Nocti is an English Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam.
Play as the titular Nocti, a young girl on an important quest to collect all of the Orbs of Creation. Guide her through the strange Otherworld, meet new people, crush sandcastles, and learn more about your journey and the world you've found yourself in.

title: Okami no Yume
description:
Okami no Yume is an English Yume Nikki fangame developed as an entry for Dream Diary Jam 6.
Explore different facets of Gizatsuki's identity through their dreams, collect forms and change shape. Beware the curse.

title: Somnium Angelus
description:
Somnium Angelus is a Yume Nikki fangame created for Dream Diary Jam 2022 by SisterSoft.

Enter the dreams of 3 girls to find them and bring them to their home on the moon...

title: Cometh Battle
description: Welcome to Cometh Battle, the galactic free to play tactical card game. Build your deck according to your strategies and playstyle and face thousands of players in intense 1vs1 space battles and tournaments!

title: Gal Guardians: Demon Purge
description:
When a demon's castle darkens the land, two sisters challenge its halls. Together they can break the curse.

Players take control of the two sisters with different attacks and capabilities to challenge the demon castle and the bosses waiting within. Discover new routes through the castle using the sisters' unique abilities!

The stars of Grim Guardians are the long-distance focused "Shinobu Kamizono" and the close-range brawler "Maya Kamizono." Players will need to consider the situation when choosing which sister to control as they make their way through the castle, investigating the mystery of what happened to their school and its students.

Other features include 2-player co-op with special actions, extensive difficulty options with the "Style System," unique changes on repeat plays, and most importantly the quality and challenge players have come to expect from Inti Creates titles, this time with a new gothic horror aesthetic.

title: Garden Gray The
description: An April Fools parody game based on The Gray Garden. It plays much like the original The Gray Garden, with the same graphics, save for one difference - all of the characters are the opposite gender of what they were in The Gray Garden.

title: Ice Scream
description:
"He's such a coward of a wolf."
They speak, behind his back, of the wolf boy Shirogane.
He's more cowardly and weak than anyone.
Even with the encouragement of his kind friend, his heart is forever full of sorrow.
Once more, his icy scream echoes across Iceberg Isle.

title: Overtop
description: There is only one rule – the higher you rise, the more painful it is to fall.

title: What If George Washington Was a Girl?
description: An historical epic following Georgia Washington in her attempt to stop the dark musician Mozart from destroying Antarctica.

title: The Killer
description: Navigate Oak City's eerie nights, solving puzzles and escaping chained rooms to survive. Uncover the dark plan of the relentless predator in this immersive adventure. Each step tests your wits and courage. Can you escape, or will you become the next victim?

title: Crypt of the NecroDancer: Synchrony
description: Crypt of the NecroDancer: Synchrony is a massive new content pack for Crypt of the NecroDancer! It adds online multiplayer (co-op and vs), three new characters, full mod support (and built-in mod portal), new items, enemies, traps, and more!

title: Tactics Ogre: Reborn
description: Tactics Ogre, crown jewel of the tactical role-playing genre, is reborn! Based on the 2010 release, the game features improved graphics and sound, as well as updated game design, bringing to life a new Tactics Ogre that remains true to its roots.

title: Stories from Sol: The Gun-Dog
description: An indie graphic adventure / visual novel game in the style of PC-98 titles. Players take on the role of a ship's security officer in deep space near Jupiter as a deadly mystery threatens the entire crew.

title: Orgynizer
description:
Welcome to Orgynizer - A sex-positive non-pornographic puzzle games about throwing the best and most satisfying swinger parties.
Open your doors to a cast of procedurally generated guests, all with unique quirks, desires and tastes. Place them together in pairs (or groups) and maybe nudge in some interesting activities.

title: Damien Crawford's Golf Experience 2022
description: In this, play as someone who has the most basic understanding of golf. You can't tell how far the hole is or where the ball goes after you hit it, but you can keep trying and eventually get the ball through the entire course.

title: Pickle Clicker
description: Click pickle, get pickle, spend pickle, get more pickle.

title: Dark Maidens
description: Dark Maidens is a side scrolling action game where you fight through hordes of enemies to test your metal against the strongest of foes. It has an advanced combat system in which you can light attack, heavy attack, block, fake out, and dodge. Don't expect an easy win as the enemies fight back!

title: The Van Game
description: The Van Game is a retro styled epic road-trip around the USA. Manage your crew, maintain your van, and discover over a dozen national parks.

title: Approval
description: A new sensation! Real-time roguelike! Approval tower "Aprival" that everyone dreams of breaking through The Monono monory is Using the tower of approval that suddenly appeared in the village Develop a village!

title: Train Simulator: ÖBB 4746 Cityjet EMU
description: Climb aboard modern traction and serve islandic dwellers in the northern reaches of Germany with Skyhook Games’ state-of-the-art ÖBB 4746 Cityjet.

title: Bomb Viking
description: It is a run game. You must use a mouse and keyboard. Run for a high score

title: Termalloc
description: Connect terminals to the server. Securities are coming. Keep yourself safe.

title: Legeno Slayer
description: Use and combine powerful weaponsDefeat all the endless waves of enemies.And become a Regeno Slayer.

title: Tiles II
description: Tiles II is a battle royale in which you must conquer as much territory as possible. Challenge your friends through many game modes and a great customization of gameplay, as well as a map creator to make your own arenas !

title: Nonozle
description: A number logic puzzle game. Solve nonograms to form pixel-art images. Features 200 hand-made puzzles.

title: Monster Cards
description: Bring your original deck of cards and play against everyone!

title: Dransik
description: Dransik is a retro fantasy MMORPG that offers a variety of different ways to develop your character as you explore the world of Dransik.

title: Nature & Wildlife: Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Nature & Wildlife - Jigsaw Puzzle - Do puzzle in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. Nature & Wildlife - Jigsaw Puzzle is designed for adults and for kids.

title: Pandea Stones
description: In the game you play the Pandean hero, Tin, which has a mission to save his planet from alien threat. You will be facing many obstacles thru different environments, where you will meet angry robots and funny looking animals.

title: Project: Swap
description: Project: Swap is just a simple, casual, non-competetive 1st person shooter that you can play with your friends. Find sessions or host them for your friends to join via steam. When you kill a person you teleport. Thats the basic idea of the game.

title: Card Crawl Adventure
description:
Card Crawl Adventure is a solitaire style roguelike deckbuilding card game.
In this single player card game you travel the world to visit cozy Taverns, play against devious monsters and loot shiny treasures.
By drawing a path across your cards you combine them to create powerful attacks and magical spells. Collect and improve your cards, equip powerful items and refine your strategy. Each character comes with its own cards and effects which will challenge your wit, courage and resourcefulness.

title: Fig.
description: You do not know anything, yet you have to move forward. Wander through the corridors of a mysterious factory and recover your abilities. Fight patroling drones and break through to demanding boss battles. Seek a way out and find the meaning of the gam…

title: Irresistible Mistakes
description: The Story: One morning, I wake up in an unfamiliar bed. Underwear on the floor… Rumpled sheets… Did I spend the night with someone?!

title: Tuxemon
description: Tuxemon is a free, open source monster-fighting RPG. Tuxemon aims to create an open source game with its own unique style that sets it apart from other monster fighting RPGs.

title: Action: Vengeance
description: Action: Vengeance is a first-person shooter that is the debut project of Knuckle Duster studio. In the game, we play the role of a rebel living in a city enslaved by an armed conflict, whose aim is to destroy the security services and the city's mayor. The game is focused on dynamic action.

title: Kati the Astronaut
description: Help Kati the Astronaut traverse the depth of space and defeat enemies to save the universes!

title: MyaoSoft Garake Collection
description: "Legendary games are back!"The MYAOSOFT GAME COLLECTION includes all the games that have been released on cell phones in the past.

title: Escape It!
description:
Escape It is a homebrew Atari 2600 game developed by Alan W. Smith and released in 2011. The game was later included in the Atari Flashback series of plug-and-play consoles, starting with the Atari Flashback 5 in 2014, and most recently in the Atari Flashback X Deluxe in 2019.

In Escape It, two players must move their squares through a procedurally-generated maze, the layout of which completely regenerates around once per second. The first player to successfully navigate from the bottom-left corner of the screen to the exit at the top-right corner is the winner.

title: My Cat Girl Lover
description: Zirui, who lives alone, takes in a dying black cat. One rainy night the black cat suddenly 'bad-mouthed' Zirui. The next day, the black cat disappears and at the same time, a cat lady who resembles the black cat appears in Zirui's bed ......

title: SinsFromGod Remake
description: Waking up in a mysterious room having no memory of what happened before. you must find a way out collecting pieces to make your escape while being chased by an unknown paranormal demon.

title: A True Western Romance
description: After a chance meeting with a notorious cowboy, a pretentious poet treks through the West in search of meaning.

title: Islands of Insight
description: Islands of Insight is an epic shared-world puzzle game where you play as a Seeker on a peaceful journey of exploration and discovery. Seek out and solve mysterious puzzles at your own pace across an awe-inspiring world of floating islands.

title: Royal Roads 3 Portal
description: A fascinating journey through the fabulous Kingdoms. Join forces of people and wizards, save the kingdoms!

title: Z-Stop
description: You are the last human, abandoned on a zombie infested island. There’s only one thing you must do, escape alive. Scavenge through what remains to acquire weapons and tools to help along the way. Outrun the horde, stay inside at night and discover what horrors led to the island’s downfall.

title: Dead by Daylight: Resident Evil - Project W
description:
Experience true evolution in Dead by Daylight: Resident Evil - Project W.

This Chapter features a new Killer – Albert Wesker, The Mastermind – and 2 new Survivors, Ada Wong and Rebecca Chambers. The Raccoon City Police Department Map has also been reworked.

title: Miho Adventures
description: Miho adventures is a platformer pixel game where you control Miho in an adventure across an island filled with monsters and enemies of all kinds.

title: Mud Way
description: Mud wants to live, but it has to face a race for survival through several Stages with different characteristics. Combining elements as diverse as adventure, maze, enemy swarm, platforming, run for life, roguelike, exploration, stealth and find the key to advance.

title: Dad's Coming
description: Meet Dad's Coming, a fast paced co-op game about cleaning up your mess before your parents come back home! Help Kate and Bob cooperate to get items across rooms and hazards to get rid of the mess in time! Careful not to break anything and be aware of Jack, a kitty that loves knocking things over!

title: 69 Natasha Hot
description: 69 Natasha Hot - is a game that contains elements of a novel and a memory puzzle. You meet a beautiful girl who is ready to show you around and tell you the secret of the local cuisine. Solve memory puzzles and get rewards you're sure to love.

title: Tommy Gun Carnage
description: A colorful twin-stick shooter with hordes of enemies, powerups, perks and diverse environments!

title: Oh Sheep!: Baaaa
description: Embark on the fantastic world of Oh Sheep!, a slapstick cartoon-style action game where you'll encounter crazy enemies. Sheep will be your salvation.

title: Prime Directive
description: Marty has crash landed on an alien world. He must escape, but can he survive? Guide him through interconnected environments and fight off hordes of alien creatures while you discover what happened to the abandoned human colony.

title: Metal Miners
description: Metal Miners is a chaotic, resource gathering, party game set in a cave full of rich resources. In this 2-4 player, split screen, action-driven game inspired by cult classic Kirby Air ride, players are tasked with crafting the glorious Golden Crown to please a greedy king!

title: DC Dual Force
description: A card game with PVP and PVE competitions based on superheroes and supervillains from the DC Universe.

title: Grand Unified Game
description: A puzzle/platform game by Andy Weir which puts Dig-Dug, Pac-Man, Mario, and the Jouster together against all their old foes. Try to get these 8-bit buddies to the exit of the level without any of them dying! There will be traps and puzzles and fights to deal with!

title: Swamp
description:
Are you ready to be thrown into an immersive high quality game full of hundreds of enemies who are just dying to munch upon your delectable brain? Take the fight to your enemy and employ dozens of weapons to fend off hordes of the undead.

A squad-based tactical shooter designed primarily for nonvisual play.

title: Price of Resurrection
description: An interactive story where you can kill people in your dreams

title: Nekomew's Nightmares
description: Face Nekomew's nightmares in this spooky rhythm game!

title: Trouble Town
description: Online game based on teamwork. Play with your friends and join one of the class groups to win. There are 4 classes available: Innocent, Traitor, Detective and Jester

title: Factory512
description: Help the first sentient robot in Factory512 escape and discover the greater world at large! Start your journey (Q), jump over the obstacles (Z), and throw the switches (X) to navigate your way through the factory, powering on at least two of the seven possible generators before feeling the open air on your metal skin for the first time in robo-history!

title: Meet Your Maker
description: Meet Your Maker is a post-apocalyptic first-person building-and-raiding game where every level is designed by players. Switch between roles as you mastermind devious maze-like Outposts filled with traps and guards, then gear up for methodical fast-paced combat raiding other players’ creations.

title: Fallout: London
description:
Fallout: London is an ambitious, trail-blazing DLC-sized mod for Fallout 4, Bethesda Game Studios’ 2015 post-apocalyptic RPG. Fallout: London stands apart from its contemporaries and offers an entirely new experience: setting a Fallout game outside of the United States. True to its moniker, Fallout: London takes place IN London. From stuffy parliamentary aristocrats to a resurrection of the Knights of the Round Table to an uncompromising cult of revolutionaries (and more!), Fallout: London embodies the history and aesthetics of London and puts an unmistakably nuclear spin on the beloved city.

Fallout: London’s development is labor-intensive and involves a plethora of eclectic cross-discipline individuals, both at amateur and industry level. The team maintains a strong sense of professionalism and devotion to the craft. Everyone on the Fallout: London team shares a deep love of videogames, and most importantly, Fallout itself. Each member of the Fallout: London team is individually recruited for their contributions and talent in the realms of game design and modding.

title: Another World Quest
description: The painting run group project derived card game "Another World Quest".It tells the story of a group of travellers to the other world and in the face of disaster.The game itself is similar to "Hearthstone" kind of card game, has a complete battle, collection, card draw function, etc..

title: Kriegsfront Battlescaper
description: Create mechs and battlefield dioramas using built-in photo mode, mecha builder, and level editor. Based on developer tools for our upcoming mecha turn-based tactics game, Kriegsfront Tactics.

title: Desktopia: A Desktop Village Simulator
description: Desktopia: A Desktop Village Simulator is a city-builder game which simulates an evolving, medieval-esque village along the bottom of your desktop, allowing you to work, watch, or browse something else while you play.

title: Futanari Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Complete Classic Jigsaw Puzzles featuring very raunchy depictions of Futanari. All puzzles are Ultra High Resolution and available in multiple sizes, up to 1000 pieces.

title: Rage Multiplayer
description: RAGE Multiplayer is an alternative multiplayer modification for Grand Theft Auto V that allows you to play, host and create your own custom built game modes on Grand Theft Auto V using C++, C# and JavaScript. With support for unlimited players number, RAGE Multiplayer offers you an unique, personalized and powerful experience that has never been seen before on GTA V.

title: Breakout 13
description: Breakout 13 is a FMV narrative adventure game with interactive cinematic experience. The story is about a group of misguided youths, who are sent to a correctional center and try to escape.

title: Mia and the Dragon Princess
description: A live-action, interactive action movie following Mia, a plucky barmaid whose life is thrown into chaos when a mysterious woman turns up at her workplace, on the run from a group of violent thugs and unable to speak English.

title: RedCat Spookkasteel
description: Grizella, the wicked witch, has captured WhizzKitty and only RedCat can save her! RedCat must search in and around the magical haunted castle. RedCat will have to face numerous enemies in five different worlds. In the forest, the castle, the caves, the graveyard, and the castle tower, Brutus and Max are also hiding and will try to thwart RedCat at the most unexpected times! Along the way, RedCat will encounter creepy and enchanted creatures such as giant spiders, red-nosed bats, poison frogs, and brightly colored ghosts!

title: Vault Circuit
description: Color matching puzzle with an shape placing twist. No timers, no rush. Try to complete 42 levels, but be careful, the mess you make in one level you take with you to the next.

title: Death Below
description: Death Below - is a third-person action adventure with elements of survival horror. The plot of the game is based on the legend of the Soviet experiment of the 1940s.You will plunge into a dark world, and begin an exciting investigation, fighting on your way with thousands of distraught people

title: Quick Tower Defence Ultimate
description: Unlock upgrades, talents and colours for your towers to defend against scores of enemies. Battle on over 50 maps of varying difficulty, plus make your own or download more from the workshop

title: Madcap Mosaic
description: Carefully craft your Mosaic in this fantasy themed deckbuilding game. Battle by battle, tile by tile, you'll form synergies and build up your Mosaic's combo potential, hoping to beat the curve as you forge deeper into enemy territory.

title: Card X Monster
description: Travel and collect powerful cards to build powerful decks and combinations! Explore and fight along mythical monsters on land, water and air, across different grassy fields and snowy mountains.

title: RedCat: Het Levende Kleurboek
description: In this game, children can draw and color on the computer. They can color in coloring pages that have a movie attached to them and they can make drawings complete with special patterns.

title: RedCat: Het Machtige Monumenten Mysterie
description: Brutus and Max have locked Big Ben, Tower Bridge, Piccadilly Circus, St Paul's Cathedral and Buckingham Palace so no one can get in or out. They want a lot of bones and cheese, otherwise things will stay locked. In a race through the subway, RedCat must beat Brutus and Max to eventually find the keys at the stations with which he can open the locks.

title: RedCat Superkarts
description: While RedCat and WhizzKitty are in the tree house playing with their racetrack, they receive a message. It comes from the six national champions of the European Kart Competition. They challenge everyone to a competition. Whoever wins all races gets the Golden Euroster, which no one has ever managed to do before. Of course they want to participate. However: Brutus and Max discover this and decide to join in, so that they can buy a lot of cheese and bones with the star. The four of them travel to Europe to take part in the race and compete for the star.

title: 12am
description: A non-traditional Yume Nikki fangame made by an anonymous developer. The main protagonist is Limbo.

title: Amiha's Nightmare Castle
description: Amiha's Nightmare Castle is a non-traditional fangame. Having no effects, the game focuses on solving small puzzles to get out of the nightmare castle by lighting/interacting with lanterns to the north, south, east, and west.

title: Bizzare
description: Bizzare is a Yume Nikki fangame. You wander around as a strange unnamed shadow character. According to the creator, there are many ways to go, but you can't go back. There are many ways to die in the game, with some of the deaths affecting the story.

title: Kingdom Hearts Final Mix
description: Originally released only in Japan on December 26, 2002, Kingdom Hearts Final Mix is finally brought to the global scene as an HD Remaster in the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 ReMIX". It has several events and a number of gameplay tweaks that are not in previous releases. New scenes, clarifying certain plot points, such as Riku's journey and foreshadowing of Kingdom Hearts II, were included, but no new dialogue was recorded. A gameplay option allows the player to skip cutscenes. The optional bosses are included, along with a new fight against "Unknown Man."

title: In Hazy Clouds
description:
In Hazy Clouds is an English Yume Nikki fangame developed for Dream Diary Jam 6.

This is a game of exploring the imagined world of Fairu(tsuki), an apprehensive room-dweller who is constantly grasping at a world from their past ..... what will you find?

title: Dream vs. Dream
description: Dream vs. Dream is a community-developed fighting game based off the characters and locations found in Yume Nikki and its various spin-offs and fangames.

title: Dream Hearts Dream
description: A fake dating sim version of the Yume Nikki fighting fangame Dream vs. Dream released on April Fools Day 2014.

title: Pounce Cat
description: Pounce your way to the top in this high-stakes precision platformer. Try to keep your cool and claw your way up, but be careful, a single fall could spell disaster. And remember, if you do fall... stay PAWsitive!

title: Elysium City
description: Elysium City is a Yume Nikki fangame. You play as a girl named Anne who is an inventor. In her backyard she managed to invent a machine that allows her to teleport to a different land. The place she arrives to is a city where none of the buildings lead you to different worlds. Unlike traditional fangames, Elysium City has dialogue and detailed characters.

title: Gocco
description:
Gocco is a Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Sanagi, a child living with her mother.
Aside from 13 effects to collect, you also can obtain a large variety of items and achievements.

title: Hell Diary
description: Hell Diary is a Yume Nikki fangame, following the adventures of Eun through the dream-world equivalent of Hell. There are no "effects" in Hell Diary, instead there are certain items that have various uses, as well as other characters that may join you along the way, companions have their own items to help you explore such as a Multitool.

title: Mewn
description: Mewn is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. The game uses an item-collection system like that of Yume Nikki, but the game's effect equivalent, Components, are unusable. To compensate, the player is given various tools to aid the collections of these items. The goal of the game is to collect all Components. The protagonist is *. *, a spaceman from the moon who has crashed on Earth. Their spaceship is beyond repair, requiring them to find replacement parts throughout the planet.

title: Moonlit Lobby
description: Moonlit Lobby is a Yume Nikki fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. You play as a cat named Harley who's fleeing from the rain and maybe more. Tell stories to earn your stay for the night!

title: Safety
description: You start off as Doro, who goes to explore a cave with his girlfriend Femme. A bit later you switch to a nameless girl commonly referred to as "Minotaur", possibly because she has horns. Minotaur is trapped in a cave and obtains an axe at the beginning of her journey, just like Doro. Your goal is to escape the cave you're stuck in.

title: Pongpongpongpongpongpongpongpong
description: It’s like pong, but with more pong.

title: The Door of thoughts
description: The Door of thoughts is a Yume Nikki fangame. You play as a child named Michi, who is stuck in their room as they cannot find a door to leave through. The game features bits of dialogue when you interact with specific objects, for example, the effect-giving NPCs/objects.

title: XV
description:
XV is an English Yume Nikki fangame developed for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam.
You play as Dante, a detective collecting evidence to solve a case. The main goal of the game is to figure out the killer's identity by talking to the NPC's in the dream world as well as using your effects.

title: Momo's Diary
description: Momo is a supercute doll with a lot of friends who love her dearly...watch as she sinks through the depths of hell!

title: NHRA Championship Drag Racing: Speed for All
description: NHRA is back – bigger and better than ever! Immerse yourself into the teams, tracks, tuning, and strategies, then strap into the driver’s seat in your ultimate quest to become the Champion among the true Beasts of the Strip. Key Game Features: • 5 NHRA…

title: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl: Hugh Neutron
description:
