Hugh Neutron joins Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl! Jimmy Neutron’s goofy dad and his signature style makes its way to the brawl with duck-themed moves and other crazy abilities!

This pack features:
· Playable brawler Hugh Neutron
· Alternate Hugh costume
· Duck, Duck, Pie! Stage

title: RockSlide
description: A simple game about run away from rocks and others dangers, How long do you survive?

title: Animal Trail Girlish Square
description: Magical girl idols are here! Get ready for the performance of a life time from the idol group Animal Trail ☆ Girlish Square! Gao~!

title: Sex Adventures: Swingers Gym
description: A visual novel about a hot couple trying a private gym. Everything takes a turn when a daring blonde starts hitting on the girlfriend.

title: Southern Princesses
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Natsumi & Fuyuko: All That's Inbetween
description: Natsumi and Fuyuko

title: One's Lonesome, Two's Company
description: When one loner meets another loner.

title: Love Goes Toward Love
description: Coffee and love. Both can be pretty bitter.

title: My Dream is to Be a Model, Not a Maid!
description: What happens when you spill coffee all over a rich girl?

title: Crash & Bump
description: Crash & Bump is an online multiplayer shooter... mixed with obstacle courses! Eliminate your opponents while dodging the obstacles and take advantage of the power-ups to get the victory.

title: Flippin Misfits
description: Meet the Flippin Misfits. Their arena? A tricked-out, stolen starship. Their gravity-swapping backpacks? Also stolen. Allegedly. Their game? An absolutely bonkers 360° melee brawler, where 2-4 players can throw down, every surface is in play, and up becomes down with the push of a button.

title: Beach Island Deluxe
description: Beach Island is a micro open-world platforming game set on the mysterious Beach Island. Scour the island for stars to open up the ancient gateway portal! There's plenty to explore and uncover on Beach Island, can you find all 12 stars?

title: PictoPull
description:
Solve 3D block puzzles built from pixel art.

Pull, push, and climb on the blocks of a PictoPull puzzle in order to reach the goal. Puzzles are simple to learn but complex to master, as puzzles get bigger, more complex, and new special tiles and mechanics are added onto them. Once you have mastered all of the 150+ PictoPull levels try creating your own in the fully featured level editor and share them via the Steam Workshop.

title: Mysterious School
description: "Mysterious School" is a horror game that supports multi player online and single player. Why do girls often cry on campus at midnight? What happened to the once famous No.1 middle school? Take your partner, find out the truth that the young girl has become a zombie, and help the girl reincarnate.

title: Chill Town
description: A sequel of Chill Corner - a combination of relaxing simulation and idle game. Listening to beautiful music while decorating the room, fishing, cooking or even keeping it in background while doing your real life activities.

title: Angry Cat
description:
Put yourself in the paws of the world’s cheekiest feline and turn Granny's peaceful home into your own chaotic playground! In Angry Cat, you’ll sneak, scratch, and smash your way through a fully interactive 3D house filled with secrets, surprises, and, most importantly, breakable items.

Cause mischief everywhere: knock over vases, scratch furniture, steal snacks, and outsmart Granny before she catches you. Each prank earns you laughs, chaos points, and hilarious reactions from your not-so-patient human.

Customize your cat with different skins and outfits. Unlock new rooms and discover hidden shortcuts as you claw your way from the living room to the attic and beyond! With smooth first-person controls and funny animations, every level is a new chance to sharpen your claws and stir up trouble, all while Granny is hot on your tail.

Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate prankster cat? Get ready to break the rules, dodge Granny’s wrath, and cause the funniest mayhem ever!

title: Furnish Master
description: Furnish Master is a relaxing game about furnishing apartments, houses, commercial estate and even outdoor territory! Realize your design dreams! Add to Wishlist now!

title: Wood & Weather
description: Wood & Weather is a silly god-game game about pizza- but we've just been told the developers have pivoted the game to be about climate change instead.

title: Rustled Pete
description: Rustled Pete is an arcade boss fighting platformer where you play as a chicken that is fighting for it's life against the very rustled and angry Pete. Unlock Pete's other forms to challenge yourself and also put him in his place!

title: Summer Trip Cruise
description: Hey you, we need a captain! Drive the cruise ship with the on-screen rudder, avoid obstacles, take pictures and enjoy the ride. Take it easy... or take the challenge!

title: Blue Fish Yokohama
description: Blue Fish Yokohama is a relaxing tile-based puzzle game. You are a fish that eats miso ramen, cheese ramen and tantanmen by jumping, bumping, bouncing and splashing through a Japanese restaurant. Solve 50 handcrafted levels with unique game mechanics.

title: Neutrino
description: Neutrino, The Mission - a minimalist game where a photon seeks the core of Neutrinos Kingdom, find out why they have mass and destroy them!

title: The Edge of The World Z Will Shock You
Girl and Demon 1
description: Experience a hardcore dungeon crawling RPG. Satisfy the craving for high numbers and complex status effects. Focus on combat and variety of fighting styles.

title: Gigant
description: Gigant is a horror point and click adventure game. You must escape from the terror of the unknown creature 'Gigant' and the conflict that revolves around it. Use your reflexes to dodge the creature's attack. Combine and use tools to overcome the given challenges.

title: Deck of Life
description: No turns, individual card permadeath. Construct defenses while launching projectiles to destroy your opponent's cards. Beat enemies and events to win cards from unique card pools. If all your cards are destroyed, you die.

title: Easy Simple Game
description: Meet the Unsuspicious dude, take a job from him and walk through deadly spikes, slimes and spinning blades. Sounds pretty simple, isn't it?

title: Formula 2D: Steer To Persevere
description: Formula 2D - Steer To Perseveer is a top of the line Formula Racing game where mild similiraties to F1 are entirely coincidental - Create and customize your team - Upgrade your facilities to upgrade the car ️ - Become the world champion and climb the rankings

title: HexTD
description: HexTD is a tower defense game where players can choose from 3 classes to defend their base. Deploy your machines, soldiers or elementals to create the enemies path and guard against powerful bosses, playing solo or with a friend to create a new experience in tower defense genre.

title: City Legends: Trapped In Mirror - Collector's Edition
description: On your way to writing the perfect supernatural novel, be prepared to face danger. Are you ready for such desperate measures?

title: Umbral Omen
description: Umbral Omen is a mystical puzzle game that generates a unique problem to decipher every time you play! Read the clues carefully in order to place the correct runes in the right spots and unravel the riddle of the Umbral Omen!

title: Isla Sinaloa
description: Isla Sinaloa is a relaxing game full of activities to enjoy on a peaceful island in a universe full of friendly animals

title: Galaxy Survivors
description: Shoot alien invaders, upgrade your ship, level up your weapons and save planets to defend against the invasion. Choose your favorite between the different unlockable ships and buy perks between your runs to ensure victory. After you triumph, hunt for achievements and ascend to save more universes

title: The Empress Quest: Full Moons Saga
description: Help Kobi the Dog to solve the secrets of his new house, find the Empress and return to his beloved Master with the help of mysterious Moon Mother. Immerse yourself in this whimsical adventure game with hand-painted backgrounds, quirky characters, light-hearted story and amazing music!

title: Arcade Waifu
description: A relaxing puzzle game with girls who love games.

title: Tank Top Tactics
description: 1 vs 1 tactical turn-based battle game with tanks

title: Table Ball
description: Table Ball by Lockyz Dev is the ultimate virtual arcade game! Compete against friends or the computer in exciting matches of top-down Ping Pong. This game is perfect for players of all skill levels. Start playing today and see if you have what it takes to come out on top!

title: NSMB: Mario vs. Luigi Online
description:
A Unity-standalone 2-10 player remake of the Mario vs. Luigi gamemode from the New Super Mario Bros. DS download game.

Includes the 5 default levels (Grassland, Bricks, Castle, Pipes, and Ice), along with a handful of custom levels to battle on! All power-ups are included and remain faithful to their original counterparts, along with the new addition of the Propeller Suit, Ice Flower, and Hammer Suit!

title: Neko Puzzle
description: Leap around randomly generated puzzles collecting blocks in the right order.

title: The Classrooms
description: The Classrooms is a procedural, liminal-space, found-footage, survival horror game. Explore The Classrooms and discover the various anomalies it contains; from malicious entities, to harmless oddities. And remember, it's different every time you play, so your found footage is uniquely yours.

title: Those Left Behind
description: A 3rd person action-horror zombie game with elements of survival, time management and base management.

title: Stones Keeper: King Aurelius
description:
Stones Keeper uses a turn-based combat system, which lets you use environmental objects as protection against your enemies. As well as the ability to break some of the environmental objects down to move faster, which, in turn, opens up a lot of strategic possibilities.

You can customize your squad by recruiting new companions with multiple specializations, skills and weapon preferences. Missions and battles will be just as diverse: Command your warriors to besiege enemy settlements or defend yours, protect your order's churches, escort civilian wagons, lay siege to enemy castles, aid your allies, and capture new technologies to upgrade your castle.

title: Lethal Omen
description:
Based off Gemini Home Entertainment's video of the same name, Lethal Omen takes you further into the mysteries of The universe of Gemini Home Entertainment.

You are an unnamed protagonist, armed with nothing but a gun, inside the Moonlight Acres Family Camp.

title: Goat Simulator 3: Goat in a Box Edition
description:
Goat Simulator 3 is a brand new third-person sandbox adventure game in which you get to become the literal goat. Just like the first Goat Simulator, you'll need to headbutt, lick and triple-jump your way across the giant island of San Angora - this time with all new areas, challenges, and events to discover.

The Goat in a Box Edition includes:
- Gustom Goat Box.
- Goat Plushy.
- Steelbook.
- Game & Soundtrack Discs.
- Double Sided Poster.
- 3 Postcards.
- Pre-Udder Gear.
- 10 Remastered Skins and Gear from Goat Simulator, MMO Simulator, GoatZ, Waste of - Space and PayDay.
- OG 2014 Pilgor.
- Digital Soundtrack.
- 3D Printing Files (Only For PC).

title: Advent Calendar
description: A cozy idle advent calendar game — unlock new items each day and decorate your little Christmas room at your own pace.

title: Shatterline
description: Shatterline is an arena FPS with a roguelike co-op mode (Expedition) as well as several traditional PvP modes such as TDM, Conquest, Plant-the-Bomb, and Escort. Players can choose Operatives and an armory of weapons that can be customized via attachments. Set in the near future, where humanity faces a threat of cosmic proportions. Players take on the roles of the Immunes – bearers of an extremely rare genetic combination that allows their bodies to resist the alien plague.

title: Omega Strikers
description: Smash opponents off the arena and score goals in this lightning-fast 3v3 free-to-play game. Squad up with friends and choose from a growing cast of colorful Strikers to sling slimes, toss tofu, and rocket boost to victory.

title: Freight Hopper
description: A fast paced platformer where you jump from train to train!

title: Faithful Backrooms
description: The mod that extends the regular Minecraft experience, adding in over 20 Backrooms levels to the game, coupled with progression, advancements, and lots of entities and terrifying environments to discover.

title: Neave 2
description: Explore the world of Neave 2 as you hunt for magical floating cubes. If you're feeling competitive, race for the fastest time to claim a top spot on the leaderboard.

title: Elf Girl Pinball
description: More than just a "very happy" pinball game~!

title: Warp Lab
description: Experience seamless portal gameplay mechanics in VR. Warp Lab allows you to take full advantage of immersive player-controlled portals across a diverse array of puzzle, combat, and sandbox levels.

title: World of Talesworth: Idle MMO Simulator
description: Explore new lands, slay monsters, gather loot and level up in this idle MMO simulation experience. Packed with unique and meaningful upgrades, moments of discovery, and gaming nostalgia, World of Talesworth is an homage to all our favorite RPGs.

title: 4 The Elements
description: 4 The Elements is a 2D Action Platformer inspired by the best games of this genre from the 90s. Switch in real time between the four elements of nature to overcome challenges, acquire new abilities and defeat powerful bosses in beautifully crafted thematic stages.

title: 1001 Jigsaw: Legends of Mystery 6
description: Otherworldly forces exist. You can make sure of this by putting together the puzzle pieces from the new game Legends of Mystery 6.

title: Aimx
description: Free, easy to use & efficient aim trainer. Improve faster!

title: Ambulance Chauffeur Simulator
description: You have a green light from the police, because you have to break any traffic rule to do your job well. The more lives saved, the cleaner your karma will be. Always be prepared because the call can come at any time!

title: Arc Intelligence
description: Arc Intelligence is an adventure strategy game for the PC about an artificial intelligence that tries to take over the world. What would you do if your mind was inside a computer? Do you have what it takes to become the arch intelligence in this arced adventure?

title: Bad Chicken
description: Bad Chicken is a retro styled sideway scrolling shoot-em-up inspired by the retro classics. It takes place in 8 locations in the Ferrus system, each one with different challenges, and dangers.

title: Bind
description: BIND is a slow-paced metaphysical puzzle journey set in the liminal realm between death and rebirth.

title: Cache Overload
description: Cache Overload is a fast-paced multi-player FPS taking place in Earth, 2041, as robots. Battle with your friends or other robots on the globe inside various maps and game modes.

title: DinoLife
description:
DinoLife is a Dinosaur farming game with Life-Sim elements.

You are able to create, hatch and look after many Dinosaurs, while making money to expand, buy upgrades or gifts for the residents so you can become friends.

Or you may just want to save and keep personalising your room and house with items you collect while playing.

title: Echo: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The deluxe edition of Echo on steam that includes the game and all 30 DLC packs.

The items in these DLC packs are mostly available in game normally at various drop rates or exclusive booster items for character experience and weapon proficiency.

title: Rogue Blight
description: Rogue Blight is a rogue-lite with focus on souls-like combat, featuring a Slay The Spire-inspired map system. Fight your way through ever-changing maps. Customize your playstyle based on what you find. Death is punishing. Only skill and persistence will carry you forward.

title: Valete vos viatores

What do you mean that Shihon-chan might die?
Eeh? Shihon-chan's head has gone missing?"

A murder isn't unusual, after all, there's at least one bloodthirsty killer at school.
Murdering people is fine and all but it's considered a taboo that must be never violated to decapitate and hide their head because one can never be revived if so.
If her head isn't found within two days, she'll really kick the bucket!

A boarding system school isolated from the outside world, and there do the immortal girls live.
The time it takes for them to become an adult is the same time it takes for them to deage and become a baby, they grow up until they become an adult once more and then do they deage again⁠—a cycle that's being repeated.

There's only one condition in order to graduate from school: one needed to be deemed a prodigy by someone observing from the outside. The moment that verdict be handed down, the girl's graduation would be recognized and she would disappear from school.

The immortal girls' peaceful school life would be greatly disturbed by a certain murder case.

Just as Sonic is about to claim the gem, Eggman overtakes him, violently knocks him aside, and claims the Emerald for himself. Sonic spends some time unconscious, and dreams of Eggman attacking and capturing his best friend, Miles "Tails" Prower. Sonic wakes up at his and Tails' home, and walks outside to find Tails making some adjustments to the Tornado before setting out on a casual flight. Sonic attempts to follow Tails, only to be confronted by Eggman, who promptly knocks Sonic off a nearby cliff. Sonic and Tails are quickly caught up in a deadly game of cat-and-mouse against Eggman and his many contraptions, fighting for their very lives.

title: Coerced Cage
description: Inspired by the pandemic lockdown, our main character goes through a period of isolation. Depending on player's choices, his mental state will result in 3 unique endings. Whether he escape his own house, or stay in for good... it is all up to you.

title: Crabada
description: Crabada is an idle game available on most native platforms. Earn in-game rewards in exciting, idle gameplay as you send your Crabada NFTs to Battle for riches and glory!

title: King's Quest Collector's Edition
description:
A collection containing the first six games in the King's Quest series which was released to celebrate the 15th anniversary of Sierra On-Line (originally founded as On-Line Systems). This collection was released alongside other well-known series from Sierra On-Line (specifically the "Space Quest" and "Leisure Suit Larry" series of games).

In addition to the first six games in the series, the collection includes the 1990 remake of the first King's Quest game, the French disk version of King's Quest V, the German disk version of King's Quest VI, a game called "King Graham's Board Game Challenge" (where you can play either Backgammon or Checkers against King Graham), archives of information on the King's Quest series, a trivia game with questions about the King's Quest series, and videos including clips of interviews with Ken and Roberta Williams and a preview of "King's Quest VII: The Princeless Bride".

title: Into the Sinkhole
description: “Into the Sinkhole” is a descending 3D platformer. With the help of explore-bot ‘Laika’, you will uncover hidden secrets that lie deep within the Sinkhole. As you traverse deeper into the Sinkhole, you will face springboard platforms that will try to push you back up.

title: Kawaii Hentai Girls 3
description: It's a relaxing anime puzzle with cute kawaii girls. Solve puzzles, and enjoy high-quality artwork.

title: Berserker: A Viking Board Game
description: A strategic and tactical board game for two players that has a timeless appeal and can be played over and over again in different variations.

title: TrainFormation
description: TrainFormation is a simple, fast-paced puzzle game created by one student as a university project. Place rails in front of an ever-accelerating train to cross procedurally generated levels, reach stations, collect power ups and make it as far as you can!

title: Reddoor
description: Survive endless waves of attacking zombie, earning points from killing.

title: Tina & Rook! Cookie Quest!
description: Two idiots are hungry for cookies after playing some games! and for some screw-up reason, you have to go through a whole puzzle to get that. Will these 2 idiots get to eat their cookies and enjoy their afternoon?

title: S.E.C.U.
description: S.E.C.U. is a Roguelite FPS Game. descend to the hellish and demon infested lands in Rougelite Mode or Survive against waves of demons in Arenas

title: Get into Backrooms
description: This is a back room theme leisure games, Enter the back room, avoid the entity, find the exit, and find the truth. There are cakes, milk tea and party balloons =) There's nothing here. Don't believe it=( Join us =) Run away=(

title: Sono Higurashi vs. Touhou Universe 2
description: 90's-style 2D fighting action in which real-life men fight in cosplay. A major update version of the second series.

title: Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle Tamagotori: Snow Miku 2022
description: The new stages have SNOW MIKU themed eggs, birds, and berries! The birds in the puzzles are SNOW MIKU themed as well. Collect exclusive berries to find SNOW MIKU design birds and birds with special items!

title: Obunga
description: You're trapped in a giant maze. There's only one way out, but it's locked. Find all six keys to unlock the exit door and escape before Obunga catches you.

title: Vex 3
description: Vex 3 is a challenging platform adventure game. Make your way from one platform to the other and avoid deadly obstacles such as buzzsaws, spikes, crumbling blocks, and more! Run and jump to reach the flags. These are the checkpoints.

title: Space for Sale
description: Space for Sale follows the journey of an intergalactic property developer on a mission to build habitats for eccentric alien clients. Discover the wonders scattered throughout the new solar system you bought on the cheap, build estates and sell them for a sweet profit!

title: Tempest Rising
description:
Tempest Rising seamlessly merges the classic action of real-time strategy (RTS) games from the ‘90s and 2000s with modern production and performance standards. Encounter a battle-scarred 1997 in an alternate timeline where the Cuban Missile Crisis went nuclear. In the fallout from the war, a strange red electrical vine known as Tempest started spreading across the planet and changed the course of history.

Tempest Rising gives players full command as they build up their bases, lead armies into battle, and execute bold strategies to emerge victorious. Experience the story of two different factions across two campaigns with deep and rewarding gameplay that keeps the focus on strategy and skill, with built-in customization options that let players approach the game their own way in both single-player and multiplayer.

title: Wreckreation
description: Wreckreation hands you the keys to your very own driving and building open world called MixWorld! Explore 400 square kilometers of pure sandbox joy as you create, race and wreck alone or together with your friends.

title: Neon Dungeon
description: This is a neon style and fast-paced platform jumping game. In the game, you need to avoid many obstacles and finally reach the star of victory.

title: Microbes and Machines
description: Microbes and Machines is a rogue-like action game where you control a little bubble robot that fights against the forces of evil.

title: Lost Lands: Sand Captivity
description: An artifact found on Earth interferes with Susan's life and forces her to return to adventures. “Lost Lands: Sand Captivity” is an adventure game in the genre of Hidden Objects, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters and complicated quests.

title: Long Live the King!
description: Long Live the King is a story-driven RPG, where the player's choices will impact the story in major ways. Players must make decisions, pay close attention to character dialogue and actions, and decide who they can trust. Will you stand with your countrymen or your kin? The decision is yours.

title: A Simple Request
description: This place is full of mysteries, weirdness and inexplicable things. You come to the suburbs to a motel, you don't know yet that your friendly neighbors are not at all what they want to seem. Can you save yourself and keep your sanity?

title: Captroon
description: Captroon is an arcade game about facing waves of insectons, with a weapon and a shield that can be activated when available.

title: Road to Newtopia
description: Road to Newtopia is a fan made game based on the cartoon Amphibia and inspired by several classic games such as The Oregon Trail, Earthbound, Kirby, and others.

title: Touhou Kisouken: Infinite Blade Pavilion
description: Touhou Project fangame developed by Len. Gameplay revolves around a combination of factors: a "Skill Tree" similar to that of Mystical Power Plant that increases by collecting leaf items, special attacks that can be used by consuming Skill Tree levels, and a "tension gauge" that increases or decreases the amount of items dropped by enemies.

title: Undertale: Bits and Pieces
description: Undertale: Bits and Pieces is a mod of Undertale featuring completely overhauled graphics, new areas, new enemies and remixed music, as well as backporting content from its successor Deltarune

title: Space Quest: Collector's Edition
description:
A collection containing the first five games in the Space Quest series which was released to celebrate the 15th anniversary of Sierra On-Line (originally founded as On-Line Systems). This collection was released alongside other well-known series from Sierra On-Line (specifically the "King's Quest" and "Leisure Suit Larry" series of games).

In addition to the first five games in the series, the collection includes the 1991 remake of the first Space Quest game, the French and German versions of Space Quest V, an arcade game collection called "Roger Wilco's Spaced Out Game Pack", information on the Space Quest series, and some videos (including a spoof journalistic piece where the "reporter" interviews various people at Sierra On-Line), and a secret bonus program about the World Famous Talking Bear.

title: Sanguine Rose
description: Sanguine Rose is an erotic visual novel set in a gritty fantasy world. Follow a team of mercenaries as they find themselves trapped during a mission gone awry. Intrigue and debauchery await as a devious plot is set into motion!

title: Soccer Story
description:
It's been a year since The Calamity tore apart the very foundations of soccer as we know it, and since then, Soccer Inc. has made dang well sure that not a soul has been allowed to even look at a soccer ball, let alone kick it.

Soccer may have been banned across the world... but now there is hope! A magical soccer ball has chosen you, our Savior of Soccer! Soccer Story is a physics-driven adventure RPG, where every problem can be solved with your trusty magic ball.

title: Super VHS
description: Explore Milwaukee's most famous bad movie warehouse! Collect over 50 VHS tapes, spin the Wheel of the Worst, and play Plinketto!

title: Atuel
description:
A surrealist documentary game in which you explore beautiful, dreamlike landscapes inspired by the topography and wildlife of the Atuel River Valley in Argentina.

Perspective is fluid and interconnected as you shapeshift to become different animals and elements that form part of Atuel’s ecosystem.

Real-life interviews about the past, present, and future of the Atuel weave together to form a historic narrative about the intimate relationship between the land and its inhabitants.

title: King Arthur's Magic Castle
description: A children's activity game set in the world of King Arthur.

title: Biomorph
description:
Become Your Enemy in Biomorph, a 2D Dark Metroidvania!

When you defeat a monster, the BIOMORPH mechanic allows you to take its shape and power. But beware - biomorphing has a cost as these creatures will now unlock new skills and will use them on the player upon encountering them again!

title: Ctrl/Esc
description: Ctrl/Esc is a Survival Horror Game, where you are a technician, fixing stuff in a school, while exploring all the rooms and discovering some strange information.

title: Sniper Elite 4 - Target: Führer
description: Hidden in a forgotten corner of the Mediterranean, a secret Nazi U-boat facility threatens Allied shipping. When agent Karl Fairburne attempts to assassinate the base’s Commander, he finds his target already dead, executed in person by a shadowy visitor. Karl’s mission has changed: Target Führer! Destroy the U-boat base and take down Hitler in as many ways as you can in this replayable campaign mission for 1-2 players.

title: Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle Tamagotori: Kagamine Rin / Len Happy 14th Birthday
description:
The new stages have "Kagamine Rin / Len Happy 14th Birthday" themed eggs, birds, and berries!

Collect exclusive berries in new stages to find special birds and birds with limited items!
Exclusive egg designs and special events for this stage...!?

title: Don't Fraud My Heart!
description: Don't Fraud my Heart is a visual novel made entirely in Microsoft Powerpoint. It is a romantic, financially literate adventure that brings you into the exciting world of tax auditing.

title: Endometric Void
description: A sci-fi shooting game, with dashing and 'freezing time' to freeze enemies in place. There is simple hip-firing for each weapon. Lastly, it's a free-to-play game. Whoever wants to play it can play it :)

title: The Alchemist Shop: An Apprentice's Life
description: Help Faih to deliver well brewed potions to your customers in the best of the alchemist shops! Dive into an innovative experience that mixes Visual Novel and Solitaire. Make your choices, manage your cards and try to impress your master. Are you up to the task?

title: Christmas Shooter
description: it's a 2d game focused on Christmas where it's snowing and you have to shoot candy at people, the game should be fun and have nice music. Your end is a goal where you have to get all the way to the end and you have two endings which are secret and normal

title: Bounce your Bullets!
description: Your bullets get stronger and stronger after they bounce enough times. Bounce your Bullets! is a casual top down shooter where you survive for as long as possible against growing waves of enemies.

title: The Vaults of Minos
description: The Vaults of Minos is a fluid arcade Jump 'n Run with a gripping story and randomized levels. Every attempt to defeat your enemies will contain new traps, bosses, and challenges. Can you defeat your opponent and leave the cursed Vaults of Minos alive?

title: Krzyżacy: The Knights of the Cross
description: Krzyżacy: The Knights of the Cross, a deck strategy game, is the fantastic adventure story of against with Teutonic Knights on the run across Europe at the dawn of Medieval period, which also includes diverse decks, random plots, ups and downs story.

title: 1387: MMO Strategy
description: 1387 is a text based free-to-play MMO strategy game that is inspired by 2010's social media games. Manage your resources, train your army and found alliances or attack to other players.

title: Kolhii Champions AU
description: On the great island of Mata Nui, the matoran compete for honor and glory in the great sport of Kolhii! With the copper masks up for grabs, all bets are off in this highly competetive arena. This is where champions are made!

title: Temple of Starlight
description: Temple of Starlight is an abstract first-person puzzle game with a unique striking retro visual style. Use colored lights to clear obstacles and explore an ancient temple along with its forgotten history.

title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Beach Season 2
description: Jigsaw Puzzle: Beach Season 2 is a fun puzzle game with 500 photos, each an idea of how to have a fantastic time this summer

title: Mystery Solitaire: Dreamcatcher 2
description: Play solitaire and explore the secrets of the world of dreams! Master the art of solitaire!

title: Griddy
description: Relax, clear your mind and fill it)

title: Solitude Underwater
description: Solitude Underwater is a short horror adventure game. Two treasure-hunting brothers are searching for sunken riches off the coast of South Africa, only to find themselves immersed in catastrophe after one of them gets trapped in a cage, deep inside shark-infested waters.

title: Unstable Rock
description: The stone predicting the weather is out of order, now it not only predicts, but also changes the weather by controlling the direction of the wind, collects the remnants of its tiny fragments in order to gather into a large boulder and roll off into the horizon!

title: Fantasy Climber: Fun Adventure
description: Fantasy Climber - is a classic platformer with modern design, honed game mechanics and retro aestetics. Each peak prepares new surprises and increases the difficulty of climbing!

title: Crossroads of Life
description: Crossroads of Life - a game in which you have to fight off waves of enemies while protecting your life.

title: Colorider
description: Colorider is a 2D shooter with a top view whose task is to clear all the rooms from enemies and move to a new room, which in turn will bring you closer to the final of the game.

title: WordSearch Story: Chapter 1
description: Reveal a hidden story in between the words as you solve each WordSearch. 30 puzzles included.

title: OMSI 2: Citybus S31X
description: They are considered a very successful bus series, the S31X city buses.

title: The Curse of Silent Marshes
description: You must save your friends from a vengeful voodoo spirit dressed as a circus clown. Move quickly and use your resources wisely in The Curse of Silent Marshes, a hair-raising hidden object adventure that will have you wondering at first who's on your side.

title: Arcade Paradise: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: Welcome to Arcade Paradise, the 90’s-fuelled retro arcade adventure. You play as Ashley, and you’ve just been given the keys to the family laundromat. Rather than washing rags for a living, you decide to turn the laundromat into the ultimate arcade. Choose from over 35 games to be in the arcade inspired by three decades of gaming – all of which are playable with high scores to set. Stay one step ahead of your father, manage and invest profits, and build your very own Arcade Paradise!

title: Soul Hackers 2: Digital Premium Edition
description:
The Soul Hackers 2 - Digital Premium Edition includes:
- Soul Hackers 2
- Bonus Story Arc: The Lost Numbers
- Booster Item Pack
- Bonus Demon Pack
- Costume & BGM Pack
- Pre-Order Bonus - Persona 5 Phantom Thieves outfits
- Mary's Maid Frock outfit
- Ai-ho Demon

title: Pitch Black: A Dusklight Story
description: This is the first installment of a six episode saga, and featuring around one hour of gameplay with features for replay-ability.

title: T3D: Genesis
description: The best 3D puzzle game where you will maneuver a shaped combination of blocks falling from the sky to match other blocks and clear the layers.

title: That Golf Game
description: A light-hearted golf game with a focus on fun! Take your time and just play the shots - in tournaments, stroke play, match play, and more... Or drive your cart from shot to shot, cruising along at your own pace, or racing against the clock!

title: No Longer Home: Friary Road
description: Bo and Ao are the last ones left after a barbecue and find themselves stargazing.

title: Hex Picross
description: A picross game on a hex grid with a beautiful minimal design and a sound environment prepared exclusively. Click to color the hexagonal cells so that all columns and diagonals are zero.

title: Hyper P.T.
description: This is a recreation of P.T. done in the HyperCard software. Some stuff is stripped back, some stuff is added; you'll just have to play to find out.

title: Ribbit
description: Ribbit is a massive variety mod based on Deltarune Chapter 1, that tells an entirely new story about frogs, ghosts, and the strange powers that surround them both. Half a joke mod, half a character-driven mystery narrative, it is an experiment in seeing just how far Deltarune modding could be taken during the 2019-2021 period, retaining Deltarune's familiar locations, while inserting new custom scenes and gameplay mechanics into them.

title: Chinatris
description: Chinatris is a Tetris-like game about Chinese characters where you combine different Chinese character components to create new ones. To clear each stage, you must create the target characters. While playing you will meet many new and surprising characters that will give you a different look of Chinese culture.

title: Sanatorium: A Mental Asylum Simulator
description: Set in a fictionalized version of the 1920s where the lines between modern psychiatric treatment and pseudoscience are still muddy at best. Sanatorium is a 2D card-based workplace adventure where the player has to test, diagnose and treat patients. At its core, Sanatorium is a comment on the turbulent history of the practices and pseudoscience used to stigmatize mental illnesses.

title: Home From Work 2
description: You arrive home from work after a long and late night working at the office. Upon arriving home you begin to experience paranormal occurrences. You soon discover that you are not alone in your own home. You begin investigating but in doing so, you aggravate the demonic presence in your home. Discover what a demonic presence is capable of doing in Home from work 2

title: Home From Work 3
description: You arrive home after a long day at work to your new modern day home. You spent a few days at the home and everything seemed to be normal; but, today, you begin to discover paranormal occurrences. Walking, talking, strange noises and even moving furniture begin to happen more frequently. It is now time to see what evil spirit lurks in the third home in Home from work 3.

title: MoonPong: Tales of Epic Lunacy
description: A psychedelic Roguelite Pong'em up where you go to rescue the Moon.

title: The Savage Hypnotist's Puppets
description: The girls are deprived of their freedom by hypnosis and their hearts are about to be shattered. Is it possible to escape from this daily life that has turned into hell?

title: Chronicles of Refugia
description: In the aftermath of catastrophic global warming, humans live in conflict with their new, not-so-human neighbors... and three "Alices" must fight against humanity to ensure the survival of their race.

title: Zoo Chess
description: Game based on chess where each piece on the board has its unique ability. You can play against the A.I or with your friends online

title: Zombies TD
description: A tower defense game mixed with a little luck. A horde of angry zombies is approaching, bombs have been placed but they will only explode in ten minutes, until then you need to defend the objective with what you have and what you have.

title: Trainz Plus: QR National GE C44aci
description: The C44aci is a model of Australian heavy duty diesel electric locomotive designed by UGL Rail and built at the Broadmeadow factory. It is operated by a number of rail freight operators, including these versions by Queensland Rail National (QRN). This pack features the 5000 and 6000 class QRN locos.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2022: QR National GE C44aci
description: The C44aci is a model of Australian heavy duty diesel electric locomotive designed by UGL Rail and built at the Broadmeadow factory. It is operated by a number of rail freight operators, including these versions by Queensland Rail National (QRN). This pack features the 5000 and 6000 class QRN locos.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: QR National GE C44aci
description: The C44aci is a model of Australian heavy duty diesel electric locomotive designed by UGL Rail and built at the Broadmeadow factory. It is operated by a number of rail freight operators, including these versions by Queensland Rail National (QRN). This pack features the 5000 and 6000 class QRN locos.

title: Top Dog
description: Dogfight your way through short, intense and randomized runs. Hard but easy to pickup, with daily leaderboards and minimum hardware requirements

title: Tribe Explorer
description: TribeExplorer Is an Retro style 2D Platformer. Play as the Tribe Explorer and try to beat all the different levels littered with sweet platforming, enemies, gravity puzzles and more!

title: Unreal Vendetta
description: You are a successful thief who periodically makes forays into various dungeons in search of treasures and wealth! Every outing you play with death, because the dungeons are full of traps and monsters that are ready to destroy you!

title: Utter Inverse
description: Something wicked enters our Dynast's high demesne. UTTER INVERSE - an RPG about the meeting of two points. Salt on your tongue : as the night sky crackles : the SWORD hums in your hands.

title: Wayward Shadows
description: Wayward Shadows is a rogue-lite monster hunting RPG with turn-based battles. Travel the United States of the 1980s and solve mysterious murders to earn experience, gather equipment, and level up. Build your custom team of hunters and find the best strategy to defeat evil and save the world.

title: The Trasamire Campaigns
description: The King is dead. The war for his Kingdom has begun. Take on the mantle of one of Trasamire's legendary founders and explore the story of their bid for the throne in this colorful strategy puzzler.

title: Thrice in a row: Last Adventure
description: The final part of a great game Available 28 completely new levels. Thrice in a row is a logic game for creating chains of identical elements. The goal of the game is to put in a row from 3 identical elements, get points and go to the next level There are also bonuses.

title: Tokyo Underground Killer
description: Dive into the neon-drenched deep underground of Tokyo as Kobayashi, a deadly assassin who harnesses the power of blood energy. Use your sword, mystical abilities and powerful weapons to assassinate highly dangerous maniacs and stop the invasion of the brutal Flatliners terrorizing Tokyo.

title: The Monstrous Horror Show
description: In an abandoned hospital, four young girls gathered here for their own reasons and began to explore the hidden secrets of the hospital. Can they escape safely and return to their normal peaceful daily life again?

title: The Devil Within: Satgat
description: The Devil Within: Satgat is a 2.5D stylish action adventure that follows the journey of an Eastern warrior infected with demonic blood. Dig into the secrets of a ruined world while taking down enemies in stylish action sequences.

title: The Hunter's Journals: Wight Chapel Dreams
description: Revisit the case which made you a legend among your peers.

title: The Kraken Wakes
description: Featuring ground-breaking interactive voice technology. Speak to the characters and receive responses in real-time to change the story, as you experience an alien attack on the oceans of Planet Earth. The exclusive interactive adaptation of John Wyndham's epic scifi/horror novel, The Kraken Wakes.

title: Aero Striker: World Invasion
description: Aero Striker is a highly stylized action-packed flight combat simulator game that is intentionally designed to be easy to make it more enjoyable and less nerve-racking. The aim is to have fun making aliens explode while experiencing the sensation of flying. Let none of the evil aliens escape!

title: Aery: Path of Corruption
description: You play as a bird-like spirit and fly through the different scenarios of the decision-making process of the protagonist. Each level represents a different path that the protagonist could take. Discover the different paths, find their possible outcomes, and find a good future for your new friend.

title: Age of Irata
description: A retro styled sci-fi metroidvania without the technical limitations. Dash, jump, roll, swing, and shoot your way back through 5 planets in this open styled exploration adventure in all of its pixel art glory!

title: A Hero's Quest pt1
description: A Hero's Quest pt 1 Fulfill the role of a Hero and join this cast of misfits in stopping evil and saving the world, but what will happen to them. Will they save the world or will they be stopped?

title: A.I.T.W
description: Play a light FPS with little story up to 4 hours & collect items, cool weapons or see The merchant, use your ability's & grapple hook to destroy your foes and reach high areas, stop a cybernetic army and other enemy factions, play 4 onslaught maps.

title: Among Ass: Trilogy
description: Local party or single player game about teamwork and killing with forbidden items!

title: Asterogues
description: Beat up planets in Asterogues, a cosmic bullet hell shoot-em-up hybrid! Pick your character from a band of outcasts banished to the Asteroid Belt, dodge and shoot your way through a brutal onslaught of bullets, and take revenge against the Solar System!

title: Dark Atlas: Infernum
description: If Hell is a state of the soul, this story is the descent to the inner abyss. Dark Atlas: Infernum is a disturbing first-person story , where the end of the world is combined with psychological terror in a survival horror experience with a strong narrative component.

title: Attack of the Trafalas
description: A long time ago in a small island, an organization of evil robots have taken over, with the mission of corrupting and exterminating mankind, until a few decided to resist.

title: Axis Football 2023
description: Axis Football is a simulation-style football game featuring the industry's best franchise mode, massive customization, and realistic gameplay.

title: BackRooms New
description: This game is "BackRoomsNew" in game, after each level the game will be harder and in each level there will be all kinds of monsters that will try to catch you. Each level will have a task where you have to find a key or a lever and all sorts of things to open the door.

title: Bargin to Win
description: BarginToWin is trade bargain simulation game that you buy cheap and sell for profit!

title: Nekomancy
description: Nekomancy is a Magic rougelite looter shooter! Craft spells and vanquish evil creatures! Grab their loot and craft better spells! Make progress in the skill tree! Only the best synergies pass the test!

title: Ninja Thea
description: Casual 2D platformer with a cute ninja girl theme.

title: Obedient Servant
description: Servant of the king or hero of the Mediterranean kingdom? What happens if an ordinary servant who cannot hold a sword decides to be promoted to the knights or even the royal guard?

title: Odin's Ring
description: Odin's Ring is a game based on the 9 worlds of Norse mythology. This isometric style will contain a fusion of popular JPRG and MOBA game mechanics.

title: Order Automatica
description: A dark tactical roguelite where positioning, synergies, and automated battles collide on a tiny 3x3 ritual grid. Like chess with demons.

title: Paper Nebula
description: Paper Nebula is a fast paced, arcade style scroller, reinvented as a Roguelike! This space shooter will have you blasting through endless waves of alien ships, to escape the Paper Nebula. With adorable paper style graphics and intense gameplay, you wouldn't want to be trapped anywhere else.

title: My Furry Protogen: 18+ Adult Only Patch
description: New additional scenes as a part of the culmination of romanceable character storylines.

title: Morris Cave
description: Help Morris find the way out of this cave as quickly as possible. Every level, a new challenge! Defeat the monsters and don't get caught by the traps hidden in the darkness.

title: My Dear Sister
description: My Dear Sister is a first-person story-driven mystery-horror game with puzzles and exploration experience. The game focuses on the secrets of Fellows Family and the story of twin sisters Alice and Astrid.

title: My First Femboy Date
description: You've matched with a cute femboy on an app. The date is set and you meet him at the amusement park.

title: Space
description:
Why not unwind in a special place, built just for you. Relax among the endless SPAce, drifting along stars so new.

"SPAce" is a unique, Myst-inspired collaboration between a husband and wife. Designed by one and modeled and programmed by the other, "SPAce" transports the player into a surreal spa located somewhere between reality and one's own dreams. More updates might grace this title later in the future!

title: Soul King
description: Reach out and connect. Fight through tight retro FPS levels to free dreamers from captivity. Build your army of free people until you're powerful enough to take on the Soul King itself.

title: Sky Captain's Return
description: Inspired by the classics "Future Cop L.A.P.D" and "Herzog Zwei" in Sky Captain's Return, you play as a strong mecha warrior to conquer the enemy base with your units. Defeat the legendary Sky Captain in single-player mode or compete against your friends or random players.

title: Sippin Hot Blickety Block N Bop Those Bad Battle Boys Down to Size Supreme
description: Hop and bop your way to victory against a wild parade of killer blocks in this endless runner!

title: Sins From Magdala
description: Enjoy this puzzle game in first person, escape room style, in which you will have to discover 7 enigmas that are hidden behind the "controversial" biblical figure of Mary Magdalene.

title: Shukuchi Ninja
description: Shukuchi Ninja is a fast-paced, high intensity arcade game with unique controls

title: Sex Adventures: The Pool Party
description: An explicit erotic visual novel following the story of a young couple experiencing their first sex party together at a very exclusive pool.

title: Search 4 Bigfoot
description: It's a dark night in the forest, and something is lurking just beyond the trees. Can you find Bigfoot before he finds you?

title: Re-Spawn Tournament
description: Re-Spawn Tournament is a competitive, arena-style multi-player first person shooter game with fast-paced, high energy combat that requires both reflexive skill and tactical thinking.

title: Writhe
description: Blast your way through ceaseless swarms of grubs to a thumping industrial soundtrack, and throw yourself into an original arcade FPS that will test your mettle at every turn. Fight to survive for as long as you can and earn your place among top exterminators on the global leaderboards. Writhe is about knowing when to run and when to gun in a desperate struggle for precious seconds.

title: Veins
description:
Outside of your room you meet a strange boy, who claims he is your friend, and you must find your true past by walking through all the worlds behind all of the drips.
By walking through maps, you can truly become friends with your companion, and deduce what was your past, and why you forgot everything.
You must gain all effects and make some good decisions to get the best ending.

title: Squirrel with a Gun
description: Squirrel, meet gun. As the neighborhood’s most obnoxious rodent, develop a knack (and a love?) for crime and mayhem in pursuit of golden acorns in this nutty sandbox shooter and puzzle platformer. Fight tooth, claw, and gun to escape a secret underground facility and defeat the Agents.

title: Sunkenland
description: A Waterworld themed survival game. Explore sunken cities, build your base, craft items, trade and fight pirates as you struggle to survive on an aquatic post-apocalypse world plagued by hunger and violence.

title: Lust Trip
description: The day of your planned road trip has finally arrived, and you are almost ready to drive off. Suddenly, an unexpected person joins your trip, so now you have to travel with her.

title: Gamma 19
description: Gamma 19 is an action RPG with beat 'em up battle mechanics. Punch and shoot your way through robots, worms, and creatures from another dimension in this strange new world!

title: Heavy Works
description: Build and Destroy with satisfying digging and building mechanics in this openworld physics constuction simulator, borrow cash to buy bigger more powerfull machines and Build more! Freely construct your yard and the world around to build a town from nothing.

title: Brewpub Simulator
description: Quit your day job, open a bar! Brew lagers, stouts and IPAs, and serve patrons at your own brewpub. Decorate the place, create your own brands of beer, and expand into the best joint in town. All of this in a relaxing simulator that values creativity and passion for crafting.

title: Escape Memoirs: Mini Stories
description: "Escape Memoirs: Mini Stories" is a series of co-operative escape-room style puzzle scenarios. Each one is sure to test your wits as you try to overcome the challenges that stand in the way of your escape.

title: Holiday with Gwen
description: Step into the shoes of detective Hank and his sidekick Gwen. This time on a top secret mission in an exotic Mediterranean-like country to uncover an illegal drug trade, but also to use this opportunity to enjoy themselves and perhaps even to savour romantic moments.

title: Highway Rampage
description: Rogue drivers pilot a high-octane run over miles of post-apocalyptic terrain, escaping the ruthless grip of the forces that thirst for their blood. Choose your driver and see if you've got what it takes to make it through wasteland highways, dodging, disarming, and destroying your opposition!

title: Medieval Kingdom Wars: Royal Blood
description: Only those of Royal Blood can undertake the King’s Campaign. Defend your mighty nation from enemies near and far, build your towns and cities into imgrenable bastions and economic powerhouses, and expand your realm by claiming all that is yours by right of your royal blood.

title: Why I was Born
description: "When I noticed, I was born on its own." This is a game that simulates the life of an ordinary man by rolling the ball.

title: Brave survivors
description: Break the besiege of various monsters! Upgrade the weapons, choose your favorite skills. Unique combination with skill and role. A 14 minutes roguelike experience, shoot with fantastic and exciting experience!! Believe yourself and beat the boss!

title: Pip 2
description: PIP 2 — cute puzzle game with pipes. Enjoy a relaxing time connecting pipes

title: Sun Shot
description: SUN SHOT - 2547 People have long since left the earth. In the course of constant military operations and endless skirmishes between states, conditions on earth have slipped into unsustainable conditions.

title: Poly Puzzle: Predators
description: Cute, relaxing, polygonal puzzle game with predators.

title: Flying Umbrella
description: "Flying Umbrella" - 2d platformer game about a girl who moves in different directions with every gust of wind. Learn to control your body. The bus won't wait long. Collect berries, only carefully flying around traps and wild animals. Everything will work out!

title: Charge Knight: A Duck's Tale
description: In this casual mechanics game, use continuous movement to overcome challenges. The unstoppable knight Dundee must be strategically driven on his journey, defeating enemies, solving puzzles and mechanics while using the scenery to his advantage.

title: Pinball Girls
description:
"Pinball Girls" is a game combined with pretty girl, pinball and galgame. The story begins with the agreement that “me” signs an alliance with Cyrili to collect the "destiny energy ball" needed together. Along the way, you will transform yourself as variety of gentlemen and appear beside all kinds of 9 girls to help them achieve their wishes.
From now on, "destiny" will be in hand, everything will be changed by you!

title: PixelJunk: Scrappers Deluxe
description: Clean up the streets of Junktown as a team of robot garbage collectors. Trash your opponents with up to 4 players or go it alone in this beat ‘em up that’s also a clean ‘em up!

title: Police Radar
description: Police officer, where are you? The city is out of control. The world needs your help right now to maintain peace and order on the city streets.

title: Bloody Hell
description: Bloody Hell is a Bullet-Hell Metroidvania about using the blood of demons to your advantage. Fight Epic Bosses, and take revenge on the terrorising demons.

title: Lucky Tlhalerwa: IMS Death Squad
description: IMS Death Squad is A Third-Person Story-Telling Action Shooter. Its Story Takes Place At The Same Time As The Original Super Incursion. SGT David Grimes Tries To Save His Team As Their Commander Has To Kill Them All, As A Requirement To Complete His Transition Into The Enemy Side.

title: Tamakagura: Tales of Turmoil
description: Yuma Nagumo, a young freelance exorcist, struggles between his own ideals and the harsh reality of life around him in this turn-based tactics RPG. As more and more urgent quests pour in, he and his friends protect the land from evil, but a terrible threat rises to stand in their way...

title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Dear Days
description: The ultimate digital Vanguard experience that includes an original story set in the world of overDress! Compete with players worldwide with "Ranked Fight," play solo casually with "CPU Fight," and enjoy the game and experience the world of Vanguard at your own pace via many other fight modes.

title: Spy Bros.: Pipi & Bibi's DX
description: Those wacky gangsters are up to no good... Dodge them, plant the bombs and flee the building before it blows up!

title: Ghostland Yard
description: Uncover the truth about the Ghostland Yard investigators disappearance in this challenging 2D precision platformer. Travel across the world in more than 250 hand-crafted levels to find your friends!

title: Desktop Dungeons: Rewind
description: Desktop Dungeons: Rewind bestows bites of tactical roguelike action, which will quickly fester into a deep, lingering, and strategic obsession. Bargain with gods, equip your spoon and pick your battles, before retreating into the healing darkness. But beware… there are still many monsters to face!

title: Kaiju Klash
description: Kaiju Klash is a turn-based fighter where you build your own giant monster and fight to climb the ranks of the arena against other perilous, and sometimes wacky, monster combinations. Each monster part offers unique stats and abilities so you can fight how you want!

title: Exome
description: EXOME is a co-op survival shooter with a focus on exploration, weapon progression and horde AI. Discover what grim mysteries are hidden in this deep forest. Explore and fight for survival, alone or with your friends.

title: Egg Boy
description: " EGG BOY " is a parkour fighting game based on cute cartoon style, including both single and multiplayer modes. Dozens of party levels, hundreds of different types of EGG BOYs to choose from, rich and interesting activity modes to participate in.

title: Phantom Alchemy: Silvia's Dynamic Urban Planning
description: In order to make up for the corruption committed by her father, Silvia had to help the development of the border city as an alchemist. But if she wants to use alchemy, she must convert the spiritual power of residents into energy.

title: Strike Force Heroes
description: Strike Force Heroes is an oldschool arena shooter rebuilt with modern mechanics with full co-operative and PvP online multiplayer. It melds over the top action with epic story-telling in this intense remake of the hit Flash game.

title: Public Land Hunter
description: Experience the challenge of hunting public land in this retro hunting sim. Hunt a variety of game using a range of weapons on procedurally generated parcels of land. Scout, set up and shoot.

title: Summer: Life in the Countryside - Outing
description:
Additional elements:
・Outdoor map is added.
・Fast travel is added.
・Outing events "Camping", "Swimming", and "Summer Festival" are added.
・One ending is added.

title: Caribbean Marque
description: Sail the open seas of the Caribbean in this light RPG game and experience the thrill of hunting down pirates or being a pirate! Along the way discover a cast of characters good and evil. Upgrade your crew and ship to become the most infamous pirate or maybe resist the temptation.

title: Pixxxel
description: Pixxxel is a game where you can immerse yourself in the colorful world of platform games, but far from simple ones.

title: Curvature
description: Take control of a highly adaptable battle machine and infiltrate a hostile civilization to keep peace in the universe. Build your own playstyle with a vast amount of gadgets, weapons and unique abilities. Survive and dominate a harsh and atmospheric world.

title: Stuff Enuff
description: A competitive party game designed to ruin friendships!

title: Friendly Blonding
description: Friendly Blonding is a linear adult visual novel focused on the themes of netorare (or cheating) and moral degeneration (or corruption). It it a short story told from both the male protagonist's and his girlfriend's perspective.

title: Millennium Conflict
description: Millennium Conflict: a real-time strategy game set in space where you must act fast to stop attackers from conquering your universe. With 40 levels, weapon upgrades, and new generals to recruit, it's up to you as the only surviving male to lead your troops to victory.

title: Idle Zombies Clicker
description: Idle clicker game with cute zombies!

title: Furry Feet: Femboys!
description:
Femboy Furry Feet!!!
- Enjoy 8 brand new levels featuring femboy characters!
- Revisit every level art in the gallery.

title: Synthalaxy
description: Synthalaxy is a top-down tactical shooter where the enemies have a series of weak points rather than traditional health. Manipulate enemies in order to complete complex puzzles. Traverse worlds, take aim, and solve puzzles to save the Synthalaxy!

title: Cursed 3
description: The epic conclusion of the CURSED trilogy.

title: Temple of Horror
description: Escape the dangerous beings lurking in the dark, dodge countless deadly traps and slowly unruffle the secret of the Temple of Horror while not just trying to survive but to find your way out of this hell. Are you ready?

title: Spike Mtn
description: Use your grappling hook to overcome challenging obstacles and reach the top of Spike Mtn! Spike Mtn is a 2D precision platformer with a fun and retro atmosphere.

title: Escape First Alchemist
description: First-person escape game, playable solo, co-op, or pvp with up to 6 people. Solve riddles of a reclusive alchemist that trapped you in his workshop. Brew potions and overcome challenges as he laughs at your failures and makes light of your successes...But what if things are not what they seem?

title: Pipes Puzzles
description: Pipes Puzzles is a casual puzzle game.

title: Goat's Tale 2
description: The Goat is back in his next adventure! The challenge will be difficult, but only with your help he will be able to get to the top.

title: Blinded by Fear
description: Blinded by Fear is a survival horror experience with a twist. You can't see anything! Navigate a 3D world with a novel lidar based sight mechanic. Solve puzzles, uncover a twisted mystery and confront unseeable horrors dwelling in the darkness. Can you survive when you are Blinded by Fear?

title: Lost Beyond
description: Lost Beyond is a Adventure Exploration game where your main quest becomes finding a way back to your dimension. Embark on a journey, find your way through a vast and mysterious environment and try to hold it together while the Universe tests your worthiness.

title: Photogenic Minds: Identity
description:
"A deck-building 3D exploration psycho-horror."
Dominate the 12 hours from PM 0:00 to AM 0:00, break free from the infinite loop, and capture the souls of the dead.
Your only tool: a single camera.

title: Cube Adventure
description: This minimalist game will help you pass the evening.

title: Spooky Mansion Manager
description: Spooky Mansion Manager is a turn-based management game where you create Spooky Tours in a mansion you inherited from your grandpa. Ultimate goal is to acquire a hundred gold bars in as many weeks to pay back a loan. NOTE: This is not a scary game (ie. it doesn't have any jump scares etc.)

title: Pussy 6
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Lost but Lucid
description: Lost but Lucid is a platformer set in the dreamscapes of a patient undergoing experimental therapy. Traverse 27 levels seeking secrets and collectables. Sprint, leap, fall, delve, and climb your way out of an unconscious prison.

title: Fishing Game
description: Fishing game is an itty bitty game inspired by the fishing minigame in Stardew Valley. Filled with a bunch of goofy writing and a handful of spicy gimmicks. Collect over twenty unique fish and add them to your compendium as you navigate through a world of quirky characters and strange locations!

title: Bloody Hell Hotel
description: In Bloody Hell Hotel, you embody a vampire. You wake up from a coma that has lasted for centuries, only to find your once-grand estate is now in ruins. It's time to turn it into a prosperous hotel! It's no easy task, though, as times are tough and resources are scarce. There are shortages of food, supplies, and workforce. Being a blood-thirsty monster doesn't help with customer satisfaction either. Luckily, underneath the estate lies a crypt and a system of caves. By foraging, farming, crafting, and fighting your way through the monster-infested dungeons, you'll find the resources you need to restore greatness to your mansion and turn it into a thriving hotel business.

title: Golden Rails: World's Fair
description: The mayor of your hometown needs your help constructing a world's fair! Continue conquering the Wild West with your favorite characters Jack and Jill. Complete 60 exciting levels and help rid the city of insidious bandits and build the most grandiose exhibition in the world!

title: Verlet Ascend
description: Verlet Ascend is a physics based, action platformer with roguelike mechanics, a fully destructable procedurally generated environment, and rope swing physics. Fight creatures, loot enemies, upgrade your character, and climb your way up in an endless parkour.

title: MultiVersus: Season 1
description: Season 1 contains a new battle pass, along with new cosmetics, modes, and characters including Rick, Morty, Black Adam, and Stripe.

title: Cardterrupters
description: Turns not guaranteed in a roguelite deckbuilder where you can cancel the enemy's turns!

title: Les Visiteurs: Le Jeu
description: In order to avenge her grandmother, the little little daughter of the witch of Malcombe has thrown a lot of trouble in the castle of Montmirail by scattering a number of objects from our time. The Inquisition thinks that Godefroy de Montmirail is a heretic and hunts him down. "Calamitas!" Stuck in our time. Godefroy and his faithful squire Jacquouille need your help: return to the castle of Montmirail, retrieve the anachronistic objects to restore order in The Halls of Time. Play as the descendants of the Montmirails: the fate of your family is in your hands. The task will not be easy and you will have to thwart many riddles to explore the castle from top to bottom.

title: Waifu Wars
description:
In a world of love and war, there can only be one ultimate waifu. Players from all over the world compete against each other in order to prove who is the best.

You will take control of your own waifu and fight against others in order to become the ultimate champion. With many different classes to choose from, each with their own unique abilities and weapons, you will need to be strategic in order to win.

Can you lead your waifu to victory?

title: Nomori
description: Nomori is a mind-bending puzzle game where you need to control time and space to journey through a shattered spirit world. Take shortcuts through portals, rotate your perspective, and control the flow of time to move forward, whichever way that is.

title: Coffee Break: A Sip Away from Doom
description: In a tedious day, Oliver finishes his best invention yet: A SubAtomic coffee machine that is to make the perfect coffee. But a problem emerged when the perfect coffee was so good it blew up the machine and ruptured timespace. Now, Oliver has to retrieve the pieces of his machine that are scattered through the multiverse. Follow Oliver in his adventure through the dimensions in search of the perfect coffee! Meet various worlds with incredible art, charismatic characters and challenging puzzles!

title: Cold Front
description: Cold Front is a 4 map wad for limit removing ports featuring snowy landscapes and Egyptian architecture.

title: I'm in Love With Your Dead Grandmother
description: Hello, I'm Noah. I'm 28 years old and still haven't got a single date in my life, I'm looking for a life coach who can help me figure out the hard choices in my day to day life, you know? I'm sad and single, I have some friends online, but that's it.

title: Projekt Everblood
description: Projekt Everblood is a 2D top-down action game set in an alternate World War 2. Embrace your vampiric abilities of flight, feeding and deadly fury to exact revenge on the enemy scientists that wronged you.

title: Magic Kingdom
description: Self moving chess, RTS, Meat pigeon game. In the game, you will control the hero, lead a powerful army, release powerful magic, have a strong city defense, and coordinate resource collection to resist the enemy's strong attack

title: The Lost Abyss
description: In the previously flourishing world, darkness has come. Warriors who fought for order and justice are now forced to fight for survival. The world is not the same as before, hunger and disease conquered civilians.

title: Surprise Cat
description: Surprise Cat is a hidden object game with puzzles. Unleash your inner feline with original gravity-defying gameplay and mind-bending puzzles. Search for hidden objects and use them to defeat your enemies!

title: Escape from Frankenstein's Castle
description: Injured in a car crash with her fiancé Horatio, Hannah wakes up alone and finds herself trapped in Dr. Frankenstein’s castle. Horatio’s missing, and with guidance from a resident ghost, Isabella, Hannah quickly realizes Dr. Frankenstein is conducting strange experiments that put both her and Horatio in grave danger. Help Hannah as she interacts with the castle’s suspicious inhabitants, discovers clues about the doctor’s master plan, and completes puzzles to find a way out!

title: Sakura X Clash: Last Millennial Spring
description:
Sakura X Clash: Last Millenial Spring is an IKEMEN-based fighting game, that pays homage to arcade classics such as The King of Fighters and Street Fighter.
sXc also uses NGPC-styled graphics and aesthetic, aiming for a simple yet deep gameplay experience, making the game easy to pickup and play for begginers, but with a lot of depth for those who want to master it.
Featuring a (quite literally) colorful and constantly expanding cast of characters, each with its on gameplay style and unique quirks.

title: Nova Antarctica
description: Survive Earth's harshest conditions on a devastatingly beautiful journey shaped by the choices you make, the paths you take, and the stories you weave with the mysterious animals of Antarctica.

title: Autocrusher: Bumper Cars
description: Auto Crusher: Bumper Cars is a car destruction racing game inspired by the bumper car rides from amusement arcades and carnivals. In this game players will feel the excitement of crashing into other vehicles, coupled with the use of several power ups and upgrades , making this game a race for glory!

title: Little Nemo the Clown
description: Little Nemo The Clown is a 2D Open World game inspired by good Metroidvania titles. Talk, Run, Fly, Explore. Find secret passages and characters and discover a Fantasy World full of Magic and Color. Little Nemo is a modern Maze Runner Adventure. Can you find the Clown before your Time runs out?

title: Godsworn
description: Godsworn is a classic mythological RTS. Experience an epic fantasy retelling of the northern crusades, where pagan gods and their tribes clash against crusaders and armies of heaven. Choose a divine hero, rally worshippers alongside mythical creatures, and smite the unworthy!

title: Cube Fight
description: Cube Fight is a shooting game with skills to aid in battle in different maps as a erm cube

title: Atic Atac
description:
From Atic dark to Cellar dank, in Caverns deep and swampland rank. The garden green spawms hideous life, the outhouse treasure leads to strife Awake...awake...and find the key! For only then wilt thou be free!
This is a brand new Atic Atac remake written from scratch following the demise of JMD's version. Gameplay wise, it's very close to the original, but with a few extra bells, whistles and that sort of thing. Graphics, sound and music have been enhanced in true remakes fashion.

title: Videoverse
description: Take a trip back to the days of the early internet and fan forums, when the video game console "Kinmoku Shark" and its online social network "Videoverse" were still popular...

title: Luna Abyss
description: Luna Abyss is a single player story driven action-adventure with fluid platforming and bullet hell combat. Follow the journey of Fawkes, a prisoner of Luna caught between a cryptic prophecy and their prison sentence.

title: Delta Dash
description:
Delta Dash is a rhythm game in active development,

2 Lines, 4 keys, keep the rhythm !

title: Mithraeum
description: Mithraeum is a blockchain game that combines elements of Grand Strategy and MMO. Fight other players, forge alliances, intrigue and betray. Friend of foe - it's your choice.

title: Gli Animotosi e la Macchina Motante
Zero Ops
description: A classic 3rd Person Shooter. Gone are the days of "run and gun". This game rewards those who rely on tactics, teamwork, and stealth.

title: Reliquary
description: Reliquary is a free-to-play online trading card game with over 1,000 cards. Build decks around a hero, summon Reliquaries from your Extra Deck when the board is right, and call forth Incarnates by offering your monsters. Play ranked and quick matches against other players, climb the solo Tower, draft a deck from scratch, challenge friends, and watch or replay duels. Available in nine languages.

title: Breaking Enigma
description: Breakout remake with a tempest 2000 and Geometry Wars like twist. No in-game purchase everything is included. The ultimate survival mode with Infinite looping levels, getting progressively harder on each loop. Submit you high scores and race to be the global leader. Supports Mouse or Controller

title: My Hero Ultra Rumble
description: Pick your favorite character, team up and fight to be the last ones standing in the new 24-player Battle Royale free to play game "My Hero Ultra Rumble"!

title: BountyHeart
description:
BountyHeart is a mobile roguelite puzzle RPG that combines Match 3 with Tactics. You play as Tobi, a criminal who has been sent to the island of BountyHeart, fabled to contain the Legendary Bounty. The only ticket to freedom is to capture the Legendary Bounty!
Assemble the perfect crew by befriending those you meet along the way, or defeat them for their bounty and strengthen your party.

title: Outbreak Island: Pendulum
description: Mysterious island, crashed plane, underground complex, classified military research. Survive in a new atmospheric sandbox thriller and uncover the terrible secret of the disaster.

title: Endgame: Survival
description: Big group of people will be dropped into a deserted island where they will have to survive.

title: Heist Master
description: Get all the loot and become the ultimate heist master!

title: Dead Pets: A Punk Rock Slice of Life Sim
description: Struggling punk band, Dead Pets, are still looking for their breakthrough after almost 10 years. Gordy has big plans for the group, but when you turn 30, life starts to get in the way. Dead Pets Unleashed is a narrative, slice of life and management-lite game; get ready to unleash your inner demon.

title: Star Trust
description: Fly with your spaceship, avoid obstacles and destroy monsters and powerful bosses. In this game you can shot with laser, missiles and powerful unique specials power of 9 different spaceships. In addition, those space ships have good mobility that you can use to avoid enemy attacks.

title: Hear Your Path
description: Hear Your Path is a maze game where, in order to find the exit, the player needs to listen and play each note of the proposed music. However, the notes and the exit are hidden, like Minesweeper, so be careful when listening to a note, because It may not be the right one to give sequence to the music

title: Xeno Command
description: Defend galaxy against Alien invasion in the RTS offline game with roguelike fun.

title: Toy Rider: Racing Game
description: Toy Rider is a mobile car racing game, what makes it different from a typical car racing game is, it is not just about speed it is about balancing, timing, proper use of power-ups & proper speed! The game is inspired by the Table Top Racing & Micromachine game but with lots of upgrades and improvements. One of the best offline racing game

title: The Aether
description: The Aether is a popular content mod for Minecraft that includes the Aether dimension, the opposite of The Nether, which provides several new blocks, mobs, and items, as well as a whole new accessory system.

title: No C1ip
description: Explore a landscape of disfigured shapes and distorted views.

title: Jetpak: Solar Crisis
description: Jetpak: Solar Crisis is a remake of Jetpac for the ZX Spectrum.

title: CaseCracker
description: In order to improve the efficiency of selecting talents, the Chicheng police specially developed a test system-the true detection system, with the black robe company. As a tester, you need to complete the cracking of the case under the rules of the system.

title: Kitsune Zero
description:
Run, jump, and stomp on ghostlike creatures from Japanese folklore lurking in the countryside and castles. Collect powerups that make Yumi grow in size, grant fireball abilities, and make her invincible for a short time. Gather the necessary ingredients to break the pact's magic and take down the leader of the samurai clan to end the war.

Defeat a sinister samurai gang to stop the clan’s war of conquest. Hear the cries of the local onmyouji, a wizardly bureaucrat assigned to keep the peace, and end the magical pact the samurai have with vengeful spirits. Only Yumi can break the alliance and restore peace… and maybe get to go on a date for her trouble. Gather the necessary ingredients to stop the dark pact’s magic and the leader of the samurai clan once and for all. But beware, for a damsel, err, dashing gentleman in distress, might need rescuing!

title: Lunar Jetman
description: Lunar Jetman is a fan remake of the game with the same name for the ZX Spectrum, made by Andy Noble.

title: LotAtc
description:
LotAtc is a complete simulation environment with client & server software which can connect with DCS World Simulator or work standalone with LotAtc Generator. It provides users to get an ATC/GCI view of the battle.
