Play the role of a tactical or air traffic controller and provide help to human pilots so that they better accomplish their missions, by radioing them a picture or guidance instructions!

title: Ghost War
description: An RPG about an alchemist that tries to find ghosts

title: Wizarre
description: Wizarre is a turn-based multiplayer game. Build and customize your team of Wizards, select from over 100 different spells, and manage your time and mana. Play with friends, compete against other players, and climb the global leaderboard across devices with crossplay support.

title: Hentai Zodiac Puzzle
description: Hentai Zodiac Puzzle is a simple 'spot the difference' strip game. 12 pretty girls with different fetishes are waiting for you. No time limit. Enjoy the game. Choose your zodiac girl!

title: Gaze Into Fate
description: A meditative and story-driven puzzle game, where you must discover answers to decisions, we all have to make. Can you make a change in a world of endless wars?

title: Hentai Zodiac Puzzle 2
description: 'Hentai Zodiac Puzzle 2' is the awesome sequel of the puzzle with 12 new beautiful girls. Even more differences and music awaits you! Choose your new zodiac girl!

title: Love Wish 2
description: The girls are sealed by magic! Complete the Hexagon Puzzle, this is the only way to gain the power to break the seal. Go! You must rescue them.

title: Romance
description: It is a love oriented short visual novel, which contains a wealth of interesting games and a large number of exquisite CG pictures. The man lives in the same apartment with his friends, works in the same company, and leads a monotonous life. The appearance of interns has changed the repetitive life.

title: Dolphin Squadron
description: Dolphin Squadron is a vertical scrolling shooter where you play as a mechanized dolphin hired by the US Navy Seals to intercept dangerous underwater mines in order to save various coastal cities from utter devastation!

title: Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider
description: Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider is a side-scrolling action platformer that channels the golden age of classic 16-bit action games in a full-throttle quest for revenge.

title: Scared Tube
description: Scared Tube is an indie, Early-Access horror-style game. You play as an influencer that explores abandon haunted locations. Like any horror influencer, you need to determine what kind of ghost you are dealing with for your audience. Get those likes and subscriptions up for currency and gear.

title: Gimmick! Special Edition
description:
Gimmick! Special Edition is a Port of the NES classic Gimmick! to modern consoles.

Gimmick! Special Edition includes brand new bonus features such as achievements, time attack mode, save, load, and rewind functions, a gallery mode, and more.

title: Ashes: Exponential RPG
description:
Rogue like, steady progression. Gain 1000 levels and more in one fight !

An RPG in the heritage of "Inflation RPG" with his own atypical universe.
A lot of Items, a lot of weapons ! Optimise your stuff to reach the end in a limited numbers of fight !

title: R-Type Final 2: DLC Set 7
description: Includes 2 new stages.

title: Dead Beacon
description: Dead Beacon is a first-person survival horror inspired by 1990s games and taking place in the Beacon manor, a location crawling with zombies and creatures governed by a malevolent will. Survive using the given array of weapons and escape the island.

title: Master of Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Free heartwarming Jigsaw Puzzles. Enjoy relaxing atmosphere with this incredible HD Jigsaws. Become the Master of Pieces!

title: Roguevive
description: Roguevive is an roguelite survive arena. Survive against hordes of enemies getting ever stronger. Level up, unlock upgrades and new guns in this multiplayer action roguelite.

title: Scar in the Void
description: A sci-fi rpg where you are a robot that flies a ship and fights on foot to save the solar system and humanity from an artificial intelligence known as I.I.I. Has a story where you try to save the solar system or you can play waves mode where you fight waves of enemy ships.

title: Warmonium
description: Featuring team fighting turn based tactics with multilevel pathfinding. Inspired by 90's board games it's a fantasy come true for fans of strategy war games! Catering to the casual and competitive player, from ranked games to custom maps.

title: Hook & Go
description: Hook & Go is a 2D platformer, you move on the levels with a hook and you grap somthing, and you are projected in this direction. Like Spider-Man!!! You will find coins and spades that can kill you, be careful!!! 100 levels of fun! For all ages! Enjoy!!!

title: The Fish
description: Dive down and see what lies beneath the surface. Discover a vast underwater world as different fishes. The game does not offer any real "Game Play" but is more of a simulation.

title: Memory Puzzle: Futanari Massage
description: Train your brain with this memory game, revealing the naughty sexual adventures of a Futanari masseur and her client, in images hidden behind pairs of cards which you have to match.

title: Parket Evolution
description: PARKET Evolution is a 3d platformer featuring multiple gamemodes, various creative worlds, a unique character and more.

title: UnHappy Place
description: UnHappy Place is a game that concentrates on depression. The main goal of the state is to better the main character's mental health by doing simple things, such as cleaning the apartment.

title: Scorphius
description: You have survived the plague. Set in the dark world of Scorpion you will delve into the dungeons and travel high up into the heavens to put an end to the plague. The focus is on the adventure, combat and powerful items and passive skills which allows character customization.

title: Steal
description: This is a 3d game that simulates a thief, control the thief to escape the police's flashlight, and quickly collect items to pass the level. Come and challenge for the highest score!

title: House of Specters
description: House of Specters is a party platformer that progressively gets harder with each level of the house you complete. Play solo, or grab up to 7 friends to play with as you make your way through 10 very challenging levels meant to test your friendship...

title: Pocket Academy 3
description:
Your favorite dream school simulator is back and better than ever! Introducing: The super fun school festival!
Build facilities and create a great school environment. Set up classrooms, a cafeteria...and a counseling room! (A little nerve-wracking for students to get called in there!)
Place compatible facilities together to create popular spots which will make your school really stand out. As the school's popularity and rep go up, enrollment applications will flood in.

title: Criminal Expert
description: As a police investigator, you take on the task of explaining this mysterious event. Who is this person and what was she doing there? Will the circumstances of this case be easy to explain or is there something deeper going on in the story?

title: Moorhuhn X: Crazy Chicken X
description: Shoot the hell out of it - with Moorhuhn X Moorhuhn X is back - also known as Crazy Chicken X and Chicken Hunter.

title: Alien War
description: In 2222 AD, only 5% of humanity survived the alien invasion. The aliens have begun their final attack. Defeat the aliens by firing the guns of the KPO9, humanity’s strongest surface-to-air weapon.

title: Timberman: The Big Adventure
description: Follow a lumberjack's story and join him on his way to help his bear friend reunite with family. Challenge the Evil Corp to rescue your friends and save the entire forest from the hands of industrialization.

title: Steamcore
description: A brand new genre FPS set in the future, in which players must invade and conquer planets representing live channels on Twitch.

title: Sakura no Sora to, Kimi no Koto: Sweet Petals For My Dear
description: It has been said that wishes will come true when the sky is full of cherry blossom petals. However, the number of sakura trees have dwindled due to recent re-development and one can no longer see such a sight. Ryou is the son of a famous artist and much was expected of him, but he decides to live a life of a commoner with few friends. One spring day, his childhood friend Kanata suddenly fainted and was hospitalized. Since that day, his days began to gradually change.

title: Pixel Petkeeper
description: A pet-collecting autobattle game. Enter dungeons to battle, tame pets, collect treasure, and unlock new areas in this pixel art indie game

title: Cube Farmer
description: Cube Farmer is a puzzle game where your goal is making the plantation grow on the island. To do this you need to put the water cube in the correct position that is indicated in the archipelago and then go to the next island.

title: Hellway to Hell
description: Hellway To Hell combines the advantages of logic games, retro stylistics and is maintained in a dark-fun atmosphere. Inherits such titles as Bomberman (stealth elements) or diablo (hack'n'slash, character development)

title: Without End
description: Without End is a story heavy, turn based, experimental RPG, following the every day life of a high schooler.

title: The Gallagher Case
description: One night in 1982 a teenager comes home from school. He receives a call from Mrs Gallagher, his neighbour, an invalid woman with Alzheimer's disease. She can't turn on the TV, she's not very good with technology, so she convinces the young man to help her with the television, not knowing that he was about to live the worst experience of his life.

title: Father's Day
description: The dream of living happily ever after was destroyed after Phil lost his wife and son. Obsessed with the desire to return them, he develops a plan that he does not tell anyone about.

title: Xmas Lemmings
description: The 1992 edition of Xmas Lemmings is another free demo intended to promote Lemmings and Oh No! More Lemmings. It includes four entirely new Christmas-themed levels, in the same style as the 1991 demo: Jingle Bells and other Christmas songs as background music and the Lemmings moving through snowscapes dressed in Santa outfits. The holiday levels from the earlier demo were comparatively easy, but this one also includes some brain teasers comparable to levels from the main games' higher difficulties.

title: Twilight Forest
description: Twilight Forest is a Minecraft mod created by Benimatic that adds the Twilight Forest dimension. The dimension is a heavily forest-themed world filled with new mobs, trees, dungeons, and bosses.

title: OmanaC: C2
description: Omanac is a role playing action card game where you collect Omanac cards. These cards are your living weaponry given sentience by using life from your life point pool via a free ratio system. This makes your “entities”functionable battle partners and part of how you play the game. Choosing a combination based on battle type(s) and skills working to defeat other malicious entities as you level up with them.

title: Lidar.exe
description: You are in a dark space, you can't see anything. You only have a lidar scanner with which you can scan the area. You wander through the corridors in the hope of finding a way out of this gloomy place.

title: Sharpshooter
description: Gunfight your way through procedurally generated Wild West towns. Customize the gameplay mechanics to suit your playstyle. Straightforward, non-stop action.

title: Bratz 4 Real
description: Bratz: 4 Real is a video game adaptation of Bratz: The Movie released to Microsoft Windows on November 5, 2007.

title: Xelphi: Second Limit
description:
This game is a sequel to the 3D racing game using DirectX 8.1. Even though it is a sequel, it doesn't carry over most of the game contents of the previous game, and after reconsidering the specifications, it's completely remade from scratch.

Unlike the previous work, the course is three-dimensional, and of course there are
overpasses, roller coaster-like loops, and even vertical walls.

Of course, there will be a more acrobatic course this time as well, so make full use of techniques such as drifting with a different sense of operation and boosts that have been newly added, and finish within the top 4 within the time limit.

Of course, there is also a replay, and it is also compatible with gamepads, so please take the first place with a cool run.

title: Eco Breaker
description:
Eco Breaker is a role-playing game inspired by the Japanese classics of the '90s.
Board your Mobile Gun mech unit and explore, liberate regions and assemble an army to fight against the Mad Ruler of Gebronia before the world is brought to an end.

title: Touhou Tougenkyuu: Riverbed Soul Saver
description: Fan-made Touhou Project game programmed by ido (known for previous fangames The Last Comer and Mystical Power Plant) and Len (known for the fangame Phantasmagoria Trues). The main gameplay mechanic involves a gauge that the player fills up by collecting items. Once full, holding down the bomb key will 'unlock' the player's full strength with a powered-up mode for a short period of time.

title: Tuin
description: Plant seeds, pull weeds and sell vegetables - all while doing something else! Expand your garden more and more by buying new plots, installing irrigation systems, or fully automating your farm for maximum profit. What will your garden look like?

title: Nanoha Taiken 2nd Chu
description: Indie STG also called Nanoha Taiken 2nd Chu and the sequel of Lyrical Nanoha, developed by the doujin circle Musume. This game was released at Comiket 72.

title: RozenDiadem
description: Indie bullet hell/STG game developed by Ichigo-Citron, based on the anime/manga series Rozen Maiden.

title: Re:Dreamer
description:
Zach, a broke college freshman and chronic underachiever who's been coasting through life without a purpose, just found a curious phone game called re:Dreamer. This incredible phone app has world-bending powers, and he accidentally turned himself into a sexy and voluptuous young woman before he even finished the tutorial. Even worse, unless he wins this perverted game, he'll never be able to change back!

With an impish and unreliable in-game A.I. as their only lead on how to change back and the ability to get help from a single friend he's allowed to invite, will Zach be able to win this predatory game without giving up the things that make him a man in the process, or will he lose and remain stuck as a woman?

title: Passed Out
description:
BattleRoyale
Survive against all the players, but not only.. 5000 zombies who surround everyone are also coming for YOU !
Be the last man standing and kill a maximum of zombies to reach the top of the leaderboard.

Zombie Hord Mode
Once you are the last man standing, the game change and is not finish yet.. Zombies will run for your life and you will need to survive them the longest as you can.
A score will be calculated based on the number of zombies and players you success to kill !

title: Moonyolk
description:
MOONYOLK is a short tale about two boys floating in the sea and watching a lonely moon.
A reminder that it's never too late to say you love me.

title: Rainbow Dash Tylenol
description: Rainbow Dash and Boyfriend singing Rainbow Tylenol, that's all.

title: Roaring Twenties Solitaire
description: Music, dances, luxury cars and grandiose parties – it's the roaring twenties. Immerse yourself in the era by heading over to the burlesque party, take part in the jazz concert, go to the best casinos, walk the slopes of San Francisco and, of course, visit Hollywood. Travel to wonderful places and earn trophies while solving fascinating card puzzles in Roaring Twenties Solitaire!

title: Platform Adventure
description: A relaxing, cozy, combat-free platformer featuring puzzles, secrets and loot!

title: Z After
description: Point and click your way through a narrative adventure and survive the risen dead in turn based combat, uncovering the truth behind a deadly virus.

title: Totemlands
description: You are an adventurer who just arrived at the mysterious land of Oakshade, inhabited by spirits known as Oaklingers, peculiar locals and… totems? Totemlands is a relaxing crafting, building game where you hunt spirits, use them to craft and raise totem poles. Totem poles produce valuable resources called Relics, which can be sold for Golden Acorns (in-game currency). which later can be used to expand, upgrade or unlock new territories.

title: Presenter Slides
description: An unconventional adventure into the corporate world of presentation software. Improve office productivity by 200% and impress your boss while doing it.

title: Bomba: The Explosive Hero
description:
Bomba is an out-dated superhero from uneXplosive.com, a company that produces and stores special effects for computer games. Due to the very strict regulations and official orders, the effects are not allowed to be violent or politically incorrect in any way.
As everyone knows, no money can be made with boring and nonviolent stuff. That's why uneXplosive.com's laboratories and storages are full of illegal effects.
But secret investigations gave the authorities a strong suspicion. So yesterday morning heavy-armed officers of the MAV (Ministry for Absence of Violence) appeared at uneXplosive.com demanding entrance.
Now only one can help and save his company from being deleted: Bomba! But he has to remove all kinds of explosive material without leaving any evidence.
A dangerous mission, even for a superhero...

title: RemiFla Spirits 2
description: A doujin game by YuuYuutei based on the Touhou Project series.

title: The Last Matches
description:
Who would buy matches on Christmas Eve? On a cold, snowy Christmas Eve, the girl strikes her first match in the darkness, illuminating memories she’d since buried deep. Will the last matches give her the strength to keep going?

Inspired by the tragic fairy tale by Hans Christian Andersen, together we bring you an alternate story of a maybe happier ending and a happier life for the little match girl.

title: UdoRin
description: A doujin game by YuuYuutei based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Sylvarcon 2049: A Cybersecurity Aventure
description: A thrilling cyberpunk adventure packed with hacking and digital forensics challenges where the player will experience an in-depth immersion into the realm of cybersecurity.

title: Hot Guns: International Missions
description: Your conventional methods of operation are "shoot first then shoot again!"

title: Kleopatra
description: Kleopatra is a hybrid Visual Novel / Action RPG that combines a retro cyberpunk noir narrative with stat-based shooting gallery combat.

title: Dimension M
description: Survival maze game, survive inside the maze to collect coins, get boosts and frighten the goopies

title: Marine Survivors
description: You are military volunteer. what? you did not volunteer? It's too late! You are already in the middle of the battlefield. kill the alien for the humanity! Marine Survivors is simple action rogue lite game. kill aliens, earn exp gem, upgrade your weapon. unlock various collection.

title: Beat Aimer!
description: Beat Aimer! is a rhythm shooter where you shoot to the beat. Get your mouse and headset ready, this game will test your rhythm and aim - pull off sick flicks to the beat and track to the bass!

title: Takoyaki Party Survival
description: You should consume a good balance of protein, carbohydrates, and fats to survive. The nutritional balance changes depending on the ingredients you put in your takoyaki. If you are overloaded with calories, you will be too full to eat, so please consume calories by squatting.

title: The Backrooms Footage
description: You have found a camera with a footage in it. For some reason you can't rewind the video, and as soon as you try winding it forward you find yourself in the Backrooms. Figure out whats in the footage and try to ESCAPE AS FAST AS POSSIBLE!

title: Dark Egg
description: A surrealist text-based RPG. You will explore an island, solve puzzles, and fight enemies, all in your attempt to get the Dark Egg.

title: Al Qmrah Restaurant
description: Survive the night in AL QMRAH RESTAURANT with a 4-Player co-op survival horror set in a real-life restaurant, players take on the roles of restaurant workers completing closing tasks while facing haunted kitchen creatures and keeping the restaurant stable to find there way out.

title: Endure Island
description: Survive on an ever-changing desert island! The goal of the player is to survive as long as possible on a deserted island, while keeping the changes under control. Keep the fight going by balancing the acquisition of weapons with keeping the changes on the deserted island in check.

title: They Came From Dimension X
description: A sci-fi horror first person shooter where gravity is only as consistent as the ground your boots are stepping upon. Navigate labyrinthine research stations, strange alien planets and escheresque eldritch tombs while surviving your maddened colleagues, monstrous entities, and worse.

title: Gunfire Reborn: Visitors of Spirit Realm
description: 2 new heroes are ready to join your adventure, as well as 4 powerful new weapons. Unlock them and prepare to explore the possibilities of new combinations and the refreshing combat experience!

title: Puzzle: Nature 2
description: Puzzle: Nature 2 - Meet the continuation of the first part of the game! The game is a cute and colorful puzzle game.

title: Double Damnation
description: Kill fast. Die faster. Abuse Immortality! Together...

title: Amaya's Lost Soul
description: Welcome to Amaya's Lost Soul. In this 2d Action Game you play as Amaya the daughter of an all and mighty great “Creator” the leader of the out raiders. You Amaya are tasked taking down a kingdom in this choice driven 2d action platformer.

title: Farewell Sen
description: Make friends with ghosts!

title: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2023
description: Draft Day Sports: College Football 2023 puts you in the role of head coach for your favorite college football team. Recruit, gameplan and make the right calls on the field to lead your team to the top of the ranks and the college football championship.

title: Castle of Full Moon
description: Elf girls marry into a mysterious castle and reveal the horrific truth.

title: Blacksmith Weapon Merchant
description: Welcome new warriors looking for their dream weapon, collect the needed resources, craft and sell them their desired weapon. Upgrade your garden so you can collect exotic resources and complete more lucrative recipes.

title: Windsurfing MMX
description: The development team of ”Windsurfing The Game” worked on providing a close-to-reality simulation of windsurfing. The aim is to provide as much as possible of the fun and excitement this sport gives.

title: DodgeKing
description: Grab your knight and enter the robot-infested gauntlet to be the next DodgeKing! In this Action-Roguelike with Grid-based Movement, dodge, jump, and parry incoming attacks to gain upgrades, collectibles, and more! Try to deliver the lost crown in one attempt or die trying...

title: Lucky Stamina
description: A crossover between the lucky and the unlucky! Lucky stamina!

title: Furry Sex: Pirates
description: Furry Sex: Pirates - is an casual Battle Simulator with unique adult only scenes. You need to win battle, and pass the level to open amazing arts and videos with our furry female-pirates.

title: A Tale of Paper: Refolded
description: A Tale of Paper: Refolded is a puzzle-platformer that tells the story of Line, a magical character made of paper who uses origami to change shape. Transform into a frog, rocket, bird and more as Line embarks on an emotional journey to fulfill the dream of its creator.

title: Mystery Solitaire: Powerful Alchemist 3
description: Solve the secret of potion-making! Solitaire game in the genre of medieval alchemy entourage.

title: Castlemaze: Ojou-sama kara no Chousen
description: A doujin game by YuuYuutei based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Buy Hyacinths
description: A colourful narrative adventure game. You're one of the first sheep to attend university. Roam the campus, attend lectures by day and enjoy friend-time at night. Discover campus truths, and sniff out secrets. Live the life of a campus sheep, but beware: not everybody wants to see a sheep graduate!

title: Magnet Effect
description: This is a story of sending a poor robot home, and very few succeed!

title: Ars Notoria
description: Explore the fantasy world of Ars Notoria, a survival-action RPG set inside an open-world sandbox that lets you hunt powerful possessed creatures. Strike out on your own or play together with friends to build a sprawling faction, utilizing deep crafting mechanics and strategic recruiting of allies.

title: Lost Lagoon: The Trail of Destiny
description: A turbulent balloon ride across the ocean crash-lands you on a strange island. Stranger now because the accident wiped your memory clean and there are no answers to any questions. A map slightly jolts your mind with the thought that you are meant to be here, but where exactly are you and where is everybody else? Only by trekking through the landscape of this island can you figure out why you are here, and why you have placed yourself in such a dire circumstance. Search the island coasts and interior to recover your memory. Investigate an ancient temple, a sunken ship, and gloomy catacombs to find answers. Uncover helpful items, solve intriguing puzzles, and capture images within stunning locations. Each clue brings you closer to unveiling all of the truths, and perhaps your ultimate destiny.

title: Amanda's Magic Book
description: Amanda's Magic Book brings magic into Match 3. The sequel to Amanda's Sticker Book, Amanda finds herself pulled into the very pages of a mystical tome. Solve dozens of challenging puzzles in an all-new story spanning 5 chapters and realms. Restore the world with unlockable upgrades and find tools and powerups to help. Find the missing pages of Amanda's Magic Book today!

title: Adventures of DaKoo the Dragon
description: Adventures of DaKoo the Dragon has over 150 levels, using a randomized vortex level rollout to make every run of the game unique. Animations, enemy spawning, and attacks are all randomized to enhance the immersion. With multiple ways to attack you will take on 5 Bosses among multiple obstacles.

title: Top Down Zombies
description: Coursing with adrenaline, this ‘top-down’ shooter will push your skill to the limit. Sprint, dash, and blast through endless waves of Reddz while upgrading your loadout to build your firepower. Do whatever you can to survive the red fury.

title: Laser Lab
description: Laser Lab is a 3D puzzle game with the theme of exploration and interaction. The player is trapped in a locked laboratory surrounded by laser beams, and those who reroute the beams' path can escape from the chamber. It contains multiple puzzle levels, casual and challenging. Never miss it!

title: Guilded Hearts
description: In this BxB visual novel, dive into the fantasy MMO world of Lost Heroes and discover true love among your guildmates.

title: Project Exo
description: Project Exo is a Movement based puzzle, Platforming game. You will be soaring thought levels using your rocket launcher and rocket boots to navigate each puzzle. Timers on each level will track your time per level and overall time for each level combined.

title: Dimensional Gears
description: Dimensional Gears is a 2.5D puzzle platformer that takes place in a dystopian steam-punk future where household appliances are the only sentient beings left. Shift dimensions in order explore a dangerous 2.5D environment, escape the factory, and save your friends!

title: Ash Battle
description: Ash tries to survive on an unknown planet, takes his weapon and sword, where many enemies will come to kill him. Ash Battle is a minimalist Bullet Hell game, trying to survive thousands of enemies.

title: Crisp's Charging Challenge
description: Play as our hero, Crisp, and navigate the puzzles by using the elements of electricity, ice, and fire. Ascend the castle and complete the challenge! OR Kick back and enjoy some fishing, who knows what's in those waters! Go beyond the challenge, create your own, or try challenges from others!

title: Twogether: Project Indigos Chapter 1
description:
Twogether: Project Indigos is a single player third person puzzle adventure. Set in the frightening Hexacells facilities, Twogether will pose original puzzles that will only be solvable by collaboration.

The game will make the players examine, evaluate and act according to the elements in their surroundings and the powers of the two protagonists, as if they were to escape from a gloomy Escape Room.

title: A Tale of Paper: Refolded - Digital Deluxe Edition
description: A Tale of Paper: Refolded Digital Deluxe Edition includes the full game with 3 prequal chapters and the official soundtrack featuring 26 songs composed by Èric Seró and Adrián Berenguer.

title: Football Club Management 2023
description: Take control of a Real Football Club or create your own club, in Football Club Manager 2023!

title: Finding Ice
description: In this one-of-a-kind story game, the player must explore vast worlds through a third-person Arctic Wolf, complete puzzles, collect items and re-connect with nature.

Welcome to a Victorian town where you'll explore this world through the eyes of a runaway high school girl. Starting off with waking up in a haunted house! A freak is haunting the school?! The town at night is creepy too! The high school girl Taffy will experience a series of supernatural stories

title: Stacky Dash
description: Dash your hero across the mazes, stack the tiles higher and higher, and reach for the skies!

title: Doxxed
description: After a botched face lift, a movie star confines herself to her penthouse apartment where she learns that her fans’ obsession may have turned fatal. Is her apartment really the safest place to be? Follow the clues and try to stay sane when it seems like the entire world has turned against you.

title: East Trade Tycoon
description: East Trade Tycoon is a trading simulator game.In the game,you can from zero to hero.By trading markets, build a business,earn money,level up, investing accurately, and manage family to become a trading tycoon!

title: Stanislav
description: Help Stanislav escape the prison and defeat the plague to save the world, in super-tight 2D pixel platformer.

title: ATCo2
description: ATCo2 is a casual/serious game for aviation fans that want to learn more about sustainability impacts of aviation. Play as an ATC, control your planes on different locations around the world, and keep an eye on your total CO2 emissions.

title: Catlike Magic
description: Catlike Magic is a top-down auto-shooter where you attempt to dodge groups of gnomes, goblins and other types of short people. Learn magical skills, buy and upgrade items and then complain about getting destroyed by a swarm of lizards after only buying offensive items in this slightly unhinged game.

title: Star Head
description: A head-launching sci-fi action adventure where you'll master the art of dual-point control. Overcome mechanical adversaries through precise skill or clever tactics - your head, your rules.​

title: Paranoia Place
description: Paranoia Place is a 2 player online co-op survival horror game. Together or alone, you will need to solve puzzles, find items and run from the bloodthirsty demonic killer.

title: Dream Logic
description: Dream Logic is a story driven first-person atmospheric horror game which takes place in liminal spaces. Explore various nostalgic, dreamlike, uncanny environments while avoiding entities that are attempting to murder you.

title: Cross the Hell Master
description: "Cross the Hell Master" is a 2D cartoon style platform jumping game.

title: Celadon
description: A tightly designed, precision platformer with a large variety of mechanics. Jump, dash and teleport your way past spikes to get to the end. Use multiple move sets over seven chapters. For players of all skill levels to enjoy!

title: Kitty's Venture
description: Join the kitty in a challenging fast-paced adventure to hunt for achievements. Kitty's Venture is a 2D side-scroller platformer game where you take control of a cute kitty. If you are a Steam achievement hunter, and love cats, then this is the game for you!

title: The Top
description: The Top is a simple precision platformer about climbing a mountain.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Chile
description: Puzzles of Chile!

title: The Nameless
description: A classic survival horror game with themes that are loosely based on the works of H.P. Lovecraft.

title: Box Party
description:
Box Party is a cartoony retro FPS where you shoot foods and go to parties.

Along the way you'll find cool weapons to use, fellow partygoers to talk to, optional side quests to complete, and more importantly, plenty of food to fight.

title: Gungrave G.O.R.E: Day One Edition
description:
Gungrave G.O.R.E is a stylish third-person action shooter by South Korean studio IGGYMOB, starring Grave, a resurrected former mafia hitman turned one-man army. Set in a near-future world threatened by the alien drug Seed, the game follows Grave’s gory, bullet-filled quest for vengeance across Southeast Asia while protecting his adopted daughter, Mika.

Day One Edition content:
- Death Ronin Grave
- O.D. Grave

title: JR's
description: JR's is an all-around investigation type FNaF fan-game. Each night, a select bunch of animatronics becomes haunted, and it's your job to weed out which ones are haunted, and which ones aren't. Search for clues and hints throughout the nights, in order to lead you who is possessed.

title: PGA Tour 2K23
description: Hit the links with more swagger in PGA TOUR 2K23. Now featuring playable male and female pros, including Tiger Woods, new licensed courses, more control options, an authentic PGA TOUR MyCareer, Course Designer, and new MyPlayer Skills and Archetypes! PGA TOUR 2K23. More Golf. More Game.

title: PGA Tour 2K23: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition contains:
- The Standard Edition
- The Michael Jordan Bonus Pack
- Deluxe Bonus Pack
- Golden Club Pack, and dual-gen entitlement.

title: Meiling to Cirno no Yokai no Yama Daibouken
description: A doujin game by YuuYuutei based on the Touhou Project series.

title: New Tales from the Borderlands
description: Decide the fates of altruistic scientist Anu, her ambitious, "streetwise" brother Octavio, and the fierce, frogurt-slinging Fran. Claw and con your way through five thrilling chapters!

title: New Tales from the Borderlands: Deluxe Edition
description: Includes the Nintendo Switch digital version of New Tales from the Borderlands. Control your corner of the universe with New Tales from the Borderlands - Deluxe Edition! This Edition includes: - New Tales from the Borderlands Full Game (Digital) - Tales…

title: Bratz: Flaunt Your Fashion
description: Play as your favorite Bratz character and begin your globe-trotting adventure to become the world’s best fashion reporter.

title: Fog & Silver
description: Fog & Silver is set in a fantastic, mystical, and dark reimagined Europe of the late 19th century; with a focus on atmosphere-driven story, powerful items, and in-depth character customization.​

title: Cursed Broom
description: Fly with Maya through this charming 2D platformer! Find your way through the different parts of Maya's hometown, collect artifacts to gain different powers and experience a heartfelt tale of self-discovery and friendship.

title: Xyz Crossing
description: Dungeon crawler RPG. Two college students and their professor must fight powerful beings and an evil corporation to uncover the dark secrets of the popular monster-collecting app known as, "MeGiDo" and preserve the balance of the world.

title: City Bus Manager
description: Build your own bus depot from scratch and create your personal bus routes in City Bus Manager. Play your own home town or any famous city in the world with real map data. Buy buses, maintain them, take care of your staff and lead your bus company to become the #1 in town!

title: Humanica
description: Humanica is a city-builder game about an ancient settlement, featuring vast technological development. Experience the journey from sticks and stones to iron tools and windmills! Survive, explore, build, discover!

title: Monster Loves You Too!
description: Live the life of a Monster within a society of fantastic creatures. Hunt for food, make friends and allies, and battle your own instincts in order to rise above your humble origins in the sequel to the best-selling Monster Loves You!

title: Finding Mosey
description: Find your cat Mosey, choosing your degree of destruction and dedication. Fight, sneak, or talk your way into new areas and upgrade your character along the way as the search gets messy. Loot ridiculous items and discover hidden stories that help you explore this open world.

title: Meow Defence
description: You will drive a spaceship, smash the bricks surrounding the Meow star, and rescue the trapped cats

title: Die O'Clock
description: Die o' clock is a solo dark and disturbing escape game. The clock gives you a chance to start over. Find the twelve keys necessary to win its challenge.

title: This Thing of Ours
description: Welcome to New Temperance, known as the last frontier for the Italian-American mafia. The two controlling La Cosa Nostra families are locked in a peaceful rivalry for the city's rackets. You play as a young hood named Vinny that's in a neighborhood-based crew known as The Beacon Hill Crew.

title: Asian Truck Simulator
description: Welcome to the heavy artillery of truck drivers in this simulation game of Asian Truck Simulator

title: Talon City: Death from Above
description: You’re a clever owl lawyer out of your depth, searching for a missing client. With enemies at every turn, can you survive and save the day?

title: Morning Kiss
description: Morning Kiss is an addicting game in which you have to solve puzzles with Lovely Girls.The game is perfect for relaxing.

title: Lempo
description: Find your way back home before Metsänpeitto, an otherworldly plane of existence, consumes you. Lempo is a psychological horror game inspired by Finnish mythology with an emphasis on exploration.

title: Splash Ship
description: Splash Ship is an arcade game in which you control a boat that moves along a zigzag water canal, where there are sharp turns and dangers lurk at every turn.

title: Open Door
description: A science experiment in which no one survives, in a first-person survival horror game made by one developer As a random person who is trapped, try to get out and find out what's going on in this godforsaken place

title: Slave Princess Finne: Why Did She Sell Out Her Own Kingdom?
description: This is a war waged between the "princesses" representing the whole race to bet on world hegemony. Once upon a time, it was the human princess who won the battle. From then on, the elves were reduced to "slaves". A thousand years later. The war of the princesses begins again.

title: Retrowave '84
description: A Stylish Retro-FPS where time can be slowed with a single jump... Also includes a hard hitting arsenal of weapons to blast mo-foes away in satisfying style!

title: Cursed House 11
description: Solve tricky Match3 levels, play bonus games and lift the curse!

title: The Madness of Death
description: The Madness of Death is a first person psychological horror game. Explore the house in order to escape from it and break the curse of the Death Stone. You will have to solve the puzzles in order to advance and try not to stay in the dark.

title: Kardun
description: Plan moves of your own and the moves of your foes. Unusual experimental button pressing combat game.

title: Goman: Stuck in the Avici Hell
description: Goman is a Infinitely looped scroll style battle action game.

title: Let's Park: Backyard Edition
description: Welcome to the world of Parking Professionals School! With the help of an engine from the 70's, you will learn to park in such a way that no obstacle will be a problem in a future.

title: Necropolis of the Angels
description: Play as a Fallen Angel fighting a host of Enemies through The Necropolis of the Angels, The Hidden Angel City, The Underworld and The Third City of Hell. An exciting third-person shooter where the player will have to use intelligence as well as the trigger finger. Male and female protagonists.

title: Hentai Pussy 4
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Sexy Hentai Puzzle
description: Our first game, Sexy Hentai Puzzle is a light-hearted and enjoyable puzzle game with light visuals adding Anime elements to complete the puzzle to unlock the pictures.

title: Lux Ex: Cyber Initiation
description: Destroy bugs and glitches in your astral body to recover data from the source of the light of your soul. Lux Ex - Cyber Initiation is a Cyberspace Shooter following up Lux Ex - Legacy, this time featuring multiple levels, improved graphics and a more contemporary approach.

title: Sticky Steve's Sticky Situation
description: Our friend Steve here, has found himself in a bit of a sticky situation, stuck at the bottom of a rather elaborate pit. He's going to need your guidance to get back out, but it's going to be tricky.

title: Bugz Bows & Curses
description: Collect all the Bugz Bows and Curses you can in a procedurally generated rouge like. But be carefull as other bugz can and will get mad.

title: Knights vs Nature
description: Engage in epic battles against nature. In Poema's take on the classic tower defense style. Build and upgrade your towers. Grow your reputation with your favorite faction. Uncover and reclaim the world!

title: Shoot the Buuuuuuugs
description: Shoot the Buuuuuuugs is hardcore arena survival game, collect crystals, kill bugs and have real fun!

title: Tap the Blocks
description: Tap the blocks is the one-screen time killer puzzle! Gain an enormous score by removing stacks of blocks with the same color. Your smart clicks are the only way to remove blocks before falling into the abyss.

title: Spam Text
description: Test your vocabulary and quick-thinking! Spam Text is a Casual word game with endless falling blocks, where your words make a difference to score the highest possible points

title: Kyivan Rus
description: A historical turn-based strategy game, where you evolve as a leader, gather armies, research technologies, found cities, build the economy, unite the tribes and expand your lands to strengthen your country! Play in a single-player campaign or skirmish against AI.

title: Ghost Shadow
description:
Single-player dynamic FPS with bright top AAA graphics, upgrade systems in steampunk style with psychedelic mechanics, puzzles, and horror elements.

You are an invincible cyborg, using frightening combo attacks from your skills, possession of other characters, and a huge arsenal of weapons, collect all the artifacts, solve the riddles of your erased memory, and find a way out of the ghostly trap, from the shadow of your mind.

title: Valhalla: Awakening of Valkyrie
description: This is a casual game that combines "match three + collection + dress up". With the advent of Ragnarok, the Protoss forces are insufficient, and most of the Valkyries in the Hall of Valor are living in various parts of the continent as human beings. You must lift the seal on them to summon them.

title: Another Farm Roguelike
description: Another Farm Roguelike is a 2D farming & crafting game with rougelike elements where your job is to earn as much money as possible to pay the rent. Start from scratch and build the most profitable farm you can make as soon as possible. Work hard to be able to afford the rent.

title: Ean's End
description: A word game about choosing paths and actions for a little boy named Ean, and even if your choices are the same every time, the outcome is likely to be completely different. Try to find all the endings, although it is very difficult.

title: Jurassic Clans
description: Jurassic Clans sets in a world where dinosaurs co-exist with humans. Ensure your people thrive in this dangerous world by surviving and evolving your tribe. Search for resources to expand your village, research technologies, defend your people from predators and prepare for the upcoming apocalypse.

title: Alpha Box
description: This is a rhythm parkour game. The pace of the game is very tight. The goal of the game is to score as many points as possible. .

title: Evercraft Mechanic: Sandbox
description: Physics-based cross-play mechanic simulator. Become a real engineer, create new mechanisms and build your worlds. Craft, join & share your creation across PC and mobile devices. Play with your friends beyond one platform.

title: The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos - Back to the Futon
description: Once again, your favourite party of unlikely heroes are in a bit of a pickle: arrested by the Dungeon's Fund, they have to accomplish a dangerous mission to earn back their freedom.

title: BallisticNG: Maceno Island
description:
Welcome to Maceno Island, a man made paradise home to high rise sea fronts, massive jungles, precarious mountain thrills and an AGL newcomer with a rich history in sea bed mineral mining and designer sandals.

Maceno Island introduces 6 new tracks, all playable in forward and reverse, a new campaign and a new set of colorful liveries.

title: Oriental Sword
description: Be a young sword man to explore and save the world. A turn-based WuXia RPG game with strategic combat system.

title: The Forest of Drizzling Rain
description: Alas, it was the "promised place," where Shiori was never meant to go. Finally, a remake of The Forest of Drizzling Rain, that masterpiece of an exploration horror game with multiple endings from the creator of the big hit Angels of Death!

title: Math Tower 2
description: Math Tower is a game of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division for which you must run, jump and catch the correct answers in balls, bubbles, frogs and birds.

title: Cave Crawler: A Retro Exploration Adventure
description: Embark on an adventure inspired by Gameboy era games. Earn various tools, and use them to collect different resources. Sell these resources, and build your own city! Explore towns, meet new people, and complete quests.

title: Puck Runner
description: A challenging endless runner inspired by air hockey. Physically hit the puck to with your mouse to avoid obstacles, with your control being constantly threatened by ever-increasing speed and complexity.

title: Quantum Gravity
description: Quantum Gravity is space themed bullet hell platformer. The game's main mechanic is inverting the gravity to hover through space. It features long-range fights but also melees fighting. Quantum Gravity has a variety of enemies to fight against but also 3 game modes including an infinity game mode,

title: Parry Nightmare
description: As a Soul, you, the player, will team up with Honno and survive this Nightmare! Parry the enemy attacks, fill up your gauge, and destroy your enemies in a sweep! The way you evolve your partner Honno would be the key strategy to break through this Nightmare!

title: Climb It!
description: Take on the challenge and dive into the intense and thrilling world of free solo climbing! Test your strength and resilience as you scale dangerous routes where every misstep can cost you everything. Become a Free Solo master and conquer the summit!

title: Call of Duty: Vanguard - Season Five
description: Everything good must come to an end… but bad is forever. Last Stand gathers Call of Duty’s most notorious villains for an epic finale. Deploy as one of four of the biggest villains in Call of Duty history — the charismatic Raul Menendez, the ruthless Khaled Al-Asad, the brainwashed Gabriel T. Rorke, and the merciless He “Seraph” Zhen-Zhen. They’re hell-bent on revenge — if it’s the last thing they do.

title: Shiver: Moonlit Grove - Collector’s Edition
description: Shiver: Moonlit Grove – Collector’s Edition is a premium release of the third installment in the Shiver hidden object adventure series. Developed and published by Artogon Games and Big Fish Games, this edition expands the original game with exclusive content including a bonus chapter, replayable puzzles, and downloadable extras. You play as a young doctor sent to replace your missing foster father, only to uncover dark secrets in a mysterious village.

title: Esophaguys
description: Esophaguys is a silly local multiplayer party game where you play as old folks with elongating necks. Stretch your necks together to find your lost kin and compete against each other for long-necked glory!

title: Bloom: Roots of Renewal
description: Bloom: Roots of Renewal is a first person shooter inspired by Hexen and Quake. Use your skills of magic and maneuverability to quell the overgrowth and free the forest and lost village of these creatures.

title: Imago: Beyond the Nightmares
description: Imago is a psychological horror game set in a dark and hostile world between dream and reality, in which mysterious creatures hide inscrutable secrets. Play Marty Burton, the detective of dreams, to unravel the case and bring home a child who has disappeared under mysterious circumstances.

title: The Darkest Files
description: The Darkest Files is a historical investigation and courtroom game based on true crimes of the Nazi era. Investigate cold cases, search for clues, interrogate witnesses, immerse the crimes and defend your case in court to bring the perpetrators to justice.

title: The Proponent
description: What if the city is a living being with its own essence? The Proponent is a first-person horror where you take on the role of a man trapped in a high-rise building and try to find a way out.

title: World Fighting Soccer 22
description: Compete with your friends in an exciting new style of Soccer! Dazzle your fans and confuse your foes all with the press of a button! From the ground or high in the sky, strike and win the day!

title: Ensora
description: Having lost contact with the Earth, the colonists split into groups in a desperate struggle for the remnants of food and resources. Can you fight back against bands of thugs? Will you uncover the secrets of the powerful Corporation? Do you have a chance to return home?

title: A Long Time Ago
description: A Long Time Ago is a 3D RPG, Adventure, Mystery game. A terrible accident happened and ever since you cannot wake up or even remember who you are.You will have to search deep inside your subconscious where all the truth about who you are is hidden and become who you used to be.

title: In the Days of My Life
description: Management and life-simulation Game with elaborate Relationships, where players manage their character’s actions and activities as they explore topics about self-discovery, parent-children relationships, friendships, and growing up as a College Student.

title: The Hideaway
description: The Hideaway is an exploration and discovery low-poly game with Hardcore survival mechanics. Lost and wandering in the wilderness without food, water and weapons, your objective will be to survive and contact an aid center as soon as possible without harming your environnement in any way

title: Tetris Girls
description: The new block elimination tests your hand speed and brain power! ! There are also beautiful CG rewards! !

title: Across the Globe
description: A nation simulator set in 19th-century. Acquire resources, research technologies, build infrastructure, conquer foes. Experience dynamic population, realistic economy and great power diplomacy.

title: Nosy Little Fly
description: Nosy Little Fly is a funny 2D side scroller with an unique movement mechanic. Instead of moving sideways as usual, you can add force to your character in any direction. You must manage you inertia in order to finish the levels. It is a challenge to your motor skills, filled with humor.

title: Moon Whalers
description: Cutest Bullet Hell In the Galaxy! Recruit captains and crewmates to become a Moonwhaler! Battle through endless waves of Space Whales in search of the legendary White Whale.

title: Call of Dusk
description: Call of Dusk is a multiplayer game where the player will venture into a very tense night not only facing demonic creatures but other players.

title: PBA Pro Bowling 2023
description: The ultimate bowling game is back with PBA Pro Bowling 2023! Become a PBA legend with the completely re-designed single player Career Mode or compete in Online matches and tournaments against your friends and rivals as yourself or as any of today’s top PBA bowlers.

title: Little Hellions
description: 4 friends. 1 weirdo mechanic. Throw away your friends with your trusty Trick Hook in this passive aggressive fighter where you can’t fight!

title: Warlocks Quarry
description: Use your skills in looting, fighting, exploring and base building to survive and progress in Warlocks world.

title: The Ramsey
description: The Ramsey is a 2D exploration platform game that solves puzzles using various weapons by controlling cute squirrel characters. Explore the maze of islands and defeat the villains who threaten the peace of the planet.

title: Bride of Darkness
description: Maria's plans for the future are completely ruined, as her parents unexpectedly marry her off. But an unwanted marriage is not the worst thing that awaits Maria, and her own life is at risk.

title: Hot Milf 8
description: "Hot Mom 8" is not just a game, but a whole art.

title: Lofi: A Year to Fulfill my Dream.mp3
description: This is a story about a young woman who thinks and chases her dreams bravely under the pressure of reality and family. In order to prove that she has the ability to support herself with music as a career, Lu must show her strength by winning the annual award of the streaming platform.

title: The Last Medic
description: The Last Medic is a 2D precision platformer set in space. Earth was hit by an asteroid and you are the last surviving medic. Your space suit is equipped with a jetpack, a dash booster, and a healing device. Use these tools as you travel from planet to planet on your way to save Earth.

title: Voxabular P.I: Penny's First Case
description: Learn Spanish by playing, not by studying! Practice languages by solving mysteries in this mix of the classic text adventure and point-and-click genres.

title: Inhabit
description: Make your way around your home and surrounding areas, practicing healthy habits and exploring the world in this open ended slice of life puzzle game.

title: Running on Empty
description: Running on Empty is a minimal yet deep post-apocalyptic role-playing game with resource management mechanics (in 64x64 retro pixel graphics!)

title: The Book of Aaru
description: Seek ultimate Egyptian god power and reveal it’s mystery. Fight demons in precision & rhythm based combat, while crawling trough living and everchanging dungeon of Aaru. Experience true rogue-like game with no compromise.

title: The Resurrection of Amelia: Across Two Worlds
description: One night, Amelia was involved in a dispute, died in a car accident, and then strangely resurrected. Amelia woke up and found herself in a strange place. She needed to escape here as soon as possible.

title: Eat Fish, Get Achievements
description: Eat Fish, Get Achievements is a relaxing arcade-style game where you eat fish and unlock new playable characters. The game involves moving around a 2d environment and eating smaller fish than yourself. Some fish have abilities and some change the rules of the game. Get achievements and high scores!

title: Pens: Ballad of the Erasers
description: A thrilling action/adventure platformer where you jump, run and shoot your way through a weaving narrative in a comical world!

title: May's Mysteries: The Secret of Dragonville Remastered
description: Follow May, an independent and charismatic girl, in her quest to find her missing brother. An exciting puzzle adventure with hidden object elements.

title: Find Your Wings
description: A bite-sized tower defense roguelike!

title: Simple Trains
description: A game about building an efficient railroad network to keep all the commuters happy.

title: Backrooms VHS
description: If you’re not careful and noclip out of reality in the wrong areas, you’ll end up in the Backrooms, where it’s nothing but the stink of old moist carpet, the madness of mono-yellow, the endless background noise of fluorescent lights at maximum hum-buzz.

title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Belgium Through the Lens
description: Enjoy a personal zen moment filled with casual gaming by solving easy, intermediate and more challenging digital jigsaw puzzles with an ever increasing number of pieces to puzzle together.

title: Imperiums: Rome vs. Carthage
description: Imperiums: Rome vs Carthage will test your tactical and strategic genius to the limits. Can the established empires defend the current world order, or will they be forced to make room for new rising states? Go through the fires of war, be destroyed or rise from the ashes to become the new hegemon!

title: Blaze in Space: Beat a-Maze
description: Fast-paced, brain teasing arcade game with competitive focus. Find an optimal route and speed through a blazing maze where you pilot ever-accelerating ship.

title: Cuties Hacked: Oh No Someone Stole My Photos!
description: Cuties Hacked is a new spin on the classic arcade formula of Xonix, that rewards your reflexes and skills with sets of beautifully crafted arts featuring some of the hottest girls you have ever seen.

title: Tower Defense: Infinite War
description: In the far future, people build a base on a strange planet they don't know about to protect their limited resources. Protect your base from the incessant invasion of extraterrestrial beings!

title: Siren Head: Remastered
description: SouthPoint is terrfied by an enormous giant monster. Mobile Version Available!

title: Phantom Recall
description: Phantom Recall delivers an exhilarating arcade experience, thrusting you into a frenetic arena FPS where every move counts. Master the art of repurposing your lines of fire on the fly amidst a relentless bullet hell to ascend the ranks and dominate the brutal leaderboard.

title: Bash Sports Online Bowling
description: BASH GAMING STUDIO PRESENTS: BASH SPORTS ONLINE BOWLING! PLAY HEAD TO HEAD WITH YOUR ONLINE FRIENDS, or practice at home! 8 player online game play, multiple characters to choose from and some secrets that will BLOW YOU AWAY! Do you have what it takes to join the SPARTA CLUB??? See you ONLINE!

title: W.R.M.
description: You are part of W.R.M trying to survive in a hostile world, plunge into the depths of the earth, and discover secrets long forgotten. Gather Anthracite. SURVIVE!

title: Soul Hackers 2: Bonus Story Arc - The Lost Numbers
description:
Grants access to "The Lost Numbers" bonus story arc and new dungeon.

Centered around a new Devil Summoner, Nana, you'll experience this side-story over the course of multiple requests (recommended levels ranging 19-99), which will appear gradually at Club Cretaceous as you progress through the main story.

title: Sabre Wulf
description:
One of the most beloved ZX Spectrum games of all time, this remake of Sabre Wulf stays faithful to the original - including the brutal difficulty!

Alone in the jungle, you must find the four parts of the amulet to allow passage past the gatekeeper and escape.
With deadly beasts jumping at you from all sides and the dreaded Wulf patrolling his territory,
you certainly have your work cut out.

title: Touhou Gekkatan
description: A doujin game by YuuYuutei based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Polars
description: A story-driven, first-person, physics-based puzzle game focusing on magnetic interactions.

title: Haunted Halls: Nightmare Dwellers - Collector's Edition
Alice to Marisa to Inakunatta Shanghai Ningyou
description: A doujin game by YuuYuutei based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Farming Simulator 22: ERO Grapeliner Series 7000
description: Prepare for grape harvesting season! With the ERO Grapeliner Series 7000, a new grape harvester becomes available at virtual dealerships near your farm. Authentically digitized, the machine from ERO harvests the delicious fruit with extreme care and efficiency.

title: BirdsBorough: Town of Alchemy
description: Build and run your own alchemy store in the ominous town of BirdsBorough...

title: Minecraft: Angry Birds
description: The Pigs are back to their old tricks, and it's up to you to stop them! Playing as Red, Chuck, Bomb, and other members of The Flock, your mission is to rescue your friends, save the eggs, and stop the pesky Pigs' grand plans. With each rescued bird, you'll unlock a new playable character with unique skills to help you pop more Pigs and topple more towers!

title: Touhou Kouhentan
description: A doujin game by YuuYuutei based on the Touhou Project series.

title: S&M: FL
description:
"S&M: FL" is a board + action reaction class of inverse tower defense game. Players need to roll dice on the board to move, and through various actions to eliminate the enemy stronghold, finally bring peace to the village!
In combat, players can make use of the Shield counter mechanic and use different skills to fight enemies.
Shield counter is when you look at the right moment to block an enemy's attack and use it to trigger skills.

title: Homeseek
description: Homeseek is a post-apocalyptic survival base builder placed at the beginning of the next century. There is almost nothing left of the Old World. Overpopulation, environmental exploitation, and complete disregard for nature resulted in the depletion of drinkable water by 2040. It took less than 15 years after that for the complete annihilation of our civilization. But a few lucky souls survived the destruction inside enormous bunkers. Now they have to get back to the surface and rebuild civilization.

title: Edge of Collapse
description: In the dead of winter, an EMP attack destroys the US power grid. For Hannah, however, it’s the best day in 5 years. She was imprisoned in a psycho's basement - explosion releases the lock of her prison. Now she can begin the search for her family while feeling the breath of her abuser on her neck.

title: Coastline to Atmosphere
description:
Coastline to Atmosphere is a big Single Player Modification for Half-Life 2. It's actually 15 Single Player maps with a story that links them together.

Leon Stephan Brinkmann took about 1 year to create this. He's done an excelent job to create this. With new models, such as a Keycard model, Tree models, a new shiny metal texture. And new sounds from the games Medal of Honor, Call of Duty, Soldier of Fortune 2, Max Payne 2, Cold Winter and a whole lot of ambient sounds.

title: Dimday Red
description: An Interactive Fiction RPG where you play as Cillian, an assassin working for the Syndicates. Pick and combine Trait cards to shape your personality, choose how you live on the final days of Earth and roll the dice: if you’re lucky, you won’t burn before the world does.

title: Weekday Warrior
description: Weekday Warrior is a mod for Half-Life 2. It was developed by students at the Guildhall at the Southern Methodist University (SMU) in University Park, Texas. Development started in January 2006 and finished June 7, 2006, the date the mod was released. It received the Best Mod and Best Singleplayer FPS Mod awards in the 2007 Independent Games Festival.

title: The Necro-Nom-icon
description: Follow the recipe-like instructions of the Necro-Nom-icon and perform rituals to make contact with the Ancient Ones. Will it provide the answers you have been looking for? A reason for those odd dreams? Or will you succumb to madness first?

title: Dune: Awakening
description: Dune: Awakening is an open-world survival game set on the desert planet Arrakis. Players create a custom character and must manage thirst, maintain stillsuits, and contend with environmental hazards like sandstorms, extreme heat, and roaming sandworms. The game involves scavenging resources, crafting equipment, building shelters, and competing with other players to harvest and transport spice. As players progress, they advance through phases from basic survival to leading a guild, eventually participating in faction warfare between House Atreides and House Harkonnen. The game features single-player, and multiplayer which can be fully played in PvE with dedicated PvP zones.

title: Moving Out 2
description:
Moving Out 2 is a video game in which payers attempt to move objects across various levels without hitting objections. It combines elements of strategy, puzzles, and party video games.

It is a sequel to Moving Out.

title: Tortuga: A Pirate's Tale
description: It’s time to see if ye truly have what it takes to become the greatest pirate of the Caribbean! Set sail on the vast and beautiful Caribbean Sea as players commence their journey with their sights on eternal gold and glory. Choose from 18 unique ship types and customize distinct features from the flag and weaponry to the hull and figurehead. It's a vast world out there, but you are never truly alone, and players will encounter historical pirate captains who they must decide is friend or foe. Take on trading convoys and settlements in tactical turn-based battles to relieve them of the burden of wealth, and then use your (stolen) riches to upgrade your formidable fleet. With a mighty fleet and enough gold, you might be able to keep your crew happy. But be warned! You are an elected captain, after all, and it is your duty to maintain your crew's morale, or else mutiny could be on the horizon…

title: Dying Light 2: Stay Human - Bloody Ties
description: Tempted by riches, fame, and status, Aiden enters a bloodsport tournament where the greatest combatants fight to the death. Face off against the worst of the worst, make new allies, climb up the ladder, and claim the title of the ultimate victor.

title: Bloodsaw
description:
A physics-based action game with multiple game modes, and an advanced damage system.

You can play in multiple game modes, like the Arena, Factory, with more being added almost every update.

You can earn skill points in every game mode, and spend them on character upgrades like impact resistance, more damage, higher lung capacity, etc, and powers, like the Dash, Slow-motion, etc.

With the damage system, every limb can be separately damaged, can bleed, can feel pain, and can even break. You can also get concussions, drown, get melted in lava, get cut by sawblades, stomped on by a hammerhead, and more. Oh, and the same applies for all enemies.

title: Under the Waves
description: Under the Waves is a narrative-driven adventure game about the engulfing power of grief. Set in the depths of the North Sea in a techno-futuristic 1970s, professional diver Stan is struggling to overcome a life-changing loss and embrace a new future. The isolation of the deep sea is a fitting manifestation of his state of mind, and as Stan retreads further into his self-imposed solitude, he starts to experience strange events far beneath the waves. Stuck between life and death, Stan will have to make the most significant choice of his existence.

title: Moonbreaker
description: Moonbreaker is a turn-based strategy, tabletop tactics game. Designed to be a true digital miniatures experience, set in an expansive sci-fi universe crafted by Brandon Sanderson. Direct Captain & Crew to determine the fate of the Reaches in gripping, ever changing competition & adventure.

title: Friends vs. Friends
description: Friends vs Friends is a frantic, online PvP shooter that combines combat and deck building. Choose a character, build your deck, and test your friendship with the craziest card effects. Fast - Fun - Friends!

title: Sweet Dream Succubus: Nightmare Edition
description: Sweet Dream Succubus: Nightmare Edition is the remastered/updated version of an erotic interactive visual novel, created by a collaboration between well-known erotic artist Doxy and popular cosplayer and model, Swimsuit Succubus. The new version features additional content with updated and improved artwork.

title: Stranded: Alien Dawn
description: Brave a new world in Stranded: Alien Dawn, a planet survival sim placing the fate of a small marooned group in your hands. Forge your story through compelling and immersive strategic gameplay as you make vital decisions to protect your survivors.

title: Atlas Fallen
description: Rise from the dust and glide the sands of a timeless land, filled with ancient dangers, mysteries and fragments of the past. Hunt legendary monsters with powerful sand-infused weapons and abilities in spectacular, super-powered combat.

title: Killer Klowns from Outer Space: The Game
description: Plan your own alien invasion and harvest humans as the iconic Killer Klowns, or gather a team of survivors to fight the extraterrestrial threat, in a game based on the ‘80s cult classic movie. Welcome to a new, craazzy take on the asymmetrical multiplayer horror experience!

title: Where Winds Meet
description: Where Winds Meet is a free-to-play wuxia action-adventure RPG set in China during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. Players take on the role of a wandering adventurer known as a youxia, wielding a variety of weapons including swords, spears, fans, and umbrellas, each paired with distinct martial arts styles. The open world spans multiple regions and supports both single-player and multiplayer modes, with cooperative dungeons, PvP arenas, and a range of casual activities. Combat combines light and heavy attacks, martial art skills, mystic arts, and defensive maneuvers like dodges, blocks, and deflects.

title: Phantom Hellcat
description: Phantom Hellcat is a dynamic slasher-platformer with showy combos in a theatrical setting. When demons kidnap Jolene’s mother, the young woman must take the stage and save her—but in the world of plays and props, things are not always what they appear to be.

title: Mingle
description: Find your perfect match in the crowd. Match and merge minglers. Repeat until they're all joined together. 50 unique playable characters.

title: The Finals
description: The Finals is the world’s first Dynamism Shooter, a free-to-play, fast-paced, physics-driven, first-person shooter set on the stage of the biggest Gameshow of the future! Fight for Fans and fortune in fully-destructible, virtual Arenas that guarantee no two rounds will ever play the same!

title: Hitboxer
description: Hitboxer is an action packed "Box vs Box" side-scroller where timing and execution are the keys to victory! Challenge your friends in chaotic free-for-all battles and team based game-modes. Collect power-ups and dodge deadly hazards as you fight for ultimate box supremacy!

title: Wyrdsong
description:
A dark, preternatural historical fantasy open-world RPG set in middle-ages Portugal. It is said to be inspired by "The Witch."

This will be the debut title for Something Wicked Games, which was founded by former Bethesda Game Studios designer Jeff Gardiner and Obsidian Entertainment alumnus Charlie Staples. It will be built in Unreal Engine 5.

title: Slendytubbies II
description:
Slendytubbies II is a sequel of Slendytubbies. It was said to have happened 5 years after the original game. The main goal is the same, collect all the Teletubby custards while being hunted down by gruesome and monstrous versions of the classic Teletubbies you all know and love.

With new maps, new monsters and a new multiplayer mode, Slendytubbies II expands on the terrifying premise of the original game that became a viral hit.

title: Destiny 2: The Witch Queen - Season of Plunder
description: Eramis, awoken from her icy prison by a Dark benefactor, has rallied old pirate lords of Eliksni legend to assist her in recovering lost relics of great power... unless you plunder them first. There is no horizon to reach, no edge to your map, but there most certainly is treasure. Assemble your crew, Guardian.

title: Unsorted VHS
description: "Unsorted VHS" is an atmospheric puzzle horror game. Sort through a box of miscellaneous VHS tapes. Retrace your steps and figure out how you got here. Everything is interlinked, don't you remember?

title: Fushigi no Daibouken: Cirno Kenzan! 2+1
description:
The Indie game in the long running Fushigi no Dungeon RPG series.
Fushigi no Dungeon RPG series is roguelike, and "Fushigi no Daibouken: Cirno Kenzan! 2" is Touhou Project's fan game.

title: Putin In Jail
description: Dictator and war criminal Vladimir Putin is behind bars. Game "Putin in Jail" is a criminal simulator. Your goal is to make the main character survive.

title: Five Night's at Freddy's: The Silver Eyes Fangame
description: Five Night's at Freddy's: The Silver Eyes Fangame is a short point-&-click exploration game based on the Silver Eyes novel. Please enjoy this little tour through the atmospheric world of Charlotte's childhood. And keep an eye out! There may be a secret hidden somewhere...

title: Mahoromatic Adventure
description: A PC game based after the anime and manga Mahoromatic.

title: FeedVid Live
description: FeedVid Live is a short puzzle game taking place in an unusual livestreaming app. It's a standalone sequel to FeedVid - the games can be played in any order as the stories are not directly related.

title: Animal Magnetism: Pochi no Daisuki
description: Animal Magnetism: Pochi no Daisuki is a PC visual novel by Gainax.

title: Reouija Sleepover
description:
Reouija Sleepover is the 2022 remake of Ouija Sleepover, a 2020 jam game.

The game has been completely revamped; new art, new dialogue, new scenes, new CGs and 2 new endings. The main endings have also been extended.

title: Umbilical
description: Umbilical is a Metroidvania-inspired top-down shooter that has you exploring an inhospitable world to stop some nasty parasites from wreaking havoc. Face off against hordes of creatures, seek out new abilities and upgrades, and take down powerful bosses as you fight to stop the parasites.

title: Ethernal
description: Ethernal is a roguelike/FPS with a fast action gameplay, combined with powers that give a nice touch of Immersive Sim to the experience. Unlock new weapons, powers and smash hordes of bloodthirsty robots while you discover the secrets of the ERE facilities in Titan, Saturn's moon. Will you survive?

title: Closed Island
description: Welcome to the classic RPG. You will plunge into the magical Middle Ages in order to clear the cursed island of various wickedness step by step.

title: Hogwarts Legacy: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Hogwarts Legacy is an immersive, open-world action RPG set in the world first introduced in the Harry Potter books. Now you can take control of the action and be at the center of your own adventure in the wizarding world.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
- 72 Hours Early Access
- The Dark Arts Pack
- Onyx Hippogriff Mount
- Dark Arts Garrison Hat
- Both generations of the game (PS4 & PS5, Xbox One & Xbox Series X|S)

title: Save and Conquer
description: This is a 2D defense game that depicts the near future that may arise from climate change. Unlike the defense game, which is automatically attacked by traditional turrets, it is an attractive game that requires you to defeat the enemy by operating the turret directly with limited power.

title: Alice's Warped Wonderland: Recollection
description: Return as Alice and embark on her adventure to find the truth...

title: Island Cities
description: Arrange the town islands and see them come to life. Just swap the blocks of a 3D jigsaw puzzle.

title: RotatePDF: A Corporate Tale
description: Explore the liminal corridors of a company that only... rotates documents? This short artistic Indie title combines 2D exploration with paper physics to create a truly unique experience.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Deluxe Edition
description:
Disney Dreamlight Valley: Deluxe Edition includes:

- Access to Disney Dreamlight Valley
- All the exclusive cosmetic items from the Standard Edition
- 14,500 Moonstones
- Exclusive Deluxe Celestial Sea Turtle animal companion
- Exclusive Deluxe Clothing Set (5 wearable items)
- Exclusive Deluxe Ears Headband & Jersey (2 wearable items)
- Exclusive Deluxe Furniture Set (8 decoration items)
- Exclusive Deluxe Wall & Floor Coverings (2 decoration items)
- Exclusive Deluxe Design Motifs (3 motifs to use in the Touch of Magic tool

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Ultimate Edition
description:
Disney Dreamlight Valley: Ultimate Edition includes:
- Access to Disney Dreamlight Valley
- All the exclusive cosmetic items from the Standard and Deluxe Edition
- 20,000 Moonstones
- Exclusive Ultimate Regal Fox animal companion
- Exclusive Ultimate Clothing Set (2 wearable items)
- Exclusive Ultimate Ears Headband and Jersey (2 wearable items)
- Exclusive Ultimate Furniture Set (13 decoration items)
- Exclusive Ultimate Wall & Floor Coverings (2 decoration items & 2 color variants)
- Exclusive Ultimate Design Motifs (3 motifs to use in the Touch of Magic tool

title: Minecraft: Sonic the Hedgehog
description: Sonic the Hedgehog races into Minecraft at supersonic speeds! Sprint, roll, and spring off enemies through iconic zones, with infinite gameplay. Master the thrilling abilities of Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, and more! Compete with friends for high scores. Unlock achievements, characters, new zones, and a challenging Eggman Mode! Includes 29 popular skins.

title: EA Classics: Syndicate Wars & Dark Omen
AnotherQuizzGame
description: AnotherQuizzGame or "AQG" is a indie game, the main purposeis to answer multiple quizzes created or not by the community!

title: Dead Island 2: Gold Edition
description: The Gold Edition includes the Expansion Pass. A deadly virus is spreading across Los Angeles, turning its inhabitants into zombies. Survive, evolve and become the ultimate Zombie Slayer.

title: Dead Island 2: Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition includes two premium character packs, featuring a unique costume and weapon, and the Golden Weapons Pack. Pre-purchase now and get the Memories of Banoi pack, with two weapons, a special weapon perk and skill card.

title: Mortal Shell: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Mortal Shell - Digital Deluxe Edition includes the base game and the expansion, The Virtuous Cycle.

Mortal Shell is an action-RPG set in a shattered world where you possess warriors, explore, and fight foes.

The Virtuous Cycle adds a roguelike element, changing enemies and environments each time you die. It also includes a new playable character, Hadern, and a new weapon, the Axatana.

title: Pedal to the Metal
description: Race around the track across 9 unique locations to achieve the fastest time on the leaderboard.

title: Bulwark Evolution: Falconeer Chronicles
description: A new city-building game set in the oceanic world of The Great Ursee, by BAFTA-nominated developer Tomas Sala. Design, develop and defend your Bulwark, manage resources and make choices to create unique fortress settlements in a world reeling from a cataclysmic war.

title: Fruit Adventure
description: Help Super Strawberry become the bravest Fruit in the Healthy Forest!

title: Rift of the NecroDancer
description: The NecroDancer's back in a brand new rhythm game spinoff! Help Cadence navigate the modern world while repairing the rifts that have torn her life apart.
