Do rhythmic battle via rift mode, minigames, and boss battles! All to the beat of a brand new soundtrack from Danny Baranowsky & friends.

title: Snaccoon
description: Snaccoon is a stealth/exploration game set in a dense, stylized city. The player controls an above-average-intelligence raccoon searching for snack foods after the local city government has banned them. Stumbling across a budding black market of cakes & chips, players will have to steal phones & items to engage in a series of deals that will take them all over the city to trade their way up to a coveted box of their favorite treats.

title: Floodland
description: A society survival game set in a world destroyed by climate change. Explore, scavenge and build a city to unite the clans. Conflicting cultures and limited resources mean you need to make tough choices; have you got what it takes to lead your people into a new era of humanity?

title: Umami Island
description: Umami Island is an adventure game where the player is stuck on a mysterious island and is trying to find their way back home.

title: Edge of Sanity
description: Set in the unforgiving lands of Alaska, Edge of Sanity is a Lovecraftian survival horror game with unique 2D art, a disturbing story, and complex base management. Gather resources, carefully plan your expeditions and explore the world of madness as you struggle to keep your humanity.

title: The Great War: Western Front
description: The Great War: Western Front is the definitive WW1 strategy game. Play a deciding role in history with this real-time tactical experience as you take charge in the iconic Western Front from 1914 to 1919. Pick your faction and lead your forces to victory.

title: Teslagrad 2
description: Teslagrad 2 is the sequel to the original Teslagrad, developed by Rain Games and released in 2023. This 2D puzzle platformer builds upon the magnetic and electrical mechanics of its predecessor, with players once again using these abilities to solve puzzles and traverse complex environments. Set in a new region, the game introduces new powers, enemies, and challenges, while maintaining the visual storytelling and atmospheric design characteristic of the series.

title: God of Rock
description: God of Rock blends rhythm-based gameplay with fighting game mechanics in tense 1v1 matches. Choose from a dozen unique fighters, each with their own design, mechanics, and harmonic attacks. Soften up your opponent by executing normal moves and building meter by hitting notes to the beat of the song, then spend your meter to unleash EX and special moves do damage and add complexity to their tracks. Finally, finish them off with a devastating Super attack! As the battle progresses, the music track will continue to grow in complexity and difficulty until only one fighter is left standing!

title: Słowica
description: Action story-based game in a Slavic low-fantasy setting.

title: Dehoarder 2
description: Dehoarder 2 is a simulation where you take control of the life of Harry the Hilldale Hoarder. You must help Harry to get his life in order before the building inspector fines him into oblivion and forecloses on the family home. But change comes hard for Harry, and at first he will only be willing to part with the simplest of things.

title: Neighbourhood Cat
description: In the peak of lockdown, you are Neighbourhood Cat, the only one around who still has the freedom to go outside. Roam the streets, visit your neighbours, listen to their stories, and spread a bit of comfort and charm. After all, you are a cat. That's what you do.

title: The Making of a Prophet
description: A sequel to the controversial title "The You Testament", made by the same developer. Travel back in time to ancient Arabia during the "Days Of Ignorance" and shadow the Prophet Muhammad as he struggles to enlighten his pagan contemporaries. Having been granted a glimpse of the true nature of reality, he beholds mankind to have gone astray and seeks to reunite them with their creator. Follow in his footsteps across 20 unique locations and become his most trusted companion as his destiny gradually unfolds. It doesn't promise to be easy, however, as a disbelieving public and an oppressive Quraysh regime seek to stifle his fledgling movement.

title: Sulkyland
description: Sulkyland is a free game of virtual horse racing. Take part to races, breed and train your horses, manage your stable, your riding school and your racetrack.

title: Disgaea 7: Vows of the Virtueless
description: The next chapter in the Disgaea saga. In Disgaea 7, the story is set in a world called "Hinomoto Netherworld Cluster," which is inspired by Japanese culture.

title: Timmy Types
description: Don't swipe - type! Improve your typing speed with this endless runner game.

title: Seikai no Senki
description: Seikai no Senki is a PC and PlayStation 2 game by Gainax.

title: GameBreak
description: GameBreak is a local multiplayer Mini Game Collection. That requires 2 Players to play.

title: Sonic Frontiers: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Worlds will collide in Sonic the Hedgehog’s newest adventure. An experience like never before, accelerate to new heights and experience the thrill of high velocity open-zone freedom. Battle powerful enemies as you speed through the Starfall Islands - landscapes brimming with dense forests, overflowing waterfalls, sizzling deserts and more!

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• Sonic Frontiers
• Explorer's Treasure Box
• Digital Art Book and Mini Soundtrack

title: Otometeki Koi Kakumei Love Revo!! 100kg Kara Hajimaru Koi Monogatari
description: Remake of the original Otometeki Koi Kakumei Love Revo!! game.

title: Florealia
description: A chance meeting with the divine, human in shape but not in thoughts.

title: Okubi
description:
Okubi is a multi-battleground Player-versus-player game where you incarnate a corrupted creature armed to the teeth.
Absorb all sources of life, upgrade your gear and join the ranks in unique, fast-paced and explosive adventures.
Learn new abilities, gather resources to forge powerful items and collect epic rewards to enhance your character. Combine ground and aerial abilities in merciless 20-minutes battlegrounds.

title: Back to the Joseon
description: Sword action game using physics collision

title: Beautiful Escape: Dungeoneer
description: Beautiful Escape: Dungeoneer is a short game about torture and love.

title: Overboss
description:
Become a villain in this retro-inspired board game. Draft terrain tiles, recruit monsters, build your map, and become the OVERBOSS!

Step into the shoes of 12 iconic bosses from the renowned board game Overboss, who want to attain supreme power by building their kingdom. The value of your dominion hinges on the arrangement of terrain tiles and the strategic placement of your monstrous minions. Each tile type and its positioning can either bolster or hinder your ascent to dominance.

title: Knockout City: Season 6 - City of Tomorrow
description: Look for Hideout updates, Boomerang Ball, League Play loss forgiveness, map changes, and numerous other updates!

title: Railway Operation Simulator
description: Railway Operation Simulator is a free and open source railway signalling simulator, allowing you to build, timetable and operate your own railway, or one of many layouts from the community

title: Disney's Animated Storybook: The Lion King
description: This game let's you revisit Disney's The Lion King in an interactive storybook format with a selection of scenes from the movie. Each scene has narrated text and the characters and landscapes can be interacted with to trigger short animations. It also features three minigames: Simba stalking Zazu, drawing picures in the stars, catching bugs for Timon.

title: Open Day
description: A comical Israeli game (in Hebrew) with puzzles, battles, funny characters, and surprises. Visit a crazy academic institution with crazy lecturers, crazy technology, cats, and singing pastries! Be careful, beneath the surface is a years-old conspiracy... Will you make it out alive?

title: VN Dating Sims: Masa SMA
description:
In the story, You play as a male main character and as a high school student in Indonesia. You are transfered student from Cimahi, and had been transfered to Garuda International High School that's all students there are very rich and genius.
You can determine their own pace in the story, otherwise it will be exposed to the skill status where it will determine to the next event. Must do the best!

title: Twist: 01 Timun Mas
description:
This is the stand alone sequel from Twist - Majapahit. It means, you still be able to understand the story, whether you've played the previous game or not.

In this episode, telling you about a legend of Timun Mas from Java.
About a little girl named Timun Mas, who must survive from an Ogra that want to kill her. But it's okay if you already know the original story, because this is TWIST. so, the story in this game is rather different. but still keep the chronology of the original one.

Also, if you noticed, after playing this game, you'll know, that there are actually more story inside, beside Timun Mas.

title: Tour de Paseban
description:
"Hi, let me introduce myself. I'm Fahrul, the resident of Paseban village. Let me show you ALL things I know, about history and dark secrets of our village! Fuahahahaha."

Follow the journey of Tito dan Fahrul as they visit various location on Paseban village.

title: Aventuras na Ilha X
description: An activity center CD-ROM for kids based on the Brazilian singer and TV host Xuxa Meneghel.

title: Cerita Jabar Sangkuriang
description: Sangkuriang West Java Folklore

title: Sarin
description: In the not-so-distant future. The Middle Eastern Arab country of Ajeeba is under military dictatorship. The government is trying to cover up a corruption scandal and it's up to a little girl to expose that scandal by staying alive.

title: Classic: Snake
description: A tribute to the timeless snake game. Use arrow keys to guide the snake, eat food to grow longer, and avoid crashing into walls or yourself. Unlock achievements, compete on global leaderboards. Simple to pick up, impossible to put down.

title: Magitek VR
description: Magitek VR is a magic adventure game that uses physics driven spells based on the four elements. Use magic to fight enemies and solve puzzles as you explore the world of Embra.

title: Haste-Miner 2
description: In Haste-Miner 2, your main objective is to mine. When mining you earn money as well as tokens which are used to upgrade your pickaxe as well as travel to new mines with more valuable ores. Eventually, you can travel to new planets to mine and earn even more.

title: Fairy Elements
description:
Yamato is a royal knight, fighting to protect the peace of his kingdom. His sword is imbued with the mysterious power of Material.
Along with his attendant, a female knight called Orka, he saved his kingdom from a crisis.
However, in the battle, he was somehow transported to a world 200 years in the future.

In the world of the future, he meets a strange creature and a mysterious girl.
At the end of his adventure, what will be the future that awaits his kingdom?
Enjoy this fantasy RPG, with all BGM by the renowned Ryuji Sasai!

title: Tanitani Wizard
description:
This is a retro style pixel-art bullet-hell shooting game.
Dodge the barrage of bullets, destroy enemies and obstacles to advance.
There are several types of items available from treasure chests, including shot enhancements, movement speed increases, and a randomly selected companion Tanishi(snail).
The ability of the companion Tanishi(snail) slows down the enemy's shot, and sometimes even eliminates the enemy's bullets.

title: Draw Rider Remake
description: Draw Rider - a classic racing game, made in 2D.

title: Journey to Destiny
description: You are sent with your teammate on a mission by a secret organization. You will have to travel thanks to the documents that will be available in your HQ in order to collect energy stones. But be careful, there are challenges waiting for you. Will you be able to overcome them?

title: Flashout 3D: Enhanced Edition
description: The classical AG racer, Flashout 3D, initially released more than 10 years ago, is back, to celebrate the upcoming launch of Flashout 3! But we bring you not only the first installment of the series for free, but we have also remastered it and enhanced with upgraded graphics and new features!

title: Trainz Plus: Est/Etat 241A Mountain Locomotives
description: Drive these powerful 4-8-2 (241 in the French system) “Mountain” locomotives. Entering service in the early 1930s, these locomotives were built using the De Glehn compound system, like many French locomotives of their time.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2022: Est/Etat 241A Mountain Locomotives
description: Drive these powerful 4-8-2 (241 in the French system) “Mountain” locomotives. Entering service in the early 1930s, these locomotives were built using the De Glehn compound system, like many French locomotives of their time.

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2019: Est/Etat 241A Mountain Locomotives
description: Drive these powerful 4-8-2 (241 in the French system) “Mountain” locomotives. Entering service in the early 1930s, these locomotives were built using the De Glehn compound system, like many French locomotives of their time.

title: Chrono Survival
description: On the eve of the end of the world, become the last hope for the world by standing alone against thousands of monsters. Chrono Survival is a hyper arcade rogue-lite game that combines simple gameplay and challenge.

title: 30 Minutes to Die
description: Slay never-ending legions of monsters while running in circles! 30minutestodie is a dark fantasyr casual game with rogue-lite elements. Choose from a variety of weapons and perks and make every playthrough a different experience. Unlock many characters each one with different abilities.

title: Vorax
description:
Vorax is an Open World Survival Horror game set on a Mediterranean island where a mysterious pathogen has infected the local population. An army battalion is sent to quarantine the population but 48 hours later, all communication with the battalion is lost.

Do you have what it takes to survive?

title: Lou's Lagoon
description: A cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure: fly your seaplane between tropical islands, collect resources with the Swirler 2000, rebuild storm damaged communities, and unravel the mystery surrounding Uncle Lou’s disappearance.

title: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia
description: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia is a satirical action-adventure, brought to life by a twisted and wicked tale. Featuring hard but fair combat, *full character customization, unique battle armor and engaging narrative mechanics rich in lore, Nostalgaia plunges you into almost certain death at every turn.

title: Circadian Cycle Deepest Sleep
description: Circadian Cycle Deepest Sleep is a low-poly 3d horror indie game. You wake up in an infinite corridor and try to figure out what is on the paintings.

title: Worldless
description: Worldless is a stylised 2D Adventure Platformer with turn-based combat and a mind-bending, interpretative narrative. Players will walk the line between physical and astral planes within a shapeless world, embarking on a journey of self-growth and understanding.

title: Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop
description: Come on down to Uncle Chop’s Rocket Shop, for all your roguelite spaceship repair simulation needs! Wake up, clock in, fix ships, make friends and enemies, pay rent, upgrade your workshop, ponder the futility of your existence, go to bed and then do it all over again the next day.

title: ANXRacers: Drift Space
description:
A 2D top-down spaceship arcade racing game. Do some spaceship drifting!
ANXRacers offers you the ultimate arcade spaceship racing experience where everything is about reaching the perfect racing time.
Optimize your turns, don't lose your speed, make epic space drifts and set World Records!

As a racing pilot, your goal is to get the spaceship from start to finish, in the least amount of time, while passing any checkpoints on the way in correct order.

title: Dynacore
description: An action roguelike shooter with procedurally generated weapons

title: Panda Legend
description: The era of cold weapons, the Panda Kingdom was suffered by combine attack because other animals wanted to capture this rich place. Now， you are a desperate frontier general and you decide to set out alone to fight for the low morale of the army.

title: Grim Tales: Horizon of Wishes - Collector's Edition
description: What is Richard up to? Pursue Anna’s missing father through time!

title: Barboozeled
description: A simple walking simulation with a twist, make around the obstacles and out the door while not in full control of your own feet.

title: Find Me in the Maze
description: Revived by a witch, a warrior relive his journey trying to pass the maze and see what happened to him and his friends in the past.

title: Nobody Saves the World: Frozen Hearth
description: The first expansion for Nobody Saves the World introduces new challenges, player forms, and abilities.

title: The Lost Vikings
description:
The PC port lacks second player to play the other vikings, backgrounds are pure black, the HUD is put at the bottom of the screen.

In 2014 the game was added to Battle.net as a free download emulated through DOSBox.

title: Buramato
description: Explore a vast fast-paced Action RPG inspired by traditional Bornean mythology. Slay monsters with stylish combos and discover the Old Lords’ cursed lands to unravel the secrets behind your lost memory.

title: Demo Disc: Spectral Mall
description:
In the before-time - your childhood, or perhaps those of your forebears - the mall stood king among shopping locales. People of all kinds flocked to them, swarming store after store, purchasing copious amounts of tie-dyed fabric and greasy food and novelty knives. But now the people are ,dead, and the corporate catacombs stand silent. Their only customers now are rats and cockroaches.

Of late, though, there have been murmurs in the emptiness - flashes of too-bright colors, flickers of wires and flesh, strangled electric sounds, almost like screams. Brave or foolish souls have returned to the sites of their pasts, spurred by curiosity. The few who have returned, amidst their gibbering, mad cries, spoke of change. Storefronts peddling wares that they do not contain, advertisements that flicker in the corner of one's eye, and distant, echoing footsteps, coming from everywhere and nowhere in the dust-suffused halls.

Your town bore one such decrepit mall, a hopeful tourist destination long since abandoned by the few teens that frequented it. Yet you find yourself standing before it in the gloom, for the first time in years. Lights flicker from within, tinny music emanates from disconnected speakers. And a phrase burns in your mind as if carved with a burning knife...

title: Vietnam War Platoon
description: This game is a new concept card and flag game with the theme of Vietnam War. It is a light snack game prepared for the leisure transition of players who are tired of playing large-scale games like me and hand injured players. 2020.8.10

title: Garin Game: Curse of Revival Ceremony
description:
MAMUI studio presents a suspense visual novel adapted from Thai top black fantasy novel –Garin Game : Curse of Revival Ceremony-- and let’s you decide your ending!

In the midnight of night of the month, without the moonlight, a school darkness and silence. Then a candle light show a shadow of horror scene in a classroom.
An unknown alphabet is written all over the floor to magic circle. In the middle of the magic circle showing someone blood.
…This is a part of murder scenes climax in the school!

title: Forlorn Memories
description:
Forlorn Memories is a love letter to the JRPG genre and an upcoming story-driven 3D steampunk fantasy retro inspired RPG with life-sim elements, contemporary storytelling and QoL improvements to create an RPG experience that feels both nostalgic and modern at the same time. The story revolves around a group of heroes who have little in common except their shared quest to recover their lost memories.

“Memories are fleeting - what are you willing to sacrifice to remember?”

title: Super Cream 64: The Grand Finale
description:
"On the week before her daughter's birthday, Vanilla wonders how to surprise her daughter this year. The answer? Rent a huge castle, redecorate it and have a bit of fun"

A visual and audio overhaul of SM64 starring Cream & Cheese, by Gamebun. Nearly every enemy remodeled, the majority of the music has been changed and new voice lines and dialog.

title: Genso Flood Front
description: A doujin game by FriendSea based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Talking Angela
description: Come join Talking Angela in Paris - the city of love, style and magic. There are so many surprises, you better sit down. ;) And watch out for birds - you never know what might fly by.

title: Halo Infinite: Season 3 - Echoes Within
description: Season 3, titled "Echoes Within," will include new maps and modes, sandbox items, expanded customization, a 100 tier battlepass, and the Custom Games Browser feature.

title: Elden Ring: Ascended
description:
With three different available difficulties, Elden Ring Ascended adds plenty of changes to the base game:

-Enemies' physics and AI changed
-New armour set effects on each piece
-New Talismans' effects
-New weapons' effects
-New enemies' status debuffs
-Altering armours gives different effects
-Spells', Items', and Weapon Arts' buffs stack
-Changeable Weapon Arts on each weapon

title: Luggage
description: You play as Steve. He has arrived at the airport from a camping trip and has some important Luggage that he must carry with him.

title: BioShock 2: The Protector Trials
description: The Protector Trials is the third DLC for BioShock 2 and the first to expand the singleplayer mode. Players step into the role of a Big Daddy who must fight off splicers while his Little Sister harvests ADAM from corpses. It offers six new maps with three difficulty levels, new unlockables and seven new achievements/trophies. There are three new weapons and Plasmid load-outs plus a fourth bonus load-out received when all previous ones are completed.

title: Mahoutsukai to Goshujin-sama: New Ground
description: Mahoutsukai to Goshujin-sama ~Wizard and the Master~ New Ground is the first remake of Mahoutsukai to Goshujin-sama ~Wizard and the Master~. The remake adds updated art and voice acting for the characters. This version was released on the PC, then later on the PSP.

title: Furry Lust
description: Pleasurable arcade game where you collect stuff to discover beautiful furry girls. Amazing atmosphere, great music, high quality furry artworks, great for relaxing. Made with love from furry lovers for furry lovers!

title: Blumen Kranz
description: Blumen Kranz is a otome game for PC.

title: Sweetest Valentine
description: Spend your Valentine's Day with the boy of your choosing... except there's blood involved.

title: The Last Star
description: Mythical beings, an eternal night, and a fairytale that seems to tie it all together.

title: Gold Digger: The Lost Mines
description: Gold Digger ‘The Lost Mines’ is a multi-level climbing game with a unique balance between strategy and action. You move around an old gold mine, picking up and mining gold with dynamite, while avoiding different adversaries. This game is different and requires more reflex skills than Spacestation Pheta, however “thinkers” will have just as much fun solving the Gold Digger screens! There are 175 built-in screens plus an editor to create your own. Available for Macintosh and Windows.

title: Touhou: Combinations With You
description: Touhou: Combinations With You is a Touhou fan game made by Rodon John based on the Japanese convenience store franchise chain FamilyMart. The game consists on a single boss battle against Murasa Tenchou.

title: Cantina Royale
description:
Having both a Free to Play & Play to Earn mechanism, Cantina Royale is an action-packed blockchain game that brings you the best of both the Web2 and Web3 worlds.
This unique combination of Free to Play & Play to Earn allows regular gamers to get started with the game without the high initial costs of buying an NFT while also allowing NFT holders to get passive rewards from the borrowers' earnings.

title: Quietus Allurment
description: Quietus Allurement follows a captured man trapped in a facility that is doing illegal tests on him. Things go awry when the head of the facility began creating creatures and releasing them on the scientists and test subjects. The attacks grew in number until the facility was overrun. Now the captured man must fight his way out to gain his freedom before the creatures kill him as well.

title: Knight Lore
description: Fan made game of Ultimate's classic Knight Lore.

title: The Last Alchemist
description: The Last Alchemist is a third-person alchemy simulation game about the blazing pursuit of science and friendship.

title: Gummy Jump
description: You are a gummy where you have to get to the top of the hill, even one small misstep you will fall quite far back down.

title: Rise of the Tomb Raider: Endurance Mode
description: Alone and in the wild, Lara must scrounge, scavenge, craft and survive the harsh elements by day, as well as lethal threats from enemies, both man and beast, by night. This is her ultimate woman-versus-wild test to push the limits of how long she can survive on her own in sprawling, unforgiving landscapes. Fire takes fuel, cold kills the unprepared, food restores health, but everything must be caught, collected, or crafted. You start with nothing and must find everything. Challenge friends to your longest survival run and battle to the top of the leaderboards for the title of Ultimate Survivor.

Almost a decade after the black mesa incident which opened up the portal storms you find yourself trying to cope with its aftermath, creatures appeared which came out of what seemed to be thin air. They cam without warning and swept the world, it is during this time that you find yourself your apartment. Alone. For no apparent reason you\'ve been approached as in a dream by a man in a suit. Having no idea of what\'s going on all you can do is try to stay alive.

title: Half-life: The Challenger Deep 2 Remake
description: This is a remake of the original Half-Life mod The Challenger Deep. This re-designed mod has been in development for more than 7 years. It follows the same storyline as the original.

title: Fall Minamo
description:
This game is about you, Minamo-chan, being swept away by a waterfall.

The object of the game is to survive as long as possible, avoiding the attacks of the ferocious creatures that live in the waterfall.The longer you survive, the better your score, and you can enjoy a cute multi-ending based on your score.

title: Half-Life: Induction
description: Prequel for Half-Life Mod allows to look and take part at the events before Half-Life. You assume the role of Dr. Gordon Freeman. You will meet Kleiner, Vance, Barney, Rosenberg and other characters.

title: The Citizen Part II
description:
Set in and around City 17, "The Citizen Part Two" contains the next three chapters of our citizen's story.

After the events of the previous two chapters, you find yourself rescued from the grave by rebels, among whom you are now a valuable asset. Taken to a makeshift field hospital, you recover in the hands of rebel medics. But the Combine are determined to crush the rebels out of existence, and the peace can't last long. You will face choices, and how you decide to proceed will ultimately dictate how the story plays out for you. Some choices are less obvious than others, and require you to take initiative where you otherwise might be distracted. One way or another, it's time to take back the city.

Part Two was originally going to be much longer, but was split in half during development. The first half was released as the current Part Two. Later in 2014, Part 2 and 3 were merged into a single part after the final release, and the ending was retconned.

title: The Sprucecape Mod
description: The Sprucecape Mod is a modification for Half-Life 2 Episode 2, featuring elements of classical Half-Life 2 action, exploration, horror and puzzles. In this single-player experience you step in the shoes of John Sprucecape, who is set on a dangerous quest to find his escaping family. The road to them is all but easy and John has to fight and solve his way trough the hazardous environments of Alaska. This mod has updated the original map pack with some new textures, models, locations and combat for a new refreshing experience.

title: Ravenbound
description: Fear everything and nothing for death brings you closer to victory in this challenging open world action-roguelite. As the Vessel of an ancient power you must use steel and skill to complete your mission in a dangerous fantasy world inspired by Scandinavian folklore.

title: Dead Island 2: Day One Edition
description:
Dead Island 2 takes players across the most iconic locations of the City of Angels, now stained with horror, in an exciting pulp journey from the verdant suburbia of Beverly Hills to the quirky promenade of Venice Beach.
Combat delivers the most intense, visceral and gory first person experience possible, with plenty of weapons and tactical (and brutal) options to chew your way through the zombie horde.

Day 1 Edition includes:
- The Memories of Banoi Pack
- Banoi War Club
- Memories of Banoi Baseball Bat
- Weapon Perk – balanced
- Personal space skill card

title: Microvolts: Recharged
description: Microvolts Recharged is a quirky lobby-based third-person shooter with a unique toy theme. The game features a fun character cast and freely swappable 7 weapon types. Battle it out across dozens of large well-designed maps and frag your enemies!

title: Deep City
description:
A small game for the PS1 Horror Jam 2021 made by Felix Kraus with audio by Viktor Kraus.
You started your journey on this rusty boat a long time ago. One night you are woken by an unusual noise and you get dragged down below.

title: Asuka-san ha Nabikanai
description: Asuka-san wa Nabikanai is a visual novel developed by Azarashi Software about a student council president.

title: Rainbow Cave Raid
description:
Play as Reimu and shoot your way through dozens of foes while grabbing as many colored items as you can to maximize your score, and face off against the boss waiting at the end!

Includes a whopping one stage of fast-paced shooting action!
And, maybe a few secrets as well?!

title: Anteform
description:
Steve Johanson has disappeared and his girlfriend Sally Franklin has hired your detective agency to locate him. Even before you get on the scene there are signs that maybe this isn't just a simple missing persons case. Can you crack it? Explore Anteform Valley and its settlements, talk to its residents, search desks and files, and build up your skills as you collect clues to figure out what really happened to Steve and maybe even prevent it from happening again.

Anteform is a horror / sci-fi detective story RPG in the style of the older Ultima games (Ultima I, Ultima II, Ultima III, Ultima IV, & Ultima V) as played on the Commodore 64 and 128 computers (although thematically it fits in better with the Worlds of Ultima games). Just like the original Ultima games, it includes a world view, enterable towns, and 3D dungeon displays. More importantly, it is a fully playable (and winnable) game with its own backstory, plot, setting, and characters.

title: Sakura-iro Dreamer
description: Sakura-iro Dreamer is a short heartwarming coming-of-age visual novel featuring hololive member Sakura Miko.

title: Hogwarts Legacy: Deluxe Edition
description: This edition comes with the Dark Arts cosmetic set and Thestral mount, as well as the Dark Arts battle arena and 72 hour early access to the game.

title: Dead Island 2: Hell-a Edition
description:
Dead Island 2 takes players across the most iconic locations of the City of Angels, now stained with horror, in an exciting pulp journey from the verdant suburbia of Beverly Hills to the quirky promenade of Venice Beach.

HELL-A Edition includes:
- Steelbook
- Season expansion pass
- Venice Beach travel map
- 6 slayer Tarot Cards
- 2 pin badges
- 1 patch
- 1 bonus weapons pack
- 2 additional DLC packs
- Memories of Banoi Pack

title: Hogwarts Legacy: Collector's Edition
description: This collector's edition comes with a floating wand and book case and the game in a steel case and collector's box.

title: Trouble Comes Twice
description: A bisexual romcom visual novel about first loves, sibling rivalry and college drama. Play as twins Hazel and Jace on their quest to becoming not-single before their twin can!

title: Fiestas del Pueblo
description: Fiestas del Pueblo is a visual novel made up of four different stories. The stories are all set in a same place in the same period of time. The rest of connections are ambiguous.

title: The Game Formerly Known as Hidden Nazi Mode
description: The Game Formerly Known as Hidden Nazi Mode was, in fact, formerly known as Hidden Nazi Mode. As such it was a failed experiment, detailed in the accompanying essay. In this release the Nazi mode has been removed, and what remains is, as the subtitle says, "a cute game for unattended young children". It involves bunnies and lots of hints.

title: The Midnight Dance
description:
Prince Everett has been sickly ever since he was young. Out of fear for his life, his parents, the King and Queen, forced him to stay in his room. On the night of the biggest seasonal event, he is laying in bed wishing to dance the night away like others in his class.

As if an answer to his prayers, a stranger appears on his balcony injured and asking to be let inside. But without knowing his intentions, what can Everett expect of him?

This Victorian-era Visual Novel revolves around our main protagonist: Prince Everett. On a night like any other, he expects to retire to bed and sleep through a once-in-a-lifetime event. But during the night, he wakes up to the sound of something rapping against his balcony glass. When he investigates the noise, he finds a tall man with an injured shoulder asking to be let in for refuge.

title: Kuggs
description: Kuggs is a fast-paced shooter with some light horror elements. Fight off hordes of enemies and grow stronger over 70 levels.

title: Zimmer
description: An action roguelike, heavily inspired by games such as nethack.

title: Midori Forest
description: Midori Forest is a spin-off game based on Yandere Simulator that was released for Halloween 2017. In the game, the player plays the game as YandereDev going through a dark forest to collect ten different laptops within a 217 second time limit. He must avoid the multiple pursuing Midori Gurin's while searching.

title: Margo
description: Margo is a short (30-60 min), point-and-click style slice-of-life adventure/art game. It follows the character of Margo, who has just awoken from an accidental nap. The player must complete various tasks to guide Margo through her evening, while putting up with her habit of overthinking.

title: Penny Blood
description:
Penny Blood is a alternative history horror JRPG and spiritual successor to the Shadow Hearts series led by former Shadow Hearts series director, Matzuso Machida.

The year is 1923 and American PI Matthew Farrell is tasked by the Bureau of Investigation to investigate a New York asylum overtaken by supernatural entities. Matthew's mission soon takes him across the world as he battles an otherworldly threat alongside a group of allies.

title: eFootball 2023
description: eFootball 2023 is a football simulation game developed and published by Konami as part of their ongoing eFootball series. Released in August 2022, it is an update to eFootball 2022 rather than a completely new title, continuing the free-to-play model introduced with the previous instalment.

title: Alabaster Dawn
description: Break Nyx’s curse and guide humanity's rebirth in this top-down 2.5D Action RPG from the creators of CrossCode. Battle enemies with stylish combos, wield multiple divine weapons, solve intriguing puzzles and explore a changing world.

title: Cracked
description: Physics-based wizard brawling! In CRACKED, glass-headed mages duel in chaotic 1v1, 2v1, or 2v2 battles. Draft absurd upgrades, unleash wild spells, and shatter the competition in this 3D roguelike PvP arena.

title: 7th Serpent: Crossfire
description: 7th Serpent is a third-person shooter modification for the Max Payne 2 game engine thrusting players into a world of corruption, secrecy and vengeance as they control Damon Pryce - the main character - who has been subjected to experimental testing and is left to his own devices in order to extract the truth from those who keep it from him.

title: 7th Serpent: Genesis
description: 7th Serpent: Genesis is a Max Payne 2 modification and the sequel to the acclaimed 7th Serpent: Crossfire.

title: Half-Life: Urbicide
description: Half-Life: Urbicide is a 11 map single player modification for Half-Life set during the Xen invasion of Earth sometime during the events of Half-Life.

title: Moriya Rhythm Rainbow
description:
This is a game based on a derivative work of Touhou Project.
Control Moriya, who keeps bouncing to the BGM, to defeat the boss.
This work was originally created for Touhou Game Jam 2021, and was adjusted and released after the event.

title: Duel Corp.
description: An action RPG that you can play alone and later with a friend during Early Access. It features an unrestricted class and AI system with fluid and challenging direction-based combat. Discover epic items, hidden secrets, unique skills and talents in a procedurally generated retro fantasy world.

title: Crime O'Clock
description: Crime O'Clock is an investigation and time exploration game with a deep storyline. Investigate cases through time and evolving maps by unveiling a multi-eras linked story. Will you be observant enough to solve the mysteries? Crime waits for no man!

title: Belt Colony
description:
The year is 2040. You, an ex-sergeant, have signed a contract with a large mining corporation in the Belt. Mine ore, build out your outpost, travel to nearby asteroids and collaborate with other belters.

Operate a mining outpost on an asteroid. Mine valuable ore from large and small rocks on the surface. Sell the ore to earn credits (the currency in the Belt in the future). Build out your mining outpost with a landing pad, drone pad, storage, solar panels, refineries, and more.

There are lots of large and small rocks on the surface that can easily be mined for ore.

You can sell the ore that you mine using the management user interface in the outpost. Just click the "sell ore" button, and you will sell ore at the current market price and earn credits. You can use the credits to buy upgrades, equipment, buildings, repairs, food, water, etc.

When you have earned enough credits from selling ore, you will be able to buy a spaceship. You can now mine ore more efficiently and travel to other asteroids.

As you venture out into the Belt, you will meet others. You can earn credits by doing tasks for others.

There are several space stations scattered throughout the Belt. Most of them are owned by United Space Corporation and Utopia Arura Corporation.

Drones are very useful for hauling ore and small equipment.

Extractors are specialized drilling and extraction rigs that can be used to extract different types of ore beneath the surface of the asteroid.

Enjoy several hours of gameplay in solitude in the Asteroid Belt, mining for ore, operating your outpost, flying your spaceship, floating in micro-gravity, etc. This may be a good game for you if you like space games and are tired of action-packed shooting games.

Scattered in an orbit around the sun, just beyond the orbit of Mars, are bits and pieces of rock left over from the dawn of the solar system. The asteroid belt has countless small asteroids, and between 700,000 and 1.7 million asteroids with a diameter of 1 km or more. The game is set somewhere in the Belt where there are several large asteroids in the proximity of each other. We have made many large high-quality asteroids of several kilometers (and several miles) in diameter. You can land on the surface of any of these asteroids and mine them. We have put quite a bit of effort into making the asteroids realistic.

title: Tricky Keys 2
description:
Replay and reestablish your connection to the world of Tricky Keys in this old-school puzzle platforming adventure!

Equip your AI assistant with the right combination of instructions and collaborate to solve each level, avoiding the hazards along the way.

title: Trash Taste: The Boys Order Pizza
description:
Wow! You became a guest on a great podcast! "Trash Taste", huh?

But who cares about the podcast itself, after the recording the boys got really hungry. We really should order something... Like pizza!

title: Cursed Colors
description: The book is cursed and you should stop the darkness within this arcade pixelated game.

title: Madness in Square Garden
description: Arrange a random set of blocks to get the most out of your garden in 30 days and rack up a high score. Till, plant, water, harvest…but keep an eye out for snakes!

title: Aion Classic
description: Aion Classic is a free-to-play return to the original Aion service that began in 2009. It is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) developed and published by the South Korean company NCSOFT. The game combines PvP and PvE in a fantasy game environment.

title: Black Stigma
description: Black Stigma is a PvP game that requires a combination of shooting and unique character skills.

title: Sonic Rush 3D
description: A 3D reimagining of the fan favorite 2D platformer, Sonic Rush!

title: The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection
description:
The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection is here! Inside you will find all seven Zachtronics solitaire games, updated with new 4K graphics, plus one brand new Tarot-themed solitaire variant only available here.

Shenzhen Solitaire:
A FreeCell-inspired solitaire with a three-color deck

Sigmar’s Garden:
A tile matching game using the alchemical symbols

Proletariat’s Patience:
An asymmetric solitaire variant where some cards are grouped by suit while others are stacked by alternating colors

Kabufuda Solitaire:
A challenging solitaire variant using Japanese kabufuda cards where additional free cells are unlocked by making sets

Cluj Solitaire:
An original solitaire variant where you can “cheat” by placing cards wherever you want, so long as you’re careful

Cribbage Solitaire:
A score-based solitaire variant using modified Cribbage rules and an actual Cold War aircraft recognition deck

Sawayama Solitaire:
A reimagined version of Klondike that is faster, more strategic, and more often winnable than the original

Fortune’s Foundation:
A brand new and extra-challenging solitaire variant using a deck of Tarot cards that presents a fortune when you win

title: Rungore: Beginner Experience
description: Card game mechanics - check. Real time battles - check. Silly humor - check. If this isn't the game of your dreams i don't know what is (Also we have hidden memes everywhere lol)

title: Rooniverse
description: Rooniverse is a pocket multiplayer online game on mobile and PC/Mac. Send your cute and murderous Roos into thrilling PvP modes to harvest resources and build your world!

title: Punihi Loader 2
description: "Punihi Loader 2" is customizable mecha third-person shooter in which the one-headed mysterious cute creature "Punihi" rides and fights in unique mecha. Customize your mecha by combining over 100 parts. You can also change the clothes of "Punihi". Create your own ultimate mecha.

title: Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories
description: Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories is a full remake of Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories, originally released on the Game Boy Advance. It was originally remade for the PS2, and eventually remastered in the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 ReMIX". The game was also changed in that completing the "Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days" cutscenes would unlock additional Enemy Cards that would have been unlocked in the original by having save data from "Kingdom Hearts II: Final Mix"

title: Everett Isle
description: Everett Isle is an exploration-based puzzle game in which you wash up on a mysterious island, and need to find a way to sail away from this abandoned place.

title: Maxon Petting Simulator
description: Maxon Petting Simulator is a clicker game about a cute kitty whose cheeks must always be squished. In this uncomplicated situation, Maxon's friends can help you: the cat who likes to jump by the TV, "Manulooshka", the Sandwich Cat, and many others.

title: Armed Fantasia: To the End of the Wilderness
description: Created by veteran game designer Akifumi Kaneko, Armed Fantasia is an RPG built as a spiritual successor to the classic Wild Arms franchise.

title: Ghajini: The Game
description: Ghajini: The Game is a third-person action game based on the 2008 film Ghajini. It was published in 2008 by FXLabs and Geetha Arts, and distributed by Eros Home Entertainment. It was hailed as India's first true 3D PC game. The game consists of five levels, following the story of the protagonist, Sanjay Singhania (portrayed by Aamir Khan), avenging the death of his girlfriend Kalpana by using martial arts, various weapons, and other artifacts.

title: Cubix Worlds
description: Cubix Worlds is a free-to-play Multiplayer 2D Online MMORPG Sandbox Game. You can build awesome worlds with your friends, roleplay with them, farm, mine through caves, customize your character's style and your profile, earn cubix and spend them in the Shop & Marketplace!

title: Volatica: The Devil's Trap
description: Volatica. The Devil's Trap – is a hand-drawn rogue-like with RPG elements and an original turn-based combat system. Take on the role of the Witch, who fell into a trap and try to deceive the Devil himself!

title: La La Land
description:
La La Land is the first game in the La La Land series, a pentalogy of short experimental videogames by Matt "theanemic" Aldridge which share a recurring cast, sardonic, subliminal, and fable-like storytelling, and a haunting atmosphere.

In the first installment, the main character Biggt wanders around a distorted world collecting lightning bolts.

title: La La Land 2
description:
La La Land 2 is the second game in the La La Land series, a pentalogy of short experimental videogames by Matt "theanemic" Aldridge which share a recurring cast, subliminal and fable-like storytelling, and a haunting atmosphere.

In the second instalment, Biggt helps a poor fishhead steal money from noblemen.

title: Terramachi: Battle Card Game
description: Terramachi: Battle Card Game is a roguelite card-playing auto-battler, consisting of over 100 evolutions of Machi (monsters), each with a unique ability. By playing cards, players develop their team of Machi; upgrading, evolving, or replacing team members after every round of battle against online opponents.

title: La La Land 3
description:
La La Land is the third game in the La La Land series, a pentalogy of short experimental videogames by Matt Aldridge (a.k.a. theanemic) which share a recurring cast, subliminal and fable-like storytelling, and a haunting atmosphere.

In the third instalment, Biggt, sick of only eating oranges every day, leaves his house to search for something else to eat.

title: La La Land 4
description:
La La Land is the first game in the La La Land series, a pentalogy of short experimental videogames by Matt Aldridge (a.k.a. theanemic) which share a recurring cast, subliminal and fable-like storytelling, and a haunting atmosphere.

In the fourth instalment, Biggt works as a chef and goes on a journey through several dreamlike scenes.

title: Coonwood
description: Coonwood is a multiplayer horror game. One player takes on the role of the alien who crashed on an unknown planet. The other players (1-4) play as raccoons. But in the place where they are located, anomalies occur and the characters begin to possess different abilities.

title: Green Hawk Platoon
description: Green Hawk Platoon is an action-packed, multi-player FPS that allows you to fight in the smallest army in the world! Team up with other plastic toy soldiers and wage war against other teams for control of the kitchen, bedroom or back yard!

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 4: Baiken
description: This allows the character "Baiken" to be used in-game.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 5: Testament
description: This allows the character "Testament" to be used in-game.

title: Tezotopia
description: Battle, Collect NFTs, and Claim Land in this Blockchain Space Adventure!

title: March of Shrooms
description: March of the Shrooms is a frenetic, cheery crowd brawler that chronicles the tiny shroom's epic odyssey to unite shroomkind against the coming storm! Punch your way to unity, happiness, and berries for everyone, through a vibrant, effervescent world, full of mysteries, bubbles, and of course, shrooms.

title: Daydream Mosaics 3: Shards of Hope
description: Help Juliette in her new venture onto foreing lands.

title: Bullcrap!
description: Meet Bucky the bull and his no good, untrustworthy farmyard friends! A turn-based bluff card game inspired by the classic game Bullsh*t! Race against your friends to offload your cards. Use wild cards to play dirty and change the rules!

title: Bite Nite
description: An online vampire game of biting, killing, crafting, hiding, running and searching for 2-12 players!

title: Last Words.
description: Last Words is a game of social deception. As a time traveler on a budget, when your improvised time machine malfunctions and you’re taken prisoner in an unknown era, you must work with another traveler to escape. Will you get home faster by working together, or through betrayal…?

title: Super DynoStory
description: Explore, Shoot, Jet Pack and Bird? your way across colourful and dangerous worlds to stop The EVIL Pallid who's stolen your gold! Meet many hilarious characters and enjoy silly dynamic cut scenes that force you to think outside the box.

title: AIdventure
description: AIdventure is a text adventure game with an AI as a story teller. It is shipped with 27 starting scenarios. Unleash your creativity by writing and sharing your own stories with other players. No rules, no censorship, the only limit is your imagination, not someone else's.

title: Orebody: Binder's Tale
description: Orebody: Binder’s Tale is a linear platform shooter that takes place on the alien world of Orebody. As an orphaned battle bot named Binder, players fight their way to the Floating City of Galvanstad, a hovering A.I. fortress, to confront their makers and avenge the death of their mentor.

title: Built Different
description: A short 3D platformer with a Rich story and really difficult gameplay and challenging puzzles.

title: The Anointed: David Saves Keilah
description: The Anointed: David Saves Keilah is a single player, 3rd person action/adventure game. As David, the player can run, climb, scale walls, swing from ropes and ride a horse on the journey through ancient Judah - using Stealth, Combat and Strategy to fulfill God's plan and save the people of Keilah from the Philistines.

title: Shopping Clutter 3: Blooming Tale
description: The Walkers, the traveling animal family well-known to fans of the Travel Mosaic series, have decided to help Auntie Sheep decorate her flower shop. After moving to Animalville, Auntie Sheep noticed there weren’t enough plants hanging from the balconies of the apartment buildings and decided to open a flower shop. But decorating isn’t as easy as it looks, and the Walkers are here to help! Clear the clutter from the store shelves and find all the necessary flowers and equipment.

title: Wild West Story: The Beginnings
description: Join Bella and Coyote Cub on their amazing journey to help rebuild their hometown in this exciting Wild West themed game! Use your Match 3 skills, awesome powerups, and quick wits to repair all the buildings and get people to move back into your town! Work your way through awesome Hidden Object scenes and save the gorgeous town!

title: Puzzle Bobble Everybubble!
description: A new title in the Puzzle Bobble series featuring a four player co-op story mode.

title: Intraquartz
description: INTRAQUARTZ is a multidimensional experimental maze puzzler where you control a microscopic mining rover inside extraterrestrial crystals.

title: Our Lady of Sorrow
description:
An unmarked tape discovered in the archives of an abandoned church containing strange footage was recently discovered.

The tape was deemed extremely dangerous by the Catholic Church and was hidden away.

title: Infection Free Zone
description: Take charge of a group of survivors from your city. Choose your base of operations, then rebuild and readapt the buildings around you to create a self-sustaining settlement. And when the night falls - Defend the zone from the infected! Play on any city in the world, using real geographical data!

title: Pushing Crates
description:
Pushing Crates is a fun and challenging sliding puzzle game that tests your logic and spatial skills.

Choose from 100 levels of varying difficulty and play them in any order you like.

title: Don't Touch Lava
description: Don't Touch Lava is a 2D platformer/runner against backgrounds of castle, caves and cliffs. Jump over pits and baddies, collect power-up charges to augment your jump ability, collect coins to boost your points, and see how high your score can go! Keep running as long as you can; don't touch enemies and don't touch lava!

title: Buns: Bunny Survivor
description:
Help the magical bunny girl to survive for 10 minutes against hordes of evil. Collect gems to get new skills, find bunnies to heal, carrots to recharge.

This is tiny roguelike bullet heaven with a bunny girl made for Pico-8 fantasy console.

title: Stick It to the Stickman
description: Stick it to the Stickman is a practical guide for anybody seeking to climb the corporate ladder in the fastest way possible. A groin-kicking, staple-gunning, chainsaw-wielding roguelike brawler loaded with high-impact, physics-based combat, copious amounts of coffee, and weaponized farts!

title: Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden
description:
Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden, is a new standalone turn-based RPG adventure, that brings players to an illustrated world presented through the medium of cards as the third release in the Voice of Cards franchise, now giving players the ability to trap the monsters they defeat in cards to use them as skills in battle.

This truly unique gaming experience brings back the creative minds behind the previous Voice of Cards games, beloved NieR series and Drakengard series, including: Creative Director, YOKO TARO (Drakengard series, NieR series), Music Director, Keiichi Okabe (Drakengard 3, NieR series) and Character Designer, Kimihiko Fujisaka (Drakengard series).

title: Only Cassette Coloring!
description: People want beautiful mixtapes. You can make beautiful cassettes. Help them in this small and relaxing puzzle game!

title: Assassin's Creed Mirage
description:
Assassin’s Creed Mirage is a stealth-focused action-adventure game set in ninth-century Baghdad. It emphasizes parkour, infiltration, and targeted assassinations. The game follows a more compact structure than recent entries in the series. Players control Basim, a young thief drawn into a secretive order. The title blends historical settings with narrative elements tied to the franchise’s established lore.

The story unfolds in a thriving Baghdad at the height of its cultural and scientific influence, where Basim, a young orphan shaped by loss, struggles to survive through street theft. Haunted by disturbing visions and driven by a need for answers, he lashes out violently, forcing him to flee the city. Taken in by the Hidden Ones, he undergoes rigorous training and adopts their code, developing his skills and sense of purpose. As he uncovers the truth about himself and the world he has joined, Basim is pushed toward a destiny that transforms both his identity and his allegiance to the emerging Creed.

title: Gone Wandering
description:
A girl, a boat and a whole lot of butterflies.

Gone Wandering is a relaxing collectathon game with puzzle elements, an interesting world to explore, and a Nintendo 64 era aesthetic.

title: Horizon Chase 2
description: Horizon Chase 2 is a classic fast-paced and accessible arcade racing game with a unique art style, thrilling soundtrack, and online multiplayer for all game modes.

title: Timberjack
description: The idea is about eco-friendly. Back of the day, when we are children, we have many chance to face the nature. Nowadays, more and more people live in city, people has less opportunity to find “green color” in the world of concrete because of environmental pollution.

title: Tails Noir Preludes
description:
Taking place years before the events of Tails Noir, Tails Noir Preludes is a narrative game following four characters through formative moments of change, circumstance, and consequences in life and told through a series of interactive vignettes.

Your choices are what’s most important – what traits are you bringing with you in your story, and what is the impact you make on the characters around you?

title: Mortal Dark
description: Mortal Dark is a first person action-adventure retro game where you have to do anything to survive and escape from the hungry creatures.

title: Vargskelethor's Hardcore Friday Super Metal Almost Criminally Violent Ultra Swedish Meatball Royal Rumble Massacre!
description: M.U.G.E.N screenpack made by Brergrsart in tribute to Vinesauce Joel. The screenpack includes Joel himself as a playable character, complete with other characters that appear or at the very least related and/or referencing to his previous streams, including Bootleg Felix the Cat, Bulk Bogan, Jotaro Kujo, Skeletor, and so on.

title: Street Fighter ONE
description: A M.U.G.E.N fanmade remake of the original 1987 Street Fighter game.

title: Empires in Arms
description: He who controls Europe, controls the world… Empires in Arms is the official licensed computer version of Australian Design Group's classic board game. Empires in Arms is a seven player game of grand strategy during the Napoleonic period of 1805-1815. Playable either solitaire against the AI or by e-mail. Corps level with full diplomatic options to allow players complete freedom to fight it out for control of Europe any way they want to.

title: Disdain
description: DISDAIN is a fast-paced, visceral retro-styled first person shooter, inspired by the legendary FPS games of yesteryear.

title: War Plan Orange: Dreadnoughts in the Pacific 1922 - 1930
description: Enter War Plan Orange: Dreadnoughts in the Pacific 1922-1930, where you will command the pacific fleet for either power in four different campaigns. The two major campaigns will take you from 1922 - 1926 and from 1926 - 1930. With incredible attention to detail and historical accuracy, War Plan Orange is the perfect modification to War in the Pacific for anyone who loves the time period between World War 1 and World War 2. The lack of airpower and inefficient fuels, as well as the natural resources required by both sides make War Plan Orange a completely different experience.

title: Lisa: The Oblivious
description:
Lisa: the Oblivious is a fangame based on LISA: the Painful, revolving around Sticky Angoneli and Richard Weeks.

Oblivious delves into the past of Brad's former friends, what their lives and relationships were like and the decisions they made leading up to the Painful.

Weighed down by the consequences of their actions, our protagonists are confronted with a rocky, twisting path that will teach them what it really means to live with the choices they've made.

title: The Other Side
description: A platformer about lights! Grab light crystals to brighten your surroundings for 10 seconds as you navigate the challenging courses.

title: Disney's A Bug's Life: Active Play
description: Laugh and play as you buzz through the fun-filled world of bugs. You'll be bug-eyed with excitement at all you can do as you scurry through this world of tiny creatures. In addition to lots of playful activities--a board game, puppet show, and swarms of surprises--your friend Flik is counting on you to help him save the colony by finding items he needs to build a grasshopper-keeper-outer invention. So get ready for a really big adventure into the tiny world of bugs. Hop to it!

title: JR East Train Simulator
description: Ongakukan and JR East have teamed up to bring you a simulator that has a wealth of experience in train driving simulators. You can experience the professional simulator actually used by JR East drivers for training at home.

title: Crescent Bloom
description: A story-rich 2D adventure game that follows Ignis's perilous journey as she looks for her missing brother. Cast powerful spells, solve tricky puzzles and work alongside the Constantin Empire to unravel the mystery behind the sudden attack of the lizard-plant invaders: the Trians.

title: Aviation Manager
description: Choose your origin, create a route to nearby airports, choose the right plane, set a schedule for your flight. Maximize the use of planes, airports, transit routes, etc. to earn wealth, and expand routes to the world.

title: The Ouroboros King
description: The Ouroboros King combines the strategic tactical depth of chess with the build variety and replayability of roguelikes. Build a formidable army, discover powerful relics, and buy surprising gadgets to defeat the three evil witches.

title: Havoc Fox
description: Take control of a sword-wielding fox and a dragon/owl duo to fight your way through the fantasy kingdom of Vanalia and stop its tyrant monarch! Havoc Fox is a combat-based action platformer featuring an unlikely partnership tasked with saving their home from its own corrupted protectors.

title: Icefishing v
description: icefishing v is an interactive, virtual sound installation in the form of a game, inspired by drone, glitch and noise-based sonic compositions.

title: Murders at Tealwoods Manor
description: You've been invited to a strange party at Lady Tealwoods' new mansion. It's not long until a sudden murder is revealed, and you must piece together who is lying, and who is the murderer as you uncover the secrets of the different strange guests of Tealwoods Manor.

title: Bud Farm Idle Tycoon
description: Sit-back, relax, and watch your wealth grow exponentially as you unlock one quirky business after another.

title: Cubic Figures
description: Cubic Figures is a minimalistic puzzle game where you need to make up different figures from a number of given shaped blocks. Take the block, rotate if needed and put it into the outlined figure to fill it. Repeat until all the blocks will be revealed.

title: Colossal Cave
description:
Roberta and Ken Williams who founded and ran Sierra On-Line for nearly 20 years have come back from a long retirement to pay homage to the game that that started it all: The Colossal Cave.

Developed using Unity, over a two-year period, Colossal Cave is a first-person, single-player, 3D adventure that will delight the millions of Sierra and Colossal Cave fans worldwide.

title: Monsterstone: Prelude
description: A 3rd person adventure where you explore, harvest resources and upgrade your tools throughout beautifully handcrafted worlds, where you complete quests and decide which parts of the world get to stay, and those that are cast back into the void.

title: Back 4 Blood: Children of the Worm
description: Children of the Worm features a brand-new Campaign story – Act 5 that puts you into an epic showdown with a fierce new enemy threat. To help combat this unknown adversary, this expansion will introduce “Prophet” Dan, a gun-toting, self-proclaimed preacher of the end times, who joins our growing list of Cleaners in their effort to save humanity. Children of the Worm also includes exclusive character skins, exclusive weapon skins, along with new weapons, accessories, and cards.

title: Railway Empire 2
description: In Railway Empire 2, grow your company into the largest railway company of the continent and outsmart your competitors as you connect cities and companies with an ever-expanding network of rail lines, bridges, and tunnels. Railway Empire 2 features bigger, more detailed and lively maps than ever before. The whole of the US and continental Europe are covered in two huge, sprawling maps, whilst more detailed maps put the focus on specific regions of each continent. Improved track construction helps you focus on the important decisions as you drive the economy and help the growth of the cities. Signals are placed automatically, bridges can hold up to 4 tracks and the expandable train stations can now have up to 8 tracks.

title: Mega Man: Shattered Diamond
description: Mega Man is back along with his rival, Bass! Take control of either character as you take down 3 rambunctious robot masters in this classic-style adventure!

title: The Jig Is Up!
description: From the fans that brought you Is Lupin Still Flirting, comes another tale of master thief Lupin the Third, as he sets his sights on cool gunman Jigen Daisuke. Keep social stats balanced as you help Lupin win over Jigen’s trust, without getting Jigen fed up with Lupin's constant BS.

title: Mega Man Uprising
description:
Working on his next world domination scheme, the nefarious Dr. Wily suddenly finds himself under attack by a group of unknown robots, who all seem to hold a grudge against the scientist. Sending out a distress call, will anyone respond to his pleas of help?

You get to play as one of the three series staples Mega Man, Proto Man and Bass, each with their own unique gameplay style. Select a character and use them to defeat the Recycled Masters, robots that have captured Dr. Wily.

title: Coreborn
description: A social survival sandbox game set in the world of Ultracore, the game combines three major pillars: a survival sandbox (the world of Tormentosia), a social hub (Coreheim, the location of the Ultracore) and adventures (diverse action experiences).

title: Moon Rider
description: Moon Rider is a road adventure not only through picturesque landscapes but also within the depths of the human soul. You are a motorcyclist fleeing from your problems. Encounter strangers in visual novels and answer soul-searching questions.

title: Mega Man: Four Hounds
description:
Mega Man Four Hounds is a new fangame in development, inspired by the classic Mega Man games developed over the years, official and fanmade. This specific fangame seeks to up the stakes in terms of challenge, personality, graphics, story, and music to provide a truly memorable experience.

Players can choose to play as Mega Man, Proto Man, or Bass, with each character having their own unique upgrades and playstyles. Dr. Wily is up to no good again, and it's up to our heroes to stop him!

This game's roster of Robot Masters includes a new series dubbed the Super Light Numbers, consisting of Smirk Man, Scorch Woman, Static Man, Wing Man, Poison Man, Meteor Man, Root Man, and Ooze Man. Each of these characters bring a unique difficulty and charm never before seen.

title: Dragon Man: Reignited
description: Dragon Man: Reignited is a fangame in the Mega Man universe taking a new spin on the refined, classic NES style, starring the titular Dragon Man, a long-forgotten fangame character brought back in polished pixel art glory. 8 all new Robot Masters are yours to take on in a mysterious tournament, with secrets at every turn! Will you be up to the challenge of taking home the glimmering trophy?

title: Deathrun Guys
description:
Deathrun Guys is an online PvP platform racing game.
Race in competitive mode or against your friends in this frenetic race that features a Bunnyhop mechanic to gain speed while jumping.
Run, jump and knock your enemies off the platforms to win the race and secure your trophy.

title: Binky Mcmxcix: The Labyrinthe
description: Binky has found themselves inside the wondrous Labyrinthe... what treasures are to be found within its walls?

title: Fydo's Magic Tiles
description: Fydo's Magic Tiles is a match-four action puzzle game for Game Boy and compatible systems. Match at least 4 tiles vertical or horizontal and clear them from the board. Pop magic bubbles with a match right next to them. Match 6 or more to start a combo, and keep matching to get bonus stars! Find and unlock all 17 Star Tiles to complete the game.

title: SpaceCorps XXX
description: SpaceCorps is a 3DCG sci-fi adult-comedy with insanely lewd content from start to finish. There are a huge number of kinks in SpaceCorps - including LGBT content - but they are all entirely optional for players. Basically, you can play a monstergirl game, a femdom game, a bi game, an abstinence game... it's 100% up to you!

title: Casper: The Interactive Adventure
description: Casper: The Interactive Adventure is a Point and click adventure CD-ROM game made by WizardWorks and Morning Star Multimedia in 1997 and takes place after the 1995 film. After the Harvey's go on vacation, Casper's human friends throw him a party to cheer him up but a revived Carrigan turns them into ghosts, using a magic spell from an old book in the library, and hides them somewhere in the manor as revenge for being tricked out of the ultimate treasure. The player must use various items to travel around Whipstaff to find traces of Casper's friends and take pictures of them for hints and collect items while defending against attacks by the Ghostly Trio who are on Carrigan's side. There was supposed to be a sequel as stated in the ending and the manual where the player would help Casper turn his friends back into "fleshies" but Morning Star went bankrupt before it was made.

title: ITYH: A Horror Otome
description: Young love with a dash of gore and blood.

title: Trapped with Jester
description: You wake up in a carriage with an annoying stranger...

title: The Demon Lord is Mine!
description: A indie visual novel on Itch.

title: Insensato
description: A man without the face, armed only with his struggling will, must begin a long journey to regain his completeness.

title: Rad Venture
description: Taking inspiration from 2000s 3D platformers and Shounen anime, Rad Venture is an edgy and stylized approach to the indie 3D platformer resurgence. Take control of Rad, an ex-magician's apprentice, on his journey to finish his community service while exploring a huge and magical world.

title: Out-Class Hunter
description:
Someone has taken Olieribos Station hostage. H-14 is here to take it back in Out-Class Hunter — A fast paced platformer that brings back things like hub worlds and fast gameplay!

Out-Class Hunter is a story that follows the Bounty Hunter H-14 "Winona" tasked with taking down a mysterious mercenary who has taken the biome research space station Olieribos hostage. This mercenary has completely flooded the station with his deadly robots. Luckily for H-14 for every one she takes down she gets a bigger reward.

title: Prototype N
description:
Destructive robots are running rampant on Turquoise Island! Nadine, a prototype robot of unknown origin, fights to save her home and friends while searching for her creator.

Prototype N is a side scrolling shooting platformer. The player must help Nadine get through many stages of tricky obstacles such as dangerous robotic foes, hazardous traps and more!

title: Tiny Rogues
description: Tiny Rogues is a fantasy rogue-lite bullet-hell dungeon crawler with rpg elements. Build a new unique character each run and fight one monster-infested room after another! Discover unique weapons, collect magical items and level up to become more and more powerful!

title: Section 13
description: Unravel a thrilling sci-fi mystery in this action-packed twin-stick roguelite shooter. Select your load-out, stack up temporary and persistent upgrades, and delve into the depths of a sinister, shifting, subterranean base in the midst of an interdimensional crisis.

title: Marissa Is Now Idle
description:
Marissa Is Now Idle is a visual novel made for the Dying MMO Jam, that takes place on a computer in 2003. After logging in, you find your internet friend Marissa sitting next to you and have one last conversation.

However, one second in real life equals one minute in-game and when 6pm hits, WarCore will shut down, whether you've resolved your feelings or not.

title: Limbo Line
description: Welcome to SSL, one of Limbo's many offices! Taking control of our protagonist, Nine, you must serve your sentence by taking on support calls from denizens of the multiverse.

title: The Mushroom Season
description:
Originally made for Indiepocalypse x kuš! collaboration!

become a hermit who lives in the woods
collect weird mushrooms
talk to critters of the forest
enjoy nature

title: Date Us, You Won't
description:
You're at the University's annual festival and somehow got dragged into participating in a dating booth. Since you're here now, might as well go for the ride, right?

Join our wacky OCs for silly jokes and simple chit-chat.

This game is meant to be a small interactive experience for you and these characters. There is no big arching story, just a conversation between two people who have just met!

title: Earth: Revival
description:
The post-apocalyptic sci-fi survival RPG game Earth:Revival is set in an alien-invaded world and centers around the core experience of open-world survival. It has undergone significant industry innovation and upgrades.
Experience groundbreaking advancements with its "visual revolution", leading-edge "Effortless Play and Fair Spending Reform," a collaboratively crafted sci-fi narrative, and a unique exosuit combat system. Dive into the distinct "Artificial Island" building and social mechanics...

title: Scratchin' Melodii
description: In this game, you're playing as the young DJ and musician, Melodii. After getting caught doing graffiti, they've gotta scratch up some melodies to pay debt for their felonies! Defeat your rivals to get to your jobs (Bosses) on time!

title: Frebbventure
description:
If you ever wondered how a Kirby inspired action-platformer would play if you ditched the copy gimmicks and smashed the speedometer, Frebbventure is the game for you! With four playable characters, you've got plenty of movesets to master, and a variety of special bonus medals will reward you for learning the levels, too. Collect them all to unlock bonus stages, and peel back the layers of a shocking secret.

Beware on your quest, as Ulcethot has many friends in high places. A colorful rogue's gallery of boss characters and monsters are waiting around every corner to thwart Frebb's efforts, so never let your guard down and always be prepared for the worst!

The tricky platforming and countless hectic boss fights might get a bit overwhelming at times, but fear not, because an imaginative and humorous plot (that's still not afraid to raise the stakes!) is there to accompany you through. Frebbventure explores and lampoons the absurdity of culturally-approved rebellion and mass-market edginess through a manipulatively hip villain, a mercilessly unindulgent hero, and a comically mismatched supporting cast.

title: Pulseman Amabilis
description: Pulseman Amabilis is a fan sequel to the original Pulseman, aiming to expand on the story and characters without the limitations of the Genesis getting in the way.

title: The Tennis Master
description: The protagonist of this adult visual novel is a disgraced former tennis champion. The former champion is hired by a mysterious businessman to coach his daughter Sofia.

title: Super Mega Hentai Collection!
description: This game contains 32 levels with 167 high quality hot and juicy hentai arts!

title: The Rest of Our Lives
description: An erotic kinetic novel(a visual novel with no choices) inspired by Pride and Prejudice.

title: In Your Nightmares!
description: This game is a survival game where you will have to survive five nightmares and escape with your life from the demons that are trying to get you. It's interesting because you have to fulfill a series of challenges to survive and reach the end of the game.

title: Snuff
description: Los Frontera. The American center of snuff production. The bastards in the industry took the last thing that brought any joy to this miserable life. All-consuming hatred drives you down the path of war. Destroy everything they have. Destroy everyone responsible for her death.

title: Delicious Solitaire
description: Delicous Solitaire cleverly combines themes like palate-pleasing and kitchen dreams with a popular card game. Unlock many solitaire levels with very appetizing looking backgrounds and enjoy different solitaire variations with a matching set of cards.

title: Springtime Mahjongg 2
description: Springtime Mahjongg 2 brings the lovely sights and sounds of this incredible season to your PC! Complete challenging mahjongg boards to reveal beautiful springtime motifs. Enjoy various hand-drawn tile sets, including classic Chinese motifs.

title: Ice Cream Killer
description: Ice-Cream Killer is an old style platform game that will test your skills.

title: Scary School Simulator
description: Join Akane and Sakura to escape the horror school in the most scariest anime school simulator game that you'll ever playing!

title: Winter's Ankh
description: A medieval CRpg with multiple storylines, kingdom building and romance.

title: Kid Canary & The Midnight Tower
description: A chill game about battling monsters in a scary dreamlike dungeon.

title: MistWorld the after
description:
Get unique item drops from countless numbers of monsters!
A classic-style 3D exploration RPG!

title: Sora Game
description:
A fast paced precision platformer starring Tokino Sora!

Take Sora through short but challenging stages surrounding a variety of Hololive's talents! The levels are made to feel satisfying to speedrun with practice, and additional special challenge stages can be unlocked through gameplay.

title: First Dwarf
description: If there’s one thing dwarves are better at than grooming their beards, it's engineering. Jump into your mech, build a base and explore the crumbled fantasy world in this immersive action RPG.

title: Cake4D
description: The 4D platform game that takes you into the endless fantasy world where your adventure gives you a unique opportunity to understand the 4th dimension in the most natural way just by playing a fun game about two girls in love.

title: FreshWomen
description: FreshWomen is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel focusing on the best parts of life. Become a freshman attending Minerva Bay College, romance girls and solve a mysterious incident. Your journey will be filled with comedy, drama, and lots of sex.

title: Hunt3r
description: Humanity has settled its first Jupiter-lunar colony. Rhonda is on the run after stealing a powerful political symbol. The Enforcers have sent a Hunter - a ferocious, relentless cyborg with whom Rhonda has a history - named Diarmuid to track her. That is, until the alien Guardian appears on the horizon.
