For the symbol in question is no a mere item. It needs to be returned to its resting place, before it is too late. Thief and Enforcer must now work together to save the colony.

title: Hansel
description: Explore the witch's house with two brothers, Oliver and Walter.

title: Reptile Rehab
description: Renovate your brand new rehabilitation centre deep inside the tropical rainforest. As time goes on care for all your injured reptile patients & earn money to upgrade and build new areas.

title: Punch Fit
description: Punch Fit is the answer to your exercise needs. Follow the example and punch and dodge for an easy and fun workout. Learn various combinations of punches, dodges, and rushes to make your play more exhilarating and pleasant.

title: Protocol: Children of War
description: Form your team with up to 2 friends in Task Force Gaming's Protocol: Children of War and enjoy the unique variation for military shooters based on real experience of US Army Soldiers who fought in Afghanistan.

title: Pro Strategy Football 2023
description: PSF 2023 is here! The accurate and fun simulation / game brings football to life better than ever!

title: Prime Horror II
description: A comedic 4v1 8 page horror game.

title: Primate: Father of Universe
description: Primate: Father of Universe is a third person adventure game with dramatic and sometimes comic elements.Help Loru bringing peace to his planet by embarking on a journey full of enemies who will hunt him down. What are you waiting for? Enjoy it!

title: Port Cranes: Container Age
description: Control a Giant Container Crane! The container crane that supported the logistics revolution is now available as a game. Real-time weather changes and state-of-the-art graphics recreate the world of cranes. Perform challenging missions to become a first-class operator!

title: Poly Memory: Predators
description: Cute, relaxing, polygonal memory game with predators.

title: Phantom Island
description: You are the only survivor of a plane crash and you find yourself on mysterious phantom island. Can you solve the mystery of the island and get out of it relying only on yourself and your survival skills?

title: Pip 3
description: Pip 3 is a cute puzzle game with pipes. Enjoy a relaxing time connecting pipes.

title: Kyubu Kyubu Dice
description: Kyubu Kyubu Dice is an Action Puzzle Game that challenges you to think about dice in different spatially oriented ways! By rolling the magical "Kyubu" the player must clear the panels that appear on the stage in this new, exciting and fast-paced puzzle experience!

title: Lady of Dreams
description: Lady of Dreams is an action rhythm bagel, the actions of which take place in a dream, where music and thoughts merged in one harmony. The environment and missions are created based on your chosen favorite composition. With each completed stage, the game will change its rules…

title: Lose Ctrl
description: LOSE CTRL is a game about control. A game that literally makes you lose control by changing the way your keyboard and mouse work. Also: Dark humor in a sarcastic and philosophical story and a fun/chaotic/weird multiplayer that you can play with your friends.

title: Hooligan James
description: Hooligan James is a gangster first-person open-world set in the fictional city of "Lost Jersey". Wanna shoot guns and drive like a maniac? Got the urge to punch people and get in trouble with the cops? Look no further, this is the game for you!

title: Idle Vikings Clicker
description: Idle Vikings Clicker is a fun and immersive clicker game. It's easy to learn, but contains many various mechanics, so you could spend hours and hours playing it and trying different tactics.

title: Ifrit
description: Ifrit is a first-person psychological horror game. It can impress you with its dark atmosphere, which is realistic and frightening. Are you ready to face the Ifrit demons, the strongest of the demons?

title: Imaginari
description: As a kid inside their own imagination, you go around areas you are very familiar with, but they look just a little bit different than usual. Conquer your fears and fight with companions to escape from your imagination.

title: Intercept 2
description: Explore and survive fully simulated procedural space stations with or against friends, Intercept 2 seats you as the alien or the crew in an attempt to escape a doomed station.

title: Hellescape
description: HELLESCAPE is a weird, heartful, bullet filled RPG by Spoofymaru, taking inspiration from Undertale, Super Paper Mario, Cave Story, EarthBound, and maybe a few melatonin induced fever dreams.

title: Hansel and Gretel
description: A Fantasy Puzzle-Adventure game, Based on the fairytale "Hansel and Gretel". Play as both Hansel & Gretel, Solve puzzles, Collect items, Meet magical creatures and live happily ever after!

title: Gumnaam
description: You are in a unnamed village to investigate missing people. Avoid getting caught by the monsters and complete collecting all the evidence while completing the ritual to escape the haunted village.

title: Gulu: A Tail's Journey
description: Gulu: A tail's journey, is a 3d-platformer game featuring a cat named Gulu on his journey in the stylized wild nature and villages. Solve puzzles, find the hidden keys to each level, cross the mountains and rivers, and reach the end of this epic story!

title: Grandmaster's Revenge
description: They say one person in the field is not a warrior. And what if this one is called to fight by the White Grandmaster himself, endowed with super powers and even the ground on which he steps helps him. Find out in the new skirmish of the Grandmasters and regain control over all the clans of Whitehills

title: Good Hell
description: Kidnapped by strangers, she is forced to follow impossible paths. Will the friendly camera make it?

title: Good Game
description: some positive-good-karma-energy flowed out of control fromout some source - made plants, insects grow bigger and come mad-happy-alive - some of them can hardly control this living-energy and stay happy - you also got affected, cant stop smiling and knowing how funny this is and got to find out more.

title: Catch Them If You Can
description: A hilariously hard QWOP-like tiny 3D mind twisting catch animals game! It's a EASY game! This is a 3D platform control game. The gameplay is using a mind twisting method to control a spaceship to suck away the animals on the platform to complete the level task.

title: The Imaginary Circle
description: The Imaginary Circle is a narrative experience, lasting about an hour and a half, in which you must find your way around an abandoned prison. Rummage through the documents, force open doors, call former employees, craft tools, but overall ask yourself: Should I use my only bullet now?

title: The Ourboros King
description: The Ouroboros King combines the strategic tactical depth of chess with the build variety and replayability of roguelikes. Build a formidable army, discover powerful relics, and buy surprising gadgets to defeat the three evil witches.

title: Guilty
description: Guilty is a first-person psychological horror game. Play with Peter and discover what your past hides. Access your unconscious to remember your traumas and the scariest memories that are hidden. A traumatic past that gives you a feeling of guilt.

title: Terrible Clicking Game
description: A Games based on multiple interpretations of click-based input, to control the game

title: Omi Oh My AI
description: Go on a captchavating adventure with Omi, a friendly (if a bit quirky) artificial intelligence! Learn to see the world the way Omi does as you solve image, word, and number puzzles inspired by the CAPTCHAs we’ve all had to do to prove we’re not a robot. Go outside the game and explore websites chronicling Omi’s development and learn how to solve the game’s stranger puzzles in this game inspired by AI, I Love Bees, the 90’s, and the constant need to prove you’re not a robot.

title: Test Drive Unlimited Gold
description: Includes the original game with latest official patch and the Test Drive Unlimited Megapack add-on. The add-on includes 45 cars from manufacturers such as Holden, Edonis, RUF, Lexus and others, one motorcycle, a mode of increased realism of driving vehicles, an improved steering support system, as well as support for widescreen resolution, which is also present in the console versions of the game.

title: World of Anterra
description: Inspired by modern and classic games, World of Anterra is a highly interactive, nonlinear, open world RPG. The game features an endlessly explorable open world, deep progression systems, fast paced combat, and rich lore, all wrapped in a satisfying and accessible interface.

title: Fog and Sea
description: You're from a world where the dead don't move on, they move out. Ghosts live in cities built on the backs of huge creatures. There's a process before you move where you get to choose where you end up, spend 3 days getting to know your perspective new neighborhoods (and maybe a little more) before you settle into the afterlife.

title: Under Maintenance
description: After a rough day at work, all you want to do is settle in with your favorite otome game, only to realize it's gone down for maintenance. How will you pass these troubling times? Risk going to a watering hole to drown your sorrows in a beverage of choice? Begrudgingly scroll through a dating app to meet your love for the night? Either way - adventure, shenanigans, and hot singles in your area await! Disclaimer: heartache probable - choose wisely.

title: Break Up! and Find Love
description:
Break Up! And Find Love... is a pair matching game where you must break lovers couple to match them with their real soul mate. It can be played on both Windows and iPads.

Across 4 chapters and 48 levels, spread the love by reuniting people with their soul mate (or at least someone they will be more happy with)!

title: Shop of Things
description:
On a gloomy afternoon, a sudden burst of rain sends you under a shop's roof.

But was it just bad weather, or did someone (or some...thing) want you under this very roof in this very moment?

Find out, by stepping into the Shop of Things!

title: Cuber
description: Cuber is a low-poly endless runner game in which you have to keep an ice cube alive. There are many obstacles, as well as items that influence the effect of the obstacles. So you have to make smart decisions: do you avoid obstacles, or do you try to get rid of them with the help of the items?

title: Amazônia
description: Amazônia is a remake of the original text-based game, now being a point-and-click adventure where, after your plane crashes, you need to survive and escape the Amazon rainforest.

title: Coronavirus
description: This game is dedicated to everyone who is fighting the terrible virus that has infected humanity. Take control of the nano-bot and destroy as many coronaviruses as you can. But do not touch the red blood cells! Go ahead, hero. Destroy the infection together in this dynamic arcade shooter with great music!

title: Coronavirus: Doom and Destiny
description: Fight in the epic battle of humanity against the terrible virus. Take control of a nano-bot that is able to withstand the virus in the human body. Complete 20 to 30 tasks to destroy the coronavirus once and for all. At each launch, the game will offer you something new. We will help humanity in a great battle.

title: Coronavirus: Doom and Destiny 2
description:
In this game you have to take control of the newest invention - the Crow bio-robot for destroying viruses. Get the operator's tasks and do everything to kill the virus in the body.
Let's help together in the destruction of the merciless virus that has struck humanity! Good luck pilot!

title: Six Braves: Summoner
description: Buy the character shown and start a new adventure! The new character will have new skills, exclusive equipment, and a new plot as well as new secrets to solve. The structure of the interior of the Tower will also change according to the new character

title: 2Tinycowboys
description: 2Tinycowboys is an action-packed western-themed arcade multi-scrolling platformer in 2D, with huge variety, in which you take the role of one of 9 different cowboys, each with his/her own play-style. It has up to 4 players split-screen multiplayer available and quirky game-play and characters.

title: 34Everlast
description: This is a super-concentrated action entertainment for busy working adults. The game is an action puzzle game where your discoveries and actions unravel a complex and intertwined world of breathless action in a dying world.

title: 69 Yuuko Hot
description: 69 Yuuko Hot - is a game that contains elements of a novel and a memory puzzle. You meet a beautiful girl Yuuko. But there is one problem. She loves to be tied up and hung on chains. Solve memory puzzles and get rewards you're sure to love.

89 is a simple platforming game that features a small twist, there is only one checkpoint in the whole game, located halfway through the game. It features straightfoward level design, 1-bit pixel art graphics and controls that are simple and intuitive.

title: Achievements City
description: Build a big Cyber / SCI-FI city broken down into multiple districts to grow the population through simple actions.

title: Age of Gladiators: Reforged
description: Age of Gladiators Reforged is a remake of the 2016 indie game. A single-player strategy/management experience set at the height of the bloody gladiatorial games in ancient Rome that allows you to manage your fighters as they increase in level, forging them into killing machines and champions.

title: A Hero's wish
description: You will be the heroine and have a mission to defeat the devil. You will encounter many people and monsters on your way to the devil. Depending on your choice, someone will be an enemy and someone will be allies. Check now for the ending you will reach with your choice.

title: Alcyon Infinity
description: Destroy hordes of ever-improving enemies and their Mothership. Alcyon Infinity is a fast shooter/bullet hell with dynamic movement and risk management. Up to 4 Co-Op players with Controllers.

title: Arithal
description: Arithal: Chapter Ildsted is a classic adventure game combined with turn-based battle mechanics, set in a dark-but-lighthearted world wreathed in snow and beset by monsters from the depths of the ocean. Survive at all costs.

title: Armoured Cavalry: Operation Varkiri
description: Double joystick / mecha / roguelike, 9 types of mecha with different characteristics, matched with 100 skills, drive powerful war machines!

title: Astro VR
description: Freely travel among the stars and planets in this VR only astronomy simulation. Experience space from some of the smallest solar system bodies to the largest stars. See planets, moons, asteroids, trans-Neptunian objects and, of course, thousands of stars and their exoplanets.

title: A Survivor Girl
description: A girl who crashes on exoplanet begins to survive desperately.

title: A Tale of Saviors: Garuda Academy
description: A Tale of Saviors: Garuda Academy is a 2D turn-based RPG with narrative storytelling. Set in a modern world 10 years after the mystic beast war.

title: A Tragic Accidental Still Life
description: A kleptomaniac ambulance driver struggles to break free from life's great dismal cycles through theft and daydreams in this three act arcade adventure.

title: A Violent Revelry
description: Explore a procedurally generated world, bolstering your strength in increasingly absurd ways in your quest to slay the hidden gods.

title: Bad Night: First Incursion
description: Play as a sexy female alien investigating the origin of the cataclysmic attacks on her home world. You will encounter a plethora of characters, both friend and foe, which can fall victim to your powers of seduction. If you like fast paced, retro style games with adult content, then get this game!

title: Bass Blasters
description: Bass blasters is a survival twin sticks shooter that builds levels based on the audio you choose to upload! Shoot varying projectiles at a wide array of enemies that spawn based on the activity of the different audio channels.

title: Battle Survival in Space
description: Crowds of aliens attack from all sides, collect the necessary skills and survive.

title: Beacon of Neyda
description: In a world where a robot revolution failed, the last humans search for a way to survive and escape. Beacon of Neyda is a side-scroller strategy game where you have to survive waves of enemies while creating and upgrading your base. Build where you want - Defend what you can.

title: Bee Craft
description: Real-time simulation game of bees Can you survive?

title: Bowling Hills
description: Bowling Hills is an exciting golf/bowling mashup! Each lane offers a new set of hills and hazards that requires you to change your approach. There's a surprising amount of strategy and skill in this unique bowling experience!

title: Bounce racing car
description: Bounce racing car is a sideboard jump racing game with simple controls and challenging enemy chases. How to play: Press the space bar and the vehicle will activate the built-in super magnetic system and bounce over obstacles.

title: Bone Lover
description: Hide & seek game with horror elements. Get into the role of kidnapped teenagers, and escape the psychopath’s house. Look for items that will help you get out. Will you succeed, or will the characters meet their doom?

title: Bubble Wars
description: Embark on an epic adventure with Rick the Hamster to defeat the Bubble Monsters and save the love of his life!

title: Breachway
description: Assemble your crew, load out your ship, and explore the galaxy in this deck-building space roguelike. Your deck is determined by your spaceship's loadout, mix and match equipment to discover different powerful card synergies, and obliterate your enemies in tactical space battles

title: Brazilian Street Food Simulator
description: Experience the dynamics of preparing Brazilian Street Food, such as Sugar Cane Juice, Pastel, and Tapioca. Play around with typical equipment, vehicles and processes from Brazilian street vendors. A casual simulator game without time pressure.

title: Blood and Sorcery
description: Journey through the mysterious land of Notor and find the corruption within! Fight bosses, learn abilities and become the most talented mage alive!

title: Blankiball: Der Trinksportsimulator
description: Finally, a fun drinking sports simulator. In Blankiball you bring the German trendy sport beer ball or flunkyball into your living room. Play online or locally against your friends in multiplayer mode.

title: Blade Jumper
description: In 2045, a super-large building was built in the middle of Yeouido, Seoul. The name of the building is Kukuru Tower. You have to enter Kukuru Tower, whose height is unknown, to overthrow the dictatorship that dominates the city. Even if you fall, jump again and go up!

title: BlackBox
description: A plane has crashed in the Indian Ocean, search the database and listen to the Cockpit voice recordings to uncover what happened. Blackbox is a 'Her story' inspired detective game, where you investigate an aeroplane crash. The devil is in the details.

title: Better Off Dead: Life as a Prison Guard
description: Story driven first-person comedy-thriller where you are tasked with guarding a small prison for 7 days.

title: Be My Loyal Subject
description: The reign of King Ulric begins. Help him decide how he will rule his kingdom. Between the clergy, the army, the merchants, and the common people, will he treat them fairly? Maybe he will find love in one of his followers...

title: Bunker 21: Extended Edition
description: All the people in the world have disappeared. The main character is left alone. He goes on a journey in search of answers. He will have to fight terrible monsters and unravel the secrets that the mysterious Bunker 21 hides in itself

title: Camp Laughter
description: A single player, low-poly horror game about escaping a killer-infested campground

title: Cannon Jump
description: "Don't forget to bring your cannon! Shoot down and jump up, it will help you,” said the old pirate. I left the tavern determined to find the mysterious island. Legend has it that countless treasures are kept up there.

title: Captain Firehawk and the Laser Love Situation
description: A shoot-em-up of macro proportions! When size-morphing alien girls decide to attack the world, only one man is able to stand against them and put things right- a pizza guy with a pilot's license.

title: Car Jump Challenge
description: Use your car to overcome obstacles, beat the time and win

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021: Aston Martin
description: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021 - Aston Martin DLC includes 4 licensed cars: - 1963 Aston Martin DB5 - 2007 Aston Martin DBS - 2019 Aston Martin Vantage - 2022 Aston Martin DBX - R6 Tadek Marek - V12 AM11 - V8 M177 twin-turbocharged V8 RWD & AWD

title: Cataire: Gambling with cats
description: Cat + Solitaire = Cataire (legal gambling with cats). Purrfection graphic, You can playing CATAIRE with mouse, meow sounds and purrfect music. Cats would buy CATAIRE (if they could play). Buy it right meow!

title: Catgirls From My Sweet Dream
description: ♥Catgirls From My Sweet Dream♥ - a fun and simple satirical visual novel with “Match3” gameplay in the Magic 1980s Japanese setting. Japanese goodies and Catgirls!

title: Catherine Ragnor: Blackbeards Fury
description: Play the second part of the great Match3 saga! After her adventures with the cursed captain of the Flying Dutchman, Catherine Ragnor has a new ship. Yet when she returns home after a long voyage, she finds that her village is under attack by the notorious pirate Blackbeard. Help her to defeat him!

title: Cavatus
description: The war against Professor Zor was won, but the price was high. Technologies were destroyed. Only a few ancient flying machines remain. Professor Zor might still be alive and start another war. You must prevent that!

title: Charming Blood
description: a visual novel that has many choices that affect not only relationships with girls, but also the fate of the hero. What will be the fate of the young vampire? Will he be able to defend his right to exist, or will he go all out, succumbing to temptation?

title: Chicken Feet
description: Chicken Feet is a first person survival-stealth horror game about a giant, angry chicken. Descend into the depths of GOOBER laboratories and uncover the horrors that lie beneath the lab's shiny façade.

title: Chess Dungeons: Shubousha
description: Help the white pieces escape by solving chess puzzles ranging from beginner-level to more experienced challenges in this Japan-themed sokoban-style game.

title: Chris Isn't Alone
description: Can you convince a demon from another realm to spare your life? Chris Isn't Alone is a visual novel horror/comedy game that gives players freedom to choose their own path towards their fate. This is a student project!

title: City Bus Driver Simulator
description: Dear passengers, please take the seats provided. Does that sound familiar? Try what it's like to be a real bus driver.

title: ClearIt 13
description: "ClearIt 13" is a large and bright game that includes over 220 multiple levels of various complexity with Match3 gameplay.

title: Code:29
description: This is a post-apocalyptic zombie shooter game. You can switch between first person and third person. You can switch between first person and third person. Multiple bosses, multiple choices, multiple endings.

title: Code Zin: Esper Arena
description: Code ZIN: Esper Arena is an action, arena, third-person shooter, with an anime character aesthetic. Test both your reflexes and strategy in adrenaline-inducing combat. Succeed and become immortalized or fail and be forgotten. This is your chance for glory.

title: Crossroad of Worlds: 100 Doors - Collector's Edition
description: What lies behind closed doors? What secrets lurk inside the rooms? Find the answers to these questions and make your escape! Are you ready to take up the challenge?

title: Crescent Cauldron Cafe
description: Crescent Cauldron Café is a casual co-op management game where you play as two sisters running their family's café. Both sisters are witches of a different variety and use their abilities for different roles. Manage a storefront, fly on a broom to deliver orders!

title: Cosmotica
description: Cosmotica is a tough-as-nails first-person platforming game that tests your platforming prowess in the void of deep space. Jump, walljump, and dash through 30 hand-crafted levels. Master the high skill movement that makes for fun speedruns through the levels.

title: Corndog
description: "CORNDOG" is a 2d sidescroll runner game with a cute character. While playing, one can experience from a casual Korean style city mood to an inspiring mother nature. Run through four different stages following along a simple story line!

title: Cookie Clicker but You Type
description: Cookie Clicker but You Type is an incremental strategy-based typing game. Type words to earn keys, a currency which can be used to buy upgrades to earn keys faster. The addicting nature of progression in this game helps typists enjoy practice.

title: Arcade Dungeon
description: Arcade Dungeon is an exciting variety game where 1-4 players can enjoy tons of arcade inspired mini-games together online or locally.

title: Apples and Asteroids
description: Collect apples. Avoid asteroids. It's as simple as that...or is it? Join Q-Boy in this 2D platform as he seeks victory!

title: An Opportunity
description: So you know that one rover that landed on Mars? Yeah this isn't that.

title: Anomaly
description: Anomaly is a horror game inspired by Scanner Somber and the Garry's Mod game mode, LiDAR. Try to escape from the level that you are in by finding keys and the exit, while not being killed by the Anomaly!

title: 0 World TD
description: 0 World TD is a 2d tower defence game with deep combat system, highly adjustable difficulty settings and many more features!

title: All Hallows Evie
description: All Hallows Evie is a Halloween themed single screen style platform game moulded on the 8 bit classics of the ZX Spectrum.

title: Alpaclands
description: Alpaclands is a relaxing strategy game about creating unusual landscapes by growing colourful plants on small islands.

title: Amata
description: Rage across the mad realms of a dead god as Charlet, the immortal artificer. Explore a vast, arcane desolation wrought by hatred. Cleanse the twisted inhabitants of ancient, forgotten worlds. Help Charlet find a way home using her powerful and varied suite of combat and platforming abilities.

title: Crusader Kings III: Friends & Foes
description: Beware, ruler - tread carefully with those you call friend or enemy; they are two sides of the same coin. Your relationships matter more than ever, and with Crusader Kings III: Friends & Foes, witness those closest to you come alive in the most intimate detail.

title: Darkness Revenge
description: Choose between a male or female character and take revenge on your killers as a vampire!

title: Day of the Shell
description: Day of the Shell is a “one-click, one-turn” tactical rogue-lite. In a shattered and flooded world, travel from island to island with only hope and a revolver, challenging and appeasing the gods.

title: Death in the Night
description: A puzzle platformer with deadly dangers.

title: Death or Treat
description: “Death or Treat” is an action rogue-lite, Hack and Slash and 2D with traditional animations and handpainted environments.You will play as Scary, the owner of Ghost Mart. The Halloween spirit is missing. Join Scary to save HallowTown.

title: Decks Against Destiny
description: Decks Against Destiny is a rogue-like, card collecting, tactics game where the player makes decisions in an overworld that determine in-game events to impact reputation with various factions. A ticking clock to an ending battle is looming, so decisions must be made to determine fate.

title: X-Plane 12
description: X-Plane 12 is the world’s most comprehensive and powerful flight simulator for personal computers, and it offers the most realistic flight model available. X-Plane is not a game, but an engineering tool that can be used to predict the flying qualities of fixed- and rotary-wing aircraft with incredible accuracy.

title: Itchy Scratchy
description:
A person approaches you with a simple request: "Friend! I have itch, scratch for me?" How can you resist? They seem so nice, so itchy, and oh so scratchable.
Warning: This game is way too short and will leave you dissatisfied. But, hey, it's free. Play at your own risk.

title: Pandaty
description: Pandaty is 2D Cute Platformer Game, Explore this sweet world of adventure! Our character must pass the sweetly designed levels, But watch out! Sometimes they may not be so sweet!

title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite - Ultimate Edition
description: Immerse yourself into Aliens: Fireteam Elite experience with the Ultimate Edition. Included are the base game and the Pathogen expansion with its new campaign, new weapons and more! Plus, both the Endeavor Pass and Veteran Pack!

title: Ballspell
description:
Ballspell is a short zuma-like game where you play as a wizard, trying to take down your teachers. Shoot magic at a train of enemies, matching colors to defeat them.

However, be aware, some enemies have special abilities that will complicate things, such as shields that bounce off your magic, or imps that will speed up the train when woken up.

Luckily you learn new spells by defeating your teachers, giving you additional tools in taking them all down!

title: Faraway Proximity
description: Faraway Proximity is a third-person puzzle game about recovering lost books. You have been contacted to recover a set of misplaced books. Find them by solving different types of challenges and uncover more puzzles by reading their contents.

title: Fast or Dead VR
description: Welcome to the dark world of Fast or Dead VR game, arcade auto-simulator + shooter. You'll find an upgrade and customization system, angry zombie pedestrians and surviving car owners, and much more to enjoy gameplay using your VR-headset!

title: Fears to Fathom: Carson House
description: In the third episode of Fears to Fathom you play as Noah Baker, an 18 year old who got a small job offer to house-sit for the COO of a local media company for the weekend, he takes the offer as he had nothing interesting going on for that weekend. It wasn't long before he began experiencing something very unsettling about the place. Little did he know what was about to come.

title: Final Recurrence
description: With so many missing persons cases revolving the Shepherd's Hill forest, why is yours any different?

title: Fix My Cat Doc
description: Fix My Cat Doc game is a simulator in which you are acting as a veterinarian. Your mission is to save as many animals as possible from torment and pain.

title: Fix My Legs Doc
description: Who will take care of our health if not us? Fix My Legs Doc, is a simulation game in which you have the chance to be a Doctor, where your mission is to help different patients to heal their legs to feel good.

title: Flagi
description: Fight your way to victory!

title: Flerp
description: Fend off hordes of enemies in this arcade tower defense roguelite with autobattler elements. Build up a team of powerful synergies and become unstoppable.

title: Fold Stories
description: An inner journey mixing exploration and puzzles in a dreamlike origami world.

title: Forests, Fields and Fortresses
description:
Forests, Fields and Fortresses - is a mix of a puzzle and a board game in which you have to build your kingdom.

In the Puzzle Mode, play handcrafted levels with a small number of pieces of territory. Your goal is to place them in such a way as to earn the required amount of gold.

In the Adventure Mode, start the game with a random map and an endless supply of pieces of territory.

title: Forest Tower Defense
description: Wrrrrrr….The evil spirits are approaching the town again. The locals can no longer feel safe like before. Welcome in this new tower defense game.

title: Forward Team
description: A team of four sets out on a journey to find the magic mirror. Change the position of the adventurers to determine whether they will be greeted by： monsters，traps,or treasure！ Your wisdom will lead the brave team through this wonderful adventure!

title: Glass Bridge
description: This is a Roguelike survival strategy game, where players click on glass to advance and jump, choose the correct glass by chance, and use skills by strategy. It has a certain scary flavor.

title: Goetita: Turn-based City
description: Goetita: Turn-based city is a turn-based strategy game controlling the element of luck through rational judgment. Survive even in a desperate situation when all your resources are running out with your strategy in the cold and dark city!

title: Gold of Lotusland
description: In Gold Of Lotusland you play as the Lead Engineer Daniel Quinn as he uncovers the dark truth about the robots he designed.

title: Grappling Dash
description: Jump, Swing, Dash Grappling Dash is fast-pace, uniquely stylized platformer game. Use your grappling hook to swing around in giant levels, dash through energy crystals, find hidden secrets and master even the most difficult worlds. It’s easy to play, it’s fast and it’s fun.

title: Guncar Arena
description: Guncar Arena is an 80s inspired roguelite vehicular combat bullet hell arena shooter. Drive and shoot your muscle car trough alien hordes and tune it with synergizing upgrades to build an absolute engine of destruction!

title: It's Only Money
description: The mayor of Rockhaven threw you down a hole into the Undercity. Why? Net worth too low. In this 1-4 player low-life simulation, emerge to the surface to steal from the rich, fight tycoons and reclaim the city block by block. Buy houses, businesses and whatever your materialistic heart desires!

title: Jelly in the Dark
description: Jelly bear who fell into an ant kingdom, Lucky! Can he survive with a sweet smell against ants? (Caution! There is not one way out.)

title: Jump Journey
description: Jump Journey is a rogelike 2d side scrolling platformer. Avoid obstacles in this fast-paced game, where the movement never stops. Get gems to unlock upgrades for each run. Play enough runs and you can get permanent upgrades. Each level plays a bit differently, learn to master them all.

title: Just Drive
description: Simple Rally Game with a time-attack mode. Play on user created maps or conquer the stock map leaderboards.

title: Karate Beasts
description: Karate Beasts is a story based simulated 2D game you have to train your beast in order to be the best and restore your family's pride by beating the villain named Dark Sensei's beast.

title: Kiss the Demiurge
description: Minori is a mage tasked with hiding magic from the world. She has spurned love in the pursuit of her mission. One day she meets a group of three girls obsessed with magic. Will she stop them from discovering real magic? Or will she fall for their charms? Find out in this dramatic girls-love story.

title: Package Rush
description: Package Rush is a strategy game about planning a delivery route system in a fast-growing city. Build and modify routes to get all packages on time. How long can you keep delivering?

title: Mimetic Love
description: Three men and one destiny. What will happen? Difficulties and overcoming. Get ready to live this adventure. Nothing will be as it once was. Everything has its time... And here will not be the exception... Love, jealousy, resentment and forgiveness.

title: Mini Arenas
description: Mini Arenas is a fast-paced PVP arena shooter in which you and your friends can play and fight together. Play on a variety of stages and choose to play as one of four classes as you fight to be the last player alive!

title: Mining Odyssey
description: Come and learn the way of the goblin miner. Take your pickaxe and your grappling gun and challenge the goblin miner exam! A dynamic first-person platformer game that will put your dexterity and perseverance to the test!

title: Minschima
description: Minschima is a relaxing puzzle game where you need to match all targets to restore the broken shapes in the board. Pieces move together. Match all targets. Solve puzzles.

title: Model Builder: Aether
description: What if you could experience the freedom of riding a motorcycle without all the pollution? This is what Lin Yu Cheng has envisioned as he works on Aether, his concept motorcycle. This is an e-motorbike embodying the next level of innovation and beauty for sci-fi lovers.

title: Monster Slayer Extermination
description: Exterminate once and for all the zombies and creatures that are loose in the city. Survive the chaos caused by mutants, monsters, and hideous creatures as you make your way to your escape route, but be warned, you're not going to be let off the hook.

title: Motherless
description: This is Sunny's story, he was separated from his mother at birth, knowing almost nothing about his past he'll try to find her. Help him find his mother and you'll be rewarded greatly during this process.

title: Miss Kawaii
description: Surrounded by many beautiful girls, a mind-blowing, sexy journey has started. Relax, clear your mind and enjoy)

title: Lustful Ponies 2
description: Short Adult-Only Visual Novel featuring 3 pony girls with different personalities and fetishes.

title: Mage Lords of Brams
description: Mage Lords of Brams is a "bullet heaven"/"reverse bullet hell" roguelite. Slaughter countless fantasy enemies with your powerful spells, powers and artifacts while gathering research scrolls to improve future runs inbetween levels. Thousands of race/class/item combinations allow for endless variety.

title: Magic Market
description: Help fund your arch-wizard overlords' research by trading potions and spells on the Magic Market. Buy low and sell high before the market closes! Master this simple, yet fast-paced, strategy game by chaining spells together to maximize your earnings. But don't get caught cheating the market!

title: Maki: Paw of Fury
description: Maki: Paw of Fury is a beautifully animated fighting game in the style of retro arcade gems. Use your martial arts skills to stun and defeat your opponents and kick the main villain’s ass!

title: ManneKin: Hessler Storage
description: ManneKin: Hessler Storage is a first-person psychological horror. Investigate and explore an abandoned storage facility, uncover the mystery of its previous use, and escape with your life.

title: Military Attack
description: Herman, a member of the armed forces, was assigned, along with his platoon, to locate a large-caliber weapon that is in possession of the enemy country's army.

title: Microscopic
description: In the year 2066, mankind has finally achieved the pinnacle in medical discovery with the massive deployment of nanotechnology. Play as Venture, a new nanobot in this top down atmospheric adventure game to seek out what went wrong in the medical disaster.

title: Mega
description: This is a short story about humanity's last attempt to resist nature. Cities lie in ruins, there are traces of huge claws everywhere - once disturbed by people, giants began to wreak havoc around the world. But is there a solution?

title: Medieval Warrior Simulator
description: Medieval Warrior Simulator is about brave medieval warrior walk in the cold night to beat the evil monsters

title: Mars: The New Eden
description: End of the 21st century. New technologies allowed the realization of a great dream of humanity: the colonization of the red planet. However, something went wrong, which could compromise the viability of this project. Embark on this adventure guiding our hero Rick and unravel the mysteries of Mars.

title: New Joe & Mac: Caveman Ninja
description: We're back in the distant Past, when “Rock & Roll” was just about rocks and “Fast food”, a dinner that you couldn’t catch. 2 cave dudes named Joe & Mac live in a peaceful and cool village. Cool it was, until a bogus bunch of Neanderthal snatched all the village’s women!

title: Ninja Hagakure
description: Ninja Hagakure is a ninja survival game. Defeat the ever-increasing number of enemies with a variety of ninja techniques to suit the situation.

title: Noracam's Slider Challenge
description: Retro 3D slider action game. Beat the 6 slides full of speed brilliantly. There is also an online ranking

title: Notebook Entries Vol.1
description: Horror Anthology focusing on different tension methods. One should caress your fears..

title: Nova Squadron
description: Dive straight into Jupiter's atmosphere and take down vast flying fortresses from within in fast-paced, arcade flight combat. Losing your plane is just a setback - return with an upgraded replacement and take back lost territory in Nova Squadron's roguelite campaign.

title: No: Worse
description: There are a few cups of tea, bottomless despair, a couple of heartbreaks, and plenty of lies waiting for you in this Visual Novel. And on top of that, you'll find a touching love story between two kind but insanely vulnerable souls.

title: Nutty Motorcars
description: Nutty Motorcars is a classic video game with a new point of view. Up to eight players on a single screen can battle it out in these crazy races. Jumps, bridges, tunnels and many more obstacles. Discover the 30 circuits available in the full version and race on them with 20 different vehicles.

title: Oil Manager
description: Who hasn't dreamed of building an oil empire? Make the dream come true.

title: Neotag League
description: Team up and beat your opponents in Neotag League, the sport from the future, where sci-fi parkour robots chase each other to score points! Jump, roll, wall run, grapple, dodge and attack in this team-based multiplayer game of Chase Tag.

title: Nature Escapes
description: Get ready to get lost in the wild beauty of Nature with this hidden object game! Let Nature Escapes take you on a trip to handcrafted snapshots of untamed wonder, and decorate your very own garden until it becomes a bouquet of beautiful plants and flowers!

title: Mythic: Frost Trials
description: Mythic Frost Trials is a free, cross-platform, massively multiplayer party game where you and your fellow wanderers compete in the Frost Trials for a coveted spot on the global leaderboard. Will you secure the fate of the realm? Will you become Mythic?

title: My Sugar Mommy is a Futanari
description: In desperate need for extra cash, you take to the internet and come across a Sugar Mommy website.

title: Mystical Riddles: Behind Doll Eyes - Collector's Edition
description: What's hidden in an ordinary toy? Is it possible to bring the dead back to life? Find answers to these questions using your wits, knowledge of the paranormal phenomena, and your special equipment – a magic camera! Are you up for the challenge?

title: Mystical Conquests
description: A turn-based fantasy strategy game that fuses 4X, RPG and survival. Lead your faction in a world where the forces of evil are trying to destroy every civilizations. Expand your realm, improves your cities, recruit heroes, seek allies, build an army and try to save the world!

title: Light Eater
description: Light shows things that cannot be seen. It creates a comfort of the unknown. But not everything is shown in the light. Don’t be afraid of the dark. Be afraid of what’s in the dark. In this game you use the visible light spectrum to avoid unseen dangers and determine possible futures.

title: Legend of Snake
description: Legend of Snake is an improved version of the previous 2 Legend of games, the game has 3 modes including the classic permanent death mode.

title: Kings and Catapults
description:
A 2 player turn-based strategy game with hack n slash element in a fantasy setting.
Players secretly set up their pieces and terrain tiles on their half of the 8x8 battleboard and once both players are ready play commences. Pieces move and attack in a fashion similar to Chess, white moves first then black while other pieces impede your movement. Pieces capture other pieces by moving to occupy the enemy square and removing the enemy piece. Capturing is always the end of your turn. Whoever captures the opposing King first wins however there is no check as in Chess.

title: WFO World Football Online
description: WFO World Football Online is an online football management game with a non-scripted match engine on a virtual football world continuously developed by AI.

title: When We Lost
description: "When We Lost" is a classic horror game in first person perspective. Some day children were missing in mysterious circumstances. There were many rumors and stories about how many people could have been lost, but no one believed in what had really happened so our hero He decided to go take pictures to prove that it was an attempt to hide government experiments.

title: Where's the Bathroom!?!
description: This is a comedic/run and gun game where your overall objective is to find the bathroom, you will battle many different types of enemies on various unique levels! Grab and gun and go have some fun!

title: Witch Story
description: In a kingdom, there is a witch who lives off the beaten track. She is busy with alchemy, potion-making, fortune-telling ,frightening people and other magic..They say she has already lived for a few centuries here. The local lord is fed up with such neighbourhood...

title: Witch Schools: Love Potions
description: Move, memorize and make 3 in a row.

title: WWII Tanks: Forgotten Battles
description: Choose your side USA/Great Britain, Axis or USSR!Participate in the biggest historical tank battles of World War II!Go through the entire war on different tanks, feel the horror of war on your skin!

title: Xearz
description: Xearz is a 2D side-scrolling platformer with a retro feel. It features a multi-plane that can be moved to the front and back. The player uses a melee weapon, the blade, a gun that can use guided and reflective rounds, and subweapons such as grenades to defeat enemies. Weapons can be upgraded.

title: Ancient Witch Arena
description: "Ancient Witch Arena" is an independently developed light survival Roguelite, hand-painted fantasy dark world. Resist hundreds of enemies, conquer bosses, explore combinations between characters and skills, and finally become the king of the arena.

title: Spirit Charm
description: A few days ago, a woman named Li Wen committed suicide by throwing herself into a well. When everyone wanted to enter the house, there was a sudden lightning flash. A figure was seen standing outside the outfit. Is it the ghost of Li Wen? Or is there someone else?

title: Zen Golf
description: Zen Golf is a relaxing and chill mini golf experience. Get lost in the beautiful zen gardens and all original lo-fi Japanese soundtrack with up to 20 friends on over 180 levels! Or play against state of the art AI opponents for rewarding and fun solo play.

title: Watamari: A Match Made in Heaven Part1
description: Hoshino HIkari is a female spy who joins an all girls school as a student to discover its secrets with no intention to stand out… when she suddenly receives the Mark of Virgo, and timeslips 1 year in the past?! By the developers of Ne no Kami: The Two Princess Knights of Kyoto.

title: WarpVector
description: WarpVector is an immersive sci-fi roguelike built around space exploration, combat, and navigation. Explore the remnants of an ancient civilization, fend off marauding space pirates, and find a way to save your home planet.

title: War of Wizards
description: Draw & cast your spells, magic showdown! War of Wizards is a VR game with MOBA confrontation. Draw dragons to summon dragons to fight for you, draw fireballs to summon fireballs to shoot at enemies, draw pills to heal yourself... - Draw & cast your spells! - Dodge the skills that the enemy fires!

title: Sapphire Moon: Forever Memories
description: The story will be accompanied by three heroines, and everyone will find their own love in this real and imaginary world. Is it the dark-skinned school girl who is available, the cold and mysterious girl, or the afterimage that I have been unable to reach in my memory?

title: Wandering Duelist
description: The Wandering Duelist is a single-player, narrative-driven adventure game that tells a story of love, conflict and reckless actions. The story takes place on a small and lively planet, where its residents carry on their daily activities that often pose dangers and obstacles for the player.

title: Void Eagle
description: Void Eagle is a single player space racer that requires you to dodge obstacles at breakneck speeds while you try to make it out alive. Will you make it and post the fastest time, or go down in a fiery explosion.

title: Vilomah
description: Play as Jake, a teen Pizza Delivery driver on the late shift - until things get BLOODY! Try to escape this DEMENTED Farm with your life! Features PS1, 80's VHS Graphics.

title: Venus in Furs: Sensual Pleasure
description: Hardpunch's Venus is alone in her temple of love, pleasure, and sex. She knows that the world we know no longer exists. Now, she remains a recluse in her palace and anyone who dares to steal her precious gifts will be punished with explicit and savage sex. This invader will become her sex slave...

title: Valkyrie Champions
description: Team up with up to 4 online players and defeat hoards of monsters in this action based looter-shooter! Unlock powerful tiers of weapons and equipment to develop your character into an unstoppable champion!

title: Upload Simulator
description: A incremental game about downloading files, uploading, and upgrading your setup. This is the official PC version of Upload Simulator.

title: United Heist
description: Your group consists of the best two thieves money can buy. One day a client requested to take something unknown from the government. Now you can decide who stays back managing the intel and who is going into the facility to accomplish the task in this asynchronous coop puzzle game.

title: Umbra Sepulcri
description: As a necromancer you need to gather the souls of the dead, witness their last moments of life and use their power to defeat your enemies, in this Story-driven/Action/Metroidvania inspired game, set in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D world.

title: Ultimate Protector
description: Tired of moving around without purposes? Come and protect the goddess with multiple combination of skills and elements. Discover and upgrade your weapon to super, even hyper! Play this game with a joy from both tower defense and rogue!

title: Two Move Chess
description: Chess, but White moves TWICE!

title: Idle magic herb
description: This game is a hang up game that integrates elements such as cultivating immortals, farming, playing strange things, and collecting cards. Protect the liver and protect the liver.

title: Hollowbody
description:
A tech-noir survival horror short story, set in the urban decay of a long abandoned British city.

It's a Shipper's biggest fear. You're grounded in the exclusion zone, twenty miles of death and decay sealed off by the towering, suffocating walls erected after the collapse.

Play as Mica, an unlicensed black market shipper who will stop at nothing to find her missing partner.

Alone, stranded, and with limited resources at your disposal you'll have to push your way through the zone, solve environmental puzzles, manage resources and fight for your life as you try to find a way to escape beyond the wall.

title: Holiday Jigsaw: Thanksgiving Day 3
description: Gobble-gobble! 500 high-quality photos! 500 ideas for a happy family harvest holiday in Holiday Jigsaw Thanksgiving Day 3!

title: Holiday Jigsaw: Christmas 2
description: Who says Christmas miracles don't exist? 500 new high-quality photos in the new Holiday Jigsaw!

title: HimeYoku: A Sacrifice of Lust and Grace
description: Hell-bent on vengeance, Caldo single-handedly topples the royal throne of Solide, capturing the king and the princess and working their ruin through his dark contracts with demons. A visual novel about hate and revenge... and possibly redemption.

title: Hardrock Sex 3D
description: Hardrock Sex 3D is a visual novel game with 3D animated sex scenes. Meet our characters, discover their story and explore all the hot scenes they are to offer.

title: Gold Drill
description: Gold Drill is a classic arcade puzzle game where you connect pipes. Clear the stage and enjoy the rewards the girls give you!

title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - The Treasure of the Midnight Isles
description: The islands scattered across the dark abyssal ocean hide treasures untold – and horrors unspeakable. Board the grim cursed ship and venture into the unknown to find your fortune... or demise.

title: Path to Warband
description: Path to Warband is a unique card battler inspired by many of its predecessors. Recruit, promote, and command cards to fight. Events and relics, the Wanted and bounty! And the most fun, fusing effects of cards! Infinite possibilities are waiting for you to be discovered.

title: Party Friends
description: Join the party extravaganza with Party Friends, a riotous collection of over 20 mini-games spanning 4 wildly entertaining themes - up to 4 players in multiplayer.

title: ParkTo
description: ParkTo is a simple puzzle game that stops the car at its destination. You don't drive a car yourself. The car just moves forward. Use the given triggers to move the car to its destination.

title: Perfect Tides: Station to Station
description: A point n' click sequel to Perfect Tides about the momentum and whiplash of young adulthood.

title: Periphery Synthetic
description: Explore a planetary system, synthesize new abilities, and reveal its past. This interactive EP offers a chill and non-violent metroidvania experience across procedurally-generated musical playgrounds.

title: Pete's Peril
description: Solving puzzles of all skill levels, dodging boulders, grabbing diamonds, upgrading tools, clothing for different climates and crush enemies along the way is all part of Pete's Peril.

title: Petite Adventure
description: Time to rev up your tiny engines for some huge fun! Control a miniature vehicle and drive your way around household obstacles

title: Poly Parkour
description: Test your skills in this challenging Jump'n Run game.

title: Swords & Adventures
description: Enter a fantastic world in search of fame and glory!

title: Super Kill-Boi 9000
description: Defend yourself from a horde of huge eye monsters by building your very own fighting robot - Kill-BOI 9000, your new best friend and toaster. Choose from a large variety of weapons and combine them to make them even larger and ridiculously powerful! Like shooting burning cannon balls.

title: Super Domino Effect 3D
description: Super Domino Effect 3D! is the last challenging Domino Effect Simulator. Your only goal is to create incredible, compelling and endless chain effects, using domino bricks, slides, platforms, "animated" games and everything your imagination suggests.

title: Super Ball Arena
description: Multiplayer ‘couch game’ that can be played up to 4 players. The primary purpose is to defeat others by hitting a ball so that it collides with the target, inflicting damage in the process.

title: Kadomon: Hyper Auto Battlers
description: Collect and battle over 180 unique creatures in this roguelike auto-battler. Level-up and evolve your Kādomon as you assemble the ultimate team, creating awesome synergies to beat BIG bosses!

title: Stunts Contest: Super Bike
description: Going on the most dangerous curves, you will really show who is a master in driving a powerful motorcycle. Let's prove that you deserve the nickname N01. As a motorcycle driver, your mission is to pass all these difficult levels successfully!

title: Stunts Contest: Beach Edition
description: The time has come when we can combine useful with pleasant. Stunts Contest: Beach Edition is a racing game where as motorcycle driver you will need to pass every mission on these beautiful beaches. You can't hide something like that from people's eyes.

title: Step Journey
description: Unusual turn-based RPG, combining Hack and SlashWith each level, monsters become more difficult and unusual, new weapons and armor appear.Locations are created using procedural generation, each map will be unique, but no less beautiful and interesting.

title: Stardust Valkyries
description: 1v1 anime fighter X platform fighter hybrid with rollback netcode!

title: Staffer Case: A Supernatural Mystery Adventure
description:
Staffer Case is a new sort of mystery game, asking players to find clues, arrange them into documents, and point out the contradictions between them to solve a series of murders.

The game is set in a fictional version of London in the 1960s where 10% of all residents have some sort of supernatural ability. In this city, incidents involving staffers, the people who have these abilities, are constantly occurring.

Players take the role of the Mana Affairs Division's newest detective, Notrick, in order to make sense of these incidents. Since the tricks buried within these staffer cases, at their core, revolve around the supernatural abilities of these criminals, conventional investigative methods won't be enough to solve them. Instead, players will have to rely on the documents that explain what their suspects' abilities entail in order to make sense of everything.

title: Spellmasons
description: Spellmasons is a tactical, turn-based, roguelike where you and your friends play as mages who combine spell pieces into powerful, epic spells!

title: Spell Defender
description: Spell Defender is a 3D, Third-Person, wave defence, survival game, with simple gameplay. Use magical powers to defeat waves of enemies. Each wave rewards you with a choice of a new power. Find synergies and combine these powers to create the ultimate defender.

title: Soulsland: Last Fight
description: New evil army and 4 bosses has rised and captured souls again to gravestone. You Powerful Lord Barbarus are again world only hope. So beat enemies and find captured souls at different areas

title: The Sims 4: First Fits Kit
description: Dress the next generation of trendsetters in fashion fit for a playdate with The Sims 4 First Fits Kit. Whether a child Sim wants to turn heads on the first day of school or run around having fun with friends, these versatile styles will keep them looking fashionable (and SO cute).

title: The Songbird Guild
description: The Songbird Guild is a Yuri RPG/Visual Novel hybrid about magical girls falling in love. Investigate the secrets of a corrupt fantasy world and fight creepy (yet somehow adorable?) monsters in turn-based battles, all to pay the bills in this world where being a magical girl is a regular 9-5 job.

title: The Suits Have Gone Mad!
description: The Suits Have Gone Mad! is a brand-new episodic series where you unravel the mysteries behind the monopoly of Blake & Whitley Innovations and bring color into the world.

title: TheTravelGame
description: A few minutes per play. Your questions will change the world.... A quiz horror game with multiple endings.

title: The Twilight of Infinity: Episode 4 - Therefore I Am
description: "If only I'd paid attention in French class" was something Alex could only say in English, which is not helpful when in 16th century France trying to help victims of the Black Death..

title: Total Tank Generals
description: Every war has its Generals. Take command of an army during World War II and lead them to victory. Strategize your way through many scenarios and real historical military campaigns of past generals.

title: TimeLost
description: TimeLost is a Soulslike Team-Based PvP Arena Fighter. Master precision combat, customize your playstyle through dual-weapon builds, and climb the ranks in Arenas that transcend space and time.

title: This Girl Does Not Exist
description: This Girl Does Not Exist is the first game of its kind. It is a game full of beautiful girls .. all of whom have been generated by a creative AI! Dive into this vibrant colorful puzzle game and discover unique personality of each girl as you unlock their beautiful pictures.

title: Roam Survival
description: In Roam Survival, Sam, an inexperienced mechanic, ventures into a vast open world in search of the last missing explorer. Hunt, build shelters, and explore uncharted lands while uncovering hidden mysteries. Every step could be your last. Will you survive?

title: The Wave of Monké
description: The Wave of Monké is an action-comedy RPG set in the internetwork of the multiverse. Explore the journey of a gorilla wanting to be more... evolved.

title: The Underground Man 2
description: We at MEHSOFT are proud to present a sequel to our very first game The Underground Man. This game is a pleasure for the fans of classic video games. Experience a mix of different genres such as beat 'em up, point-and-click, platformer, and many more in a thrilling post-apocalyptic adventure.

title: The Pizza Courier
description: Our mission is to make people happy, eating the best pizza in town, as it is taken out of the oven. Do you think you are ready for such challenges?

title: The Original Island
description: The Original IslandIs an open world island survival RPG independently developed by Lanmeng technology. From the main perspective of the victim, Lin Yunfeng, it depicts a beautiful and dangerous, magnificent and mysterious island, and tries to solve its secrets.

title: The Longest Walk
description: The Longest Walk is a deeply personal biographical documentary walking simulator game about my father's experience of living with depression and suicidal thoughts.

title: The Legend of Capa Negra
description: The Legend of Capa Negra is a souls-like Action-RPG set in a medieval, dark fantasy world. As a new member of the Rebel Faction, your first mission will be to travel to a small village to meet a contact, find your way through dangerous landscapes, and join the war against the King!

title: The King's Castle
description: The castle is in danger.! Enemies from neighboring kingdoms are approaching. Take everything under control, because there is no one left. Everyone relies only on you.

title: The Hard Game
description: Can you beat these five HARD levels? Who knows, you may just get some "lovely rewards" for your efforts!

title: The First Step
description: Explore 2 levels, and collect all the required items. The levels are timed, so you can try to beat the levels as fast as possible. Or you can casually take your time and explore around. This project is only meant as a learning project for me. So please do not expect a complete game.

title: College Kings: Act II
description: Sex, girls, parties, and power. As a freshman at San Vallejo College, you have the whole world in front of you - but it’s up to you to take it. Will you let the next four years pass you by, or will you lead your fraternity to the crown and become campus royalty?

title: Nope Nope Nurses
description:
Hospital ≠ hospitality...?!
Yamada is afflicted with a rare condition that makes his life hard, and when he manages to break bones in both his hands too, he ends up on a medical bed with beautiful nurses tending to his every need.
Make no mistake, though—these nurses are vicious and no love sparks fly… Will young Yamada leave the hospital with his sanity intact?

title: College Kings: Act III
description: Sex, girls, parties, and power. As a freshman at San Vallejo College, you have the whole world in front of you - but it’s up to you to take it. Will you let the next four years pass you by, or will you lead your fraternity to the crown and become campus royalty?

title: College Kings: Act IV
description: College Kings - Act IV was later cancelled and is now a standalone game by the name of College Kings 2.

title: Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty
description:
Phantom Liberty is a spy-thriller expansion for the open-world action RPG Cyberpunk 2077. The narrative centers on the aftermath of the President of the New United States of America's orbital shuttle being shot down over Dogtown, one of Night City’s most dangerous districts. Players control V, a mercenary tasked with navigating a complex web of espionage and political intrigue.

The expansion introduces Dogtown, a heavily militarized, autonomous zone ruled by a strict and authoritarian leader. With support from NUSA sleeper agent Solomon Reed (voiced by Idris Elba) and returning character Johnny Silverhand (voiced by Keanu Reeves), players engage in a story involving shifting alliances and covert operations. Designed for next-generation hardware, Phantom Liberty features new gameplay mechanics, side activities, and a main storyline centered on themes of power, trust, and survival.

title: Love in Lockdown: Eli Version
description:
This is the counterpart to Love in Lockdown: Ella Version.

It's the year 2025 in the United Kingdom. 5 years have passed since the initial coronavirus lockdown, and with the gradual spread of dangerous new variants, life is still far from what it was. Fighting a losing battle with no certain end in sight, the government has invested billions of pounds into new technology to help aid Britain's single adult households, struggling to deal with the state of perpetual isolation.

You have been selected to participate in a new wave of trials testing the effectiveness of the latest synthetic model. Meet ELI, your emergency lockdown loneliness assistant.

title: Queen Mary's Script Retold
description:
Queen Mary's Script tells the peculiar story of a girl thrust into the world of dolls and contracts. Join Mary, Clause and Edmund as the three travel between worlds, facing their past demons and learning more about themselves that they never intended to. They question just what it is they want as well as if it's worth the sacrifice to get it.

Queen Mary's Script - Retold is a complete overhaul of the main game. Updated graphics are not the only thing you'll see. Story changes, new havens/characters and different outcomes for certain characters will give you a whole different experience from the original!

title: Alight: Lunar Survival
description: Stranded in the darkness, survive and build a base scattered across the lunar surface to generate electricity and alight the moon as you upgrade your equipment, struggle for oxygen, and escape fearsome monsters. Alone or together you will survive, gather, craft, build, and explore.

title: Straight!?
description: Straight!? is a coming-of-age visual novel about Zack, a 19-year-old college student, and his journey of self-discovery after meeting his new roommate, Braden. Players follow Zack as he explores his feelings, navigates his identity, and develops relationships. The game focuses on dialogue and character development, addressing themes like sexuality, attraction, and personal growth through choices that shape the story.

title: Entre Laços e Amassos
description: A young woman who wants to find direction in her life moves to a big city. There she goes to a festival and has misunderstandings and disasters, losing her job, home and getting stuck on a farm with a rude Agroboy.

title: Santa's Secret Valley
description: Santa’s Secret Valley is a light-hearted graphical adventure with a Christmas theme. Can you rescue Santa’s magic items? Each puzzle you solve takes you further into the unfolding story, and one step closer to winning. Highlights include the Christmas Quiz, the TransDimensional InterLocator, and a train ride aboard the Secret Valley Express.

title: A Caçadora: Sorriso de Vampiro
description: Sorriso de Vampiro

title: The Wall Mustn't Fall
description: You will select a hero with unique abilities. As you defend your castle, you will earn money and loot. This will allow you to upgrade your castle and recruit ai controlled allies to synergize with and equip them with weapons and relics. You may also choose to allow the ai to control your hero.

title: Kuzgakai's Dungeon
description: One day you receive a message from your friend, but it was so strange... that night something happened. the Nightmare becomes real... or It was just another dream?... What would you do if your worst nightmare becomes an arcade?... Are you ready to face it? Are you ready to pay for your murder?

title: Exotica: Petshop Simulator
description: Exotica is a simulation game where you run an exotic pet shop in the city.

title: Seafrog
description: Seafrog is an action platformer where you use a giant wrench to perform tricks and combos in order to fly up walls and stick to ceilings! Explore hundreds of hand crafted levels as you grind enemies, complete platforming challenges, and defy gravity to escape a mysterious sinkhole in the ocean.

title: SeaOrama: World of Shipping
description: Seaorama: World of Shipping gives you all the tools necessary to become the next kingpin in the shipping industry. Buy ships, acquire contracts, travel the world, and do the job better than anyone else.

title: Seclusa
description: You're a wildlife photographer staying at a cozy, secluded safari lodge in East Africa. Spend time relaxing at scenic outlooks, snapping photos of local wildlife, and working your way through a variety of upgrades and unlockables in this laid-back photography sandbox.

title: Shaytan
description: Shaytan is psychological horror game.Shaytan is devil in islam. Devil will try to mislead you so that you are on wrong way before Angel of death comes.

title: Shopping Spree: Extreme!!!
description: Make your way around the shopping center to collect items on your shopping list. But be careful; one slip up and you'll be paying for a broken item! Avoid grumpy shoppers or simply shove them out of the way! Various other obstacles get in your way as you fill your cart and make it to checkout!

title: Simple Builder
description: Simple Builder is basically exactly what it's name is a simple building game. You can build a large number of structures and/or large ones and have five save locations to try out. As you build more in each save location your gathering range increases.

title: Skate Rift
description: An immersive first person skateboarding simulator set on an island, interconnected by many courses and rifts.

title: Terrorform
description: Terrorform is a modern take on classic FPS games. Blast your way through a space station and leave a wake of destruction in your wake.

title: The Burrito Quest
description: Someone stole your burrito. You have to find it. What are you waiting for?

title: The Chronicles: Wasteland Assault
description: The wastes of Dubai have been overwhelmed by Screamers. Play and evolve the iconic characters from the hit novel; The Chronicles: Wasteland and take back the dead lands. Survive against the horror and use whatever it takes to last long enough to build sanctions, unlock characters and items.

title: The City Cards Challenge
description: Relax with this challenge by building your city and placing the cards buildings with different effects in an optimal way for the residents.

title: The Entity Code
description: The Entity Code is a sci-fi themed 2D puzzle game with simple but challenging mechanics.

title: The Fairy's Secret
description: In the sequel to the fantasy yuri visual novel, The Fairy's Song, Marnie and Lisbeth return to Fenchapel to visit Marnie’s grandmother. Things soon become complicated, however, when they run into two figures from the past who ought to be dead.

title: Toy Sports
description: With Toy Sports, you will return to an exciting and very special place: your childhood memories. Now it is YOUR time to be the toy you love, drive cars, compete in various sports for points, prizes and glory. Prepare your engines and play with the whole family!

title: Train Simulator: Holzkirchen - Wörgl Route
description: All aboard for Austria! Take charge of cross-border passenger & freight traffic with RSSLO’s Holzkirchen - Wörgl route for Train Simulator.

title: Robot Resistors
description: Robot Resistors is a rogue-lite action game with auto-attacking weapons and deep customization. Choose from multiple stages, characters, weapons, and upgrades to make each twenty-minute run unique. Escape your brutal robot overlords or be turned to scrap!

title: RollCats
description: A futuristic racing game across the galaxy. Huge cats rolling on massive wheels. Drifts, weapons and crazy speed tests your driving skills!

title: Rome Defenders: The First Wave
description: Support the brave Romans and face the terrible creatures from the deepest gates of the underworld!

title: RunBean Galactic
description: Run, jump and roll on your way to the new high score! Sounds easy, right? Not when you try to keep up with the hazards and bonuses that are constantly appearing all around the planet!

title: And Then You Come to a House Not Unlike the Previous One
description:
You haven't been over since she told you a month ago that she was moving to some small town in Wisconsin. But Riley is here, and the computer is here, and that's what matters for now. "Have you played the game yet?"

"You told me to wait to play it with you about a billion times," she says.

A work of interactive fiction by B.J. Best.

title: Rêverie
description: It's your birthday! The first thing you do after opening your gift is try it out on the ice. As you find your bearings with your mentor you start to discover yourself...

title: Cerebral
description: Cerebral is a psychological horror game where every mistake hurts your memory. Save your mind... or lose it to the system.

title: Distant Bloom
description: From a world in ruins to a world in bloom. This serene management game lets you explore an alien planet where things have gone amiss. Harness the power of plants to restore the environment and build a flourishing community with your crewmates.

title: Shutokou Battle Online
description: Shutokou Battle Online was a MMO take on the infamous Shutokou Battle (aka, Tokyo Xtreme Racer) formula. Released on PC only in Japan, this game had a short life from 2003 to 2005.

title: Tagline
description: Tagline is a lightning fast, graffiti based shooter set in a loud, wild world sprinkled with street art, hip-hop, and towering skyscrapers. Parkour and snatch the tags off the walls of this funky metropolis, and overcome an array of enemies and challenges!

title: Life After Magic
description:
"Life After Magic" is a Y2K, queer WLW visual novel focused around retired magical girls!

What's a magical girl to do when the teenage years are over, and there's no more bad guys for you to fight? How about navigating lost connections? Or juggling a totally awful retail gig? Worst of all - your magical powers are fading...

title: Duelyst II
description: Choose your faction, construct your deck and put your strategy to the test in the evolution of the ultimate collectible tactics game.

title: Exipelago
description:
Exipelago is a colony building sim in a fully destructible world. You manage your growing tribe by providing food & shelter while building giant structures above and below the surface with the materials you gather.

You begin with 1-5 Villagers on an empty (randomly generated) island of various sizes. You will learn how to keep your villagers fed, how to provide them with shelter and how they can handle the nights.

Every block and every item in the world of exipelago can be gathered, destroyed, created or crafted into something else and every type of material will result in an equally different item being crafted out of it.

Bring your tribe to gloriness by building a big village on an initially empty island.

title: Drunk: Relapsed
description: Drunk: Relapsed is a challenging and comedic 3D adventure. You will need to stumble and hop through the treacherous streets and alleys to reach the safety of your house. On your journey you'll be able to collect drinks to unlock new outfits.

title: Fury Life
description: Fury Life is a Conway's Game of Life simulator where cells are visualized as animated creatures called "Octos".

title: Dwarven Realms
description: Face massive hordes of mobs and unleash chaotic abilities that paint the screen with mayhem. Dive into the largest mob density of any 3D ARPG and slay them all. Wield epic powers, create your build, and shape a world of endless possibilities in the action-packed ARPG experience.

title: Garbanzo Quest
description: Garbanzo Quest! The crazy bullet-heck platformer where your main weapon is your own spit! Help Garbanzo (and Pinto if you have a buddy) save their Friends from the evil Billi' Bones and his wacky world full of hand-crafted challenges, secrets, and branching paths!

title: Eigengrau
description: A twist at every turn! Explore a colorful shoot 'em up with varied and diverse gameplay beyond the familiar shooting and dodging. Every situation, every enemy, and every boss offers a different handcrafted experience.

title: Escape From Meat City
description: A fast-paced, roguelike first-person shooter with hand-drawn visuals. Escape from the slaughterhouse, shoot your way through hordes of Federal Agents, and collect enough change for the bus!

title: Epileptic Seizure Battle Ball Challenge
description: Collect riches, fight monsters, unlock secrets and balance the task for which you have been chosen, saving humanity from an evil Saurian alien species by participating in a single player, fast paced, top down, permadeath, looter shooting, retro style game of Battle Ball.

title: Geometry Arena 2
description: Geometry Arena 2 is a free-form arena-shooter Roguelite game, dedicated to creating an exciting battle experience. Freely combine difficulty options, components, modules and upgrades to create the best gaming experience for yourself!

title: Puzzle Park
description: Welcome to the puzzle park! You will meet with a lot of puzzles scattered across the park. Solve them and get stars that will help you move forward. Choose your own path on which you will go, because the game is completely non-linear and with an open world.

title: Dimwarper
description: Dimwarper is an Icy Tower type of platformer, where You play as a mysterious character, who gained an ability to swap between two dimensions. Your task is to climb seven towers, controlled by seven wizards with different powers. This journey will require from You great focus and speed. Good luck!

title: Duppy Detective Tashia
description: Help Tashia unravel the case of a heinous murder and find her cell phone in this point & click, mystery adventure based on Caribbean folklore!

title: Slime Runner
description: Explore the treacherous realm as a slime, all while being protected by an ethereal entity in this precision-based platformer. Explore numerous regions, surpass the most difficult challenges, and find your way towards FREEDOM.

title: Falinere Fantasy
description: Falinere Fantasy is a turn-based RPG Dungeon Crawler played via Twitch Chat. Your viewers can change between 7 different classes (Druid, Alchemist, Crystalsmith, Bard, Warrior, Rogue, and Wizard) and run through dungeons, leveling up and gaining skills as they traverse the land.

title: Execute Daddy: Papa ga Nandemo Shinu Game
description: In this ADV game, you become the administrator of a netherworld where you have lost both your memories and your body, and you have to recover your lost memories and body.
