The criminals who come back to life after execution after execution are cute, and their executions are like a show.

title: My Sexual Hospitalization
description: Souma, the main character, is hospitalized and falls in love at first sight with his doctor, Dr. Isami! Even though he keeps getting dumped, he is undeterred and makes a fierce attack, involving "boobs"! Eventually, the doctor begins to enjoy the silly interactions with Souma.

title: Furry Boss
description: Office work is boring as hell, especially when your boss is not a hot woman who likes to tease you. Gladly, we can show you how it feels to have one!

title: Dust & Neon
description: Dust & Neon pits a single mech-enhanced cowboy against an army of robots in this fast-paced, Roguelite Action RPG twin-stick shooter, set in a futuristic Wild West.

title: Echo Wars: Road Rage
description: Drive with one hand while shooting with the other, making your way through the memory lane of the Echo Brothers, two old cyber soldiers whose wacky and hectic memories you'll relive thanks to the magic of VR, in an adventure that can also be played in cooperative mode.

title: Tumble Toys: Aviation
description: Tumble Toys: Aviation is a unique flying game where you play as a tiny plane in a big room.

title: Taxi Life: A City Driving Simulator
description: Climb into the driver's seat of your car and your business, transport passengers across Barcelona and grow your company! Can you help relieve the transportation challenges of a city that never sleeps?

title: Furry Striptease
description: Furry Striptease - is a classic 2D game in the memory genre which is about you find the same pictures and enjoy different images of furry beautiful ladies.

title: Skinny & Franko: Fists of Violence
description: Brutal next chapter of Amiga's legendary beat'em'up 'Franko: The Crazy Revenge' is here. It's time to clean the streets of shit. The iconic game finally gets a sequel it deserves.

title: Dream of Light
description: This is a walking simulator developed by Unreal 4. The scene contains a certain amount of fragmented dialogue content. It tells the story of a young girl who left her hometown to venture into the outside world. .......

title: Rectangle Guy
description: Introducing Rectangle Guy, a brand new game by The Bare Minimum Studios. Rectangle Guy (game) features Rectangle Guy (character) in this platforming adventure! With over 30 levels and 6 boss fights and a plethora of post-game content, there's plenty to do and see in this wacky game.

title: Don't Hide
description: Trapped in a maze with a beast, you must find five keys and their door to escape. The monster can only smell and hear you, but as long as it hasn't fully caught your scent, you can move freely.

title: Pandecrown
description: Killomnia collapsed in 2019 after the virus escaped from the Medical Hospital in Laucthi City, which held the corporation liable for compensation in the Laucthi City Incident in 2019. The verdict led to bankruptcy, causing them and their subsidiaries to close for the year Following.

title: Runic Survivor
description: Combine Runes to craft unique spells! Survive the endless hordes of monsters as you work to break the four Runic seals! Runic is a casual horde shooter with rogue-lite elements and a charming retro aesthetic.

title: Sakura Sunshine
description: Rei and her pet cat, Koneko, are brainstorming the perfect manga! Battle Rei's adorable inner-thoughts as she overcomes her writer's block, shoot'em-up style!

title: Tuning Champions
description: Tuning Champions is a PvP Multiplayer Racing Game where you have to earn money by racing to upgrade your vehicle and beat the others! Featuring full vehicle tuning, low poly style and a lot of fun! Earn money and upgrade your vehicle to beat the others!

title: Outatime
description: Those boards don't work on water! Outatime is a futuristic multiplayer hoverboard racing game. Lean-to-move system designed from the ground up for VR. Race against the clock and other hoverboarders in a futuristic setting. Will you claim victory, complete the race, or be out of time...

title: Dungeons 4
description: The Absolute Evil and its trusted *cough* servant, the Dark Elf Thalya, return in Dungeons 4 after the events of its fabulous predecessor to bring about their triumph over the forces of good once more.

title: My Escort Company
description: Start your own Escort Company now! Join your mentor, recruit girls, build your company, get to know the girls better!

title: V.O.S.S. Turbo
description: VOSS Turbo is a retro styled, on rail, twin stick shooter with controller and keyboard support. Gameplay difficulty will climb as you visit and conquer new worlds. 30 stages to explore, with secrets to uncover, and bosses to whoop. Explore everything the multiverse has to offer!

title: CapoeiRogue: Dandara Cordão de Ouro
description: CapoeiRogue is a rogue-like capoeira game that mixes Afro-descendant culture in Brazil and fantasy, through the game mechanics you will experience elements that were of great importance to our history.

title: Live Cycling Manager 2022
description: Live Cycling Manager 2022 is the ultimate cycling manager game. Select or create the club of your dreams and manage each and every aspect! Become the Sports Manager of a professional team and compete against another 40 teams until you reach the top.

title: Divinus Vanitas
description: This multiplayer souls-inspired spell-casting game sees you collecting equipment and finding new spells to help on your journey of proving your worth to the gods, and redeeming yourself from the cardinal sin of mortality. Explore the floating island and unravel the secrets of the fragmented world.

title: Riding to Bounce City
description: Game inspired by old-school racing games, with explicit sexual content in third person. A mysterious call makes these girls go on a pleasure trip, riding their faithful friend between their legs.

title: Energy Tail
description: Energy Tail is an oldschool arcade game where you fight enemies in relentless arena battles. It's free, so go and give it a try!

title: Europa Universalis IV: Lions of the North
description: Europa Universalis IV: Lions of the North adds new mission trees and historical options for a number of Baltic Sea nations. Many of these options include new “branching missions'' which allow greater variety as you explore different alternate histories through the decisions you make.

title: Input Chaos
description: A physics based multiplayer fighting game.

title: Double Trouble
description: Double Trouble is a dating simulator where every choice you make matters! You will have to become Scott, the manager of a small branch of a large company in a small town. Can you handle the hurricane of emotions, office intrigue and maybe even find love?

title: Enclosure 3-D
description: You are Mike Goodman, joining a mission to investigate mysterious activity at an arctic base. Text-parser mystery adventure game inspired by classics of the genre, using pixel art in 3D.

title: Exterminate Zombies: Get Paid
description: Exterminate Zombies: Get Paid (EZGP) is a 4 player co-op top down zombie shooter. Players survive endless waves of enemies with the chance of extraction after a final boss every 30 waves.

title: Sorry, Wrong Door
description: Sorry, Wrong Door is an online co-op game for 1-4 players. Trapped in a haunted castle with a powerful demon hunting you. Explore the ever-changing castle, slay monsters, fight boss battles, uncover clues, avoid traps, and use powerful weapons to escape.

title: Fallen Bride Mege
description: Mege is the childhood sweetheart of the protagonist. Lucky enough, he is able to marry Mege with everyone's blessing and lives a happy life. But the sudden news of layoffs broke his peaceful days.

title: From Madness with Love
description: This is a dating sim with guys you will never be on the same page with! For some reason, you just can't communicate with the guy you like... An unusual yet extraordinary experience with a cute pixel art style, fully voiced in Japanese.

title: Purge Force 2070
description: The Sputnik 986 space station is under attack by alien life forms. You and your team are part of the cleanup team that is supposed to rid the station of the alien. Secure and clear the station from the aliens.

title: Railway Fun: Adventure Park
description: Organize railroad networks in this exciting time management game! Direct trains and monorails to clear areas and venture into new park sections.

title: Slide Girls
description: Be a good boy and enjoy this puzzle game with sexy girls.

title: RecNaviClub
description: 9 kinds of games are included in the package. What was developed for prevention and recreation. There is a variety of games lined up for brain training, physical exercise, learning, and cognitive function testing.

title: Shooting Waltz
description: Fight with beautiful waltzes with crisp shooting battles, what are you waiting for?

title: Devil Devour Alive DX
description: Devil Devour Alive DX is a pick-up-and-play occult themed arcade game with an over the top 90s style. It supports vertical screen orientation, online leaderboards, and unlockables. It also features retro 32-bit era style graphics, CRT shader, and spooky synth-wave music.

title: Garden Simulator
description: Plant, design, harvest. With Garden Simulator you'll get your own allotment, place deco elements and cultivate plants to harvest and sell them. Get ready for a beautiful time in nature. Always remember: A garden is a delight to the eye and a solace for the soul.

title: Mud Warriors
description:
The black gate at the east end of the schoolyard is closed, locked. The After School Program does not relinquish its warriors willingly.

Here is where the mud is thinnest on the ground, and in some places the painted lines of the kickball diamond are visible.

A text adventure by Ryan Veeder.

title: Rift Loopers
description: Survive the horrors of the multiverse, alone or with your comrades, as you battle against an onslaught of insectoid like creatures. Combine abilities in different ways each loop to overcome and return safely to your universe.

title: MapleStory Worlds
description: MapleStory Worlds is the next generation "Content Creation & Play Platform" where anyone can build and enjoy content. MapleStory Worlds welcomes you with an array of diverse Worlds, from content uniquely designed by myself to original series created by other MapleStory World Developers! With a roster of easy-peasy creation-paced avatars, communicating with your friends will double your experience in MapleStory Worlds!

title: The Cabin: Summer Vacation | Episode 1
description: When your summer plans take a sharp detour, and you find yourself out in the middle of the wood, you'll soon learn this will be summer you'll never forget. Filled with adventure, love, fear and danger; your choices could be the difference between life and death out here, at The Cabin.

title: Soul Dog TD
description: Tower defense game with one Soul Dog and six units. You don't always have to fight with a full team in battle. Strengthen your army efficiently by collecting souls with Soul Dogs and training your units according to the situation. Can you defend the 30 Wave with your leadership?

title: Koi hi Kogaruru Kamikakushi
description: Tetsuya Kai sneaks into school at night to pick up a forgotten item and is suddenly attacked by an unidentified monster. In a desperate pinch, he is saved by his classmate Tomomi Soshi.The mystery surrounding the "shikigami" that attacked him and saved him is explored.

title: Blöck
description: Blöck is a hardcore and challenging 2D Platformer. The goal is easy: Get to the level end as fast as possible and try not to die. But let's be realistic. You will die. A lot.

title: Train Sim World 3: DB BR 155 Loco
description: A classic loco dating back to the 1970s and Deutsche Reichsbahn’s answer to the growing freight and passenger railways in Germany. The DB BR 155, or "Electric Container" as it’s affectionately known by railfans, has stood the test of time.

title: Train Sim World 3: BR Class 33 Loco
description: Train Sim World 3 BR Class 33 now joins the BR Class 47 and BR Class 09 to further bring to life the heritage festivities of the West Somerset Railway route’s diesel gala.

title: Train Sim World 3: BR Class 52 Western Loco
description: Train Sim World 3: BR Class 52 Loco now joins the BR Class 47 and BR Class 09 to further bring to life the heritage festivities of the West Somerset Railway route’s diesel gala – and is required to use this loco add-on.

title: Train Sim World 3: Tees Valley Line: Darlington - Saltburn-by-the-Sea
description: Experience a bygone era of British Rail in the historic birthplace of railways and the heart of the British Steel industry. Operate your trains over an aging rail network on a route deep in transition between old and new.

title: Train Sim World 3: Southern BR Class 313 EMU
description: Pep up operations on the South Coast of England with the classic BR Class 313/2, adorned in the distinctive Southern Coastway livery and ready to serve Brighton, Seaford and beyond in Train Sim World 2: East Coastway.

title: Train Sim World 3: Rush Hour - London Commuter Route
description: Experience one of Britain’s busiest main lines, from the nation’s Capital to England’s oldest coastal destination, via the international hub of Gatwick Airport. Whether Southern commuter or Gatwick Express, a flurry of passengers await in Train Sim World 2: Rush Hour - London Commuter.

title: Train Sim World 3: Sand Patch Grade Route
description: Experience the challenge of hauling heavy CSX freight through the tight and winding Alleghenies. Navigate the vast Cumberland Yard on complex switching duties, and do battle with nail-biting grades, all in Train Sim World 2: Sand Patch Grade.

title: Train Sim World 3 S-Bahn Zentralschweiz: Luzern - Sursee Route
description: Experience the thrill of racing around tight bends, tackling steep gradients, and providing an intense passenger service in the heart of Switzerland. State-of-the-art traction and systems await with Rivet Games’ S-Bahn Zentralschweiz: Luzern - Sursee!

title: Train Sim World 3: Schnellfahrstrecke Köln-Aachen Route
description: Experience the thrill of high-speed inter-city German rail as you push the throttle through bustling German Metropolis and the rolling open countryside in the exquisite Train Sim World 2: Schnellfahrstrecke Köln - Aachen.

title: Train Sim World 3: Sherman Hill: Cheyenne - Laramie Route
description: All the grandeur of big-time, modern American freight railroading – bustling and constant action, tough grades, powerful diesels, majestic western scenery, and extraordinary history – come together on Union Pacific’s legendary Sherman Hill.

title: Train Sim World 3: Tharandter Rampe: Dresden - Chemnitz Route
description: Lean into yesteryear and experience the challenge of unique tilting diesel traction. Power out of Dresden, tackle steep gradients bordered by forest, and drive through the picturesque valleys of Saxony and beyond to Chemnitz with Train Sim World 2: Tharandter Rampe.

title: Train Sim World 3: West Cornwall Local: Penzance - St Austell & St Ives Route
description: Experience the rolling hills and picturesque countryside of the “Great Western”, aboard classic British diesel traction, with Rivet Games’ West Cornwall Local: Penzance - St Austell & St Ives route.

title: Train Sim World 3: Cajon Pass: Barstow - San Bernardino Route
description: Experience the challenge of hauling a nation’s freight industry on the back of your 4000-horsepower shoulders. Tackle stunning mountain ranges and blinding deserts as you tote tonnage through the winding curves of California with Train Sim World 3: Cajon Pass.

title: Train Sim World 3: Schnellfahrstrecke Kassel - Würzburg Route
description: Experience the thrill of racing through dense, forested valleys, over awe-inspiring viaducts and deep into swooping tunnels. Germany’s classic Inter City Express awaits on our longest route yet with Train Sim World 3: Schnellfahrstrecke Kassel - Würzburg.

title: Train Sim World 3: Southeastern Highspeed - London St Pancras: Ashford Intl & Faversham Route
description: Experience the unique and exciting blend of classic main line running and thrilling high-speed commuting, in London and the Garden of England with Train Sim World 3: Southeastern Highspeed – now including Ashford International and Dartford!

title: Karma Collector
description: This is an action combat game that is played with with the D and A keys or a controller. You earn experience points by defeating enemies. When you have earned enough your rank will increase, which raises your attributes such as your attack power. A tutorial is available.

title: Train Sim World 3: Spirit of Steam: Liverpool Lime Street - Crewe Route
description: Step back in time and discover the soot and sounds of the romantic steam era through historic Merseyside and Cheshire with Train Sim World 3: Spirit of Steam: Liverpool Lime Street - Crewe!

title: Lunatic Viewer: Streamer Girl at Risk
description: The protagonist who became a recluse after being bullied, meets a group of streamer girls who broadcast live. It was supposed to be an escape from reality but... he started wanting to make them his own...

title: Train Sim World 3: Class 20 'Chopper'
description: A veteran in every right, having been in use since the 1950s, the BR Class 20 “Chopper” has earned its place among enthusiasts’ hearts; and now Type 1 traction comes to life in Train Sim World 2, ready for hard-working duty on the Tees Valley Line!

title: Train Sim World 3: CSX C40-8W Loco
description: As created for Train Sim World 2, the versatile CSX C40-8W is richly detailed and features realistic controls and operating performance. The powerful locomotive wears CSX’s attractive YN2 livery and is authentically suited for duty on Sand Patch Grade.

title: Train Sim World 3: DB BR 101 Loco
description: The DB BR 101 is a classic among the modern electric locomotives of Germany, with heritage spanning some of the nation’s most revolutionary designs and continuing the honour by working throughout the Deutsche Bahn network every day. Experience this icon for yourself in Train Sim World 2!

title: Train Sim World 3: DB BR 187 Loco
description: Experience the pinnacle of modern motive power and the latest generation in a long line of classics with Skyhook Games’ DB BR 187 for Train Sim World 2!

title: Train Sim World 3: DB BR 204 Loco
description: The DB BR 204 was a double-ended loco with the cab in the middle, allowing for seamless operation in either direction. 860 of these would be built, and they were put to use on freight traffic throughout Germany. Experience the classic DB BR 204 for yourself in Train Sim World 2!

title: Train Sim World 3: DB BR 363 Loco
description: A true veteran of the rails, the DB BR 363 has spent decades on shunting duties and light freight work throughout Germany, and you can experience this for yourself along the stunning Ruhr Valley in Train Sim World 2!

title: Train Sim World 3: DB G6 Diesel Shunter
description: Ready your hard hat and get to work in the yards of Hagen and Wuppertal with TSG’s DB G6 Diesel Shunter for Train Sim World 2!

title: Train Sim World 3: Harlem Line: Grand Central Terminal - North White Plains Route
description: Operate modern and classic equipment as you ferry commuters in and out of the iconic Grand Central Terminal; hurry them across the tightly packed Park Avenue, over the Harlem River, and out to the New York suburbs with Train Sim World 2: Harlem Line.

title: Train Sim World 3: Island Line 2022 - BR Class 484 EMU
description: Experience a unique marvel of rail innovation, an Underground veteran turned Solent explorer. Modern-day Isle of Wight duties await with Rivet Games’ Island Line 2022: BR Class 484 for Train Sim World 2!

title: Train Sim World 3: LIRR M3 EMU Loco
description: Dressed in yellow, gray, and silver, the LIRR M3 EMUs have become railroading classics, soldiering on since the 1980s and expected to remain in serve for a number of years to come. Experience the challenges of operating the memorable LIRR M3 EMUs on Train Sim World 2’s Long Island Rail Road route!

title: Train Sim World 3: Nahverkehr Dresden -Riesa Route
description: Be in control of modern traction, and explore the countryside of Train Sim World 2: Rush Hour - Nahverkehr Dresden.

title: Train Sim World 3: Rush Hour - Boston Sprinter Route
description: Experience the fastest rail line in America, from modern suburbia to sprawling countryside, linking the state capitals of Massachusetts and Rhode Island, in command of both Amtrak Regional and MBTA Commuter operations with Train Sim World 2: Rush Hour’s Boston Sprinter.

title: Train Sim World 3: Horseshoe Curve: Altoona - Johnstown & South Fork Route
description: Horseshoe Curve! In American railroading, there are few places that evoke more history and drama.

title: Train Sim World 3: London Underground 1938 Tube Stock EMU Loco
description: Experience a true London veteran that harkens back to the Art Deco era, a unit that defined Underground commuting for generations. Mind the gap, as Rivet Games’ London Underground 1938 Stock has arrived in Train Sim World 2 for yesteryear Bakerloo Line operations!

title: Train Sim World 3: RhB Anniversary Collection
description: Climb aboard an eclectic mix of authentic and detailed Ge 4/4 II locomotives in celebratory liveries, and experience the wintry Alps from the classic observation coach, with Rivet Games’ RhB Anniversary Collection for the challenging Arosalinie.

title: Train Sim World 3: Bakerloo Line Route
description: Experience the hustle and bustle of packed-in commuters, trains every few minutes, the echo of screeching rails in tunnels with the classic Bakerloo Line, rendered in its entirety within Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 3: BR Class 31 Loco
description: A classic loco which harkens back to the dawn of dieselisation and the backbone of British Rail’s low-to-mid range fleet of motive power, the iconic BR Class 31 has served for decades and now you can take this iconic loco over Tees Valley rails.

title: Train Sim World 3: Caltrain MP15DC Diesel Switcher Loco
description: Climb aboard for challenging switching, maintenance-of-way, and train rescue operations with the Train Sim World 2 Caltrain Electro-Motive MP15DC diesel locomotive for the Peninsula Corridor: San Francisco – San Jose route!

title: Train Sim World 3: Caltrain MP36PH-3C 'Baby Bullet' Loco
description: Caltrain’s modern and flashy MP36PH-3C diesels have been operating on Baby Bullet services since 2003, and now you can experience them for yourself in Train Sim World 2! Race southbound from the futuristic cab of the MP36 and be pushed on the return from the immersive Bi-Level Cab Car.

title: Train Sim World 3: Cane Creek: Thompson - Potash Route
description: Journey through the American West’s awe-inspiring, rugged, and remote desert scenery while tackling heavy tonnage and daunting grades with the Union Pacific Cane Creek Subdivision route for Train Sim World 2!

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Pirate Palooza
description: 2 Brand New Tables with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Pirate themed tables with an emphasis on X

title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent - Vol.1 Challenge Quest: "Super Special Dreamer EX"
description: Description: Adds a bonus challenge quest featuring an enhanced version of the boss encounter from Super Special Dreamer. This quest does not include any story content.

title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent - Vol.1 Bonus Unit: Spinel
description: Description: Adds Spinel, a main character from the storyline, into the game as a playable character.

title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent - Vol.1 Bonus Unit: Citrin
description: Description: Adds Citrin, a main character from the storyline, into the game as a playable character.

title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent - New Adventure Volume 1: Super Special Dreamer 1-3
description: Description: A new adventure in the Sapphire Waterlands, featuring three brand new quests! Citrin and Spinel take center stage as main characters! Just what will become of the mysterious treasure hunt on the faraway island?

title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent - CoH 3: Felpurr
description: Description: A special unit that hearkens back to an older title in the series, this special Felpurr is straight out of Class of Heroes 3. This Felpurr is no stronger and no weaker than any of the other Felpurrs that can be recruited in the game.

title: Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent - CoH 3: Dwarf
description: Description: A special unit that hearkens back to an older title in the series, this special Dwarf is straight out of Class of Heroes 3. This Dwarf is no stronger and no weaker than any of the other Dwarves that can be recruited in the game.

title: Puttium
description:
Puttium is a short puzzle where the cursor passes over a panel, it changes color.
Match the colors vertically or horizontally to erase them within the time limit.

title: Voice of Steel
description: An online robot fighting simulator where you can build your own character from 16 modules. You're able to create your own strikes and use them all (up to 32) in combat. Each module has its own health points and can be torn off. But you can fight without arm or leg.

title: Extra Lives
description: See how long you can survive in a world full of brainless zombies and heartless humans! Find your place among hundreds of other characters spread across several warring factions, and battle to reclaim every corner of a sprawling city in real-time.

title: Alphadia Neo
description: Use up to three styles for each character in turn-based battles to get benefits from recovery to fighting styles. Increase Energi levels by raising multiple elementals unique to the Alphadia series and learn new skills. The combo skill called Resonant Skill is also the key to victory.

title: Our Life: Beginnings & Always - Derek's Story
description: Spend wonderful summer days in the company of Derek Suarez during Steps 2 and 4! This is an optional DLC for the free game Our Life: Beginnings & Always.

title: Curious Expedition 2: Robots of Lux
description: The exploration roguelike of Curious Expedition and the robotic pirates from SteamWorld Heist come together for the best collaboration of the industrial age.

title: Frightened
description: Frightened is a cooperative horror and survival game that can be played with 1-4 players. Your goal is to destroy the evil with your team and leave. Collect items in the area with your team, find the demon's weak spot and destroy it! But don't you dare get caught.

title: Field of Glory II: Medieval - Sublime Porte
description: At the end of the thirteenth century, with the Seljuk Sultanate of Rum in terminal decline, Anatolia was divided into several small independent Turkish principalities, called beyliks.

title: Tasty Static
description: Tasty Static is a videogame where you go really fast and jump a lot. You'll probably get really annoyed along the way too.

title: Doghouse 2
description:
You find yourself in your backyard yet again with the same goal: constructing the perfect doghouse. But this time, things get even crazier than they were last time.
This game has five endings in total.

title: The Salatroisk Incident
description: 'The Salatroitsk Incident' is a short PSX-style horror game set in a fictional Russian city after a nuclear incident.

title: Harmful
description: Made in 2 days for Haunted PS1 Wretched Weekend.

title: MetalCore
description: MetalCore is an NFT-based, open world, mechanized combat game. Fight alongside your faction in territorial battles on a mineral rich alien planet. Win vehicles and mechs, craft gear, recruit pilots, develop land, sell and trade gear and much more as players battle for planetary domination.

title: Normal Adult Human Person
description: This was made in a week for Brackeys game jam with the theme "stronger together".

title: Death of a Pet
description: A short and disturbing little horror game about the tragedy of losing a pet.

title: Football Manager 2023
description: New tools thrust you closer to every aspect of the beautiful game in FM23. Get ready for your journey towards footballing glory.

title: Joey and Penguin's 2 Player Adventure
description: Penguin the penguin has been framed for a crime and Joey the monkey is determined to prove his innocence. In this top-down action adventure, 2 players must toss a water balloon back and forth to knock out foes and collect items as they journey ever closer to the truth.

title: Again and Again
description: Again and Again is a first-person psychological horror game. How much can a game affect your real life? Enjoy the terrifying moments of being in a realistic home environment and a suspenseful story.

title: Car Dealership Simulator
description: Car Dealership Simulator is an extremely comprehensive and detailed car dealership business simulation game.

title: Little Horror Raiser
description: Choose a little horror to raise then unleash it upon the world.

title: Lust Theory
description: Lust Theory is an adult Visual Novel in which you take control of a 20 year old guy whose life is turned up side down when he finds out that the same day is repeating. The game is packed with sex, humor, romance, drama and mystery.

title: Quite Soulless
description: Dive into the surreal world of J.MacGoey's adventure, where only aliens could help him to get out or even to understand where he is...

title: Sambaquis: A Story before Brazil
description: Sambaquis - A History Before Brazil is a game developed entirely by archaeologists and allows the player to experience the daily life within an indigenous group about 3000 years before the present in archaeological sites today denominated sambaquis (shellmounds). To perform the funeral of the Elder of your group, explore the ancient Brazilian landscape, talk to people and collect the necessary resources.

title: Sword: Depths of the Void
description: Sword: Depths of the Void is WorthyWorm and The Sword Teams first upcoming game, releasing in 2025. Sword: Depths of the Void is a 2D Action RPG Platformer with a special sword that can morph it's blade into different weapons. Play as Trent Helms, the chosen one of this legendary sword, and make your way through various areas in open-world forms, bring people with you on your journey, explore a town in the sky, and much, much more.

title: Cosmo Vulpes
description: Inspired by 90's and 2000's 3D platformers, Cosmo Vulpes is a sci-fi adventure where your main tool is the jetpack. Play as bounty hunter fox called Klaus, with his jetpack and others gadgets developed by his friend Safira, a brilliant and skilled mechanic, you will help him to pass through challenges and missions on this adventure, earning money and collecting Vultechs, which are a big source of energy, but he is not the only one looking for them!

title: Darksiders II: Limited Edition
description:
The Limited Edition includes free access to the "Argul's Tomb" DLC pack, when it becomes available.

Wield the unstoppable power of Death, the most feared of the legendary Four Horsemen. Battle forces of heaven, hell and beyond, in an epic world unlike anything you have seen before.

title: Wizordum
description: Wizordum is a retro-inspired FPS with a focus on action and light puzzles. It blends the best features of classic fantasy shooters from the 90s with some modern aspects making it a unique experience. Take the role of a Cleric and fight against Chaos that roams the land - smash, burn and loot!

title: Warframe: Veilbreaker
description:
Although The New War is largely over, Narmer’s enslavement of the Origin System continues. But who is in control of Narmer now? Many Grineer and others remain imprisoned and helpless under the crushing influence of the Narmer Veil.

Enter Kahl-175. Having survived his brush with the Sentients, and now free from their shackles, he emerges as the Origin System’s newest savior. Wield his explosive Grineer armaments as you race against time to rescue your Brothers from Narmer’s oppressive clutches. Battle Archons alongside your Squadmates, meet the 50th Warframe Styanax*, take on all-new Missions, bend time with the Protea Caladrius Collection, and much more!

title: Rocket League: Season 8
description:
It's time to take it outside!
Far from the bright lights of Utopia Coliseum, the dynamic neighborhood of Sovereign Heights is home to an underground Soccar scene like no other. While crews of tuner cars compete for street cred, local garages work through the night, beautifying the block with vibrant custom rides.

Dive into the Sovereign Heights Arena, play through a gritty new Rocket Pass, and unlock the classic Honda Civic Type R in Season 8 starting September 7!

title: Angst
description: Dive into the abyss of Angst, a first-person survival horror game. Explore the cube as a Private detective and try to survive. Discover its many secrets and maybe... Maybe you will escape...

title: Reimus Awesome Holiday
description: Its Reimus Day off. But her day is ruined by an unknown force in Gensokyo! Play as Reimu to find out what this mysterious group is about and uncover their secret!

title: Seeking Asylum: Revelations
description: Seeking Asylum: Revelations is a Single player/ multiplayer Co-Op video game for the PC. It is 100% free to play and you may enjoy it with your friends at any time. Connect through Discord voice chat and shoot zombies with your friends in this story driven Left for Dead style game.

title: Dayshift at Freddy's 3
description: Dayshift at Freddy's 3 is the third and final game in the series.

title: Pixel drawing block
description: Pixel drawing block is a leisure and nourishing game. In the game, you need to fill in the block according to the prompts of the number to complete the hidden graphic. You need to push the density according to the value, and the results graphic will be obtained after completing the topic.

title: Lights e Shades: Safìna
description: A 2D turn-based fantasy RPG. Equipped; Grow; Aggregates; Form friendships; Uncover secrets; Fight; You decide. An original storyline, day / night cycle, freedom of action and what you do will influence the story.

title: Ami's Room
description: An exploration game set in a surreal dreamscape full of projections. Piece together past recollections and elusive memories. Make a choice as the reality and dreamed world begins to blur...

title: Azurea: Sora no Uta
description: A fantasy life RPG where you become one with the world.

title: Sir Stretchalot: The Plight of the Elves
description: Sir Stretchalot is back! After a sensual moaning leads our hero to a sharp-eared hottie with a tight ass that promises immortality, Sir Stretchalot quickly finds himself caught up in a brand new adventure full of ruffians to flog, hotties to stretch, and panties to collect!

Best game in the world

An abstract, experimental dystopian game.

title: The Settlers: New Allies - Deluxe Edition
description: Upgrade your game experience with the Deluxe Edition including the game, the Deluxe Pack and additional digital content.

title: Super Anime Waifu BBQ Simulator
description: Grill Guy needs Waifu's help! Tour the Glazed Fields looking for Grill Guy's lost BBQ sauce! Explore various mouth watering sections of the Glazed Fields, a mysterious place that somehow has floating hot dogs and ground beef mountains, is this even edible?

title: Dereism
description: Dereism is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame where you control a girl called Mayu and explore different worlds. The goal is explore and collect Flowers (effects).

title: Snowblind Aces
description: Two aces shelter from a snowstorm under the wing of a biplane. They've duelled and played in the air for years. Love is inevitable. But what kind of relationship will they end up in?

title: Dead Like Ants
description: You play as a young woman in red overalls, a red worker ant. Every spring, five dangerous creatures visit the tree and threaten the village, and every spring, the Queen sends one of her daughters to negotiate with them. This spring, the Queen wants you to be that daughter.

title: Rogue of the Multiverse
description:
Welcome to Dryzandia, convict 76954. Oh, you're a human? We don't get many of your kind around here, and when we do they don't last for long.

Escape? To where? There's nothing out there but barren wasteland and a saurian civilisation that'll eat you alive. But... every so often one of you alien inmates gets selected for some government programme or something. I don't know what they do there, but it can't be worse than this place... Can it?

title: Timepiece Ensemble
description:
It’s the day before Hourai Shinobazu Academy’s culture festival. Taki and the rest of the Pip Club’s members are busy preparing their booth. On to way to the discount store to buy some last-minute supplies, he came upon a new store in a back alley called Kikouya (House of Tricks). Entering the shop, he was greeted by a talking cat Tetmet who took his order and brought him everything he needed, and at a bargain too. When he was about to leave, the storeowner Kuroha asked him if he would like to ‘buy time’. He was perplexed at her question, but was too worried about finishing up the club’s booth for the culture festival, muttering that ‘if he only had one more day, then everything would be done in time’. “Thank you, please come again,” said Kuroha as he left.

As expected, there wasn’t enough time for them to finish their preparations, so the club members all stayed overnight at the school to finish up. Although some parts were still not completely done, they planned to give it their all. When they woke up, they began their preparations for the culture festival the next day. An extra day had been added due to Taki’s wish, and he was the only one who realized it.

title: Pinball Science
description: Pinball Science is a video game published in 1998 on Windows by Dorling Kindersley. It's an educational and puzzle game, set in a pinball theme.

title: The Five Steps to Ensuring Momo Graduates Successfully!!!
description:
As a magical girl, it is your duty to fight against the forces of evil and save the planet!!!
Now, you're being faced by your most daunting task yet... Ensuring a high schooler graduates.

title: Iron Marines Invasion
description: Iron Marines Invasion will give you hours of colorful, fun gameplay in this epic real-time strategy space odyssey, available to play offline.

title: Fingercrafts
description: Bite, bleed and lick. The skin of the fingers around the nail have comforted and calmed.

title: Bike Banditz
description: Bike Banditz is a horizontal scrolling shoot 'em up game developed by Hot Pulse and published by the doujin circle French Bread in August 2003 for Windows.

title: Stella Nova
description: Build modular space stations, manage citizen crews, and master a deep crafting chain in a procedurally generated solar system with real orbital physics. Mine asteroids, smelt alloys, manufacture components, and expand across the planets!

title: Hypnospace Enforcer
description: The game takes place in the year 2114. During that year, people are using pink electronic headbands in their sleep to connect to a world called Hypnospace. It is the future, and everyone is using it. But, there are bad apples who tend to break the rules of Hypnospace, and it is your job as an HSPD Enforcer to traverse across the Hypnospace road to bring these people to justice. The gameplay is rather simple, and is split up into three pint-sized levels and even features subtext and social commentary, and ramming your police cruiser into other cars causes your screen to shake, as well as big ol' explosions, and if you hit into oncoming cars, the cars fly off the road completely.

title: Smoke Attack
description: Smoke Attack is a top-down shooter game made for the Swiss government as part of an anti-smoking campaign. The player fights against the aggressive smoking balls with cigarettes by shooting them with an oxygen gun. The goal is to reach the next level and fight even more smoke. On each level players can find extra ammunition, secret weapons and hidden keys. The gameplay is non-violent; after being shot smoking balls are turned into oxygen.

title: For I, the Moon
description: A short conversation with the moon.

title: Tron: Identity
description: Something has been taken. Enter a new Grid and forge alliances via visual novel gameplay, uncovering truths through Identity Disc puzzles. Make critical decisions and plot your own course in a world without a creator.

title: Disney Illusion Island
description: Join Mickey & Friends on a quest to explore the mysterious island of Monoth and recover three mystical books to save the world from disaster! Choose your favorite character and unlock special abilities as you perform high-flying platforming feats, solve fun puzzles, and take on epic boss battles. Run, swim, swing, and jump your way through a beautiful yet mysterious island and discover rich biomes, intriguing characters, and hidden secrets!

title: LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga - Galactic Edition
description: The Galactic Edition includes 6 new packs in Character Collection 2, plus the 7 original packs from Character Collection 1.

title: Gargoyles Remastered
description: Gargoyles Remastered is an artfully crafted revival of the 1995 SEGA Genesis classic 16-bit side-scrolling platform adventure. Relive the epic journey of Goliath and the Gargoyles featuring enhanced visuals, animations, and SFX, all inspired by the acclaimed animated series. The world of Gargoyles comes to life with a level of detail that will thrill fans of the animated series and retro gaming enthusiasts alike. Experience classic gameplay that stays authentic to its predecessor while including new features such as achievements, gameplay rewind, and more!

title: Assessment Examination
description:
Thanks for applying to the Authenticity Assessment Department.

We wish you luck on your upcoming examination!

You will need it.

title: Shinobi Rising
description:
Welcome to Shinobi Rising, the exciting new game set in the Japanese-inspired cyberpunk universe of Katana-Ra. In this thrilling adventure, you play as a shinobi who must solve a murder mystery and discover the culprit behind the death of an innocent child heiress.

As you navigate your way through the streets Clan Kata’s village, the entire game takes place across one single night and you'll need to use all your cunning and skill to survive. Uncover clues and solve puzzles and inch closer to uncovering the truth behind the killing. But be warned, this is a village where not everyone is what they seem.

Who will you strike from the shadows?

title: Marisa no Kagi
description: A doujin game by -NRF- based on the Touhou Project series.

title: Tinysss!
description: This is an action game created by Wanmpaku Pixels.

title: Chico Bento: Um Dia na Roça
description: Children's game about the Brazilian character Chico Bento.

title: Among Us Arena: Ultimate
description: The Ultimate Among Us Arena experience has arrived! Fight with over 30 different crewmates all with their own strengths and abilities!

title: 195 Hours in the Cold
description:
Your long journey through the icy wastes is finally at its end. You hope. Your eyes are heavy, but sleep does not come... there is a faint, distant memory of fire and bloodshed...

Pass through the empty, echoing halls to learn what has transpired in your long, long absence.

Made for the Haunted PS1 Madvent Calendar 2020.

title: Easter Bonus
description: Easter Bonus is a match-three game with an Easter theme. To clear the levels, you must turn all the squares gold. You do this by making matches of three or more items over them or using bonus items. Later in the game, some squares are coated in ice. Items in ice cannot be moved and iced squares cannot be turned gold until the ice is removed. To break the ice, you match the item trapped in the ice or use a bonus item. You must do this before the candle on the left burns down, meaning your time is up. As mentioned earlier, there are bonus items

title: Smok: Legend of the Laid-Back Heroes
description: Smok: Legend of the Laid-Back Heroes is an RPG Maker fangame themed around the talents of Hololive. To prevent the awakening of the Demon Lord, the main character, accompanied by Subaru, Mio, Okayu, and Korone, embarks on a very absurd adventure.

title: Nim's Sin Removal Service
description:
An amateur occultist fails to summon the devil, and is now haunted by seven doppelgangers representing his sins! (Will he be able to exorcise them before Dad gets home?)

Scare the spirits out of hiding, then chase them down and exorcise them from this mortal realm!

title: Shada Kalo
description:
A game jam build for the Epic Mega Jam 2022.
The theme of the jam was: "As Above So Below"

Control the pair of characters in game to solve your way out of each level by solving puzzles.

WASD : Movement

Space : Jump

title: Don't Shit on My #!$@& Roof
description: Don't Shit On My Fucking Roof is a roguelite survival with an extremely simple gameplay. Move and aim, you don't even have to shoot! Choose a starting deity, gain experience and build your equipment. For you and your home. And yes, it looks like the game with vampires there... Or the one with lovecraftian monsters, or the one with living gun bullets, or the game with the crying baby... but well, here, we shoot pigeons.

title: Ebola 3
description: Ebola 3 is created in the spirit of the great classics of survival horrors. In this game, you will control the main character with a first-person camera which makes you feel like you’re in a real horror movie.

title: Second Stone
description: Second Stone is a colorful Action RPG built around two fully playable parallel worlds. Play as Shiren, a young treasure hunter who can cross between the vibrant Light World and its sinister mirror, the Shrouded World. Master fast-paced combat and forge your path to power with elemental Manastones.

title: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra
description:
This narrative-driven ensemble game stars Captain America Steve Rogers, Black Panther Azzuri (T'Challa's grandfather), U.S. soldier and member of the Howling Commandos Gabriel Jones, and leader of the fledgling Wakandan Spy Network, Nanali.

All four characters will be playable at different parts of the story. According to Skydance, players can look forward to "intuitive controls and exhilarating second-to-second gameplay that captures the action and excitement of Marvel, inspired by landmark comics, television, and films, as they navigate this all-new glob-trotting adventure."

title: Assassin's Creed: Codename Hexe
description:
Official details are thin on Hexe, but it appears to have a horror slant, and Cote said it would provide “a different experience” in terms of game and game structure. It is heavily rumored to be set somewhere in the Holy Roman Empire during the infamous Witch Trials that were prominent in the 17th century. "Hexe" is German for "Witch" and in itself hints towards this setting.

Project Hexe is being led by Clint Hocking, who previously worked on Far Cry 2 and Watch Dogs: Legion. It will launch into the Assassin's Creed: Infinity Hub.

title: The Impossible Bottle
description: Housework is only as dull as your imagination. Join Emma, six years old, on a playful adventure of peculiar proportions.

title: The Moonlit Tower
description:
No, not a prison, though stone stands around you, as expressionless as a mirror awaiting face and form; and in the silence you hear no plaint of flute or roar of gong, but instead the crash of porcelain shattering.

A work of interactive fiction by Yoon Ha Lee.

title: Tapestry
description: Take control of one of four unique factions and weave your actions into legend! Tapestry is an asymmetrical wargame for 1-4 players where you must lock in your actions several turns in advance and adapt to survive. Will your strategy prevail? Or will you fall — forgotten to history?

title: Crocodracula: The Beginning
description: The first Taleframe game based on the 90s children's horror soap opera.

title: U.S.G. A New Beginning
description: STG/RPG hybrid developed in RPG Maker XP featuring a strength/weakness battle system and character levelling.

title: Water
description:
Water is a third person puzzle solving adventure type of game with an unique look and gameplay. It's a story about a mermaid, and fish men who aren't fish men. A story that brings you into tears and fears. It's about fish people, harp instruments, swimming, and crazy priests.

It is an artistic Half-Life 2 mod that fuses adventure, puzzle, and stealth game mechanics together in one. You take control of the goddess of the sea, one of the sister goddesses who founded the world.

title: Vain Empires
description: The memoir of a demonic spy in the Cold War between Heaven and Hell.

title: The Magpie Takes the Train
description: A millionaire guards a fabulous ruby in her private train car. Countless thieves have failed to steal it. But they weren't the Magpie!

title: Katana
description: Katana is a clicker game where you click... a katana! Click the katana to earn more katanas — simple, addictive, and ever-growing. Every 3 hours, you'll receive a random katana drop to add to your collection.

title: Cannery Vale
description:
Hell, even a seagull would hit the spot right now, roasted crispy over a flame--

He immediately put all thoughts of food out of his head because at the moment it was just torture_

A work of interactive fiction by Hanon Ondricek.

title: When in Rome 1: Accounting for Taste
description:
Manhattan, May, 1954.

The last few years, you've settled into a routine. You work at the bank, you go home, you occasionally have dinner with your mother. It is all acceptably ordinary.

One day a strange creature crosses your path, and disrupts the schedule entirely.

A work of interactive fiction by Emily Short.

title: Polar Payne
description: Dinky is a polar bear whose family was murdered by Eskimos. He seeks revenge of the ones who murdered his family by attacking their camp and taking them out.

title: Polar Paradise
description:
It's Christmas Eve and Dinky is angry.

After returning home from his last adventure, Dinky discovers that his family have (once again) been kidnapped by the forces of evil. A mysterious trail of toys, tinsel, and wrapping paper leads into the night...

Enraged and with nothing to lose, Dinky heads out to save his family from a grizzly (yet seasonal) demise.

title: Santego Special Unit
description: Santego Special Unit is a mod for Max Payne 2: The Fall Of Max Payne based on Half-Life: Opposing Force.

title: Mission: Impossible - New Dawn
description:
When Major Sean Dickens’ F-15 crashes over Utah, everything looks like an accident. However, as the wreck is recovered, Dickens is gone, and with him the F-15’s deadly cargo: a new generation warhead.

Ethan Hunt’s mission is clear: the warhead has to be recovered before Dickens is able to sell it, and Dickens, along with the possible buyer, a former Russian general, with unknown intentions, have to be eliminated. However, all too soon Hunt realizes that things aren’t as they seem, and suddenly finds himself right in the line of fire. In his quest to gain answers, Hunt hits upon a conspiracy that puts doubts upon the trustworthiness of his own ranks, and change everything he believed in.

He has nothing to rely on.
And nobody left to trust.

But whoever is trying to deceive him – they have obviously forgotten with whom they have to deal…

title: When Day Breaks
description: "When Day Breaks" is a short SOMA mod that aims to turn S. D. Locke's Proposal from the SCP Foundation Wiki into a playable story, featuring the key events, and some additional ones, with my own interpretation on the environments.

title: Onirica
description: Onirica is a short, experimental and state of the art looking horror mod, which brings you to explore the darkest corners of hero’s mind.

title: Aida's Bizarre Halloween
description:
A stand-alone follow up to the adventure classic Aida's Strange Christmas!

Aida is trying to live a normal life after her past adventure in Santaland. But that grows harder as something new draws her away from her home, this time to a land of pumpkins and dark candy.

title: Resident Evil: During the Storm
description: A new Resident Evil 2 (1998) SourceNext mod that takes place during the first days of the Raccoon City outbreak. Playing as Kevin from the Outbreak series, you'll have to resist inside and outside the RPD, managing the few resources at your disposal and making sure that survivors don't die. For this, there will be new gameplay mechanics, and you'll have to choose carefully what you want to do, leaving room for dozens of outcomes. Not only your actions will affect the course of the story, but also the moment in which you do them, as there is an internal timer.

title: Atsumete! Banki-chan
description: A doujin game by Kyuushoku Touban based on the Touhou Project series.

title: XenoMoon
description: Four astronauts are on a mission to the moon, it's a simple soil collection mission. But things start to get weird when Steffen discovers they're not alone...

title: Card Cowboy
description: On a quest for revenge in the wild west, how you play the cards you're dealt determines your fate.

title: Shadowrun Returns: Deluxe Edition
description: It includes: Shadowrun Returns Game, The Shadowrun Returns Soundtrack, The Shadowrun Returns Anthology - Explore the world of Shadowrun Returns even more with an illustrated PDF of short stories written for the game.

title: Shadowrun: Hong Kong - Extended Edition Deluxe
description: It includes the full 22-track, 320kbps Shadowrun: Hong Kong Soundtrack from fan-favorite composer Jon Everist, and a 125-page Art of Shadowrun: Hong Kong PDF showcasing a wide variety of the concept and production art that went into the game.

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Future Soldier - Ultimate Edition
description: In Ghost Recon Future Soldier join an elite team of highly trained, cut-throat special-ops soldiers. Armed to the teeth with unrivalled combat technology, Ghost Recon takes you to the globe’s most deadly warzones to hunt down the highest value targets.

title: Asterigos: Curse of the Stars - Ultimate Edition
Asterigos: Curse of the Stars - Deluxe Edition
description: Asterigos Deluxe Edition includes the base game and Call of the Paragons DLC.

title: Aquarist Simulator VR
description: Get the best aquarium store in town! Create, renew, manage, observe. See if you can create an aquarium empire.

title: Dreamer's Road
description: Help make the world a better place while carrying the weight of your studies and 3 jobs on your shoulders! Experience the reality of thousands of young immigrants in the United States, seeking to improve themselves and help the growth of this great nation.

title: Quoin
description: Quoin is a top-down game where you shoot enemies collect coins and upgrade your stats. With a wide choice of weapons to use each serving a different role, Quoin will keep you captivated with different enemy types, weapons, and play styles.

title: Open Air
description: Summer! Sea! Festival! You've been waiting for this for so long, and here you are! But what is it, why are the stages empty, and everybody around you is sad? Explore the island, learn the stories of the islanders, unlock new strengths during meditations and arrange the loudest and coolest festival!

title: Pactus
description: A magician and a wendigo, wake up together inside a dark crypt. After centuries sleeping, you find yourself captive in the bowels of a massive cathedral. Only by working together will you find your way out...

title: Freestyle Mage
description: Freestyle Mage is a top-down action RPG game with lite rouge feature. The player will experience learning new magic during the battle, and build his own preferred battle style. Make the best use of synergy effect among spells to defeat different Crack Lords.

title: FootPool
description: FootPool is an original pool game that mixes with the rules of soccer

title: Boomshine Plus
description: A simple and easygoing, but addictive puzzle game

title: Roghill Incident
description: Roghill Incident is an Indie storytelling/exploration/kind-of-horror game that focuses on the story, while creating the uncomfortable feeling that something bad will happen soon.Find all the locations, notes and hints to get different endings.

title: EEvol
description: Simulate cellular life, create an aquarium, fill it with tens of thousands of cells, modify their DNA and watch them evolve! See how they fight for survival, give them food or put them in harm's way. Monitor the population of each species and their descendants.

title: Tapering Tower
description: Tapering Tower is a casual arcade game for accuracy. Build the tallest tapering tower.

title: Kvlt
description: Fight your way through armies of Nazi occultists, religious zealots, and unspeakable cosmic horrors to unveil the Eldritch secrets behind the war theatre in this 2000s-era-inspired grimdark singleplayer FPS where WW2 meets Cthulhu Mythos.

title: Lofi Checkers
description: Lofi Checkers is a cozy take on a classic game. Play with the AI or a friend for a light, refreshing game of checkers. Nothing beats the simplicity of a straightforward game when you have a few moments.

title: Gravity Box
description: Gravity Box is a retro-styled score attack game that requires the player to frantically swap gravity in order to avoid hazards. Grab the gems, unlock cool costumes, and see how long you can last!

title: Viking: Sagas of the Norse Lands
description: VIKING - Sagas of the Norse Lands is a city-builder where you forge your legend. Become a Jarl, transform a camp into a thriving city, manage your people's expansion, and build your legacy. Explore, fight, and erect monuments to etch your saga in history!

title: Investigation Stories: Windsound
description: As the investigation deepens, the secret of the town gradually emerges, the truth behind this is --?

title: Timewell: Trail of Celestes
description: Timewell: Trail of Celestes is an old-school story-driven 3D space shooter RPG. As A.I. SAT-V, explore exotic planets and fight with Constructs in an ever-deepening plot. Change her skills and adaptations on the fly. May you guide SAT-V to her destiny?

title: Exodus Checkmate
description:
You're trapped in school and monsters appeared... The only way out? Playing real-life and mortal chess! Explore complex Gameboards in this First Person Dungeon Crawler and raise the affection with your teammates to get closer to them!

You are the king. You are the school's only salvation!

title: CyberFuck 2069
description: CyberFuck 2069 is casual shooter game. You need to win the battle and pass levels to open unique and hot scenes with our girls. Cyberpunk atmosphere and locations will deep you to this very special vibe. So, girls are waiting for you, hurry up!

title: Assassin's Creed Mirage: Deluxe Edition
description:
In Assassin's Creed Mirage, you are Basim, a cunning street thief with nightmarish visions seeking answers and justice. Join an ancient organization and come to understand a new creed – one that will change Basim’s fate in ways he never could have imagined.

The Deluxe Edition includes a Prince of Persia–inspired Deluxe Pack with outfit, eagle and mount skins, weapons, a digital art book, and selected game soundtrack.

title: Epiphyllum in Love
description: Final chapter of the trilogy. In a world where memory can be controlled, everyone is selling their souls. "I" have left everything behind, except the girl named Yin who still remains in my mind. At the end of my life, should I die with a beautiful fantasy, or go in search of sad memories of her?

title: NBA 2K23: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: Rise to the occasion and realize your full potential in NBA 2K23. Prove yourself against the best players in the world and showcase your talent in MyCareer or The W. Pair today's All-Stars with timeless legends in MyTeam Build a dynasty of your own as a GM, or lead the league in a new direction as the Commissioner in MyNBA. Take on NBA or WNBA teams in Play Now and experience true-to-life gameplay. How will you Answer The Call?

title: Castle Walker
description: Castle Walker is a retro-style classical action platformer, where you play as a young mage who must fight with hordes of monsters and defeat the ancient evil. Fight bosses, gain new abilities and defeat ancient evil.

title: The End is Nahual: If I May Say So
description: A surreal puzzle game, where everything that we put into the game is possible. Push yourself through puzzles, fights, dialogue boxes, and an inventory. Use your will, wits, and English reading ability, You can do it!

title: Doukutsu Randamu
description: Experience art style and gameplay of classical indie game Cave Story in brand new procgen environment: each adventure is different and you only have one life for each!

title: Generic Kart Racing
description: Generic Kart Racing is a celebration of the retro, 16-bit kart racers of old - a modern twist on the ol' tried and true kart racing formula!

title: Tom Clancy's The Division 2: Warlords of New York - Season Ten: Price of Power
description: The target is General Peter Anderson, a power hungry True Sons leader looking to secure his position in the True Sons as Antwon Ridgeway's successor. This puts him in a position to build an alliance strong enough to take down The Division. General Anderson is looking to mend the relationship between the Black Tusk and the True Sons by brokering a peace in order to martial their combined forces against The Division. Well, we can't have that, now, can we? It is up to us to locate and eliminate the threat that Anderson poses. As you and your fellow Agents take out targets on the trail of General Anderson, you'll earn rewards through the new Season Pass and get the chance to score new cosmetic items during apparel events.

title: I.A.G. Alpha
description:
You may think this game is about a post-Soviet Research Institute. About an experiment that went out of control. You may think that the initials "I.A.G." are somehow related to the Institute. You may think this game is unfinished. You may even think that the game ends exactly as the author tells you.

But then you will figure it out—these statements are not entirely true.

title: 1958: Dancing with Fear
description: "Dancing with Fear" (1958, directed by Víctor Ojuel). In this forgotten classic of Golden Age Hollywood, a vedette fallen on hard times (Salomé Vélez) finds herself enmeshed in a tangle of political intrigue, romance and betrayal in a Caribbean republic. Torn between her love for a smuggler, the lust of a corrupt policeman and the machinations of a Soviet intelligence operative, the protagonist navigates the dangers of a high-society party on the eve of revolution. As she tries to survive through that fateful night, the memories of her past will come to haunt her. Controversial at the time for its depiction of Cold War politics and morally ambiguous protagonist. (120 minutes, Technicolor, in-game hint system).

title: The Great Forever Tomorrow
description: The Great Forever Tomorrow is a surrealist adventure through an AI's mind.

title: Captain Verdeterre's Plunder
description:
You should carry the bag. I'm more of a delegator.

A work of interactive fiction by Ryan Veeder.

title: Muggle Studies
description:
You play as Alice Armstrong, the new Professor of Muggle Studies at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in Scotland, even though you've never heard of "muggles" before and never knew magic was real until the headmaster proved it to you. But when you arrive at the school, you discover that a botched spell has made everyone disappear and you're now trapped within the castle. Is this something you can fix without magic?

A work of interactive fan fiction by Flourish Klink.

title: Living Legends: The Blue Chamber - Collector's Edition
description: When Alex visits his sister at Bird’s Nest Castle, he quickly discovers its curse – all the artwork has come to life!

title: Holiday Jigsaw Christmas 3
description: 500 high-quality photos! 500 ideas for a happy family holiday in Holiday Jigsaw Christmas 3!

title: Thelos
description: Your main ability is to place two crystals on a viable surface and pull towards them. You can use dashing, jumping, running, and perform a special jump which is available after collecting rewards. Your opposition will be two types of sentries, dragons, mines, and traps who all want to keep you down.

title: Tower Survivors
description: Fight an endless horde of evil minions and survive as long as you can. Collect loot and purchase new upgrades and magic abilities. Summon allies to stand along side you and survive the horde!

title: 2MD: VR Football Unleashed All Star
description: 2MD: VR Football Unleashed All Star is the massive sequel to the groundbreaking motion-controlled VR football game, 2MD: VR Football. Draw the plays and throw, hand-off, catch, and run the ball before the clock runs out!

title: Amity Park
description: Amity Park is a Dating Sim/Visual Novel game based on the notable Nickelodeon television show, Danny Phantom. The game is a bit of a retelling of the show, most notably with the introduction of explicit adult themes and suggestive content. You play as Danny Fenton, a boy who has accidentally been gifted amazing ghost powers due to his father's incredible ghost dimensional gateway. He must now use his powers to defend his town from other rampant ghosts, save the girl next door, and still turn in his homework on time. With plenty of ghosts to meet, with just as many cute girls to explore, Amity Park invites you to Go Ghost. Amity Park is made in Ren'Py, and uses 2D character portraits and 3D background models, all made by hand.​

title: Completion LawnCare
description: A short game where you take strange lawn-mowing requests and eventually get yourself into some big trouble.

title: The Joy of Creation: Ignited Collection
description: The Joy of Creation: Ignited Collection was a bundle that was planned to remake the first three titles in The Joy of Creation series and was being developed by Nicodemo "Nixon" Sitá under The Fazbear Fanverse Initiative. The titles being remade were The Joy of Creation: Classic, originally named "The Joy of Creation," The Joy of Creation: Reborn, and The Joy of Creation: Story Mode. On March 25, 2024, Nikson would cancel the bundle and replace it with THE JOY OF CREATION, a standalone reboot of The Joy of Creation series with new assets and a new storyline.

title: Zutto Atai no Turn!
description:
This is a modified version of an English vocabulary memorization game that the author created in high school.
This game is a secondary production of Touhou Project.

title: Fright Cops
description: Fright Cops is an indie arcade game about cops and food, described by its author as "a portrayal of the police as what they are: a horde of murderous undead."

title: Nitori Dungeon
description:
How far can you conquer? This is a 2D action game.
This game is a derivative work of Touhou Project.

title: Furikake Spacey
description: Furikake Spicy is a Neo Showa Visual Novel!

title: All Hands on Deck
description: All Hands on Deck is a co-op puzzle platformer game. Use Rock, Paper, Scissors and various items together to solve puzzles, traverse through playful worlds and save plushies. Everyone can share the same experience! Just swap items and you're good to go. How handy is that!

title: Ancient Cultures: Tikal's Realm
description: Ancient Cultures: Tikal's Realm, is an action-adventure game that takes you to the height of one of the greatest Mayan civilizations. Become a legendary warrior of Tikal, train with the army of the time, explore mystical places of this mythology and finally, acquire the powers of the ancient gods.

title: Another Space Opera: Episode 1 - The Wake of The Giant
description: In 2297, Earth is united under a gestalt technocratic order - reborn from the ashes of nuclear fire. Now, humanity finds itself caught in the crossfire of a bloody, supernatural conflict for the fate of the galaxy. Hack and blast your way through this explosive, cinematic action platformer.

title: Artificial Extinction 2
description: A Tower Defense hybrid where survival depends on strategy and firepower. Build turrets, mine resources, and hold the line against relentless AI swarms. Switch instantly between commanding the battlefield in RTS view or fighting on the ground in FPS combat.

title: Archenemy: Lunafall
description: An era of "peace" just liberated from the powerful ruling of The Church, A doomsday prophecy of "the fall of the moon", A struggle and intrigue around the "last Saint". "Archenemy: Lunafall" is a romantic and suspenseful visual novel, which will tell a story about "self" and...

title: Zim's Word Game
description: In this fast-paced word game, you build words from falling tiles before your game board fills up. Compete with your friends on the global leaderboards for high scores and longest time played. Always keep an eye out for the Word Of The Day.

title: Your Waifu Juice
description: Fight with the dungeon dwellers and enjoy sex scenes with lovely girls! You have to consistently conquer 5 dungeons of varying difficulty. Defeat opponents, fight terrible bosses, get more and more sophisticated weapons.

title: Xuhivan's Autonomous Cube
description: Xuhivan's Autonomous Cube is a roguelite turn based brain twister on a fully functioning magic cube, where allies and enemies move deterministically without your command, requiring you to wisely choose fighters with bizzare fates and relics of extraordinary power.

title: World War 3: Card Battler
description: Play as your favorite country, in a card battle for world domination.

title: Wonderland Quest
description: Wonderland Quest is a casual point & click adventure game. Travel across Wonderland teeming with colorful challenges, surprises and creatures, brought to life with beautiful artwork.

title: War In Heaven
description: Chaotic boss-rush, bullet-hell-y, twin-stick arena shooter mayhem! Dynamically changing arena forces you to be vigilant: Watch the bullets, watch the walls!

title: VR Tribes
description: VR Tribes is an action-packed and strategic online multiplayer battle. One in VR and up to three as PC players. As VR player you have to conquer the island and protect your magical crystals. The PC players have to join together to attack and defeat the VR player.

title: Ultimate Panzer
description: Drive your tank through abandoned and decrepit cities and battle the evil alien machines in this fast-paced and explosive action rogue-like

title: Unsolved Case
description:
Unsolved Case is the free prequel to the popular cooperative point-and-click puzzle game 'Cryptic Killer' series.
Dip your toes in and go back to where it all began as you team up in two as detective duo Old Dog and Ally, up against the Cryptic Killer. For the first time in the series, you'll encounter a labyrinth of puzzles and challenges laid by one of the most devious minds in the world. Solve puzzles, crack codes, and find a way out.
Have you got what it takes to crack the Unsolved Case of the Cryptic Killer?
Unsolved Case is a free game for two players to complete in 30-60 minutes. In this puzzle game, you'll get a taste of the mystery to come over the 5-part Cryptic Killer series.

title: Vade Retro: Exorcist
description: Vade Retro is a 4 player PvP exorcism game. Play as Demon and make your opponents go through hell, or join the exorcist team by choosing a specialty to save victims from the devil's grip in this action-packed experience.

title: Vampire Clans
description: Create the most powerful Vampire Clan, to take over Paris streets and underground. Challenge other clans, beat them and enslave. Use spells, alchemy and human blood to grow up your power. Become the terror of all inhabitants or use quiet politics to achieve your goals.

title: Vivat Slovakia
description: Vivat Slovakia is a third-person shooter set in the 90s´ Bratislava, the capital of Slovakia, where the streets are full of thugs and local mafia supported by the corrupted government. The game contains five weapons to use, 30 classic cars of that time to drive and one open city to explore.

title: Vladimere's Lhore
description: A collection of games by Vladimere Lhore.

title: V Lights
description: V Lights is a 2D multiplayer horror game with eye-catching graphics. Set strategic traps on your opponent with items, light controls, and dash time.

title: Titan Shell
description: Titan Shell is a roguelike twin-stick platformer set in a dystopian world. Travel by shell, or by foot, across a massive mountain full of hazardous terrain, bloodthirsty mercenaries, and a ridiculously well-funded police force.

title: Tinting Time
description: Tinting Time is a Japanese-style crafting game. Play as a creator who can create all kinds of solutions, and spend some leisure time in the city of Folest. The game's creation system that combines crafting and complex resource management gameplay is eye-catching.

title: Tide of Thieves
description: Tide of Thieves is a colorful light-hearted top-down action adventure. You take the helm of a pirate ship crewed by a salty old sea captain, a cannoneer who always expect the worse and a witty cartographer, all trying to claim back their treasure.

title: Tiles and Towers TD
description: A 3D tower defense where not only the towers matters but also the ground that alters the towers. Spiced up with randomized wave modifications, skilltree, unique towers and spells. Voila! You get Tiles and Towers TD!

title: The Unluckiest Man
description: After his wife draws her last breath, Dragomir is devastated. As a poor man with a drinking habit, he must not only manage to hold a decent funeral, but also stand for himself in a small town that doesn't see him with good eyes.

title: The Pepper Prince: Episode 5 - A Royal Descent
description:
He's found. But his heart is broken into a thousand pieces. It is up to you to bring him back from the brink and return together to restore the kingdom!

This DLC unlocks Episode 5 of The Pepper Prince: Seasoning 1, a quirky point-and-click adventure about love, grief, and the power of friendship. Solve puzzles, meet quirky fairy-tale-inspired characters, and help your friend regain confidence and self-love after heartbreak!

title: Suspicious
description: An online party game of teamwork and deception for up to 8 players, with full VR support for increased immersion. Experience incredible stories unfold as you and your friends discover who is the killer!

title: Elengard: Ascension
description: Embark on an epic adventure to rise to power in this new Real-Time-With-Pause medieval fantasy RPG that combines action and strategy mechanics. Fight a lot, explore, choose how you fight, configure your abilities, create powerful builds and combos. Awaken your true power!

title: The Blue Cat
description: The Blue Cate is a game about a little girl who finds a cat and learns about love and compassion.

title: The Excrawlers
description: Action-RPG roguelike game in which you and others hero will have to plunge into the dark atmosphere of dungeons full of monsters and madness.

title: The Hunt of the Blood Moon
description: The Hunt of the Blood Moon offers a first person murder mystery experience. Interacting with friends and other people from all over the world to find out who is the mythological creature that’s trying to kill everyone else. Win by killing the creature, before it kills you.

title: Super Adventure Hand
description: It’s the world’s most adventurous hand! You play as a hand on a gripping handventure, a quest, a calling, through a strange and dangerous world. And in the end figure out why your beloved arm has left you.

title: Stories from the Outbreak
description: Stories from the Outbreak is a turn-based zombie RPG. Lead a group of survivors from the doomed city of Riga towards the ferry sailing across the North Sea. Scavenge for supplies, fight the zombies, decide the fate of your crew. What are you willing to sacrifice to survive the zombie plague?

title: SIC-1
description: SIC-1 is a single-instruction programming game. Neglect your personal life in pursuit of promotions and vague assurances of job security! Optimize your programs to rise to the top of the leaderboards! SIC Systems thanks you for your hard work! Now please return to your desk.

title: Slurpies Free
description: Snake, slither, SLURRPP! In this free multiplayer arcade game, control luminescent snakes that grow in length and size. Collect as much food as possible and survive each round without colliding with yourself and other players in fast-pacing battles.

title: Solanaceae: After All
description: Join Battam, a witch exiled by all conventional covens, on his quest to make a brand new type of coven! Explore a colorful world, gather ingredients for potion brewing and cooking, immerse yourself in a long and detailed story, and view sexy scenes!

title: Somewhen
description: Fight, fish, build, cook, and invent your way through 8 chapters guaranteed with hours of play through a unique dungeon stage system, turn-based combat, and challenges. Collect hundreds of items. Built a town? Migrate special NPCs to them! Invent new weapons and trinkets! Restore the world!

title: Sakura Alien 2
description: Haru’s life was turned upside-down when the alien princess, Ena, declared herself his future wife – but now things are getting really crazy, with the appearance of a beautiful new professor at Haru’s university, who seems a little too interested in Ena. What will happen next?

title: Scrap Seas
description: Scrap Seas is a Vehicle 3rd-Person Shooter Action Rogue-Like. Build your ship and fill it to the brim with every kind of weaponry you can find. Then take it out into the ocean to take part in fast-paced generated sea battles against your Robot Overlords.

title: Seranu
description: Find lost treasure, fame and fortune in the ruins of the Lost City! SERANU brings spelunking to the PC in a single-player adventure full of puzzles and mysteries.

title: Serious Sally
description: Serious Sally is the daughter of a very serious man. She wants to be just like her father. Her adventure is for you to follow in this old-school first-person shooter created with respect for the good old classic games of the genre. Just pure fun and violence for those who love it.

title: Seven Wonders
description: Seven Wonders is an ancient city-building game. It brings you back to ancient times, where you have to build the seven wonders of the ancient world. You have to manage resources and labor to build the wonders.

title: Raven Estate
description: Become the bullet-hell as you play a crow on a mission to expel the monsters from his newly acquired estate in this high-octane shoot-em-up!

title: Princess hunter
description: Lead a party of monstergirl princesses on an exciting journey across a variety of worlds. Explore hand-drawn locations, fight numerous enemies in turn-based card battles and find keys to the hearts of your companions!

title: Lights Out: TPP Shooter
