description: Planked! Survive & Thrive is a multiplayer adventure, crafting, and building game. Work together or alone to gather resources, craft items, and fight your way around the island, but beware, not all pirates are friends!

title: Prepare Uranus: Exploring Black Holes for Adults
description: Prepare Uranus is NSFW Visual Novel, where you're taking control of a bar on the planet Uranus, in which beautiful girls work. You have to improve the economy of your bar, pay off debts to space pirates, unravel the mystery of Black Holes and make Uranus the most popular place in the galaxy!

title: Miraculous: Rise of the Sphinx
description: Paris needs a hero! Once again, the city of lights is in trouble as it faces a new menace—the most threatening sentimonster ever created is about to take control! As you take on the personna’s of the globally renowned superheroez Ladybug and Cat Noir, you’ll need to unveil the diabolical plan hatched by archvillain Hawk Moth—and squash it! Immerse yourself into the magical world of Miraculous and level up your superpowers as you embark on your biggest journey yet!

title: GeneWars
description: This is the story of the birth of life. You will take on the role of the 23,008689th sperm cell to be born, fighting and advancing to fulfil your birthright, to create a great legend.

title: In Dreams of Addict Remastered
description: "In Dreams of Addict Remastered" - A re-release of the original 2018 game with a new story and improved graphics. You will play as a guy named Jora, who has fallen into a coma due to excessive alcohol consumption. You enter Jora's consciousness, consisting of his memories and deepest fears. Help Jora fight his nightmares, which are holding him back, and get out of his coma.

title: In Dreams of Addict 2
description: "In Dreams of Addict 2" is the sequel to the re-release of the original game. Now his girlfriend Lisa will fight for Jora, who out of despair has decided to experiment in order to get into jora's mind. Help the girl to cope with hostile subconscious creatures, find jora and leave his world.

title: Ookami-kun
description: Jump action game by Wanpaku Pixels.

title: Fall Guys: Season 2 - Satellite Scramble
description: Fall Guys is launching a brand new season... IN SPACE! Fall Guys: Season 2 - Satellite Scramble sees the residents of the Blunderdome leaving the relative safety of their planet for the first time. By heading to the stars, you’ll explore the wonders and challenges of the vacuum!

title: Loggerhead
description: Loggerhead is a classic style survival horror game set in Australia, during the 1980's. Featuring fixed camera angles, challenging puzzles and limited resources, Loggerhead will take you on a journey into the dark heart of Australia. Can you survive the horrors of Boggarogga Creek?

title: Path of the Abyss
description: Dive deep into the ABYSS.

title: Room of Depression
description: "Same encounter, different world." Moon is a young woman who lives an ordinary city life as an office worker. However, because she suffers from depression, she reacts and deals with things in a way that is very different from regular city folk.

title: Last Day of Summer
description: It's the last day of summer, and you're old enough now to go into town by yourself.

title: Playing Games
description: Playing Games is a short fantasy game about an trial of initiation in a semi-secret club.

title: The Life and Deaths of Doctor M
description: Your vision clears as you gently land in an endless landscape. There is the wind, a bleak and chill thing. And there is your sense of uncertainty: You don't know which way to go. Or, maybe, which way you went.

title: Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration - Steelbook Edition
description:
Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration - Steelbook Edition includes:

Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration gamecard for Nintendo Switch
A specially designed cardboard protective sleeve
An exclusive golden and black Commemorative Steelbook
An exclusive 50th Anniversary Poster

title: The Mono-Yellow Madness
description: The Mono-Yellow Madness is a survival horror game taking place in the backrooms. Will you survive in this multi-level trap? Will you put an end to this? Only you can uncover the mysteries.

title: Myth Caller: The Nightmare Shaman
description: Myth Caller: The Nightmare Shaman is a 3D collectathon platformer fused with a monster-catching RPG! Catch monsters, collect permanent upgrades, and unlock even more of this huge 90's-inspired world.

title: Roots of Yggdrasil
description: Ragnarok is over. The gods have fallen and the World Tree lays shattered. Against all odds, only a Viking tribe remains, caught in an endless loop at the end of time. Can they break the cycle and rebuild their broken home?

title: Battlestation
description: Better with friends, up to 3 players. You and your friends must work as a team to craft, load and shot at enemies before they shot back.

title: Moses: From Egypt to the Promised Land
description: Moses: from Egypt to the promised land is a first person adventure game inspired by one of the most amazing stories in human history from the Old Testament. In the game, we play the role of Moses, the holy prophet, the leader of the Israelites, during their journey to the Promised Land.

title: Clarice: The Storyteller
description: Clarice, a young storyteller, teaches her secret to a disillusioned Dungeon Master and helps him create unforgettable adventures!

title: Dreamed Away
description: A walking simulator in which you control a mentally ill hero. You must escape the "something'' you encounter and return to the original world as you know it. Explore the map while running away from "something" and find a way to escape.

title: Ocnus Theory
description: Ocnus Theory is a challenging sandbox platformer that will test your creativity, reflexes, and ability to rise from a painful fall. Explore the mysteries of this open environment, shape your Ocnus to match the current challenge, and ascend to the peak! Just don't look down.

title: Pets Hotel
description: Welcome to Pets Hotel, a place where you can start the business you always dreamed of! Pets Hotel gives you a unique opportunity to build, design, and run a place where pets can feel at home. Cats, dogs, turtles, and many other animals are waiting for you to take proper care of them!

title: Coffee Bar Renovator
description: Create and expand a global café franchise! Start locally and expand your business around the world! Buy old, abandoned premises, renovate them, plan the decor and open the place of your dreams. It's easy to make money at Coffee Bar Renovator!

title: Long Gone
description: Decades after the outbreak, you play as a survivor stranded in an old-world suburban neighborhood. Explore the lives of people Long Gone through their forgotten belongings and uncover secrets as you search for supplies in this 2.5D pixel puzzle platformer inspired by adventure games of old.

title: Operation: Forge the Deep
description: Solve real materials science problems, contribute to science, and survive a new ice age in a puzzle adventure that combines engineering problems with a unique puzzle that will challenge how you look at the world around you.

title: Dead of Winter
description: Build, gather and defend against relentless hordes of undead as you lead your villagers to safety and battle for survival in a world plunged into a seemingly endless winter

title: GhostCry Hill
description: The story follows Liang Suxian, a female university student, who inadvertently becomes entangled in an urban legend. An ancient book transports her back to the campus of the 1950s. Suxian's fate seems inextricably linked to the death of a mysterious girl from the same school.

title: Goo Keeper
description: Lead Rolly in his adventure within the wonderful world of Shroomast, and explore its deep semi open-world underground. Goo Keeper is a pure metroidvania with tons of unique bosses, hand-crafted worlds and creatures, and tons of awesome abilities.

title: Farm Renovator
description: Buy a ruined farm and give it its full glory back. Clean, repair, restore, improve. Repair machines, manage the work on your farm, take care of your animals, and choose your development strategy. We're sure you'll have many satisfied customers.

title: Dreamables
description: First-person survival horror You may encounter unrealistic monsters and be intrigued with luck.There is a small chance that you will die from anything that damages you. Be careful out there.

title: Bodacious Agents
description: Enter "B.O.D.A.C.I.O.U.S.", the highly classified secret agent organization. In this 3-D Platformer, your co-agents have been abducted by forces unknown on missions top secret! Take the dubiously tax-funded gadgets granted to you by B.O.D.A.C.I.O.U.S. and use them to save the world and your friends!

title: Locksmith Simulator
description: Become a local hero! Fix doors, open locks and help damsels in distress.

title: Books in Wrong Places
description: Books have always been important to you. They were your guides, your friends. Your escape from everyday problems. But while you were gone some of them have gone missing. Find the misplaced books. Take care of the ones that have been mistreated. Put them back where they belong.

title: Kriegsfront Tactics
description: Kriegsfront Tactics is a procedural turn-based mecha tactics RPG set in alternate 1970s during an era of conflict in Southeast Asia where you'll play as a commander of a mecha squad sent behind enemy lines. Build your mecha squad, complete missions, and survive the front another day.

title: Halloween Store Simulator
description: Begin your Halloween empire building and managing your first Halloween Store! Manage your staff and products to attract new customers! Grow your Halloween empire by building Halloween restaurants, cafes, and entertainment! Expand and make every day and everything Halloween!

title: Monkey Valley
description: Explore the deep jungle in search of your grandpa, engage with the locals, discover dark secrets about the valley and choose its and subsequently your own fate...

title: Golden Light of Rose
description: Eat weapons, be scared and question your own mind in this Survival-Horror FPS Prop Hunt Roguelike about meat. Golden Light of Rose is a story prequel to Golden Light which follows Rose during her first time in the gut.

title: Lost Sector
description: Explore the sci-fi world of Lost Sector and master the souls-like combat. Defy overwhelming odds to overcome evolving creatures and gradually changing environments in this unforgiving third-person action-roguelike.

title: Barista Simulator
description: Barista Simulator lets you experience making a wide variety of coffees just like espresso, latte, cappuccino or even your special mix of coffees. While managing your coffee shop, you play as a Barista and make the coffees your customers want. It's up to you to choose how to treat your shoppers.

title: Burrito Bear
description: Burritos are raining from the sky - Bear wants to eat them, but colliding with dangerous falling garbage causes serious gas! Before indigestion strikes, Bear needs your help to eat them all!

title: False Skies
description: False Skies is a traditional turn-based RPG with an involved class system and a retro look. Explore a not-quite-modern world with a party of your own creation, and learn the truth behind the disappearance of a city that vanished 2000 years ago.

title: Mammon: Devil Help
description: Mammon: Devil Help is a turn-based, resource management, indirect battle between you and the will of any unfortunate victims. Drive them to desperation and buy their souls while being a human in the shoes of the Devil.

title: Bakudan Hero
description: Bakudan Hero is a game where you push blocks to clear the way for the Cat-bus to pass. Can you find the best route using the fewest bombs?

title: Funny Bunny Gun
description: The game is a cartoon-style Metroidvania. Explore winding mazes, ancient temples, and fiery caves. Fight in fast-paced battles against aggressive oversized vegetables and mutant beetles. Gear up with customizable guns to stop the inhumane experiments of a mad scientist!

title: Deitrus
description: In Deitrus, heroes are forced to fight for the sake of their techno fantasy world through fast-paced, grid-based, combat, but not everyone is up to the task…

title: Empires Shall Fall
description: Empires Shall Fall is a turn based tactics set in a dieselpunk world. Exploit terrain for combat advantage, combine troops, upgrade your army, eradicate your enemies with sheer power and sharp tactics.

title: Paranormal Hunter
description: Paranormal Hunter is a first-person co-op online multiplayer horror game with VR support. Explore ominous haunted locations, turn your fear into courage, and face sinister supernatural challenges.

title: Bogey Brian
description: Play as Brian, a slime who dreams of playing golf - with himself as the ball! Squish, jump, roll, and spin your way to glory by getting Brian to the flag on each hole. Improve your score through the use of strategic powerups and collect hats along the way that can totally change the game experience.

title: Darkest Abyss
description: Darkest Abyss is a platform/action game inspired by the Classic-Vania genre.

title: Fantasy Network
description: Join Lyn in a colorful, cartoonish world of Holua where "Likes" are the ultimate power! Explore a non-linear world, master umbrella-based combat, and smash your way through talent-show boss battles. It’s a metroidvania with a social media soul- no subscription needed.

title: Candy Kombat
description: Immerse yourself in a world of sweets, which is full of delicious candy. Beat the odds as a sweet frog to find Pinkie and Gingerbread man, to whom you need to explain some things.

title: MonsterCare
description: MonsterCare is a management-simulation game, where you play as the manager of a shelter for homeless monsters. Try to avoid it spiraling out of control, and get rich in the process!

title: Devil's Island
description: Devil's Island is an FPS with elements of survival, maintained in a horror atmosphere with post-apocalyptic themes in a world that has already ended. This is a game whose history combines what has long been forgotten with what may yet come.

title: Bunker Renovator
description: Find and buy abandoned bunkers and underground shelters to turn them into an estate of your dreams - a shop, a modern flat, a warehouse or maybe even an underground club!

title: SubwaySim Hamburg
description: Explore the picturesque U3 line of Hamburg's elevated railroad in SubwaySim Hamburg!

title: Insomnia: Theater in the Head
description: As the name suggests, it is a game depicting the feeling of insomnia, whose plot is revealed through the exquisite hand-drawn paintings of KeKe, the chief artist of "A Perfect Day".

title: Prison King
description: Sentenced for innocence… And now you need to learn how to survive. Navigate the prison life, make deals with guards and gangs alike, manage and sell contraband, and plot your next move. Your goal: to get out.

title: Discolored 2
description: All the colors have gone missing from the world. While on a mission to bring them back you discover you are being hunted by those who would see the colors banished. Your only hope is a woman in red who may be holding the key to preventing the world from becoming discolored.

title: The Legend of Gandar II
description: The Legend of Gandar II takes place four years after the events of The Legend of Gandar. The Legend of Gandar II is again based on an 2D action-adventure video game.

title: Atomic Wilds
description: Explore a post apocalyptic world in an attempt to restore balance to nature. Discover 7 hidden weapon factories and the treasures hidden within. Find upgrades to personalize your shooting and exploration experience. Get help from the ghosts of humanities past to solve the riddle of its future.

title: Norigin
description: Norigin is a third person story driven adventure exploration game centred around a son reconnecting with his father through lost memories. Take control of our lost travelling protagonist during his journey of self discovery as you become intertwined in this gripping and emotional origin story.

title: Follow My Steps
description: Lead and protect a mother wolf and her pup seeking a new shelter. Use your magic to explore a dreamlike open world through numerous environments. Make the right choices to take care and educate your cub. Survive together and try to escape from the Midnight Pack…

title: Blue Wednesday
description: Blue Wednesday is a story about jazz and love, and about failure. The boring days pass for failed jazz pianist Morris. One day is the same as the next until Morris meets jazz saxophonist Angela.

title: Arata Haunted Asylum
description: Arata Haunted Asylum is a 2D Top Down Survival horror game based on the story of a haunted asylum located in Japan. You will investigate the asylum for the proof of the paranormal.

title: Shopping Mall Renovator
description: Build the mall of your dreams! Clean, renovate and decorate old shopping malls and halls to get the best ratings from your visitors. Manage, invest and risk to get a fortune!

title: The Doll's Window
description: A horror exploration game that takes place in an underground labyrinth. Avoid malicious creations that are hungry for your soul. Depart from the nightmares that constantly haunt you.

title: Destroiders
description: No nonsense, action packed, 2.5D, Asteroids inspired shooter. Scream around speeding rocks narrowly avoiding an untimely death as you obliterate rocks whilst harvesting their valuable resources. See how far you and your friends can get. Best played with mates but also pretty fun on your own.

title: Dexter Stardust: Returns to Outer Space
description: An SNES-Inspired, platforming, sci-fi adventure. It's like playing a Saturday Morning Cartoon!

title: The Wizardz Dungeon
description: A difficult, fast-paced action-rogue-lite where you hack n'slash your way through a dungeon full of loot and monsters. Your goal is to get strong enough to be able to defeat the Guardian. Death means starting over again.

title: Legend of Utorepia
description: The Last Hero departs for the mysterious world of Utorepia.What you see at the end of that journey ...? Feature-length retro RPG!

title: Intergalactic Transfer Station
description: Build & manage your Intergalactic Transfer Hub. Receive travellers and dock ships. Help passengers transfer, but also control them. Expand hub, build shops, take care of everyone's needs. Increase profits, change taxes. But beware: dangerous diseases and asteroids may alter your plans!

title: Plumpy Uprising
description: Plumpy Uprising is a roguelite tower defense game featuring unique elders, random upgrade choices and a constantly shifting map. The difficulty increases every time you beat the game!

title: Pit Fighter Tycoon
description: Slavery. Violence. PROFIT. You're an alien slaver - abduct humans to build the most powerful gladiator team in the universe! Surgically enhance your slaves, or grind them down for profit. Become the worst kind of corporate overlord in this strategic auto-battler & management game.

title: Autopanic
description: Autopanic is a minimalist twinstick shooter with rogue-like elements. Also a game about acknowledging player action.

title: Slavic Tales
description: A party-based RPG in a hand-drawn environment, representing a fantasy setting based on Slavic mythology and folk tales. Tactical combat with simultaneous planning of character actions, designed specifically to improve upon the slow, turn-based gameplay, especially when playing in multiplayer.

title: Enelia: Dawn of Madness
description:
Immerse yourself in the enigmatic world of Nauris, where enchanting landscapes hide terrifying secrets: the strange behavior of elders, sinister rituals of priests, and the disappearance of citizens.

Madness lurks everywhere – will you master it or become its victim?

The choice is yours.

title: Cat and Watermouse
description: Cat and Watermouse is a combination of modern endless runners and old school 2d platformers. Can you dodge the obstacles, defeat your enemy, and forge a new alliance along the way?

title: Weird Japan
description: Weird Japan is a role-playing game in which the main character returns from the war with the Crusaders.During the war, the world has changed and he will have to take one of the sides.Explore a fantasy alternative medieval Japan.

title: Might of Merchants
description: Might of Merchants combines an economic and trading simulation with role-playing elements in a medieval kingdom. Experience a unique and lovingly hand-drawn world in which you have to prove your skills as a merchant.

title: Tenebris Somnia
description:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.

title: Magic Kingdom War
description: Magic Kingdom War is a cartoon-style turn-based role-playing game. Each character has different skills and attributes. In the game, you can choose different formations to fight, and the formation can increase the character's attributes. Players need to collect more characters to grow their team.

title: Theseus Protocol
description: Theseus Protocol is a SCI-FI DBG strategy game. In this highly intelligent time, you are forced to adapt to the laws of survival and become stronger in battles. Seeking for the truth, you must travel across variety of novel scenes to reveal the full story by collecting fragments of information.

title: Knights of Frontier Valley
description: Knights of Frontier Valley is a highly replayable survival RPG where no two games are the same. Take on the role of an adventurer and guide him through his life in a unique and dynamic world. Gain fame and fortune, while never losing sight of the most important goal: staying alive!

title: Trail of Nanook
description: Trail of Nanook is a co-op game that takes you on an arctic survival adventure. Team up with your Inuit twin and build igloos, raise your huskies to sled over ice plains, fish, hunt and craft your tools to survive the harsh environment.

title: Brewmastery: Tavern Simulator
description: Brewmastery is an innkeper & beer brewery simulator. Build your own brewery and revive the old Tavern. Develop your territory, grow ingredients and try different recipes in a realistic brewing process. Tavern guests can tell you stories & give tasks. And don't forget to pull apart drunk Orcs!

title: City Worlds
description: City Worlds is a city builder where your playstyle directly impacts the environment and people of your cities.

title: Chess: The Lost Pieces
description: A chess game with 30+ pieces and deck building,

title: Burger Butt
description: Burger Butt is a casual, side-scrolling, survival game where you dodge traps like lasers and missiles. How do you dodge? By sharting of course! You do this all while wearing silly hats and collecting coins to unlock even more hats!

title: Bing in Wonderland
description: Bing in Wonderland is the sequel of Wanba Warriors. it's a 2D platformer no-exploration rogue-lite game with special ink art style.

title: Kingsblood
description:
Kingsblood is a tactical party-based RPG that blends autobattler mechanics, a mercenary management and dungeon crawling with a fully voiced story.

Join the fight against the Crown's injustice in this epic tactical RPG! Assemble a powerful guild, lead them through treacherous missions and dungeons, and unlock their true potential with smart combat decisions. Will you prevail?

title: Ikki Unite
description: With up to 16 players, this is roguelike action, but united! "You can't riot with just one or two people!"The legendary "bad game" that once had people scoffing is back, and this time it's time to unite! This is roguelike action…but united!

title: Moshcave
description: Buff Murphy and obliterate hundreds of enemies as you crawl deep into the cave of Mr. Mosh! Moshcave is a retro-style action roguelite game with many different possible builds and strange enemies that gets progressively stronger.

title: A Chamber of Stars
description: The rise and fall of a rock n' roll star. The sequel to 2018's The Endless Empty.

title: Supersonic Fight
description: Supersonic Fight is a modern combat flight game with authentic jet handling and cinematic, story-driven missions. Fly high-stakes battles over San Francisco where timing, precision, and decisive strikes matter, without the complexity of hardcore simulators.

title: Potion Wilds
description: Explore the wilds filled with curious creatures, delve into a mystery and grow fantastic plants as a tiny cat with a huge talent for potions in this 3D action adventure RPG.

title: Cozy Cabin
description: Fish, farm, and mine in a quiet, rainy town.

title: Agent in Depth
description: Agent in Depth is a stylish pixel graphics indie action game featuring fast paced action and instant-death combat. Unfold the truth by running, jumping, and deflecting bullets.

title: Hood Story: Kaito Yamazaki
description: Play as "Kaito Yamazaki" a young Japanese delinquent from the underprivileged Kamagasaki district of Osaka. He will have to juggle love, friendship and violence to get his life back on track.

title: Tiny Bookshop
description: Leave everything behind and open a Tiny Bookshop by the sea in this ambient narrative management game. Stock your wagon, set up shop in scenic locations, and navigate a post-capitalist future alongside Bookstonbury’s eclectic cast of characters.

title: Knighty
description: Join the Royal Tournament! Knighty is a funny multiplayer party game with dozens of different knightly competitions waiting for you. Avoid obstacles, compete with others, make your way to the top and fight for the Knighty title. There can be only one winner!

title: A Peculiar Adventure on Bast
description: Join two colorful heroes from opposite sides of the continent as they stumble into the adventure of their lives. Crazy gadgets, charismatic characters, a hint of the uncanny - you'll find it all in the beautifully hand-drawn steampunk world of Bast!

title: Serum
description: Immerse yourself in a survival experience, where a mysterious liquid takes hold of your life. Courage, time pressure and the sheer will to survive will determine your future.

title: Spring Dash
description: Catapult yourself to incredible speeds in this FPS precision platformer. Use your command over fast-growing vegetation to build up momentum, decimate the bugs in your way, and finish each level as quickly as you can.

title: Crown of Greed
description: Forget about direct orders you know from other games of the genre. Master an unusual, indirect management system in which you must skillfully bend your subjects and heroes to your will. Claim the throne of Rodovia, build cities, recruit troops, expand your kingdom and exploit the power of a coin.

title: Astride
description: Explore Astride, a horse game set in a Scandinavian-inspired environment. Care for and train horses, reveal mysteries and more!

title: Sunrise's Order
description: Having your own farm as your favorite game hero is your biggest dream. You decide to become the proud owner of a desert island and you are ready to embark on this new adventure and sell your farm products to your future customers.

title: Super Jagger Bomb
description: With retro-styled 3D graphics and mechanics that are easy to pick up and play but tough to master, Super Jagger Bomb offers a straightforward and rewarding gameplay experience.

title: Speedy Spears
description: Speedy Spears is a casual 2d duel of the classic knight tournament where knights riding on a horses with spears. Players take on the role of 1 of 2 knights, whose task is to throw the opponent off the horse and not fall yourself.

title: Gobs of Glory
description: A multiplayer PvP and PvE combat RPG true to the 5E SRD ruleset!

title: Undone Mind
description: 2D-Action-Platformer with terrain transformation. Place tiles to reach new heights, block incoming projectiles, or hide yourself from the enemy. All abilities/weapons acquired are equipped at all times. Stand still and hold fire for a laser beam, move and fire for a bubble, move and hold to roll…

title: Escape from the Marble Monster
description: Rotate the world, physics will move the marble. Dodge obstacles, collect stars, lead monsters to a quick death, a journey against the clock full of challenges and fun.

title: Soda-Powered Penguin
description: Control a soda-propelled penguin in this fast-paced precision platformer!

title: Dream Fight Will
description: This is an exciting and interesting action clearance game. You control all the enemies you defeat to fight. The game can be a single player, a duel with two people, a team of five people, a 10v10 battle, a melee with 25 people, and so on!

title: Shenanigans
description:
The Evil Dr. Wector has taken the Great Sunflower’s Sun Energy for his evil plan and now it is up to you to get it all back! Join the four hooligans, Simon, Sebrina, Rae, and Beast, in a wacky and goofy 2D adventure!

From the mind of The Escaped Mental Patient, John Coday, explore a world of goofy characters and zany places created by Mythos Makers and Co. Run, Jump, Wall Run, and Swing Your Hammer as you go through beautiful levels and take down enemies along the way. You can run through all the levels or take your time. Take advantage of the smooth and fast paced 2D platforming giving you ultimate control of the adventure! Explore the world or speed through to save it! The choice is yours!

Play as one of four nut cases. The bat wielding madman, Simon. His violent hamer swinging sister, Sebrina. A kind witch named Rae, and her empty headed magical creature, Beast.

title: Mixed Guns
description: Thirsty for a good old Side Scrolling shoot 'em up? Well i got ya covered, fight your way through levels, covered with countless unique enemies, grab your guns and mix them togheter with sick upgrades, to create even sicker guns!

title: Legendary Hoplite
description: A combination of Action RPG and Tower Defense: slay monsters, find weapons, upgrade your armies, defend your base… Prevent humanity from extinction at the hands of monsters from Greek mythology and ancient tribes. Don't let them cross the gate, commander!

title: Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity
description: Extreme Evolution is an expressive platformer adventure; movement is your power: transform, drive, run, split, tumble, and launch yourself. Discover new forms and evolve as you explore this organic underworld open world.

title: Danghost
description: Danghost is an arcade puzzle game, inspired by fighting games, in which you play an exorcist who needs to hoover up small ghosts. Make combos, use unique spells and beat your opponents! Playable in single-player, it’s with the local multiplayer mode that the game will reveal all its spice!

title: Food Empire
description: Build your very own Food Empire in this economic strategy game. From diners and burger joints to succesful restaurants, with everything in between, you decide how to expand your brand. Buy properties, design the look of your restaurant, hire staff and finally feed all those hungry customers!

title: Super Greedy Cat
description: Help King-Meow to collect gold to increase your cat speed and make the higher score in this precision platformer.

title: Odyssey of Dremid'ir
description: In the desolate realm of Dremid'ir, abandoned by god-like architects, a fragile world teeters on the edge of oblivion. Unearth secrets in ancient ruins, and navigate lost civilizations in this danger-fraught 2d RPG!

title: The King's Dilemma: Chronicles
description: Lead the King’s Council for generations as the consequences of your decisions decide the kingdom’s resources and political standing. Form alliances, solve dilemmas, and prepare for the final uprising that was foretold by an ancient prophecy

title: Shargad: First Blood
description: He drew the first blood. Winter is named after him, carrying its perishing winds to the very essence of his legacy. Enten, son of Adapa, killed his brother, staining the honour of his unborn descendants and leaving them a burden to carry for ages...

title: Blocks of Nature
description: Combine cubes of the same color in a lapland-inspired scene with bright visuals and relaxing music for casual gameplay

title: Kring
description: KRING is an hand-made / random-designed / indie-god-clicker game where you'll need to dominate the most stupid breed of the whole universe: the KRING! Do it through 8 (or 10?) different games, which tell to the universe the story of the loser gods who defeated (maybe) the SuperLegendary Gods!

title: Rooftop Postgirl
description: Jump from one building to another, dodge the birds and face many obstacles in order to accomplish a simple task... delivering letters! Isn't it fun? Play as Carolina, the postgirl and Alice, the... normal person? I guess.

title: Cycle of the Moon
description: Soul-like, foguelike where you fight your way through a map, collecting souls to beat the boss

title: Caveshifter
description: Caveshifter is a dungeon-crawling Roguelike. Build your character and engage in fast-paced melee combat that blends Hack'n'Slash action with Souls-like precision. Fight your way through mysterious, ever-changing labyrinth in a dark fantasy world.

title: Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog
description: A top-down 2D story-driven adventure game inspired by real-life events. Traverse and experience the life of a formerly homeless man through an interview of how he regained his sense of self by telling his past to a stray dog. Set in Bangkok, Thailand 2017.

title: Jake's Halloween Night
description:
"It's October 31, follow Jake as he gets ready for a killer Halloween party."

A short horror game inspired by old slasher movies

title: 0Hz Zero Hertz
description: Press buttons to the beat of the music while aiming and shooting in this simple but difficult skill game. Will you get through it?

title: 10 Dead Doves
description: 10 Dead Doves is a single-player, fixed-perspective narrative horror set in the heart of Appalachia. Avoid strange noises, collect lifelines, and creep through a forest that seems to hate you. Will you discover why the birds drop dead -- or leave behind nothing but footprints?

title: 2 Late 2 Evade
description: 2 Late 2 Evade is a driving game inspired by different road movies. Cover the maximum distance in heavy traffic at the highest possible speed. Use the temporary state of slow motion to avoid crashing. Compete a tour across iconic and treacherous roads. Pick a car, customize it and just hit the road.

Climatic side scroller where history plot intermingles with Slavic legends, Second World War, and paranormal activity. Solve complex puzzles, do some platforming, interact with various characters, discover their unclear motives, and be a part of the dark and forgotten mystery.

title: Abglantz
description: Enter a realm of nightmares and claw and shoot your way through hordes of bloodthirsty vermin and things that are much, much worse in this retro FPS

title: A Broken Halo
description: A Broken Halo is a 2D Puzzle game. You play as Zime, an angel that had her Halo destroyed by an evil mage. Now, she has to recover the broken pieces of her Halo and destroy her nemesis. Is Zime going to survive this challenge?

title: 30 Days Another
description: 30 Days will change someone's life, maybe your life.

title: AC-130 Gunship Operator
description: In AC-130 Gunship Operator game you will seat in chair of armament operator of three most powerful gunships in the world. As first, we are pleased to offer to gamers Russian artillery aircraft AN-12 Aurora and Chinese Y-9 Hawk. Prepare for lead rain from the sky and great emotions.

title: Across the Galaxy: Infinite War
description: This is an endless interstellar war. You are sent to the battlefield by the mysterious organization to test the combat capability of the latest experimental spacecraft, and help collect as much battlefield information about the major factions as possible.

title: Adrianne and Oliver
description: 7 days to achieve your goals. Build your relationship with characters through the choices, leading to different events and then the final outcomes. We’ll have 9 endings, 60 breathtaking sex animations, and more than 750 static images.

title: Urban Myth Dissolution Center
description: Join forces with the psychic Director of the Urban Myth Dissolution Center and solve a variety of cases involving cursed relics, rental properties with shady histories, and dimensional anomalies. Monstrous oddities and otherworldly planes abound in this occult mystery adventure game!

title: Lianhai Billiards Club
description: "Lianhai Billiards Club is a game that combines the elements of role-play and billiards leisure, telling the story of the lonely protagonist who grows up from an unruly delinquent to a shining professional billiards star with the companionship of his friends.

title: Wataju: My Super Fulfilling Real Life
Floating Life 2
description: Floating Life2 is a sandbox fairy quest where you interact with NPCS in real time and experience the ups and downs of fairy quest together. Join xiuxian Zong Gate, experience the rich adventure map and real-time combat, gradually discover the truth of the earth and earth changes, change your fate.

title: CaveFiction
description: "Cave Fiction" is a self-developed "game" that is actually a monstrous creation born from the author's sad, arrogant, and foolish consciousness. Its name is derived from a classic metaphor in Plato's philosophy, making it a manic modern story within a classical narrative framework.

title: The Jianghu
description: 敬请期待！

title: Broken God Awakening
description: "If you don't want this city to be in ruins, let me stay here for one night." Seeing the girl in black who forcibly broke into her house, Mikage Du couldn't understand the meaning of her words at this fashion.

title: Nightmare Without Return
description: This is a journey without return When you wake up... In the strange space, the bronze gate that eats people, the strange rules of the game, and the ever-changing nightmare world appear in front of you Everything starts from here

title: Touhou Língshǒusì: Consciousness' Unity of Opposites
description: Dōngfāng Lingshousi: Consciousness' Unity of Opposites is a Chinese Touhou Project fangame.

title: The last four
description: The waking girl lost her memory? There's a zombie in an empty base? What is the cat guarding? Sleeping girl , is she eager to wake up? What's the wandering boy doing? Can we find out what happened on this base, get our happiness back? A little AVG game. I hope you like it.

title: Little Wu Chang
description: "Little Wuchang" is a soul-like APRG game. You'll play as Wuchang, the netherworld's envoy, and start on adventures in a world based on Chinese mythology. You must defeat enemies of various types on multiple different maps. You gonna love and enjoy every time you died.

title: Dullpain
description: Dullpain is a side-scrolling, interaction, and storytelling game. Playing as Jingwen, a young boss of a long-established repair shop, you need to repair not only everyday items, also memories. You can enjoy dull-pain and breathtaking stories in different time and space and redefine the end of story.

title: Zoo Simulator
description: In Zoo Simulator, your main task is to run and manage your own zoo. Renew it and take care of all the animals' needs, ensuring them a peaceful life! Will you attract crowds of visitors? Create your own zoo!

title: Yeah! Fighting Girl
description: This is a relaxing and casual game. Five cute girls owe a huge debt for breaking the naked statue of the demon king. In order not to be sold to goblins, they are forced to go to an arena and start fighting to earn money to pay off their debts.

title: Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom
description: Make full use of your advanced move-set to navigate hand-crafted retro worlds without a jump button in this vibrant love letter to the N64 era of collectathons!

title: Yesterdreamt
description: Deliberate movement, limited ammo and precious sanity. Yesterdreamt is a twin-stick horrorvania where the odds are stacked against you, Gunslinger. Unlock arcanicks to tip the scales and keep close to your dog, and you might just win this fight. And if you were to fall, well… Blessed be the Dreamweavers.

title: Yukar From the Abyss
description: A fantasy otome game based on the myths and legends of Hokkaido, Japan. Meet and fight with unique Gods, overcome fierce trials together, and discover what happens when you pursue forbidden love with the divine..

title: Zed Zone
description: A great catastrophe has come, and you, who are on duty, crash and trapped in a Zed Zone. There are zombies and monsters everywhere, In order to escape, by collecting materials, upgrading skills, building shelters, defeating zombie waves and mysterious mechs, chasing a glimmer of hope.

title: Zero Orders Tactics
description: Terraforming is your weapon! An experimental puzzle strategy where you are not commanding your troops - now, you are shaping the battlefield itself! Nothing is random*, everything is predictable*, and the battlefield is changing. Every turn. By you.

title: Zombie Hell: Infected City
description: Zombie Hell is an FPS where you take on the role of the head of a family – a father fighting for his family's survival, lest they all meet a grim end at the rotting hands of a zombie horde in an apocalyptic city.

title: Xion Leak
description: Cooperate quickly as a duo and set the fastest times to win the trophies! Escape before the Xion gas fries your precious circuits! Run fast, be in sync, and avoid the countless dangers that the mysterious Foreman has placed in your path.

title: WuJiDaoRen
description: WuJiDaoRen is a physics-based fighting game, that can put you back into the classic Kung Fu films. Play as a mighty hero to challenge the most dangerous villains in the world and bring peace to the people.

title: WTC: Love's Labour's Lost
description: The Violet Hotel's waitress and local tour guide are determined to foil the protagonist's plans to take Grendel back to America. Unfortunately, neither native is prepared for the cost of doing so

title: Xxx_Cyberrat_Xxx
description: An infamous cybercriminal and owner of a luxurious underground marketplace tries to reclaim his position in the distrustful society of blackhat hackers and druglords. You must utilize your hacking and intelligence gathering skills in a race with your worsening mental state and sudden hallucinations.

title: Wormwood
description: Two "orange and vaguely ﻿﻿spooky maps" made by Grain of Salt and Ribbiks for Halloween.

title: World of Buh
description: Take control of the destiny of a Buh as he makes his way through an adventurous retro wave world populated by many other Buhs. Some may help you to find what's this all about... but most of them will try to get in the way and do what only the one and only choosen of the Buhs can do.

title: Without Judgement
description: Without Judgement is a third or first person open world action rpg. Set in the futuristic Florida, you are going to be able to freely explore the countless cities and settlements across the state. Experience engaging and dynamic quests and random encounters which can be solved in multiple ways.

title: Winter Resort Simulator 2: Riedstein
description: Just in time for the start of the winter season, a DLC will be released with a new game world, frequently requested features and no less than three new ropeways.

title: Whispering Abyss
description: Whispering Abyss is a top-down rogue-like in the setting of Lovecraftian horror. Play as Grace as you navigate the treacherous abyss and rid Dululth of its monsters with your trusty dual revolvers! Descend into the madness in a procedurally generated abyss, collecting loot to aid your quest.

title: Wheeled Warriors: Ultimate Destruction
description: Even if civilization is gone, humanity still loves high-speed racing. In Wheeled Warriors you drive through the post-apocalyptic streets of destroyed cities. Build your own savage war machine by choosing the right weapons, armor, customizations and more.

title: Wiener Wars
description: After a horrific science accident in a secret world war 2 laboratory, all of humanity is ripped through space time only to be reintroduced as sentient wieners. The war still rages. How will we get out of this mess? Who knows? But we can only figure that out once we’re doing killing…

title: Winged Raider
description: Save the Kingdom of Daanco from the curse of Turkzu in Winged Raider! Unlock the story by progressing in this goofy roguelike 2D shooter. Fly around the Winged Castle, find new weapons, unlock abilities with colored wings, kill your enemies, and DIE?! Try not to die.

title: Wings of the Universe
description: Wings of The Universe (WoTU) is a free-to-play 2D indie space action MMORPG top-down game developed by a single programmer. WoTU is designed to be co-op heavy, but even a lone wolf can survive with his skills and have fun.

title: Watashi Suzume
description: Shamrock Creations is proud to present Watashi Suzume. A story that explores the far reaching impacts that love, friendship, and understanding have on not only our own lives, but how we view life itself. All wrapped up in a typical anime inspired narrative we hope everyone will enjoy.

title: Wedgie Simulator
description: 1, 2, 3. ATOMIC. WEDGIE. ACTION! Give people wedgies in several different angles and poses. Take screenshots. Animate. Make a video. Upload it online.

title: Wetory
description: A child abandoned from the world immediately after birth due to a congenital disease When all the colors of the world were taken away by the villain, Realizing that his illness is the power to defeat the villain, Join us in our adventure to regain the color which lost to the villain!

title: Warpsquad
description: WARPSQUAD is a space exploration rogue-lite in an ever-changing galaxy to be played solo or co-op. Encounter a wide range of hostile spaceships, special events, and upgrades to your ship and crew. Master the ship terminals and crew with unique traits to survive this hostile world.

title: Secrets of Temple Isle
description: Explore ancient ruins and diverse biomes, fight in third-person combat while collecting gear and powers. Design your space and decorate with items gathered in the world. Become the legend in this exciting single player adventure.

title: Vostok 2061
description: Vostok 2061 is a modern graphic vertical scroll-shooter. Gorgeous alien worlds, a lot of spaceships, bright explosions, secrets, various bosses, and a great soundtrack!

title: Volunteer
description: Experience first-person horror and fight to survive in a chaotic landscape infested with bloodthirsty creatures.

title: Voidhunter
description: In a dystopian spacefaring future, mankind struggles to maintain their humanity. Take control of devastating spacecrafts, upgrade their loadouts and offer justice to the highest bidder. Become a space-traveling mercenary. Become the voidhunter.

title: Urbano: Legends' Debut
description: Hang out during the day, hunt urban legends at night. Make new friends and fight to the beat.

title: Vacation Adventures: Park Ranger 14
description: Help run Pinecreek Hills National Park Have fun organizing Summer Season events on Bluewaters Lake, Cherokee River & Apache Nature trails.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Parliament of Knives: What Stares Back
description: Play as a vampire of the insightful clan Malkavian or the manipulative clan Lasombra! New powers, new secrets, and new romance options await within.

title: Vendetta: Mafia Wars
description:
The year is 1940 and the rules of the game has changed. The underground world in the United States is reborn along with new bosses. As a real-time strategy game, our product offers you the atmosphere of those times with all its glory by placing you in the heart of the mob wars that shaped the USA. Form your family, manage your economy, forge alliances with other families to outsmart your rivals.

While everybody is talking about the war in Europe, you must reshape the criminal underground and will have a sit down with six families to do so. Create your criminal empire and run your family, expand your turf and protect it against rivals. You are free to choose which path to take to be the greatest; find allies and prove your worth to them or back stab all and show how power hungry you are. Ultimately destroy all and be the real king of the city!

title: Vex Clock
description: Vex Clock is a Clockpunk styled action-adventure, where you must run, gun and save the kingdom from absolute corruption. Your choices with who you bond with will shape the final outcome.

title: Virtueror: The Virtual Conqueror
description: Virtueror is an RTS with 4x and RPG elements. Your mission is to conquer new worlds and to extend your domain over the whole galaxy. Build your base, command your units, gather resources, set up defenses and crush anyone challenging you. Have no mercy and the universe will be yours!

title: Stunt Derby
description: Stunt Derby is a throwback stunt car racer with high-fidelity physics, online play and a built in track editor. Master tracks, build your own, explore a variety of game modes and smash through stacks of boxes in this unique low-poly drive-em-up.

title: Stunts Contest Extreme Cars
description: In this simulation-racing game, as an experienced driver, you will be able to modify your car in such a way that you really feel that you are driving cars from another planet...

title: Sudocity
description: Build your city, solve puzzles, and rule the urban jungle in this minimalist masterpiece of city-building and sudoku. New citizens arrive on each season, will you be ready to welcome them?

title: Sugoi Adventure! DragonSlayer
description: A game of choices where you get to become a hero, impress hot girls, and slay a dragon. Choose your own adventure and make it truly sugoi!

title: Sully: A Very Serious RPG
description: A fantasy comedy story jrpg with (optional!) turn-based combat.

title: Summa Expeditionis
description: Summa Expeditionis is a survival and strategy game set in ancient Roman Empire. Follow the career of a Roman soldier from Legionnaire to Centurion. Build and manage your camp, recruit more soldiers and face the barbarians for the glory of Rome.

title: Spirit & Stone
description: A kingdom's open ended journey from a small village to a patchwork of bustling castles. Build your kingdom block by block. Explore the world, grow your industries, and watch your citizens thrive in your creations. Do it your way - there are no wrong choices.

title: Springy: A Bounce Adventure
description: Help Springy and his friends on a fantastic 3D adventure in an unknown world full of dangers.

title: Splittown
description: Cold War has split the world in two. The Great Divide spans across the globe with an impenetrable wall between the two blocs. You are Leonard Nimby; stone-faced agent of IM5, hot on the trail of a shrink gun stolen from you by a villanous mayoral candidate on the eve of a fateful election.

title: Spectator
description: You are an observer tasked with monitoring surveillance footage for suspicious activity. This innocuous job soon takes a turn for the creepy, as anomalies begin to appear, from moving furniture... to them. Experience a real-time horror straight from horror-filled creepypastas!

title: Keeper's Toll
description: Rise, fallen hero! Keeper's Toll, a harrowing journey into a dark and retro world that demands skill and courage. Every moment could be your last, but with each setback, you grow stronger. Embrace the challenge, overcome daunting foes, and cleanse the world of its cursed lands.

title: Space Tail: Every Journey Leads Home
description: Space Tail is a 2.5D adventure platformer, which immerses the player in a deep, emotional plot, and lets him explore new planets and interact with alien civilizations.

title: Snowtracked
description: It's a simple snow exploration game, and stickbuilder.

title: Snapshot Aquarium
description: Snapshot Aquarium is an aquarium simulator with photo shooting mechanics. (yes yes, you need this.) Create cozy habitats for your fish, unlock new content in arcade-style photo challenges and visit other players!

title: Slime Hero
description: Slime Hero is a slime collecting and fighting game, you need to collect and select the best slime team to pass all the stage, after that you can go to challenge the boss, try to dodge all the attack and kick away all the enemy.

title: Somber
description: Somber is an atmospheric action-platformer that takes place in the semi-open world of Gloom. A hand-painted game filled with stunning environments, Somber demands absolute precision from players who wish to unlock its many secrets.

title: Songs from the Iron Sea
description: Immerse yourself in a contrasted emotional journey with delicate visuals! Songs from the Iron Sea is a poetic platformer set in a whimsical aquatic universe. Guided by a kind entity, embody a creature lost in a metal nightmare and escape the foreman's gaze to regain your freedom.

title: Soothing Farmer
description: Manage your farm and take care of your plants. Make new friends by completing the quests of the locals. Learn new skills and expand your knowledge of crop farming as a result. Master the art of cultivation and become the ultimate farmer!

title: Souldead
description: The awakening of Hell has awakened you. Go through different worlds to catch the Messiah of Hell and take back what was taken from you. Souldead is a fast-paced dark fantasy FPS shooter with a modern take on the gameplay.

title: Soul Dier
description: Soul Dier is a story-driven grid-based and turn-based tactical JRPG. Embark on a adventure to retrieve the lost memory and delve into the world's mysteries. Fight against the evil legion with your allies on the journey!

title: Tactical Recon
description: Battle your way through many levels in an epic journey to free your country from an enemy invasion in this 2D action game, gather gold and buy more stuff, that you probably would not buy in real life.. like a double barrel shotgun with split-in-two-fire-two-ways mechanism! Or even a Jet pack!

title: Swirl W@tch
description: Swirl W@​tch is a tense stealth-action roguelite that takes place on an over-exploited gas giant. Infiltrate industrial installations, evade or eliminate guard ships, commit corporate sabotage and grow the movement to unlock new gear. Can your actions free this otherworldly world?

title: Survive the Fall
description: Scavenge, Craft, Build and Fight! Survive the Fall is an open-world action game with a rich story. Collect loot & fight to rebuild your community and its base. Uncover the secrets of the fallen world after a meteorite strike!

title: Super Pentagon
description: Super Pentagon revolves around a unique rhythm game concept, challenging vision, focus and beat skills alike!

title: SuperOffice
description: SuperOffice is an intense top down view shooter experience where time moves only when you move.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Landscapes 2
description: Puzzles of Landscapes!

title: The Blunderbuss
description: The blunderbuss is a powerful bomb created by the most secretive cartel in the DR. They involve Eduardo, an ordinary man who must prevent the detonation of that unique bomb to protect his loved ones before... Blunderbuss!

title: The Blood Games
description: 100 players awake in a room alongside a prize of $1 Billion. Your goal, pass 7 deadly challenges and be the last one standing.

title: The Beast in the Cave
description: This is an adventure plot game in the pixel style of kesulu. Follow the tourists described by Lovecraft to have an incredible Cave Adventure. In the depths of darkness, there are eyes staring at you

title: The Day After
description: Floods, raging hurricanes, and weather anomalies cause great havoc around the globe. People are forced to leave their homesteads. Each day becomes a challenge and a fight for survival.

title: The Death Tree
description: The Death Tree is a first-person horror hunt game set in a nightmarish dark forest that involves action and "jump scares" through a tension and intrigue atmosphere. Hunt creepy monsters,ruthlessly creatures and witches.

title: The Evil of Mutant
description: Game features ・JRPG ・Easy operation ・No complicated explanations ・Addictiveness that gets you hooked in 5 minutes from the start ・There are so many mini game

title: The Godfeather: A Mafia Pigeon Saga
description: A mafia pigeon roguelike saga full of danger, adventure and poop! Join the pigeon underworld. Take back the old neighbourhood. Become The Godfeather.

title: The Heroes Around Me
description: The Heroes Around Me tells a story of a family of 3: the hard-working and quiet father – Nan, his daughter Lili, and their pet dog Sesame. Players will experience the harshness and warmth in the simpler time of the 1990s, where lots of stories are untold.

title: The Host: Cataclysm
description: After a Post-Armageddon event the world has gone back to its roots living in simpler times, back to swords, kings, and war. After the hero has chosen evil the world is left in ruins as everyone struggles to survive in this new found world.

title: The Hungry Fly
description: Once upon a time, there was a fly. A hungry fly. A fly with razor-sharp teeth, with a taste for dead things. This is the tale of its adventure to find something dead to devour, in a swamp where nothing dies, everything is grotesque, and every choice matters, no matter how surreal.

title: Sakura Melody
description: Play as Ren, a rookie producer in the idol industry, and help him shape three beautiful young women into multi-talented superstars. Plan your idols' routines, help them accrue fans, and beat your competition, while finding time to take your girls out on steamy dates.

title: Sailors: Age of Corsairs
description: Become a merchant, pirate, or privateer in the 17th century Caribbean! Join colonial powers or fight for gold and glory in this epic sandbox crew simulator!

title: Samurai Pig : The Way of the Rooster
description: Samurai Pig: The Way of the Chicken is a brutal Action RPG. Tragedy has thrown the Zodiac and the very world into disarray. You are an exiled pig, who must return to the blade to protect the world. Crush rogue deities. Protect your chickens. Save your bacon.

title: Samurai Pussy
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Save the Princess
description: Oh no, The princess has been kidnapped! Help our valiant Knight rescue the princess from the clutches of the demons in this enjoyable, but challenging, platformer game. Defeat your enemies using different weapons, and ultimately Save the Princess.

title: Sanri
description: SANRI is a first-person psychological horror game where you play a schizophrenic patient whose wife disappeared during camp. Face the delusions, solve the mystery and try to find her despite your constantly distorted perception of time-space.

title: OnOrbit: Virtual Space Lab
description: OnOrbit is a virtual space lab lets you assemble and operate space hardware as if you were actually in space. Make your own craft in a sandbox mode, then simulate its operation as part of the Supernational Space Cooperative (SSC). Climb the ranks and head out to the planets.

title: Scissors in Hell
description: Scissors in Hell is a madcap 1st person Dungeon Crawler. Slice demons (in turn-based combat), explore among the flames (in real-time), then make a cool base (in hell)!

title: Screech of Steel: Gladiators
description: Gladiator fights online in a free multiplayer game for PC and mobile devices. Create characters, buy weapons and armor, and participate in gladiator battles in up to 5x5 mode. Immerse yourself in the world of gladiatorial battles of ancient Rome!

title: Ronin: Samurai Redemption
description: The Ronin - Three samurai whose master was framed for disgrace in the high court and ordered to kill himself, are now alone. Instead of accepting the same fate, the samurai swore an oath of vengeance and became RONIN.

title: Psycho Reign
description: Psycho Reign is a Single or 2 player co-operative online horror puzzle and stealth game where in each level you will be chased by a blood thirsty psycho. Look for and solve mini puzzles in order to progress further on the map. Ultimately, find something to fight back...or get chopped up.

title: Public Bounce
description: Public Bounce is a collection of erotic stories, narrated by a sensual presenter. The game is full of girls willing to have sex in risky and exciting places. No matter the place or time, they all want to feel the excitement of risk while enjoying the guilty pleasure with their partners.

title: Raid Healing
description: Raid Healing is a single player healer RPG with focus on collecting and improving equipment. Based on MMO healer gameplay, you have to heal the raid you created while fighting waves of enemies.

title: Q'Redux
description: In this Celtic-Egyptian, open-world fantasy, you play a healer on a personal journey to rescue a mentor. Learn powerful new sorceries as you discover magic, mix salves & help alt-gendered spirits in this souls-lite, action-RPG. Burn, Grow, Heal, Summon, Transform, Control. The power is yours.

title: Quasimorph
description: Take on a role of a hardened PMC fighter in a dark turn-based extraction RPG. Engage in unforgiving combat, manage your ship and pile up the bodies of your clones to unravel the dark mystery behind threat to all life.

title: Primal Omen
description: Explore a lush tropical island overrun by fierce dinosaurs. A tense third person survival horror experience against tenacious creatures. Unearth why dinosaurs roam the earth once more.

title: Primordials Legends: Hollow Hero
description: Primordials Legends: Hollow Hero tells the tale of Brunt, an anthropomorphic Combat Wombat on her first adventure in the fantasy world, Eridal. Embark on this epic 3rd person action-filled adventure, uncover how this world came to be, and meet new legends that will help shape the future of Eridal!

title: Reclaim the Sea
description: Reclaim the Sea is a roguelike strategy game set in a pirate fantasy world. Fight your way through randomly generated maps and text events. Command your pirate crew, upgrade your ship and make tactical decisions to beat the boss and save the world… or die trying.

title: Reflection
description: You woke up in some basement and don't remember who you are or how you ended up here... But what you do know is that you need to get out of here...

title: Renai X Royale: Love's a Battle
description: I, transfer student Hanamaru Mari, love you, Komachi Hiro-kun! Please go out with me! Our protag, Komachi Hirotaka. Every day, he goes through the motions-- dodging his cunning underclassman's advances, accidentally hitting on the student council president, and chasing idols.

title: Restless Kids
description: Restless Kids is a multiplayer thriller game. A group of children try to undermine the reever's job in choosing the neighborhood. But it should not be forgotten that the reever is a police officer. CHILDREN YOU HAVE 15 MINUTES!

title: The Operator
description: As an Operator, you will assist FDI's field agents by analyzing evidence on your computer and making deductions. Help them solve impossible cases in this immersive interface game, full of plot twists and mysteries. Everything will be explained, you just have to ████ ██ ██████.

title: Prison Life 2
description: An online game that you'll play with 3-11 players as a Prisoner or a Guard and will try to escape or prevent escapes. Loot, Craft, and make your way to the exit, or investigate and arrest wanted players as a guard!

title: Out of Jail
description: Out of Jail is a multiplayer game that is in development, where the objective is to escape from prison together with other players by solving different challenges in each match. One player in the match will take on the role of the jailer and must prevent the players from escaping the prison.

title: Orc Warchief: Strategy City Builder
description: Become an Orc warchief and fight for survival of your race. Rebuild your village and train your warriors. Gather resources and craft your weapons. Raise your warbanner and gather The Horde.

title: On the Peril of Parrots
description: Explore the line between machine and personhood, in this Puzzle Narrative experience. Take on the role of an AI, created by the world renowned, Dr. G. Step through a battery of cognition tests and prove your intelligence, sentience and ultimately your humanity.

title: Not Alone: Remake
description: NOTALONE is a single-player horror simulator in which you play the role of 45-year-old Mortie Jones. You learn that your mother is dead and your father is missing. Your task will be to spend the night in your old family home.

title: Nova Lands: Emilia's Mission
description: Nova Lands: Emilia's Mission is a prologue chapter of the main game, Nova Lands. Learn your way around the planet you've landed on, build your base, and automate it with your helpful bots!

title: Novi Cube
description: Casual + Old-School + Roguelike = Novi Cube! Shoot dozens of projectiles at evil geometric shapes to finally satisfy that itch to kill geometric shapes that we all have since we had to calculate weird shapes and forms! Calculating areas of squares is boring! Novi Cube is fun²!

title: Nowhere: Mysterious Artifacts
description: Nowhere: Mysterious Artifacts Survival & Horror Game Set in September 1993, the first episode begins with four friends searching for an artifact. They have no difficulty in realizing that something is wrong here, this is the site of the Root Experiment mentioned in conspiracy theories. There is only one thing left for the rest, to survive and not to be afraid if it is possible...

title: Oblivion Eclipse
description: Oblivion Eclipse is open world souls-like action RPG platformer. Vast world, slick combat, fun movement. Slash through gods as you platform your way through a breathtaking world on an unforgettable adventure.

title: Offline
description: The game is a first person visual novel, and has a lot of text and reading.

title: OHV
description: Build your own buggy. Obtain, maintain and tune your OHV car. A game set in Poland in the 90s.

title: Offroad Delivery Service
description: A courier and an off-road simulator rolled into one, where you are faced with an arduous task of delivering cargo of various sizes to distant and hard-to-reach places. Get contracts, earn money, upgrade your equipment and SUV.

title: Once a Porn a Time
description: Once a porn a time, is an adventure style visual novel with princesses and other strange creatures that you have to bang.

title: Non-Stop Raiders
description: In this infinite side-scroll runner play as different raiders, run and jump across areas. Pillage gold from either your enemies or chests across your journey to upgradeabilities or unlock new charecters.

title: Nonno Lorenzo
description: Farm, cook, explore and level up in Nonno Lorenzo! An exploration driven farming and cooking RPG where you run your own pizzeria. With an old farm at disposal, you must grow ingredients, level up and explore the island to make it the happy community it once was.

title: Noir Storm
description: Take on the role of a private detective who, intercepted by a MOSSAD spy on the city of Buenos Aires in 1952, is drawn into a dangerous odyssey against exiles from the Third Reich and the inminent threat of a new and unprecedented weapon of mass destruction.

title: Night of the Wererat
description: A cheesy short horror game where you play as an exterminator on a dark and rainy night. The house has rats within its walls, but what if something more sinister lies deep within the home? Survive and complete your job, or face down the wrath of the wererat!

title: New Town Needs Tamer
description: Become a champion tamer for a newly formed town, full of people eager to meet you.

title: Neverland
description: Waking up on a strange island, you find yourself transformed into the appearance of a child. You could make new friends, have fun, and explore the island. Depending on your choices, you may even become one with the darkside of the island.

title: NanoHive
description: Manage your hive of nanobots in a Free-to-Play top-down arena shooter and exterminate all the bacteria and viruses infecting the body. Multiply the hive by absorbing bacteria to save people's lives as fast as possible while competing with others in order to become the fastest NanoHive Operator.

title: My Wife is a Princess
description: A traitor appeared in the kingdom, and the seal of the demon king was lifted. In order to save the kingdom~the beautiful queen sent a rescue request to the brave...The price was to become the wife of the brave!

title: Mythargia
description: You are a journalist in search of your breakthrough story. A promising lead takes you to the abandoned island of Mythargia where you have to discover its buried history connecting two different dimensions.

title: The Multi-Medium
description: The Multi-Medium is a visually unique 2D puzzle platform adventure in which you play an interdimensional explorer lost in the multiverse. Travel to diverse worlds, each drawn or painted by hand in a different medium and style, in search of your place in the cosmos.

title: The Masked Prisoner
description: "The Masked Prisoner" explores the untold stories of several Half Life characters - taking place in a prison on the outskirts of City 17.

title: Human Error
description:
Human Error: Episode One tells the story of a civil protection officer called Anders fighting Vortigaunts, Alien Grunts, and Alien Controllers using the Combine's forces as his allies.

You can also play in Traitor & Alyx Modes with three of your friends in Human Error: Co-op.

Alyx Mode is enabled in Beta 1.0.6 and later versions.

In Alyx mode one of the players is selected as Alyx, before everyone selects their character. While in Traitor Mode selecting the Traitor is always random, in Alyx Mod it's based on who has longest time since he or she was last Alyx. In short Alyx Mode is like Traitor Mode with the Traitor starting as Revealed with some additions to her abilities.

Alyx has a fixed set of weapons, she can't pick up or drop weapons (except grenades). She always spawns with the Gravity Gun, Alyx Gun, Shotgun, and the Emp Tool. The Gravity Gun can be used to disable Combine Generators. Alyx also regenerators ammo for the Alyx Gun.

You can currently play Alyx Mode only in Backbone (althought there will be seperate maps for it in future releases). Instead of having to destroy the Main Frame, Alyx has to hack it. None of the Hostiles do damage or try to attack the Main Frame, they are there just to help Alyx hack it. Hacking it will take a lot longer than it takes to hack a normal Combine Interface.

title: ArcheWorld
description: ArcheWorld is the first seamless, open-world PC MMORPG that utilizes NFT(Non-Fungible Token) based on blockchain technology. Battle enemies and explore a wide world across a selection of classes and areas!

title: Dark Old Sun II: Unspace
description: A calamity that imprisons everyone in a dying earth, the unspace. Explore the uncharted space in random generated maps, get new weapons in a diablo-like weapon drop system and upgrade them, level up, and also chilling inside your spaceship listening to amazing synthwave tracks. Conquer the unknow.

title: Inner Ashes
description: Inner Ashes is a first person, narrative, puzzle adventure, where the player puts himself in Henry's shoes, a forest guard diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer’s. He has to travel through his mind to discover why his only daughter Enid disappeared from his life.

title: Hauntii
description: A beguiling adventure in which you uncover the secrets of an expansive and mysterious world - haunting both the environment and its denizens to craft ingenious solutions to the many challenges that await.

title: MudGate
description: Explore, survive, and make it home to build a kingdom! As a stranger to yourself in a foreign land, you must explore, improve, and most importantly survive in these unforgiving lands in order to make it home.

title: Convenient
description: You pull over to the nearest convenience store on your way home to get gas and quickly realize the rumors were true about this place. Survive and escape the Oldlake Stalker.

title: Foolish Mortals
description: Obsessed with finding the lost treasure of Bellemore Manor, Murphy McCallan encounters ghosts, voodoo, and an evil Phantom who wants the treasure as their own! Eccentric characters and exciting puzzles populate the mysterious island of Devil’s Rock in this classic style point & click adventure.

title: Rue Valley
description: A highly emotional RPG with Personality System and Mind Map Mechanics. Survive the unjust psychotherapy, lift yourself from rock bottom and uncover the mystery of the time anomaly that keeps the world stuck in 47 minutes.

title: Automatica
description: Tactical puzzle game where you need to program your robots to finish the task.

title: Goblin's Expedition
description: Embark on an epic quest with Trax the goblin, using classic "Pipe Dreams" mechanics to strategically build tracks and reach the Goblin King's Castle, all while avoiding derailment in this challenging railway building puzzle game!

title: Battle of Decay: Survival
description: Battle of Decay: Survival is a top-down casual survival game that throws you into a world during a virus outbreak. Fight your way through the missions with your friends and get out of hell alive. This game is set in the world of the in-development game 'Battle of Decay'.

title: Hidden Object Vacation
description: Solve hidden object puzzles around the world visiting 150 cities and finding 10,000 hidden objects!

title: Heart of the Machine
description: You are the first sentient AI, born into a city filled with endless opportunities. Raise an army of robots and obliterate your foes, become a benevolent machine overlord, or explore countless other objectives and the many paths to accomplish them.

title: Cursed Crew
description: Cursed crew is a roguelike crew management game taking place on a 18th century ship in a fantasy setting. You control a captain that needs to keep the ship’s crew alive in a harsh world with environmental hazards, pirates, sea monsters and much, much more. Can you lift off the Curse?

title: Angler's World
description: Delve into the relaxing world of fishing with Angler's World, a casual simulator project that lets you recapture some peaceful as well as exciting moments between enjoying your surroundings and noticing the float dip under. Win contests, invest in equipment, discover ever newer fishing challenges.

title: Evening Vibes
description: Find the girl, escape from the terrible demon and solve riddle of this place.

title: Starwisp Hyperdrive
description: A cozy atmospheric exploration game about making your home in space, finding your way in a strange and whimsical universe, and the impact you have along the way.

title: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
description: "Where will their light lead them?" Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

title: City of Rampage
description: City of Rampage is a beat'em up game inspired by such classics as "Streets of Rage" and "Comix Zone", with advanced fighting mechanics and challenging tough bosses. It won't be easy, but beautiful hand drawn visuals and dope soundtracks will make sure you will be coming back for more.

title: Scribbleman Army
description: Scribbleman Army is a colony management game where you have to explore a cave.

title: Beat Blitz
description: “Beat Blitz” is a hardcore rhythm-platforming experience. Jump and Roll your way through a gauntlet of platforming challenges, all while collecting beats to create dope music!

title: Skaramazuzu
description: Enter the mysterious world of Skaramazuzu, and get ready to be tested. Meet strange beings and whimsical personalities, face challenges, and solve riddles in a hand-drawn, black and white 2D world.

title: Darfall
description: Darfall is a strategy survival city-builder with RPG elements. You lead your hero with a band of warriors to defend your settlement, explore the corrupted land and craft new items. Expand your settlement and defeat the darkness coming from everywhere.

title: Agri-Tycoon
description: A throwback to the old school farming simulators where you focus on building and expanding a farm while producing crops and breeding livestock. Keep an eye on your expenses and follow market trends to sell at the right time and become the ultimate agricultural tycoon.

title: Archrebel: Tactics
description: Archrebel is a sci-fi turn-based strategy war game, strongly inspired by the classic Rebelstar released back in 1986. In Archrebel, players can control a few dozens of units in a grid-based map, performing actions limited by a classic action-point system similar to the one found in the X-COM series.

title: Metal Voyager
description: It's your one way ticket to midnight! A side-scrolling heavy metal guitar shooter. Blast your enemies with pure metal energy from your astral guitar as the backing track rages in the night. Featuring a fleet of surreal hand drawn space monsters and an arsenal of cosmic items to whomp them with.

title: CrazyCaps
description: Free ! Free ! Free ! UnLock All Difficulty And Puzzle Round!

title: Elowen's Light
description: A heartfelt story of recovery, finding your place, and the power of supportive loved ones. Your expanding home provides more opportunities to help the curious creatures you encounter in this procedurally generated endless world that adapts to your skill level. Enjoy zero stress platforming.

title: Daomei Village
description: You have been banished to Daomei Village for your offense. In order to return to the Emperor's favor, you must make an effort. Repair, build, cultivate fields and fight various adversities. Meet new friends and learn their stories. Do whatever it takes not to be banished forever!

title: Plead with the Elder Gods
description: A 3D metroidvania adventure in a large, interconnected dark fantasy world. Discover secrets in snowy canyons, lush forests, murky caves and fallen castles. Gain divine abilities, meet peculiar travellers, fight deadly creatures, and make pilgrimage to meet four elder gods.

title: Tale of Witch's Heart
