description: When Chaos came, He brought us two blessings. One is your heart. A Witch's Heart. How will you respond to His kindness? Will you carry His will and slay Demons roaming this world, or shall you rebel and abandon your destined path? Will you carry this burden and face lurking threats?

title: Lianhai Casino
description: A ray of light shines on the sea, inviting you to the Lianhai Casino. Gold, silver, treasures, all with a desire to devour their guests, even today. The four men who challenge them - are they heroes? Or a lamb driven mad? Get your tickets ready for the grandest adventure!

title: RichBroker
description: RichBroker is a keyboard controlled tycoon game. Build & sell buildings, upgrade your company and buy out your competitors!

title: Line Hold
description: Top-Down Shooter meets Tower Defense. Build a maze, turrets and barricades. Survive waves of enemies and keep shooting. Level up and unlock new skills and buildings.

title: Underfoot Queens
description: Underfoot Queens is an ant themed 4x where you will lead your species across generations. Explore, forage for food, expand your colony, fight off competitors, and survive the elements on your path to evolution. In the end, only the most adaptable species will survive.

title: Left to Rot
description: Left to Rot: is a first-person psychological horror with a heavy focus on exploration and immersion that will leave your blood running cold. The player must solve puzzles, explore the surroundings and survive. Navigate through unsettling environments and constantly changing rooms.

title: Astro Sailor
description: Astro Sailor is a hand-drawn action-adventure game with rogue-like elements and a unique gravity-based movement system. On your journey to explore the galaxy, you’ll meet new friends and foes, discover hidden treasures and face dangerous obstacles.

title: Bartender Simulator
description: Become the bartender and bar owner with Bartender Simulator! Start with a small and little-known bar, expand your business and attract new guests. Serve well-known drinks and create new unique ones, develop your bartending and flair skills. Make you and your bar the best and most famous in the city!

title: Until Lights Out
description: A beautiful Christmas night that was interrupted, by a haunting and terrible curse. Look for an answer to all this, and maybe you have a chance to survive.

title: The Last World
description: The Last World is a sci-fi simulation game with elements of space, adventure, survival, modding and automation. The game in which the player has to create his own empire from the ruins of the old one. Mine, build, research, produce and travel!

title: Belonging
description: Belonging is a game about a cult and its victims. As a thief scouting a potential location they want to steal from, the player searches an abandoned estate of a cult to find valuables and uncover uncomfortable truths about what happened to the people that lived there.

title: Crafty Survivors
description: All heroes got corrupted! Unlock a diverse cast of crafty professionals, use their unique skills, create your own builds and defend your home by eliminating hordes of monsters. Gather materials, rebuild your village and craft your way to the origin of this malignous curse!

title: Cage of Etha
description: A story-oriented visual novel set in historical France. Play as Emile, a lonesome boy whose past has caught up with him. Witness as the choices he makes continue on a downwards spiral…

title: Made Beaver
description: Historically accurate fur trade simulator and inventory manager. Build forts, trade with tribes and settlements, ship furs back home for profit.

title: Post Industrial Renovator
description: Give a second life to old factories by turning them into modern places of art and culture. Accept orders from city authorities and turn old wastelands into museums, cafes, and even parks. Use your skills to create post-industrial treasures in the Post Industrial Renovator.

title: Coffee Shop Simulator
description: Open your own coffee shop and serve the best coffee in the world. Sell delicious cakes, desserts, croissants, muffins and ice cream. Expand your cafe, add tables, cabinets, chairs and decorate it with paintings and plants.

title: Mystery Trails
description: Delve into a first-person atmospheric adventure game, where you’re a mountain rescuer and a hiking guide who has just received information about an accident in the area. You know it might be too late for the victims, and soon you realize something strange happened out there.

title: Honeymancer
description: Honeymancer is a cute RPG and Farm Simulator with wave-based combat.Play as a secluded Bear Witch. She's a beekeeper and a user of honey magic.Help your bee friends make honey by planting flowers, use your honey to cast spells and protect the forest from evil robots.

title: Field of Arms: Tactics
description: Field of Arms: Tactics is a strategy game with a unique board game aesthetic, set in the 18th century, recreating battles that occurred during this period of time. Players will have to think strategically in order to defeat the enemy, defend or attack forts during tense battles and sieges.

title: Corpse Keeper
description: Corpse Keeper is a very challenging action-strategy Dungeon Crawler. You'll need to lead a squad of three corpses to explore the grim and dark medieval world within limited time, build a powerful army of the living dead, and finally kill the demon lurking in the deep end of the cathedral.

title: Halve
description: Two spirits wake up separated in a broken world, with no memory of what they once were. Control them simultaneously in an atmospheric, immersive journey about separation, memory, and the hope of becoming whole again.

title: Hospital Renovator
description: Become a one-man renovation company and take care of the reconstruction of a ruined hospital! Save a neglected facility and create a fully functional emergency complex. The entire process of cleaning, planning, repairing, and arranging is on your side. Build a dream clinic in the Hospital Renovator!

title: Idler Coaster
description: Build the ride you want, where you want! Customize your park, upgrade rides and research new attractions to turn your guests into happy customers! Sit back and count your money or click your way to the top!

title: EvoMon
description: Evomon Is a creature collector in tamagotchi version. Take care of your evomon since its infancy and discover its new evolutions, have fun playing the mini-games, adventure in mysterious expeditions, battle intensely against different monsters to reach the title of Evomon Champion.

title: European Football Dynasty 2023
description: In European Football Dynasty, the best clubs from all over Europe are combined in one league-structure. You take over the job as the top manager of a soccer club. Will you manage to lead your club to success - even if your competitors for the title come from Madrid, London, Milan and Munich?

title: Silen House
description: 《silen house》 is a scary adventure puzzle game. There is always a strange cry in the deserted old house in the deep mountains. I don't know where I came from. When I approached the old house, a grim burst came.

title: Feudums
description: Feudums is a medieval strategy simulation with a detailed player-to-player vassalage system, full modding support and community-driven narrative. Balance diplomatic, economic, and military aspects while making your play for the throne. Is it your destiny to rule?

title: Gun Knight All Day
description: Gun Knight All Day is a close quarters bullet hell dungeon crawler about a knight who uses guns. Shoot, dodge, and scavenge your way through the procedurally generated dungeons one room at a time. Challenging boss fights test the sharpness of your skills and the lethality of your weapons.

title: Tear Factory
description: A game about hunting rats, feeding them to your family, and going to bed.

title: Rats in a Cage
description: A corporate satire puzzle game. As a typical corporate rat, you manipulate your coworkers with coffee and gossip and take credit for their work in order to beat every level of a skill assessment test controlled by a rude AI that goes beyond the game window to stop you.

title: Monster Bullets
description: Monster Bullets is a retro fast paced FPS with a twist. Each monster has a unique weakness. Quickly load the correct bullet for each monster and fire them off! Experiment with upgrades on each procedurally generated attempt and try to reach the end!

title: Magnus Positive Phototaxis
description: Magnus Positive Phototaxis is an atmospheric journey through a mysterious world of characters, traces and symbols. The task of the player is to solve the puzzles, using proper combinations of objects, finding them in the environment around him.

title: Hand Shadow
description: Challenge your mind with puzzles that are based on optical illusions. Find the perfect position and angle by rotating the hands until order is restored, and discover a story of protagonist Morgan with professional voicing.

title: Iron Dungeon
description: Iron Dungeon combines a twin-stick shooter, a 2d platformer, and a roguelite. Explore a dangerous underground complex searching for dozens of weapons, gadgets, and upgrades to find a way to the surface and discover if there is still life on Earth!

title: Polterguys
description: Polterguys is a fun-for-all-ages multiplayer game - a supernatural mix of whacky powerups and fast paced chases. The polterguys (ectoey little creatures) possess everyday objects to run around a quirky playlist of fantasy and real-world settings with a super-clear objective, which is to escape the Monster that is hunting them.

title: Lost Fragments
description: Move between reality and memories, changing the shape of fragments of the past.

title: Athenian Rhapsody
description: Athenian Rhapsody is a turn based RPG which includes intense and fast paced real-time-dodging. You'll be faced with many challenges, and you'll have to fight your way through the world by either fighting, or awkwardly trying to make friends with your opponents through pick-up-lines, mean jokes, memory games, and other strange and funny interactions.

title: Cozy Room
description: Cozy Room is an idle game for chilling. Enjoy your time with a feline companion.

title: Firebird: Legend of the Crystal Goddesses
description: Firebird: Legend of the Crystal Goddesses is a love letter to classic RPGs of the SNES era, inspired by 8-bit and 16-bit classics of the 90's, with some self-aware meta humor for fans of the genre. Come experience a unique fantasy adventure!

title: Plow the Snow!
description: Fight the cold, plow the snow and rescue Snow Angeles in this arcade 1-4 player co-op experience! Clear the streets, parks, cemeteries, lunaparks and other parts of the city from the effects of The Great Blizzard and become a city hero!

title: Kitty May Cry
description: Kitty May Cry is a 3D open world adventure-puzzle game in which you take on the role of a black kitty cat, stranded upon a little island chock-full of ancient relics thanks to a failed rocket launch. Hunt down your lost backpack and the batteries now scattered across the land.

title: The Secret Life of Dorian Pink
description: A choices-matter narrative RPG set in an alternate universe of the Picture of Dorian Gray by Oscar Wilde. Save your boyfriend Basil from the Devil by making questionable choices, gaining allies, and making doughnuts explode.

title: The Many Deaths of Lily Kosen
description: A demon is trying to kill you and your friends, and it's all that you can do to survive. How can you stop it permanently? How many of your friends have to die before it's all over? Try and make the best choices you can in this pulse-pounding horror visual novel!

title: Mr. Honeybunch
description: A point-and-click adventure game taking place within a single room. Equipped with some trash and a makeshift time machine, and aided by a neurotic version of yourself from 5 years ago, you must traverse time, collect objects, solve puzzles, befriend a large zombie bee, and escape the madness.

title: Deep Abyss
description:
Control the newest submarine the Deep Abyss, please collect the radioactive waste dumped in the deep sea!

Searching for radioactive waste dumped in the deep sea using sonar and torpedoes and your senses.
Various obstacles will interfere with your search.

It consists of a 50 normal missions, 50 hard missions and more challenge missions.
Use a mission rewards, you can upgrade the Deep Abyss.
Please try to get a clean sea!
Some of the profits will be donated for the clean sea

title: Fitness Center Renovator
description: Shape your future with Fitness Center Renovator! Build not only your clients’ muscles but also your unique brand. Create and expand a global fitness center franchise. Renovate old premises, customize them and sell with the profit!

title: Guardians of Gridvale
description: Push enemies into water or set them on fire. Use the environment and smart positioning in this tactical, turn based roguelike. Enemies telegraph their moves and the swingmeter decides the damage of your attacks. Equip and level up your heroes and take control of the Guardians of Gridvale!

title: Curse of Argion
description: Curse of Argion is a randomly generated, rogue-like, dungeon crawler in which a small hero must climb a tower full of dangerous traps and enemies to fight a curse that threatens to infect the world of Argion.

title: Furcifer's Fungeon
description: Furcifer’s Fungeon is a loot-based dungeon crawler action roguelike. Forge powerful character builds using common, rare and legendary items and upgrade your collection for following runs!

title: The Sob Island
description: The Sob Island is a 2D plot puzzle game. The story of Aidan's mysterious death of his mother on his 13th birthday is like the first domino that fell, changing everything he knew.

title: Neon Cyber Desert
description: Slice through hordes of mutated monsters as you wander the vast post-apocalyptic wastelands. Follow the trail of mysterious obelisks and craft upgrades from scrap metal to unlock your hidden functions. Experience deadly exploration and dynamic combat in a stylized open world!

title: Innkeep
description: Innkeep is an immersive job sim with an RPG core and a dark twist. Run your own fantasy world inn. Serve ale. Share rumors. Tell jokes. Rob your guests…?? Well, maybe just a little.

title: Dismal Reverie
description: Dismal Reverie is a short FMV puzzle about a woman trying to escape from her reality. Or is it just a dream?

title: Fury of West
description: Fury of West - Top Down Shooter, a top down shooter game, where your mission is to control a cowboy with an unusual revolver, your task is to look for ways out of the intricate labyrinths of the Wild West, simultaneously shooting back from thugs, avoiding the spikes and arrows

title: The 9th Charnel
description: A first-person survival horror game, The 9th Charnel is filled with a rich and frightening atmosphere. While exploring the many mysteries of this world, you must survive- whether you do it through stealth or by using weapons.

title: Astro Duel 2
description: Astro Duel 2 is a sci-fi combat game combining top-down space dog fights with up-close platforming action. Whether versus or co-op, battle through space and on foot at the same time! Strike within the fully-destructible arenas or just nuke ‘em from orbit.

title: Kleebuu Craves Fruit Salad
description: Explore your warped mind while solving platforming puzzles, in an tale that will unfold the deeper you get. Delve into the suppressed memories and remember how to leave this dream. Escape before the nightmares catch up... If you dream about fruit for long enough it's bound to turn rotten.

title: I am Your Lawyer
description: I Am Your Lawyer is a game where you play the role of a lawyer. Your task is to represent your clients in court. You have to defend innocent, harmless people and shady guys (murderers, thieves, crooks). See you in court!

title: Servants of Sumomon
description: This is a single player roguelike-deckbuilder game. Unlike other games of the genre, player must design every level of the game to survive against the invader. To design levels, player should summon creatures and increase their strength by giving right items.

title: Midwest 90: Rapid City
description: Midwest 90: Rapid City is a single player, narrative focused survival- tycoon PC game, where the player Builds and Protects their restaurant that serves Monster Meat Dishes.

title: Unbridled: That Horse Game
description: 'Unbridled: That Horse Game' will be an online multiplayer game where you can build on your own piece of land, explore a beautiful open world, breed horses and take part in challenging competitions such as eventing or western riding!

title: Mess Quest
description: In Mess Quest, arrive at the aftermath of numerous wacky scenarios to clean, mop, and put things back together! Grab a bucket and a mop and get swinging. What’s that green stuff? Where did that bone come from? We don't get paid to ask questions, we get paid to clean!

title: In Woods
description: In Woods is a roguelike survival game. Each battle require player to level up the character, collect different magic item, survive for a certain time and defeat the final boss.

title: Enchanted Blacksmith
description: Take on the role of a blacksmith in the world of the sword and magic. Use your workbench to craft/modify/repair weapons and sell them at your shop. Complete quests to gain experience and money. Craft legendary weapons to seek fortune and Forge Your Legend!

title: Ringlorn Saga
description: Ringlorn Saga is an adventure RPG inspired by the Japanese PC classics. Prince Gerhard the Brave embarks on a journey to the neighboring land to investigate the appearance of a magic barrier and his father's disappearance.

title: Juno 06
description: Complete fast turn-based battles in any order you like as you rise to the top in a psychic battle arena on the moon... Discover a twisted plot during your downtime.

title: Unlock
description: A group of passwords in front of you, with no way forward. Impossible to solve.

title: Little Learning Machines
description: Explore the incredible power of reinforcement learning to inspire, train and customize adorably intelligent machines in this cozy life sim. Craft and inspire each Little Machine’s unique personality, then train them to do amazing things!

title: Grab n' Throw
description: Throw your friends! What would happen if we could throw entire stacks of people around? Ridiculous sports are what would happen. In Grab n' Throw, take on the role of an athlete with Totally Natural upper body strength and play the full-contact games of the near-future against human and AI players.

title: Dangerous Community
description: Welcome to Sterling Hollows... Play as Jacoby Paccs and explore the town to learn about Jacoby and his reputation in the community, meet unique NPC's across town, choose to make positive or negative decisions for Jacobys life, and optionally use violence against other residents.

title: Astro Pirates
description: Space pirate co-op hack-and-slash roguelike flight shooter game-description-salad!

title: Apollo Red Moon
description: Apollo Red Moon - is a retro sci fi fast paced shooter. That takes action in alternative history. As a member of Apollo Mission, after successful landing on the moon, you were amubushed and taken prisoner by Soviets who builds military base on the moon.

title: Isle Goblin
description: Build, explore, fight and rescue your goblin family from the human invaders in a sandbox survival adventure game. Play solo or with up to 7 friends as you rebuild your town, craft powerful gear, explore dungeons, mine rare resources, salvage human treasure, and befriend your goblin neighbours

title: Kowloon's Curse: Lost Report
description: Explore a surreal world inspired by Kowloon Walled city in this turn-based RPG inspired by Japanese games from the Dreamcast and PS1-era.

title: Hyde's Haunt & Seek
description: Spook or be spooked in this team-based party game. Set in a haunted manor, the mortal Seekers search for a Prized Possession, playing against a team of pranking poltergeists dead set on keeping it to themselves.

title: Exodus of Souls
description: Gather souls and unleash your wrath on your enemies!

title: Meanderer
description: Meanderer is a unique roguelite game set in a world of loss and rebirth. Embark on a pilgrimage with a young monk to make the Sun bright once more. Traverse the ruins of fallen empires, encounter strange endearing characters, and sacrifice your powers as you get closer to fulfilling your purpose.

title: The Witch of Fern Island
description: The Witch of Fern Island is a game about a young girl who wants to become a real witch. Immerse yourself in the history of the island and get to know its inhabitants. It's time to find your place in the world.

title: NecroCity
description: Welcome to NecroCity, a place that does not bustle with life. Take on the role of the governor of this dark city - manage your resources and develop your NecroCity. NecroCity is a city-building economic strategy game, with a defense and combat system. The world of the dead is just in front of you!

title: Mars Vice
description: Mars Vice is a narrative adventure game set on a distant and futuristic Mars. Follow two civil investigators, Dax and Anaya, as they root out deep-seated corruption in the Martian city of Pavonis in this biopunk-infused story.

title: Department of the Devil
description: You're trapped in hell for all eternity - at least, that's what the paperwork says. Can you escape by snooping around the private office of The Devil himself? Or will you get caught by his watchful eye?

title: Thyria
description: Thyria is a RPG, with turn-based combat and isometric 2D exploration, playing on time management mechanics. Summon and train a team of Guardians, who will accompany Thyria into the minds of the cursed villagers. Help them vanquish their nightmares.

title: Exodition
description: You won't survive this game. Let yourself pull into this atmospheric narrative focussed experience .. If you are ready.

title: Dreamout
description: Explore a surreal world filled with the strangest and most incredible events! You will never know what awaits you around the corner!

title: Avanzar
description: Avanzar is a fast-paced FPS Roguelike set in an ancient Aztecan temple. Overcome the guardians of the temple by stacking up synergistic weapon upgrades and mastering the advanced movement mechanics in order to reach the heart of the ever-changing temple.

title: Miuma
description: Miuma is a cozy game about a little, modest bakery with unexpected twists. The game features the significant feat of Kevin, the bakery’s new owner, and his venture within the middle of nowhere of which he calls his home.

title: Undead Horde 2: Necropolis
description: Become an Undead King and raise undead minions from the remains of your enemies. Command an undead army and rebuild the Necropolis after the vile attack by the living. Undead Horde 2 is an action game with elements from RPG, strategy and hack'n'slash.

title: Calme
description: This is Calme, a peaceful haven on a precipitous cliff. With a rod in your right hand and a dumpling on the other… This is an action-adventure exploration game set in the town on the cliff, which is more than just a "warm and cozy" place.

title: Destroyed Aperture
description: Aperture Science Experimental Facility #7 is empty. Following the failure of the central core, the complex has been consumed by overgrowth and decay. With the exits sealed, David Grayling is trapped, with no recollection of his past. Will he ever regain his memories and discover the truth?

title: Mimic Man
description: Mimic Man is a team based 5v5 multi-player tactical hybrid first/third person shooter. Team up with friends to defeat the opposing team in an ultimate battle of action and wits. Hunters must eliminate mimics quickly, but beware, for mimics will disguise, sabotage and taunt you to stay alive.

title: Kakuriyo
description: Kakuriyo is an online co-op horror game for 1-4 players. A vindictive ghost seeks a new victim. You and your team members need investigating the distorted world and purifying the curse.

title: Karvan
description: Karvan is a tactical roguelite game. A gigantic tree grew a few years ago, many are exploring it and exploiting the incredible resources that grow there, be the first to send a caravan all the way up, or die trying

title: Chaos Crown
description: An RPG Styled Roguelite set in fantasy procedural paths. Craft artifacts, slay legendary monsters and abuse synergies to fulfill the secret goal of your champion. Which one will you choose? We need your feedback before the official launch!

title: Star Strikers: Galactic Soccer
description: Star Strikers: Galactic Soccer is a beautiful hand-drawn arcade football game, with fast-paced action, unique playfields and crazy characters from all over the universe! Great in single-player, even better with friends.

title: Natural Spirit
description: Natural Spirit is a third-person adventure game where you will play as the shiba Yukito, to help the spirit Aura to save the tree of life from a certain death that would doom us all.

title: Copcore
description: Cop themed FPS with RPG elements. Become a police officer and fight against the bad guys. Upgrade your equipment and police station. Train your skills to become more efficient and strong at enforcing the law.

title: Elves Christmas Hentai Puzzle
description: A relaxing puzzle game full of beautiful art featuring Christmas-themed sexy elves!

title: Maptroid: Worlds
description: A metroidvania experienced entirely in the map! Explore and fill the map of several planets in this minimalistic and abstract metroidvania game, collect powerups to get to new places, and discover lore items to read. Have extra fun in the puzzletroid maps, or relax in zentroid.

title: OPG: Clan Wars
description: Clan Wars is a severe first-person shooter with survival elements in the open world and in some limited locations, primarily oriented on online multiplayer game, and with the presence of a cars and trucks.

title: Jett: The Far Shore - Given Time
description: Given Time is a brand new campaign for Jett: The Far Shore available for free on January 31st. This new campaign takes place 3 years after the events of the original campaign's ending. As Mei arises from torpor into a mostly hibernating Ground Control, there are new whispers from the wyld to seek out and unravel, this time, alone.

title: Lollipop: Summer!
description: Lollipop: Summer! is an exciting puzzle game with delicious, sweet candy combinations! In the game Lollipop: Summer! You will find many bright and varied visuals, very beautiful music and many achievements.

title: Turnip Mountain
description: In this hands-on climbing platformer, chart your own path as you reach, swing and soar to the summit!

title: Earth of Oryn
description: Earth of Oryn is an indie city-builder/strategy game set in a medieval world filled with story and heart. Starting from nothing, shape your kingdom according to your vision while managing the needs and wants of your people.

title: Cyber Noir Stories: The Trunk
description: An unique hybrid of a classic Point-And-Click Adventure and an interactive Visual Novel Combine the best of both worlds: explore your surroundings, solve tricky puzzles and influence the course of the story through your decisions and playstyle!

title: Division
description: Division is a sci-fi adventure game. The whole world became strange, the place we live seem to be falling apart. A girl named YI will embark on an incredible journey.

title: CityDriver
description: Explore the streets of Munich in CityDriver and experience driving like never before. Choose from a variety of realistic vehicles including electric cars, SUVs and sports cars. Test your driving skills in an authentic environment with landmarks and historic buildings, as well as AI vehicles and pedestrians. There are several kilometres of city streets, motorways and highways at your disposal, as well as various missions such as passenger transport or pick-up and delivery missions.

title: Escape the Dead
description: You awake inside of a cave in Starnex Island with your handgun and double barrel shotgun, ready to shoot anything that gets in your way of escaping the island of Starnex.

title: FallNation
description: FallNation is a free-roaming army based RPG adventure mixing a Worldmap stage and FPS battlefield with Real Time Tactics in the middle of an apocalyptic environment where the future depends on you.

title: Lair Land Story 2: Mist of Sea
description: After traveling far to the southern end of Lair Land, seven knights have reached Chainch Bay. Settled in a small tropical fishing village surrounded by ruins, they will spend the next few years building a new life here while facing the most challenging quest they will ever meet.

title: Feelings
description:
Feelings is a puzzle story-driven game that follows the adventures of Sarah, a young adult girl who lost her sense of self after years battling against anxiety and depression without seeking aid.

Sarah is trapped inside her mind and needs help of her younger self to face the challenges that her memories and feelings bring to her. A new light is shed upon old problems and relationships she lost along the way.

Will Sarah learn to seek help and let other people in to save her? Or will she be forever trapped inside her own mind?

title: Cardbob
description: Explore the sci-fi dungeons, collect loot, and negotiate the highest prices in this action roguelite, set in a 3D cardboard world. Grow stronger with each attempt. Be the unlikely hero.

title: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread
description: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread is an action-platformer fan game where you jump, spin, and fight through unknown lands to help Gura reunite with her lost bread!

title: City of Springs
description: Craft & modify your own robot drones to fight off a cruel regime in City of Springs, a steampunk adventure game. Use your drones in tactical combat against an army of drones. Sneak into forbidden areas, help the people rebel, and explore the streets of Riveton.

title: Dual Gunstrike
description: Dual Gunstrike is a 100-Mega Shock!/32-bit inspired horizontal shmup. Choose between 4 heroes and blast into space to stop a mysterious multi-dimensional creature from destroying humanity!

title: Mist Slayer
description: Mist Slayer is an action Roguelite game. You play as a time traveler with unique weapon and skills, fighting against different kinds of enemies in parallel universes, collecting various power-ups, and exploring the world. You can play with your friends, or on your own.

title: Humanities Legend: Dark Horizon
description: A segmented open world action-adventure game. Fight bosses, explore dungeons, and find magic abilities to push out the Dark form the land. Collect and level up to fight stronger enemies.

title: Gilded Eternal
description: Gilded Eternal is a replayable, run-based, action, arcade game about luring monsters and hoarding gold.

title: Dire Destiny: Time Travel
description: Dire Destiny: Time Travel is a deck building game set in a steampunk apocalypse.

title: Aurora Chronicles
description: Aurora Chronicles is a 2D side-scrolling survival action game where you play as a Demon Rogue Bounty Hunter named Aurora, you must survive against waves of enemies who are out to destroy and kill you, utilize your rogue skillset to see how long you can survive in the world of Orellia

title: Infinitevania
description: Explore different worlds, defeat enemies and challenging bosses, in search of power to destroy the core of infinitevania.

title: Battle Dawn 2: Terra Reborn
description: Place your colony, find an alliance of like-minded players and triumph over thousands of other players to conquer the world through strategy, tactics, diplomacy and skill in the biggest social-interaction based MMO of all time. Upgrade your colony, collect items for your Avatar and become a legend!

title: Animarama
description: Animarama - is a humorous interactive puzzle game in which you have to help the characters in the game solve their problems. To complete all the levels you will need the following skills: logic, physics, mathematics, humor and a little imagination. Will you be able to?

title: Escape the Mad Empire
description: Enjoy a unique kind of roguelike party-based tactical RPG that features real-time combat with actions on pause and management/base-building elements. Explore the various apocalypses caused by the Mad Empire. Will your next journey be a glorious victory or an epic failure?

title: Glyde the Dragon
description: Witness an epic story as Glyde and Wing set out on an adventure to find out the cause of mysterious corruption! Use 8 elemental forms with more than 60 different abilities! Explore the world, collect crystals, save other dragons and gain more insight into the story as you progress!

title: Forklift Flowerpot: Botanical Investigator
description: Change between three seasons on a strange archipelago to solve puzzles, quiet-quit your forklift job, and dismantle the potato-dominated shipping industry. When you're done exploring, kick back and play a deckbuilding card game in a wild attempt to dethrone your local Gods.

title: Long Dream
description: Zhao Sheng, a retired postman, has been suffering from dementia over the past years. He insists that his partner Qi Mei is waiting for him under a peach tree. Zhao Sheng’s family didn't want him to leave with any regrets and decided to go and find that peach tree he had been talking about...

title: Skator Gator 3D
description: Stop the mayor from polluting the swamp in this short, 3D adventure! Explore new open locales with skateboard in hand or while grinding on pipelines - Greenjamin's skating into the third dimension in Skator Gator 3D!

title: UFObia
description: UFOBIA is a cooperative horror game for 1 to 4 players who need to solve puzzles and face beings from another planet.

title: AHOD: All Hands on Deck!
description: Build the strongest sailing crew and defeat your opponents in AHOD: All Hands on Deck! This fast-paced deckbuilder game features exciting card gameplay, strategic deck composition, and a variety of powerful weapons and magical loot.

title: MatchR: Now Hiring
description: Fight with your colleagues to ascend through the MatchR company in this Match-3, RPG and Roguelike mix! Choose, upgrade and use your skills to emerge victorious! Gain new character traits during your runs which will drastically change the way you plan your matches! Also... Sticker collection!

title: Delivery Driver: The Simulation
description: You are a delivery driver, your primary job duties include ensuring successful transfer and delivery of goods to intended destinations.

title: Cat Cafe Simulator
description: Build and manage the cat café of your dreams! Find new forever-homes for abandoned cats, and serve food to customers to earn money for expanding and decorating your café!

title: Death of the Reprobate
description: Explore a world built from the luscious landscapes, turbulent townscapes and preposterous portraits of real Renaissance paintings. Death of the Reprobate is a Rabelaisian adventure game from the creator of Four Last Things and The Procession to Calvary.

title: Evergreen: Mountain Life Simulator
description: Evergreen is a simulation game about leaving the stress of the city behind and starting a new life in a mountain valley.

title: NEG: The Threefold Cord
description: Join NEG and Buddy on their journey to return the stolen scrolls and save their village. In this precision platformer you will face many daring challenges. Overcome the challenges and defeat all the bosses to fix The Threefold Cord.

title: Ten Dates
description:
Ten Dates is the sequel to the interactive rom-com, Five Dates. Misha, a millennial from London in search of that elusive in-person connection, tricks her best friend Ryan into going to a speed dating event with her. Each with their own five potential matches, Misha and Ryan must pluck up the courage and turn on the charm to date wildly different personalities.

Throughout the game, your choices and interactions will either strengthen or weaken your relationship with your date. Amidst a branching, multi-directional chain of conversation topics and deep-dive questions, Misha and Ryan are faced with ice-breaker games, awkward scenarios and unexpected truths. Will either find love?

title: Brichi Quest
description: Brichi Quest - adventure roguelite. Gameplay is a mix of Dont Starve and Zelda in lowpoly style. Explore randomly generated islands and dungeons in search of special items. Build your character set and fight the final boss.

title: KiNoKoe: Tree's Voice
description: You play as Hiro, a young Japanese man whose life is filled with a boring job. One evening, you see a strange light in the park’s trees near your home. You walk to the oldest tree and discover strange symbols on a piece of bark...

title: Guardians of Gaia
description: Guardians of Gaia is a team-based PvP Arena Brawler. Control the battleground using intuitive third person melee combat. Choose from a cast of powerful Guardians and join exhilarating battles.

title: Calamity Creatures
description: Calamity Creatures is a 2D action game in boss rush format. Mechanical creatures of overwhelming stature stand before you. Gadgets in the prosthetic hands, the terrain, and the enemies' habits...use all the elements to dismantle the living calamity.

title: These Doomed Isles
description: Inspired by classic god games, survival city-builders and roguelike deck-builders, in These Doomed Isles you'll craft your deck of cards to raise islands from the sea, build settlements for your followers and keep them alive as famine threatens, forests burn and raiders loom on the horizon.

title: Garage Flipper
description: Garage Flipper is a game where you get to be a builder and renovator of garages and car repair shops. Your task is to complete jobs and build up your empire by buying and restoring old facilities. Grab your hammer, your mortar, and get to work!

title: Go Nutz
description: Bounce through forests delivering nutz to fellow squirrels as you tail-slap and gun down swarms of insects and woodland creatures. Discover what's disrupting the usual balance of nature.

title: Roguematch: The Extraplanar Invasion
description: Roguematch is a Fantasy Turn based Rogue-like fused into a Match-3 layout, giving players many more ways to get out of challenging situations! With so much raw elemental magic at your command, theres even more to do than just smack and bash your way through creatures from the extraplanar realms!

title: Another Dungeon Game
description: Battle your way through this 2D Action RPG Dungeon Crawler with over-the-top skills, extensive passive trees, and all the randomized loot you can carry! Another Dungeon Game has been designed with casual players in mind, making it quick and easy to dive right in and start slaying from level 1.

title: Far From Dead
description: A twitchy shoot 'em up boss rush game inspired by run 'n gun classics. Fight your way through seven challenging bosses and hitch a ride off this awful planet.

title: Goblin Rules Football
description: Test your mettle on the goblin gridiron in Goblin Rules Football! Withstand the ferocious punches and blows of your opponent to actually touch the ball down to score a touchdown! Only one team can win, unless the score ends in a tie!

title: Axon Hero
description: Help factories with their logistical problems. Creative puzzles!

title: Galactoids: Galactic Invaders
description: Battle swarms of Galactic Invaders in this action-packed retro-inspired arcade shoot em up. May the Nerd be with you.

title: Kallax
description: Kallax is a chaotic furniture-building coop game in which only one player can read the instruction manual. Experience what should have been a one person's job and lose friendships forever.

title: Combat Complex
description: Combat Complex is a fast-paced sci-fi action RPG. You are alone against hordes of enemies. Wield legendary weapons, level up your stats, unlock devastating talents and abilities. Think quick, move fast, outsmart your enemies!

title: Domains of Dusk
description: Supernatural factions clash over dominance of the city, control exerted from boardrooms and ritual circles, but also reclaimed on the streets and in the underground. Play a new story every game as you lead new factions, new characters and overcome new supernatural challenges. Take the city!

title: Heart of Crown Online
description: The great emperor's untimely death... Seven princesses are candidates for his succession! Who will save the empire from chaos? An online deck-growing card game where you grow your deck and fight for the Princess.

title: A Quest That Became Legend
description: A Quest That Became Legend is a game inspired by old school RPG classics, with turn based combat and an open world environment. Set out on an epic quest to defeat the dark conjurers and save your world from destruction.

title: Dungeon Dreams 2
description: Roguelike Romance JRPG. Create your character and get a room at the Magic Academy dormitory, to win the Challenge of the Infinite Dungeon! A game with town building, relationships, and many quests with alternate routes.

title: RPG Town
description:
RPG Town is a lighthearted management sim where you run a small fantasy-game town, converting local businesses to serve rowdy adventurers!

These adventurers are looking for typical RPG stuff - shops to stock up before the next big dungeon, an Inn to rest at or maybe grab a pint... but as time passes, they get impatient... Your grandmother's beautiful earthen-ware vase? They'll smash it. They'll ransack your house for pocket change. They'll drive everybody in town nuts. So what are you gonna do about it?

title: Robocraft 2
description: The sequel to the hit robot building PVP combat game, played by over 16 million players. Robocraft 2 is the ultimate battlefield for player-created content. Build your Robot from scratch, test drive it, and then bring it online to fight against others in epic combat!

title: Disco Tomb
description: Disco Tomb is a sci-fi retro FPS / boomer shooter made just like the good ol' days! Use magic spells and guns to fight your way through huge waves of enemies in freaky dungeons or out in the open desert against the hordes of the invaders! Oblivion awaits!

title: Ms Jenkins Estate
description: Mrs Jenkins Estate - This is a first-person psychological horror game. An old mansion has some blood-curdling secrets, which have been kept for too long…Bursting out, the secrets plunge you into the whirlpool of chilling horror: a constant sense of another presence, dark and scary atmosphere.

title: Star in the Hollow
description: A young girl who finds herself alone in a massive cave with no memory of how she arrived there. Aided by a mysterious talking bird, she must find her way out of the cave, and hopefully, return to a family that she can’t even remember.

title: Boom Shocketa: Rocket Storm
description: Boom Shocketa: Rocket Storm brings true 6DoF (six degrees of freedom) rocket racing to your PC. Blast faster than ever before in a game designed for those who are never satisfied with their record times.

title: Road to Vostok
description: Road to Vostok is a hardcore single-player survival game set in a post-apocalyptic border zone between Finland and Russia. Survive, loot, plan and prepare your way across the Border Zone and enter the Vostok.

title: Star Exodus
description: Be ready to wander around the endless space, where you have to fight for resources, manage them and take care of your crew. Star Exodus will take you on a journey through barren space and put your survival skills to the test!

title: Allakin
description: Help Allakin find his way back home and defeat the dark force in many varied levels

title: Star Sign
description: Climb to the sky while collecting stars. No matter how many times you fall, don't give up.

title: Steel Wound
description: A fast-paced and violent action game with light rpg-elements, inspired by an old Amiga classic. Fight monsters inspired by Japanese folklore, earn experience and money, upgrade your character, and take on more challenges. Play solo, or with up to four players in hotseat or online.

title: For the King II
description: Battle against Fahrul's tyrannical Queen alone or as a party of 4 players in the sequel to For The King, the massively popular turn-based roguelike tabletop RPG. Level up and explore as you unravel the once beloved Queen's terrible secret.

title: The Spirit Lift
description: The Spirit Lift is a deck-building rogue-like horror adventure in a haunted hotel. Ascend 13 floors in a ghostly elevator. Use equipment cards to battle monsters. Make it to the villain at the top… or die trying!

title: Mistrogue: Mist and the Living Dungeons
description: Mistrogue is a strategic roguelike action game that combines "traditional roguelike" and "skill building" gameplay concepts. Your goal is to explore dungeons and create the optimum build with the limited resources you find. Use your creativity to create powerful builds no one has found!

title: Through the Abyss
description: Join the protagonist in his adventure through a mysterious place called the Abyss. Explore unique and tough environments with hundreds of hand crafted levels!

title: Hellvivors
description: Hellvivors is a survival roguelike inspired by Binding of Isaac and Vampire Survivors. Face hordes of hellish creatures, level up, choose cards and make crazy broken builds to survive this hell.

title: Titan Station
description: Far into the future, in the year 1999: David, a systems operator, runs from his troubles by taking a job on a space station. After arriving, his mundane work turns into a struggle for his very life as he makes a shocking discovery.

title: Lunars
description: Gather your friends for the zodiac party game where chaos meets competition! Up to 4 local and 8 online players can customize characters, conquer mini-games, and outsmart rivals with items and power-ups. With 3 game modes—including one where everyone plays at the same time—it’s non-stop fun!

title: Build and Discover: America
description: Build and Discover: America is a mixture of real-time strategy game genres combined with a country building simulation and strong economic elements, all based on the history of the USA.

title: Immortal: And the Death that Follows
description: Develop your own unique fighting style, form your own gang and fight your inner demon while trying to escape an interdimensional prison for demigods. Immortal is a rogue-like side-scrolling beat-em-up inspired by fighting games and 90s anime.

title: Gem Venture
description: Jump, dash, and mine your way through obstacles and enemies in this platforming tribute to the classics! Restore the Sacred Gems of Aventurine, or else it will become a land of nothingness.

title: Hollowmoor
description: Grow crops, brew potions and search for mystical creatures in this cozy magic life sim. As a budding Witch or Wizard you’ll also befriend and date the townsfolk as you bring magic back to the town of Hollowmoor!

title: Kaiju Catastrophe
description: Crush, smash, and eat thousands of enemies showing humanity what the meaning of destruction is! Kaiju Catastrophe is an arcade game with roguelite mechanics. Mutate devastating weapons, unlock permanent evolutions, and wreak havoc with a variety of monsters to tear humanity apart! Wishlist today!

title: A Star of Chrome
description: A top down Action-Adventure inspired by 16bit and 8bit handheld games. Explore the Martian frontier, while searching for your lost dog and uncover the mysterious cause of a day that never ends.

title: Termina
description: Termina is an intense, adrenaline-fueled, survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. Dive into the heart-pounding action of endless waves of the undead, scavenging for power-ups, unlocking powerful weapons, and battling through hordes of relentless zombies until your last breath.

title: Enoch
description: Step into the world of Enoch: Children of Fate, a sci-fi noir point-and-click adventure set in 2279. Take command of multiple characters with connected storylines as they seek the truth behind the mysteries of Enoch Space Station.

title: Bitter
description: This game is a vibrant puzzle game that combines upbeat background music with a simple yet engaging gameplay mechanism.

title: Builders of Greece
description: Immerse yourself in the beautifully recreated golden age of Hellenic city-states. Builders of Greece is a city management game that lets you display your strategic and economic mastery. Build your Polis from scratch, make meaningful decisions, trade, fight and expand to become the ultimate ruler.

title: Creatures of War
description: Embark on a survival horror saga set in a treacherous world ruled by primal terrors. Scour for invaluable treasures, fortify your arsenal to combat evolving threats, and unravel the chilling mystery shrouding Delta squad's fate. Can you survive amidst the lurking jaws of the ancient predators?

title: Seekers Aeterna
description: After a mysterious global cataclysm, the last few surviving humans wake up in the disconnected remains of a foreign gothic fantasy world. Take part in epic battles, befriend a colorful cast of characters and explore an interconnected Vania-Like world.

title: Delilah
description: Eastern Europe is the newest Circle of Hell, but outside its walls things aren't much better. Relentless action, pixelated gore, 256 colors. That is Delilah.

title: Jawbreaker
description: Let’s play hide-and-seek with serial killers. Jawbreaker is a psychological horror game that will have you running, hiding, and fighting to survive a terrifying gang-infested society on the verge of collapse. Though that’s not all, once the sun goes down the true fear will begin...

title: Colossal Citadels
description: A fantasy strategy, featuring turn-based factory building over procedural resource types. Expand and optimize your network of towns, grow your heroes, and excel in deep tactical seamless auto-battler combat.

title: Ultra Mega Cats
description: Ultra Mega Cats is a high-paced roguelike cooperative third-person shooter. As a player, you control one of the Mega Cats, armed to the fangs, escaping their corporate prison.

title: Cell Scientist: Beyond
description: An exciting puzzle game with 50 levels story mode and easy to pick gameplay mechanics. Embark on an adventure to destroy viruses using futuristics nano ships and help the patients. Save the day using your puzzle-solving skills!

title: Avopug Show
description: "Avopug Show" is an arcade racing game that not only challenges the traditional rules of the genre but also dynamically changes its settings during the race. From celestial realms to vintage 1930s animation styles.

title: Pirate Dragons
description: Play a dragon in this third-person, action RPG! During the time of sailing ships and piracy, you are a dragon. Grow your hoard by joining a faction, trading goods, or becoming a pirate!

title: Malware Rewritten
description: A game where you play as a virus, and your goal is to destroy the computer from the inside.

title: Spiritus Astrum
description: Spiritus Astrum is a persistent, open-world roleplaying sandbox with multiplayer support. It features an infinite, procedurally generated universe which players are free to explore without restriction. Spiritus Astrum is more than a game, it is a world.

title: Lazerball
description: 2-8 player brawler! Whack an electric dodgeball into your opponents! Jump, dodge, counter, curve & slam your way to victory! Play in teams or solo and become the Lazerball champion!

title: Chickenoidz Super Party
description: Chickenoidz Super Party - multiplayer top-down arena shooter for up to 4 players. You can play local or altogether online via Remote Play. Steal the show using an array of incredible weapons, special equipment and even mutations. Smash your opponents to smithereens, rip everything around you.

title: Bura: The Way the Wind Blows
description: Explore the beautiful Adriatic coast, live as part of a small community and roam among the spirits of Mediterranean old-folk tales. Level up your character and make meaningful choices as the legends you're told come to life. Every decision is important, truth or lie, it is on you to decide.

title: The InBetween
description: The InBetween is a 2D, action-packed yet emotional Undertale-Metroidvania in which your fate, as well as the fate of an infected world, lies in your skills and choices.

title: Sektori
description: Sektori is an intense, fast paced twin-stick shooter where every run is unique. Choose your upgrades carefully and create powerful builds to take on numerous enemies and epic bosses on a constantly evolving battlefield.

title: Future Reality: Racing League
description: Race high speed bio-refuse shells through a dark future ruled by omni-corps and overrun with fleshy abominations. Racing Horror from Future Reality Softworks.

title: Galaxi Taxi
description: Galaxi Taxi is a hybrid of Story-Driven Action-Adventure, Shoot’em and Boss Fight, and you’re a taxi crew in the classy 90s animation art style. Drive your taxi and discover the depths of a rural outer space, a muddy milky way, a cosmic dust flooding the taxi and an ubiquitous smog.

title: Karl Marx and the Ring of Communism
description: Workers of the world, unite! You have nothing to loose, but, like, less than two dollars. - Karl Marx... would probably say about this challenging platformer. Play as the great thinker, overcome capitalism and return the world to the one righteous state of universal, common, great and equal poverty.

title: Kasaba
description: "Kasaba" is a life simulation game set in the medieval period. You can work in various jobs, specialize in them, trade, marry and get rich in different ways. The possibilities are endless in a procedurally generated limitless world.

title: Lucky Heroes
description: Find A single card which leads you to the victory. Lucky Heroes is a very simple and easy card game. Explore and manipulate decks with 20 unique characters.

title: Match Village
description: Match Village is a minimalist strategy game about match buildings to create villages on colorful islands.

title: Prescience
description: Unlike other single player deckbuilder, you are going to fill a bag with black and white stones. Wether you can use your skills depends on the order you pick the stones. Build a unique combo, defeat powerful enemies, and don't forget to use your Prescience!

title: Coffeehouse
description: Have you ever dreamed of owning a small place where you can sell coffee, tea, and cake to your lovely customers? Coffeehouse is exactly that! Take care of customer orders, make coffee, resolve customers problems and lose yourself in this first-person management game!

title: Capes
description: Superheroes clash in this turn based strategy game. Recruit, train, and deploy your team in order to take back the city from the villains that hold it hostage.

title: Portobugia
description: Portobugia is a management/survival game where you manage a port and you must supply a city with goods and food. To do so you must unload boats, but, be careful, some of them could be infected!

title: Louny Balloony
description: Fly through the exciting skies in this unique side-scrolling platformer! Collect balloons and feathers to gain the ability of flight as you navigate dazzling landscapes and face off against surprising obstacles and enemies during your aerial journey across the world!

title: Archery Simulator
description: Take your bow and start the adventure to reveal the big secret!

title: Holo Arena: Death League
description: Holo Arena: Death League takes the ancient gladiator fights to be the main sport of the future, in an intense MOBA TPS battle.

title: I Am Die
description: I Am Die is a physics-based 3D puzzle platformer in which you play as the dice itself, guiding a ball through ramps, tubes, conveyors, and other obstacles. Explore, solve problems, and try not to roll a six!

title: Gatedelvers
description: Gatedelvers is a dungeon-crawling roguelite. Fight, sneak, cast and jump your way through hostile worlds, alone or with friends. Make use of everything you find and upgrade your gear to your liking. Discover the lost worlds beyond the Gates.

title: The Bakerville Case
description: Get ready for a first-person horror, adventure and survival experience, enter the darkness and enjoy incredible graphics generated in real time with the Unity engine. Play as Thomas Baker and explore Bakerville to discover the terrible evil that resides there.

title: Netcorter: City 2179
description: Netcorter: City 2179 is a sci-fi storytelling third-person shooter(TPS) with a cyberpunk aesthetic and Bullet Hell and Roguelite elements. You would become a Netcorter (S-class hacker) and dive into a chain of events that followed the disaster in 2178.

title: Titanium Hound
description: Titanium Hound is retro-looking video game in cyberpunk genre, where you are going to pilot huge and agile exoskeleton to crush hordes of crazed security drones and abominations to uncover conspiracy carefully crafted by one of global corporations.

title: Mile High Taxi
description: Deliver Zany Passengers While Dodging Mile-High Skyscrapers & Blabbermouth Pedestrians.

title: Crocodile Transformator
description: Crocodile Transformator is an action game where your mission is to defend your city by destroying the enemies.Now is your time to help civilization to live in peace.

title: Pixiescape
description: Each match, players will play as fairy & robot. Fairies must survive as long as possible. Robots capture fairies as quickly as possible. Both teams will have unique abilities at their disposal. Once all fairies are captured, the players will switch roles. The team with the best survival time wins.

title: Big Hops
description: Big Hops is a fresh and froggy action-platformer focused on deep movement and emergent gameplay! Use parkour and your tongue to explore 8 huge, colorful worlds full of charming animal friends. Discover a huge range of surprising, playful interactions with gadgets and veggies!

title: Terminal Breach
description: Terminal Breach is an action rogue-lite twin stick shooter where you gun down countless waves of creatures, choose upgrades to create powerful and unique synergies and unlock a variety of characters, weapons and levels.

title: Skala
description: Skala is a puzzle game about changing the scale of the world.

title: It Sleeps Below the Haar
description: A short exploration game, set in a secluded coastal village in North East Scotland. Explore Kellas Bay and it's surrounding forests, caves and ocean to uncover what lies beneath the fog-covered village.

title: Pizza Kidd
description: Kidd Games presents: an all new, stylish, combat driven 2-D beat-em-up set in a dark sci-fantasy world - featuring uniquely drawn 16-bit pixel art with an aesthetic heavily inspired by 90's anime, graphic novels, and quarter munching arcade brawlers.

title: From Hell
description: From Hell is a third-person action survival horror. Explore an ancient manor in the late 1960s, fight ghouls and all kinds of monsters from the mythical underworld. Survive, craft items, solve puzzles and unlock secrets in the hunt for secret of your missing old friend.

title: Randomish
description: Simple Arcade style challenging Multiplayer games

title: ClayTown Horror
description: Well, welcome to ClayTown Horror. This here is a single-player horror game with a focus on story, and puzzles. You can expect an strange art style and chilling atmosphere, as well as intriguing riddles and puzzles throughout. Be sure to keep a eye out; you may find something we haven't.

title: The Axis Unseen
description: The Axis Unseen is a heavy metal horror game created by one of the developers of Skyrim, Starfield and Fallout. Hunt nightmarish monsters from ancient folklore in a mysterious open world, collecting their enhanced sense powers and discovering elemental arrows.

title: Tobor
description: Tobor is a spy simulator game where your mission is to observe an insane world using a surveillance camera. You have 7 days to gather intelligence and investigate the tragic story of Undercroft.

title: Future Mirror
description: "Ten years from now, I will be dead..." A coming-of-age fantasy adventure tale, Future Mirror is a visual novel that explores fate and the choices that affect our future, tragedy, relationships, and happiness.

title: Axial Disc 2
description: The long awaited sequel to Axial Disc 1!

title: Sinned
description: Sinned is a fast-paced retro FPS game situated within the darkest depths of hell where you will fight demonic legions and Pandemonius, Lord of Hell himself!

title: Cryogenesis
description: An exploration, mystery and science fiction game in which you must discover who you are and why you woke up in the future where the human race has apparently become extinct. Solve puzzles, use firearms and properly manage your inventory for your survival.

title: Mothership
description: A space map

title: Dodge the Missionaries
description: How long can you run from God?!

title: Peregrine
description: After escaping from an inevitable death you have been chosen to wield the Desolation Blade. While wielding it you can bring justice to those who brought death and destruction to earth and enslaved mankind.

title: Planet Barren Objective
description: Fight, upgrade, explore and build your way out off this dangerous planet in this 2D, pixel art side scroller. Stream of foes will keep you on your toes while beating them will reward you with much needed resources.

title: Roll on Dice
description: Roll On Dice is a puzzle game where you have to roll on other dices! Learn your own dice, to determine if your top face number will be superior or equal to the one that you are rolling on, otherwise you will break your own…

title: CyberBlocker: Complete Edition
description: It is a block breaker with a gauge type power-up system. The player's ship can always fire a shot, which, combined with the power-up system, makes it an aggressive block breaker. The difficulty level can be adjusted depending on the ship, so it can be enjoyed by both beginners and experts.

title: Astro
description: Astro is a zero-gravity multiplayer FPS set in a near-future sci-fi universe. In this arena shooter, players master fluid, high-skill movement using high powered 6DOF thrusters, magnets to walk and slide on surfaces, grappling hooks, and more. Each weapon is crafted to have a unique playstyle with special abilities and movement tech. Experience fast-paced fun in the exhilarating frontier of zero gravity.

title: NeonCyber.exe
description: NeonCyber.exe is a 3D parkour platform game. Complete levels in the shortest time possible and score points to earn coins. You can use them to buy skills, upgrades and skins for your character.

title: ASMR Food Experience
description: If you are looking for tones that will put you in an amazing mood, you've come to the right place! In ASMR Food Experience, we have connected the game with the tones of the world around us. Open, manage and listen to your own restaurant!

title: Enthrean Radiance: The First Strike
description: Enthrean Radiance: The First Strike is a 2D action-RPG that invokes the feeling of classic Japanese games. Help Millia and Razh to save the world of Enthrean from chaos!

title: Candy Bar
description: Candy bar is a dating simulator with a set of mini-games. You ended up in a new city thanks to a candy store inherited from a wealthy relative. Meet the locals, invite them to your new store and treat them to candies.

title: Oxu
description: Minimalistic 3d puzzle with portals, cubes and lasers.

title: TinyAttack
description: Tiny Attack is an action roguelite game. Fight against hordes of enemies in procedurally-generated levels with distinctive themes. Loot items, defeat bosses in uniquely designed fights, and survive until you find the truth.

title: Picayune Dreams
description: Adrift across the void, you must fend off thousands of nightmarish and otherworldly creatures. You're never at rest, as you weave between horde survival and bullet hell gameplay. Test new builds, and improve through roguelite meta progression. And don't forget. You mu [Transmission Interrupted...]

title: Tales of Terror
description: Tales of Terror is a co-op or PvP horror survival game. Work together to survive, Use a variety of items, solve the mystery and escape… if you can! Or play as the monster and stop the gang from escaping!

title: Shoot to Kill
description: Shoot To Kill is a single player retro-FPS inspired by the violence and pace of shooters of the past. Take on hordes of soldiers and experiments created by an authoritarian military group in the dystopian future of 2140.

title: Alienate!: A Trivia Game
description: Alienate! is a social deduction trivia game for 2 to 12 players. Each player is either an Alien competing to win the big showcase (Planet Earth) on a Space Game Show - or an Earthling, who infiltrated the game show in an effort to save their planet. Over 200 trivia questions with

title: Rock Paper Scissors Ultimate
description: Rock Paper Scissors Ultimate is a roguelike deckbuilder where the players can enhance the classic gameplay with powerful cards to gain an advantage over their opponents.

title: Desordre: A Puzzle Game Adventure
description: Desordre is a first-person puzzle game, inspired by the Portal series, in which you solve each puzzle by traveling through two timelines the same room. You have at your disposal a portal gun and the ability to slow down time.

title: House Builder VR
description: Travel around the world and through the ages to build iconic designs! Beware unpleasant temperatures and dangerous fauna! Now in VR to fully immerse in the adventure...

title: Simulsaga: Data_Break
description: Simulsaga: Data_Break is a darkly humorous RPG, inspired by games like Earthbound, Undertale and LISA: The Painful. You play as an office drone who lives a seemingly ordinary life, but something isn't right... A mysterious stranger will soon set into motion a series of events that gradually reveal the horrifying truth...

title: Mortal Crux
description: Mortal Crux is an action RPG set in a sprawling medieval world. Alone or with a party up to 4 players, venture from the warmth of your cozy cottage and explore a mysterious frozen land. Take on quests, meet eccentric characters, and survive brutal combat in this homage to ARPGs of the early 2000s.

title: Barbarian
description: Soulslike-inspired open-world survival RPG for 1-10 players. Master fluid combat with precise parries and dodges, defeat epic bosses, craft & upgrade gear, build your base, and share items with friends. Your progression persists across every world — play solo or with friends.

title: Fit Puzzle Blocks
description: Solve a lot of puzzles in Fit Block Puzzle. Try to fit all the different shaped blocks on the grid.

title: More Enemies
description: Put on your ass-kicking socks and get ready to have them promptly blown off in this indie monster-killing-bad-guy-fleeing-vent-crawling-chair-wielding shooter!

title: Total Factory
description: You are a robot with unrealistically advanced artificial intelligence on a previously unknown planet, people created you for one single purpose - to ensure the automatic production of the necessary resources and their dispatch. It would seem that what could go wrong?

title: As Above So Below
description: As Above So Below is a Survival Horror Open World Action/RPG. You play as a recent college graduate offered a job in a small town, but upon arrival things are not what they seem. Face a series of unexplained events that unravel history, and ultimately change the future. Explore, Fight, Survive.

title: Emancipator Go!
description: Go free your besieged home planet... all by yourself! Emancipator Go! is a survival game with roguelite elements.

title: Trouble Juice
description: Trouble Juice is a Side Scrolling Shooter Roguelike set in a TV show tournament that is broadcasted across the universe. Use your character's special abilities, and unlock prizes in the Achievement Bingo. Become the ultimate champion and earn your place in the galaxy's hall of fame!

title: Gooper
description: Gooper is a challenging 2D puzzle game. Work your way through 200 levels with escalating difficulty and mechanics.

title: Baldy Bounce
description: Baldy Bounce is a 3D platforming adventure game with collectables, mini-games, character customisation, and much more.

title: Dad's Dice: History of Legends
description: Once, a DnD session went out of control. The kids found themselves in a magical world of tabletop adventures. It's time for Dad to step into the game! Become a hero, roll the dice, and save the children from the clutches of the tabletop monsters. Every roll shapes your destiny!

title: The Levels of Backrooms
description: Explore, discover, and document the dark, liminal reality known as the Backrooms, experiencing dread and isolation as you navigate it. We wish you luck in your travels.

title: Just A Guy
description: Just A Guy is a fun and colorful platform game entirely based on physics with ragdoll characters, playable on your own or with a friend in splitscreen.

title: Project Unseek
description: Project Unseek is a 2v6 class-based asymmetrical online multiplayer horror game inspired by 80s slasher horror movies, SCP urban legend, and Science Fiction, where you compete against each other to survive the experiment as High Schoolers or Mythical Creatures.

title: Learning Geography: Countries of the World
description: Learn or test your knowledge of 176 countries across the world. There are two separate game modes: an easier mode multiple choice to get started with and then a second mode where you have to type the names in.

title: Into Evil
description: In this modernized take on old-school roguelikes! Explore a vast megadungeon where death lurks around every corner! Battle nightmarish foes in frenetic real time combat! Brand yourself with the souls of fallen heroes!

title: Dragon Island
description: Henry Heimlich, a shark dragon lifesaver suddenly received a ticket to Dragon Island, the famous resort. Follow Henry to the island, and create some unique memory on the long shore with 6 other dragons!

title: Guns N' Rushes
description: Aboard your ship, shoot monsters and build defenses to withstand waves of thousands. Collect experience and upgrade your weapons. Guns N' Rushes is a sci-fi atmosphere game that mixes tower defense and RPG elements.

title: Apex Point
description: Apex Point has been in development since 2018 by a group of friends that aim to create a car enthusiast's dream game. It is an open world game that aims to immerge you into the Japanese car culture by providing a huge variety of customizations and race types so you can choose your own path

title: Grey Eminence
description: Spanning from 1356 to 1956, steer the fate of any country on Earth through six epic centuries of conflict. Diplomacy, economics, warfare and intrigue are all weapons in your arsenal to transform the world that was into the world that could be.

title: Flip TD: Tower Defense
description: Flip Tower Defense on it's head in Flip TD. Flip your world upside down to defend with towers, upgrades, modifiers, powers, and more. Build custom worlds with the in-game world builder and share them online to compete for high scores in the community leaderboards.

title: Lovers Anonymous: Rehab for Romantics
description: Be gay, do crime, and go to therapy!

title: Funny Pizza Land 2
description: Uncover the truth behind the legend of Pizzaland and save the dark comedy world of this funny point & click adventure.

title: Amazing Maze
description: Amazing Maze is a minimalistic "roll a ball" game where you have to capture all the crystals and find the way out in beautiful 3D mazes. Use your creativity and logical thinking to overcome obstacles or use them to your advantage.

title: DUCK: Dangerous Ultimate Cartridge Kidnapper
description: A group of ducklings finds a mysterious 100-in-1 cartridge and are now forced to play all the games to escape the insidious cartridge spirit!

title: Asteroids and more asteroids
description: A shooter based on the classic "Asteroids", but here you'll have to show your coordination using the right color on the right enemy, will your record enter the best of online rankings?

title: Mobius Band
description: Mobius band is a novella visual novel game. In such an era, everyone is powerless to care for others. Under the skin of prosperous civilization, it is a veritable hell. In the war that has not yet subsided, how will they choose in the end.

title: Kargo: A neo-noir adventure
description: Be a heist driver, smuggle drugs, avoid police, gamble at illegal fight club, meet disgusting people and look for a lost cargo in the middle of nowhere in an open-world neo-noir adventure that tells a story of two thugs working for an Eastern European crime syndicate. The night roads of Kargo await.

title: The Tower of Luminus
description: After a horrible accident, Benjamin’s only company is his battered teddy bear. Together, you must find your way to safety, while solving puzzles and evading those that hide in the dark. Find ways to repair your bear to unlock its full potential, and discover new ways it can help you on your journey.

title: The Eternal Fool
description: A poetic adventure game about nostalgia, the death of faith, and the relentless feeling of Toska.

title: Melody's Escape 2
description: Run to the rhythm of your own music library! Melody is back, with vastly improved audio analysis algorithms! Each mp3 creates a unique obstacle course synchronized to the beat of the music. Melody's actions will match the energy and intensity of any music of your choice!

title: Hedgehot: Battle Strike
description: Turn-based strategy card game where you use different creatures and spells to defeat your enemies.

title: Co Operation: MultiTurn
description: The people in charge have defunded hospitals so you decide to help. With your squad of volunteer medics, plan your tactics, schedule actions and optimize the team strategy to heal as many patients as possible. 1-8 players, only the host needs to have the game installed. Modding support integrated.

title: Kingdom of Nyabur: The Shattered Realm
description:
The Kingdom of Nyabur, once prosperous and peaceful, is now a shadow of its former self. The dark sorcerer Adomor has plunged the kingdom into chaos, overthrowing the royal dynasty. Arvin, the former Prince of Nyabur, must now gather allies, overcome formidable trials, and embark on a heroic quest to reclaim his throne and restore his homeland to its former glory.
Gather the elemental stones, challenge Adomor and become the new King of Nyabur!

title: Bunker Builder Simulator
description: Plan your work, dig a hole and build a bunker, that will survive anything! Manage safety, needs and moods of your clients, so you can become the best architect and earn a fortune. Will you be able to meet the expectations?

title: Tower Walker: MMO Grind Simulator
description: Tower Walker is a fresh new addictive auto-grinder rich with features, inspired by classic MMORPGS and RTS games with indirect control over your hero. The mysterious tower awaits!

title: Metal Suits: Counter-Attack
description: They should never have ticked him off. Begin a hot-blooded revenge as the protagonist Kevin, who has lost everything and was reborn as a cyborg!

title: Masterchef Cakes Edition
description: Your mission is to cook the best cookies in town!

title: Ball Game Remix
description: ball game remix is a video game that you can play

title: Riffle Effect
description: Riffle Effect is a hardcore TPS adventure game with cartoon graphics applied. Shoot the enemy, avoid the bullets, and knock down the giant alien to save your friend Rose!

title: Fractium
description: A ruthless looting & shooting survival rogue-like FPS for 1-4 players, set in a procedurally-generated world. Slay hordes, bandits, and bosses. Setup traps, research, craft, and upgrade gear across multiple biomes in order to stay alive.

title: Hell's New World
description: Enter hell and experience blood and torment the way God intended. Use shotguns, rocket launchers, and more to spread the joy of suffering to your friends and loved ones.

title: Crash Effects Inc.
description: Crash Effects Inc. a pioneering vehicle research and development center needs your help! Take the seat of a crash test engineer & build your own vehicle creations. Stage accidents to push your design to its limits! Watch as the carnage unfolds in a realistic crash test simulation you control!

title: Battle Sage
description: BattleSage is a 3rd person single player Flight Action Adventure game. An adventure set in a vertical world filled with floating villages, towns and temples Along the way, you will meet friends and enemies and puzzles will challenge you to gain more mastery of your flying skills.

title: Sea Power: Naval Combat in the Missile Age
description: From the lead designer of Cold Waters, Sea Power lets you control NATO and Warsaw Pact forces in modern naval conflict campaigns. Use your advanced naval weaponry and sensors to respect rules of engagement and defeat the enemy forces in a tense fight for initiative and air/naval supremacy.

title: Dolmenjord
description: Arrange the Viking villages in the islands to expand their domains. After many years of battles, a group of Vikings decided it was time to conquer new lands. With the protection of the god Njord, a new clan specialized in navigation sets off in search of glory!

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 18
description: PUBG: Battlegrounds players can expect some exciting changes, including the return of the original Sanhok map to Team Deathmatch Mode.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege: Operation Vector Glare
description: Divert enemy attention and gain the upper hand with Sens, the new Operator from the Belgian Special Forces Group. Sens comes equipped with the brand-new POF9 assault rifle and the R.O.U. Projector System ability, allowing them to break line of sight and turn the tide of battle. Operation Vector Glare also introduces the Shooting Range and a new Team Deathmatch map set in Greece, offering fresh venues to hone your skills and put them to the test.

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege: Operation Brutal Swarm
description: Operation Brutal Swarm clears the way for our new Singaporean Attacker: Grim. Discover his gadget, the Kawan Hive Launcher: with no reload and a low fire rate, it allows for Intel-Gathering and Area Denial. Stadium will now be a permanent map where you can defy your opponents in ranked matches. This season also brings major balancing updates that will shake things up.

title: For Honor: Season 22 - Curse of the Scarab
description: Includes Testing Grounds, Justice of Pharaohs (Seasonal Event), Bolthorn's Curse Raider Skin, New Seasonal Customization and a new Battle Pass.
