description: Curupira is an action platformer where you need to help restore the ecological balance and retrieve the energy spheres from the hands of the fearsome god Anhangá.

title: Historical Trilogy
description: Klabater’s ‘Historical Trilogy’ contains three meaningful, story-driven & history-inspired games: We. The Revolution, Help Will Come Tomorrow, and The Amazing American Circus. Immerse yourself into plots inspired by momentous historical and political events created with Unique hand-drawn 2D visuals!

title: Reksio i Kretes: Tajemnica Trzeciego Wymiaru
description: A mysterious buzz in the middle of the night puts Reksio, Kretes and the Inventor Rooster on their feet. The friends, regardless of the danger, set out on a scouting journey. Soon it turns out that a powerful Black Monolith has grown in the clearing in the forest. Kretes touches its surface and at once all three heroes are drawn into the depths of the third dimension.

title: Puzzle by Nikoli W: Sudoku
description: Sudoku is a puzzle in which you place numbers from 1 to 9 into a 9x9 grid, divided into horizontal and vertical lines and 3x3 blocks, filling up all of the spaces with the numbers. With everything from simple puzzles to super-difficult ones, this game is popular with a wide range of players, from beginners to veterans. Please enjoy this high-quality sudoku game.

title: Bolek i Lolek: Tajemnicze Zamczysko
description: It was supposed to be another carefree vacation. However, something went wrong on the way to the mountain shelter. A violent storm damaged the road markings and the boys ended up in the mysterious castle of a Master Siegfried instead of the shelter. This suspect scientist was not going to miss such an opportunity! Each pair of hands to work on an alchemist's great project was worth its weight in gold.

title: Graveless
description: Graveless is a single-player third person dungeon crawler Hack and Slash Action RPG set in the realm of chaos when immortality is no longer a myth and fiction.

title: Trinity Fusion
description:
Take control of your parallel selves on a mission to save the dying multiverse in this rogue-lite action platformer! Explore dark, sci-fi worlds and engage in fast-paced, smooth and precise combat.

The various branches of the multiverse are always changing. Fight through a combination of procedurally-generated levels as well as hand-crafted challenges and arenas that will put your skills to the test. Levels with 3D graphics are seamlessly constructed out of hundreds of hand-made rooms.

With weapons and attack systems that leverage our previous experience working on fighting games. You’ll slide, dash and dodge between enemy attacks and strike back with an arsenal of satisfying special weapons and abilities.

Each of your parallel selves has their own world with multiple biomes to explore, as well as their own sets of unique abilities and weapons. Travel through a universe of desolate wastes and caverns roamed by mutant creatures, escape the endless forges and labs of a world ruled by machines, and survive the dangerous sky cities of a post-human society.

title: Enotria: The Last Song
description: Enotria: The Last Song is a soulslike set in a beautiful sun-lit world inspired by Italian folklore where the brightest sun casts the darkest shadow. Wear unique role-altering masks, face formidable foes and alter reality with the power of Ardore to unravel the secrets of Enotria.

title: It Was a Human
description: A short SF psychedelic interrogation ADV game that focuses on the interrogation of a suspect in a dismemberment murder case. The protagonist is a lieutenant colonel, tasked with interrogating the suspect. The protagonist needs to find out why she killed the two men and how she committed the crime.

title: PokéROM: Mew
description: PokéROMs were promotional shaped CD-ROMs with varying characters on the design. Each disc contained a memory game. This particular disc contained Mew on its label and had a memory game included in which the player had to find 2 of a pair of Pokemon related imagery.

title: PokéROM: Psyduck
description: This PokéROM is part of a set of educational games featuring creatures from the Pokémon universe. The game contains mathematical challenges for children up to a fifth grade level; upon completion, the player will be awarded with pictures of Psyduck. A competitive trivia mode supports up to four players in a race to the finish line. Players take turns to answer questions pertaining to such subjects as geography, grammar, and Pokémon knowledge, with correct answers moving the player closer to the goal.

title: Old Site
description: Old Site is a mod of Celeste Classic using ideas from the chapter "Old Site" from the game's full release, Celeste.

title: Harry Buster
description: Harry Buster is an arcade shooting game set in a stock exchange. Originally released in Germany on T-Onlines 'onGames' serviced where levels could be purchased individually, a later 'XL' CD-ROM version was released that included 20 levels

title: Biohazard Village: Z Version
description: Resident Evil Village is a first-person survival horror game and the sequel to Resident Evil 7: Biohazard. The game maintains elements from previous Resident Evil games, with players having to scavenge environments for items and manage their resources. However, it adds more action-oriented gameplay, with higher enemy counts and a greater emphasis on combat.

title: Feather Park
description: Explore an autumn park and play minigames. Make friends and enter the barn.

title: Emi's Country Store and Farm
description: Play relaxed or timed in this Onet/Match 2 Game. Enjoy the nice graphics and the cute colorful tiles. Look beyond the nearest option and make every level a 3-star win. Catch the mouse while playing, earn bonus coins and create the nicest Country Store and Farm for Emi.

title: Death Corp
description: Death Corp is a classic 2D Point and Click Adventure game where you play as the young new intern for Death's own company.

title: Eat Me Alive
description: In dependency of where in the body you are positioned, you get different bonuses. In general you will get Bone, Blood and Tissue with which you can create more bugs. In addition to that you will be able to research different bug types which have bonuses themself.

title: Tekla
description: Blast your way through an endless horde of enemies in this pixel art top-down shooter. Collect their remains in order upgrade your character for increased combat abilities. Tekla is a top-down shooter with roguelite elements.

title: The Silent Huntress
description: "The Silent Huntress" is a visual novel in the genre of a dark fairy tale with choices and different endings. Not only the development of events will depend on your choices, but also the conclusions that the main character makes about her life and the world around her.

title: Fantasteroids
description: Fast-paced gameplay, rainbow colours and snappy animations all come together to give you a retro arcade-feel game with renewed graphics and avatars. There's a variety of different modes for you to choose from, and different skins to unlock and leaderboards for you to show off to your friends!

title: Lost Fleet
description: Lost Fleet is a co-op space shooter. Every ship in your fleet is flyable, from the smallest fighter to the largest battleship. Protect the Mothership, mine resources, crush your enemies.

title: Lovely x Cation 2
description: Spring has come again and the protagonist has moved into a new home by himself after his parents transfered elsewhere for their jobs. Everyone went smoothly until he received a prediction at a shrine which he had come upon: “Go find the one who will become your partner for life. Otherwise, you will live a cruel life”. However, a non-assertive man like him didn’t know anything about love. At such an critical juncture in his life, will he be able to summon up the courage to find himself a girl?

title: Panic Diet!!
description: Panic Diet!! is a finite runner with scaling difficulty, character progression and unconventional obstacles.

title: Folds of a Separation
description: Folds of a Separation is a short rumination on a state's control over bodies and the grief that stems from carceral violence.

title: Blueprints
description:
Blueprints is a 3D third-person parkour platformer game where the more levels you beat, the prettier they get.
Experience beautiful natural (and not natural) landscapes in this short casual adventure you are very likely to forget.
Play all sorts of parkour challenges (and a random 2 minutes of holding [W]) in this adventure of a lifetime.

title: Burial
description: A videographer receives the task of filming a wake in an old Soviet apartment. But he soon realizes that something terrible is lurking within these walls. And in the middle of the room there is a closed coffin...

title: Safety: Life Is A Maze
description: A action/adventure game revolving around Mina, and her friends, as she tries to escape her mysterious captivity.

title: The Dark Conjunction
description: The Dark Conjunction is a Single-Player Total Conversion for Quake 3: Arena that is inspired by the works of H.P. Lovecraft.

title: Generations Arena
description: Generations Arena is the "ultimate tribute" to ID Software, as it combines play styles and characters from all games previous to Quake III's release, such as Doom, Wolfenstein, and both Quake 1 and , combining them all into one giant multiplayer mod that pits characters from all those games in Quake III style arenas.

title: Navy SEALs: Covert Operations
description:
Navy SEAL/s: Covert Operations is a realism total conversion mod for ID Software's Quake3 engine. NS:CO pits players in realistic combat missions such as:

-Retrieve Information in a suitcase and return it to a capture point
-Defend Fortified Area's from Capture
-Assassinate VIP Player (distinct model for VIP)
-Capture Specific Points on the map for your team to win.

Navy Seals has one of the most realistic damage effects you will ever see in a Mod. You won't see anyone taking one-hundred bullets and surviving here. It's all based on reality and how bullets really effect someone when hit by them.

title: Super Cult Tycoon 2 Deluxe Edition
description: The game’s set in a small Colorado town, and basically has you driving around recruiting the townsfolk, putting them to work, raising cash and ultimately getting enough gear together for your cult’s mothership to arrive and whisk you all off to a better place.

title: A Bomb Called Darkipt
description: The third game released by Gretchen, also known as BrownSugar, creator of both A Vague Story and Patty & Mr. Miles in Wolf RPG Editor.

title: Babes & Balls Vol. 1: X-Treme Beach Volleyball
description: The first in a series of adult sports games by Redfire Software.

title: Babes & Balls Vol. 2: X-Treme Beach Soccer
description: The second in a series of adult sports games by Redfire Software.

title: Babes & Balls Vol. 3: Gotcha Babes X-Treme
description: The third and final in a series of adult sports games by Redfire Software.

title: The Chronicles of Myrtana: Archolos
description:
The Chronicles Of Myrtana: Archolos is a free, total conversion mod for Gothic II: Gold Edition. It features a completely new open world, improved skills systems, gameplay mechanics and complex story.

Main goal of this project is to honour one the best classic cRPG and take the die-hard fans of the original Gothic trilogy as well as new players on one more adventure in the Kingdom of Myrtana.

title: Pico World Race
description: Pico World Race is a fast-paced racing game for PICO-8. Get in your supercar and take a trip around the world, testing your driving skills on challenging circuits against a host of opponents.

title: Sword of Moonlight King's Field Making tool
description: The user can make his own role-playing game using this 3D RPG making tool. It includes various useful tools to create a King's Field-like game. The remake of the original King's Field is also included as a customizable sample.

title: Astral Guard
description: Astral Guard is an interplanetary RPG adventure following a group of aliens trying to stop a vicious hivemind from taking over the solar system. Find friends, fight foes, and travel the stars!

title: Anniversary no Kuni no Alice: Wonderful Wonder World
description: Anniversary no Kuni no Alice ~Wonderful Wonder World~ is a remake of Heart no Kuni no Alice featuring redrawn CGs and new character routes. It was originally released on March 2010 for PC and a version for PSP was released on July 2011.

title: Max Payne@University
description: "Max Payne@University" follows a young Max Payne during his time at university. One year there is a dangerous threat to the university that escalates drastically very quickly.

title: Matrixed Reality
description: A modification of Max Payne that recreates scenes from the first three Matrix films.

title: The Real World
description: The creators of ‘MAX PAYNE: Kung Fu Edition 3’ and ‘Katana’ join forces to deliver THE most explosive and complete mod to ever grace the Max Payne engine! Combine a massive arsenal of lightning-fast punches, kicks, and cool signature takedown moves to devastate your opponents with style! Run along walls, dodge bullets effortlessly, and flip off walls, objects and even people! The rules are yours to bend and break, as you relive some of the Trilogy's most memorable scenes, including The Lobby, Dojo, and The Burly Brawl!

title: The Family
description: "The Family" follows the young gangster Tony in an entire black and white film noir-ish world of the 1930's mafia era.

title: Back to School: My Worst Day
description: Personal survival story loosely based on real events set in western Ukraine.

title: True Matrix Total Conversion
description: The True Matrix TC for Max Payne converts this popular game into The Matrix, complete with new weapons, characters, and music from the hit film.

title: Out of Hell
description: You are Donovan Ling, a police officer and one of the last living souls in a city decimated by a demonic onslaught. Fight against relentless hordes of the undead, nightmarish horrors and hellish entities as you attempt to unravel the mysteries behind the invasion and escape with your life!

title: Watch Your Plastic Duck
description:
Small rubber ducks calmly swim in the pool and you can watch them to relaxing music. What can go wrong?
Watch Your Plastic Duck is an idle game where you just relax and watch the ducks in the pool.

title: CyberHeroes Arena
description: CyberHeroes Arena is an autobattle roguelite. Choose your cyber hero, create your build and destroy all cyber monsters to survive.

title: Coalescence
description: Coalescence is a visual novel that takes you deep within Moniker Labs to explore its secrets. Play as one of three characters, each with their own storyline and dialogue options. Form relationships with the companions you encounter and try to make it out alive!

title: Heroes of Hellas Origins: Part Two
description: With Hellas captured by evil, it is in desperate need of saving. Join Hades in this match-three puzzle game to transform the stone wasteland into a realm of justice and rid the people’s hearts of evil. Become the hero that saves Hellas!

title: Fried Panic
description: Survive as long as possible in Fried Panic! Buy weapons, abilities, and even donut producing machines. Fight through waves of eggs, lemons, chicken drumsticks, and much more, all in a top down pixel art style.

title: Fisher's Qualm
description: ASMR based casual island fishing game!

title: Panda Roll
description: With a puzzle mechanic controlling both heroes at the same time, guide Pandara and Mulatta on an adventure of challenges and friendship, to find the mighty Sun Bamboo, and cure the Mulatta's mother.

title: QuentBlast
description: QuentBlast is a cool indie RPG, where you bowl to attack! In this thrilling game of chance, the renowned Dr. Quent Blast has taken you on as his apprentice. As he shows you the art and science behind bowling, enjoy snappy, witty dialogue.

title: Spooked Hide & Seek
description: Spooked is a crazy hide & seek game in a huge magical castle with up to 10 hiders playing against one dangerous seeker. Maybe you will be sneaky enough to complete all the tasks and get out of the mysterious castle or enough determined to hunt everyone else down

title: Chronique des Silencieux
description: Set in 1970s southern France, you play a rookie private eye tasked to dig out the secrets of a stubborn old man. Think on your feet while you follow your leads : ask questions to witnesses, detect their lies, hypothesize why and finally confront the silent ones running from their past.

title: Rikua
description: Rikua is a 2.5D action platformer ninja cyberpunk game surrounded in beautiful, realistic and futuristic 3D aesthetics, and introduces a unique hack-and-slash/third-person-shooting mechanics that will keep you constantly on the edge!

title: Broilers
description: Broilers is a turn-based game that resembles chess and similar board games, but only externally. The basis of almost all of the mechanics in Broilers, is selection (breeding). Learn how to breed new species and their characteristics in order to win the online challenge.

title: This Bed We Made
description: This Bed We Made is a third-person mystery game in which you play as a maid in a 1950s hotel and snoop around strangers' rooms to uncover their deadly secrets. Discover what links the clients together in this tale of love, heartbreak and murder!

title: The Lost Bloodline
description: The Lost Bloodline is a game where you will venture into an immersive story developed in medieval times, endowed with a lot of action, exploration and a touch of fantasy, we recommend you to venture into this great epic journey.

title: Snow Plowing Simulator
description: Experience the serene joy of snow plowing in this relaxing simulation game! Drive powerful plows, clear roads, and keep your town safe. Uncover a surprising story, face survival challenges, and tackle advanced weather systems. Embrace winter's chill and become the ultimate snow-clearing hero!

title: El Dorado: The Golden City Builder
description: El Dorado The Golden City Builder is a single-player city-building economic strategy game that is set in the mysterious land of pre-Columbian Latin America, where wealth does not always lead to happiness, and the anger of the Gods can bring disaster to anyone who is not favorable to them.

title: Dungeon Knight
description: You will play as a brave knight, exploring underground mazes, completing various challenges. Each level in the game is the ultimate platform jumping experience, requiring your precise calculation of jump timing and distance, dodging danger, and finally reaching the finish line.

title: Nanokings
description: Nanokings is a rogue-lite infused game where you try to survive the onslaught of evolved beasts and viking tribes augmented by steampunk machinery. Increase your power by collecting mysterious powders that allow you to choose items or upgrades in the norse dystopia of Myrkrafjordur.

title: Ink Inside
description: INK INSIDE is the hand drawn beat-em-up RPG with the heart of a Saturday Morning Cartoon! Play as Stick (Brian David Gilbert) an unfinished doodle in an old notebook trying to discover who they are. Fight back against the wet "Sog" corrupting the world while saving your friends in co-op!

title: Dismantled 2
description: Dismantled 2 is a survival horror game, and is the sequel to Dismantled. The game will see new characters involved in the story, 4 years after the events of the first game.

title: Supermarket Manager
description: Supermarket Manager: Lead, manage, develop, and upgrade your own stores. Choose the right products and employees. Increase your revenue to create a strong supermarket brand.

title: Dad by the Sword
description: Dad by the Sword is a First Person Swordfighting game with a heavy focus on tactical dismemberment, dynamic slicing, giant spraying fountains of purple blood, and dad jokes. Play as YOUR DAD in his quest to fight evil hot dogs, Wizzards, things hatched from eggs, and other vile Anti-Dads.

title: Northgard: Hræsvelg, Clan of the Eagle
description: Carried by the winds, the agile explorers of Hraesvelg do not need to occupy a large territory, for they will readily venture outside to gather resources. Their profound knowledge of the terrain and their ability to exploit it to its fullest allows them to survive in the most desolate of areas.

title: Maze of Realities: Reflection of Light - Collector's Edition
description: Where's the borderland of light and darkness? A meteorite crashes in Arizona and creates a portal to the parallel universe. Will you dare to explore foreign lands?

title: Click to Sail
description: Build a team of sailors to navigate around the world using only your mouse!

title: Cyclo Chambers
description: Collect synergizing items to create an overpowered character to fight hordes of cyclops monsters. Cyclo Chambers is a fast-paced, top-down arena shooter with light rogue-like elements. 200 items to choose from to create frantic combinations. Different runs every time.

title: The Odarian Accounts
description: Follow Cedric on his adventure as he tries to get his home and family back after events take place uprooting all that he knows, and throwing him into a world of chaos.

title: S.P.L.I.C.E.D.
description: S.P.L.I.C.E.D. is a free Metroidvania made by students from Breda University of Applied Sciences. Traverse a Biopunk Chinatown with high mobility and difficult combat encounters.

title: Personal Chef to the Stars
description: “Personal Chef to the Stars” is a menu management simulator, Romantic Comedy Yuri Visual Novel, and Dating Sim. Play as Chef Ayesha Rogers as she must balance the needs and desires of a household filled with eccentric celebrities while also managing her own budding love life.

title: Potato Survival
description: Potato Survival is a short story game about a character who lives alone on the open sea, collecting potatoes to survive for 21 days. By using knowledge, unlock new skills to create a more meaningful daily life! Experiencing relationships in the midst of everyday life is the objective of the game.

title: The Cat Maze
description: it is a 2d solving puzzle game, the maze is subvert your imagination, you need to find the start point and end point by yourself that to solve the cats maze. there have many type of cats have special power to help you to solve it, there have 499 level waiting for you to solve!!

title: Capsule Rush
description: Capsule Rush is a third-person 3D platformer game set in different environments. You spawn in on a platform, along the journey you'll have to traverse through many obstacles in order to reach the finish line. Compete against others for the fastest time and buckle up for the challenges waiting ahead!

title: Milita Aventuro
description: 游戏的背景是90年代的东欧国家，讲述两个虚构民族艾斯佩罗族和伊多诺族的战争，主人公是一位艾斯佩罗族的少女，玩家要操纵她在战争中游历冒险，期间会遇到各种各样的朋友和敌人。游戏由探索对话和炮弹躲避玩法，目前游戏只制作到序章部分，每制作完成一章就会进行更新。

title: Zombie Mansion
description: Zombie Mansion is a 2D side-scrolling platform shooter with puzzle and exploration elements.

title: Red Haven
description: Navigate through the Red Haven complex and uncover secrets and survive!

title: Effigy
description: A retro FPS/metroidvania set on a prison moon overrun by a cult of former prisoners.

title: JoJo Siwa: Worldwide Party
description: You’re invited to JoJo Siwa’s Worldwide Party! Lace up your “High Top Shoes” and run through JoJo's worlds listening along to her biggest hits including D.R.E.AM, Bop and Nonstop! Complete levels as JoJo to perform special dance routines! Can you match t…

title: Hazelnut Hex
description: A strange curse falls across the land! Breakfast everywhere has disappeared, and it's up to you to save the most important meal of the day! Blast your way through 5 colorful stages jam-packed with dangerous enemies, dense bullet patterns, and ruthless bosses to rescue breakfast once and for all!

title: S7 Mexico
description: An open world game inspired by Mexico.

title: Project X: Love Potion Disaster
description:
Project X: Love Potion Disaster is fan-erotic game based on Sonic The Hedgehog universe.
The gameplay is 2D scrolling beat'em up, where you play for the character, that you choose at the beginning. You have a choice of 7 characters: R-02 Zeta, Amy Rose, Rouge The Bat, Blaze The Cat, Cream The Rabbit, Miles "Tails" Prower and Zu The Cat. Your goal is to reach the end of the level. Along the way, you will meet enemies that you need to kill to reach the end of the level.

title: So Below
description: Gear up, hunt, adapt, survive. Engage in a co-op survival horror experience with up to 4 players online. Explore the haunted location, find the clues and tools needed to complete the ritual and defeat the entity. Will you be able to survive?

title: That Night
description: That Night is a short PSX horror game. You're a girl in the 90's that one night decided to take a walk in a road in the middle of the forest. The more you progress, the more you hear voices of something that is following you.

title: Truth Loop
description:
Truth Loop is a short game with a scary story and bizarre moments...

It has a "loop" style of gameplay, you keep repeating an action while the game and the story progress.

title: Half-Life: Sum
description: Half-Life: Sum takes place during and after the resonance cascade in which you play as the tough as nails HECU grunt Jane Doe as she has to wade through 11 sprawling maps. A remake of the previous released mods "HTC", "Autonomy Lost" and "Abeyance".

title: The Slasher Camp Massacre
description: A vengeful and angry killer is killing everyone in the camp, are you ready to escape? or are you ready to die?

title: On Earth as in Hell: Woytons Plague
description:
Is a ps1-style horror game set in a small, quiet town.

You are a resident, who works in the city market, and who has to go through dark and scary paths to get to your shift.

But on that day you find something strange, a mark in the back of the supermarket.

Who knows what it might mean?

title: ChocuPixel
description: ChocuPixel is a two dimensional platformer starring the beloved character chocu. In this adventure we must find chocus friend Juan who is lost in the basement, but we will have to fight many enemies to get to him.

title: Spiritfarer: Lily Update
description: The Lily Update is ready to spread its wings, and Lily is finally making her debut to the Spiritfarer crew! Alongside Lily herself, some new features, Quality of life changes and Bug Fixes have been added.

title: Spiritfarer: Beverly Update
description: The Beverly Update contains new features, quality of life changes and narrative tweaks. From new food items, to brand new buildings, there are lots of new content to explore!

title: Spiritfarer: Jackie & Daria Update
description: The Jackie & Daria Update adds two new characters, Jackie & Daria, as well as a brand new island to the game.

title: Vanilla: Garden of Judgement
description: "In life and death, in the paradise between those, you will know your own crime" A visual novel ADV where raw and dead intersect "Garden of the Vanilla Judgment" Circle Charon's latest work challenging straight from the theme of "life and death".

title: Prima Doll: Fuyuzora Hanabi/Sekka Monyou
description: Prima Doll: Fuyuzora Hanabi/Sekka Mon'you is the first volume of a kinetic novel series based on the multimedia project Prima Doll that adapts the Haizakura and Karasuba prequel episode originally serialized for the official website.

title: Suspension
description:
A 10 minute game about Mark Wonnacott's final year of university.

One good ending, and one satisfying ending.

title: Prima Doll: Kouto Tantei
description: Prima Doll: Kouto Tantei is the third volume of the kinetic novel series based on the multimedia project Prima Doll, which is a sequel to the anime series.

title: Lonely Wolf Treat: The Complete Series
description: Lonely Wolf Treat: The Complete Series is an RPG Maker game that combines the previously-episodic story of treat into one package! This project is still in development, so only 7 of the 8 chapters are available to play.

title: Prima Doll: Mumei Tenrei
description: Prima Doll: Mumei Tenrei is the second volume of the kinetic novel series based on the multimedia project Prima Doll. It is a prequel to the anime series focused on the character Houkiboshi.

title: Monika After Story
description:
Monika After Story picks up where Doki Doki Literature Club left off, allowing you to spend the rest of your days with Monika as your virtual girlfriend.

Use the new dialogue system to have conversations with Monika about subjects ranging from video games to the nature of god and existence. Or wait for a little while and she'll muse on dozens of new and interesting topics with new art and expressions not found in the original game!

title: Gasoline Gypsies Game
description:
The Gasoline Gypsies Game is a retro 2-D action platform game. Play as Caleb, Steve, Joe, and Neal as they try to make it to the top.

As a member of the Gasoline Gypsies you will run, jump, and rock your way through various levels. Find hidden items and power-ups along the way. Use your instruments to defeat opponents. You will encounter broken strings, zombie tuners, deranged groupies, and more on your way to the stage. At the end of each level you will face off with a rival group.

Listen to 8-bit renditions of original Gasoline Gypsies music as you travel across Michigan. On your adventure you will unlock levels, costumes, mini games and more. Compete for dominance on the online leaderboard or team up with a friend for local co-op. The Gasoline Gypsies Game is a colorful non violent game intended for all ages.

title: There's Nobody
description: A short horror movie in a psx style game. A woman in a simple hotel is bothered by the noise coming from the neighbor, but is anyone there?

title: #Doubleblush
description: By squishymoss and violet lafleur. Girl meets girl and shit gets #gay

title: Wild Hearts
description: Prepare for an epic adventure set in a fantasy world inspired by feudal Japan. Developed by Omega Force, the Japanese studio behind Dynasty Warriors, in partnership with Electronic Arts.

title: Hero's Harem Guild
description: In Hero's Harem Guild you're a simple poor guy who becomes a community hero for accidentally surviving a powerful demon. You'll lead a Guild full of beautiful adventurers willing to work, train, and fight for you. Upgrade the Guild, repair the town, seek new members, build relationships with those that already are and complete quests in this RPG-themed world.

title: Pokémon Realidea System
description: Pokémon Realidea System is a fanmade Pokémon game with fakemon starters and a new legendary mon. A few regional forms, new characters, new quests, 8 Gym Badges to get and of course a Pokémon League and plenty more!

title: Parlor
description: Parlor is an interactive party game that can be played with your Twitch chat! Each round you give clues to your chat and they try to guess the answer by typing it to your chat, competing with each other.

title: Cursor0x0
description: Cursor0x0 is a collection of various cursor mini games that require a good reaction, stamina, and precision. Fight enemies, win races, dodge bullets, complete different goals to unlock new challenge types and reach the final level!

title: Pretty x Cation
description:
Spring has come to Tokyo once again, except this year you’re now living alone after your parents had to leave due to work. You’re renting a room at an apartment run by your aunt, who bluntly asks you, “Could it be that you’re not interested in girls…?” Well, of course you are! It’s just that you haven’t had much luck finding someone. “Your youth is now. Go and find your love or you will regret it later.” With just that little push, you feel a little confident that it’s your time to fall in love. Yes, your love will begin to bloom now…

While the old-style dating sim concept is still the same, this new title is produced by a different staff.

title: Reflex Runner
description: Reflex Runner is a speed running platformer that increases in difficulty as you progress through close to 40 unique levels. clear each level as fast as possible dodging razor sharp saw blades, red hot lasers, shooting flames and more as you race to set world record clear times!

title: Prima Doll Encore
description: Prima Doll Encore is the fourth and final volume of a kinetic novel series based on the multimedia project Prima Doll, depicting the aftermath of the Kuronekotei café.

title: The Way Back Home: Sinister Night
description:
This is a short horror game with some elements of exhibition
The focus is on a horror-like atmosphere, so there are no jump scares.
The game has multiple endings.

title: Untold Atlas
description:
Riya Cross is sent on an expedition to explore Aethra, a mysterious island which was once a beacon of ancient technology before being lost to the depths of the sea, then resurfaced back into the world.

Led by Captain Felix Harker, Riya and the rest of her crew which includes loose cannon Eli Ryder, the accomplished Lilith Wren, the contracted scientist Alexei Nova, and the ever-pleasant Aethran guide Claris Io to embark into the mysteries of Aethra and all its regions as they grow closer to the answers behind the true source of the island’s ancient technology while diving into their own adventures and romances along the way.

title: Crypt
description: This is not a video game. This is a psychological torture device. Do not attempt to play this game. You won't have an enjoyable experience. And that's intentional.

title: Petty's Adventure: Desert
description: Petty's Adventure: Desert is a colorful game with changing gravity in which you have collect crystals to complete a level.

title: Witch Guild Survivor
description: Witch Guild Survivor is a fun horde roguelite game where you play as a witch that must survive from the monsters using your poweful spells! Collect white orbs and upgrade your magic spells. Choose a combination of various elements to generate synergies between them in each run

title: Valor & Victory: Arnhem
description: Arnhem Sunday 17th September. Lt-Col John Frost's 2nd Battalion, The Parachute Regiment, reach Arnhem Bridge little knowing the fierce battles they would be fighting over the next few days.

title: Undertale Last Breath
description: Undertale Last Breath (aka. Undertale Final Breath) is an AU fangame where after 30 genocide routes Frisk reached the 31st genocide, Frisk found a strange door, and found a strange figure who then left, sending Frisk unconscious. The strange figure informed Sans the skeleton of the past genocide routes, agitating sans to the point that he swears to kill the human, no matter the cost.

title: Haunted Castle II
description: Fight Dracula in his castle. Cross 10 Levels of terror starting from the Camilla Cemetery.

title: Cardseer
description: Cardseer is a fantasy deckbuilding game combining old school RPGs like the original Final Fantasy's with card games Yugioh, Hearthstone and Gwent. features a story based campaign, taking you across the continent to stop a mysterious evil force, and a challenging roguelike Gauntlet mode. Engage in fast paced card combat against a horde of villains, carefully traverse the hazardous map and strategically collect game-changing artifacts to emerge victorious!

title: Shrimp Magicality
description:
Shrimp Magicality is an adventure game that is focused on exploration. You play as ‘The Professor,’ a narcoleptic academic, wandering around a fictionalized Seattle. Experience her wildest dreams, as she dozes off throughout The Ave.

Meet quirky characters, discover a colorful world, and try to get some rest.

title: Samurai Unicorn
description: An action horror game with retro-graphics, set in the sprawling megacity of Sydney3.

title: Mouse Sector
description:
A small constellation full of mysteries

"earth is so far away now ... "

title: Infinimine
description: A mining Experience for all to discover and work together.

title: Yum Yum Cookstar
description: Stir, fry, chop and bake your way through over 70 unique recipes in Yum Yum Cookstar. Impress the judges with dishes like Rainbow Waffels, Unicorn Smoothies or Sushi Burritos in an energetic cooking competition hosted by Chef Yum Yum.

title: Victoria 3: Day One Edition
description: The game in and exclusive case with attached art book.

title: Block Steady
description: Chunky jumpy platformer sprinkled with puzzle!

title: Cursed Crops
description: Play with up to 4 players as a group of conspiracy addict farmers as you defend farmlands built on haunted land from the cursed vegetables that rise during the harvest.

title: I Commissioned Some Bees 7
description: The brief was simple. Artists were commissioned to create a fantasy world, and hide as many bees as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 10 art pieces to choose from, and 1000+ bees, you will have a lot of searching to do.

title: Toem: Basto Region
description: Basto is Toem's biggest region filled with brand new content like treasure hunting, minigames, and spooky stories.

title: Redsun 2020
description: Redsun 2020 follows Joseph, the newest Nanotech agent developed by UNATCO.

title: Late Night Mop
description: Late Night Mop is a haunted house cleaning simulator.

title: Bara no Ki ni Bara no Hanasaku Fandisk
description: Short Story Collection delivering 20 extra episodes featuring heroes of original game.

title: ZooRacers
description: Get ready to rev your engines and unleash the competition in ZooRacers! This electrifying, free-to-play 3D battle kart game is packed with non-stop action and endless fun. Show off your skills and attach some seriously cool NFTs to boost your character's performance. With a play-to-earn mode, you can rack up rewards while dominating the competition. Get creative and customize your karts, drivers, weapons, and more to leave your opponents in the dust and climb to the top of the leaderboard! The race is on, are you ready?

title: Sarah and the Lonely Key
description: A short, Sokoban-style puzzle game with many doors, but only one key.

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed: Game of the Year Edition
description: Collect the best vehicles in the Hot Wheels universe, build spectacular tracks and dive into breathtaking races.

title: War Obelisks
description: Protect the obelisk and save this world! The obelisk that gives life to all living things is under threat! Defensive structures will help you in defense, some deal a lot of damage, some slow down or attack over long distances.

title: Stellar Fight
description: is a 2D arcade game. The main goal of which is to kill all the enemies on the field and get points...

title: Charley's Day
description: Every night, Charley looks up at the stars in the sky and finally decides to go on an adventure on a special day!

title: Bay Bell
description: A science fiction point and click word puzzle game. Navigate an off-course spaceship, and find a way toward returning home. The end is near… Can you save the Bay Bell?

title: The Rise and Fall of Odysseus Kent
description: An abandoned sequel to The Trials of Odysseus Kent made in Adventure Game Studio by Ben "Yahtzee" Croshaw.

title: Broken Boughs
description: An cancelled Silent Hill inspired first person adventure game made by Ben "Yahtzee" Croshaw.

title: Adventures in the Dimension of Insidual Cruelitude.
description: A cancelled sequel to Adventures in the Galaxy of Fantabulous Wonderment made by Ben "Yahtzee" Croshaw.

title: Phone
description: An cancelled horror game made by Ben "Yahtzee" Croshaw.

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Future Soldier - Deluxe Edition
description: Developed by the creators of the acclaimed Ghost Recon Advanced Warfighter series, the Ubisoft Paris studio is proud to present the next installment of the legendary Tom Clancy franchise: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Future Soldier.

title: Twisted Insurrection
description: Twisted Insurrection is a critically acclaimed, standalone modification based on the Command & Conquer Tiberian Sun engine. It features a complete redesign of the original game, set in an alternate "what-if?" timeline where the Brotherhood of Nod was victorious during the first Tiberian War.

title: Hungry Lamu
description: Hungry Lamu is a game about a Lamu in search fruits to fill his stomach, but things started to get scary after the sun goes down.

title: Bonnie's Bakery
description:
A game where you serve customers delicious food as Bonnie! Yes, that's all it is! A game where you serve customers delicious food...

Nothing else...

title: Cirno's Perfect Punchout!!
description:
Indulge in Cirnos dream-world of overconfidence and beat up all the frogs you can find before she wakes up!

Unlock additional modes by becoming stronger than the strongest frog!

title: Nekoneko
description:
This is a casual intellectual game that can be easily played, your goal is to swap the fragments to restore the pictures.
There is no time or star limit in the game, you are supposed to enjoy the relaxing experience.

Together the full picture of all the lovely cat ladies with your own hands, collect their portraits.

title: Yu Crossing Animals
description: Yu's got a new job - working as a mayor's assistant in a small town.

title: Defeated Girl
description: Defeated Girl is a jigsaw puzzle.

title: Hentai Pazu
description: Enjoy the beauty girls picture and relaxing music to complete the puzzle.
Collection of logic riddles.

title: Diavolo no Daibouken
description: Diavolo no Daibouken is a free Japanese fangame based off the manga JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. It is a simplistic graphical roguelike that stars Diavolo, the main villain of part 5 of the manga.

title: Oak Hill
description:
In this new short 2D adventure you play as Theo, a dog! After dying, you find yourself in Oak Hill, the dimension between life and death. You will have to face many challenges to reach your best friend Harriet to say goodbye and to move on.
Meet Spirit, the guide who will accompany you on this adventure.

title: Elevator Hitch
description:
Elevator Hitch is a short 2.5D surreal horror/escape room visual novel with point-and-click and puzzle elements following the story of two co-workers suddenly finding themselves stuck together in a "Perfectly Normal" 70s office elevator.

They must explore each liminal-looking floor and find a way to
get off the elevator to their actual destinations.

title: Army of Ruin
description:
Army of Ruin is an auto-shooter in which you guide legendary heroes on a quest to defeat the Armies of Evil.

Get hold of a deadly arsenal capable of slaying hundreds of enemies in seconds, and you may have a shot at defeating the deadly Army Generals!

title: Archaeogem
description: Hats up and whips out; the jungle's mysteries await! Explore lush biomes, use your trusty whip to extract wild flowers' mystic powers, and collect rare gems in this dynamic precision-platformer. Unearth archaeological marvels and become a legend - if you make it out alive!

title: Overly Qualified Ms. Mary
description: Overly Qualified Ms. Mary follows the story of Tomoya, an average student just trying to get by at school. His life turns upside-down when he meets Mary Morgan, a transfer student known for her uncommon beauty, being the subject of many students' jealousy and lust. In a surprising twist, Ms. Mary finds Tomoya unexpectedly attractive. Despite her being a bit of a tsundere at times, the two end up in a relationship together. Will the ordinary Tomoya be enough to satisfy the needs of such rare beauty?

title: Buff Doge
description:
Hide in the back rooms from the scary buff doge or he will kill you. In this scary horror game you have to beat the difficult maze, behind every corner there could be a terrifying monster! Or is the monster already among us?

Find weapons to defend yourself from the buff doge. The back rooms are full of surprises, do you have what it takes to win against the buff doge?

title: Sudoki
description: Are you desperate for zero time dilemma? Need something to refresh your memory? want to have a little fun before you suffer in hell for the rest of eternity?

title: Exoracer
description: Exoracer is a fast-paced multiplayer platformer game where you compete for the world record. Play on short and fun levels to get the best time as you can. Compete in short races to climb up the trophy road!

title: Plasma
description: Plasma is a creative engineering playground where you can build any device you can imagine. Bring to life your own amazing robots, factories, arcade machines, giant rampaging spiders, whole game worlds, and things that don't even have a name yet, then share them with the community.

title: Zombie Claus
description: You find yourself in a big empty house. Around the Christmas lights, but no friends, no family, and only bad Santa. Solve the mystery of the protagonist.

title: Cavern of Dreams
description:
Cavern of Dreams is a mysterious, surreal adventure game inspired by N64 classics.
You play as a young dragon who's just lost all of his unhatched siblings! You have to explore the Cavern of Dreams and the many strange worlds it's connected to, solving puzzles and facing adversity to rescue them...

title: Panacea: Rebirth
description: A sickly girl explores the forest everyday. Could the creatures from the woods be as dangerous as the rumors claim?

title: You are now Possessed
description: A puzzle game where you're not always in control.

title: CielClou
description:
It is a first person shooter.
As you defeat enemies, the % in the upper right corner increases,
and when it reaches 100%, the boss will appear.
The game ends when all five sides are cleared.

title: Parasite in Love
description: Marlowe dreamed of finding a loyal partner who wants to raise a family. She just never thought the first taker would be a brain-eating amoeba. Trapped in a remote cabin, she must fight to stop the parasite in her brain from shutting her off for good.

title: Adrian's Tale
description: One day most of the animals disappeared and Hero has to find out what happened the night when animals have disappeared and bring them back. For this purpose the Hero has to travel a lot, search for various items and weapons as well as solve puzzles, fight against enemies and bosses.

title: Olympus 2207
description: Olympus 2207 is a total conversion (modification) of Fallout 2, using its engine and basic mechanics, but getting completely new graphics, additional gameplay features, and a new story in a new world, not related to the Fallout series. It is the first part of the series.

title: Abiotic Factor
description: Abiotic Factor is a survival crafting experience for 1-6 players set in the depths of an underground research facility. Caught between paranormal containment failure, a military crusade, and chaos from a dozen realms, the world’s greatest minds must survive against the universe’s biggest threats.

title: Meridian 157: Prologue
description: Meridian 157: Prologue is the first in a series of point-and-click puzzle adventure games. Play as David Zander, a meteorologist who is investigating a mysterious weather signal on a remote island south of Alaska. Venture toward the remote island to discover the mystery behind the 157th meridian!

title: Wishbone: Activity Zone
description: Wishbone: Activity Zone is a game with some educational elements for children aged seven and up starring the dog Wishbone from the TV series. It contains ten activities and they are all started from central library that acts as a hub. The game contains for instance summaries for a number of classic novels and these are narrated by Wishbone. Similarly there is an activity where only the introduction of a famous story is provided and the player has to choose between different paragraphs to reconstruct the story in a logical way. The scrap book holds a collection of Wishbone photos for the player to browse.

title: Datura Time
description:
Datura Time is a third-person action-adventure game that catapults you into a realm swirling with mystery, suspense, and dynamic action. This captivating world is a tribute to the 90's console games era, handcrafted with love and passion by a single-developer, Vladeta Stojanovic, with an infusion of post-Soviet and Eastern European aesthetics.

You, the player, are plunged into an enigmatic alternative reality known as the "Zone" after an accidental encounter with a peculiar drug - "Datura". Here, you'll cross paths with a host of characters, some allies, some foes, all delivering a singular message - you are an outsider and the unfolding reality is more than meets the eye.

As you navigate this perilous world, you'll unravel the Zone's hidden truths - it's a metaphysical limbo, home to the souls of Eastern Europe and the former Soviet Union, currently under the control of malevolent entities. This sinister realm is in desperate need of a true hero - a role YOU never expected but must now embrace. Your mission? Survive, defeat the wicked forces, restore balance, and return home.

title: Weird RPG
description: "Weird RPG" is a highly difficult and fast-paced action RPG game focusing on boss battle,

title: Lost in MaLul
description:
Lost in Malul is a community made game following a streamer protagonist. After preparing to start his stream one day, the unexpected happens and his house is taken over by vile beasts. Fight with a flurry of punches and kicks to take back the house from the creatures that wish to make it their own.

In this 2D pixel beat-em-up, you will fight against enemies with multiple attacks, and larger than life bosses. Defeat enemies to get temporary power-ups and search the house for inventory items to progress through the story. This game was made by a team of devoted stream watching community members.

title: Hwajilguji
description: An entertainmental game.

title: Nick Bounty: A Case of the Crabs
description: Something stinks and it smells like crab. You play as Detective Nick Bounty, who despite his ability to solve the most tangled cases, has yet to work for a paying client. This time it’s up to you to discover who knocked off a local seafood salesman and get to the bottom of a diabolical counterfeiting operation

title: Blue Portals
description: Blue Portals is a unique Portal mod that has players traverse through new test chambers using only the single portal device and many new test elements.

title: Chell's Way to Home
description: What you would do, if everything seems to be over and you are still alive? We are pretty sure you'd like to come home. The story takes place in Half-Life universe, after being a lab rat and death of mental ai system, you should make your way in the wake of last alive members of "Aperture Transport Systems", subdivision of "Aperture Science". They're barricaded in Institute Campus, which is located on volcanic island. However, after a while the portal storm has begun, which brought Combines, Headcrabs and Antlions...

title: Portal: Project Beta
description: Using Valve assets from the video game Portal made in 2006 and maps/storyline from 2006, The Project-Beta team present a modification to Portal that allows players to play Portal 1 as it was in Late 2006, using a developer build from Valve to piece together the storyline, present Portal: Project-Beta.

title: Portal: Prospekt
description: A Portal Recreation of the Nova Prospekt Aesthetic in the early to mid 2005 beta.

title: Grove Island
description:
Trapped on a small island, you are being stalked by multiple entities but you must keep your light sources alight while you try to search the island for anything useful...
Keep your campfire and torch lit, if both go out, who knows what may be bold enough to come for you. Search the Island to collect relics but be wary of those who are watching from the shadows.

title: Koutarichou Jin'youtan: Mayoigo no Shou
description: The first of the 3-part "Koutarichou Jin'youtan" series.

title: Dessert Love: Kare to no Hajimari
description: An 18+ otome visual novel.

title: Rabio
description: Rabio is a 2D short retro-styled hardcore platformer with skill-based gameplay. Little Rabio discovers the depths of the rabbit hole, full of dangers and trials. Help him pass all the trials!

title: Shopping Clutter 4: A Perfect Thanksgiving
description: Shopping Clutter 4 - A Perfect Thanksgiving invites you to create the perfect Thanksgiving feast! Give thanks with the Walker family and create your own unique holiday traditions. Clean up the shop, set the table, and serve the best meal Animalville has seen in years! Enjoy over 150 colorful puzzles in Shopping Clutter 4 - A Perfect Thanksgiving.

title: Pinball Star
description:
Enjoy the best classic pinball game on Windows!

Remember the good old days of pinball on your computer? Now you can re-live the experience on your new Windows devices. Engage your hyperdrive, and blast into this classic game.

title: Furball Over the Front: 1938
description: Take to the skies over the western front in this fantasy world WW1 casual run and gun style sim-shooter. Fly as a heroic pilot of the Allied Empires as you take on nefarious Soviet forces.

title: ApocZ
description: ApocZ is open world survival on the northern Black Sea. Set in a post apocalyptic environment you will have to navigate walking dead zombies and other survivors. Team up with other survivors or live as a loner, but know that when you die its final.

title: Aquapark Renovator
description: Build your own water park! Use plenty of tools to renovate the aquapark. Tear up what’s old, put up the tiles and paint the different elements. Choose from multiple water slides, giant fountains, plants, and relaxation zones. Use your creativity and have fun while doing it!

title: King of the Castle
description: King of the Castle is a Twitch-integrated social narrative game for 4-4000 players. The streamer plays the Monarch while everyone else plays the squabbling Nobles of their Council, who can vote on every decision and change the course of the Kingdom's history.

title: Asia Empire 2027
description: Lead your Asian empire in an empire building turn based strategy war game. Are you ready to lead, Supreme Commander?

title: A Smooth Game Unlike Life
description: Little Jessie's adventure to find a reason to stay alive. Playable with only one hand (WSAD). Continue eating those chips with the other hand(s).

title: Assassin's Vol.
description: Assassin's Vol. is a level puzzle game.

title: I am an Air Traffic Controller 4: Airport New Chitose - RJCC
description:
This product (ATC4: Airport New Chitose [RJCC]) is DLC for "I am an Air Traffic Controller 4".
This DLC includes control of New Chitose Airport and the adjacent Chitose Air Base in Chitose, Hokkaido, Japan.

title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 2 - Collector's Edition
description:
The Collector's Edition includes:
8 extra locations with even more things to find!
8 more mini-games to solve!
Downloadable wallpapers and soundtrack to revisit Europe whenever!
Add exclusive postage stamps to your album!

title: Bill Hates Videogames
description: A comedic misadventure game about a jerk named Bill who gets sucked into a videogame. Eat trash, solve things and fart at anytime. Also it's supposed to be funny, but I don't guarantee that.

title: Billion Bastard Bots
description: Intense first-person bullet-hell arena-shooter in a fully randomised city-scape.

title: Blackjack at Carrot
description: Modern 2D Blackjack game with customizable table rules. For up to 4 local players.

title: Blade-Shift Rage
description: Blade-Shift Rage is a lightning-paced, combo-chasing 2D action platformer, with brutal one hit kills and deaths. Teleport to dodge attacks, slash and shoot anyone who stands in your way and dash to complete tough platforming challenges, chasing S-Rank scores.

title: Blessed Work
description: A new work appears, but for some reason the lack of security is everywhere, place objects, activate buttons, move things and do everything in your power to prevent your workers from dying trying to finish the construction in this lemmings-style game!

title: Blockpop Heroes
description: A parodic minimalist runner focused on jumps.

title: Bumblebee: Little Bee Adventure
description: Bumblebee: Little Bee Adventure is a story-driven, narrative 3D flight exploration game in which you control a little bee on its journey to find a new home. On its quest to find a beautiful and fitting it discovers distant places, friendly and calm animals, and amazing and dangerously habitats.

title: Calamity Sanctuary
description: Calamity Sanctuary is a roguelite action rpg with deckbuilding elements. Build your deck, acquire powerful daemons and fight your way in realtime for a chance get to safety before the prophesied Calamity strikes.

title: Call of the Golden Valley
description: Become a detective and delve into the depths of desire and motivation to solve the mystery of vanishing hikers in the Australian bush. Follow clues, solve puzzles, dive into conspiracy theories, and find your missing friend. This thrilling story is an immersive escape into a true crime-like mystery.

title: Cards from the West
description: Make your way through the dangers of the Wild West with your revolver and your deck of cards

title: Carrot Revenge
description: Rabbit was taken from his family, unknowingly where he is or for what purpose and he will be looking for revenge.

title: Car War Legends
description: Overcome dangerous obstacles, Battle against other drivers, and Race to the death in this intense car racing game!

title: Cavalier
description: The King's pup levels up! Cavalier is a single player hand drawn Metroidvania. Combat enchanted creatures while you explore the expanding map, and restore the magical kingdom in this charming medieval adventure.

title: Connected through fate
description: Romatic and dramatic Otome Game

title: Conspiracy Girls: The Madness of Madison Delaroux
description: /Conspiracy/ Girls is a visual novel about cute and funny girls who go around exposing conspiracies, and get into all sorts of trouble for doing so! A kinetic (linear) visual novel for enjoyers of internet memes, anime and anonymous message boards.

title: Crazy Edition of Stunts
description: Have you ever imagined what it's like to do all kinds of acrobatics with a car at heights like above the clouds?

title: Crimson Phoenix Rise
description: The game is a story-driven 2D platformer, with some Metroidvania aspects, where the player determines the outcome of the game based upon their “Morality” score, which itself is based upon the player's decision to kill in the game.

title: Cruise Control Mode On!
description: This is about adrenaline.

title: Crush Penguin
description: Crush Penguin is a visual novel where you must romance one of four penguins, each with their own personalities and ambitions. To offer you a unique experience the entire game is hand drawn from scratch.

title: Cursed Pantsu
description: Kaori is a good girl who always does the right thing. But one day, succumbed to temptation, she had stolen panties in the Mall... Cursed Pantsu is a story-driven action-adventure game with RPG and platforming elements about Kaori’s adventures in the Hellish Mall.

title: Deep Dungeon
description: Deep Dungeon is a rogue-lite like you have never seen before. The vast underground caves are dangerous and full of vicious enemies. There's no failsave, no checkpoints. If you die, the run is over!

title: DeerHunterFan.com TV: The Season
description: Hunt Deer that act and react differently depending on the time of the season, weather and rut stage. Bucks very in size and you will be able to hunt monster bucks that have potential to score well over 200 inches. Each successful hunt gains you EXP and you can purchase / upgrade gear and firearms.

title: Defect detector
description: Defect detector - A dynamic game for fans of the breakout genre! Find the weak point among hundreds of colored blocks and destroy defect after defect in this exciting game! Collect bonuses, hit the ball accurately and get to the end!

title: Havoc
description:
Experience intense, team-based action in Havoc, a tactical FPS that takes the genre to new heights with semi-destructible environments. Use strategy and skill to plant and defuse bombs, destroy walls to reach your target, and more. Immerse yourself in team-based action across various game modes, including bomb defusal, team deathmatch, and more.

Havoc introduces semi-destructible environments, adding a whole new layer of strategy to the gameplay. Destroy walls and obstacles to create new paths, catch opponents off guard, and create distractions. Every match is filled with unexpected twists and turns, keeping you on your toes and demanding quick thinking and skill.

With multiple game modes at your disposal, you can choose the experience that suits your preferences. Engage in high-stakes bomb defusal matches, where teamwork and strategy are essential. Or jump into team deathmatch mode and engage in epic battles against 5 other players. The choice is yours.

Havoc allows you to customize your lobby settings, giving you control over gravity, movement, and more. Tailor the game to your liking, whether you prefer fast-paced, gravity-defying combat or a more grounded and realistic approach.

Prepare to defend bomb sites, plan your strategies, and customize your loadout to emerge as the winning team. Havoc offers an immersive and customizable experience that will keep you hooked. Gear up, dive into the action, and embrace the chaos of Havoc now!

title: Demolish or Die
description: Demolish or Die is an open world third person action game that takes place in a destructible, dystopian city.

title: Deputinization
description: Deputinization is run and gun action game focused on boss battles. The game features pixel graphics and music that is rooted in Ukrainian culture.

title: Derp Souls
description: Flailing, Flatulence. It's fine. Some appliances have kidnapped your blowup doll soulmate, so go save her!

title: Detriot
description: A political satire micro-management arcade game. Balance your time juggling a series of responsiblities in the ever chaotic City of Detroit, and see how long you can last!

title: Dinoblits
description: Create your dino chief, lead your tribe. Survive waves of enemies, explore and settle on foreign islands. Find a way to avoid extinction!

title: Eclipse: Shine of Dawn
description: Eclipse: Shine of Dawn is a game with a Fantasy RPG aesthetic that combines the best of storytelling and hack 'n slash elements, unique characters, memorable enemies, and immersive puzzles in a pleasant setting, whether to think, admire, or beat down hordes of monsters. As you progress through the story, unlock new weapons, abilities, and emotions that deliver unique moments in a completely epic way.

title: Elland: The Crystal Wars
description: After 20 years, experience the never-before-released Game Boy Advance game Elland: The Crystal Wars. As an ace raptor pilot, protect the Gatherers as they harvest the precious Crystal from the remote desert world of Elland from the vicious forces of the Trafford Corporation.

title: Endless Engines
description: Endless Engines is an endless roguelike dungeon crawler where you play as a bandit aboard the Endless Engine, a never-ending train that travels through time and space.

title: English A-Game
description: English A-game is a comprehensive English course in the form of a video game. It is a fun English language game to teach you basic English up to upper intermediate level. Included are an in-game user guide and English grammar tutorial for self-study. Designed for Polish learners of English.

title: Eon Fighter
description: Eon fighters, key to our survival, collect resources to sustain the war against different invading civilizations. Join this huge task, upgrade your ship and weapons to survive waves of increasingly difficult enemies!

title: Epic Survivors
description: Face thousands of simultaneous enemies in Epic Survivors, a fast-paced action roguelite! Pick heroes with unique weapons, two powerful abilities, and collect random weapons each run. Battle relentless foes with diverse attack patterns, dynamic events with epic rewards, and intense boss encounters!

title: Escape Chase Monster
description: "Escape Chase Monster" is an action game. Run away from monsters, shoot guns and reach the goal.

title: Escape Condition
description: A time-travel adventure RPG with multiple endings that asks: How do we move forward without repeating the mistakes of the past?

title: The Eyes of Dr Kautzmann
description: The Eyes of Dr Kautzmann is a first-person point-and-click detective game inspired by German expressionist cinema. Solve environmental puzzles to uncover the tragic history and secrets of a doomed town.

title: Umbral Core
description: Umbral Core is a 2.5D fighting game set in a world of dark high fantasy. It features rollback netcode, uncapped FPS, engaging combat mechanics for players across all skill levels and lots of customization options. Kickstarter and public demo coming soon!

title: Trader of the Night
description: A horror-themed stock market simulator where the player must make enough money to pay their debt in time. Buy, sell and short shares in fictional companies, earn dividends, pay taxes and follow the in-game news for possible hints on what to invest in. No previous experience in stock market required.

title: Warpaws
description: Let slip the dogs of war or embrace your inner feline and settle the age-old question of Cats vs Dogs, in this quick-to-learn classic RTS game where players fight over territory to eventually destroy their opponent’s base. One side may have nine lives, but even the good bois can get ruff!

title: Maze Blaze
description: Maze Blaze is filled with endless possibilities. Lock and load, then enter at your own peril.

title: Memory
description:
Created in 48 hours for Ludum Dare 54, "Limited Space"

Choose which memories to save on each milestone of your life, and try to live positively overall.

title: Farm Wars
description: Set a price for your farm and protect it. Your shapeshifter farmer will help you harvest your farm and destroy your rival’s farm. Farm Wars is a top-down PvP farm game against time. Create a strategy for your opponent and purchase their farm. Pay attention to the mines while making your attack!

title: Femboy Bangers 2
description: A late night drive around town in search of pizza has you stumbling upon a new establishment.

title: FFF
description: FFF is an idle merge game about friendship and love…and a microwave. Everything is entirely fictional and made up. It's not based on actual events or people. Due to poor content and ugly art style, the game should not be played by anyone… Maybe except you. You are special.

title: Final Knight
description: Retro console-style beat 'em up action RPG, Giant weapons, massive monsters, Lightning Ring, 9 fantasy classes, and Sword of Legend.

title: I Love Finding More Pups: Collector's Edition
description: Who doesn’t love finding pups?

title: Finger Soccer
description: Finger Soccer is a button soccer game where you flick to score incredible goals from midfield! Choose from over 30 teams, compete in tournaments, penalty shootouts, and many more. Play solo or with friends, and become a finger football champion!

title: Football Coach: College Dynasty
description: A true college football management game. Play as a coach or a school, recruit players, develop your team, and compete for national championships. Build a college football dynasty in a realistic and customizable league with up to 90 teams.

title: Forbidden zone
description: Be a survivor in a massive open world with the radioactive mutant. Explore the new ultra-realistic world, find your community, crafter your best weapons, and survive the regions.

title: Forest Dongmul
description: Play as a cute lamb as he tries with his friend to return to the mysterious FOREST that he once grew up in. (With cute 2D pixelated top down graphics.)

title: Forest Spring
description: With the arrival of spring, it is necessary to clear the forests, but you will get blood, not dust, on your hands. Do you have the courage for this ?

title: Forge Industry
description: Forge your destiny as a blacksmith! Automate your workshops, optimize your supply chain, research new materials, craft legendary weapons, and cast your place in the world.

title: Forklift Extreme: Deluxe Edition
description: An exceptional physical experience with unique visuals and super smooth, yet demanding gameplay

title: For Mother Matron
description:
Lizzy is a girl living in The Boarding, a walled city surrounded by fog. All who live here serve the mysterious Mother Matron, its revered leader who hasn’t been seen in person in many years. Periodically, the Mother Matron selects residents to become Surveyors, tasked with exploring the dark unknown tunnels that lie underground to find the key to a better future for the collective. The odds of survival are slim to none. It is an honor and a death sentence. One day, Lizzy finds herself on the draft.

Using your wits and quick thinking, you must guide Lizzy through the dangers beneath. Will you survive? Will you find Paradise? Or will you be lost to the dark forever?

title: Formula Retro Racing: World Tour
description: A retro racer updated for the modern age, rediscover nostalgic racing as you drive through iconic locations in Formula Retro Racing: World Tour. Fusing 90s-style arcade racing with realistic physics, split-screen multiplayer, and 60fps performance. With new tracks and car types!

title: Fortune: Rewritten
description: Fortune: Rewritten is a PvP, or PvE experience! Battle in head-to-head combat where only one can be the winner!

title: Fraction Reaction
description: Craft potions using your knowledge of fractions to help the animals and defeat the robots!

title: Fraim
description: Fraim is a fun survival rhythm aim trainer that makes you improve faster by challenging you to your fullest by introducing difficulties and level overrides. Miss too many targets and it's game over! Focused mostly on fast small adjustment shots which are highly relevant for in high-skilled FPS.

title: Girls vs. Zombies
description: "Girls vs Zombies": Multiplayer cooperative 3D tower defense. Grab your gun and fight with friends against Eastern and Western demons, or oversee and deploy beautiful girls, defending against zombie waves with swords, guns, and magic!

title: Girls slap
description: This is an exquisite fighting game for beautiful girls. You can choose more than 14 beautiful girl characters. The classic fighting system ensures that you can get started easily.

title: Girl and Chainsaw
description: In a world after the zombie pandemic disaster.A third-person 3D action game with an emphasis on control and exhilaration, where you smash zombies and other creatures while spraying blood with a chainsaw like in a B-movie!

title: Gimmiko
description: The world is frozen in an endless night, trapped under a shadowblighted moon. Demons from the collective subconcious are leaking into reality. Save the world from the curse of the Jabberwock in this wacky dicebuilding roguelite!

title: Ghost of Ice Valley
description: Ghost of Ice valley is a Visual Novel where you follow multiple different storylines and make choices according to what you believe the characters may do in that situation. Interact in the Interview system to find out more about the characters and about yourself as you go along.

title: Ghost of Fall
description: "Ghost of Fall" is a 2d side scroller adventure, story driven game with rythm based combat, high quality pixel art and high production value soundtrack.

title: Ghost Knight: A Dark Tale
description: Ghost Knight: A Dark Tale is a 2.5D action platformer, set in a toon dark fantasy world, where a mad king, in search for immortality, opens portals to a dark dimension. As Ghost Knight, a spirit bound to a suit of armour, you must traverse an epic land of monsters to stop The Mad King.

title: Ghost at Dawn
description: Explore an abandoned hotel and search for clues while trying not to succumb to your fears in this ode to 90’s survival horror games. You will solve puzzles, face off against supernatural entities, and use limited resources to maintain your sanity so you can explore deeper in The Pines Hotel and find out what really happened to Emi Kosuke.

title: Geese and Gats
description: A take on the classic round-based survival game. But the geese have spears

title: Gas Station Simulator: Party Time
description: The party is about to start with new content in this free DLC. Collectables, popularity boosts and ice cream to get everyone excited!

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Aquarion
description: Having risen from the depths of the ocean to fight in Square-wide struggle, the underwater-breathing, fish-like Aquarion have summoned their aquatic allies to take dominion over their land-dwelling kin.

title: Touhou: Dreamland of Infinity
description: "Helping to construct my dreamland, you can take away an artifact of your choice from the dreamland..." To help Doremy Sweet, the Master of the Dreamland, using different Gensokyo girls and their magnificent projectiles, facing the challenges in the endless dreamland!

title: Autumn Spirit
description: Hunted by anxiety, you exiled yourself to a lonely mountain inhabited by a ghost and his regrets.

title: Corebreaker
description: Corebreaker is a fast-paced action-platformer game with rogue-like elements. Play as Nova, a robot designed to awaken when humanity is extinct by the machines. Unlock abilities, upgrades and powerful weapons as you fight your way through supreme robots to find out your purpose!

title: Terra: A Terraria Demake
description: A demake of Terraria, in PICO-8!

title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 2
description: Prepare for a journey through 30 amazing tourist spots around Europe! Hunt for hidden objects and solve brain-teasing mini-games as you visit the Paleontological Museum in Paris, see the Pena Palace in Portugal, enjoy a walk in Bruges, and even ride the tram in Lisbon!

title: Stickman Trenches
description: Stickman Trenches is a Real Time Strategy game in which you need to manage your men and weapons and build up your defenses in the brutal trenches of Stick World War 1.

title: The Human Story
description: The Human Story is a hidden object game set in a colorful, historically accurate miniature world. Explore different cultures and ages. Find characters, objects and little stories about our ancestors. Learn about their lives and piece together the history of humankind.

title: Little Witchelsa: Pumpkin Peril
description: Enter the world of witches and solve all kinds of puzzles in this fun blend of match 3 and hidden object game!

title: Police Interceptors
description: High-speed, adrenaline-packed car chases right in the middle of rush hour in a big city. Face multiple challenges and put your skills to the test. There’s a call coming in – bring those perps into custody!

title: Polylithic
description: The Polylithic is a 3rd person crafting survival set in the Paleolithic/Neolithic era where the player crafts items, unlocks technology, discovers the world, builds bases, and can either grow the tribe and command the settlement or play the game solo.

title: Unforgettable Voyage
description: Unforgettable Journey is casual pirate themed sokoban-like puzzle adventure game.

title: Veridian Expanse
description: Explore the depths as you drill, craft, and fight to escape from a mysterious asteroid deep in the Veridian Expanse.

title: Path to Ruin
description: - Classic turn-based combat - Story and exploration driven progression - Hybrid visual style combining hand-drawn and pixel art - Dark comedy combined with heartfelt character interactions - Original soundtrack specifically written to fit the story and events

title: Parkour Legends
description: A precision platformer with air-tight controls, inspired by the thrill of movement and momentum in free running. Sprint, slide, roll, rebound, grab onto ledges, and run across walls to complete hundreds of hand-crafted courses as quickly as possible (and find hidden collectibles along the way).

title: Extermination Cars Stadium
description: Extermination Cars Stadium presents a new type of racing - competition game where only one can emerge victorious.

title: Extreme Truck Stunts
description: We think you've heard a lot of legends about how hard it is to be a real truck driver.

title: Dwarf's Adventure
description: Creation, exploration, survival, strategy, roguelike. Can you find the exit and complete all the objectives proposed in each dungeon? Create your own levels and share them with the Community via the workshop. Show the world your own creations!

title: Flappy Bat 2
description: It's a Halloween night and Flappy Bat is trying to make his way home. Can you help the Flappy Bat navigate through numerous procedurally generated obstacles. Flap your way past enemies and obstacles and compete on the global leader board for the ultimate top score!

title: Government Simulator 2
description: Government Simulator 2 is based on real world statistics and data and lets you control a whole country, like the USA, Germany, UK, France, Russia, and others: Change laws, taxes and budgets, and see what happens. Manage emergencies, impose tariffs, start wars.

title: Bandit Realms
description: A medieval turn-based strategy card game with a procedurally generated world map to explore and conquer.

title: Water City
description: In the Dome of D'Sparil there is an ancient underwater city that has recently been taken over by the minions of the dark wizard. It is your responsibility to remove the foul presence of these evil creatures from this place! City of the Damned? That was mere practice compared to the beings you must face here!

title: Thistlemine
description: Thistlemine is a puzzle RPG that tells a story about the work that takes place within an Anomalis Exclusion Zone – a hostile environment where space and time are warped, and the thick miasma suffocates those trapped within.

title: Ludde
description: Explore a charming winter world with Ludde and discover various exciting, challenging, and fun activities for all ages!

title: VanillaBeast: Retro Knock-Out!
description:
VB Retro Knock-Out! is the first prequel chapter to VanillaBeast: Ace in the Hole. Follow Vanilla as he works through the boxing ranks facing off against tons of parody boxing opponents on his way to the undisputed champion of the Venereousville Boxing Association.. Tike Myson.

Experience nostalgic game play and visuals as you battle over 30 parody opponents in your quest to become the champ. Retro Knock-Out! is a “pick up and play” arcade boxing game with beautiful pixel art, incredible arenas, mature story, and fast-paced arcade style game play.

title: Our Passing Thoughts
description: 【 It’s like catch but the ball is the ability to jump. 】 Take on the role as one of two creatures in this imaginative co-op experience that tests how well you and your friend get along. Explore a broken world together and discover what is valuable, and what remains just a passing thought.

title: Sneaky Rat
