description: Push mirrors, hide behind boxes, don't be seen by the cat and get the cheese. In this fun puzzle.

title: Gigantosaurus Dino Kart
description: Race around Cretacia in a prehistoric kart championship for up to 4 players of all ages, where you can play as your favorite dino friends and even bump into the mysterious Gigantosaurus himself!

title: Need for Speed: Unbound
description: Race against time, outsmart the cops, and take on weekly qualifiers to reach The Grand, Lakeshore's ultimate street racing challenge. Pack your garage with precision-tuned, custom rides and light up the streets with your style, exclusive fits, and a vibrant global soundtrack that bumps in every corner of the world.

title: Web3War
description:
Web3War, the multiplayer shooter developed by Roll1ng Thund3rz and incubated by Zilliqa, delivers an exciting and competitive FPS experience that rivals the top shooting games on the market.
The game offers action-packed gameplay, tactical maps, custom load-outs, weapon skins, progression, and many more of the features found in many of the best FPS games.

Web3War also uses blockchain technology to allow players to earn valuable rewards from playing the game. Unlike most other Web3 games,

title: Elite Soldier Shooter
description: Sometimes there are tasks where SWAT can not handle... and then you appear — Elite Soldier. You are the "champion" on special assignments.

title: Car Racing: Highway Driving Simulator
description: Car Racing Highway Driving Simulator - start your engines and step on the gas!

title: Beeny
description: A vertical 2D platformer featuring a round bee in an early 90s pre-rendered environment. Roll and hop up to the precious honey.

title: Maximum Velocity
description:
Maximum Velocity is a high-stakes, high-speed racing game looking to shake up the racing genre forever. Join your friends and take on challenges in an immersive, ever-changing world. Drift, drag, or sprint your way around Industrial City and discover hidden secrets to the lore and ever-evolving story.
Drive the way you want to.

Upgrade your vehicles to handle the way you want them to. Make them as fast as you want or as drifty as you wish. You are in control of your car and how it handles. Unlock performance parts by exploring the city and doing challenges to get rewards and upgrades.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Elyrion
description: Elyrion is Polytopia’s second Special Tribe! Emerging from isolation in a mystical forest, the Elyrion will stop at nothing to uncover the magical secrets of the Square. The Elyrion are known for surrounding themselves in the magic of the forests, using their powers to lure woodland denizens to their Sanctuaries for profit, bargain with awesome dragons, and enchant animals into soldiers to help them fight.

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Cymanti
description:
Have you ever felt that the cute denizens of the Polytopian world needed more bugs in their lives? Well, you’re in luck, because the Cymanti have come from the heart of the wetlands to infest the Square through the power of gigantic bugs and poisonous fungus!

The Cymanti are a breakout group of Polytopians who moved to the swampy forests long ago and learned to live in symbiosis with the incredible Ciru Bug, which attaches to their faces and merges with their brains! These bug-loving Polytopians cultivate fungus that they use to feed their population and defend themselves from invaders! Led by a mystical Shaman, the Cymanti train gigantic bugs, use their enemies to fertilize their fungi farms, and bathe their foes in crippling poisons to vanquish all who would threaten their marshy home!

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Polaris
description: Polaris is Polytopia’s third Special Tribe! From the frozen wastes emerge the Polaris, servants of the mysterious Gaami, who are hellbent on freezing the Square into a new frigid paradise. Imbued with icy powers granted by their overlords, the Polaris construct adorable Mooni, freeze the waters, shatter their foes, and diligently work their way toward an unforeseen fate...

title: The Battle of Polytopia: Deluxe
description:
In addition to The Battle of Polytopia the game, the Deluxe bundle includes the Aquarion, Elyrion, Polaris and Cymanti Tribes
Includes 11 items: The Battle of Polytopia, Aquarion Tribe, Elyrion Tribe, Polaris Tribe, Cymanti Tribe, Aquarion Skin, Elyrion Skin, and Skin Packs 1-4

title: Memory: The Original Matching Game from Ravensburger
description:
Everyone knows it, everybody loves it: hardly any other game manages to bring young and old together more than this.
Pick up two cards: if they match, you keep them and can uncover two more cards. If they’re different, they stay in play and it’s the next player’s turn. The player with the most pairs of cards at the end is the winner!

title: Kalyskah: Jungle Trouble!
description: In this short story, the vampire Kalyskah and her friend Merishya, a succubus, explore a jungle searching for a portal that could take the demoness back home. Things were going well until funny things started to happen.

title: Weaponeer
description: Control your character with two buttons and fight your way through 90+ levels of retro platforming that introduce new and original content.

title: Raining Blood: Hellfire
description: Annihilate countless hordes of enemies while unraveling the mysteries of the demonic invasion in this CoD Zombies-inspired bullet Hell. Kill, upgrade, explore, die, repeat.

title: Undertale Tag
description: A solo co-op experience. Control two humans with one SOUL in a new UNDERGROUND with four official endings (with differing variations).

title: Halt
description: HALT is a story-driven run-&-gun platformer that combines classic RPG-style gameplay with intense arcade action-platforming.

title: Songs for a Hero 2: March of Malachi
description: Songs for a Hero 2: March of Malachi is an upcoming sequel to the 2D musical platform game, with a brand new story about a world that lives in the shadow of the memory of a once prosperous king, that has been mysteriously dethroned by a ruthless tyrant who rules through fear and brute force. But when the world needs saving most, legends from the past bring forth a new Hero. Experience a new chapter of this saga with a brand-new hero and his many allies, each one of them with their own singing voice. Unravel the mysteries behind the new Hero, help him develop his skills, fight iconic bosses and face Malachi's terrifying army!

title: Prepare for Adventure
description: One day, the protagonist gets teleported to a new, unknown town. She wants to go on adventures right away, but the guards won't let her, because she's not properly prepared. She shall fix this predicament.

title: Necro Saga
description: The story of you and the immortals begins in a kingdom about to be destroyed by a necromancer. You can give someone mercy, or you can take someone's precious things away. This is an action RPG where you decide the ending of the story.

title: 11111Game
description: Master addition in different bases. Slide tiles to add them, take advantage of overflow mechanic and game's grid.
1990 is a fun, casual RPG with turn-based combat.

title: 2 Pattern
description: What about taking an atmospheric trip through a sliding puzzle game ?

title: 32 in 1 Game Special
description: A tribute to those less then stellar computer shareware and multicart games of the past, 32 in 1 features many different game genres, some with a odd sense of humor. Games mainly lean on point scores ,speed runs and survival, all to give you the player a sense of pride and accomplishment!

title: 3 Crystals
description: 3 Crystals is a free twin stick shooter. Protect the Crystals!

title: 3D Don't Die Mr Robot
description: Fresh from the Neon Dunjun, Mr. Robot returns in the third dimension!

title: 4D Golf

title: Actala: The Hero's Shadow
description: The fairy tale is over. The Hero won. But the story is just beginning. Explore the web of intrigue in this emotional, suspenseful visual novel, depicted with hundreds of unique, animated illustrations. Who is the hero, and who is the villain? Who lives, and who dies? Your choices will decide.

title: Adanath
description: Adanath is a 2.5D side scrolling single player, action and exploration oriented, story based adventure game with a fluid & innovative PvE combat system.

title: Aerial Platforms
description: Aerial Platforms is a first person platformer game. Run your way through levels, before the timer hits 0:00, jumping on different platforms while ("the floor is lava")

title: Aero GPX
description: Aero GPX is an anti-gravity racer focused on high velocity, flight, machine-to-machine combat, and responsive controls that are easy to pick up but difficult to master. Fight for the best position possible with high speeds, risky maneuvers, and visceral attacks!

title: Aery: Calm Mind 3
description: Calm down from the hassle of your daily life, experience the feeling of flying, and immerse yourself into beautiful and atmospheric landscapes.

title: Aery: Heaven & Hell
description: Discover the passions and fears of the human race as a flying god-like creature.

title: A Friend Called Loneliness
description: A Friend Called Loneliness is a third-person exploration game based on the song from The Beatles, Eleanor Rigby. Uncover the truth of our main character Norra, as she will leave you clues through her poems that she has written.

title: Amok Runner
description: One day, a noble woman turns our protagonist's (the doctor) life upside down by visiting his clinic, in a town where the amok madness is rampant. The doctor leaves all his personal effects and career aside and begins to follow this woman's footsteps while fighting against the deadly amok syndrome.

title: Ankh Tower: Protect the Fortress with Dark Magic
description: Ankh Tower is a dark-fantasy rogue-like strategy. In the depths of darkness, the Ankh remains the only bastion of life. Build your tower wisely using the offensive, defensive and magical capabilities of its floors. Develop your arsenal of spells to defeat evil forces. Protect the Ankh and survive.

title: Ascend: Reborn
description: Ascend Reborn is an old-school, 3rd person action RPG. Wage war as a brutal Caos warrior on your journey to Ascension. The reign of the Titans has come to an end. The New Gods have risen to claim ultimate power and need a champion. Will you rise to the challenge?

title: Astraea
description: Unleash bolts, set traps, and bash through relentless hordes of minions to protect a little girl from Hera’s wrath.

title: Astral Tournament: A prequel of the Astral Masters
description: This DLC contains a special collection build of Astral Tournament game dedicated to it's 20th anniversary (first published on SEP-23-2002). This is the first game of the Astral games series and the direct ancestor of Spectromancer game.

title: Awakening of Legend
description: Awakening of Legend is a free, retro-inspired, rogue-like adventure with randomized loot, transferable perks and combat inspired by the Active Time Battle (ATB) system from old school JRPGs.

title: Azarine Heart
description: What will you sacrifice; for the safety of your sister?

title: Elite Dangerous: Commander Premium Edition
description: Take control of your own starship in a cutthroat galaxy. Elite Dangerous is the definitive massively multiplayer space epic. Includes Elite Dangerous: Odyssey, and the Elite Dangerous: Odyssey OST.

title: Beyond the Pines
description: Beyond the Pines is a first-person, story-driven, psychological horror game, inspired by the partnership between Owner and Dog, and the impact when that relationship is threatened, set in a remote cabin, with influences from Welsh folklore and beyond.

title: BoozeBall
description: Booze ball is a casual sports game. Test your aim and reactions against an increasingly difficult computer player to see how many levels you can beat!

title: Boxes: Lost Fragments
description: As a legendary thief, your next assignment lures you into a grand and lavish mansion. There you find a series of puzzle boxes, designed for an unknown purpose. What should have been a quick in-and-out, gradually turns into your own harrowing struggle for freedom and answers.

title: Budgie Genetics Simulator
description: Breed budgies and discover hidden colour mutations in this realistic genetics simulator.

title: Call to Arms: Gates of Hell - Scorched Earth
description: The “Scorched Earth” expansion redefines the Eastern Front with a stunning arsenal for multiplayer, plus brand new single player content to complete the most brutal theater of the war. From the Siege of Sevastopol to the very last offensives of WWII in the east.

title: Camouflet
description: Camouflet is a short first-person action-horror game During WW1, You are placed in a fighting tunnel under the front lines. With just a shovel, you must recover lost weaponry, reopen passages and place explosives at your objectives.

title: Cannon Shoot Plane
description: A Light 2D Shooter Game. Planes will come from both sides. Don't let them escape. 25 levels in total.

title: Cat Herder
description: Cat Herder is a cute and chaotic little puzzle game about literally herding cats! Pick them up, entice them with toys, and learn their preferences as you wrangle them into the target zones as quickly as possible.

title: City Metro Simulator
description: In this simulator you will act as a metro driver driving above the city. T

title: ClasSimVR
description: ClasSimVR is a serious game and an exploratory platform targeted at helping pre-service teacher learn about challenging student behaviour.

title: Clutter's Greatest Hits: Collector's Edition
description: The most addicting Un-Hidden Object game you'll ever play, Clutter 13 is the most fun & challenging Clutter yet. Over 2000 puzzles will keep you playing for days and days. Featuring 25% more puzzles and additional bonus materials.

title: Coffee For Robots
description: An atmospheric café simulation game. Run a small, peaceful café serving coffee to the robot denizens of the world.

title: Coin Flipper
description: Heads or tails? Coin Flipper is an idle clicker game that is all about flipping lots of coins. Upgrade your coin flips and get even more coins to flip!

title: CorpoNation: The Sorting Process
description: Greetings, valued employee. You have been tasked with sorting the Ringo CorpoNation's genetic samples. With the credits that you earn, you can shop, game and pay your bills on time. Rogue workers may try to entice you into betraying your beloved employer, but we know you'll give 110%.

title: CustomBullet
description: Endless customization and exhilarating robot action!Speed, power, size, all at your own will.An overwhelming sense of speed that runs through the body.Huge craters and concrete jungles create high-speed battles.Game for Robo-Game Fans.

title: Cute Fight
description: Let's have a cute battle!

title: Danger Ducklings
description: Cautiously navigate 2 cute but not-so-bright ducklings through dangerous puzzles. You'll need to keep track of both ducks' movements at once in over 100 asymmetrical levels. Collect stars to unlock new modes, costumes, and levels. Complete jobs on construction sites, in castles, and even in space!

title: Disembowel
description: Disembowel is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players. You are a reporter who travels around the world documenting the darkest secrets and mysteries that inhabit the planet. Prepare your camera, gather a team and start suffering.

title: Wunderling DX
description: Dash, jump, and fly at full speed through Wunderling DX: a non-stop puzzle platformer and the world's first "goomba simulator"! Race against the clock, beat tricky puzzles to uncover shiny secrets, and stomp the odds to please your evil overlord!

title: Dragonfield
description: Fight in epic medieval fantasy sandbox battles! Use swords, shields, bows, magic spells, ballistas, catapults and more. Ride armored horses and fly giant dragons. Or just watch armies of bots battle it out with ragdoll physics and destructible environments!

title: Drift racing car
description: This is a racing game that can drift flexibly. You can make your own game vehicles, vehicle hubs and friction smoke. Multi vehicle viewing angle, arbitrary switching

title: Dummy Dungeon
description: Fight your way through randomly generated dungeons in this hardcore rouge-lite game. Discover your favorite character from a group of unique heroes, get powerful weapons and power-ups to save beautiful princesses in need.

title: Fabric of Reality
description: In this game, you are the bullet hell. Face off against 100 waves of enemies and bosses by collecting a deck of attack cards that activate in real-time to unleash destruction upon everything in sight. There's an insane amount of customizability leading to an infinitely replayable experience.

title: R-Type Final 2: DLC Set 8
description: Includes 2 new stages.

title: Old World: Complete
description:
The complete bundle for the game Old World, may be expanded to include all future DLC and Expansions released for the game.
Currently includes:

- Old World
Old World is a revolutionary new strategy game where you lead your dynasty over generations of rule against rival kings and queens. Wage massive wars, manage your court, and build a dynasty — or watch your empire crumble to dust. What legacy will you leave behind?

- Heroes of the Aegean
Old World - Heroes of the Aegean asks you to lead Athens to victory in the Battle of Marathon, defend Greece from a Persian invasion as Leonidas and his 300 Spartans, and conquer the Hellenic world as Alexander the Great himself in a series of scenarios spanning over 200 years.

- The Sacred and The Profane
Experience over 350 new events, recruit new historical characters, and deal with the demands of the clergy as you try and appease the various faiths that exist within the Old World.

title: Vlad Circus: Descend Into Madness
description: Vlad Circus: Descend into Madness puts your sanity to the test, challenging you to escape a labyrinth of nightmares and torment. Test your mind against a slow burn of puzzles, light survival mechanics, and methodical action.

title: Fight Until Death
description: Are you ready to Fight Until Death?

title: Fishton: A Town to Remember
description: An open world, survival, mechanical simulation game set in a small town. Cruise around town in a new car or a piece of junk you pieced together with scrap. Race for money and glory. Solve the mystery that's been casting a shadow over this pleasant town for so long.

title: Gamedec: Definitive Edition
description: Gamedec is a single-player cyberpunk isometric RPG. You are a game detective, who solves crimes inside virtual worlds. Use your wits to gather info from your witnesses and suspects, getting to the bottom of deceptive schemes. The game continually adapts to your decisions and never judges.

title: Fix My Hand Doc
description: Fix My Hand Doc is a simulator that teaches you how to proceed in various extreme situations. Your mission is to be a doctor who will have to treat the hands of different patients.

title: Flawless
description: Flawless （完美无瑕） is a third-person puzzle adventure game about a nightmare a schoolboy dreamed about. This third-person puzzle adventure probably could help you fix your relationship with your parents.

title: Forbidden World
description: Penetrate deeper into the Forbidden World. Fulfill your fantasies in your own private dungeon. From the creators of SinVR, Forbidden World is the destination for provocative and amusing adult entertainment, for your PC or in VR.

title: Girbal
description: "Girbal" is a single player sci-fi Puzzle platformer in which the player solves various puzzles including matching sequences, object size manipulation, and much more using number of tools such as a grappling hook, jet-pack, gravity well generator, and more to overcome these obstacles.

title: Girls! Girls! Girls!?
description: Step into Girls! Girls! Girls!? Café in this heartwarming, romance-filled visual novel. As the new manager, charm your way into the hearts of 4 captivating "ladies", throw parties, tackle unruly customers, and create unforgettable memories in a tale full of fluff and love!

title: Gnomonic
description:
GNOMONIC – The Art RPG! In this ART-PG, walk through watercolor paintings, fight in real-time projectile battles, solve puzzles with shadows, meet friends with creative talents in worlds themed by artistic mediums, and discover a story about how we experience art…
and how art experiences us.

title: Gods of Defense
description: Next level in Tower Defense Rogue-like game progression. GoD offers a bunch of novel mechanics that allow you to craft your unique play style. In addition to traditional weapon towers, you can play with Tornadoes and Dragons. You can worship your favorite Gods to unlock their specials attacks.

title: Golden Egg
description: A young knight is looking for a golden egg in a magic world. But countless dangers are lurking. 3D Jump and Run

title: Golfinite
description: Play golf, complete challenges, buy new gear, gain experience, level up, and compete in tournaments on your quest to become a Professional Golfer! Golfinite is a fun and relaxing golf game, where each course, challenge, and playthrough is unique.

title: Good Bear
description: Good Bear is a game about bears. It has mini games, fun mechanics, simple puzzles, and some more challenging encounters. There are different environments to explore, characters to interact with, and treasures to discover. Help the bears prepare for their picnic!

title: Grapple Gal
description: A linear 3D platform where you race through a destroyed future. Play as Bullet, an augmented human with incredible abilities and speed. Navigate environments using your grappling arm, using the momentum you've built to fly through stages at amazing distances.

title: Grapple Gunners
description: A fast-paced multiplayer experience about grappling hooks and guns! Play against friends and compete to be the winner in this action-packed PvP game! Fight to be the last one standing across 30 unique maps!

title: Grave-Queen
description: Perpetual and infinite energy used to be sought after, but now it's a reality, and it's caused problems. These problems can only be solved with some sick combos.

title: Hard Life
description: This game is a survival game. Even though there are zombies in the game, the biggest challenge is the cold-temperature balance. The SandBox mod of the game is under construction. Apart from that, there are 3 different sections. The goal is to reach the farthest corner of the map.

title: Haunted: Attack of the Dead Men
description: Inspired by the most epic and little known battle of the Great War, Haunted: Attack of the Dead Men puts you in the middle of a chaotic fight for your life against hundreds of resurrected Russians. Put your arsenal of 8 weapons to good use through 14 levels as you rid the world of this nightmare...

title: Havenview
description: Havenview is a rogue-lite looter shooter based in the nineties. Battle your way from Suburbia to the depths of the alien mothership as you search for upgrades to your lazer to help you banish the invaders of Havenview. Coming soon!

title: Haxware Comgam
description: Comgam is a free game that you can play that takes place in the Haxware universe. Configure a team of 5, & take them online to battle other players around the world to prove that your configured team is the best.

title: Mushroom Card RPG
description: An RPG/visual novel engine. Visualized no-code editing.

title: Kimi mo vtuber ni Naranai?
description: New free novel game "Will you become a vtuber too?" One day, you came to the virtual world Return to the real world? Or... would you make another choice? A story that changes depending on your choices.

title: Charlie's Delivery
description: The game includes love, peace, environment, science, dreams, friendship, ambition, passion and NO SAVE. TRY IT NOW!

title: Heavy Hearts
description: If humans are near extinction - and have become a rarity. In many cases, denizens would love to get their hands on one. Luccia's quest is to stop the decline of human civilization in this action RPG, where love and lust get in the way of the mission.

title: Hell Grocery
description: This is a simulated business game with the theme of hell. The player will play the zombie girl to open a grocery store in the underworld. You can expand the store and decorate freely, and even hire employees to improve their skills.

title: Heroes Raid
description: Enter a dark dystopian world that combines demons, guns, swords, magic, monsters and modern technology. Raid alone or with your friends, craft your unique playstyle by mixing and matching abilities between heroes. Raids, Builds, Team PvP, and Solo PvP await.

title: Hover Muscle
description: Hover Muscle is a modern take on old school arcade racing games featuring V8 Powered "Hover" Muscle Cars, tons of customization, competitive leaderboards and a high energy Rock OST.

title: Howlbreath
description: Free to play desktop (64-bit Windows) fantasy MMORPG featuring medieval combat and lots of spells, weapons, armor, and items to find and help grow your character. Party with fellow players to hunt stronger monsters or the enemy town.

title: Hunting grounds
description: Hunting grounds - Take on a fleet of space pirates as you pilot your starship in this arcade shoot'em up! Blow up enemies and collect bonuses in the vastness of the vast space and break new score records. How far can you go on this adventure?

title: Hunting Labyrinth
description: Shelared found that she had been cursed by a powerful monster in the labyrinth. There is no other way to remove the curse than to conquer the labyrinth. Shelared, who was sent to the church, began to conquer the labyrinth in order to remove the curse.

title: Idle Heros
description: 《IDLE HEROS》 is a special placement game, invite your friends to form a fixed team, come to participate in the battle, placement can easily obtain a variety of resources

title: I Live Under Your House.
description: You are a monster under someone's house.

title: Kalt
description: Explore and survive in the harsh weather conditions of northern lands.

title: Katana Arena
description: Slice your enemies in different gory arenas by yourself or with your friends. Earn battle points and use them to upgrade your skills and looks.

title: Kawaii Asian Girls
description: Kawaii Asian Girls - It's a relaxing anime puzzles game with cute kawaii asian girls. Solve puzzles, and collect full images. Enjoy high quality artworks.

title: Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls
description: Re-Enter The World Of Kaz's Adventure And Travel Through The Underworld In 5 New Amazing Worlds With New Graphics And Ability's!

title: Keiko-san (47) my co-worker, is a single mother
description: An adult visual novel game with full animation, tells the story of a widowed woman named "Tanaka-Keiko". she was abandoned by her husband, and her daughter chose to follow him. because of economic problems, Keiko has to work at a mini market, and met a young man named Fujimoto-Arata.

title: Kinetic Storm
description: Defeat waves of enemies in this action-packed twin stick shooter. After every wave upgrade your ship to customize your build.

title: Knights Crypt
description: Knights Crypt is an action adventure RPG, embark on hundreds of quests, conquer your enemies and make a name for yourself throughout the kingdom. Employ ancient magic and train your combat abilities to restore peace throughout the lands of Altera damaged by the revolt of its people 50 years ago.

title: The King of Fighters XV: Team Samurai
description: Haohmaru, Nakoruru, and Darli Dagger of "Team Samurai" can be used in The King of Fighters XV

title: Konkan Coast Pirate Solutions
description: A puzzle game about helping pirate ships accomplish their pirate goals.

title: Loose Nozzles
description:
Built by a veteran game developer around his young son’s artwork, Loose Nozzles is a slapstick arcade game of flight and rescue. Use simple, two-button controls to pilot your rickety rocket and save endangered colonists over 25 levels of increasing intricacy and menace.
The child-like look masks a grown-up challenge; each collision risks losing a piece of your rocket, turning a mission of precision flight into a chaotic struggle to survive. Master the controls and learn to fly “smooth” – fast, close, and free of injury – to make your way up the leaderboards.
Loose Nozzles is free to play to completion, and a one-time purchase unlocks: unlimited lives, restarting from any level, rocket upgrades, skins that look and fly differently, and alternate play modes for even greater challenge.
Loose Nozzles is a labor of love from Foster and Family Games. We hope you like it!

title: Jumbo Airport Story
description:
Make your fledgling airport into a world-famous international landmark jam-packed with entertainment!
First build facilities such as Bistros and Bookstores to make visitors comfortable.
Satisfied customers make your airport more popular, and will attract even more visitors!
But the bigger your airport gets, the more tired visitors will be from walking around...
Still, never fear! Simply place seating like Benches and Sofas near facilities, and visitors will be able to rest up.

title: Infineural
description:
Infineural is a short horror game that doesn't rely on jumpscares or monsters to shock the player, but instead on the concept of time dilation. This game features multiple endings.

Remember: 1 minute on Earth is 10 years in the warp-drive, so make sure you drink that coffee. It makes you forget.

title: American Commando
description:
Gear up for an explosive journey into the heart of a twisted war! American Commando combines the razor-sharp wit of Duke Nukem, the mind-bending aesthetics of Wolfenstein, and adrenaline-pumping blitzkrieg-style gameplay. Brace yourself, soldier, and rewrite the course of history!

Get ready to immerse yourself in a nostalgia-fueled, 90s-style FPS adventure that will leave you grinning from ear to ear. Embrace the pixelated charm we all adore and prepare to unleash havoc on hordes of Nazi soldiers. Armed with a formidable arsenal of traditional WWII weapons and mind-bending Wunderwaffe prototypes, obliterate your enemies in style!

title: Dawnlands
description: Dawnlands is an Open-World Survival Crafting cross-platform game with a massive world and epic lore. A variety of biomes, relics, and puzzles dot the landscape... an ancient land, lain dormant for centuries, is waiting to be awoken. New stories are waiting to be written.

title: Stormshot
description: 300 brilliant levels await! Come unveil the myth of Treasure Isle!

title: After the Flood
description: Five local teenagers have gone missing from Prairieville, Louisiana. The town is in an uproar. In this first-person survival horror game, play as Detective May Samson, sent to help find these missing kids. Investigate to piece together the story and learn the dark truth behind this simple town.

title: Agenda 21
description: Set amongst the ruins of Joe Biden's America, survival means war. Fight alone or with friends and AI in this brutal third person action game. Everyone from criminal gangs and corrupt cops is out to get you on the streets of Freeside. Do you have what it takes to survive?

title: AI: Art Impostor
description: AI: Art Impostor is the brand new party AI drawing game. You are an artist who commands AI to draw new artwork. You and other artists will collaborate in preparing for the next exhibition, but one of you doesn't know its theme. You should find a fake artist without being doubted by other artists.

title: Air Defenders
description: A small and interesting air defense simulator. Don't let enemy missiles reach their target!

title: Alchemist: The Potion Monger
description: Become the Alchemist not only in your Lab! Open the door of your home, explore, gather ingredients, interact with various characters and sell or use the potions you craft! Design your home and grow plants in the backyard. Be good, bad, or neutral, and write your own alchemical tale!

title: Alice with Gatling
description: This is an exhilarating FPS where you shoot your Gatling Gun and mow down your enemies! Face a horde of monsters as a cute girl "Alice".

title: Alien Invasion
description: The goal of the game is to blast the alien forces and get the highest score possible with your three lives. The tougher the enemy is to destroy, the greater the chance they will drop a valuable power-up.

title: AlphaBlue
description: Cross the universe, shoot aliens, upgrade your weapons and face powerful bosses with AB in this retro inspired lateral shoot 'em up to save the world. Adventure into Campaign Mode or face the never-ending waves of Endless Mode with suitable challenges for all skill levels.

title: Ceplion
description: Unique platforming mechanics with detailed enemy patterns and combat skills. Explore the Ceplion Island and Uncover the dark truth about its people.

title: Chacara
description: Hitting the highway immediately after finishing a crazy party was definitely not a good idea... Now you are stranded on the road, luckily, there is a cozy country house nearby, what could go wrong?

title: ChamberLocked
description: After you were stunned you found yourself in an abandoned house. You got out of bed and tried to leave the room only to find that the door was locked. However, you heard the door outside the room open...

title: ChaseTag
description: Come participate at ChaseTag ! A tag competition where athletes are candy ! Face your friends in intense Player-versus-Player matches, that will make you sweat !

title: Chevalier Historie: Append
description: Follow Jeanne, the first and only female knight in the Kingdom of Berde's lengthy history. She sets out to restore the Royal Ring's power and save the imprisoned Princess Lily. The new Append adds another adventure for Jeanne and her friends, along with many new scenes and events!

title: Chicken Hero in Wulin
description: All Creatures will be uphold justice and "chivalrous".In the familiar world of martial arts,I regenerate a chicken.As a chicken, can you change your life against the weather and create miracles!Become an unprecedented and fantastic Great Xia! Everything is about to start!

title: Choice of the Viking
description: Sail forth to a land of gods and giants! Wield your sword, words, and magic to take your place among Iceland’s chieftains and forge your legacy of honor.

title: Cities: Skylines - Paradise Radio
description: Let the synth sounds surround you on your journey towards endless adventure. This radio station will have you building to 80’s-inspired synth tracks that let your imagination flow freely.

title: Cities: Skylines - Shoreline Radio
description: Play Shoreline Radio and portal yourself to a much slower natural pace. Peace out, transmute your ego into pure self-love and let your heartbeat to a new-age folkish indie vibe.

title: Darold the Doomer: Back 2 Reality
description: The sequel that takes place in the real world.

title: Datasight
description: will take you behind enemy lines as a member of an elite special forces unit engaging in covert warfare, classified operations, and explosive conflicts across the globe. Your actions will tip the balance during the most dangerous time period mankind has ever known.

title: Super Mario Death Row!
description:
Wowza! Nintendo's gone and done something new and exciting for Mario's 35th Anniversary; a playable Nintendo Direct!

That's right! Live out the live execution of everyone's favorite Italian Plumber, all from the comfort of your own home! Browse the gallery of his greatest hits, talk to all of his friends and family, and make Mario face his death with dignity! All in celebration of the world's most famous Goomba-stompin', mushroom-chompin' hero!

title: Dawn of Arba
description: Become a new adventurer in a massive online multiplayer adventure. Explore the new Dawn emerging over the horizon of a new world, ARBA. Although beautiful at first sight, ARBA's history harbors a hidden secret and a much deeper and dangerous truth.

title: Dawn of Kagura: Maika's Story - The Dragon's Wrath
description: Vanquish and recruit youkai in randomized dungeons in Dawn of Kagura: Maika's Story, a replayable roguelike RPG! To save the villagers, Maika decides to take up her pike and go into battle once more...

title: Death Relives
description: Be prepared for a first-person look on life through the eyes of a teenager, who is trying to escape from mighty Aztec god Xipe Totec. Get ready for a chaotic experience with horror and survival mechanics.

title: Deceptus
description: Arena PVP Multiplayer with up to 8 Players, pure mayhem, kill and collect famous death coins to unlock and equip up your characters with famous accessories and power-ups on 9 levels and counting.

title: Decopins: Asset Fighters Series
description: Decopins (meaning flick in japanese) is a tower defense like game with simple click. Don't let Donuts escape from your donuts shop by Clicking! 20 stages, Hell/Death mode, and more. Level up your Decopin and make full use of your MAGIC.

title: Epic Ninja
description: Epic Ninja - Bad Dudes have taken over the Town, Use Your Stealth and Combat Skills to take out the Bad Dudes and Save the Town. Battle Enemies across Several Exciting Levels !

title: Epsylon
description: A private eye mystery game where you decide how to solve the case. Use your detective skills to solve the case or rely on the abilities of your little dragon partner to see things from a new angle.

title: Europe Bus Driver
description: Europe Bus Driver presents a passenger transport simulator through the largest European capitals.

title: Europe Empire 2027
description: Lead your European empire in an empire building turn based strategy war game. Are you ready to lead, Supreme Commander?

title: Expense
description: Balance chance and strategy to escape a procedurally generated maze of unique AI opponents in this first-person adventure/escape room blend. Follow your pendulum and try not to lose money; you're going to need it.

title: Extraction Force
description: Nuclear launch codes have been stolen! Invade the enemy base. Destroy everything in your path. Locate the stolen codes and return them safely to prevent the end of the world.

title: Eyo: Jump 'n' Run RPG
description: Upgrade your robot, equip powerful weapons and defences and uncover the secret of your existence. Merciless enemies, treacherous traps and tricky jump 'n' run passages await you in this Jump 'n' Run RPG adventure by two passionate indie game developers.

title: Freedom Drive
description: Drive for your life, and Freedom. Defeat your challengers, upgrade your vehicle or purchase new more powerful vehicles with your winnings. Race the clock to beat your best time and earn more rewards.

title: Freed Software
description: Freesoft is an IT company simulator. You have to build your own IT empire. Develop your character and your employees. Create the best software in the game world.

title: Frenzy
description: In this simple riff on an arcade classic, released in 1983 for the ZX Spectrum by famed game developer/publisher Ocean Software, search labarinthine levels for the exit, while surviving an ever-increasing onslaught of deadly robots.

title: Half Hour Hexagon
description: Obliterate a never-ending horde of enemies while you attempt to reach the 30 minute mark. Race to earn XP and level up to gain new items and opportunities for each run to become stronger than the last.

title: Halloween Trouble 4
description: Halloween Trouble 4 is a Match 3 game with a cheery yet spooky halloween ambience. The game tells the story of a detective who receives a mysterious invitation to the witch forest. The game also includes minigames for variety and extra fun!

title: Hallway Defender
description: Hallway Defender is a roguelite tower defense where you defend your base from an endless wave of fellow classmates. With over 25 different towers and even more upgrades and effects there are infinite ways to set up your own defenses.

title: Hand Simulator: Rendezvous
description: Hand Simulator: Rendezvous is game for adult fans of the series. Create appointments. Play with friends tete-a-tete or a big group. Chat or do something hot.

title: Handyman Legend
description: The dude was a playboy when he was young, while after losing his job in big company, he become a handyman who take cases from smartphone app. Even though the money is short, but he somehow discovers a new paradise...

title: HardCube 2
description: HardCube 2 is an adventure puzzle game. You play as a cute creature that travels through colorful worlds. Each level has its own history, secrets and dangers!

title: Hero Jumper
description: Hero Jumper is sandbox game where you can destroy objects and do whatever you want.

title: Hidden Office Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Hidden Shapes: Cat Realm
description: The hero kitty sets out on an epic quest to save the princess from a dragon's clutches! Relax and have fun following the story and solving beautiful hand-drawn puzzles in a world of adventurous kittens. A beautiful puzzle created to delight you and rescue your tranquility.

title: Inversion Institute
description: A visual novel/puzzle game set in a medieval fantasy world. Using "Magic Ink," you will draw working logical gizmos and contraptions to solve problems for the Institute and surrounding townsfolk. With the help of other characters, you may even invent a machine that will change the world forever.

title: Isekai Janken Hero
description: The player plays an unemployed man who travels to the other world, where the goddess grants him magical powers and embarks on a journey to save the world... But there seems to be some secret behind this?

title: Is It Wrong to Repay the Debt in a Dungeon?
description: To repay the debt, both Akane and her mother have to earn a lot of money! Explore the dungeon, challenge strong enemies, and even use her own body! Everything she is trying to do is for saving her family!!

title: Super Mario Death Row 2: Shroomshank Redemption
description: Wuh-oh! Looks like Mario's gotten himself in a bit of a pinch! He appears to be safe and sound in the sewers of the Mushroom Kingdom...but how? A mysterious savior seems to have taken pity to Mario's sorry ROM-downloading soul.

title: I Wanna Go Home
description: Can't stand working overtime anymore! Must find some properties to get rid of this ugly office,be aware of the mean boss,don't get caught by him!

title: Jeeps Offroad Simulator
description: Have you ever had the opportunity to participate in a real offroad?

title: Yume Gatari
description: Yume Gatari is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Netsuki, a boy that refuses to leave his room. Once in the dream world, the player can explore and collect effects. A mini game called SOUL can also by played by interacting with the console.

title: Barold
description: A hard 2D fantasy platformer with unique boss fights and bullet hells.

title: Zodiac Fantasy 2
description: The little sisters have an important date (maybe several!) Now they need your help to cross the obstacles, use jumping or climbing flexibly to reach the date, the girls will thank you for it!

title: Let's Go Camping
description: Let's Go Camping places you in the world of nature, combining the useful with the pleasant.

title: Mutants: Genesis
description: Mutants: Genesis is an online card game that you can play solo or with up to 3 players in PvE and PvP modes! Join the next generation of Psycogs and climb the ranks to establish yourself as Champion! Collect hundreds of mutants, fashion your own deck, cooperate with or fight other players!

title: Polestar
description: A turn-based RPG with a Fantasy-Western setting, brimming with giant salamanders, sun-soaked rainbow mountains, and saloons scattered across the land. Discover secret symbols, hunt down outlaws, and ride the rails, all in our unique hand-drawn style.

title: Toast the Ghost
description: Toast the Ghost is a retro platformer, with elements of many classic platformers combined into one crazy adventure!

title: Roost
description: 'ROOST' is a brief atmospheric First Person Horror-Exploration game, set in the fictional North-East English town of Mournbrough - a place harbouring dark secrets and seemingly lost to time. Welcome to your happy place.

title: Namco History Vol. 1
description: Includes Xevious, Super Xevious, Mappy, Motos and Toy Pop.

title: Namco History Vol. 2
description: Includes Tank Battalion, Rally-X, New Rally-X, Phozon, The Tower of Druaga and Grobda.

title: Pileup
description: In PILEUP you play as a green square that is trying to rise up by substituting gray squares underneath it. Since reaching the top of the green square will end the game, you must prevent it from rising. Pink rectangles will fall from above and destroy all the blocks in their path, including you. Dodge them to live as long as possible and earn more points.

title: Clash of Panzer
description: Select your tank, armored vehicle or helicopter. Experience fast pace modern warfare!

title: Let's Minesweeper
description: It's an online Minesweeper game. You can start with any piece of minefield in the vast map. Plan your territory and purify the minefield with numerous players. Sweep at any time, and it's always there for you when you need a break.

title: Streets of Rogue 2
description: Streets of Rogue goes open-world! Fight, sneak, hack, drive, build, farm, quest, craft, and just live in this non-linear sandbox with a focus on fun. Unlimited adventures await!

title: Hazmob FPS: Online Shooter
description:
Online gun shooting game with fast-paced gunfights.Experience the ultimate FPS.

Unleash tactical warfare in intense PvP battles, team up with friends, and dominate the multiplayer arena in our adrenaline-fueled gun shooting game. Get ready for fast-paced action and immerse yourself in the thrill of multiplayer FPS combat.

title: Namco History Vol. 3
description: Includes Pac-Man, Ms. Pac-Man, Dig Dug, Super Pac-Man, Pac & Pal and Dig Dug II.

title: The Witcher Remake
description: Previously codenamed Canis Majoris, The Witcher Remake is being built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5. It is being developed by the Polish studio Fool's Theory, in collaboration with veteran staff from The Witcher series, and is still in development.

title: Waking Knightmare
description: Become a Dream Walker in this high Adrenalin Knightmare! Push yourself to the limits on Single Player for a high score or challenge your friends in a battle with your Knightmares on your side. The choice is yours...

title: Pretty Ninja Himekage
description: This is the story of a group of girl ninjas who fight against "Super Insect Fortress Antross", which has come back from the ancient world. The story part proceeds in the form of an adventure game, and there is also a battle mode against ant-men.

title: Devolution: Maken no Ou to Shimobe-tachi
Hack the Planet
description: Hack The Planet is a roguelike set in a 90s retrofuture all about hacking Netpol, the cops who rule the internet, alongside your BBS of hacker friends. Bypass firewalls, vandalize nodes, and get into petty arguments with your friends as you hunt for the score of a lifetime: The Motherlode.

title: Aikagi 3
description: Aikagi 3 is a console port for the Nintendo Switch.

title: Are You Afraid of the Dark
description: Are you afraid of the dark? you should be. Enjoy this horror game that thrives on your fear of darkness and unknown.

title: Backrooms: Escape Together
description: A visually lifelike 1-6 player co-op survival horror made in Unreal Engine 5. Explore procedurally generated levels that host liminal environments, puzzles, and entities with new levels and content added regularly. You are at the mercy of what's lurking and must do whatever it takes to escape.

title: Backrooms Hide and Seek
description: Team up with your friends online with this MMO, Massively Multiplayer version of Backrooms. You heard me right. This is Backrooms Hide and Seek Hide, be sneaky and beat the other players online. This game features up to 100 online players around the world. Play as Monsters or Humans

title: Barber Shop Simulator
description: Barber Shop Simulator is a first-person simulation game where you run your own barbershop from scratch. Serve a wide variety of customers, each with unique styles and preferences. Offer everything from quick fades to full beard grooming. Upgrade your shop, and become the most chosen barber in town.

title: Bargain Platfomer
description: You will have to run, jump and dodge traps in this old-school platformer game. The ideal game to play in your lunch break.

title: Battle Thunder Front
description: Battle Thunder Front is a unique casual turn-based war game. The background of the game takes the Vietnam War as the theme, and players can fight in the form of small teams or large forces. The game also supports personalized configuration of battle mode for playing

title: Beach Games
description: Your life is like a fairy tale... You worked hard on your internet startup for the last few years. The dating site you created turned out to be a spectacular success, and you became a millionaire youngster...

title: Detective Super Star
description: Join the famous Detective Doyle to solve a series of murder cases in this captivating hidden object, adventure game.

title: Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 2023
description: Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 2023 puts you in the role of general manager of your favorite football team. Every decision can be made by you from drafting, trading, signing free agents right down to creating and calling your own plays to lead your team to championship glory and becoming a dynasty.

title: End of world: Survivors
description: It is the end of the world and you have survived in an under ground bunker. It is your job to rescue survivors and bring them back to your home. You will need to provide them with the means to live by going out in to the zombie infested world and collecting items.

title: Fuktopia 4
description: Fuktopia 4 is a frantic post apocalyptic First Person Shooter.

title: Funeral
description: A tale of existential horror — Attend a funeral and discover the dark secrets that have torn a family apart.

title: Furry Hentai Tangram
description: Enjoy a light challenge with beautiful visuals on this relaxing puzzle game full of cute furry girls!

title: Hold The Line
description: Hold The Line is a 4-player online co-op wave-based zombie shooter. Team up with friends to survive endless waves of the undead, defend your core, upgrade your weapons and barricades at the workbench, and hold the line as the horde grows deadlier with every wave. Featuring multiple enemy types, a wide arsenal of firearms, character customization, and a perk system.

title: Hook&Loop
description: A puzzle and maze 3D game that'll stick in your heart. In this adventure, you as HookGUY has to rescue your love LoopGIRL from the clutches of cotto, a big, bad, and jealous piece of cotton. But you need to dodge all the fluffy people that live in Cottonland.

title: Horoscopicus
description: Horoscopicus is a 2D Retro style platformer where you complete levels based on the zodiac signs! There are also secret animals to find and pet throughout the game! Can you find them all? :D

title: Horticular
description: You have been magically summoned by mysterious gnomes to restore a long-lost garden. Attract adorable animals, build a lush environment, and immerse yourself in this relaxing garden-builder. Will you manage to reclaim the wasteland or succumb to a looming corruption?

title: Infinite Stars: The Visual Novel
description: Infinite Stars is a visual novel filled with romance, mystery & roleplaying elements where you choose how the adventure unfolds. Establish your character & personality through the hundreds of choices presented in this interactive fiction inspired by stories like Dune, The Expanse & Mass Effect.

title: Inner Call
description: Inner Call is a 2D adventure game where you play as a wise orc and help the locals with their problems. For the last 20 years, the forests have been filled with various monsters, which are now aggravating the villagers.

title: Instinct War
description: Enter in a bitesized roguelike dungeon crawller. Choose your hero and face relentless enemies through an everchaging card-based dungeon. Collect items to power up your hero to face the Instinct War.

title: Jumping Cat
description: "Jumping Cat" is a simple and straightforward platform jumping game. In order to revive the lost kingdom, our cat hero puts on his cape and overcomes many obstacles to collect Gold Coins and Paw Gems in dungeons full of traps!

title: Jump Warrior
description: Jump Warrior is a fun and relaxing game. Many enemies and bosses are waiting for you. How many levels can you reach? Let's jump!

title: Ladder Larry
description: A challenging retro arcade platformer game, where you need to clear each level in order to progress in the game. Collect items and bonuses and outwit your opponents to reach the end goal. Climb to the top of the highscore leaderboard to brag on your friends!

title: Lillusion
description: An action role-playing game with a non-linear plot choice. Soul-like running and slashing combat system, Naruto-inspired seal system.

title: Lion King Simulator
description: In this hunting simulator, you will play the role of a predator who is looking for food for himself and his family.

title: Litha and the Sunhouse
description: Litha and the Sunhouse is a rogue-lite dungeon crawler with a flashy, fast-paced combat system. You will explore the complex lair of the mighty Sun Usurper while defeating monsters, collecting treasures, avoiding traps, discovering secrets, and helping unlucky fellows you meet along the way!

title: Littlelands
description: The Littlelands region is brimming with strange characters and magical landscapes to discover if you know where to look, for a big-headed little youngster like you every moment exploring, growing berries, searching for buried treasures or walking through these lands can be an epic adventure.

title: Llama the Farm Drama
description: Play as a Llama! Spit on farm animals, farmers and end-cows. Speedrun cozy farms and unique dungeons in this short, fun and light-hearted platformer.

title: Loading...
description: You are a 10-year-old Kiet. It is 2005, and your brother is dead. Nothing to do but play video games.

title: Lockdown 2024
description: A modern day point-n-click adventure game about a guy who spends a year with seven women locked down in a house due to COVID.

title: Locomotorica: Staggering Ragdoll
description: You are a machine learning model tasked with driving an active ragdoll in a computer physics simulation. Take manual control of your feet to retain balance, walk, navigate obstacles, and perform various tasks. A challenging game partially inspired by Bennett Foddy's work.

title: Lofi Waifu Jigsaw
description: Lofi Waifu Jigsaw is puzzle game in which you have to combine pictures of sexy anime girls into one image using jigsaw pieces. Relaxing gameplay with beautiful artwork and original lofi music will help you calm down after a hard day at work or study.

title: Lone Wolf
description:
Lone Wolf: A Post Apocalyptic Beat-Em Up Role Playing Game. This action/adventure game lets a player use martial arts skills, weapons, and turn into a werewolf to fight their way through a world set in the aftermath of post nuclear devastation.

This game was made with the love of the beat-em up arcade machines and console games of the 1980's and 1990's, taking some of the mechanics of these games mixed with some more modern gameplay.

title: LonlyToy
description: Pass through various obstacles and descend to the next level when you have reached the signpost after crossing all obstacles and mechanisms.You can buy HP at the store. When you end the game due to a trigger mechanism in the middle of the game, you can continue the game from the position before the trigger mechanism by consuming HP instead of restarting.

title: Make Them Naked
description: Four precious girls are waiting for you! Flirt with them and play the rhythm game to Make Them Naked. Make a cup of tea and dive into the world of love! The game allows you to play with one hand thanks to an easy control.

title: Maskonauts: Chat'Attack
description:
Shoot and loot the content of your favorite Twitch channels!
Get in your Maskopod and play in real time with Twitch chats activities! Survive waves of texts, Emoticodes and enemies.
Collect bonuses and try to defeat the Blockbossters and save the Maskotios!

Everything you type in the chat appears in the game!

title: Masterchef Ice Cream Edition
description: Summer is comming... Who doesn't want to eat a tasty ice cream when it's hot outside?

title: Me in the Office
description: Me in the Office is a sandbox destruction game where you can destroy the large three-floor office in different ways. In this game you are anything but a regular employee in an office. Throw furniture, smash glass, raise a fuss or make employees dance - do anything you want, no one will fire you!

title: Memory's Reach
description: Memory’s Reach is a first person puzzle-adventure metroidvania. Explore labyrinthian megastructures, solve mind-bending puzzles, and wield fantastic alien technology in a quest to reveal the legacy of a doomed civilization.

title: Merchant's Rush
description: Roguelike merchant simulator in the times of crisis.

title: Middle East Empire 2027
description: Lead your Middle Eastern empire in an empire building turn based strategy war game. Are you ready to lead, Supreme Commander?

title: Middle Evil: The Priest
description: A young priest is coming in a small village where the local church became full of evil. 2d cartoon arcade game with elements of action, top-down shooter and adventure. Use a cross, a sword, a censer and compose words from the holy book to defeat the creatures of the darkness!

title: Mikey & Grover's Unexpected Adventures
description: Mikey and Grover go on a treasure hunt in a mysterious ancient lighthouse. It seems that everyone in town has a different theory about what is hidden in the lighthouse. The boys don't know what they'll find there, anything is possible. Join them as they embark on a bunch of unexpected adventures!

title: Fury Turn
description: Save the scientists! Prevent biological catastrophe! Eat all the burgers on the way!

title: Gary Grigsby's War in the East 2: Steel Inferno
description: Steel Inferno puts the spotlight on several major offensives that influenced the course of the war in the East, while opening up new areas of the War in the East 2 map. With 8 new Scenarios and 2 new Campaigns, it will significantly expand your War in the East 2 experience.

title: Gems Defenders
description: Match 3 Game, Tower Defense Game and Story driven RPG. Gems Defenders have it all! Match enchanted gems to power up your town, heal your heroes, charge powerful spells, defeat the enemies that are storming the gates of your city and uncover lore of the mysterious Aldenor!

title: Grist
description: Explore the worlds of the mysterious videogame Atropos, engaging in strategic card-based battles and TTRPG-style story choices and skill tests. Plan routes, rush bosses, and press your luck but beware: things that happen in the game may sometimes affect the outside world...

title: Guitar Zeros
description: Guitar Zeros is narrative survival sim where you try to manage your band's hectic life on tour. Take a band from humble beginnings to headliners (and God willing keep them all alive).

title: Hack & Schlitz
description: Hack & Schlitz is an epic random-generated Arcade-Roguelike game. Starting a run will spawn you in a 2d-Pixelstyle dungeon where you can decide what difficulty the next room has.

title: Hidden Shapes: Trick or Cats
description: Relax and have fun with our kittens' trick or treats in Halloween-inspired monster costumes! Solve beautiful hand-drawn puzzles and be amazed by the creativity of our kittens. A beautiful puzzle created to delight you and rescue your tranquility.

title: High School Dirty Secrets
description: High School Dirty Secrets is a horror/puzzle adventure where Kasuga wakes up locked inside her high school with no memory of how she got there. As she searches for a way out, strange and unsettling events unfold, leading her to uncover dark secrets hidden within the school's walls.

title: Highway Cross
description: In this casual game, you will be the guide of several travelers who got lost and need to reach their desired destination.

title: Hohenheim: Skywards
description: Welcome to Hohenheim: Skywards Fly high into the skyes and hope not to fall to the below as the Underbelly is ready to swollow you whole. A 3rd-person Plattformer with environmental puzzle and Randomly generated Maps.

title: Love of Magic Book 3: The Return
description: Love of Magic is an Urban Fantasy Erotic VN/RPG about discovering your destiny, finding true love and becoming a God. Book 3 is the final part of the trilogy.

title: Love Sucks: Night Two
description: This is Love Sucks:Night Two, the second part in your mission to get laid and not die doing it. When sexy monsters are out to kill you for their own mysterious goals, it's date or die! You've survived the first night, but can you survive your second?

title: Ludicrous Uprising
description: Join the (ridiculous) adventure of Kaemill and his allies in the attempt of freeing the lands of Prassa from the hands of evil Taeippa in this beautiful pixelart medieval fantasy JRPG with hand-drawn battle scenes and a story that will crack you up.

title: Lunar: The Last Human
description: Seek the truth and explore the mysterious World after pose-apocalypse, be a guide for "lunar" the last human a lost memory girl blessed by the god with magic power to , A top-down RPG Adventure cure this world back to normal

title: Magical Fairy Force: Champion Edition
description: A competitive top-down shooter inspired by 90s arcade games, Magical Fairy Force - Champion Edition is an exciting, action-packed follow-up to 2020's Atari 5200 original. Choose from one of 16 characters and fly into battle against the computer opponent or up to three friends.

title: Magical Girl Clicker
description: Click & idling! Gather the hearts of cute girls and see their naughty appearance!

title: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII: Reunion - Digital Deluxe Edition
description: In addition to the game, you will also receive a mini soundtrack showcasing the game’s powerful music and an art book filled with gorgeous illustrations.

title: Magic Axolotl
description: Magic Axolotl is a tiny game about draw the spells on the screen to defeat the enemies.

title: Cosplay Club
description: In this tactical turn-based RPG you'll embark on the journey of becoming a Magical Girl cosplayer! But don't let this journey fool you, because this is not just roleplaying: your costumes will give you real life powers, and the world's fate will be in your hands!

title: Maiden Kingdom
description: Maiden Kingdom is a lightweight hentai RPG dating simulator set in a fantasy world.

title: MindHunt
description: MindHunt is a solo/multiplayer detective like game (1-10 players), where you as an agent try to find out which androids are infected in order to shut them down! Well, if you are the infected one, you better blend with other androids and complete all tasks necessary!

title: Mini Skull
description: An adventure game with interactive storylines.

title: Neuro Horror
description: Psychological horror in format of a visual novel, created using a neural network.

title: Nightmare of the Purge
description: The rules are simple! 2 teams with the same number of players the rule of the game is to kill each other and ambush the other team your team must have the most players compared to the other to win at the end of the time limit.

title: Nina Aquila: Legal Eagle, Chapter IV - Sacred Feathers
description: Nina Aquila is back for her brightest, boldest, most magical adventure yet!

title: Nitro Racers
description: Drive the hottest supercars across 30 incredible tracks in Nitro Racers! Drift on slippery ice, slog through sloppy mud, blaze over burning-hot asphalt and a lot more! Push your way through the pack without mercy as you send other cars into walls with explosively-spectacular results!

title: Noel the Mortal Fate: Season 10
description: This is the tale of a girl who lost everything in her deal with a devil and her quest for revenge. Will she and her friends be able to uncover the dark secret that sleeps within the city of Lhaplus...?

title: Nonogram: Girl's Sweets
description: This is a puzzle game called NONOGRAM. Please enjoy cute and sweet anime-like illustrations by solving simple puzzles.

title: Nox Timore Remake
description: Official remake of the original Nox Timore, that was released in 2014. A nightmare, that you come back to every night. Mannequins. Darkness. Horror.

title: NSG
description: NSG tells a story about Hugo, on his last year as a high school student, while he confronts the great dilemma of choosing a career. He dreams about making a movie and needs to decide between his dream and financial stability.

title: Wife of My Boss
description: When your boss is an asshole who ruins your life - it's time to take revenge and steal his wife!

title: Pathogen: Survival
description: Pathogen: Survival is an arcadey wave based FPS zombie game that prioritises progression and customisation.

title: Path to Purge
description: "Path to purge" is a game with simple operation and exciting combat. The game integrates three-dimensional high-precision scene models, distinctive cartoon-rendered characters, and a skill selection system full of changes, providing a tense and exciting combat experience in just a few minutes.

title: Pax Augusta
description: Be part of important decisions within the Roman empire. Build up a prospering city, take care of your citizens, trade goods or earn money to build impressive monuments and hire advisors. Secure your city, increase your power to become senate and maybe the next emperor?

title: PermaNight
description: Survive in a world full of darkness. Gain resources. Kill entities. Repeat. But beware, there might be entities lurking around...

title: PhD
description: Will you navigate the intricacies of the scientific world to get your PhD?

title: Pip 4
description: PIP 4 — cute puzzle game with pipes. Enjoy a relaxing time connecting pipes.

title: Pixel Chan
description: Pixel version of cute girls in relaxing puzzle game.

title: Pixelmancer
description: Pixelmancer is a casual roguelite game developed by a single developer. You play as a necromancer with pets that will aid on your journey, you can upgrade almost anything for your hero and your pets. You will die constantly but become stronger and better with every death. How far can you go?

title: Pixel Starships 2
description: Pixel Starships 2; the sequel to the popular Pixel Starships game is currently in development. Please add to your wishlist to receive the latest updates.

title: Planet U
description: An attractive and shape changing adventure

title: Play with Me 2: On the Other Side
description: It is the sequel to the game Play with Me: Escape room. Use again the available objects in your room, outwit tricky illusions and optical puzzles and above all, answer the question – will you play with me too?

title: Psychedelia: The Psychonaut
description: Trippy Clever Funny Relaxing Adventure For someone looking to kick back and relax and get immersed in a psychedelic world.

title: Pushing Popo
description: This game is a simple 2D puzzle game. You control a character to move boxes and reach the goal to complete the game. Gimmicks are added as you progress.

title: Puzzle: Triangles
description: Puzzle: Triangles - The game is a challenging and interesting puzzle game.

title: Quatro!
description: Make regrets and lose the rest of your friends in this terrifying card game

title: Quest Hunter: Strangewood
description: Strangewood is a story addition to Quest Hunter. Explore new locations, fight with new enemies, solve puzzles with new mechanics. Level up new skills and get new weapons and equipment. Play alone or together with your old and new friends!

title: Quiet Town
description: Explore a wildness world full of strange creatures, relics and resources. Lumber, mine, build, fight, craft and farm to survival in this stranger land.

title: Ralph and the Blue Ball
description: Ralph needs your help to find all his toys especially his lovely little blue ball. Embark on a very charming hidden object game based on a true story.

title: Randy Blaster 3D
description: Randy Blaster 3D is a satirical retro-style FPS game where the player faces off against an evil overlord named Randy and his devoted followers. Battle hordes of corrupted beasts and collect Randy’s Vinyls of Power to bring his reign of terror to an end.

title: RC Dash
description: Dash to a high score in this racing platformer to become #1 on the leaderboards.

title: Rebel Inc: Escalation - Sand & Secrets
description: Control the Oil. Control the Region. Take command and stabilise Golden Sands, a vast desert of riches. Uncover secrets in four new official scenarios, from stealthy insurgents to supercharged tanks and even oil infernos.

title: Reilla: Sweets Adventure
description: A magical world full of sweets! The heroine, Leila, is a wizard girl who loves sweets. She comes to the world of sweets with her "Sweets Parasol," a magical umbrella that turns sweets into power!A magical sweet adventure filled with sweets begins now!

title: Relieve
description: "Relieve" is a hand-drawn comic style narrative puzzle visual novel with unique art and high-quality music. It allows you to experience the story of a couple's separation and reunion from different perspectives.

title: Remy Raccoon and the Lost Temple: Halloween Hijinks - Volume 2
description: Remy Raccoon is back in this Halloween special of our cute, gem-grabbing arcade game. Join Remy in 11 brand new Halloween levels filled with fiendish traps and malevolent creatures. Your adventure awaits...

title: Rungore
description: Card game mechanics - check; Real time battles - check; Silly humor - check. If this isn't the game of your dreams i don't know what is (Also we have hidden memes everywhere lol)

title: RunMan Turbo
description: The indie legend returns, now in a 2D platformer where you speedrun randomly generated levels. Bounce, slide, jump, and run fast as heck. Easy to play and challenging to master, with an awesome soundtrack and a style that will make you go, "Oh snap!"

title: Rush Red & Blue
description: In this game, the player and a bot race in the cyberspace. The first car to finish 2 laps wins. There are two arrows and a prop in the track. Use these to complete the race faster!

title: Saga Cube
description: A fun and casual puzzle platformer where you play as Heuggy the little mouse. Alongside Koda the fox, you travel the world in search of cube fragments in order to restore the harmony between humans and foxes.

title: Sagger
description: This is a free part of the Sagger game - historical simulator that will give you control over all Israel resources to face the Yom Kippur War. With the help of your advisor and knowledge, you will acquire, make the crucial decisions that will lead the state of Israel to Victory or Defeat.

title: Skeleton Punchers
description: Explosive 2D Pixel Art Action! Help the Skeleton Punchers defeat the Zerpian army of the night and recover the Patrician's Hoard before it's too late!

title: Square Off
description: Square Off is a mayhem filled local party arena brawler where you must roll to move, move to aim, and aim to win by battling it out with up to 3 of your friends in short-chaos filled matches.

title: StarMaker VR
description: Start your music journey in StarMaker VR, sing to release the real you, and dance with your souls in the melody of the music, you will enjoy what you have changed.

title: Starr Ringer
description: Grab the fate of all life in your hands. Blast your way through the cosmos, destroying monstrous cosmic beasts and the space cultists summoning them, on your path to stopping your mother from unleashing the chaos realm upon the universe, in this sci-fi cosmic horror bullet-hell, STARR RINGER.

title: Stellar Mess: The Princess Conundrum - Chapter 1
description: Stellar Mess is a 2D point&click adventure game, set somewhere in Argentinean Patagonia. The game is inspired by early classic EGA games of the genre.

title: Storekeeper Revenge
description: Storekeeper is a miniature story puzzle game with simple mechanics. The gameplay consists of emails that need to be delivered to the browser.

title: Stray Cat
description: Is a game about a homeless cat who decided to save money for a new home. 2D platformer with a side view, where you will play as a brave cat who decided to collect all the coins on his way and destroy evil opponents.

title: The Pentest
description: The Pentest is a first-person puzzle game. You play as a pentestor in charge of the security audit of the space station Achero 410. You will have to use your gear and skills to detect all the flaws and complete your mission.

title: The Riftbreaker: World Expansion II
description: Explore an entirely new area of Galatea 37 in this Story Campaign expansion for The Riftbreaker. Catalog new species. Craft new and unique weapons. Fight hordes of aliens, unlike anything you've seen before.

title: The Roc
description: Venture into the dark realm of the legendary Roc, Run from cover to cover, Be wary of wild beasts and supernatural terrors and use your hand cannon if you have to, Find all ancient tablets and put an end to the Roc's Tyranny.

title: The Senex Bird
description: In this story-driven adventure, you're an old bird at a castle full of senile geezers. While enduring their bad gags, you're pulled into a conflict about … cows and meat? On a journey to save Senexcastle, you meet quirky fellas, play minigames and slowly uncover the truth while trying to stay sane.

title: The True Love Rings
description: "The True Love Rings" is a scene interactive decryption game. The overall atmosphere is casual and relaxed. Players follow the prompts in the scene to gradually solve the puzzles and help solve the problems encountered in life.

title: The Twilight of Infinity Episode 5: Flight into Yesterday - The Disappearance of Amelia Earhart
description: What happened to Amelia Earhart and Fred Noonan? Where did their plane go? A mystery that remains to this day, perhaps Alex and Professor Emit could have the answer..

title: The Waterflame Brothers
